translations.translation: parama karuNAmaYa, asIma daYAlu AllAhara nAme zuru karachi|
sakala prazaMsA AllAhara janya, yini jagatasamUhera rava|
yini parama karuNAmaYa, asIma daYAlu|
yini vicAra-divasera mAlika|
AmarA kevala ApanArai ivAdAta kari; Ara kevala ApanArai sAhAyya cAi|
Apani AmAderake sarala-sudRr3ha pathe paricAlita karuna|
tAdera patha yAdera opara Apani niYAmAta varSaNa karechena; tArA naYa, yAdera opara gajava par3eche (iYAhUdidera), evaM tArAo naYa, yArA pathabhraSTa (khriSTAna) |
Alipha lA-ma mI-ma|
eTA sei mahAna kitAva, yAra madhye keAno sandeha nei, muttAkidera janya eTi hidAYAta|
yArA adRSTa viSaYe ImAna Ane evaM sAlAta pratiSThA kare| Ara Ami tAderake ye riyika diYechi, tA theke (AmAra pathe) vyaYa kare|
evaM yArA tAra prati ImAna Ane, yA teAmAra prati avatIrNa haYeche evaM yA avatIrNa haYeche teAmAra pUrve evaM yArA AkhirAte nizcita vizvAsa kare|
tArAi tAdera ravera pakSa theke hidAYAtera opara Ache, Ara tArAi saphalakAma|
nizcaYai yArA kuphuri kareche, tAderake tumi bhIti pradarzana karo Ara nA karo—tAdera janya ubhaYai samAna, tArA ImAna Anave nA |
AllAha tAdera antare evaM tAdera karNakuhare mohara mere diYechena evaM tAdera dRSTira opara raYeche AvaraNa; Ara tAdera janya raYeche mahAzAsti|
Ara mAnuSera madhye emanao raYeche, yArA vale, AmarA AllAha o kiYAmAta divasera prati ImAna enechi; athaca tArA mu ’ mina naYa|
tArA AllAha evaM yArA ImAna eneche tAderake dheA~kA dite cAYa| vAstave tArA nijederakei dho~kA deYa; athaca tArA tA anudhAvana kare nA |
tAdera antare vyAdhi raYeche; ataHpara AllAha tAdera vyAdhi Arao vRddhi karechena, Ara tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti; kAraNa, tArA mithyA valata|
Ara yakhana tAdera valA haYa ye, duniYAra vuke viparyaYa sRSTi kareA nA, takhana tArA vale, AmarAi teA (samAjera) saMskAraka|
sAvadhAna! tArAi viparyaYa sRSTikArI, kintu tArA tA anudhAvana kare nA|

Ara yakhana tAdera valA haYa, ‘teAmarA ImAna Ano yebhAve lokerA ImAna eneche| tArA vale, ‘AmarA ki ImAna Anava sebhAve, yebhAve nirvodherA ImAna eneche’? sAvadhAna! prakRtapakSe tArAi nirvodha; kintu tArA jAne nA|

Ara yakhana tArA mu ’ minadera sAthe sAkSAt kare, tArA vale, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’, AvAra yakhana tArA tAdera zaYatAna netAdera sAthe ekAnte sAkSAt kare, tArA vale, ‘AmarA teAmAdera sAthe raYechi, AmarA teA kevala (musalamAnadera sAthe) upahAsakArI|
AllAhao tAdera upahAsera javAva dena; Ara tAderake avakAza dena, tArA nijedera avAdhyatAYa vibhrAnta haYe ghure ver3AYa|
tArAi yArA hidAYAtera vinimaYe bhraSTatA kraYa kareche; sutarAM tAdera vyavasA lAbhajanaka haYani evaM tArA hidAYAtaprAptao naYa|

tAdera dRSTAnta oi vyaktira mato, ye Aguna prajvalita karala, ataHpara Aguna yakhana cArapAza Alokita karala, takhana AllAha tAdera AleA uThiYe nilena evaM tAderake ghora andhakAre cher3e dilena; phale, tArA kichui dekhate pAYa nA|
tArA vadhira, mUka o andha; sutarAM tArA phire Asave nA|

kiMvA AkAza theke varSaNamukhara ghana meghera mato, yAte raYeche nikaSa A~dhAra, vajradhvani o vidyutcamaka| tArA vajramAlAra kAraNe mRtyura bhaYe tAdera kAne AGula deYa; Ara AllAha kAphiradera pariveSTanakArI|

vidyutAleAka tAdera dRSTizakti ker3e neoYAra upakrama haYa| yakhanai tAdera sAmane Alo udbhAsita haYa takhanai tArA patha cale tAra madhye, AvAra yakhana andhakArAcchanna haYa, takhana tArA ThAYa dA~r3iYe yAYa| yadi AllAha cAitena, tA hale tAdera zravaNazakti o dRSTizakti chiniYe nite pAratena| AllAha sakala viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
he mAnavakula, teAmarA teAmAdera ravera ivAdAta karo, yini teAmAdera evaM teAmAdera pUrvavartIdera sRSTi karechena; tAhale teAmarA tAkaoYA arjana karate pArave|

oi sattA, yini bhUmike teAmAdera janya vAniYechena vichAnA evaM AkAzake vAniYechena chAda, Ara AkAza theke vRSTi varSaNa karena, ataHpara tA dvArA teAmAdera jIvikAra janya phalamUla utpanna karena| ataeva, tomarA jene-zune kAuke AllAhara samakakSa vAniYo nA|

Ami AmAra vAndAra prati yA avatIrNa karechi tAte yadi teAmarA keAno sandehe thAko, tave tAra mato ekaTi sUrA (racanA kare) niYe eso evaM AllAha vyatIta teAmAdera sAhAyyakArIdera AhvAna karo, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao|
anantara yadi tA nA pAra, Ara teAmarA kakhano tA pArave nA, tA hale se Aguna theke vA~cAra ceSTA karo, yAra jvAlAni have mAnuSa o pAthara; yA prastuta karA haYeche kAphiradera janya|

susaMvAda dAo, yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche, nizcaYai tAdera janya raYeche emana jAnnAta—yAra pAdadeze pravAhita haYa nada-nadI| yakhanai tAderake tA hate phalamUla jIvikA hiseve deoYA have, tArA valave, ‘e to tA-i, yA pUrveo jIvikA hiseve AmAdera deoYA haYeche’; Ara tAderake ekai dharanera phala pradAna karA have evaM sekhAne tAdera janya thAkave pavitra saGginI; Ara tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|

nizcaYai AllAha mazA vA tAra ceYeo kSudra vastu dvArA upamA peza karate lajjAveAdha karena nA| Ara yArA mu’mina tArA jAne ye, nizcaYai tA satya tAdera ravera pakSa theke| Ara yArA kuphuri kareche, tArA vale, emana upamA dvArA AllAha kI (vojhAte) cAna? era dvArA AllAha anekake vibhrAnta karena, AvAra anekake hidAYAta karena| Ara ekamAtra pApAcArIderakei tini tAra dvArA vibhrAnta karena|
yArA AllAhara saGge dRr3habhAve aGgIkArAvaddha haoYAra para tA bhaGga kare evaM tArA chinna kare yA AllAha akSuNna rAkhate nirdeza diYechena, Ara pRthivIra vuke azAnti sRSTi kare—tArAi kSatigrasta|

kIbhAve teAmarA AllAhara sAthe kuphuri kara? athaca teAmarA chile niSprANa| ataHpara tinii teAmAdera prANa diYechena, AvAra mRtyu devena, punarAYa teAmAdera jIvita karavena, ataHpara tA~rai dike tomAdera phiriYe neoYA have |

tinii se sattA, yini tomAdera janya sRSTi karechena yA kichu Ache pRthivIte, savakichu| ataHpara tini AsamAnera dike manoyogI haYechena, ataHpara tini tAke sAtaTi AsamAne suvinyasta karechena| Ara tini sava viSaYe sarvajJa|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana teAmAra rava pherezatAdera valalena, ‘nizcaYai Ami pRthivIte eka pratinidhi sRSTi karate yAcchi’; tArA valala, ‘Apani ki pRthivIte emana kAuke sRSTi karavena, ye sekhAne viparyaYa sRSTi karave evaM raktapAta ghaTAve? athaca AmarAi ApanAra prazaMsAsaha tAsaviha pATha karachi evaM ApanAra pavitratA varNanA karachi;’ tini valalena, ‘niHsandehe Ami yA jAni, teAmarA tA jAno nA|’
Ara tini Adamake zekhAlena yAvatIYa nAma| tArapara segulo pherezatAdera sAmane upasthApana kare valalena, ‘AmAke teAmarA eguleAra nAma vale dAo, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI haYe thAko|’
tArA valala, ‘Apani mahAna pavitra! AmAdera kono jJAna nei, tA vyatIta—Apani AmAdera yA zikhiYechena, tA vyatIta; nizcaYai Apanii sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|’

tini valalena, ‘he Adama, tAdera tumi vale dAo sesavera nAmadhAma|’ tArapara yakhana Adama tAderake vale dila tini (AllAha) valalena, ‘Ami ki teAmAdera valini, nizcaYai Ami jAni AsamAnasamUha o yaminera geApana viSaYa evaM Ami jAni yA teAmarA prakAza kara, Ara yA teAmarA geApana kara?’

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami pherezatAdera valalAma, ‘tomarA Adamake sijadA karo’; takhana tArA (savAi) sijadA karala ivalIsa vyatIta; se asvIkAra karala evaM ahaMkAra karala| phale se haYe gela kAphiradera antarbhukta|

evaM Ami valalAma, ‘he Adama, tumi o teAmAra strI jAnnAte vasavAsa karo evaM sekhAna theke yA icche svAcchandye AhAra karo; kintu e gAchera nikaTavartI haYeA nA; hale teAmarA have sImAlaGghanakArIdera antarbhukta|’

ataHpara zaYatAna tAdera sekhAna theke padaskhalita karala; tAderake vera kare dila sekhAna theke yekhAne tArA chila| Ami valalAma, ‘teAmarA neme yAo, eke anyera zatrurUpe| teAmAdera janya nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta raYeche pRthivIte avasthAna Ara upabhogya vastu|’
ataHpara Adama tAra ravera pakSa theke kichu kAlimA lAbha karala, tArapara tini tAke kSamA karalena; nizcaYai tini tAovA kavulakArI o asIma daYAlu|

Ami valalAma, ‘teAmarA sakale ekhAna theke nice neme yAo| ataHpara nizcaYai Asave AmAra pakSa theke tomAdera nikaTa hidAYAta; ataeva, ye anusaraNa karave AmAra nirdezanA, tAdera kono bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhita have nA|’
Ara yArA kuphuri karave evaM AmAra nidarzanasamUha mithyA pratipanna karave, tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI; tArA sekhAne cirakAla thAkave|

he vani isarAIla, teAmarA smaraNa karo, tomAdera prati AmAra niYAmAtera kathA evaM teAmarA pUrNa karo AmAra sAthe kRta pratijJA, tave Amio teAmAdera deoYA pratizruti pUrNa karava; Ara AmAkei bhaYa karo |

Ara teAmarA ImAna Ano tAra prati yA Ami avatIrNa karechi, yA teAmAdera sAthe yA Ache tAra satyAYanakArI| Ara teAmarA tAra prathama asvIkArakArI haYeA nA, Ara AmAra AYAtake svalpa mUlye vikri karo nA | Ara AmAkei bhaYa karo|
teAmarA satyake mithyAra sAthe mizrita karo nA evaM jAnA sattveo satyake geApana kareA nA|
Ara sAlAta kAYema karo, yAkAta pradAna karo evaM yArA ruku karata, tAdera sAthe ruku karo|
teAmarA ki lokajanake satkarmera nirdeza dAo evaM nijedera bhule yAo! athaca teAmarA kitAva tilAoYAta kara; tavuo ki teAmarA anudhAvana karave nA?
tomarA sAhAyya cAo sAlAta o savarera mAdhyame; nizcaYai tA kaThina, vinaYIrA chAr3A|
yArA vizvAsa kare ye, nizcaYai tArA tAdera ravera sAthe sAkSAt karave evaM nizcaYai tArA tA~rai dike phire yAve|
he vani isarAIla, teAmarA smaraNa karo AmAra niYAmAtera kathA, yA Ami teAmAdera diYechi evaM Ami teAmAdera samagra vizvavAsIra opara zreSThatva diYechi|

Ara se dinake bhaYa karo, yedina keu kArao sAmAnya upakAre Asave nA evaM tArao pakSe keAno supArizao kavula karA have nA; evaM kArao nikaTa theke vinimaYa grahaNa karA have nA evaM tArA sAhAyyaprApta have nA|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami tomAdera niSkRti diYechi phiraAunera sampradAYa theke, tArA teAmAdera marmAntika zAsti dita, teAmAdera putradera javAi karata o nArIdera jIvita rAkhata| Ara ete tomAdera ravera pakSa theke tomAdera janya chila mahAparIkSA|
Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami teAmAdera janya sAgarake vibhakta karechi, ataHpara teAmAdera uddhAra karechi evaM phiraAunera vaMzake DuviYe diYechi, Ara teAmarA tA tAkiYe dekhachile|
Ara yakhana Ami mUsAra sAthe oYAdA karechilAma calliza rAtera, ataHpara tAra anupasthitite teAmarA garura vAchurake ilAharUpe grahaNa karechile; Asale teAmarA sImAlaGghanakArI|
tAraparao Ami teAmAdera kSamA karechi, yena teAmarA kRtajJatA svIkAra karo|
Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami mUsAke kitAva o phurakAna diYechi, yAte tomarA hidAYAta lAbha karate pAra|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana valala, mUsA tAra sampradAYake, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA nijedera prati yuluma karecha garura vAchurake grahaNa kare; ataeva, tomarA tAovA karo tomAdera sRSTikartAra nikaTa evaM tomAdera nijederake hatyA karo—eTAi teAmAdera janya kalyANakara teAmAdera sRSTikartAra nikaTa| tArapara tini teAmAdera kSamA karalena; nizcaYai tini atIva kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|’

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana teAmarA valale, ‘he mUsA, kakhanoi AmarA tomAra prati ImAna Anava nA, yatakSaNa nA AmarA AllAhake prakAzye dekhava|’ phale teAmAdera vajra pAkar3Ao karala, ematAvasthAYa tomarA tA pratyakSa karachile|
ataHpara Ami tomAdera punarjIvita karalAma tomAdera mRtyura para, yAte teAmarA kRtajJatA prakAza karo|

Ara Ami teAmAdera opara meghamAlA dvArA chAYA dAna karechilAma evaM teAmAdera janya ‘mAnnA’ o ‘sAlaoYA’ avatIrNa karechilAma| ‘tomarA khAo pavitra jinisa theke—yA Ami teAmAdera riyika diYechi|’ Ara tArA AmAra opara yuluma kareni varaM tArA nijedera pratii yuluma kareche|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami valalAma, ‘teAmarA e nagarIte praveza karo evaM tA theke yA icchA svAcchandye AhAra karo evaM toraNa diYe praveza karo natazire, Ara valo—‘kSamA cAi’; tave Ami teAmAdera kSamA kare deva, Ara acirei Ami satkarmazIladera (pratidAna) vAr3iYe deva|’

kintu yAlimarA parivartana kare phelala—yA valA haYechila tAra parivarte anya kathA dvArA| phale Ami avatIrNa karalAma tAdera opara yArA yuluma kareche AsamAna theke eka zAsti, e-kAraNe ye, tArA pApAcAra karachila|

Ara smaraNa karo, mUsA yakhana nija jAtira janya pAni prArthanA karala, Ami valalAma, ‘tumi tomAra lAThi diYe pAthare AghAta karo’, phale tA theke pravAhita halo vAroTi prasravaNa| pratyeka gotra nija nija pAni pAnera sthAna jene nila| (takhana Ami valalAma) ‘tomarA AllAhapradatta jIvikA hate pAnAhAra karo evaM viparyaYa sRSTikArI haYe pRthivIra madhye vAr3AvAr3i karo nA|’

Ara yakhana teAmarA valale, ‘he mUsA, AmarA ekai (dharaNera) khAvArera opara moTeo dhairyadhAraNa karava nA| kAjei Apani ApanAra ravera nikaTa AmAdera janya prArthanA karuna, tini yena utpAdana karena AmAdera janya bhUmite yA utpanna haYa, tA hate tarakAri, kA~kar3i, gama, masuri, pe~YAja prabhRti|’ tini valalena, ‘teAmarA ki uttama vastu parivartana kare anuttama vastu nite cAo? tave teAmarA keAno nagarIte upanIta hao, sekhAne Ache tomAdera prArthita jinisa|’ ataHpara tAdera opara AreApita halo lAJchanA o daridratA| tArA AllAhara pakSa theke gayava Tene Anala| eTA ejanya ye, tArA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIke asvIkAra karata evaM navigaNake anyAYabhAve hatyA karata| tAdera e pariNati haYechila sImAlaGghana o avAdhyatAra kAraNe|

nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche evaM yArA iYAhUdi, nAsArA o sAveYi, (tAdera madhya theke) yArAi AllAha o kiYAmAta divasera prati ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche, tAdera janya raYeche puraskAra tAdera ravera nikaTa| Ara tAdera keAno bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhita have nA|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami teAmAdera theke aGgIkAra niYechilAma evaM tUra pAhAr3ake teAmAdera opara tule dharalAma ye, ‘Ami teAmAdera yA diYechi tA dRr3habhAve A~kar3e dharo evaM ete yA Ache tA smaraNa rAkho, tA hale teAmarA tAkaoYA arjana karate pArave|’
ataHpara teAmarA punarAYa phire gele! yadi AllAhara anugraha o anukampA teAmAdera opara nA thAkata, tave avazyai teAmarA kSatigrasta haYe yete|
Ara avazyai tomAdera madhye yArA zanivArera vyApAre sImAlaGghana kareche tAdera vyApAre tomarA jenecha| Ami tAdera valechilAma, ‘teAmarA lAJchita vAnara haYe yAo|’
ataHpara Ami eTAke tAdera sAmasAmaYika o paravartIdera janya dRSTAnta vAniYechi Ara muttAkidera janya karechi upadeza|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana mUsA tAra jAtike valala, ‘AllAha teAmAdera ekaTi garu javAi karate Adeza dicchena|’ tArA valala, ‘Apani ki AmAdera sAthe ThATTA karachena?’ se valala, ‘Ami AllAhara kAche AzraYa cAi, yena Ami mUrkhadera antarbhukta nA hai|’

tArA valala, ‘Apani ApanAra ravera kAche AmAdera janya prArthanA karuna, tini seTi kemana, tA varNanA karena|’ se valala, ‘tini valachena, seTA have emana eka gAbhI, yA ati vRddhao naYa evaM alpavaYaskao naYa—madhyavaYasI| ataeva, tomarA pAlana karo yA karate tomarA AdiSTa haYecha|’

tArA valala, ‘Apani ApanAra ravera kAche AmAdera janya prArthanA karuna, tini varNanA kare dena tAra raM kemana have?’ se valala, ‘tini valechena, seTA haluda varNera garu, ujjvala gAr3ha raMviziSTa—yA darzakake Anandita karave|’

tArA valala, ‘Apani ApanAra ravera kAche AmAdera janya prArthanA karuna, yena tini varNanA karena seTA kIrUpa? nizcaYai gAbhITi AmAdera kAche sandehapUrNa haYe geche| AllAha yadi cAna, evAra AmarA avazyai dizA pAva|’

se valala, ‘tini valachena, seTA emana eka gAbhI yA jami cASe o kSete pAni sece vyavahRta haYani—sustha o nikhu~ta|’ tArA valala, ‘etakSaNe Apani yathAyatha vivaraNa niYe esechena|’ avazeSe tArA seTAke javAi karala, yadio tArA tA karate prastuta chila nA|
Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana tomarA eka vyaktike hatyA karechile, tArapara eke anyake doSAropa karechile se viSaYe, Ara tomarA yA gopana karachile AllAha tA prakAza karechena|
ataHpara Ami valalAma, ‘era kono aMza diYe tAke AghAta karo|’ ebhAvei AllAha mRtadeke jIvita karena evaM tomAderake dekhAna tAra nidarzanAvali—yAte tomarA anudhAvana karate pAra|

era pareo teAmAdera antara kaThina haYe gela; tA pAtharera nyAYa athavA Arao vezi kaThina| kichu pAthara emanao Ache, yA theke pravAhita haYa nada-nadI, emanao Ache, yA vidIrNa haYa| ataHpara tA theke pAni nirgata haYa evaM emanao Ache, yA AllAhara bhaYe dhase par3e; AllAha teAmAdera kAjakarma samparke vekhavara nana|
teAmarA ki AzA kara ye, tArA teAmAdera prati ImAna Anave? athaca tAdera ekadala AllAhara vANI zravaNa karata, ataHpara tA bhAlobhAve vojhAra parao jenezune tA vikRta karata|

yakhana tArA mu’minadera sAthe sAkSAt kare, takhana vale, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi|’ Ara yakhana tArA paraspara nibhRte avasthAna kare, takhana tArA vale, ‘tomarA ki tA vale diccha yA AllAha teAmAdera nikaTa prakAza kare diYechena? phale tArA era mAdhyame tomAdera ravera nikaTa tomAdera viruddhe pramANa peza karave? teAmarA ki tA upalavdhi karo nA?’
tArA ki jAne nA ye, nizcaYai AllAha sesava viSaYao parijJAta—yA tArA geApana kare Ara yA prakAza kare?
Ara tAdera mAjhe emana kichu nirakSara leAka Ache yArA (mithyA) AkAGkSA chAr3A kitAva samparke kichui jAne nA; tArA zudhu amUlaka dhAraNA poSaNa kare|

ataeva, tAdera janya durbhoga yArA nija hAte kitAva racanA kare evaM vale, ‘eTA AllAhara pakSa theke’, yena tArA era dvArA arjana karate pAre tuccha vinimaYa| ataeva, dhvaMsa tAdera janya, se-kAraNe yA tAdera hAta racanA kareche, tAra janya evaM dhvaMsa tAdera janya, yA tArA upArjana kareche, se-kAraNeo|

tArA vale, ‘nirdiSTa kaYekadina vyatIta kakhano Aguna AmAdera sparza karave nA|’ valo, ‘teAmarA ki AllAhara kAcha theke keAno aGgIkAra grahaNa karecha, AllAha yAra viparIta kakhano karavena nA; nAki tomarA AllAhara vyApAre emana kathA valo—yA tomarA jAno nA?’
avazyai yArA pApa arjana kare evaM tA tAderake pariveSTana kare neYa, tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI; tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|
pakSAntare yArA ImAna Ane evaM satkAja kare, tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI; tArA sekhAne cirasthAYI have|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami vani isarAIlera kAcha theke aGgIkAra grahaNa karalAma ye, teAmarA AllAha chAr3A kArao ivAdAta karave nA, pitA-mAtA, nikaTajana, iYAtIma o daridradera sAthe sadaYa AcaraNa karave, Ara mAnuSake uttama kathA valave, sAlAta kAYema karave evaM yAkAta pradAna karave, tArapara tomAdera madhya theke kichusaMkhyaka vyatIta teAmarA sakale upekSA kare mukha phiriYe niYecha|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami teAmAdera theke aGgIkAra niYechilAma ye, teAmarA paraspara raktapAta ghaTAve nA evaM tomarA tomAdera vAr3i-ghara theke Apana vyaktiderake vahiSkAra karave nA, ataHpara teAmarA tA svIkAra karechile evaM teAmarAi tAra sAkSI|

ataHpara teAmarAi sesava loka yArA paraspara khuna-khArAvi karacha evaM teAmAderai ekadalake tAdera vAr3i-ghara theke vera kare diccha| tomarA eke anyera viruddhe sahayogitA karacha tAdera opara anyAYa o sImAlaGghana dvArA| Ara tArA yakhana vandi haYe teAmAdera kAche Ase, takhana tomarA tAdera muktipaNa dAo; athaca tAdera vahiSkAra karAo teAmAdera janya hArAma chila| tave ki teAmarA kitAvera kichu aMzera prati ImAna Anacha evaM kichu aMzera prati kuphuri karacha? tA hale tomAdera yArA erUpa kare tAdera ekamAtra pratiphala duniYAra jIvane lAJchanA evaM kiYAmAtera dina tAdera kaThoratara zAstira dike niYe yAoYA have| Ara tomarA yA kara, AllAha se vyApAre vekhavara nana|
tArAi se sava loka, yArA parakAlera vinimaYe pArthiva jIvana kraYa kareche; ataeva, edera theke zAsti laghu karA have nA evaM tArA sAhAyya pAve nA|

avazyai Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechi| evaM tAra pare paryAYakrame aneka rAsUla pAThiYechi| Ami mAraiYAma-putra IsAke spaSTa aneka nidarzana dAna karechi evaM rUhula kudusa dvArA tAke zaktizAlI karechi| ataHpara yakhanai keAno rAsula teAmAdera kAche emana kono nirdeza niYe eseche, yA teAmAdera naphasa pachanda kare nA, takhanai teAmarA ahaMkAra karecha| zeSa paryanta teAmarA ekadalake mithyAvAdI valecha evaM ekadalake hatyA karecha|
tArA valala, ‘AmAdera hRdaYa AcchAdita’; varaM tAdera kuphurira kAraNe AllAha tAderake abhizApa diYechena| tAi tArA alpai ImAna rAkhe|

Ara yakhana AllAhara pakSa theke tAdera kAche kitAva elo satyAYanakArIrUpe tAra yA tAdera sAthe Ache, Ara itaHpUrve tArA kAphiradera viruddhe vijaYa pratyAzA karata| parizeSe yakhana tAdera paricita kitAva elo yA tArA cinata, takhana tArA tAra sAthe kuphuri karala| ataeva, kAphiradera opara AllAhara lA‘nata|

tA katai nA manda, yAra vinimaYe tArA nijedera vikri kareche—ye tArA AllAhara avatIrNa viSaYe kuphuri karache vidveSavazata zudhu ekAraNe ye, AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhya theke yAra prati icchA nija anugraha avatIrNa karena| ataeva, tArA kreAdhera opara kreAdha puJjIbhUta kareche| Ara kAphiradera janya raYeche apamAnajanaka zAsti|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘tomarA ImAna Ano tAra prati—yA AllAha nAyila karechena’, tArA vale, ‘AmarA ImAna Anava oi viSaYera prati—yA AmAdera opara nAyila karA haYeche|’ era vAire yA Ache tA tArA asvIkAra kare| athaca tA satya, satyAYanakArI—tAra yA tAdera nikaTa raYeche| valo, ‘tave kena teAmarA itaHpUrve naviderake hatyA karate, yadi teAmarA mu’mina haYe thAka?’
Ara avazyai mUsA teAmAdera kAche eseche suspaSTa pramANAdi niYe| teAmarA tArapareo garura vAchurake (upAsyarUpe) grahaNa karecha; vAstavikai teAmarA sImAlaGghanakArI|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami teAmAdera nikaTa theke pratizruti niYechi evaM tomAdera opara tUra pAhAr3ake tule dharechi, (valechi) ‘tomarA majavutabhAve A~kar3e dharo—yA tomAderake Ami diYechi evaM tomarA zono|’ tArA valala, ‘AmarA zunalAma o amAnya karalAma|’ tAdera antare garura vAchura-prIti siJcana karAneA haYeche tAdera kuphurira kAraNe| valo, ‘yadi tomarA mu’mina haYe thAka tave tomAdera ImAna yAra nirdeza kare tA katai nA nikRSTa!’
valo, ‘yadi AllAhara nikaTa ekamAtra teAmAdera janyai haYa AkhirAtera vAsasthAna, anya lokadera vyatIta, tave tomarA mRtyu kAmanA karo—yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|’
Ara kakhano tArA tA kAmanA karave nA sekAraNe—yA tAdera hAta Age pAThiYeche| (arthAt yA tArA e-yAvat kareche, tAra daruna) Ara AllAha yAlimadera samparke samyaka avagata|

evaM sakala mAnuSa, emanaki muzarikadera thekeo tAdera tumi jIvanera prati adhika AkAGkSI o lobhI pAve| tAdera pratyeke kAmanA kare, tAke yena hAjAra vachara AYu deoYA haYa; athaca dIrghAYulAbha tAderake zAsti theke rakSA karate pArave nA| tArA yA kare, AllAha tAra sarvadraSTA|

valo, ‘ye keu jivarAIlera zatru have se hoka nA! kAraNa nizcaYai se AllAhara anumatikrame tomAra hRdaYe (kuraAna) avatIrNa kare—yA pUrvavartI kitAvera satyAYanakArI evaM mu’minadera janya hidAYAta o susaMvAda|’
ye vyakti AllAha, tA~ra pherezatAgaNa o rAsUlagaNa evaM jivarAIla o mikAIlera zatru, (se nizcaYai kAphira, Ara) nizcaYai AllAha kAphiradera zatru|
avazyai Ami tomAra prati suspaSTa AYAtasamUha avatIrNa karechi| pApAcArIrA vyatIta anya keu tA asvIkAra kare nA|
kI Azcarya, yakhanai tArA keAno aGgIkAre Avaddha haYa, takhana tAdera ekadala tA chur3e phele, varaM tAdera adhikAMzai ImAna Ane nA!

yakhana AllAhara pakSa theke tAdera kAche kono rAsUla Agamana kare, yA tAdera kAche raYeche tAra satyAYanakArIrUpe, takhana yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche tAdera ekadala AllAhara kitAva pechane chur3e phele, yena tArA jAnei nA|

Ara sulAimAnera rAjatve zaYatAnarA yA AvRtti karata, tArA tA anusaraNa kareche| Ara sulAimAna kuphuri kareni; varaM zaYatAnarAi kuphuri kareche| tArA mAnuSake jAduvidyA zikSA dita evaM yA vAvela zahare hArUta o mArUta dui pherezatAra prati avatIrNa karA haYeche| tArA ubhaYai ekathA nA vale kAuke zikSA dita nA ye, ‘AmarA ekaTi parIkSAmAtra, kAjei tumi kuphuri karo nA|’ ataHpara tArA tAdera dujanAra kAcha theke emana vidyA zikhate lAgala; yA dvArA tArA svAmI-strIra madhye viccheda ghaTAta; yadio tArA AllAhara anumati chAr3A tA dvArA kArao aniSTa karate pArata nA| kintu tArA tAi zikhata, yA tAdera kevala kSati kare, kono upakAra kare nA| Ara avazyai tArA jAne ye, yA tArA kraYa kareche tAra janya parakAle nei keAno aMza| Ara tA katai-nA manda yAra vinimaYe tArA nijedera vikri kareche, yadi tArA jAnata!
Ara nizcaYai yadi tArA ImAna Anata evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karata tave AllAhara pakSa theke pratidAne tArA prAptavya pratiphala niHsandehe adhika kalyANakara| yadi tArA jAnata!
he yArA ImAna enecha, teAmarA ‘raYinA’ valeA nA, varaM tomarA valo ‘unayuranA’ evaM teAmarA zono| Ara kAphiradera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke teAmAdera prati keAno kalyANa avatIrNa heAka—tA Ahale kitAvadera madhye yArA kuphuri kareche tArA evaM muzarikarA cAYa nA| Ara AllAha yAke icchA tA~ra rahamatera janya manonIta karena; AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|
Ami keAno AYAta rahita karale athavA vismRta kare dile tAra ceYe uttama athavA tAra samaparyAYera AYAta AnaYana kari| tumi ki jAno nA ye, nizcaYai AllAha savakichura opare kSamatAvAna?
tumi ki jAno nA ye, AllAhara janyai AsamAna o yaminera Adhipatya? Ara AllAha vyatIta teAmAdera nei keAno abhibhAvaka evaM nei kono sAhAyyakArI|

teAmarA ki teAmAdera rAsUlake temani prazna karate cAo, yemana itaHpUrve mUsAke prazna karA haYechila? ye keu ImAnake kuphurira dvArA parivartana kare, avazyai se sarala patha theke vicyuta haYe yAYa|

kitAvidera anekei kAmanA kare, yadi tomAderake tomAdera ImAna AnaYanera para kAphirarUpe phiriYe nite pArata! satya spaSTa haoYAra pareo tAdera nijedera pakSa theke pratihiMsAvazata| ataeva, teAmarA tAdera kSamA karo evaM upekSA karo yatakSaNa nA AllAhara kono nirdeza Ase; nizcaYai AllAha savakichura opara kSamatAvAna|
teAmarA sAlAta kAYema karo evaM yAkAta pradAna karo| tomarA nijedera janya ye kalyANa Age pAThAccha, tA teAmarA AllAhara kAche pAve| teAmarA yA kichu karo, nizcaYai AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|
Ara tArA vale, ‘iYAhUdi athavA khrisTAna vyatIta keu kakhano jAnnAte praveza karave nA|’ eTA tAdera manera alIka vAsanA| valo, ‘teAmarA pramANa upasthita karo—yadi tomarA hao satyavAdI|’

avazya hyA~, ye vyakti tAra cehArA AllAhara nikaTa samarpaNa kareche, e avasthAYa se satkarmazIlao vaTe, tAra janya raYeche puraskAra tAra ravera kAche| Ara tAdera kono bhaYa nei evaM tAdera kono duHkha karate have nA|

Ara iYAhUdirA vale, ‘nAsArArA keAno bhittira opare nei’ evaM nAsArArA vale, ‘iYAhUdirA keAno bhittira opare nei’; athaca tArA kitAva pATha kare! emanibhAve yArA kono jJAna rAkhe nA, tArAo tAdera matoi kathA vale| ataeva, AllAha kiYAmAtera dina tAdera madhye mImAMsA karavena—ye viSaYe tArA matavireAdha karachila|

ye vyakti AllAhara mAsajidasamUhe tA~ra nAma smaraNa karate vAdhA deYa evaM seguleAke dhvaMsa karate apaceSTA cAlAYa, tAra cAite var3a yAlima Ara ke? athaca tAdera janya yekhAne bhIta-santrasta nA haYe praveza karArai adhikAra nei| tAdera janya ihakAle lAJchanA evaM parakAle mahAzAsti raYeche|
pUrva o pazcima AllAharai janya| ataeva, teAmarA yedikei mukha pherAo, sedikai AllAhara dika| nizcaYai AllAha sarvavyApI, sarvajJa|
tArA vale, ‘AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena|’ mahAna pavitra tini tA theke; varaM AsamAna o yamine yA kichu raYeche, tA tA~rai| savai tA~ra AjJAdhIna|
tini AsamAnasamUha o yaminera atulanIYa astitva dAnakArI sraSTA| yakhana tini keAno viSaYera siddhAnta nena takhana tAra janya zudhu valena, ‘hao’; Ara amani tA haYe yAYa|

yArA kichu jAne nA, tArA vale, ‘AllAha AmAdera saGge kena kathA valena nA? athavA AmAdera kAche keAno nidarzana kena Ase nA?’ emanibhAve tAdera pUrve yArA chila tArAo tAderai anurUpa kathA valeche| tAdera antaragulo ekai rakama| avazyai Ami AYAtasamUha varNanA kari sei sampradAYera janya—yArA dRr3ha pratyaYa rAkhe|
nizcaYai Ami tomAke pAThiYechi satyasaha susaMvAdadAtA o bhIti pradarzanakArI kare| tomAke jAhAnnAmIdera samparke jijJAsA karA have nA|

iYAhUdi o nAsArArA kakhanoi teAmAra prati santuSTa have nA, ye paryanta nA tumi tAdera dharmAdarza anusaraNa karave| valo, ‘nizcaYai AllAhara hidAYAtai prakRta hidAYAta|’ yadi tumi tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa karo, teAmAra kAche jJAna pau~chAra parao, tave AllAhara pakSa theke teAmAra nA thAkave kono abhibhAvaka Ara nA keAno sAhAyyakArI|
Ami tAderake ye kitAva diYechi, tA yArA yathAyathabhAve pATha kare, tArAi tAra prati ImAna rAkhe| Ara yArA tAra sAthe kuphuri kare, tArAi kSatigrasta|
he vani isarAIla, tomarA AmAra niYAmAtera kathA smaraNa karo, yA Ami teAmAdera diYechi evaM e-viSaYaTio ye, Ami teAmAderake vizvavAsIra opara zreSThatva dAna karechi|

teAmarA bhaYa karo sedinake, yedina keu kArao vindumAtra upakAre Asave nA, kArao kAcha theke kono vinimaYa/kSatipUraNa grahaNa karA have nA, kArao supAriza kArao upakAra karave nA Ara tArA kono sAhAyyao pAve nA|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana ivarAhImake tAra rava kaYekaTi kAlimA dvArA parIkSA karalena, ataHpara se tA pUrNa karala, tini valalena, ‘Ami teAmAke mAnavajAtira imAma vAnAva|’ se valala, ‘AmAra vaMzadhara thekeo!’ tini valalena, ‘AmAra aGgIkAra sImAlaGghanakArIdera kSetre prayojya have nA | ’

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami (kA ‘ vA) gharake mAnavajAtira milanakendra o nirApattAsthala vAniYechi, Ara (valechi) ‘ teAmarA mAkAme ivarAhImake sAlAtera sthAnarUpe grahaNa karo| ’ evaM Ami ivarAhIma o isamAIla theke aGgIkAra niYechi ye, teAmarA dujana pavitra rAkhave AmAra gharake tAoYAphakArI, i ‘ tekAphakArI o ruku sijadA AdAYakArIdera janya|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana ivarAhIma valala, ‘he AmAra rava, e nagarIke Apani nirApada vAniYe dina evaM era adhivAsIdera madhye yArA AllAha o kiYAmAte vizvAsa kare, tAderake phala-mUla dvArA riyika dAna karuna|’ tini valalena, ‘ye kuphuri kareche, Ami tAkeo kichudina jIvanopabhoga karAra suyeAga deva, ataHpara tAke Agunera zAsti bhoga karate vAdhya karava| Ara tA katai nA nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala!’

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana ivarAhIma o isamAIla kA‘vA gharera bhitti sthApana karachila/uThAcchila, (tArA du ‘ A karala) ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAdera pakSa theke kavula kare nina| nizcaYai Apani sarvazrotA, sarvajJAnI|’

‘he AmAdera rava, AmAdera ubhaYake ApanAra anugata vAniYe dina evaM AmAdera vaMzadhara thekeo ApanAra eka anugata jAti sRSTi karuna, AmAdera ivAdAtera niYama-paddhati dekhiYe dina evaM AmAdera kSamA karuna| nizcaYai Apani tAovA kavulakArI, asIma daYAlu|’

‘he AmAdera rava, Ara Apani tAdera madhya theke tAdera nikaTa ekajana rAsUla preraNa karuna, yini tAdera kAche ApanAra AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karavena, tAderake zikSA devena kitAva o hikamAha evaM tAdera pavitra karavena| nizcaYai Apani parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|’
ye ivarAhImera dharmAdarza theke mukha phiriYe neve se vyatIta ke nijeke nirvodha vAniYeche?! avazyai Ami tAke pRthivIte maneAnIta karechi evaM se parakAle satkarmazIladera antarbhukta|
smaraNa karo, yakhana tAke tAra rava valalena, ‘AtmasamarpaNa karo’, se valala, ‘Ami jagatasamUhera ravera kAche AtmasamarpaNa karalAma|’

Ara ivarAhIma o i‘YAkUva tAdera putraderake ei asiYata karala, ‘he AmAra santAnerA, nizcaYai AllAha teAmAdera janya e dInake maneAnIta karechena| kAjei teAmarA musalamAna nA haYe mRtyuvaraNa kareA nA|’

tomarA ki upasthita chile, yakhana i‘YAkUvera mRtyu upasthita haYechila? yakhana se tAra santAnadera valala, ‘AmAra pare teAmarA kAra ivAdAta karave?’ tArA valala, ‘AmarA ivAdAta karava ApanAra ilAh evaM ApanAra pitRpuruSa ivarAhIma, isamAIla o isahAkera ilAhara —ekaka ilAha| Ara AmarA tA~rai nikaTa AtmasamarpaNakArI|
tArA chila eka sampradAYa, yArA gata haYe geche| tArA yA kareche tA tAderai janya; Ara tomarA yA karecha tA tomAdera janya| Ara tArA yA karata, se viSaYe teAmAdera jijJAsA karA have nA|
tArA vale, ‘teAmarA iYAhUdi athavA nAsArA haYe yAo, tavei hidAYAta pAve|’ valo, ‘varaM AmarA ekaniSTha haYe ivarAhImera millAtera opara Achi, tini muzarikadera antarbhukta chilena nA|’

teAmarA valo, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi AllAhara opara evaM yA avatIrNa haYeche AmAdera prati evaM yA avatIrNa haYeche ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, i‘YAkUva evaM tAdera vaMzera prati evaM Arao yA deoYA haYeche tAdera ravera pakSa theke mUsA, IsA evaM anyAnya navidera prati| AmarA tAdera madhye pArthakya kari nA| Ara AmarA tA~rai prati AtmasamarpaNakArI|

ataeva, tArA yadi ImAna Ane, yebhAve tomarA ImAna enecha, tave tArA hidAYAta pAve| Ara yadi mukha phiriYe neYa, tave avazyai tArA viruddhabhAvApanna, sutarAM tAdera vipakSe teAmAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa| tinii sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
AllAhara raM (tini AmAdera opara Aropa karechena) Ara ke AllAha apekSA adhika sundara raM Aropa kare thAke? AmarA tA~rai ivAdAtakArI|

valo, ‘teAmarA ki AmAdera sAthe AllAhake niYe tarka karacha? athaca tinii AmAdera rava evaM teAmAdera rava| AmAdera janya AmAdera Amala, teAmAdera janya teAmAdera Amala; evaM AmarA tA~rai prati ekaniSTha|’

athavA teAmarA ki valacha ye, ‘nizcaYai ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, i‘YAkUva o tAdera santAnarA iYAhUdi athavA nAsArA chilena?’ valo, ‘teAmarAi adhika jAno, nA AllAha?’ tAra cAite var3a sImAlaGghanakArI ke hate pAre, ye AllAhara pakSa theke tAra kAche ye sAkSya Ache tA geApana kare? AllAha teAmAdera karma samparke vekhavara nana|
tArA chila eka sampradAYa, yArA gata haYe geche| tArA yA kareche tA tAderai janya, Ara tomarA yA karecha tA tomAdera janya| Ara tArA yA karata, se samparke teAmadera jijJAsA karA have nA|

acirei mAnuSera madhya hate nirveAdherA valave, kIse tAderake phiriYe dila tAdera oi kivalA theke, yAra opara tArA chila? valo, ‘pUrva o pazcima AllAharai| tini yAke icchA sarala pathe hidAYAta dena|’

emanibhAve Ami teAmAdera madhyapanthI sampradAYa vAniYechi, yAte kare teAmarA sAkSI hao mAnavajAtira janya evaM yena rAsUla sAkSI haYa teAmAdera janya| tumi ye kivalA anusaraNa karachile tAke Ami ejanyai kivalA nirdhAraNa karechi—yena Ami jAnate pAri ye, ke rAsUlera anusArI thAke Ara ke pichuTAna deYa| nizcaYai AllAha yAderake hidAYAta dAna karechena tArA chAr3A anyadera nikaTa tA kaThina| AllAha emana nana ye, teAmAdera ImAna naSTa kare devena| nizcaYai AllAha, mAnuSera prati atyanta snehazIla, asIma daYAlu|

avazyai Ami teAmAra cehArA vAravAra AkAzera dike pherAno dekhi| ataeva, avazyai Ami tomAke se kivalAra dikei ghuriYe deva, yeTA tumi pachanda kara| ataeva, tumi teAmAra cehArA mAsajidula hArAmera dike pherAo evaM teAmarA yekhAnei thAko, tAra dikei tomAdera cehArAke pherAo| Ara yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche, avazyai tArA jAne ye, nizcaYai eTA tAdera ravera pakSa theke satya| tArA yA kare se samparke AllAha vekhavara nana |

Ara yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche, yadi tumi tAdera nikaTa samudaYa nidarzana upasthApana karo tavuo tArA teAmAra kivalAra anusaraNa karave nA evaM tumio tAdera kivalAra anusArI nao| Ara tAdera keu kArao kivalAra anusArI naYa| Ara yadi tumi tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa karo tomAra nikaTa satya-jJAna AsAra parao, tave nizcaYai tumi sImAlaGghanakArIdera antarbhukta have|
Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi, tArA tAke cene, yemana tArA cene tAdera putraderake| Ara avazyai tAdera ekaTi dala jJAtasAre satyake geApana kare|
satya teAmAra ravera pakSa theke (prerita)| kAjei tumi sandihAnadera antarbhukta haYeA nA|

Ara pratyekera janya ekaTi dika raYeche, se sedike mukha pherAYa (ivAdAta kare)| kAjei satkAje pratiyeAgitA karo| yekhAnei teAmarA thAka nA kena, AllAha teAmAdera sakalake samaveta karavena| ‘nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe sarva zaktimAna|
Ara tumi yekhAna thekei vera hao, teAmAra cehArA mAsajidula hArAmera dike pherAo| nizcaYa tA teAmAra ravera pakSa theke vAstava satya| Ara teAmarA yA kara se samparke AllAha vekhavara nana|

Ara tumi yekhAna thekei vera hao nA kena masajidula hArAmera dike tomAra cehArA pherAo, Ara tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena, tAra dike tomAdera cehArA pherAo, yAte kare mAnuSera janya tomAra vipakSe dalila nA haYa, tave tAdera madhya theke yArA sImAlaGghana kareche tArA vyatIta| kAjei tAdera bhaYa karo nA; varaM AmAkei bhaYa karo| Ara yAte Ami tomAdera prati AmAra niYAmata paripUrNa kari evaM yAte tomarA hidAYAta lAbha karo|

yemana, Ami preraNa karechi teAmAderai madhya theke emana ekajana rAsUla, yini teAmAdera nikaTa telAoYAta karavena AmAra AYAtasamUha evaM teAmAdera pavitra karavena; Ara teAmAdera zikSA devena kitAva o hikamAta evaM tomAdera zikSA devena emana viSaYa, yA teAmarA jAnate nA|
sutarAM teAmarA AmAke smaraNa karo, Amio teAmAdera smaraNa karava| evaM AmAra kRtajJatA prakAza karo; evaM AmAra akRtajJatA karo nA|
he mu’minagaNa, teAmarA dhairya o sAlAtera mAdhyame sAhAyya prArthanA karo| nizcaYai AllAha dhairyazIladera sAthe raYechena|
Ara yArA AllAhara rAstAYa zahIda haYa tAdera mRta valeA nA; varaM tArA jIvita; kintu teAmarA tA anudhAvana karate pAra nA|
evaM avazyai Ami teAmAderake parIkSA karava kichuTA bhaYa, kSudhA, mAla o jAnera kSati evaM phala-phasala vinaSTera mAdhyame| Ara susaMvAda dAo dhairyazIladerake|
tAdera opara yakhana vipada ese par3e, takhana tArA vale, ‘nizcaYai AmarA AllAharai janya evaM AmarA tA~rai kAche phire yAva|’
oi sava leAka, yAdera prati tAdera ravera aphuranta anugraha o rAhamAta evaM tArAi hidAYAtaprApta|

nizcaYai sAphA o mAraoYA AllAhara nidarzanaguleAra anyatama| sutarAM yArA vAitullAhara hAjja vA umarAha pAlana kare, tAdera janya e duTite tAoYApha karAte keAno deASa nei| varaM keu yadi svecchAYa kalyANakara kAja kare, tave nizcaYai AllAha uttama guNagrAhI, sarvajJa|

nizcaYai Ami ye suspaSTa nirdazanAvali o hidAYAta avatIrNa karechi, Ami mAnuSera janya kitAve ati spaSTabhAve vyakta karAra parao yArA tA gopana kare, AllAha tAderake abhisampAta karena evaM abhizApakArIgaNao tAderake abhisampAta kare|
tave yArA tAovA kare evaM nijedera saMzodhana kare evaM (yA gopana karechila, tA) spaSTa varNanA kareche, Ami tAdera tAovA kavula kari evaM nizcaYai Ami tAovA kavulakArI asIma daYAlu|
nizcaYai yArA kuphuri kare evaM kAphira avasthAYa mRtyuvaraNa kare, tAdera prati AllAhara, pherezatAgaNera evaM sakala mAnuSera lA‘nata|
sekhAne tArA cirasthAYI| tAdera zAsti kakhano hAlakA karA have nA evaM tAderake avakAzao deoYA have nA|
Ara teAmAdera ilAhi ekamAtra ilAh| tini chAr3A Ara kono satya ilAha nei| tini ati daYAmaYa o asIma daYAlu|

nizcaYai AsamAnasamUha o yaminera sRSTite, dina o rAtera Avartane evaM nauyAnasamUhe yA calAcala kare samudre emana jinisa niYe, yA upakAre Ase mAnuSera| Ara AllAha AkAza theke ye vAri varSaNa karena, tA dvArA mRta jaminake sajIva kare tulena evaM tAte char3iYe dena savarakama jIvajantu| Ara vAtAsera pravAhe evaM AkAza o pRthivIra mAjhe niYantrita meghamAlAra saJcAlane raYeche jJAnIdera janya nidarzanAvali|

Ara mAnuSera madhya theke kataka emanao Ache—yArA AllAha vyatIta anyaderake tA~ra samakakSa rUpe grahaNa kare, AllAhake bhAlovAsAra nyAYa tArA tAderake bhAlovAse| Ara yArA AllAhara prati ImAna eneche tArA AllAhara prati bhAlovAsAYa dRr3hatara| yadi sImAlaGghanakArIrA zAsti pratyakSa karale yemana vujhave temana ekhanai vujhata, tave upalavdhi karata ye, sarvamaYa kSamatA zudhu AllAharai janya| Ara AllAha zAsti dAne atyanta kaThora|
yakhana anusRtarA anusArIdera dAYitva asvIkAra karave evaM tArA zAsti pratyakSa karave Ara tAdera madhyakAra samasta samparka chinna haYe yAve|

evaM anusArIrA valave, yadi AmAderake ekavAra pRthivIte phire yAvAra suyeAga deoYA hato! tAhale AmarAo tAdera theke sarmpaka chinna karatAma yemana tArA AmAdera theke samparka chinna kareche|’ ebhAvei AllAha tAderake tAdera kRtakarma tAdera janya AkSepa rUpe dekhAvena| tArA jAhAnnAma theke vera hate pArave nA|
he mAnuSa, tomarA AhAra karo tA theke yA-kichu pRthivIte hAlAla, pavitra| Ara zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa kareA nA; nizcaYai se teAmAdera prakAzya zatru|
se teA zudhu tomAderake anyAYa o azlIlatArai nirdeza deYa, evaM yena valo AllAha samvandhe emana kichu ye viSaYe teAmarA jJAna rAkho nA|

Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa ye, ‘teAmarA Anugatya karo tAra, yA AllAha avatIrNa karechena|’ takhana tArA vale, ‘varaM AmarA se viSaYerai anusaraNa karava, yAra opara AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera peYechi|’ yadio tAdera pUrvapuruSarA kichui vujhata nA, Ara hidAYAtera pathe paricAlita chila nA|
Ara yArA kuphuri kareche tAdera udAharaNa emana ye, kono vyakti emana kichuke DAkache ye hA~ka-DAka chAr3A Ara kichui zone nA| tArA vadhira, vovA evaM andha; sutarAM tArA kichui anudhAvana kare nA|
he yArA ImAna enecha, teAmarA AhAra karo pavitra vastusAmagrI theke, yeguleA Ami teAmAderake riyika diYechi evaM teAmarA AllAhara zukariYA AdAYa karo, yadi teAmarA tA~rai ivAdAta karo|

mUlata tini teAmAdera janya kevala hArAma karechena—mRta jantu, rakta, zUkarera mAMsa evaM (sesava jIvajantu) yA AllAha vyatIta anya kArao nAme utsarga karA haYeche| avazya ye leAka ananyeApAYa haYe par3e evaM nApharamAni o sImAlaGghanakArI nA haYa, tAra janya (egulo khAoYAYa) keAno pApa nei| nizcaYai AllAha mahAkSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

nizcaYai yArA sesava viSaYa geApana kare, yA AllAha kitAve avatIrNa karechena evaM tArA tA tuccha mUlye vikri kare, tArA zudhu Agunai tAdera udare pUrti kare| Ara AllAha kiYAmAtera dina tAdera sAthe kathA valavena nA evaM tAderake pavitrao karavena nA; Ara tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
tArAi hidAYAtera vinimaYe bhraSTatA evaM kSamAra parivarte zAsti kraYa kareche; e avasthAYa Agunera opara tArA katai nA dhairyazIla!
eTA ejanya ye, AllAha satyasaha kitAva avatIrNa karechena| Ara yArA kitAvera viSaYe matavireAdha kareche, avazyai tArA sudUra matAnaikye raYeche|

pUrva o pazcime cehArA pherAnotei puNya nei; kintu puNya tAra janya ye ImAna Anave AllAhara prati, kiYAmAta divasa, pherezatA, kitAvasamUha evaM navigaNera prati| Ara sampadera prati bhAlovAsA sattveo dAna karave nikaTatama AtmIYasvajana, iYAtIma-misakIna, pathika-musAphira, sAhAyyaprArthI o dAsamuktira kSetre| Ara yArA sAlAta kAYema karave, yAkAta pradAna karave, pratizruti diYe tA pUrNa karave, dhairyadhAraNa karave artha-saMkaTe, duHkha-kaSTe evaM yuddhera samaYa| tArAi satyAzraYI, Ara tArAi muttAki|

he mu’minagaNa, teAmAdera opara nihatadera vyApAre kisAsera vidhAna pharaya karA haYeche| svAdhIna vyaktira vadale svAdhIna vyakti, dAsera vadale dAsa evaM nArIra vadale nArI| ataHpara yAke tAra bhAiYera pakSa theke kichuTA kSamA kare deoYA haYa, tAhale (nihatera abhibhAvaka) anusaraNa karave Ara (hatyAkArI) uttamarUpe tAke AdAYa kare deve| eTA teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke sahajIkaraNa evaM vizeSa anugraha| eraparao ye vyakti sImAlaGghana karave tAra janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
he vivekasampannagaNa, kisAsera madhye teAmAdera janya jIvana raYeche, tAhale teAmarA sAvadhAnatA avalamvana kara|

tomAdera opara pharaya karA haYeche, yakhana tomAdera kAro mRtyu upasthita haYa, yadi se kono sampada rekhe yAYa, tave pitA-mAtA o nikaTAtmIYadera janya nyAYaparAYaNatAra sAthe asiYata karave| eTA muttAkidera janya Avazyaka| (eTi pUrvatana vidhAna, yA rahita haYe geche)
yadi keu tA zeAnAra para tAte keAno rakama parivartana sAdhana kare, tave yArA parivartana kare era pApa tAdera opara vartAve| nizcaYai AllAha sarvazrotA o sarvajJa|

yadi keu asiYatakArIra pakSa theke AzaGkA kare pakSapAtitvera athavA keAno anyAYera, ataHpara se tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare deYa, tave tAra keAno pApa nei| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
he yArA ImAna enecha, teAmAdera opara siYAma pharaya karA haYeche, yemana pharaya karA haYechila teAmAdera pUrvavartI leAkadera opara, yena teAmarA tAkaoYA arjana karate pAro|

(siYAma) gaNanAyogya kataka dine| tave teAmAdera madhye ye vyakti asustha, athavA saphare thAke, se anya dinagulote (ei) samAna saMkhyA (pUraNa kare neve)| Ara yArA siYAma pAlanera sAmarthya rAkhe, tArA era parivarte phidiYA—ekajana misakinake khAdya dAna karave| (eTi pUrvatana vidhAna, yA rahita haYe geche) ye vyakti svecchAYa satkarma kare, tA tAra janya uttama| Ara tomAdera siYAma pAlana tomAdera janya kalyANakara, yadi teAmarA vujhate|

rAmAyAna mAsa, tAte kuraAna avatIrNa karA haYeche mAnuSera janya hidAYAta evaM yA spaSTa nidarzanAvalIrUpe hidAYAta o phurakAna (satya-mithyAra pArthakya karAra)| kAjei teAmAdera madhye ye e mAsaTi pAve, se yena tAte siYAma pAlana kare| Ara ye asustha kiMvA musAphira se anya dinagulote (ei) samAna saMkhyA (pUraNa kare neve); AllAha teAmAdera janya yA sahaja, tA karate cAna, kaThina karate cAna nA| yena tomarA nirdhArita saMkhyA pUrNa karo evaM tini teAmAderake ye hidAYAta diYechena sejanya teAmarA AllAhara var3atva varNanA karo Ara tAra zukariYA AdAYa karate pAro|

yakhana AmAra vAndArA AmAra samparke tomAke jijJesa kare, (takhana valo) nizcaYai Ami sannikaTe| Ami AhvAnakArIra AhvAne sAr3A dii yakhana se AhvAna kare| kAjei tArAo yena AmAra DAke sAr3A deYa evaM AmAra prati ImAna Ane; yena tArA satpathe calate pAre|

siYAmera rAte teAmAdera janya teAmAdera strIdera sAthe sahavAsa hAlAla karA haYeche| tArA teAmAdera pozAka evaM teAmarA tAdera pozAka| AllAha jenechena ye, teAmarA nijedera sAthe anyAYa AcaraNa karachile, erapara tini teAmAdera kSamA karechena evaM teAmAdera parizuddha karechena| ataeva, ekhana tomarA tAdera sAthe milita hate pAro evaM AllAha yA tomAdera janya nirdhAraNa karechena tA tomarA anveSaNa karo| Ara pAnAhAra karo yatakSaNa nA tomAdera kAche SpaSTa haYe yAYa USAra zubhrarekhA kRSNa rekhA theke| ataHpara siYAma pUrNa karo rAta paryanta| Ara tomarA mAsajide i‘tikApharata avasthAYa tAdera sAthe milita haYo nA| egulo AllAhara sImArekhA| ataeva, tomarA tAra nikaTavartI haYo nA| emanibhAve AllAha varNanA karena mAnuSera janya tA~ra nidarzanasamUha; yAte tArA sAvadhAnatA avalamvana kare|
teAmarA anyAYabhAve eke aparera sampada grAsa kareA nA| evaM mAnuSera sampadera kiYadaMza avaidha panthAYa grAsa karAra uddezya jenezune vicArakera hAte tule diYo nA|

tArA tomAke natuna cA~dera vyApAre jijJesa kare| valo, eTi mAnuSa (-era nAnA viSaYa) o hAjjera janya samaYa nirdhAraka| Ara pechanera dika diYe ghare praveza karA to keAno puNya nei| varaM puNya halo oi vyaktira, ye tAkaoYA avalamvana kare| tAi teAmarA ghare praveza karo sammukha darajA diYe| AllAhake bhaYa karo, tAhale tomarA saphalakAma hate pArave|
Ara tomarA AllAhara pathe tAdera viruddhe yuddha karo, yArA tomAdera saGge yuddha kare| avazya sImAlaGghana kareA nA; nizcaYai AllAha sImAlaGghanakArIdera pachanda karena nA|

Ara teAmarA tAderake yekhAne pAo hatyA karo evaM tAderake vera kare dAo sekhAna theke, yekhAna theke tArA teAmAderake vera kareche, Ara phitanA hatyAra ceYeo gurutara| Ara mAsajidula hArAmera nikaTa tomarA tAdera sAthe yuddha kareA nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA teAmAdera sAthe sekhAne yuddha kare| tave yadi tArA teAmAdera sAthe yuddha kare, tave tomarA tAderake hatyA karo; ei halo kAphiradera pratiphala|
Ara tArA yadi virata thAke, tA hale AllAha atyanta kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

teAmarA tAdera viruddhe yuddha karate thAka yatakSaNa nA dIna ekamAtra AllAhara janya haYa evaM phitanA nirmUla haYe yAYa| ataHpara tArA yadi nivRta haYa tave sImAlaGghanakArIrA vyatIta| kArao prati javaradasti nei|

sammAnita mAsa sammAnita mAsera vadalA| Ara sammAnita viSaYera raYeche vadalA| yArA teAmAdera sAthe sImAlaGghana kareche, teAmarAo tAdera opara pratizodha grahaNa karo se parimANe, tArA teAmAdera opara ye parimANa anyAYa kareche| teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo Ara jene rekho, AllAha muttAkidera sAthe Achena|
Ara tomarA AllAhara pathe vyaYa karo, Ara tomAdera jIvanake dhvaMsera dike nikSepa kareA nA| evaM tomarA uttama Amala karo| AllAha uttama AmalakArIdera bhAlovAsena|

Ara teAmarA AllAhara janya hAjja o umarAha pUrNa karo| yadi teAmarA vAdhAprApta hao, tave yA sahajalabhya ‘hAdi’ (hAjjera janya ye prANIke nirdhAraNa karA haYa, tA javAi kareA) Ara teAmarA tomAdera mAthA muNDana karave nA, yatakSaNa nA ‘hAdi’ tAra sthAne pau~che| tave tomAdera madhye ye vyakti asustha haYa vA tAra mAthAYa kaSTadAYaka kichu haYa, tave tAra janya phidiYA siYAma, sAdAkAha vA kuravAni| ataHpara yakhana tomarA nirApada have, tave ye hajjera sAthe umarAhara suvidhA bhoga karave, tave se yA sahajalabhya ‘hAdi’ tA javAi karave; kintu ye ‘hAdi’ nA pAYa, tave se hAjjera pUrve tinadina siYAma pAlana karave evaM sAtadina pAlana karave yakhana teAmarA phirave, ei halo pUrNa daza| ei vidhAna oi vyaktira janya, yAra parivAra mAsajide hArAmera adhivAsI naYa| AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM jene rAkho—AllAha zAstidAne kaThora|

hAjjera mAsasamUha sunirdiSTa; sutarAM ye keu e samaYa nijera opara hAjja karAke pharaya kare, tAra janya hAjjera bhetare yaunasambhoga o pApAcAra o kalaha-vivAda vaidha naYa| tomarA bhAlo yA kichu karo, se viSaYa AllAha jAnena, tomarA pAtheYa saGge nAo, nizcaYai sarvottama pAtheYa tAkaoYA| he vivekasampannagaNa tomarA AmAkei bhaYa karo|

tomAdera ravera anugraha anusandhAna karAte tomAdera opara kono pApa nei| ataHpara yakhana ArAphAta theke pratyAvartana karo, takhana mAza‘Are hArAmera nikaTe (muyadAliphAYa) AllAhara smaraNa karo| Ara tA~ke smaraNa karo yebhAve tini teAmAderake nirdezanA diYechena| yadio tomarA itaHpUrve chile pathabhraSTadera arntabhukta|
ataHpara tomarA pratyAvartana karo yekhAna theke mAnuSa pratyAvartana kare| evaM tomarA AllAhara nikaTa kSamA cAo| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

ataHpara yakhana tomarA tomAdera hAjjera kAryAvali zeSa karave, takhana tomarA AllAhake smaraNa karo, yebhAve tomarA smaraNa karate tomAdera pitRpuruSadera, varaM tAra ceYeo adhika smaraNa karo| Ara mAnuSera madhye kichu loka Ache; yArA vale, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAderake ihakAle dAo’, tAdera janya parakAle kono aMza nei|
Ara tAdera madhye kichu Ache; yArA vale, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAderake ihakAle kalyANa dAo evaM parakAleo kalyANa dAo evaM AmAderake jAhAnnAmera zAsti theke rakSA karo|’
tAdera janya raYeche ekaTA aMza, yA tArA upArjana kareche| Ara AllAha hisAva grahaNe druta|

Ara tomarA AllAhake smaraNa karo nirdiSTa dinagulote| tave ye tAr3AtAr3i kare dudine phire Ase tAte tAra kono pApa nei, Ara ye vilamva kare phere tArao kono pApa nei| eTA tAra janya, ye tAkaoYA avalamvana kare| teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo| Ara jene rekho, nizcaYai tomarA tA~ra kAchei samaveta have|
Ara mAnuSera madhye emanao Ache, yAra kathA tomAke pArthiva jIvane mugdha karave| Ara tAra antare yA Ache se-samvandhe se AllAhake sAkSI rAkhe| prakRtapakSe se bhISaNa kalahapriYa|
Ara yakhana se prasthAna kare, takhana se pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi, zasya kSetra o jIvajantura vaMza dhvaMsera ceSTA kare| Ara AllAha viparyaYa pachanda karena nA|
Ara yakhana tAke valA haYa ye, AllAhake bhaYa karo, takhana tAra ahaMkAra tAke pApAcAre udvuddha kare| sutarAM tAra janya jAhAnnAmai yatheSTa| Ara nizcaYai tA nikRSTatara AzraYasthala|
kichu mAnuSa emana raYeche, yArA AllAhara santuSTilAbhe nijeke vikiYe deYa| AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera prati atyanta daYAlu|
he mu’minagaNa, teAmarA isalAme paripUrNabhAve praveza karo | Ara zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa karo nA| nizcaYai se teAmAdera prakAzya zatru|
yadi tomAdera kAche suspaSTa pramANa AsAra pareo teAmAdera padaskhalana ghaTe, tave jene rekheA, nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tArA ki zudhu e apekSA karache ye, AllAha o pherezatArA meghera chAYAYa tAdera kAche Asavena| Ara savakichura mImAMsA haYe yAve| Ara AllAhara dikei sava viSaYa pratyAvartita have|
vani isarAIladerake jijJesa karo, tAderake Ami kata spaSTa nirdazana diYechi| AllAhara niYAmAta AsAra para ye tA parivartana kare, tave nizcaYai AllAha zAsti dAne atyanta kaThora|

suzobhita karA haYeche tAdera janya—yArA kuphuri kareche, pArthiva-jIvanake evaM tArA mu’minadera sAthe TippanI kATe| pakSAntare yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, tArA kiYAmAtera dina tAdera ceYe atyanta uccamaryAdAYa thAkave| Ara AllAha yAke icchA aphuranta riyika dAna karena|

sakala mAnuSa eka ummAta chila| ataHpara AllAha naviderake preraNa karalena susaMvAdadAtA o bhItipradarzanakArI hiseve| Ara tAdera sAthe avatIrNa karalena satyasaha kitAva, yAte mAnuSera mAjhe sesava viSaYe mImAMsA karate pArena yA niYe tArA matapArthakya kareche; Ara yAderake tA deoYA haYechila, tAdera kAche suspaSTa nirdazanasamUha AsAra pare zudhu paraspara vidveSavazata se viSaYe tArA matAnaikya karata| ataHpara AllAha svIYa icchAYa yArA ImAna eneche tAderake hidAYAta diYechena se satya viSaYa, ye viSaYe tArA matAnaikya kareche| Ara AllAha yAke icchA sarala pathera dike hidAYAta dAna karena|

tomarA ki bhevecha, ye tomarA jAnnAte praveza karave, athaca tomAdera opara Aseni tomAdera pUrvavartIdera mato avasthA? tAderake sparza kareche abhAva-anaTana o duHkha-kleza| evaM tAderake prakampita karA halo, yAra phale navi o tAra sAthe yArA ImAna enechila tArA valala, ‘kakhana Asave AllAhara sAhAyya?’ jene rekho, AllAhara sAhAyya ati nikaTe|

tArA tomAke jijJesa kare, tArA kI vyaYa karave? valo, ‘ye pavitra dhana-sampada tomarA vyaYa karave, tA pitA-mAtA, nikaTAtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma, misakIna o musAphiradera janya|’ Ara tomarA ye uttama kAja karo, nizcaYai AllAha se samparke samyaka avagata|

teAmAdera opara yuddha pharaya karA haYeche, athaca tA teAmAdera kAche apachandanIYa| hate pAre teAmarA apachanda karo kono jinisa; athaca tA teAmAdera janya kalyANakara| AvAra hate pAre tomarA emana viSaYa pachanda karo—tA tomAdera janya akalyANakara| Ara AllAhai jAnena, teAmarA jAno nA|

sammAnita mAse yuddha karA samparke tArA tomAke jijJesa kare| valo, ‘ete yuddha karA bhISaNa var3a anyAYa|’ kintu AllAhara pathe prativaddhakatA sRSTi karA evaM tA~ra sAthe kuphuri karA, mAsajidula-hArAme vAdhA deoYA evaM sekhAnakAra adhivAsIderake tA theke theke vahiSkAra karA, AllAhara nikaTa tAra ceYeo var3a anyAYa| adhikantu phitanA hatyAra ceYeo jaghanya| Ara tArA sarvadA tomAdera viruddhe yuddha karave yatakSaNa nA tomAderake tomAdera dIna theke pherAte sakSama have| Ara tomAdera madhya theke ye tAra dIna theke phire yAve evaM kAphira avasthAYa mRtyuvaraNa karave—duniYA o AkhirAte tAdera yAvatIYa Amala vinaSTa haYe yAve| Ara tArAi haleA jAhAnnAmi; tAte tArA cirasthAYI|
nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche evaM yArA hijarAta kareche Ara AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche, tArA pratyAzA karate pAre AllAhara rAhamAtera| Ara AllAha ati kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

tArA tomAke mada o juYA samparke jijJesa kare| valo, ‘e duTira madhye raYeche mahApApa, Ara mAnuSera janya upakArao| tave eguleAra pApa upakAritAra ceYe gurutara|’ Ara tomAke tArA jijJesa kare, tArA kI vyaYa karave? valo, ‘udvRtta, (sampada vyaYa karave)|’ ebhAvei AllAha teAmAdera janya AYAtasamUha varNanA karena, yena teAmarA cintA karo|

duniYA o AkhirAtera viSaYa| Ara tArA tomAke iYAtImadera samparke jijJesa kare| valo, ‘ tAdera janya saMzodhanamUlaka kAjai uttama| ’ Ara yadi tAdera vyaYabhAra nijedera sAthe miziYe nAo, tAhale tArA teAmAdera bhAi| Ara kalyANa pratyAzI o phAsAda sRSTikArIdera maGgalakAmIdera samparke AllAha jAnena| Ara AllAha yadi icchA karatena, tave teAmAdera opara jaTilatA AreApa karate pAratena| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Ara teAmarA muzarika nArIderake viYe kareA nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA ImAna Ane| avazyai musalima dAsI muzarika nArI apekSA uttama, yadio tArA tomAdera mugdha kare| evaM teAmarA keAno muzarikera sAthe viYe diYo nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA ImAna Ane| avazyai mu’mina dAsa muzarikera tulanAYa uttama, yadio se teAmAderake mugdha kare| tArA jAhAnnAmera dike AhvAna kare, Ara AllAha nija anugrahe jAnnAta o kSamAra dike AhvAna karena| tini mAnuSera janya tA~ra AYAtasamUha varNanA karena, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

tArA tomAke RtusrAva samparke jijJesa kare| valo, ‘tA ekaTA azuci| kAjei teAmarA RtusrAva avasthAYa strIgamana theke virata thAko|’ pavitra nA haoYA paryanta tAdera nikaTavartI haYo nA| yakhana tArA uttamarUpe pavitra have, takhana tAdera kAche gamana karo, yebhAve AllAha teAmAdera nirdeza diYechena| nizcaYai AllAha tAovAkArIdera evaM pavitratA arjanakArIdera pachanda karena|

teAmAdera strIrA teAmAdera zasyakSetra| ataeva, teAmarA yebhAve icchA tAdera kAche gamana karo| Ara nijedera janya agrima preraNa karo, Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo| tomarA jene rekho, nizcaYai tomarA tA~ra sAthe sAkSAtkArI, Ara tumi mu’minadera susaMvAda dAo|
Ara satkAja, tAkaoYA evaM mAnuSera mAjhe zAnti sthApana karA theke virata thAkA tomarA nijedera zapathera janya AllAhara nAmake prativandhaka vAniYo nA|| AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
AllAha teAmAdera nirarthaka zapathera janya teAmAderake dharavena nA; kintu tomAdera dharavena, oi kAraNe teAmAdera antara yegulora pratijJA kareche| Ara AllAha parama kSamAzIla, ati sahiSNu|
yArA nijedera strIdera theke dUre thAkAra zapatha kare, tArA cAra mAsa apekSA karave| ataeva yadi tArA phire Asate cAYa, tave nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu |
Ara yadi tAlAkera dRr3ha saMkalpa kare thAke, tAhale nizcaYai AllAha sarvazrotA o sarvajJa|

tAlAkaprAptA nArI pratIkSAYa thAkave tina RtusrAva paryanta| Ara tAdera janya vaidha naYa ye, tArA tA gopana karave—yA tAdera garbhAzaYe AllAha sRSTi karechena; yadi tArA AllAhara evaM parakAlera opara ImAna Ane| Ara tAdera svAmIrA vezi adhikAra rAkhe tAdera punaHgrahaNera, yadi tArA Apasa karate cAYa| Ara strIdera nyAYasaMgata adhikAra raYeche, yemana puruSadera tAdera opara adhikAra raYeche, avazya nArIdera opara raYeche puruSadera eka starera zreSThatva| Ara AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tAlAka duvAra| tArapara vidhimotAveka rekhe deoYA, anyathAYa sadaYabhAve cher3e deoYA| Ara tomAdera janya hAlAla have nA ye, tomarA tA theke kono kichu grahaNa karave—yA tomarA tAdera diYecha| avazya tArA dujana yadi bhaYa kare ye, tArA AllAhara sImArekhA rakSA karate pArave nA, yadi tomarA AzaGkA karo ye, tArA AllAhara sImArekhA rakSA karate pArave nA, tave tAdera kono pApa nei, yadi strI kono kichura vinimaYe niSkRti pete cAYa| eTA AllAhara sImArekhA| ataeva, tA tomarA laGghana karo nA| Ara yArA AllAhara nirdhArita sImA laGghana karave, tArAi sImAlaGghanakArI|

ataHpara yadi se strIke tAlAka deYa, tave tAra janya hAlAla have nA yatakSaNa nA se anya svAmIke vivAha kare| ataHpara yadi se (dvitIYa svAmI) tAke tAlAka deYa, tAhale tAdera kono pApa nei ye, ubhaYe parasparake punarAYa viYe karave, yadi tArA mane kare ye, tArA AllAhara sImArekhA rakSA karate pArave| eTA AllAhara sImA; tini tA varNanA karena emana sampradAYera janya yArA jAne|

Ara yakhana tomarA strIderake tAlAka deoYAra para tArA (iddAtera) nirdhArita samaYe pau~chAra nikaTavartI haYa, takhana haYa tomarA tAderake nyAYasaMgatabhAve rekhe dAo vA uttamabhAve cher3e dAo| sImAlaGghanera uddezye kaSTa deoYAra janya tAdera rekhe diYo nA| ye emanaTA karave se nijera oparai anyAYa karave| Ara AllAhara nirdezake upahAsera viSaYa hiseve grahaNa karo nA| tomarA smaraNa karo tomAdera prati AllAhara niYAmAta evaM tomAdera opara yA avatIrNa karechena— arthAt kitAva o hikamAta; yA dvArA tini tomAdera upadeza dena| tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo| jene rAkho, AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|

tomarA strIdera tAlAka deoYAra para (iddAtera) nirdhArita samaYe pau~chAle tArA punarAYa yadi svAmIdera viYe karate cAYa ubhaYera sammatite nyAYasaMgatabhAve, tAhale tAderake ei viYete vAdhA diYo nA| era dvArA upadeza deoYA hacche tomAdera madhye AllAha o AkhirAtera prati vizvAsI vyaktike| eTAi tomAdera janya sarvAdhika vizuddhatama o pavitratama| vastuta AllAhai jAnena, tomarA jAno nA|

Ara mAe samaYakAla) tAdera janya yArA dudhapAna karAnora meYAda pUrNa karate cAYa; santAnera pitAra kartavya nyAYasaMgatabhAve tAdera bharaNapoSaNa deoYA| kAuke tAra sAdhyAtIta kichu cApiYe deoYA have nA| mAtAke tAra santAnera kAraNe kSatigrasta karA have nA, Ara pitAkeo tAra santAnera kAraNe kSatigrasta karA have nA| uttarAdhikArIderao anurUpa vidhAna| yadi tArA paraspara sammati o parAmarzakrame (meYAdera Age) stanyapAna chAr3Ate cAYa, tave ubhaYera janya kono aparAdha nei| yadi tomarA cAo ye, tomAdera santAnaderake stanyapAna karAve (dhAtrI dvArA) tave tomAdera kono pApa nei, yadi tomarA vinimaYa diYe dAo pracalita vidhi motAveka evaM tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo| Ara jene rekho, nizcaYai AllAha sarvadraSTA oi viSaYe—yA tomarA karo|

teAmAdera madhye yArA strIdera rekhe mRtyuvaraNa kare, tave strIrA nijedera cAra mAsa daza dina apekSAYa rAkhave| ataHpara yakhana nirdhArita meYAde tArA pau~chAve, takhana tomAdera janya kono pApa nei tAte yathAvidhi nijedera janya tArA yA karave| Ara tomarA yA karo se sarmpake AllAha samyaka avagata|

Ara AkAra-iGgite (vidhavA) nArIderake viYera prastAva deoYA vA antare gopana rAkhAYa teAmAdera keAno pApa nei| AllAha jAnena, acirei tAderake tomarA mane karave; kintu vidhi-motAveka kathA-vArtA chAr3A geApane tAdera kono pratizruti diYo nA; evaM tomarA vivAhavandhanera saMkalpa karo nA tAdera nirdhArita iddAta samApta nA haoYA paryanta| Ara jene rekheA, AllAha tomAdera manera kathA jAnena, kAjei tA~ke bhaYa karo, Ara eo jene rekheA, nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla o parama sahiSNu|

tomarA strIderake sparza karAra Age vA keAno meAhara dhArya karAra Age tAlAka deoYAra mAjhe keAno pApa nei| tave tAderake sacchala vyakti tAra sAmarthya anuyAYI, Ara asacchala vyakti tAra sAdhya anuyAYI deve upahAra-sAmagrI vidhisammatabhAve; eTA satkarmazIladera opara dAYitva|

Ara yadi tomarA tAdera sparza karAra pUrve tAlAka pradAna karo evaM tomarA tAdera janya mohara dhArya karecha, tAhale tomarA yA nirdhAraNa karecha tAra ardheka pradAna karo; tave yadi tArA kSamA kare athavA vivAhavandhana yAra hAte se yadi kSamA kare; Ara kSamA kare deoYATAi tAkaoYAra adhika nikaTatara| tomAdera parasparera anugrahera kathA bhule yeYo nA| nizcaYai AllAha sarvadraSTA oi viSaYe—yA tomarA karo|
tomarA sAlAtasamUhera prati yatnavAna hao, evaM vizeSata madhyavartI sAlAte| Ara AllAhara sAmane vinItabhAve dA~r3Ao |

yadi tomarA zaGkita hao, tave dA~r3Ano athavA ArohI avasthAtei par3e nAo| tArapara yakhana teAmarA nirApada hao, takhana tomarA AllAhara jikira karo, yebhAve tini teAmAdera zikSA diYechena, yA tomarA jAnate nA|

Ara yArA tomAdera madhye strIdera rekhe mRtyumukhe patita haYa, tArA yena tAdera strIderake ghara theke vera nA kare eka vacharera bharaNa-poSaNera asiYata kare yAYa| kintu tArA yadi vera haYe yAYa, vidhi-motAveka nijedera janya tArA yA karave, tAte tomAdera kono pApa nei| Ara AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
Ara tAlAkaprAptA nArIdera janya vidhi-motAveka bharaNa-poSaNa deoYA muttAkidera kartavya|
ebhAvei AllAha teAmAdera janya tA~ra AYAtasamUha varNanA karena, yAte teAmarA tA vujhate pAra|

tumi ki tAdera lakSa karani, yArA mRtyura bhaYe nijedera ghara cher3e veriYe giYechila? athaca tArA chila hAjAra hAjAra| ataHpara AllAha tAderake valalena, ‘tomarA mare yAo|’ punarAYa tini tAderake jIvita karalena| nizcaYai AllAha mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla, athaca adhikAMza mAnuSa kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA|
tomarA AllAhara pathe yuddha karo evaM jene rekho, nizcaYai AllAha sarvazrotA o sarvajJa|

ke Ache ye, AllAhake RNa deve, uttama RNa? ataHpara tini tAra janya tA vahuguNe vRddhi kare devena| AllAhai rijika saMkucita karena evaM prazasta karena| sarvopari tA~rai nikaTa tomarA pratyAvartita have|

mUsAra pare tumi ki vani isarAIlera netAderake dekhani? yakhana tArA tAdera navike valala, ‘AmAdera janya ekajana vAdazAha niyukta karuna, yAte AmarA AllAhara pathe yuddha karate pAri|’ se valala, ‘emana karave nA to ye, tomAdera opara yuddha pharaya karA hale tomarA Ara yuddha karave nA?’ tArA valala, ‘AmAdera kI haYeche ye, AmarA AllAhara pathe yuddha karava nA; athaca AmAdera vera kare deoYA haYeche AmAdera gharavAr3i o santAnasantati theke!’ ataHpara yakhana pharaya karA halo tAdera opara yuddha, takhana tAdera salpasaMkhyaka vyatIta savAi pRSTha-pradarzana karala| Ara AllAha sImAlaGghanakArIdera vyApAre samyaka avagata|

tAdera navi tAderake valala, ‘nizcaYai AllAha tAlUtake teAmAdera janya vAdazAha niyukta karechena|’ tArA valala, ‘AmAdera opara tAra rAjatva kIbhAve have? athaca rASTrakSamatA pAoYAra kSetre tAra ceYe AmAderai adhikAra vezi| Ara se Arthika dika diYeo prAcuryera adhikArI naYa|’ se valala, ‘nizcaYai AllAha teAmAdera opara tAke nirvAcana karechena evaM jJAna o daihika dika diYe tAke samRddhi dAna karechena|’ Ara AllAha yAke icchA tAke tA~ra rAjya dAna karena| Ara AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|

tAdera navi tAdera valala, ‘nizcaYai tAra rAjatvera nidarzana haleA, teAmAdera kAche sei sindukaTi Asave, yAte thAkave teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke prazAnti Ara mUsA evaM hArUna parivAravargera parityakta sAmagrI; pherezatAgaNa tA vahana kare Anave| nizcaYai tAte raYeche aneka var3a nidarzana; yadi tomarA mu’mina hao|’

ataHpara yakhana tAlUta sainya-sAmanta niYe vera halo, takhana se valala, ‘nizcaYai AllAha teAmAdera ekaTi nadIra mAdhyame parIkSA karavena| sutarAM ye sekhAna theke pAna karave se AmAra dalabhukta naYa; Ara ye tAra svAda grahaNa karave nA se-i AmAra dalabhukta| tave hAtera A~jalA bhare sAmAnya pAna karale aparAdha have nA|’ ataHpara tAdera sAmAnya kaYekajana chAr3A savAi tA theke pAni pAna karala| tArapara yakhana se evaM tAra sAthe yArA ImAna enechila tArA tA atikrama karala, tArA valala, ‘Ajakera dine AmAdera zakti nei jAlUta evaM tAra senAvAhinIra sAthe jihAda karAra|’ AllAhara sAthe sAkSAte vizvAsIrA valala, ‘kata kSudra dala vRhatdalake AllAhara hukume parAbhUta kareche! Ara AllAha dhairyazIladera sAthe Achena|’

Ara yakhana tArA jAlUta o tAra senAvAhinIra mukhomukhi halo, tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAdera opara dhairya Dhele dina evaM AmAdera dRr3hapada rAkhuna, Ara AmAderake kAphira jAtira viruddhe sAhAyya karuna|’

Ara tArA tAderake AllAhara hukume parAjita karala; Ara dAUda jAlUtake hatyA karala evaM AllAha tAke dAna karalena rAjatva o prajJA, Ara yA icchA zikSA dilena tAke| yadi AllAha mAnuSera katakake katakera dvArA pratihata nA karatena, tAhale pRthivI viparyasta haYe yeta; kintu vizvavAsIra prati AllAha anugrahazIla|
eguleA AllAhara nidarzanAvali, yA Ami tomAra nikaTa yathAyathabhAve varNanA karachi, Ara nizcaYai tumi rAsUlagaNera antarbhukta|

oi rAsUlagaNa, Ami tAdera kAuke kArao opara maryAdA diYechi| tAdera madhye kArao sAthe AllAha kathA valechena, Ara kAro maryAdA uccatara karechena Ara Ami mAraiYAma-tanaYa IsAke suspaSTa nidarzanasamUha dAna karechi, evaM tAke zaktizAlI karechi rUhula-kudasera mAdhyame| Ara AllAha yadi cAitena, tAdera paravartIrA paraspara yuddha karata nA tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa nidarzanasamUha AsAra para| kintu tArA matavireAdhe lipta haYeche| phale tAdera kataka ImAna eneche, Ara kataka kuphuri kareche| Ara AllAha yadi cAitena tArA paraspara yuddha karata nA, kintu AllAha yA icchA tAi karena|

he mu ‘ minagaNa, Ami teAmAderake ye riyika diYechi, sedina AsAra pUrvei teAmarA tA theke vyaYa karo, yedina nA Ache vecA-kenA, nA Ache vandhutva evaM supAriza| Ara kAphirarAi haleA prakRta sImAlaGghanakArI|

AllAha, tini chAr3A anya keAno ilAha nei, tini ciraJjIva, sarvasattAra dhAraka| tA~ke tandrA o nidrA sparza kare nA| AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA kichu raYeche, savai tA~ra| emana ke Ache, ye supAriza karate pAre tA~ra kAche tAra anumati vyatIta? tAdera sammukhe o pazcAtera savai tini avagata Achena| tini yA icchA karena tA chAr3A tA~ra asIma jJAnera keAno kichui tArA AYatta karate pAre nA, tA~ra kurasi AsamAnasamUha o yamina parivyApta haYe Ache | Ara e duTira saMrakSaNa tAke klAnta kare nA| tini sarveAcca, sumahAna|

dInera vyApAre keAno javaradasti nei| avazyai satya bhraSTatA theke pRthaka rUpe spaSTa haYe geche| sutarAM ye tAgUtake asvIkAra kare evaM AllAhara prati ImAna Ane, se sudRr3ha hAtala A~kar3e dharala, yA vicchinna havAra naYa| Ara AllAha sarvazrotA o sarvajJa|

yArA ImAna Ane AllAha tAdera abhibhAvaka, tAderake tini vera kare Anena andhakArasamUha theke AleAra dike| Ara yArA kuphuri kare tAdera abhibhAvaka hacche tAgUta| se tAderake vera kare Ane AleA theke andhakArasamUhera dike| tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, tArA sekhAne cirasthAYI have|

tumi ki tAra samparke cintA karecha, ye tAra ravera vyApAre vAdAnuvAda kareche ivarAhImera sAthe, yehetu AllAha tAke rAjatva diYechena? ivarAhIma yakhana valala, ‘AmAra rava tinii, yini jIvana dAna karena evaM mRtyu ghaTAna|’ se valala, ‘Amio jIvana dAna kari evaM mRtyu ghaTiYe thAki|’ ivarAhIma valala, ‘nizcaYai AllAha sUryake pUrva dika theke udaYa karena| evAra tumi tAke pazcima dika theke udaYa karAo to!’ ataHpara ye (namarUda) kuphuri kareche, se hatabhamva haYe gela| Ara AllAha sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYake hidAYAta dena nA|

athavA oi vyaktira avasthA cintA karecha? ye emana eka janapada atikrama karachila—yA vidhvasta haYe par3echila tAra bhittira opara| se valala, ‘kemana kare AllAha maraNera para eke jIvita karavena?’ ataHpara AllAha tAke ekazo vacharera janya mRtyu dilena| tArapara tAke punarjIvita karalena| valalena, ‘kata kAla avasthAna karale?’ se valala, ‘Ami ekadina vA ekadinera kichu aMza avasthAna karechi| (AllAha) valalena, varaM tumi avasthAna karecha ekazo vachara| ataeva, tumi lakSa karo tomAra khAdya o pAnIYara dike, seguleA paceni evaM tumi lakSa karo tomAra gAdhAra dike| yena Ami teAmAke mAnuSera janya dRSTAnta vAnAte cAi| Ara tumi lakSa karo hAr3aguleAra dike, kIbhAve Ami tA saMyojana kari evaM seguleAra opara mAMsera AvaraNa pariYe dii| ataHpara yakhana tAra nikaTa spaSTa halo, se valala, ‘nizcaYai Ami jAni AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|’

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana ivarAhIma valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke dekhAo—kIbhAve tumi mRtake jIvita karave|’ tini valalena, ‘ tumi ki vizvAsa kara nA?’ se valala, ‘hyA~ avazyai, tave yena AmAra antara prazAnti lAbha kare|’ tini valalena, ‘tave cAraTi pAkhi dharo| seguleAke nijera poSa mAnAo, ataHpara seguleAra dehera ekekaTi aMza pratyeka pAhAr3e rAkho| tArapara seguleAke DAko; segulo teAmAra nikaTa daur3e Asave| Ara jene rekheA, nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|’

yArA AllAhara rAstAYa nijedera dhanasampada vyaYa kare tAdera (dAnera) udAharaNa ekaTi vIjera mato, yA sAtaTi zISa utpAdana kare, pratyekaTi zISe thAke ekazo kare dAnA; evaM AllAha yAke icchA vahu guNe vRddhi kare dena, Ara AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|

yArA tAdera dhanasampada AllAhara rAstAYa vyaYa kare, ataHpara vyaYakRta dAnera kho~TA evaM kaSTa deYa nA, tAdera janya raYeche tAdera ravera nikaTa puraskAra evaM tAdera keAno bhaYa nei, Ara tArA cintitao have nA|
uttama kathA valA evaM kSamA oi dAna-khaYarAta apekSA uttama, ye dAnera pare kaSTa deoYA haYa| AllAha amukhApekSI, parama sahiSNu|

he mu ‘ minagaNa, teAmarA tomAdera dAnake kho~TA o kaSTa diYe naSTa karo nA oi vyaktira mato, ye tAra dhanasampada leAka dekhAneAra uddezye vyaYa kare evaM AllAha o parakAlera prati ImAna rAkhe nA| ‍sutarAM tAra dRSTAnta emana ekaTi masRNa pAthara, yAra opara kichu mATi raYeche| ataHpara era upara pravala vRSTi varSita haYe tAke sampUrNa pariSkAra kare dilo| tArA upArjita sampade kono pratidAna lAbha karave nA| AllAha kAphira sampradAYake hidAYAta dena nA|

Ara oi sakala mAnuSa yArA tAdera dhanasampada vyaYa kare AllAhara santuSTi arjanera lakSye evaM nijera manake sudRr3ha karAra janya, tAdera upamA TilAYa avasthita vAgAnera mato, tAte varSita haYa pravala vRSTi; phale tA dviguNa phla-phasala utpanna kare| tave yadi pravala vRSTi nA-o haYa, tave hAlakA varSaNai yatheSTa| tomarA yA kara, AllAha oi viSaYe samyaka draSTA|

teAmAdera keu ki kAmanA kare ye, tAra ekaTi khejura o AGurera vAgAna have, pravAhita have tAra taladeza diYe nada-nadI, tAte thAkave sarvaprakAra phala-mUla| ataHpara se vArdhakye pau~che edike tAra raYeche durvala santAnasantati, ataHpara tAte AghAta hAne ghUrNivAYu, yAte Ache Aguna, phale tAke bhasmIbhUta kare deYa? ebhAve AllAha teAmAdera janya nidarzanasamUha varNanA karena, yAte teAmarA cintAbhAvanA karo|

he mu ’ minagaNa, tomAdera upArjita sampada evaM bhUmi theke Ami tomAdera janya yA udgata kari, tA theke pavitra vastu dAna karo; tA theke nikRSTa jinisa vyaYa karate manastha kareA nA| athaca, tA teAmarA grahaNa karo nA, tA theke cokha vandha karA chAr3A| Ara jene rekheA, nizcaYai AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|
zaYatAna teAmAdera abhAvera bhaYa dekhAYa evaM azlIlatAra nirdeza deYa| pakSAntare AllAha teAmAderake nijera pakSa theke kSamA o anugrahera pratizruti dena| AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|
tini yAke icchA hikamAha dAna karena, Ara yAke hikamAha dAna karA haYa, se lAbha kare prabhUta kalyANa| Ara jJAnI vyaktirA chAr3A keu upadeza grahaNa kare nA|
teAmarA yA kharaca kara athavA yA mAnata kara, nizcaYai AllAha tA jAnena| Ara sImAlaGghanakArIdera keAno sAhAyyakArI nei|

yadi teAmarA prakAzye dAna karo, tave tA katai nA uttama| Ara yadi geApane karo evaM abhAvagrastadera diYe dAo, tave tA teAmAdera janya Arao uttama; AllAha teAmAdera kichu gunAha muche devena| AllAha teAmAdera yAvatIYa kAja samparke samyaka avagata|

tAderake hidAYAta deoYAra dAYitva tomAra naYa; varaM AllAha yAke icchA hidAYAta dAna karena| ye sampada teAmarA vyaYa karo, tA nija upAkArArthei karo| Ara tomarA ekamAtra AllAhara santuSTira uddezyei vyaYa kareA| teAmarA ye artha vyaYa karave, tAra puraskAra pUrNa kare deoYA have evaM teAmAdera prati avicAra karA have nA|

ei dAna oi sakala abhAvagrastera janya—yArA AllAhara pathe vyApRta o avaruddha haYe geche, jIvikAra sandhAne yamine bhramaNa karate pAre nA; nivRta thAkAra kAraNe ajJa leAkerA tAderake abhAvamukta mane kare; tumi tAderake tAdera lakSaNa dvArA cinate pArave| tArA mAnuSera kAche kAkuti-minati kare cAYa nA| tomarA ye sampadai dAna kara, ye-samparke AllAha samyaka jJAta|
yArA svIYa dhana-sampada vyaYa kare rAte o dine, geApane o prakAzye| tAdera janya pratidAna raYeche tAdera ravera nikaTa| tAdera keAno AzaGkA nei evaM tArA cintitao have nA|

yArA suda khAYa, tArA oi vyaktira mato dA~r3Ave, yAke zaYatAna svIYa sparza dvArA pAgala kare deYa| eTA ejanya ye, tArA vale, nizcaYai vyAvasA to sudera matoi! athaca AllAha vyavasAke karechena hAlAla evaM sudake karechena hArAma| ataHpara yAra kAche tAra ravera pakSa theke upadeza AsAra para se virata haYeche, tave atIte yA haYeche tA tArai; tAra viSaYa AllAhara opara nyasta| Ara yArA punarAYa suda grahaNa karave, tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI; tArA sekhAne cirasthAYI have|
AllAha sudake nizcihna karena evaM dAnake vardhita karena| AllAha kono akRtajJa pApAcArIke bhAlovAsena nA|

nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche, satkAja kareche, sAlAta pratiSThA kareche evaM yAkAta pradAna kareche, tAdera janya raYeche tAdera ravera nikaTa pratidAna| tAdera keAno bhaYa nei evaM tArA cintitao have nA|
he mu ’ minagaNa, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM sudera yA vakeYA Ache, tA parityAga karo, yadi teAmarA mu’mina haYe thAko|

Ara yadi teAmarA tA nA karo, tave AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera pakSa theke yuddhera ghoSaNA zune nAo| kintu yadi teAmarA tAovA karo, tave mUladhana teAmAderai thAkave| (ebhAve) teAmarA kArao prati atyAcAra karave nA evaM tomarAo atyAcArita have nA|
Ara yadi se abhAvagrasta haYa, tave sacchalatA AsA paryanta avakAza (pAoYA nyAYasaGgata adhikAra)| Ara dAna kare dile tA khuvai uttama, yadi teAmarA jAnate|
Ara tomarA oi dinake bhaYa karo, ye dina teAmAdera AllAhara kAche phiriYe neoYA have| ataHpara pratyekakei tAra karmera phala pUrNamAtrAYa deoYA have evaM tAdera prati keAno avicAra karA have nA|

he mu’mina gaNa, yakhana teAmarA paraspara nirdiSTa samaYera janya RNera AdAna-pradAna karo, takhana tA lipivaddha kare nAo evaM teAmAdera madhye keAno lekhaka yena nyAYasaMgatabhAve tA likhe deYa; kono lekhaka yena likhate asvIkAra nA kare| yemana AllAha tAke zikSA diYechena, temana tAra ucita lekhA| yAra dAYitve RNa, se yena lekhiYe neYa, Ara yena (ekSetre) bhaYa kare tAra rava AllAhake evaM lekhAra madhye vindumAtrao kama nA kare| yAra dAYa (RNI vyakti), se yadi nirveAdha vA durvala haYa, athavA nije lekhAra viSaYavastu valate akSama haYa, tave yena tAra abhibhAvaka nyAYasaMgatabhAve tA lekhiYe neYa| teAmAdera puruSadera madhya theke dujana sAkSI rAkho; yadi dujana puruSa nA haYa, tave ekajana puruSa o dujana mahilA sAkSIdera madhya theke yAdera teAmarA pachanda kara, (tAdera rAkho) yAte ekajana bhule gele anyajana smaraNa kariYe deYa| sAkSIgaNa yena asvIkAra nA kare; yakhana tAdera DAkA haYa| teAmarA ete virakta haYo nA, tomarA likhave tA cheATa heAka kiMvA var3a, tAra nirdiSTa samaYasaha| eTA AllAhara nikaTa adhika nyAYasaMgata evaM dRr3hatara sAkSya-pramANera janya evaM teAmAdera sandehe patita nA-haoYAra adhika upayukta| kintu yadi tomarA paraspara nagada vyavasA kara, tave tA nA likhale teAmAdera keAno doSa nei| teAmarA kraYa-vikraYera samaYa sAkSI rekho, keAno lekhaka o sAkSIke yena kaSTa deoYA nA haYa| (athavA kono lekhaka vA sAkSI yena kaSTa nA deYa) yadi teAmarA erUpa karo, tave tA teAmAdera pakSa theke pApAcAra| AllAhake bhaYa karo Ara AllAha teAmAdera zikSA dena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe samyaka jJAta |

Ara teAmarA yadi saphare thAko evaM keAno lekhaka nA pAo tave tomarA kono vastu vandhaka rekhe tAra dakhala vujhiYe dAo| yadi eke anyake vizvAsa kare, tave yAke vizvAsa karA haYa, se yena tAra kAche thAkA AmAnata phiriYe deYa evaM svIYa rava AllAhake bhaYa kare| teAmarA sAkSya geApana kareA nA; Ara ye tA geApana kare, tAra antara pApI| Ara tomarA yA kara AllAha oi viSaYe samyaka jJAna rAkhena|

AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA Ache, sava AllAharai| yadi teAmarA prakAza karo vA geApana karo yA tomAdera antare raYeche, AllAha teAmAdera kAcha theke tAra hisAva nevena| ataHpara yAke icchA tini kSamA karavena evaM yAke icchA tini zAsti devena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

rAsUla tAra ravera pakSa theke tAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche, sesavera prati ImAna enechena o mu’minarAo savAi ImAna eneche AllAha, tA~ra pherezatAdera, tA~ra kitAva o tA~ra rAsUladera prati| (tArA vale) AmarA tA~ra rAsUladera mAjhe pArthakya kari nA| tArA vale, AmarA zunechi o mene niYechi| he AmAdera rava, AmarA tomAra kSamA pratyAzI| Ara tomAra dikei (AmAdera) pratyAvartana|

AllAha kAuke tAra sAdhyAtIta kichu cApiYe dena nA| tAra janya bhAlomanda tA-i, yA se upArjana kare evaM tA-i tAra opara vartAYa, yA se kare| he AmAdera rava, yadi AmarA bhule yAi kiMvA bhula kari, tave AmAdera pAkar3Ao kareA nA| he AmAdera rava, AmAdera opara emana gurubhAra arpaNa karo nA, yemana AmAdera pUrvavartIdera opara arpaNa karechile, he AmAdera rava, AmAdera dvArA oi veAjhA vahana kariYo nA, yA vahana karAra zakti AmAdera nei| AmAdera pApa meAcana karo, AmAderake kSamA karo evaM AmAdera prati daYA karo| tumii AmAdera abhibhAvaka| sutarAM kAphira sampradAYera viruddhe AmAderake sAhAyya karo, vijaYI karo|
Alipha lA-ma mI-ma|
AllAha chAr3A keAno ilAha nei, tini ciraJjIva, sarvasattAra dhAraka|
tini tomAra prati kitAva avatIrNa karechena satyasaha—yA satyAYanakArI pUrvavartI kitAvasamUhera evaM avatIrNa karechena tAorAta o inajIla|

mAnuSera hidAYAtera janya, itaHpUrve (nAyila karechena) Ara nAyila karechena phurakAna| nizcaYai yArA AllAhara nidarzanAvalike asvIkAra kare, tAdera janya raYeche kaThina zAsti| Ara AllAha daNDadAne mahAparAkramazAlI|
nizcaYai AllAha, yA~ra nikaTa yamina o AsamAnera keAno viSaYai geApana thAke nA|
tinii, yini mAtRgarbhe yebhAve icchA teAmAdera AkRti gaThana karena| tini chAr3A Ara keAno ilAha nei| tini mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tinii tomAra prati kitAva avatIrNa karechena| tAte kichu AYAta suspaSTa, seguleAi kitAvera mUla aMza| Ara anyaguleA mutAzAviha| sutarAM yAdera antare vakratA raYeche, tArA phitanA evaM apavyAkhyAra uddezye, tAra tanmadhyakAra mutAzAvihaguleAra anusaraNa kare| athaca seguleAra vyAkhyA AllAha vyatIta keu jAne nA| evaM yArA jJAne sugabhIra, tArA vale, AmarA era prati ImAna enechi| era savai AmAdera ravera pakSa theke| Ara veAdhazaktisampannarAi zikSA grahaNa kare|
he AmAdera rava, hidAYAta deoYAra para Apani AmAdera antaraguloke vakra kare devena nA| ApanAra pakSa theke AmAdera dAna karuna rAhamAta| nizcaYai Apanii mahAna dAtA|
he AmAdera rava, Apani mAnuSake avazyai ekatrakArI oi dina, ye vyApAre kono sandeha nei| nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra pratizrutira vyatikrama karena nA|
nizcaYai yArA kuphuri kare, tAdera dhanasampada, santAnasantati AllAhara zAsti theke vA~cAte moTei kAje Asave nA| Ara tArAi hacche jAhAnnAmera indhana|

tAdera AcaraNa phira ‘ Aunera sampradAYa evaM tAdera pUrvavartIdera AcaraNera matoi, tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kareche| phale tAdera pApera kAraNe AllAha tAdera pAkar3Ao karechena| Ara AllAha zAstidAne atyanta kaThina|
kAphiradera vale dAo, teAmarA acirei parAbhUta have evaM tomAderake ekatra karA have jAhAnnAmera dike| Ara tA katai nA nikRSTa AvAsasthala!

nizcaYai duTeA dalera paraspara mukhomukhi haoYAra madhye teAmAdera janya nidarzana chila| ekaTi dala AllAhara pathe yuddha kareche; Ara apara dala kAphira, erA cokhera dekhAYa tAderake (musalamAnadera) dviguNa dekhachila| Ara AllAha yAke icchA nijera sAhAyyera mAdhyame zaktizAlI karena| nizcaYai ete raYeche antardRSTisampannadera janya zikSAgrahaNera var3a upakaraNa|

mAnuSera nikaTa suzobhita karA haYeche nArI, putrasantAna, stUpIkRta svarNa-raupya, cihnita ghor3A, gavAdi pazu evaM kSeta-khAmArera prati Asakti; yA tAra pravRttira cAhidA motAveka haYa| esavai hacche pArthiva-jIvanera bheAgyavastu| Ara AllAha, tA~rai nikaTa raYeche uttama AzraYasthala|

valo, ‘Ami ki teAmAdera esava apekSA uttama viSaYe avagata karAva? yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, tAdera janya tAdera ravera nikaTa raYeche jAnnAta, yAra taladeze nada-nadI pravAhita| tArA sekhAne cirasthAYI have| Ara pavitra strIgaNa evaM AllAhara pakSa theke santuSTi| Ara AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera samparke samyaka draSTA|
yArA vale, he AmAdera rava, nizcaYai AmarA ImAna enechi; ataeva, AmAdera gunAha kSamA kare dAo Ara AmAdera jAhAnnAmera zAsti theke rakSA karo|
tArA dhairyazIla, satyavAdI, anugata, dAnazIla evaM rAtera zeSaprAnte kSamAprArthanAkArI|
AllAha sAkSya dicchena Ara pherezatAgaNa evaM jJAnIgaNao ye, nizcaYai tini chAr3A kono ilAha nei, tini nyAYanItite pratiSThita| tini chAr3A Ara keAno ilAha nei| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYa isalAmai AllAhara nikaTa ekamAtra dIna| Ara yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche tArA paraspara kevala vidveSera kAraNe tAdera nikaTa jJAna AsAra parao matAnaikya kareche| evaM ye keu AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera prati kuphuri kare, (se jene rAkhuka) nizcaYai AllAha atyanta druta hisAva grahaNakArI |

sutarAM yadi tArA teAmAra sAthe vitarke lipta haYa tave vale dAo, ‘Ami evaM AmAra anusArIgaNa AllAhara prati AtmasamarpaNa karechi|’ Ara yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche o nirakSaraderake vale dAo, teAmarAo ki AtmasamarpaNa karecha? takhana yadi tArA AtmasamarpaNa kare, tave hidAYAta pAve| Ara yadi mukha phiriYe neYa, tA hale teAmAra dAYitva haleA zudhu pau~che deoYA| Ara AllAha vAndAdera samparke samyaka draSTA|
