nizcaYai yArA AllAhara nidarzanAvalike asvIkAra kare evaM naviderake anyAYabhAve hatyA kare, Ara sesava leAkake hatyA kare yArA mAnuSera madhye nyAYaparAYaNatAra nirdeza deYa| tAderake yantraNAdAYaka zAstira saMvAda dAo|
oisava leAka, yAdera kRtakarma duniYA o AkhirAte niSphala haYeche evaM tAdera keAno sAhAyyakArI nei|

tumi ki tAdera dekhani, yAderake kitAvera kichu aMza deoYA haYeche? tAderake AhvAna karA haYechila AllAhara kitAvera prati, tAhale tA tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare deve; etatsattveo tAdera madhye ekadala vimukha haYe phire yAYa|
(tArA erakama kare) e-kAraNe ye, tArA vale, ‘alpa kaYekadinera janya Aguna AmAdera kakhano sparza karave nA; ’ tAdera udbhAvita bhittihIna kathA tAderake dheA~kAYa pheleche|
sutarAM sedina, kemana have? yedina Ami tAderake ekatra karava, yAte kono sandeha nei evaM pratyekake arjita kAjera pratidAna pUrNamAtrAYa deoYA have; evaM tAdera prati kono avicAra karA have nA|

valo, he AllAha, tumii mAlika sArvabhaumatvera| tumi yAke icchA rAjatva dAna karo evaM yAra theke icchA rAjatva chiniYe nAo evaM yAke icchA sammAna dAna karo Ara yAke icchA lAJchita karo| teAmArai hAte yAvatIYa kalyANa| nizcaYai tumi sarvaviSaYe kSamatAvAna|
tumi rAtake dinera bhetare praveza karAo evaM dinake rAtera bhetare praveza karAo; Ara tumii jIvitake mRta theke evaM mRtake jIvita theke vera karo| Ara tumii yAke icchA aphuranta riyika dAna karo|

mu’mina gaNa yena mu’mina derake cher3e kAphiraderake vandhurUpe grahaNa nA kare evaM tAdera aniSTa theke AtmarakSAra uddezya vyatIta ye erUpa kare, AllAhara sAthe tAra kono samparka nei| AllAha tA~ra samparke teAmAdera satarka karachena| Ara AllAhara dikei pratyAvartana|
valo, teAmarA tomAdera antare yA-kichu Ache tA yadi geApana karo vA prakAza karo, AllAha tA avagata| Ara AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA kichu Ache, tini jAnena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

yedina pratyeke se yA bhAlo Amala kareche tA upasthita pAve evaM se yA manda kAja kareche tA-o pAve, se kAmanA karave yadi tAra evaM tAra vada Amalera madhye vizAla vyavadhAna thAkata| AllAha tA~ra samparke teAmAderake satarka karachena| Ara AllAha vAndAdera prati atyanta snehazIla|
valo, yadi teAmarA AllAhake bhAlovAso, tAhale AmAra anusaraNa karo, AllAhao teAmAderake bhAlovAsavena evaM teAmAdera aparAdha kSamA karavena, Ara AllAha atyanta kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
valo, ‘AllAha o rAsUlera Anugatya karo|’ yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tAhale AllAha kAphiradera bhAlovAsena nA|
nizcaYai AllAha Adama, nUha evaM ivarAhIma o imarAnera vaMzadharake samagra vizvajagatera madhye manonIta karechena|
tArA eke aparera vaMzadhara| Ara AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

smaraNa karo, imarAnera strI yakhana valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAra garbhe yA Ache nizcaYai Ami tA ekAnta tomAra janya mAnata karalAma, AmAra pakSa theke tumi tAke kavula karo| nizcaYai tumi sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

ataHpara yakhana se tAke prasava karala takhana se valala, he AmAra rava, nizcaYai Ami kanyAsantAna prasava karechi| se yA prasava kareche AllAha tA samyaka avagata| Ara putrasantAna to kanyA santAnera mato naYa| Ara Ami tAra nAma rekhechi mAraiYAma evaM abhizapta zaYatAna theke tAra o tAra vaMzadharake ApanAra AzraYe dicchi|

ataHpara tAra rava tAke uttamabhAve grahaNa karalena evaM tAke uttamarUpe lAlana-pAlana karalena o yAkAriYAke tAra tattvAvadhAYaka karalena| yakhanai yAkAriYA tAra kakSe praveza karata takhanai tAra nikaTa khAdyasAmagrI dekhate peta| se valala, ‘he mAraiYAma, esava tomAra janyava kothA theke Ase?’ se valata, ‘esava AllAhara pakSa theke| AllAha yAke icchA aparimita riyika dAna karena|’
sekhAnei yAkAriYA tA~ra ravera nikaTa prArthanA karala| valala, ‘he AmAra rava, tomAra nikaTa theke tumi AmAke pUta-pavitra santAna dAna karo| nizcaYai tumi prArthanA zravaNakArI|

ataHpara pherezatArA tAke DAkala e avasthAYa ye, se tAra kakSe sAlAtarata chila, ‘AllAha teAmAke susaMvAda dicchena iYAhaiYAra, se have AllAhara pakSa theke Agata eka kAlimAke satyAYanakArI, sardAra o sakala kAmanA-vAsanAmukta emana ekajana navi, yini puNyavAnadera antarbhukta|’
se valala, ‘ he AmAra rava, kIbhAve AmAra santAna have? athaca AmAra vArdhakya ese geche evaM AmAra strI vandhyA|’ tini valalena, ‘ebhAvei|’ AllAha yA icchA tA karena|

se valala, ‘he AmAra rava! AmAra janya ekaTi nidarzana dAo|’ tini valalena, ‘teAmAra nidarzana haleA ei ye, izArA-iGgita vyatIta tumi tina dina paryanta kArao sAthe kathA valate pArave nA evaM teAmAra ravake adhika parimANe smaraNa karo Ara sakAla-sandhyA tA~ra tAsavIha pATha kare pavitratA varNanA karo|
Ara yakhana pherezatA valala, ‘he mAraiYAma, AllAha tomAke manonIta karechena evaM teAmAke pavitra karechena Ara vizvajagatera nArIgaNera opara tomAke zreSThatva dAna karechena|
he mAraiYAma, teAmAra ravera anugata hao evaM sijadA karo o rukukArIdera sAthe ruku karo|

eTA gAYevera saMvAdasamUhera antarbhukta, yA Ami tomAra nikaTa oYAhi pAThiYechi| Ara mAraiYAmera tattvAvadhAnera dAYitva tAdera madhye ke grahaNa karave era janya yakhana tArA tAdera kalama nikSepa karechila tumi takhana tAdera nikaTa chile nA evaM yakhana tArA vAdAnuvAda karechila takhano tumi tAdera nikaTa chile nA|

yakhana pherezatA valala, he mAraiYAma, AllAha teAmAke tA~ra pakSa theke eka kAlimAra susaMvAda dicchena| tAra nAma mAsIha IsA mAraiYAmera chele| se duniYA o AkhirAte mahAsammAnera adhikArI evaM (AllAhara) naikaTyaprAptadera antarbhukta|
Ara se mAnuSera sAthe kathA valave dolanAYa thAkA avasthAYa o pariNata vaYase evaM se satkarmazIladera antarbhukta|

se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, kemana kare AmAra santAna have; athaca AmAke keAno puruSa sparza kareni| valalena, ‘ebhAvei! AllAha yA icchA sRSTi karena| yakhana keAneA viSaYa siddhAnta grahaNa karena takhana kevala valena, ‘hao’! phale tA haYe yAYa|
Ara tAke tini zikSA devena kitAva, hikamAha, tAorAta o inajIla|

Ara tAke vani isarAIlera janya rAsUla hiseve maneAnIta karavena| nizcaYai Ami teAmAdera nikaTa teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke nidarzana niYe esechi| Ami teAmAdera janya mATira dvArA pAkhira mato AkRti vAnAi; tArapara tAte yakhana phu~ dii, takhana tA ur3anta pAkhite pariNata haYe yAYa AllAhara hukume| Ara Ami Arogya kari janmAndhake evaM zvetakuSTha rogIke, Ara Ami mRtake jIvita kari AllAhara hukume| Ara Ami tomAderake valate pAri—yA tomarA bhakSaNa karo evaM yA tomarA ghare saJcita rAkha| nizcaYai ete tomAdera janya nidarzana raYeche; yadi tomarA mu’mina hao|’

Ara Ami esechi satyAYanakArIrUpe AmAra pUrve yA Ache tAra arthAt tAorAtera, evaM Ami yena tomAdera janya hAlAla kari kataka, yA tomAdera janya hArAma karA haYechila| Ara Ami teAmAdera nikaTa esechi teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke nidarzanasaha, kAjei AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya karo|
nizcaYai AllAha AmAra o teAmAdera rava| sutarAM tomarA tA~rai ivAdAta karo, eTAi sarala-saThika patha|

ataHpara yakhana IsA tAdera kuphuri upalavdhi karala, takhana valala, ‘kArA AllAhara pathe AmAke sAhAyya karave?’ hAoYArigaNa valala, ‘AmarAi AllAhara pathe sAhAyyakArI| AmarA AllAhara prati ImAna enechi| Ara Apani sAkSI thAkuna, nizcaYai AmarA musalima|’
he AmAdera rava, AmarA se viSaYe ImAna enechi—yA Apani avatIrNa karechena, AmarA rAsUlera Anugatya karechi; ataeva, AmAderake sAkSyadAtAdera antarbhukta kare nina|
evaM tArA cakrAnta kareche Ara AllAhao kauzala avalamvana karechena; Ara AllAha hacchena sarveAttama kauzalI|

smaraNa karo, yakhana AllAha valalena, ‘he IsA, Ami tomAke pUrNatA dAna karava evaM tomAke AmAra nikaTa uThiYe neva; evaM yArA kuphari kare tAdera theke tomAke pavitra/mukta karava| Ara teAmAra anusArIderake kAphiradera opara kiYAmAta paryanta prAdhAnya deva| tArapara AmAra kAchei tomAdera pratyAvartana| ataHpara ye viSaYe tomarA matavirodha karate Ami tAra mImAMsA karava|
ataeva, yArA kuphari kareche, tAderake Ami duniYA evaM AkhirAte kaThina zAsti devo, Ara tAdera keAno sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA|
pakSAntare yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche| tini tAdera prApya paripUrNabhAve devena| Ara AllAha atyAcArIdera bhAlovAsena nA|
eTA Ami tomAra nikaTa tilAoYAta karachi AYAtasamUha o hikamAtapUrNa upadeza theke|
niHsandehe AllAhara nikaTa IsAra dRSTAnta hacche Adamerai mateA| tAke mATi dvArA sRSTi karechilena tArapara tAke valechilena ‘hao’| phale se haYe gela|
ei satya tomAra ravera pakSa theke, kAjei tumi saMzaYavAdIdera arntabhukta haYo nA|

ataHpara teAmAra nikaTa jJAna AsAra para ye keu e viSaYe tomAra sAthe tarka kare tAke valo, eso AmarA AhvAna kari AmAdera santAnaderake o tomAdera santAnaderake, AmAdera nArIderake o tomAdera nArIderake, AmAdera nijederake o tomAdera nijederake, tArapara AmarA muvAhAlA kari, ataHpara mithyAvAdIderake AllAhara lA ‘ nata dii|
nizcaYai egulo satya varNanA | Ara eka AllAha chAr3A anya keAno ilAha nei| nizcaYai AllAha; tinii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
ataHpara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, nizcaYai AllAha viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera samparke samyaka avagata|

vala, ‘he kitAvigaNa, eso eka kathAYa, yA AmAdera madhye o teAmAdera madhye samAna ye—AmarA AllAha chAr3A anya kArao ivAdAta nA kari, tA~ra sAthe keAno zarika nA kari, evaM AmAdera keu AllAha chAr3A kAuke rava hiseve grahaNa nA kari| tArapara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale tomarA valo ye, tomarA sAkSI thAko, nizcaYai AmarA musalima|’
he kitAvigaNa, kena teAmarA ivarAhImera viSaYe vAdAnuvAda karo? athaca tAorAta o inajIla to tAra parei nAyila haYeche| tavuo ki teAmarA vojho nA?

dekho, tomarA to sesava loka, ye viSaYe teAmAdera sAmAnya jJAna Ache se viSaYe teAmarA vivAda karecha, tave ye viSaYe tomAdera vindumAtra jJAna nei, se viSaYe kena vivAda karacha? Ara AllAha jAnena; kintu tomarA jAno nA|
ivarAhIma iYAhUdi o chila nA evaM khRsTAnao chila nA, varaM se chila ekaniSTha musalima evaM chila nA se muzarikao|
nizcaYai mAnuSera madhye tArAi ivarAhImera nikaTatama yArA tAra anusaraNa kareche, Ara ei navi evaM yArA tAra prati ImAna eneche| Ara AllAha mu ’ minadera abhibhAvaka|
kitAvidera ekadala cAYa, yadi teAmAdera vipathagAmI karate pArata, athaca tArA nijederakei vipathagAmI kare; kintu tArA upalavdhi kare nA|
he kitAvirA, kena teAmarA AllAhara kAlAmake asvIkAra karo, athaca teAmarAi tAra sAkSya vahana karo|
he kitAvirA, kena teAmarA satyake mithyAra sAthe saMmizraNa karacha evaM satyake geApana karacha, athaca teAmarA tA jAno|
Ara kitAvidera ekadala valala, ‘mu ’ minagaNera opara yA kichu avatIrNa haYeche, tAra prati dinera zurubhAge ImAna Ano, Ara dinera zeSa bhAge kuphari karo, (tAhale) sambhavata tArAo phire Asave|’

yArA teAmAdera dIna anusaraNa kare calave, tAdera chAr3A Ara kAUke vizvAsa karave nA, valo, ‘niHsandehe AllAhara hidAYAtai prakRta hidAYAta; yA tomAdera deoYA haYeche anurUpa anyakeo deoYA have, vA teAmAdera ravera sAmane tArA teAmAdera opara vijaYI have, tumi valo, nizcaYai anugraha AllAharai hAte, tini yAke icchA tA dAna karena, evaM AllAha prAcuryamaYa o sarvajJa|’
tini svIYa anugrahera janya yAke icchA ekAntabhAve veche nena| Ara AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|

Ara emanao kitAvi raYeche, teAmarA yadi tAdera kAche vahu dhana-sampada AmAnata rAkha, tavuo tA teAmAdera pherata deve, Ara tAdera madhye emanao raYeche, yAdera nikaTa ekaTi dinAra gacchita rAkhaleo pherata deve nA, ye paryanta-nA tumi tAra (mAthAra) opara dA~r3iYe thAkave| eTA ejanya ye, tArA vale, nirakSaradera adhikAra vinaSTa karAra vyApAre AmAdera kono javAvadihitA nei| Ara tArA AllAhara nAme jenezunei mithyA vale|
avazyai, (kena javAvadihitA have nA?) ye tAra aGgIkAra pUrNa kare evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, avazyai AllAha sesava muttAkiderake bhAlovAsena|

nizcaYai yArA AllAhara saGge kRta pratizruti evaM nijedera zapathake tuccha mUlye vikri kare, AkhirAte tAdera kono aMza nei| kiYAmAtera dine AllAha tAdera sAthe kathA valavena nA evaM tAdera dike tAkAvena nA| evaM tAdera parizuddha karavena nA; Ara tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

Ara tAdera ekadala, yArA vikRta kare kitAvake pATha kare, yAte tomarA tA kitAvera aMza mane karo, athaca tA kitAvera aMza naYa| evaM tArA vale, tA AllAhara pakSa theke; athaca tA AllAhara pakSa theke naYa| (ebhAve) tArA jenezunei AllAhara prati mithyAreApa kare|

kono mAnuSera janya samIcIna naYa ye, AllAha tAke kitAva, hikamAha o navuoYAta dAna karavena, ataHpara se mAnuSake valave, teAmarA AllAhara parivarte AmAra dAsatva karo; varaM (se valave) ‘tomarA ravvAni (AllAha-oYAlA) haYe yAo, yehetu tomarA kitAva zikSA dAo o adhyaYana karo|
tAchAr3A se tomAdera pherezatAgaNa o navigaNake rava hiseve grahaNa karate Adeza kare nA| se ki tomAdera musalima haoYAra parao kuphurira Adeza karave?

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana AllAha navidera aGgIkAra grahaNa karalena ye, yadi Ami teAmAdera dAna kari—kitAva o prajJA; ataHpara teAmAdera nikaTa ekajana rAsUla Ase, ye teAmAdera kitAvera satyAYanakArI, takhana avazyai se rAsUlera prati ImAna Anave evaM tAke sAhAyya karave| (AllAha) valalena, ‘teAmarA ki svIkAra karacha evaM ei samparke AmAra oYAdA grahaNa kare niYecha?’ tArA valala, ‘AmarA svIkAra karalAma|’ tini valalena, ‘tAhale evAra sAkSI thAko| Ara Amio teAmAdera sAthe sAkSI railAma|’
sutarAM erapara yArA vimukha have tArAi to phAsika|

tArA ki AllAhara dInera parivarte anya dIna sandhAna karache? athaca AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA-kichu raYeche, svecchAYa heAka vA anicchAYa heAka, tA~rai anugata evaM tA~ra dikei (sesava) pratyAvartita have|

valo, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi AllAhara prati evaM yA kichu avatIrNa haYeche AmAdera opara evaM ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, i ‘ YAkUva o tA~dera santAnavargera opara; Ara yA kichu deoYA haYeche mUsA o IsA evaM anyAnya navigaNake tAdera ravera pakSa theke| AmarA tAdera kArao madhye pArthakya kari nA; Ara AmarA tA~rai kAche AtmasamarpaNakArI|
ye isalAma chAr3A anya keAno dharma grahaNa kare, kakhano tA gRhIta have nA evaM AkhirAte se antarbhukta have| kSatigrastadera

kIbhAve AllAha emana jAtike hidAYAta dAna karavena, yArA kuphuri kareche ImAna AnaYanera para evaM tArA sAkSya diYeche ye nizcaYai rAsUla satya evaM tAdera nikaTa eseche suspaSTa pramANa? Ara AllAha yAlima sampradAYake hidAYAta dAna karena nA|
erAi tArA, yAdera pariNAma halo tAdera opara AllAha o pherezatAgaNa evaM sakala mAnuSera lA ‘ nata|
sekhAne tArA cirasthAYI, tAdera zAsti zithila karA have nA evaM tAderake avakAza deoYA have nA|
tave tArA vyatIta, yArA erapara tAovA kareche evaM saMzodhana kareche| nizcaYai AllAha parama kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
nizcaYai yArA ImAna AnAra para kuphuri kareche evaM kuphuri karate agragAmI haYeche, kakhano tAdera tAovA kavula karA have nA| Ara tArA haleA pathabhraSTa|

nizcaYai yArA kuphuri kareche evaM kAphira avasthAYa mRtyuvaraNa kareche tAdera kAro kAcha theke pRthivIpUrNa svarNa vinimaYasvarUpa pradAna karaleo tA kakhano kavula karA have nA| tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti; Ara tAdera kono sAhAyyakArI nei|
tomarA yA bhAlovAso tA theke vyaYa nA karA paryanta tomarA kakhano kalyANa arjana karate pArave nA| Ara tomarA yA kichu vyaYa karo, nizcaYai AllAha se viSaYe samyaka avagata|

tAorAta avatIrNa haoYAra pUrve isarAIla tAra nijera opara yA hArAma karechila, tA chAr3A sava khAdyai vani isarAIladera janya hAlAla chila| valo, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao tave tAorAta Ano evaM tA pATha karo|
eraparao yArA AllAhara prati mithyAreApa kare, tArAi sImAlaGghanakArI|
valo, ‘AllAha satya valechena| kAjei tomarA ekaniSThabhAve ivarAhImera dharmera anusaraNa karo| Ara se muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA|
niHsandehe sarvaprathama gRha—yA mAnuSera (ivAdatera) janya nirdhArita haYeche, yA vAkkAYa (mAkkAYa) avasthita evaM sArA jAhAnera mAnuSera janya hidAYAta o varakatamaYa|

tAte raYeche mAkAme ivarAhImera mato suspaSTa nidarzana| ye keu tAte praveza karave ؃ se nirApada| Ara mAnuSera mAjhe pratyeka sAmarthyavAna vyaktira opara AllAhara santuSTira uddezye oi gharera hAjja karA pharaya| Ara ye keu pratyAkhyAna kare, tAra jAnA ucita—nizcaYai AllAha vizvajagat hate amukhApekSI|
valo, ‘he kitAvirA, kena tomarA AllAhara nidarzanAvali asvIkAra karacha? athaca tomarA yA karo, AllAha se-viSaYe sAkSI|’
valo, ‘he kitAvirA, kena tomarA AllAhara pathe mu’ minadera vAdhA dAo tAra mAjhe vakratA anusandhAna kare? athaca tomarA (satyatAra) sAkSI| Ara AllAha teAmAdera kAryakalApa samparke anavagata nana|’
he mu’ minagaNa, yAderake kitAva pradAna karA haYeche, tomarA yadi tAdera dala vizeSera anusaraNa karo, tave tArA tomAderake ImAna AnAra para kAphira vAniYe chAr3ave|

Ara kIbhAve tomarA kuphuri karo, athaca tomAdera kAche pATha karA haYa AllAhara AYAtasamUha evaM tomAdera mAjhe vidyamAna tA~ra rAsUla? Ara ye keu AllAhake dRr3hatAra sAthe avalamvana karave se avazyai sarala pathera dike hidAYAtaprApta have|
he mu’ minagaNa, tomarA AllAhake yathAyathabhAve bhaYa karo evaM musalima nA haYe kakhanoi mRtyuvaraNa karo nA|

Ara teAmarA ekatre AllAhara rajjuke dRr3habhAve A~kar3e dharo evaM paraspara vibhakta haYeA nA| Ara teAmarA tomAdera opara pradatta niYAmAtera kathA smaraNa karo—yakhana teAmarA paraspara zatru chile, ataHpara AllAha teAmAdera mane samprIti dAna karechena, phale ekhana teAmarA tA~ra anugrahe paraspara bhAi-bhAi haYe gele| tomarA chile agnigartera kinArAYa; tini tomAdera tA theke rakSA karechena| ebhAve AllAha tA~ra nidarzanasamUha spaSTabhAve varNanA karena, yAte tomarA hidAYAta pAo|
Ara teAmAdera madhye emana ekaTA dala haoYA ucita, yArA kalyANera dike AhvAna karave, satkAjera Adeza deve evaM asatkAja theke niSedha karave; Ara tArAi haleA saphalakAma|
teAmarA tAdera mato haYo nA, yAdera nikaTa spaSTa nidarzanasamUha AsAra para tArA vibhakta haYeche o matavirodha kareche; Ara tAdera janya raYeche mahAzAsti|

sedina, yedina kataka cehArA ujjvala have, Ara kataka cehArA kAleA have; ataeva, yAdera cehArA kAleA have, tAdera valA have, ‘teAmarA ki ImAna AnAra para kuphuri karecha? ataeva, tomarA zAsti bhoga karo, yehetu tomarA kuphuri karechile|’
Ara yAdera cehArA ujjvala have, tArA AllAhara rAhamAtera mAjhe thAkave; tathAYa tArA anantakAla avasthAna karave|
eguleA hacche AllAhara AYAtasamUha; yA Ami teAmAra kAche yathAyathabhAve pATha kare zunAcchi| Ara AllAha vizvajagatera prati yuluma karate cAna nA|
Ara yA-kichu AsamAnasamUha o yamine raYeche, sesava AllAharai evaM AllAhara dikei have savakichura pratyAvartana|

teAmarAi sarveAttama ummAta, mAnavajAtira kalyANera janya yAdera astitva dAna karA haYeche| teAmarA satkAjera Adeza deve o asatkAje niSedha karave evaM AllAhara prati ImAna Anave| Ara yadi kitAvirA ImAna Anata, tAhale tA tAdera janya kalyANakara hateA| tAdera madhye kichu raYeche mu’ mina Ara adhikAMzai haleA satyatyAgI|

yatsAmAnya kaSTa deoYA chAr3A tArA teAmAdera keAnoi kSati karate pArave nA| Ara yadi tArA teAmAdera sAthe yuddha kare, tAhale tArA pRSTha pradarzana karave; ataHpara tAdera sAhAyya karA have nA| (phale tArA vijaYI have nA)

AllAhara pratizruti kiMvA mAnuSera pratizruti vyatIta orA yekhAnei avasthAna kareche, sekhAnei tAdera opara lAJchanA cApiYe deoYA haYeche| Ara orA upArjana kareche AllAhara krodha| tAdera opara cApiYe deoYA haYeche daridratA| tA ejanya ye, tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake anavarata asvIkAra kareche evaM navigaNake anyAYabhAve hatyA kareche| tA ejanya ye, tArA avAdhyatA evaM sImAlaGghana karata|
tArA savAi samAna naYa| Ahale kitAvadera madhye kichu leAka emanao Ache, yArA satye avicala, tArA rAtera velA AllAhara AYAtasamUha pATha kare evaM sijadA kare|

tArA AllAhara prati o kiYAmAta divasera prati ImAna rAkhe evaM satkAjera Adeza deYa; evaM asat kAja theke niSedha kare evaM kalyANakara kAje pratiyogitA kare| Ara tArAi halo satkarmazIladera antarbhukta|
tArA yesava satkAja karave, tAderake tA hate kakhano vaJcita karA have nA| Ara AllAha muttAkidera viSaYe avagata|
nizcaYai yArA kuphuri kareche, tAdera dhanasampada o santAnasantati AllAhara vipakSe tAdera kono kAje Asave nA| Ara tArAi halo jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|

e pArthiva jIvane tArA yA-kichu vyaYa kare, tAra tulanA haleA sei jhar3eA hAoYAra mateA; yA himazItala vA pracaNDa uSNa, yA oi jAtira phasalera kSete AghAta hAne, yArA nijedera prati avicAra kareche, ataHpara tA dhvaMsa kare deYa| prakRtapakSe AllAha tAdera opara avicAra karena nA, kintu tArA nijerAi nijedera opara avicAra kare|

he mu’ minagaNa, tomarA mu’ mina vyatIta anya kAuke antaraGga vandhurUpe grahaNa kareA nA, tArA teAmAdera amaGgala sAdhane keAno truTi kare nA| yA tomAdera vipanna kare tA-i tArA kAmanA kare| tAdera mukhe mArAtmaka vidveSa prakAzita haYa, Ara yA-kichu tAdera antare lukiYe raYeche, tA Arao vezi jaghanya| nizcaYa Ami teAmAdera janya vahunidarzana vizadabhAve varNanA karechi, yadi teAmarA tA anudhAvana karo|

dekho! tomarAi to tAdera bhAlovAso, kintu tArA teAmAderake bhAlovAse nA| Ara teAmarA samasta kitAvei vizvAsa karo| athaca tArA yakhana teAmAdera sAthe sAkSAt kare, vale, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi|’ pakSAntare tArA yakhana pRthaka haYe yAYa, takhana teAmAdera opara Akroze AGula kAmar3Ate thAke| valo, ‘teAmarA tomAdera AkreAze marate thAko| nizcaYai antare yA raYeche se samparke AllAha savizeSa avagata|

teAmAdera yadi keAno kalyANa sAdhita haYa, tA tAderake kaSTa deYa, Ara teAmAdera kono akalyANa hale tArA Anandita haYa, Ara tAte yadi teAmarA dhairyadhAraNa karo evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karo, tave tAdera cakrAnta teAmAdera keAno kSati karate pArave nA| nizcaYai tArA yA kichu kare samastai AllAha pariveSTana kare Achena|
smaraNa karo, yakhana tumi parijanadera kAcha theke sakAla velA veriYe mu’ minaderake yuddhera avasthAne vinyasta karale, Ara AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
yakhana teAmAdera duTi dalera sAhasa hArAnora upakrama haleA, athaca AllAha tAdera abhibhAvaka; Ara AllAhara oparai mu’ minadera bharasA karA ucita|
avazyai AllAha vadare teAmAderake sAhAyya karechena, athaca teAmarA chile hInavala| kAjei tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo, yAte teAmarA kRtajJa hate pAreA|
smaraNa karo, yakhana tumi mu’ minagaNake valachile, ‘teAmAdera janya eTA ki yatheSTa naYa ye, teAmAdera sAhAyyArthe teAmAdera rava avatIrNa karavena tina hAjAra pherezatA?’

avazyai, varaM yadi teAmarA savara karo evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karo Ara tArA yadi drutagatite teAmAdera opara car3Ao haYa, tAhale tomAdera rava pA~ca hAjAra cihnita pherezatA dvArA tomAdera sAhAyya karavena|
Ara eTA teA AllAha zudhu susaMvAda o tomAdera Atmika prazAntira janya karechena| Ara sAhAyya to kevala parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAhara nikaTa thekei Ase|
yAte nirmUla karena kAphiradera eka aMzake vA tAdera lAJchita karena, yena orA vyartha/nirAza haYe phire yAYa|
e viSaYe tomAra karaNIYa kichui nei, yatakSaNa nA tini tAdera kSamA karena vA tAderake zAsti dena; kAraNa, tArA to sImAlaGghanakArI|
Ara yA kichu AsamAnasamUha o yamine raYeche, savai AllAhara| tini yAke icchA kSamA karena, yAke icchA zAsti dena| Ara AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
he mu’ minagaNa, tomarA cakravRddhi hAre suda kheYo nA| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo, yAte teAmarA saphalakAma hate pAreA|
evaM teAmarA se Aguna theke ve~ce thAko, yA kAphiradera janya prastuta karA haYeche|
Ara teAmarA AllAha o rAsUlera Anugatya karo, yAte kRpA lAbha karate pAra|
teAmarA teAmAdera ravera kSamA evaM emana jAnnAtera dike druta agrasara hao| yAra vistRti hacche AsamAnasamUha o yamina sadRza, yA prastuta karA haYeche muttAkidera janya|
yArA sacchala o asacchala avasthAYa vyaYa kare, yArA krodha saMvaraNa kare, Ara mAnuSera prati kSamApradarzanakArI, Ara AllAha satkarmazIladerakei bhAlovAsena|

Ara tArA yakhana kono azlIla kAja kare athavA nijedera prati avicAra kare AllAhake smaraNa kare, ataHpara nijedera pApera janya kSamA cAYa| Ara AllAha chAr3A ke pApa kSamA karate pAre? evaM tArA jene-vujhe tAdera kRtakarmera punarAvRtti kare nA|
oisava lokera pratidAna halo, tAdera ravera pakSa theke kSamA o jAnnAta| yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita haYa nada-nadI, yekhAne tArA sthAYI have| Ara satkarmazIladera puraskAra katai nA uttama!
teAmAdera Age atIta haYeche aneka jIvanavyavasthA | sutarAM teAmarA pRthivIte bhramaNa karo evaM dekha mithyA pratipannakArIdera pariNati kI haYeche|
egulo mAnavajAtira janya varNanA| evaM muttAkidera janya hidAYAta o upadeza|
Ara hInavala haYo nA evaM cintita haYo nA; teAmarAi vijaYI yadi teAmarA mu ’ mina hao|

yadi teAmarA Ahata haYe thAka, tave tArAo teA temani Ahata haYeche| Ara e dinaguleAke Ami mAnuSera madhye pAlAkrame Avartana ghaTiYe thAki| yAte kare AllAha jAnate pArena kArA ImAna eneche, Ara tini teAmAdera katakake zahIda hiseve grahaNa karate pArena, Ara AllAha atyAcArIdera bhAlovAsena nA|
Ara yAte AllAha mu ’ minadera parizodhana karena evaM kAphiraderake nizcihna karena|
teAmArA ki dhAraNA karo ye, teAmarA jAnnAte praveza karave, athaca AllAha tomAdera madhye ke jihAda kareche Ara ke dhairyazIla tA ekhano jAnenani?
Ara avazyai teAmarA teA mRtyu AsAra Agei maraNa kAmanA karate, kAjei ekhana teA teAmarA tA svacakSe upasthita dekhate pAccha|

Ara muhAmmAda kevala ekajana rAsUla, tAra pUrveo vahu rAsUla ativAhita haYeche| tAhale se yadi mRtyuvaraNa kare athavA nihata haYa, tave ki teAmarA ulaTA dike ghure yAve? Ara keu yadi ulaTAdike ghure yAYa, tave tAte AllAhara kono kSati karate pArave nA; evaM AllAha kRtajJaderake acirei pratidAna devena|

Ara AllAhara hukuma chAr3A keu marate pAre nA; tAra janya samaYa nirdhArita raYeche| Ara ye pArthiva vinimaYa kAmanA kare, Ami tAke tA theke kichu pRthivItei dAna kari| pakSAntare ye parakAle vinimaYa kAmanA kare, Ami tAke tAra theke kichu dii| evaM acirei Ami kRtajJadera puraskAra pradAna karava|

emana kata navi raYeche, yAdera sAthe vahu AllAhaoYAlA jihAda kareche| AllAhara pathe yA tAdera opara Apatita haYeche tAte tArA hInavala, durvala evaM nata haYani| Ara AllAha dhairyazIladera bhAlovAsena|

e kathA chAr3A tAdera Ara kono kathA chila nA—he AmAdera rava, mocana kare dAo AmAdera pApa evaM yA kichu sImAlaGghana haYe geche AmAdera kAje| Ara AmAderake dRr3hapada rAkho evaM kAphiradera viparIte AmAderake sAhAyya karo|
ataHpara AllAha tAderake diYechena duniYAra pratidAna evaM AkhirAtera uttama puraskAra| Ara AllAha satkarmazIladera bhAlovAsena|
he mu’ minagaNa, yadi teAmarA kAphiradera Anugatya karo, tAhale tArA tomAdera ulaTodike phiriYe deve, tAte teAmarA kSatigrasta have|
varaM AllAha teAmAdera abhibhAvaka, Ara tini uttama sAhAyyakArI|

acirei Ami kAphiradera hRdaYe bhItira saJcAra karava| kAraNa, tArA AllAhara sAthe zarika kareche ye samparke tini keAno pramANa avatIrNa karenani, Ara tAdera ThikAnA haleA jAhAnnAma| Ara katai nA nikRSTa sImAlaGghanakArIdera ThikAnA |

Ara avazyai AllAha tA~ra oYAdAke satye pariNata karechena, yakhana teAmarA tA~rai nirdeze tAdera vinAza karachile, ye paryanta nA tomarA sAhasa hArAle evaM Adeza samparke matabheda karale evaM yA tomarA bhAlovAso (tomAdera vijaYa) tA tomAdera dekhAnora para tomarA amAnya hale| tomAdera kichu saMkhyaka cAcchila ihakAla evaM kichu saMkhyaka cAcchila parakAla| tArapara tini tomAdera parIkSAra uddezye tAdera theke tomAdera phiriYe dilena| (arthAt tAdera hAte tomAdera parAjita karalena) avazya tini tomAdera kSamA karalena evaM AllAha mu’ minadera prati anugrahazIla|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana teAmarA UrdhvazvAse chuTachile evaM kArao prati bhrUkSepa karachile nA; athaca rAsUla teAmAderake DAkachila teAmAdera pechana dika theke| phale tini tomAderake vipadera para vipada dilena; yAte teAmarA yA hAriYecha evaM ye vipada tomAdera opara eseche, tAra kAraNe viSaNNa nA hao| Ara tomarA yA kara AllAha se viSaYe samyaka avagata|

ataHpara tini teAmAdera opara duHkhera para avatIrNa karalena prazAnti tandrArUpe, yA teAmAdera ekadalake Acchanna karechila Ara Areka dala nijerAi nijedera udvigna karechila| AllAha samparke tAdera mithyA dhAraNA hacchila mUrkhadera mato| tArA valachila—AmAdera ki kichu karAra adhikAra Ache? tumi valo, ‘savakichui AllAhara adhikAre| tArA tAdera antare lukiYe rAkhe emana viSaYa—yA teAmAra nikaTa prakAza kare nA| tArA vale, ‘AmAdera hAte yadi kichu karAra thAkata, tAhale AmarA ekhAne nihata hatAma nA|’ valo, ‘teAmarA yadi nijedera ghareo avasthAna karate tavuo yAdera janya mRtyu avadhArita chila tArA nijedera mRtyusthAne vera haYe Asata;’ eTA ejanya ye, AllAha tomAdera hRdaYe yA Ache tA parIkSA karena evaM tomAdera antare yA Ache tA parizodhana karena| Ara antare yA Ache AllAha se samparke vizeSabhAve avagata|

ye dina dudala parasparera mukhomukhi haYechila sedina tomAdera madhya theke yArA pRSThapradarzana karechila, tAdera kono kRtakarmera phale zaYatAnai tAdera padaskhalana ghaTiYe chila| avazya AllAha tAderake kSamA karechena| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla o var3a sahanazIla|

he mu’ minagaNa, tomarA tAdera mato haYo nA, yArA kuphuri kare evaM tAdera bhAiYerA yakhana deze deze saphara kare vA jihAda kare takhana tAdera samparke vale, tArA yadi AmAdera sAthe thAkata, tave tArA marata nA o nihata hato nA| phale AllAha tA tAdera antare AkSepe pariNata karena| prakRtapakSe AllAha jIvana o mRtyu dAna karena, Ara tomarA yA karo—AllAha se viSaYe samyaka draSTA|
Ara yadi teAmarA AllAhara pathe zahIda hao vA mRtyuvaraNa karo, tArA yA kichu saJcaYa kare thAke, AllAhara kSamA o karuNA sesava kichura ceYe uttama|
Ara yadi teAmarA mRtyu varaNa karo athavA nihata hao, avazyai tomAderake AllAhara sAmane samaveta karA have|

AllAhara rAhamAtei tumi tAdera janya keAmala hRdaYa haYecha, pakSAntare yadi tumi rUr3ha o kaThina hRdaYa hate tave tArA tomAra nikaTa theke vicchinna haYe yeta| kAjei tumi tAdera kSamA kare dAo evaM tAdera janya kSamA prArthanA karo, evaM gurutvapUrNa viSaYe tAdera sAthe parAmarza karo| ataHpara yakhana keAno siddhAnta grahaNa karo, takhana AllAhara opara bharasA karo; nizcaYai AllAha bharasAkArIdera bhAlovAsena|

yadi AllAha teAmAdera sahAYatA karena, tAhale keu teAmAdera opara jaYI hate pArave nA| Ara yadi tini teAmAderake sAhAyya nA karena; tave emana ke Ache, ye teAmAdera sAhAyya karate pAre? Ara AllAhara oparai mu’ minadera bharasA karA ucita|

Ara keAno navira janya zobhanIYa naYa ye, se khiYAnAta karave| Ara ye khiYAnAta karave se kiYAmAtera dina sei khiYAnAtakRta vastu niYe Asave| ataHpara pUrNabhAve vadalA deoYA have pratyekake, se yA arjana kareche| Ara tAdera prati keAno avicAra karA have nA|
ye AllAhara icchAra anugata, se ki tAra mato, ye AllAhara krodha niYe phireche? tAra ThikAnA jAhAnnAma; Ara tA katainA nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala!
AllAhara nikaTa tArA vibhinna starera; Ara AllAha dekhena, yA kichu tArA kare|

avazyai AllAha mu’ minadera prati anugraha karechena yakhana tini tAdera mAjhe tAdera nijedera madhya theke ekajana rAsUla pAThiYechena| yini tAdera nikaTa tA~ra AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karena | tAderake parizeAdhana kare evaM tAderake kitAva o hikamAh zikSA deYa; evaM nizcaYai tArA pUrve suspaSTa pathabhraSTatAra madhye chila|

kI vyApAra! yakhana teAmAdera opara emana musivata elo athaca nizcaYai teAmarA era dviguNa musivata ghaTiYechile, takhana teAmarA valale, eTA keAthA theke elo? valo, e kaSTa teAmAdera opara pau~cheche teAmAderai pakSa theke| nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
Ara yedina dudala sainyera meAkAvilA haYeche, sedina teAmAdera opara yA Apatita haYeche, tA AllAhara hukumei haYeche evaM yena tini parakha kare nena mu’ minaderake|

evaM tAderakeo jAnavena—yArA munAphika chila| Ara tAderake valA halo, eseA, AllAhara rAhe jihAda karo kiMvA pratihata karo| tArA valala, AmarA yadi jAnatAma ye jihAda have, tAhale avazyai teAmAdera sAthe thAkatAma| se dina tArA ImAnera tulanAYa kuphurira kAchAkAchi chila| tArA nijera mukhe se kathAi vale yA tAdera antare nei; Ara AllAha bhAlobhAve jAnena— tArA yA kichu geApana kare|

tArA se sava leAka, yArA vase theke svIYa bhAidera samvandhe vale, yadi tArA AmAdera anusaraNa karata tave nihata hato nA| valo, teAmAdera nijedera theke mRtyuke pratihata karo yadi teAmarA satyavAdI haYe thAko|
Ara yArA AllAhara rAhe zahIda haYa, tAderake tumi kakhaneA mRta mane kareA nA; varaM tArA tAdera ravera nikaTa jIvita o tAderake riyika deoYA haYa|

AllAha svIYa anugrahe tAderake yA dAna karechena tAte tArA Anandita| Ara tAdera pechane yArA ekhano tAdera sAthe milita haYani tAdera janya tArA Ananda prakAza kare| e kAraNe ye, tAdera keAno bhaYa nei evaM tArA cintitao have nA|
AllAhara niYAmAta o anugrahera janya tArA Ananda prakAza kare evaM nizcaYa AllAha mu’ minadera karmaphala vinaSTa karena nA|
yArA Ahata haoYAra parao AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera AhvAne sAr3A deYa, erUpa yArA satkAja kare o tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, tAdera janya raYeche mahApratidAna|

yAderake leAkerA valechila, nizcaYai tomAdera viruddhe lokerA jar3o haYeche; ataeva tomarA tAderake bhaYa karo| takhana eTi tAdera ImAna Arao vAr3iYe diYeche evaM tArA valeche, AmAdera janya AllAhai yatheSTa; tini katai nA uttama karmavidhAYaka!
ataHpara phire elo musalamAnarA AllAhara niYAmAta o anugraha niYe, kono aniSTa tAdera sparza kareni evaM tArA AllAhara santuSTi anveSaNa kareche; Ara AllAha mahAanugrahazIla|
nizcaYai zaYatAna, se tomAderake tAra vandhudera bhaYa dekhAYa| sutarAM teAmarA tAderake bhaYa kareA nA, AmAke bhaYa karo teAmarA yadi ImAnadAra haYe thAko|

Ara yArA kupharera dike dhAvita hacche, tArA yena teAmAke viSaNNa nA kare| nizcaYai tArA AllAhara keAno aniSTa karate pArave nA| AllAha cAna ye, AkhirAte tAdera janya (jAnnAtera) keAno aMza rAkhavena nA; Ara tAdera janya raYeche mahAzAsti|
yArA ImAnera parivarte kuphara kraYa kare niYeche, tArA kakhano AllAhara vindumAtra kSatisAdhana karate pArave nA; Ara tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
kAphirarA yena mane nA kare ye, AmAra avakAza tAdera janya kalyANakara| Ami teA tAdera avakAza dii, yena tArA pApa vRddhi kare; Ara tAdera janya raYeche lAJchanAkara zAsti|

apavitra theke pavitrake pRthaka nA karA paryanta tomarA ye avasthAYa raYecha, AllAha emana nana ye, mu’ minaderake se avasthAYa cher3e devena| ebhAve gAYeva samparke tomAderake avagata karA AllAhara niYama naYa; tave AllAha tA~ra rAsUlagaNera madhye yAke icchA nirvAcana karena| ataeva, tomarA AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUladera opara ImAna Ano| Ara yadi tomarA ImAna Ano o tAkaoYA avalamvana karo tave tomAdera janya raYeche mahApuraskAra|

Ara AllAha nija anugrahe tAderake yA diYechena tA niYe yArA kRpaNatA kare tArA yena eTAke kalyANakara mane nA kare; varaM tA tAdera janya akalyANakara| yA niYe tArA kArpaNya karave kiYAmAtera dina tA diYe tAdera galAYa ver3i parAno have| AsamAnasamUha o yaminera svatvAdhikAra ekamAtra AllAharai| tomarA yA karo AllAha se viSaYe samyaka avahita|

avazyai AllAha tAdera kathA zunechena, yArA vale—‘AllAha daridra Ara AmarA vittavAna!’ acirei Ami tAdera kathA evaM naviderake anyAYabhAve hatyA karAra viSaYaTio likhe rAkhava ataHpara valava, AsvAdana karo jvalanta Agunera zAsti|
e halo tArai pratiphala, yA teAmarA itaHpUrve nija hAte pAThiYecha| Ara AllAha vAndAdera prati atyAcArI nana|

yArA vale, nizcaYai AllAha AmAdera theke aGgIkAra niYechena ye, AmarA yena keAno rAsUlera opara ImAna nA Ani, yatakSaNa nA tini AmAdera nikaTa emana kuravAni niYe Asavena, yAke Aguna grAsa kare neve| valo, teAmAdera mAjhe AmAra pUrve rAsUlagaNa nidarzanasamUha evaM teAmarA yA valacha tA niYe esechila, tave kena teAmarA tAderake hatyA karecha, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI haYe thAko?

tArA yadi teAmAke mithyAvAdI pratipanna kare, (jene rekho) tave teAmAra pUrve aneka rAsUlake mithyAvAdI pratipanna karA haYeche, yArA spaSTa nidarzanasamUha, sahIphAsamUha o dIptimaYa kitAva niYe esechila|

pratyeka prANIke mRtyura svAda AsvAdana karate have| Ara kiYAmAtera dina teAmAdera paripUrNa vadalA pradAna karA have| sutarAM yAke jAhAnnAma theke dUre rAkhA have evaM jAnnAte praveza karAneA have, se-i have saphala; Ara pArthiva jIvana dho~kAra sAmagrI chAr3A Ara kichui naYa|

avazyai tomAderake tomAdera dhana-sampada o jIvana niYe parIkSA karA have| teAmarA avazyai zunave pUrvavartI kitAvidera evaM muzarikadera nikaTa theke vahu kaSTadAYaka ukti| Ara yadi teAmarA dhairyadhAraNa karo evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karo, tave tA have ekAnta dRr3ha saMkalpera vyApAra|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana AllAha Ahale kitAvadera kAcha theke pratijJA grahaNa karalena, avazyai tA tomarA mAnuSera nikaTa varNanA karave evaM tA geApana karave nA; takhana tArA se pratijJAke nijedera pechane nikSepa karala Ara tA tArA svalpa mUlye vikraYa karala | sutarAM katai nA nikRSTa tArA yA vikraYa kareche!

tumi kakhano ekathA mane kareA nA, yArA nijedera kRtakarmera opara Anandita haYa evaM nijedera nA karA viSaYera janya prazaMsA kAmanA kare, tArA AmAra zAsti theke avyAhati lAbha karave| Ara tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
Ara AsamAnasamUha o yaminera sArvabhaumatva AllAharai janya| AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
nizcaYai AsamAnasamUha o yaminera sRSTite evaM divA-rAtrira Avartane veAdhasampanna leAkadera janya aneka nidarzana raYeche |

yArA dA~r3iYe, vase o zAYita avasthAYa AllAhake smaraNa kare evaM cintA-gaveSaNA kare AsamAnasamUha o yaminera sRSTira viSaYe; (evaM vale), he AmAdera rava, esava tumi anarthaka sRSTi karoni| tomArai janya sakala pavitratA, tumi AmAderake jAhAnnAmera zAsti theke vA~cAo|
he AmAdera rava, nizcaYai tumi yAke jAhAnnAme praveza karAve tAke tumi apamAnita karave; Ara yAlimadera kono sAhAyyakArI nei|

he AmAdera rava, AmarA nizcitarUpe zunechi ekajana AhvAnakArIke ImAnera prati AhvAna karate ye, tomarA tomAdera ravera prati ImAna Ano, tAi AmarA ImAna enechi| he AmAdera rava, AmAdera sakala gunAha kSamA karo evaM AmAdera sakala doSatruTi dUra kare dAo, Ara AmAderake satkarmaparAYaNadera sahagAmI kare mRtyu dAo|
he AmAdera rava, yA tumi pratizruti diYecha teAmAra rAsUlagaNera mAdhyame tA AmAderake dAo evaM kiYAmAtera dina AmAderake tumi apamAnita kareA nA; nizcaYai tumi pratizrutira vyatikrama kareA nA|

ataHpara tAdera rava tAdera du‘A kavula karalena; valalena, Ami teAmAdera keAno AmalakArIra Amalai vinaSTa kari nA, se puruSa heAka kiMvA nArI| teAmarA eke aparera aMza| ataeva, yArA hijarAta kareche, nijedera ghara theke utkhAta haYeche evaM AmAra pathe tAdera utpIr3ana karA haYeche evaM tArA jihAda kareche o zahIda haYeche, avazyai Ami tAdera theke sakala pApAcAra muche devo evaM tAderake praviSTa karAva jAnnAte, yAra taladeze pravAhita nada-nadI| eTA haleA AllAhara pakSa theke puraskAra; Ara AllAhara kAchei raYeche uttama puraskAra|
yArA kuphuri kareche, deze deze tAdera mukta vicaraNa yena teAmAke moTei dheA~kA nA deYa|
eTA haleA sAmAnya bhoga mAtra, erapara tAdera ThikAnA have jAhAnnAma; Ara tA katai nA nikRSTa AvAsasthala!

kintu yArA tAdera ravake bhaYa kare, tAdera janya raYeche jAnnAta, yAra taladeze pravAhita raYeche nada-nadI| sekhAne tArA cirasthAYI have| eTi AllAhara pakSa theke ApyAYana| Ara yA AllAhara nikaTa raYeche, tA satkarmazIladera janya ekAntai uttama|

Ara nizcaYai Ahale kitAvadera madhye emana vyakti raYeche, yArA ImAna Ane AllAhara opara evaM yA-kichu teAmAdera opara avatIrNa haYa, Ara yA-kichu tAdera opara avatIrNa haYeche, seguleAra opara, AllAhara sAmane vinaYAvanata thAke evaM AllAhara AYAtasamUhake svalpamUlye vikraYa kare nA, tArAi haleA sesava leAka yAdera janya raYeche puraskAra tAdera ravera nikaTa| nizcaYai AllAha druta hisAva grahaNakArI|
he mu ’ minagaNa, tomarA dhairyadhAraNa karo, mokAvelAra samaYa avicalatA pradarzana karo evaM sadA ImAnta raksaSAra janya sthita thAko, Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo, yena tomarA saphala hate pAro|

he mAnavajAti, teAmarA teAmAdera ravake bhaYa karo, yini teAmAderake eka vyakti theke sRSTi karechena evaM tAra theke tAra saGginIke sRSTi karechena; Ara vistAra karechena tAdera dujana theke vahu nara-nArI| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo, yA~ra nAme teAmarA eke aparera nikaTa AvadAra karo, evaM AtmIYadera vyApAre satarka thAko| nizcaYai AllAha teAmAdera paryavekSaNakArI |

tomarA iYAtI made rake tAdera sampada arpaNa karo, Ara tomarA apavitrake pavitra vastura dvArA vadale niYo nA| Ara tAdera sampada nijedera sampadera sAthe mizrita kare grAsa karo nA; nizcaYai eTA mahApApa|

Ara yadi tomarA bhaYa karo ye, tomarA suvicAra karate pArave nA iYAtI ma meYedera prati, tave nArIdera madhya theke yAdera bhAlo lAge tAdera viYe kare nAo—dui, tina, vA cArajana| tave yadi AzaGkA karo ye, tAdera madhye samatA vajAYa rAkhate pArave nA, tave ekajana athavA teAmAdera adhikArabhukta dAsIra (mAjhe kSAnta thAka); tomAdera avicAra nA karAra janya eTAi adhika zreYa|
Ara teAmarA strIderake sAnande tAdera meAhara diYe dAo; yadi tArA khuzi haYe kichu cher3e deYa tA teAmarA svAcchandye khuzimane bheAga karate pAro|

Ara tomarA diYo nA svalpajJAnera adhikArIderake tomAdera dhanasampada, yA AllAha teAmAdera jIvanayAtrAra avalamvana vAniYechena; varaM tA theke tAderake khAoYAo, parAo evaM tAdera sAthe uttama kathA valo|

viYera vaYase pau~chA paryanta iYAtImadera prati kheYAla rAkho; ataHpara yadi tAdera mAjhe paripakvatA anubhava karo, tAdera kAche tAdera sampada phiriYe dAo| evaM tomarA tA apacaYa o tAr3Ahur3A kare kheYo nA ei bhaYe ye, tArA var3a haYe yAve| sacchala vyakti yena (tA khAoYA theke) virata thAke, Ara abhAvagrasta saMgata parimANa khete pArave| yakhana tAdera hAte tAdera sampada pratyarpaNa karo, takhana se vyApAre sAkSI rAkho| hisAvagrahaNe AllAhai yatheSTa|
pitAmAtA o nikaTa AtmIYadera rekhe yAoYA sampattite puruSadera aMza Ache temanibhAve pitAmAtA o AtmIYadera parityakta sampattite nArIderao aMza Ache; alpa heAka kiMvA vezi, e aMza nirdhArita|
sampatti vaNTanera samaYa (oYAriza naYa, emana) AtmIYasvajana, iYAtIma o misakIna upasthita hale tA theke tAdera kichu dAo evaM tAdera sAthe sadAlApa kareA|
tArA yena bhaYa kare ye, yadi tArA cher3e yeta tAdera pazcAte durvala santAna-santati, tArAo zaGkita thAkata tAdera vyApAre; ataeva, tArA yena AllAhake bhaYa kare evaM saMgata kathA vale|
nizcaYai yArA iYAtImadera artha-sampada anyAYabhAve grAsa kare, tArA nijedera udare Agunai bharti kare; Ara acirei tArA jvalanta agnite praveza karave dagdha haYe|

AllAha teAmAdera santAnadera samvandhe nirdeza dicchena—eka putrera aMza dui kanyAra aMzera samAna; tave yadi zudhu kanyAi duiYera adhika haYa, tave tArA rekhe yAoYA sampadera dui-tRtIYAMza prApta have| Ara yadi kanyA ekajanai haYa, tave tAra janya ardheka| mRtera pitAmAtA pratyekera janya parityakta sampattira eka-SaSThAMza, yadi mRtera putra thAke| yadi putra nA thAke evaM pitAmAtAi oYArisa haYa, tave mA pAve eka-tRtIYAMza| Ara mRtera bhAi-veAna thAkale tAra mA pAve eka-SaSThAMza kRta asiYata vA mRta vyaktira RNa parizeAdhera para| teAmAdera vAvA-mA evaM putrera madhye ke teAmAdera janya adhika upakArI teAmarA jAno nA| eTA AllAha kartRka nirdhArita vidhAna; nizcaYai AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

tomarA strIdera rekhe yAoYA sampadera ardheka pAve, yadi tAdera santAna nA thAke, Ara santAna thAkale pAve eka-caturthAMza kRta osiYyAta pUraNa, vA RNa parizodhera para| strIrA tomAdera sampadera eka-caturthAMza pAve yadi tomAdera santAna nA thAke| Ara santAna thAkale tomAdera rekhe yAoYA sampada theke tArA pAve eka-aSTamAMza tomAdera osiYyAta pUraNa kiMvA RNa parizodhera para| yadi kono nara vA nArI pitA-mAtA o santAnahIna avasthAYa oYArisa rekhe yAYa, tAra raYeche vaipitreYa bhAi vA vona, tAdera pratyeke (arthAt eka bhAi vA eka vona thAkuka) eka-SaSThAMza pAve| Ara era adhika hale savAi samAnabhAve zarika thAkave eka-tRtIYAMze, kRta osiYyAta pUraNa vA RNa parizodhera para, kArao kSati nA kare| eTA AllAhara nirdeza; AllAha sarvajJa, sahanazIla|

eguleA AllAhara nirdhArita sImA| ye-keu AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karave, tAke tini emana jAnnAte praveza karAvena, yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita have nada-nadI; tArA sekhAne cirasthAYI have; Ara eTA mahAsAphalya|
Ara ye-keu AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera avAdhya have evaM tAra sImAlaGghana karave, tini tAke jAhAnnAme praveza karAvena; se sekhAne cirasthAYI have| tAra janya raYeche lAJchanAkara zAsti|

Ara teAmAdera nArIdera madhye yArA vyabhicAre lipta have, tave tAdera viruddhe teAmAdera madhya theke cArajana puruSake sAkSI talava karo| yadi tArA sAkSya pradAna kare, tAderake gRhe Avaddha karo, yatakSaNa nA mRtyu tAderake tule neYa athavA AllAha tAdera janya anya keAno vidhAna dena|

Ara teAmAdera madhye ye dujana ei anaitika kAje lipta haYa, tAderake zAsti dAo| ataHpara yadi ubhaYe tAovA kare evaM nijedera saMzeAdhana kare, tave tAdera theke virata thAko| nizcaYai AllAha tAovA kavulakArI, asIma daYAlu|
avazyai AllAha tAdera tAovA kavula karavena, yArA bhulavazata manda kAja kare ataHpara anativilamve tAovA kare; erAi tArA yAderake AllAha kSamA kare dena| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara tAdera janya keAno taovA nei, yArA manda kAja kare yete thAke; emanaki yakhana tAdera nikaTa upasthita haYa mRtyu, takhana vale, ‘nizcaYai Ami ekhana tAovA karachi| Ara tAovA nei tAdera janya, yArA kuphuri avasthAYa mRtyuvaraNa kare| Ami tAdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|

he mu’ minagaNa, valapUrvaka nArIdera uttarAdhikArI haoYA teAmAdera janya vaidha naYa| tAderake tomarA yA pradAna karecha, sekhAna theke kichu neoYAra janya tAderake ATake rekho nA; tArA yadi nA keAno prakAzya azlIlatAYa lipta haYa| nArIdera sAthe sadbhAve jIvanayApana karo| tomarA yadi tAdera apachanda karo, tave haYato teAmarA emana eka jinisake apachanda karacha, yAte AllAha aneka kalyANa rekhechena|

yadi teAmarA eka strIra parivarte anya strIke grahaNa karate cAo evaM tAdera ekajanake pracura dhana-sampada dAo, tave tA theke kichui grahaNa karo nA| teAmarA ki tA apavAda diYe o prakAzya pApera mAdhyame grahaNa karave?
teAmarA kIbhAve tA grahaNa karave, athaca tomarA eke aparera sAthe ghaniSTha haYecha evaM tArA teAmAdera theke dRr3ha aGgIkAra grahaNa kareche?
tomarA emana nArIderake vivAha karo nA, yAderake tomAdera pitRpuruSagaNa vivAha karechena; tave yA atIta haYeche| nizcaYai eTA azlIla o ghRNya kAja evaM nikRSTa panthA|

teAmAdera janya hArAma karA haYeche—teAmAdera mAtA, teAmAdera kanyA, teAmAdera vona, teAmAdera phupu, teAmAdera khAlA, bhAtiji, bhAgini, teAmAdera dudhamA, teAmAdera dudhaveAna, teAmAdera zAzur3i, tomarA yesava strIdera sAthe milita haYecha tAdera apara svAmI theke sesava kanyA yArA tomAdera gRhe pratipAlita haYeche, tave yadi tAdera sAthe milita nA haYe thAka (tAhale tAdera anya svAmIra kanyAke viYe karale) tAte tomAdera kono pApa nei| evaM teAmAdera aurasajAta putravadhu evaM dui veAnake ekatra karA; tave yA atIte haYeche| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

evaM nArIdera madhya theke sadhavAderake, tave tomarA yAra mAlika haYecha, eTA teAmAdera janya AllAhara vidhAna| erA vyatIta teAmAdera janya anya nArIke svIYa arthera vinimaYe vivAhavandhane Avaddha karate cAoYA hAlAla karA haYeche; vyabhicArera janya naYa| ataHpara tAdera madhye yAke teAmarA sambhoga karave, tAke tAra nirdhArita mohara pradAna karo| mohara nirdhAraNera para (tAte hrAsavRddhira) kono viSaYe paraspara sammata hale kono pApa nei| nizcaYai AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara teAmAdera madhye ye vyakti svAdhIna mu ’ mina nArIke viYe karAra sAmarthya rAkhe nA, se teAmAdera adhikArabhukta mu ’ minA dAsIderake viYe karave; AllAha teAmAdera ImAna samparke adhika avagata| teAmarA eke anyera theke esecha,(arthAt maulikabhAve kono pArthakya nei) ataeva, tAderake tAdera mAlikera anumatikrame viYe karo evaM vidhi motAveka tAderake meAhara pradAna karo| tArA saccaritrA have, vyabhicAriNI vA upa-pati grahaNakAriNI naYa| ataHpara yadi tArA vivAhavandhane AsAra para keAno azlIla kAja kare tave tAderake svAdhInA nArIdera ardheka zAsti deve| eTA tAdera janya teAmAdera madhye yArA vyabhicAre lipta haoYAke bhaYa kare; Ara dhairyadhAraNa karA teAmAdera janye uttama| AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
AllAha teAmAdera janya savistAre varNanA karate cAna, teAmAderake hidAYAta dite cAna, tomAdera pUrvavartIdera Adarze evaM teAmAdera kSamA karate cAna| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
AllAha teAmAdera tAovA kavula karate cAna, Ara kupravRttira anusArIrA cAYa, teAmarA bhISaNabhAve pathacyuta hao|
AllAha teAmAdera veAjhA hAlakA karate cAna; Ara mAnuSa to durvala rUpe sRjita|

he mu ’ minagaNa, teAmarA eke aparera sampada anyAYabhAve grAsa kareA nA; tave teAmAdera parasparera sammatikrame vyavasA karA vaidha| Ara teAmarA nijedera hatyA kareA nA| nizcaYai AllAha teAmAdera prati asIma daYAlu|
Ara ye keu sImAlaGghana kare atyAcArI haYe erUpa karave, tAke khuva zIghrai Agune dagdha karava; eTA AllAhara pakSe khuvai sahaja|
yadi teAmarA kavirA gunAha parihAra karo, yA theke tomAderake vAraNa karA haYeche| tave Ami teAmAdera sagirA gonAha kSamA karava| evaM tomAderake praveza karAva sammAnajanaka sthAne|

Ara AllAha tomAdera ekajanake aparera opara ye zreSThatva dAna karechena, teAmarA tA AkAGkSA karo nA| puruSera janya oi aMza—yA tArA upArjana kareche, nArIra janya oi aMza yA tArA upArjana kareche| AllAhara kAche tA~ra anugraha prArthanA karo| nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvajJa|

Ami pratyekake pitAmAtA evaM nikaTatama AtmIYasvajanera parityakta sampattira uttarAdhikArI vAniYechi| Ara yAdera sAthe teAmarA aGgIkArAvaddha haYecha tAdera prApya diYe dAo| nizcaYai AllAha savakichura sAkSI|

puruSarA nArIdera opara tattvAvadhAYaka, e kAraNe ye, AllAha ekake aparera opara zreSThatva dAna karechena evaM tArA tAdera artha vyaYa kare| ataeva, puNyavatI nArIrA AnugatyaparAYaNa, leAkacakSura antarAle oi viSaYera hiphAjatakAriNI haYa—yA AllAha hiphAjata karechena| Ara yAdera theke tomarA avAdhyatAra AzaGkA karo tAderake tomarA sadupadeza dAo, tArapara tAdera zayyAYa ekA cher3e dAo, ataHpara prahAra karo| yadi tArA tomAdera anugata haYa, tave tAdera viruddhe kono panthA anveSaNa karo nA| nizcaYai AllAha samucca mahAna|

yadi tAdera madhye vicchedera AzaGkA karo, tave svAmIra parivAra theke ekajana evaM strIra parivAra theke ekajana sAliza niyukta karo| yadi tArA ubhaYe mImAMsA cAYa, AllAha tAdera ubhaYake (tAra) sAmarthya devena| nizcaYai AllAha sarvajJa, samyaka avagata|

tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo, tA~ra sAthe kAuke zarika kareA nA; evaM pitAmAtA, AtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma-misakIna, nikaTavartI o dUravartI prativezI, pAzApAzi calAra sAthi, musAphira evaM nijera dAsa-dAsIra sAthe sadAcAra karo| nizcaYai AllAha dAmbhika-ahaMkArIke pachanda karena nA |

yArA nijerAo kArpaNya kare evaM anyakeo kRpaNatAra nirdeza deYa, Ara geApana kare sesava viSaYa, yA AllAha tAderake svIYa anugrahe dAna karechena| Ara Ami kAphiradera janya lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|
Ara yArA svIYa dhana-sampada vyaYa kare leAka dekhAneAra uddezye evaM AllAha o kiYAmAta divasera prati ImAna Ane nA| vastuta zaYatAna yAra sAthi haYa se katai nA nikRSTa sAthi!
Ara kIi-vA kSati hato tAdera, yadi tArA ImAna Anata AllAha o kiYAmAta divasera prati evaM yadi vyaYa karata AllAha ye rijika diYechena tA theke? athaca AllAha tAdera vyApAre samyaka jJAta|
nizcaYai AllAha aNu parimANao yuluma karena nA; Ara tA satkarma hale tAke vahuguNe vRddhi kare dena evaM nijera pakSa theke tini devena mahApratidAna|
ataeva, kemana have yakhana Ami upasthita karava pratyeka sampradAYera ekajana sAkSI Ara tomAke upasthita karava tAdera sAkSIrUpe?
sedina kAmanA karave yArA kuphuri kareche evaM rAsUlera avAdhyatA kareche| yadi tArA mATira sAthe mize yeta| Ara tArA AllAhara kAche kono kathA gopana karate pArave nA|

he mu ’ minagaNa, teAmarA nezAgrasta avasthAYa sAlAtera kAcheo yeYo nA, yatakSaNa nA vujhate pAra teAmarA yA valo, Ara yadi tomarA musAphira nA hao tave apavitra avasthAYao naYa yatakSaNa paryanta nA tomarA geAsala karo| Ara yadi teAmarA asustha hao kiMvA saphare thAko athavA teAmAdera keu yadi zaucAgAra theke Aso kiMvA strI- sambhoga karo evaM pAni nA pAo, tave pavitra mATi dvArA tAYAmmuma karo evaM mukhamaNDala o hAta mAsAha karo| nizcaYai AllAha pApa mocanakArI, ati kSamAzIla|
tumi ki tAdera dekhani, yAdera kitAvera kichu aMza deoYA haYeche? tArA pathabhraSTatA kharida kare evaM kAmanA kare, teAmarAo yena pathabhraSTa haYe yAo|
AllAha teAmAdera zatru samparke adhika avagata| Ara abhibhAvaka hiseve AllAha tAAlA yatheSTa evaM sAhAyyakArI hiseveo AllAhai yatheSTa|

iYAhUdidera madhya theke yArA kAlimAsamUhake vikRta kare tAra mUla sthAna theke evaM vale, AmarA zunalAma evaM amAnya karalAma, Ara (navIke lakSa kare vale) tumi zonAra anupayogI kathA zuno tAdera jihvAgulo vA~ki Ye (dInera prati) tAcchilya kare vale ‘rA-YinA’| athaca yadi tArA valata ye, AmarA zunalAma o mAnya karalAma evaM Apani zununa evaM (oYAnayuranA) AmAdera dike tAkAna, tave seTAi chila tAdera janya uttama o yathArtha; kintu AllAha tAdera prati abhisampAta karechena tAdera kuphurira kAraNe| phale tAdera khuva alpa saMkhyakai ImAna Ane|

he ai sakala loka yAdera kitAva deoYA haYeche, tomAdera granthera satyAYanakArI hiseve Ami yA avatIrNa karechi tAra prati ImAna Ano| emana haoYAra Agei ye, Ami vikRta karava aneka cehArAke evaM seguleAke ghuriYe devo pechana dike athavA abhisampAta karava tAderake, yemana abhisampAta karechi AsahAve sAvatake| Ara AllAhara nirdeza avazyai kAryakara haYe thAke|
nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra sAthe zarika karA kSamA karavena nA| echAr3A anyAnya pApa yAke icchA tini kSamA kare devena| Ara ye vyakti AllAhara sAthe ziraka kare, nizcaYai se jaghanya pApa kare|
tumi ki tAdera dekhani yArA nijederake parizuddha vale thAke? varaM AllAhai yAke icchA pavitra karena| Ara tAdera opara sutA parimANa avicAra karA have nA|
lakSa karo! kIbhAve tArA AllAhara prati mithyA (apavAda) AreApa kare, spaSTa pApa hiseve eTAi yatheSTa|

tumi ki tAdera dekhani, yAderake kitAvera kichu aMza deoYA haYeche, tArA jivata (pratimA) o tAgUte vizvAsa kare? evaM kAphiradera sammandhe vale, erA mu ’ minadera tulanAYa adhikatara sarala saThika pathaprApta|
erAi tArA, yAdera AllAha abhisampAta karechena| Ara AllAha yAke abhisampAta karena, tumi tAra keAno sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
nAki tAdera janya Ache rAjatvera keAno aMza? yadi hato tave tArA mAnuSake (tA theke) sAmAnya parimANao dita nA|

nAki AllAha svIYa anugrahe mAnuSake yA pradAna karechena tA niYe tArA tAderake hiMsA kare? avazyai Ami ivarAhimera vaMzadharadera kitAva o hikamAha dAna karechi Ara tAderake dAna karechi vizAla rAjya|
ataHpara tAdera keu tAra prati ImAna eneche AvAra keu tA theke virata thekeche; Ara jAhAnnAmera Agunai tAdera dagdha karAra janya yatheSTa|

nizcaYai yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kareche, ati zigagira Ami tAderake Agune dagdha karava| yakhanai tAdera cAmar3AguleA pur3e yAve, takhanai AvAra Ami tA pAlTe deva anya natuna cAmar3A diYe, yAte tArA zAstira AsvAdana karate pAre| nizcaYai AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkarma kareche, acirei Ami tAderake emana jAnnAte praveza karAva, yAra taladeze pravAhita nada-nadI; sekhAne tArA cirasthAYI have| tAdera janya thAkave pUta-pavitra svAmI-strI evaM tAderake Ami praveza karAva ghana chAYAYa|

nizcaYai AllAha tomAdera nirdeza dicchena, teAmarA AmAnatasamUha prApakadera nikaTa phiriYe deve| Ara yakhana teAmarA mAnuSera mAjhe vicAra karo takhana nyAYabhittika phAYasAlA karo| AllAha teAmAdera ye upadeza dAna karena, tA kata uttama| nizcaYai AllAha sarvazrotA o sarvadraSTA|

he mu ’ minagaNa, AllAhara Anugatya karo evaM rAsUlera Anugatya karo evaM teAmAdera madhye yArA ‘ulula-Amara’ vA dAYitvazIla, tAdera (tAderao Anugatya karo)| ataHpara yadi teAmarA keAno viSaYe matabheda karo, tave tA AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera prati pratyarpaNa karo yadi teAmarA AllAha o kiYAmAta divasera opara ImAna ene thAko| Ara eTAi kalyANakara evaM pariNAme utkRSTatara|

tumi ki dekhani tAdera dike yArA dAvi kare ye, nizcaYai tArA tomAra prati avatIrNa evaM tomAra pUrve avatIrNa viSaYera opara ImAna eneche, tArA tAgUtera kAche vicAraprArthI hate cAYa, athaca eTAke pratyAkhyAna karate Adeza deoYA haYeche| Ara zaYatAna tAderake bhISaNabhAve pathabhraSTa karate cAYa|
Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena tAra dike evaM rAsUlera dike AseA, takhana tumi munAphikadera dekhave orA tomAra theke sampUrNabhAve mukha phiriYe nicche|

ataHpara kemana have yakhana tAdera kRtakarmera daruna tAdera opara vipada AreApita have? tArA tomAra nikaTa ese AllAhara nAme kasama kare valave, maGgala o samprIti chAr3A AmarA anya kichui kAmanA karini|
tAdera antarasamUhe yA Ache AllAha tA avagata Achena| ataeva, tumi tAdera upekSA karo, evaM sadupadeza dAo, evaM tAderake tAdera samvandhe marmasparzI kathA valo|

Ami zudhu ei uddezye rAsUla preraNa karechi ye, AllAhara nirdeze tAra anusaraNa karA have| tArA yadi nijedera prati juluma o sImAlaGghana kare e avasthAYa yakhana tArA yakhana tArA tomAra kAche Ase, evaM tArA AllAhara kAche kSamA cAYa evaM rAsUlao tAdera janya kSamA prArthanA kare, tAhale avazyai tArA AllAhake tAovA kavulakArI o asIma daYAlu rUpe pAve|

ataeva, teAmAra ravera kasama! tArA ImAnadAra have nA, yatakSaNa nA tAdera madhye sRSTa vivAdera vyApAre teAmAke vicAraka mAnave| ataHpara teAmAra mImAMsAra vyApAre nijedera mane konorakama saMkIrNatA nA rekhe tA paripUrNarUpe kavula kare neve|

Ara yadi Ami tAderake nirdeza ditAma ye, nijederake hatyA karo vA nijedera ghara cher3e veriYe yAo, tave tAdera madhye alpa saMkhyaka vyatIta keu tA karata nA| tArA yadi tA-i karata yA tAdera karate upadeza deoYA haYa, tave tA tAdera janya uttama evaM sthiratA sRSTite sudRr3ha hato|
Ara takhana avazyai Ami tAderake ditAma AmAra pakSa theke mahApratidAna|
Ara tAdera sarala pathe hidAYAta dAna karatAma|
Ara yArA AllAha o rAsUlera Anugatya karave, tArA AllAha yAderake niYAmAta dAna karechena—navi, siddIka, zahIda o satkarmazIla, tAdera sAthe thAkave| Ara sAthi hiseve tArA katai-nA uttama!
eTA AllAhapradatta anugraha| Ara AllAha parijJAta hiseve yatheSTa|
he mu ’ minagaNa, tomarA satarkatA avalamvana karo, erapara pRthaka pRthaka dale vA ekatre vera hao|

nizcaYai teAmAdera madhye Ache emana vyakti ye gar3imasi karavei, ataHpara tomAdera opara yadi kono musivata Ase, takhana se vale, nizcaYai takhana Ami tAdera sAthe nA-thAkAYa AllAha AmAra prati anugraha karechena|

pakSAntare teAmAdera prati AllAhara pakSa theke yadi keAno anugraha pau~che takhana avazyai se emanabhAve vale, yena tomAdera o tAra mAjhe keAno mitratAi chila nA| valave—hAYa! Ami yadi tAdera sAthe thAkatAma, tave Amio virATa saphalatA lAbha karatAma|

ataeva, AllAhara kAche yArA pArthiva jIvanake AkhirAtera vinimaYe vikri kare deYa tAdera AllAhara pathe jihAda karAi kartavya| Ara ye AllAhara pathe jihAda kare, ataHpara zahIda hoka vA vijaYa arjana karuka, zIghrai Ami tAke mahApuraskAra devo|

teAmAdera kI halo ye, teAmarA lar3Ai karacha nA AllAhara pathe, durvala sei puruSa, nArI o zizudera pakSe? yArA vale, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAderake ei janapada theke niSkRti dAna karuna; yAra adhivAsIrA atyAcArI! Ara ApanAra pakSa theke AmAdera janya ekajana abhibhAvaka evaM ApanAra pakSa theke AmAdera janya sAhAyyakArI pAThAna |

yArA ImAna eneche tArA AllAhara pathe jihAda kare| pakSAntare yArA kuphuri kareche tArA tAgUtera pakSe yuddha kare| sutarAM teAmarA jihAda karo zaYatAnera vandhudera viruddhe; (dekhave) zaYatAnera cakrAnta nitAntai durvala|

tumi ki tAdera dekhani, yAdera valA haYechila, teAmarA tomAdera hAta saMyata rAkho, sAlAta kAYema karo evaM yAkAta pradAna karo? ataHpara yakhana tAderake jihAdera nirdeza deoYA halo, takhana tAdera ekaTi dala mAnuSake bhaYa karala AllAhake bhaYa karAra mato, emanaki tAra ceYeo adhika| Ara valate lAgala, he AmAdera rava, kena AmAdera opara yuddha pharaja karale? AmAdera kena Arao kichukAla avakAza dile nA| tumi valo, pArthiva sAmagrI ati nagaNya, Ara AkhirAta muttAkidera janya uttama| Ara tomAdera prati sutA parimANao avicAra karA have nA|

teAmarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena, mRtyu teAmAderake pAkar3Ao karavei| yadio teAmarA sudRr3ha prAsAde avasthAna karo| yadi tAdera keAno kalyANa sAdhita haYa, tArA vale, eTA AllAhara pakSa theke| Ara yadi keAno akalyANa haYa, takhana vale, eTA haYeche teAmAra pakSa theke, vale dAo, e savai AllAhara pakSa theke| Ara esava lokera kI halo ye, tArA kono kathA vojhAra dhArekAcheo yAYa nA|

tomAra ye kalyANa pau~che, tA AllAhara pakSa theke Ara tomAra ye akalyANa haYa, seTA tomAra nijera kAraNe| evaM Ami tomAke mAnuSera prati rAsUla hiseve preraNa karechi| Ara sAkSI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|
ye rAsUlera Anugatya kare, se AllAharai Anugatya kare| Ara yArA mukha phiriYe na eYa, Ami tomAke tAdera janya rakSaNAvekSaNakArI niyukta kare pAThAini|

Ara tArA vale, AmarA anugata| ataHpara yakhana tArA tomAra nikaTa theke vera haYa, tAdera ekaTi dala rAtera velA parAmarza kare tumi yA valo tAra viparIta| AllAha tAdera rAtera salAparAmarza likhe rAkhena| sutarAM tumi tAderake upekSA karo evaM AllAhara opara bharasA karo, AllAhai karmavidhAYaka hiseve yatheSTa|
tArA ki kuraAna niYe cintA-gaveSaNA kare nA? eTA yadi AllAha vyatIta anya kArao pakSa theke hato, tave ete avazyai vahu vaiparItya o asaMgati dekhate peta|

yakhana tAdera kAche kono nirApattA vA bhaYera kono viSaYa Ase, takhana tArA seguleAke char3iYe deYa; kintu seguleA yadi tArA pau~che dita rAsUla vA tAdera ‘ulula Amara’ dAYitvazIladera nikaTa, tave tAdera madhye yArA tathyAnusandhAna kare tArA tAra yathArthatA nirUpaNa karate pArata| AllAhara anugraha o karuNA yadi teAmAdera prati nA hato, tave teAmAdera alpasaMkhyaka leAka vyatIta sakale zaYatAnerai anusaraNa karata|

ataeva tumi AllAhara pathe jihAda karo, tomAra opara nijera dAYabhAra chAr3A anya kArao dAYabhAra nei, Ara tumi mu ’ minaderake utsAhita karo| AzA karA yAYa, zIghrai AllAha tAdera zakti-sAmarthya kharva kare devena—yArA kuphuri kareche| Ara AllAha zakti-sAmarthye pravalatara evaM zAstidAne kaThina|
ye uttama kAjera supAriza karave, se tA theke ekaTi aMza pAve| Ara ye manda kAjera supAriza karave se tAra ekaTi aMza pAve| Ara AllAha sarva viSaYe saMrakSaNakArI|
Ara teAmAderake yakhana sambhASaNa jAnAno haYa, tAhale teAmarAo tAke sambhASaNa jAnAo tAraceYe uttama athavA tArai mato panthAYa; nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe hisAva grahaNakArI|
AllAha, tini vyatIta keAneAi ilAha nei| avazyai tini teAmAderake samaveta karavena kiYAmAtera dina, ete vindumAtra sandeha nei| Ara ke Ache AllAha apekSA adhika satyavAdI?

teAmAdera kI halo ye, munAphikadera samparke teAmarA dudale vibhakta haYe gele? athaca AllAha tAdera kRtakarmera daruna tAderake pUrvAvasthAYa phiriYe diYechena| AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tomarA ki tAke hidAYAta diYe cAo? yAke AllAha pathabhraSTa karena, tumi kakhano tAra janya patha pAve nA|

tArA cAYa ye, yadi tomarA kuphuri karate, yemana tArA kuphuri kareche, phale tomarA savAi samAna haYe yete| ataeva, tomarA tAderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kareA nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA AllAhara pathe hijarAta kare| ataHpara yadi tArA vimukha haYa, tave tAderake pAkar3Ao karo evaM yekhAne pAo hatyA karo; tAdera madhye kAuke vandhurUpe evaM sAhAyyakArI grahaNa kareA nA|

tave tArA naYa yArA emana sampradAYera sAthe milita haYa ye, teAmAdera madhye o tAdera madhye cukti Ache athavA teAmAdera kAche ebhAve Ase ye, tAdera antara teAmAdera sAthe evaM svajAtira sAtheo yuddha karate anicchuka| AllAha cAile tAderake tomAdera opara cApiYe ditena, phale tArA teAmAdera sAthe avazyai yuddha karata| ataeva, yadi tArA teAmAdera theke sare yAYa, teAmAdera sAthe yuddha nA kare evaM teAmAdera nikaTa zAntira prastAva kare, tave AllAha teAmAdera janya tAdera viruddhe keAno patha rAkhenani|

acirei tomarA anya eka sampradAYake pAve; tArA teAmAdera theke nijedera evaM svIYa jAti theke nirApattA lAbha karate cAYa| yakhanai tArA phire yAYa phitanAra dike tArA tAra mAjhe jhA~piYe par3e| sutarAM yadi tArA tomAdera theke sare nA yAYa evaM tomAderake sandhira prastAva nA deYa, evaM tAdera hAtake virata nA rAkhe, tave teAmarA tAderake pAkar3Ao karo evaM yekhAne pAo hatyA karo| Ami tAdera viruddhe teAmAderake suspaSTa pramANa dAna karechi|

mu ’ minera kAja naYa ye, se anya mu ’ minake hatyA karave; tave bhulakrame (hale bhinna kathA)| ye vyakti kono mu ’ minake bhulakrame hatyA kare, se ekajana mu ’ mina golAma mukta karave evaM raktapaNa samarpaNa karave tAra svajanaderake; tave tArA yadi kSamA kare deYa| Ara nihata vyakti yadi teAmAdera zatrupakSera haYa evaM se mu ’ mina haYa, tAhale ekajana mu ’ mina golAma mukta karave| Ara yadi se emana gotrera haYa, yAdera sAthe teAmAdera mitratA raYeche, tave raktapaNa samarpaNa karave tAra svajanaderake evaM ekajana mu ’ mina golAma mukta karave| ye vyaktira sAmarthya nA thAke, se AllAhara kAche tAovA hisAve avirata dui mAsa siYAma pAlana karave| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

ye vyakti icchAkRtabhAve kono mu ’ minake hatyA kare, tAra zAsti jAhAnnAma, se sekhAne cirasthAYI have| AllAha tAra prati kruddha haYe, tAke abhisampAta karena evaM tAra janye prastuta kare rAkhena bhaYAnaka zAsti|

he mu ’ minagaNa, teAmarA yakhana AllAhara pathe saphara karo, takhana teAmarA yAcAi karo, evaM teAmAderake sAlAma sAlAma deYa tAke valo nA, tumi mu ’ mina nao| teAmarA pArthiva jIvanera sampada kAmanA kara, athaca AllAhara kAche raYeche pracura gAnImAta| teAmarA Age emanai chile; ataHpara AllAha teAmAdera prati anugraha karechena; ataeva, ekhana yAcAi karo| nizcaYai AllAha samyaka oYAkivahAla oi viSaYe yA tomarA karo|

mu’minadera ma dhye akSama nA haYeo ghare vase thAkA loka evaM nijedera jAna o mAla diYe AllAhara pathe jihAdakArIrA samAna hate pAre nA| AllAha ghare vase thA kAdera tulanAYa tAdera maryAdA vAr3iYe diYechena yArA nijedera jAnamAla dvArA jihAda kare evaM pratyekera sAthei AllAha kalyANera oYAdA karechena| AllAha mahApratidAne mujAhidInake upaviSTadera opara zreSTha karechena|
eguleA tA~ra pakSa theke uccamaryAdA, kSamA o karuNA; AllAha ati kSamAzIla o asIma daYAlu|

nizcaYai yArA nijedera opara yuluma kareche, pherezatArA tAdera mRtyura samaYa vale, teAmarA kI avasthAYa chile? tArA vale, e bhUkhaNDe AmarA asahAYa chilAma| tArA vale, AllAhara yamina ki prazasta chila nA ye, teAmarA hijarAta kare sekhAne cale yAve? ataeva, tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma Ara tA katai nA nikRSTa gantavyasthala!
tave durvala zreNira nArI-puruSa evaM zizurA, yArA kono upAYa avalamvana karate pAre nA, evaM pAYa nA kono patha|
sutarAM AzA karA yAYa, AllAha tAdera kSamA karavena; AllAha mArjanAkArI o ati kSamAzIla|

ye AllAhara pathe hijarAta kare, se pAve pRthivIte AzraYasthala o aneka prAcurya| Ara ye vyakti nija gRha theke vera haYa AllAha o rAsUlera prati hijarAta karAra uddezye, ataHpara (pathimadhye) mRtyumukhe patita haYa, tAra pratidAna AllAhara kAche sthirikRta haYe railo| AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

yakhana teAmarA yamine saphara karo, takhana sAlAta kasara karale teAmAdera keAno pApa heva nA, yadi teAmarA AzaGkA karo ye, kAphirarA teAmAderake vipade phelave| nizcaYai kAphirarA teAmAdera prakAzya zatru|

yakhana tumi tAdera madhye thAko, ataHpara tAdera sAlAta par3Ao, takhana yena ekadala dA~r3AYa tomAra sAthe evaM svIYa astra sAthe rAkhe| ataHpara yakhana tArA sijadA sampanna kare, takhana tomAra kAcha theke yena sare yAYa evaM anya dala Ase, yArA sAlAta par3eni| ataHpara tArA yena tomAra sAthe sAlAta par3e satarka avasthAYa evaM AtmarakSAra hAtiYAra sAthe rAkhe| Ara kAphirarA cAYa ye, yadi teAmarA tomAdera astra-zastra o sAjasaraJjAma theke sAmAnya asatarka hao tave tArA ekayeAge teAmAderake AkramaNa kare vasave| yadi vRSTira kAraNe teAmAdera kaSTa haYa athavA teAmarA asustha hao, tave tomarA astra rekhe dile teAmAdera keAno pApa have nA, Ara satarkatA avalamvana karo| nizcaYai AllAha kAphiradera janya lAJchanAkara zAsti prastuta kare rekhechena|

ataHpara yakhana teAmarA sAlAta sampanna karo, takhana dA~r3iYe vase o zAYita avasthAYa AllAhara yikira karo| ataHpara yakhana vipadamukta haYe yAo, takhana yathAsamaYe sAlAta kAYema karo| nizcaYai sAlAta nirdiSTa samaYe kAYema karA muminadera opara pharaya|

tAdera pazcAddhAvane zaithilya kareA nA| yadi teAmarA AghAtaprApta hao, tave (mane rekho) tArAo teAmAdera matoi AghAtaprApta haYeche evaM teAmarA AllAhara kAche AzA karo, yA tArA AzA kare nA| AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|
nizcaYai Ami tomAra prati satyasaha kitAva avatIrNa karechi, yena tumi mAnuSera madhye phaYasAlA karo, yebhAve AllAha tomAke dekhiYechena| tumi vizvAsaghAtakadera pakSe vitarka karo nA|
Ara tumi AllAhara kAche kSamAprArthanA karo; nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
yArA mane vizvAsaghAtakatA peASaNa kare tAdera pakSe vitarka karo nA| AllAha vizvAsaghAtaka pApIke pachanda karena nA|

tArA mAnuSa theke lukAte cAYa, kintu AllAha theke lukAte pAre nA| kAraNa, yakhana tArA rAte emana viSaYe parAmarza kare, yAte AllAha sammata nana, takhano tini tAdera sAthe thAkena| nizcaYai tArA yA kare AllAha tA jJAne veSTana kare Achena|
zuno, tomarAi oi sakala loka, yArA tAdera pakSa niYe pArthiva-jIvane vivAda karacha; kintu kiYAmAtera dina tAdera pakSa haYe AllAhara sAthe ke vivAda karave athavA ke have tAdera abhibhAvaka?
ye anyAYa kAja kare vA nijera opara yuluma kare, ataHpara AllAhara kAche kSamAprArthanA kare, se pAve AllAhake kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
ye-keu pApa kare, se nijera vipakSei kare| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
ye vyakti kono doSa vA pApakAja kare, ataHpara keAno niraparAdhera opara apavAda AreApa kare, se vahana kare mithyA apavAda o prakAzya pApa|

yadi tomAra prati AllAhara anugraha o karuNA nA hato, tave tAdera ekadala tomAke pathabhraSTa karAra saMkalpa karechila| tArA nijederakei zudhu pathabhraSTa kare, Ara tomAra sAmAnyatama aniSTa karate pArave nA| AllAha tomAra prati aizI grantha o prajJA avatIrNa karechena evaM tomAke emana viSaYe zikSA diYechena, yA tumi jAnate nA| Ara tomAra prati raYeche AllAhara mahA-anugraha|

tAdera adhikAMza gopana parAmarze kono kalyANa nei; tave ye nirdeza deYa sadakAra, satkAjera vA mAnuSera madhye saMzodhanera (tAra parAmarze kalyANa raYeche), Ara ye vyakti tA AllAhara santuSTira janya kare, zIghrai Ami tAke mahA-pratidAna deva|

ye-keu tAra nikaTa hidAYAta prakAzita haoYAra para rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare, evaM mu ’ minadera anusRta pathera viruddhe cale, Ami tAke oi dikei pherAva ye dika se avalamvana kareche evaM tAke jAhAnnAme dagdha karava; Ara tA katai nA nikRSTa gantavyasthAna!
nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra sAthe ziraka karA kSamA karavena nA, tA vyatIta anya yA kichu yAke icchA, kSamA karavena| ye AllAhara sAthe zarika kare se sudUra bhrAntite patita haYa|
tArA tA~ra parivarte zudhu katipaYa devIra kAche ArAdhanA kare evaM zudhu avAdhya zaYatAnera ArAdhanA kare|
tAke AllAha abhisampAta karechena evaM se valeche, Ami avazyai teAmAra vAndAdera nirdiSTa eka aMzake (AmAra dale) niYe chAr3ava|

avazyai tAderake pathabhraSTa karava, tAdera antare mithyA vAsanA sRSTi kare devo; tAderake pazudera kAna chedana karate valava evaM tAderake AllAhara sRSTira AkRti parivartana karate Adeza deva| ye-keu AllAhake cher3e zaYatAnake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kare, se prakAzya kSatigrasta have|
se tAderake pratizruti deYa evaM tAdera antare mithyA vAsanA sRSTi kare deYa| zaYatAna tAderake ye pratizruti deYa, tA zudhu pratAraNA |
tAdera vAsasthAna jAhAnnAma; tArA tA theke pAlAnora jAYagA pAve nA|

yArA ImAna Ane evaM satkAja kare, Ami tAderake emana jAnnAte praveza karAva, yAra taladeze pravAhita haYa nada-nadI| tArA sekhAne cirasthAYI have| AllAhara pratizruti satya| ke AllAhara cAite adhika satyavAdI?

(pratidAnera viSaYaTi) teAmAdera AzA anuyAYI naYa evaM naYa Ahale kitAvadera AzA anuyAYI| varaM ye-keu manda kAja karave, tAke tAra pratiphala deoYA have evaM se AllAha chAr3A nijera keAno abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
nArI o puruSera madhye mu ’ mina avasthAYa yArA sat kAja kare, tArA jAnnAte praveza karave evaM tAdera prati vindu parimANao avicAra karA have nA|

ye AllAhara nirdezera sAmane nijeke samarpaNa kare satkAje niYeAjita theke evaM ivarAhImera Ardaza anusaraNa kare ekaniSThabhAve, tAra cAite uttama dharma Ara kAra hate pAre? Ara AllAha ivarAhImake vandhurUpe grahaNa karechena|
AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA-kichu Ache sava AllAharai janya| AllAha savakichuke veSTana kare rekhechena|

tArA tomAra nikaTa nArIdera sarmpake jijJesa kare, valo, AllAha teAmAderake tAdera samparke vidhAna jAnAcchena evaM kuraAne teAmAderake yA pATha kare zonAneA haYa, tA-o iYAtIma nArIdera samparke, yAderake teAmarA nirdhArita adhikAra pradAna karo nA; athaca vivAhavandhane Avaddha karAra vAsanA rAkho| Ara asahAYa zizudera samparkeo ye, iYAtImadera kSetre inasAphera opara pratiSThita thAko| teAmarA yA bhAlo kAja karo se samparke AllAha samyaka avagata|

yadi keAno strI svAmIra pakSa theke asadAcaraNa vA upekSAra AzaGkA kare, tave paraspare samajhotA kare neoYAte ubhaYera keAno pApa nei; Apasai uttama| pratyeka antare lobha o kRpaNatA vidyamAna| yadi teAmarA uttama kAja karo evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karo, nizcaYai AllAha oi viSaYe avagata yA tomarA karo|

teAmarA strIdera mAjhe kakhano samatA rakSA karate pArave nA, yadio tomarA tA cAo | ataeva, tomarA sampUrNa jhu~ke par3eA nA ye, anyajanake phele rAkho, jhulanta avasthAYa| yadi tomarA saMzodhita hao evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karo, tave AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
yadi tArA ubhaYei vicchinna haYa, tave AllAha svIYa prazastatA dvArA pratyekake amukhApekSI karavena| AllAha prAcuryamaYa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA kichu raYeche savai AllAhara| Ara Ami nirdeza diYechi teAmAdera pUrvavartI kitAvera adhikArIderake evaM teAmAderakeo ye, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo| yadi teAmarA kuphuri karo, tave (jene rekho) AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA kichu Ache sava AllAharai| Ara AllAha amukhApekSI, prazaMsita|
AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA kichu Ache sava AllAhara| karmavidhAYaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|
he mAnavakula, yadi tini icchA karena, tave tomAderake apasArita kare (teAmAdera jAYagAYa) anyadera pratiSThita karate pArena| nizcaYai AllAha se viSaYe kSamatAvAna|
ye-keu duniYAra kalyANa kAmanA karave, (tAra jene rAkhA praYeAjana) duniYA o AkhirAtera kalyANa AllAharai nikaTa | Ara AllAha sarvazrotA sa myaka draSTA|

he mu ’ minagaNa, teAmarA nyAYera opara pratiSThita thAko, AllAhara janya nyAYasaMgata sAkSyadAtArUpe, yadio tA teAmAdera nijedera vA pitAmAtAra athavA nikaTavartI AtmIYa-svajanera vipakSe haYa| yadi se dhanI haYa vA daridra, AllAha ubhaYa prakAra lokera vyApAre adhika kalyANakAmI| ataeva, yakhana teAmarA nyAYavicAra karave, takhana pravRttira anusaraNa karave nA| Ara yadi pe~ciYe kathA valo vA upekSA karo, tave AllAha teAmAdera kAja samparke samyaka avagata|

he mu ’ minagaNa, tomarA ImAna rAkho AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera evaM oi kitAvera, yA tini tA~ra rAsUlera prati avatIrNa karechena evaM tAra pUrve tini avatIrNa karechena ye kitAva, tAra prati| Ara ye vyakti AllAha, tA~ra pherezatAgaNa, tA~ra kitAvasamUha evaM rAsulagaNa o kiYAmAta divasake asvIkAra karave, se sudUra vibhrAntite patita have|

nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche, ataHpara kuphuri kareche, punarAYa ImAna eneche erapara AvArao kuphuri kareche, ataHpara tArA kuphurite agragAmI hate thekeche, AllAha tAderake kakhano kSamA karavena nA evaM hidAYAtao devena nA|
munAphikadera susaMvAda dAo, tAdera janya nirdhArita raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
yArA mu ’ minadera parivarte kAphiraderake vandhu hiseve grahaNa kare| tArA ki tAdera kAche zakti o sammAna pratyAzA kare? athaca yAvatIYa sammAna o zakti zudhu AllAharai janya|

kitAve tomAdera prati tini to (e-nirdeza) avatIrNa karechena ye, yakhana tomarA zunave AllAhara AYAta pratyAkhyAta hacche evaM tA niYe vidrupa karA hacche takhana, ye paryanta tArA anya prasaGge lipta nA have tomarA tAdera sAthe vaso nA, naYato tomarAo tAdera mato have| munAphika evaM kAphera savAike AllAha jAhAnnAme ekatra karavena|

yArA teAmAdera vyApAre suyogera apekSAYa thAke, AllAhara icchAYa teAmAdera vijaYa arjita hale tArA vale, AmarA ki teAmAdera sAthe chilAma nA? pakSAntare kAphirarA AMzikabhAve vijaYI hale vale, AmarA ki teAmAdera opara pravala chilAma nA, evaM mu ’ minadera theke tomAderake rakSA karini? avazyai AllAha teAmAdera madhye kiYAmAtera dina phAYasAlA karavena evaM AllAha kAphiradera janya mu ’ minadera viruddhe (cUr3Anta vijaYera) kono patha rAkhena nA|

nizcaYai munAphikarA AllAhara sAthe dho~kAvAji kare, athaca tini tAderake dho~kAYa phele rAkhena, Ara yakhana tArA sAlAte dA~r3AYa takhana alasabhAve dA~r3AYa loka dekhAnora uddezye, Ara tArA AllAhake khuva alpai smaraNa kare|
tArA deAdulyamAna era (ImAna o kupharera) mAjhe; edikeo naYa odikeo naYa| Ara yAke AllAha pathabhraSTa karena, tumi tAra janya kakhano patha pAve nA|
he mu ’ minagaNa, teAmarA mu ’ minadera vAda diYe kAphiradera vandhu hiseve grahaNa karo nA| teAmarA ki tomAdera viruddhe AllAhara nikaTa prakAzya pramANa dAr3a karAte cAo?
niHsandehe munAphikarA thAkave jAhAnnAmera sarvanimna stare| Ara tumi tAdera janya keAno sAhAyyakArI kakhano pAve nA|

tave yArA tAovA kareche, nijederake saMzodhana kareche evaM AllAhake sudRr3habhAve avalamvana kareche, AllAhara janya tAdera dInera prati ekaniSTha haYeche, tArA mu ‘ minadera sAthei avasthAna karave| AllAha zigagira mu ’ minaderake mahApratidAna devena|
tomarA yadi ImAna Ano, kRtajJa hao, tave teAmAdera zAsti diYe AllAha kI karavena? Ara AllAha guNagrAhI, sarvajJa|
AllAha keAno manda prakAza karA pachanda karena nA; tave tAra kathA bhinna, yAra opara yuluma karA haYeche| Ara AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
teAmarA yadi uttama kAja prakAza karo vA geApana rAkho athavA kono mandake kSamA karo, tave nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, mahA kSamatAvAna|

yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUladera sAthe kuphuri kare, Ara tArA cAYa AllAha o rAsUlera prati vizvAse tAratamya karate, evaM vale, AmarA katakake vizvAsa kari Ara katakake pratyAkhyAna kari, tArA cAYa ye tArA grahaNa karave madhyavartI keAno patha|
tArAi prakRta kAphira; Ara kAphiradera janya Ami prastuta karechi lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|
Ara yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUladera opara ImAna eneche, evaM tA~dera kArao mAjhe pArthakya kareni, zigagira tAdera prApya puraskAra dAna karavena| Ara AllAha ati kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

tomAra nikaTa kitAvirA Avedana kare ye, tumi tAdera opara AsamAna theke kitAva avatIrNa karave| vastuta tArA mUsAra kAche era ceYeo var3o kichu ceYeche| ataHpara tArA valeche, ‘AmAderake prakAzye AllAhake dekhAo|’ phale tAderake vajrapAta pAkar3Ao kareche tAdera sImAlaGghanera kAraNe; ataHpara tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa pramANa AsAra pareo tArA garura vAchurake upAsyarUpe grahaNa kareche; tavuo Ami kSamA karechi evaM Ami mUsAke suspaSTa pramANa dAna karechi|

Ara tAdera kAcha theke pratizrutira uddezye Ami tAdera opara tUra pAhAr3ake tule dharechi evaM tAderake valechi, ‘tomarA avanata mastake darajA diYe praveza karo|’ Ara valechi, ‘tomarA zanivAra samparke sImAlaGghana kareA nA;’ Ara tAdera kAcha theke dRr3ha aGgIkAra grahaNa karechi|

Ami tAdera sAthe yA karechi tA tAderai aGgIkAra bhaGga, AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra, anyAYabhAve navigaNake hatyA evaM tAdera ukti, ‘AmAdera hRdaYa AcchAdita’ esava kAraNe; kintu tA naYa, varaM kuphurira kAraNe svaYaM AllAha tAdera antarera opara meAhara mere diYechena| phale tAdera alpasaMkhyakai ImAna Ane|
Ara tAdera kuphuri evaM mAraiYAmera prati gurutara apavAda AreApa karAra kAraNe|

Ara tAdera ukti ye, ‘AmarA AllAhara rAsUla mAraiYAma-putra IsA mAsIhake hatyA karechi|’ athaca tArA nA tAke hatyA kareche, Ara nA zUle car3iYeche; varaM tAdera vibhrama haYeche| nizcaYai yArA e vyApAre matabheda kareche avazyai tArA ekSetre sandehera mAjhe par3eche; zudhu anumAna chAr3A tArA e viSaYe keAno jJAna rAkhe nA| Ara nizcita ye, tArA tAke hatyA kareni|
varaM AllAha tAke nijera kAche uThiYe niYechena| Ara AllAha mahA parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
Ara Ahale kitAvadera savAi tAra opara ImAna Anave svIYa mRtyura pUrve| Ara kiYAmAtera dina se tAdera viruddhe sAkSI have|
Ara Ami iYAhUdidera janya hArAma kare diYechi vahu pavitra vastu yA tAdera janya hAlAla karA haYechila tAdera sImAlaGghanera kAraNe evaM AllAhara pathe anekake vAdhA deoYAra kAraNe|

Ara tAdera suda grahaNera kAraNe, athaca tAderake tA theke niSedha karA haYechila evaM anyAYabhAve mAnuSera sampada grAsa karAra kAraNe| Ara Ami tAdera madhya theke kAphiradera janya prastuta karechi yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

tave tAdera madhye paripakva jJAnera adhikArI o mu’minarA tomAra prati avatIrNa evaM tomAra pUrve avatIrNa kitAvera opara ImAna Ane, Ara yArA sAlAta pratiSThA kare, yAkAta pradAna kare, sarvopari AllAha o AkhirAtera opara ImAna Ane, acirei tAderake Ami mahApratidAna deva|

Ami tomAra prati oYAhi avatIrNa karechi, yemana oYAhi avatIrNa karechi nUhera prati evaM tAra paravartI navidera prati| Ara oYAhi avatIrNa karechi ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkUva, o tAra vaMzadharagaNera prati evaM IsA, AiYUva, iunusa, hArUna o sulAimAnera prati| Ara Ami dAUdake dAna karechi yAvUra grantha|
itaHpUrve Ami tomAra nikaTa kichu rAsUlera ghaTanA varNanA karechi evaM kichu rAsUlera varNanA karini| Ara AllAha mUsAra sAthe sarAsari katheApakathana karechena|
rAsUlagaNake (pAThiYechi) susaMvAdadAtA o bhItipradarzanakArI (hiseve), yena rAsUladera Agamanera para AllAhara viruddhe mAnuSadera janya keAno ajuhAta nA thAke| AllAha parAkramazIla, prajJAmaYa|
kintu AllAha sAkSya dicchena oi viSaYe—yA tini avatIrNa karechena tomAra prati, tA tA~ra jJAnera bhittitei avatIrNa karechena, Ara sAkSya dicchena pherezatAgaNao| Ara sAkSI hisAve AllAhai yatheSTa|
nizcaYai yArA kuphuri kareche evaM AllAhara pathe vAdhAra sRSTi kareche, tArA cUr3Anta vibhrAntite patita haYeche|
nizcaYai yArA kuphuri kareche evaM sImAlaGghana kareche, AllAha kakhano tAde rake kSamA karavena nA evaM tAderake hidAYAtao devena nA|
tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera patha; tArA sekhAne cirasthAYI have| Ara eTA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|
