he mAnavajAti, teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke tomAdera nikaTa satyasaha rAsUla esechena; ataeva, teAmarA tAra prati ImAna Ano, eTAi teAmAdera janya kalyANa| Ara yadi teAmarA kuphuri karo, jene rekho, nizcaYai AsamAnasamUha o yaminera yA-kichu Ache sava AllAharai| Ara AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

he kitAvirA, teAmarA svIYa dInera madhye vAr3AvAr3i kareA nA evaM AllAhara samvandhe satya vyatIta kichu valeA nA| niHsandehe mAraiYAma-tanaYa IsA mAsIha AllAhara rAsUla evaM tA~ra kAlimA, yA tini preraNa karechena mAraiYAmera nikaTa evaM tA~ra pakSa theke rUha| ataeva, teAmarA AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlagaNera prati ImAna Ano; Ara tomarA ‘(prabhu) tinajana’ valo nA| teAmarA virata hao, eTAi teAmAdera janya uttama| nizcaYai AllAha ekaka ilAha; santAna-santati haoYA theke tini pavitra| AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA kichu raYeche savai tA~ra| Ara karmavidhAYaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|

mAsIha AllAhara vAndA haoYAte kono lajjAveAdha kare nA evaM ghaniSTha pherezatArAo kare nA| Ara yArA AllAhara ivAdAte lajjAveAdha kare evaM ahaMkAra kare, acirei tini tAderake tA~ra nikaTa samaveta karavena|

ataHpara yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche, tini tAderake paripUrNa pratidAna devena, varaM svIYa anugrahe vRddhi karavena tAdera maryAdA| pakSAntare yArA lajjAveAdha kareche evaM ahaMkAra kareche tini tAderake devena yantraNAdAYaka zAsti; AllAha vyatIta tArA tAdera keAno abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
he mAnavakula, teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke tomAdera kAche eseche spaSTa pramANa, Ara Ami teAmAdera prati avatIrNa karechi dIptimaYa eka nUra|
ataeva, yArA AllAhara prati ImAna eneche evaM tA~ke dRr3habhAve A~kar3e dhareche, tini tAderake svIYa rAhamAta o anugrahera madhye praveza karAvena evaM sarala saThika pathe hidAYAta devena|

tArA tomAra nikaTa phateAYA cAYa; ataeva, valo, ‘AllAha teAmAderake kAlAlAra vyApAre phatoYA dicchena—yadi keAno puruSa mArA yAYa evaM tAra keAno santAnAdi nA thAke, zudhu eka veAna thAke, tave se pAve tAra parityakta sampattira ardheka aMza| Ara se (bhAi) vonera uttarAdhikArI have yadi (mRta vona) niHsantAna haYa| tArA dui veAna thAkale tAdera janya (bhAiYera) parityakta sampattira dui-tRtIYAMza| pakSAntare yadi bhAi o veAna ubhaYai thAke, tave ekajana puruSera aMza dujana nArIra samAna|’ AllAha teAmAderake suspaSTabhAve jAniYe dicchena yAte vibhrAnta nA hao; Ara AllAha hacchena sarvaviSaYe jJAta|

he mu ’ minagaNa, tomarA aGgIkArasamUha pUrNa karo| tomAdera janya catuSpada jantu hAlAla karA have, tA vyatIta yA tomAderake par3e zonAno haYeche; kintu iharAma avasthAYa zikArake hAlAla mane karo nA, nizcaYai AllAha yA icchA Adeza dena|

he mu ’ minagaNa, hAlAla mane karo nA AllAhara nidarzanasamUha evaM sammAnita mAsasamUhake evaM ‘hAdi’ke evaM galAYa mAlAparihita cihnaviziSTa jantuke, evaM sammAnita gRha-abhimukhe yAtrIderake, yArA svIYa ravera anugraha o santuSTi kAmanA kare| yakhana tomarA iharAma-mukta hao, takhana tomarA zikAra karate pAro| Ara yena tomAderake sImAlaGghane prarocita nA kare sampradAYera vidveSa, yArA mAsajidula hArAma theke tomAderake vAdhApradAna karechila| tomarA paraspara satkarma o tAkaoYA avalamvane eke anyake sAhAyya karo| Ara tomarA pApa o sImAlaGghane eke anyake sahAYatA karo nA| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo| nizcaYa AllAha zAstidAne kaThora|

teAmAdera opara hArAma karA haYeche mRta jantu, rakta, zUkarera gozata, yesava jantu javAi karAra samaYa AllAha vyatIta anyera nAma neoYA haYeche, yA kaNThareAdhe mArA yAYa, yA AghAta lege mArA yAYa, yA u~cu sthAna theke patanera phale mArA yAYa, yA ziM-era AghAte mArA yAYa evaM yAke hiMsra jantu bhakSaNa kareche, tave yA teAmarA (mRtyura Age) javAi karecha| ye jantu yajJa-vedIte javAi karA haYa evaM yA juYAra tira dvArA vaNTana karA haYa, egulo pApa kAja| Aja kAphirarA teAmAdera dIna theke nirAza haYe geche; ataeva, tAderake bhaYa kareA nA, varaM AmAke bhaYa karo| Aja Ami teAmAdera janya teAmAdera dInake pUrNAGga kare diYechi, Ara tomAdera opara AmAra niYAmAta pUrNa karechi evaM teAmAdera janya isalAmake dIna hiseve Ami pachanda karechi| tave, ye vyakti tIvra kSudhAYa vAdhya haYa; kintu pApera prati AkRSTa nA haYe tA theke svalpa AhAra kare, tave nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

tArA tomAke jijJesa kare ye, tAdera janya kI kI hAlAla karA haYeche? valo, ‘teAmAdera janya pavitra vastusamUha hAlAla karA haYeche evaM yesava zikAri jantuke teAmarA prazikSaNa dAna karo zikAra dharAra janya, tomarA tAderake oi paddhatite prazikSaNa dAo, yA AllAha teAmAderake zikSA diYechena; ataeva, tomarA khAo yA tArA teAmAdera janya zikAra kare Ane evaM tAra opara AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karo| AllAhake bhaYa karo| nizcaYai AllAha hisAva grahaNe druta|

Aja teAmAdera janya pavitra vastusamUha hAlAla karA halo, Ara yAdera kitAva deoYA haYeche tAdera khAdya teAmAdera janya hAlAla evaM teAmAdera khAdya tAdera janya hAlAla| Ara teAmAdera janya hAlAla satIsAdhvI mu’mina nArI evaM tAdera satIsAdhvI nArI, yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche teAmAdera pUrve, yakhana teAmarA tAderake meAhara pradAna karo tAderake strI karAra janya, kAmavAsanA caritArtha karAra janya vA upapatnI hiseve grahaNa karAra janya naYa| ye vyakti ImAna AnaYane asvIkAra kare, tave tAra Amala viphale yAve evaM parakAle se have kSatigrastadera antarbhukta|

he mu ’ minagaNa, yakhana tomarA sAlAtera janya dA~r3Ao, takhana svIYa mukhamaNDala o hAtagulo kanui paryanta dhauta karo, evaM tomarA mAthA mAsAha karo o teAmAdera padayugala gi~Tasaha dhauta karo; yadi tomarA apavitra hao tave paripUrNabhAve pavitra hao| Ara yadi tomarA asustha hao, athavA saphare thAka, kiMvA tomAdera keu zaucAgAra theke Aso, athavA tomarA strIdera sAthe sahavAsa karo, ataHpara pAni nA pAo, tave tomarA pavitra mATi dvArA tAYAmmuma kare nAo; arthAt, svIYa mukhamaNDala o hastadvaYa mATi dvArA mAsAha karo| AllAha tomAdera asuvidhAYa phelate cAna nA; varaM tomAderake pavitra karate cAna evaM tomAdera prati svIYa niYAmAta pUrNa karate cAna, yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza karo|

smaraNa karo, tomAdera opara AllAhara niYAmAta evaM oi aGgIkArakeo yA teAmAdera nikaTa theke tini grahaNa karechena, yakhana teAmarA valechile, ‘AmarA zunechi evaM mene niYechi|’ AllAhake bhaYa karo| nizcaYai AllAha tomodera antarasamUhera avasthA samvandhe samyaka jJAta|

he mu ’ minagaNa, teAmarA AllAhara uddezye satya sAkSyadAnera vyApAre avicala thAko evaM keAno sampradAYera vidveSa yena nyAYavicAra parityAge prarocita nA kare| tomarA suvicAra karo; eTAi tAkaoYAra adhika nikaTatara| AllAhake bhaYa karo| teAmarA yA karo, nizcaYai AllAha se viSaYe samyaka jJAta|
tAdera janya raYeche pratizruti yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche, (tAdera janya) kSamA o mahApratidAnera (pratizruti)|
yArA kuphuri kareche evaM AmAra nidarzanAvalike mithyA valeche, tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

he mu ’ minagaNa, teAmAdera prati AllAhara anugraha smaraNa karo, yakhana eka sampradAYa teAmAdera dike svIYa hAta prasArita karate ceYechila, takhana tini tAdera hAta teAmAdera theke pratihata kare dilena| AllAhake bhaYa karo| Ara mu ’ minadera AllAhara oparai bharasA karA ucita|

Ara avazyai AllAha vani isarAIlera kAcha theke aGgIkAra niYechilena evaM Ami tAdera madhya theke vArojana mukhapAtra niyukta karechilAma| Ara AllAha valalena, nizcaYai Ami teAmAdera saGge Achi| yadi teAmarA sAlAta pratiSThA karo, yAkAta dAo, AmAra rAsUladera prati ImAna AneA, tAderake sAhAyya karo evaM AllAhake uttama RNa dAo, tave Ami avazyai teAmAdera pApa mocana karava evaM avazyai teAmAderake jAnnAte praveza karAva, yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita haYa nada-nadI| eraparao tomAdera theke ye kuphuri karave, se nizcitai sarala patha theke vicyuta haYeche|

ataeva, tAdera aGgIkAra bhaGgera kAraNe Ami tAderake abhisampAta karechi evaM kare diYechi tAdera antarake kaTheAra| tArA kAlimAke tAra sthAna theke vicyuta kare deYa evaM tAderake ye upadeza deoYA haYechila, tAra ekAMza tArA bhule geche| tumi sarvadA tAdera keAno-nA-keAno pratAraNA samparke avagata hate thAkave, tAdera alpasaMkhyaka vyatIta| ataeva, tumi tAderake kSamA karo evaM upekSA karo| AllAha satkarmazIladera bhAlovAsena|

Ara tAdera madhya theke yArA vale, ‘AmarA nAsArA,’ Ami tAdera kAcha theke aGgIkAra niYechi; ataHpara tAdera ekAMza pradatta upadeza bhule giYeche| ataHpara Ami kiYAmAta paryanta tAdera madhye pArasparika zatrutA o vidveSa saJcArita karechi; acirei AllAha tAderake tAdera kRtakarma samparke avahita karavena|

he Ahale kitAvarA, teAmAdera kAche AmAra rAsUla Agamana kareche; kitAvera yesava viSaYa teAmarA geApana karate, se tAra madhya theke aneka viSaYa prakAza kare evaM aneka viSaYa mArjanA kare| teAmAdera kAche AllAhara pakSa theke ekaTi ujjvala jyeAti eseche evaM ekaTi suspaSTa kitAva|
tA dvArA AllAha tA~ra santuSTi o zAntira patha pratyAzIdera hidAYAta dena evaM tAderake svIYa nirdeza dvArA andhakAra theke Alora dike vera karena evaM tAderake hidAYAta dAna karena sarala pathe|

nizcaYai tArA kAphira, yArA vale, ‘mAsIha ivanu mAraiYAmai AllAha|’ valo, ‘yadi AllAha mAsIha ivanu mAraiYAma o tA~ra jananI evaM yamine yArA Ache savAike dhvaMsa karate cAna, tave emana kArao sAdhya Ache ki ye tA~ra theke vA~cAte pArave?’ AsamAnasamUha, yamina o e duYera madhye yA Ache savakichura opara AllAhara Adhipatya| tini yA icchA sRSTi karena| AllAha sarva viSaYa sarva zaktimAna|

iYAhUdi o nAsArArA vale, ‘AmarA AllAhara santAna o tA~ra priYajana|’ valo, ‘tave tini teAmAderake pApera kAraNe kena zAsti devena? varaM teAmarA mAnuSa, tAdera antarbhukta yA tini sRSTi karechena|’ tini yAke icchA kSamA karena evaM yAke icchA zAsti pradAna karena| AsamAnasamUha, yamina o e duYera madhye yA kichu Ache, tAte AllAharai Adhipatya raYeche evaM tA~ra kAchei pratyAvartanasthala|

he Ahale kitAvarA, teAmAdera kAche AmAra rAsUla eseche, se rAsUladera viratira para teAmAdera kAche suspaSTa varNanA kare, yAte teAmarA valate nA pAra, ‘ AmAdera kAche keAno susaMvAdadAtA o bhItipradarzaka Aseni| ’ nizcaYai teAmAde ra kAche susaMvAdadAtA o bhItipradarzaka eseche| Ara AllAha sarva viSaYe sarva zaktimAna|

yakhana mUsA svIYa sampradAYake valalena, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmAdera prati AllAhara niYAmAta smaraNa karo, yakhana tini teAmAdera madhye naviderake vAniYechena, teAmAderake rAjyAdhipati karechena evaM teAmAderake emana jinisa diYechena, yA vizvajagatera kAuke denani|’
‘he AmAra sampradAYa, pavitra bhUmite praveza karo, yA AllAha teAmAdera janya nirdhAraNa karechena evaM pechana dike pratyAvartana kareA nA| tAhale teAmarA kSatigrasta haYe pratyAvartana karave|

tArA valala, ‘he mUsA, nizcaYai sekhAne eka durdAnta zaktidhara sampradAYa raYeche| AmarA kichutei sekhAne praveza karava nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA sekhAna theke vera haYe yAYa; tArA yadi sekhAna theke vera haYa, tavei AmarA praveza karava|

yArA bhaYa karata, tAdera madhye dui jana yAdera opara AllAha anugraha karechilena tArA valala, ‘tomarA tAdera mokAvelA kare darajA diYe praveza karo| ’ ataHpara teAmarA yakhana tAte praveza karave, takhana teAmarAi jaYI have| Ara AllAhara opara bharasA karo yadi teAmarA mu’mina hao|
tArA valala, ‘he mUsA, AmarA kichutei kakhanoi sekhAne praveza karava nA, yatakSaNa tArA sekhAne thAkave| ataeva, tumi o tomAra rava yAo evaM ubhaYe yuddha karo| nizcaYai AmarA ekhAne upaviSTa| ’
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Ami zudhu nijera opara o AmAra bhAiYera opara kSamatA rAkhi| ataeva, Apani AmAdera madhye o e pApAcArI sampradAYera madhye samparkaccheda karena|’
tini (AllAha) valalena, ‘tave nizcaYai tA calliza vachara paryanta tAdera janya hArAma karA halo| tArA pRthivIte udbhrAnta haYe ghurave| ataeva, tumi avAdhya sampradAYera janya Aphasosa karo nA|’

tumi tAderake Adamera dui putrera saMvAda yathAyathabhAve pATha kare zonAo| yakhana tArA ubhaYei kuravAni karechila, takhana tAdera ekajanera kuravAni gRhIta haYechila evaM aparajanera gRhIta haYani| se valala, ‘Ami avazyai teAmAke hatyA karava|’ se valala, ‘AllAha zudhu muttAkidera pakSa thekei grahaNa karena|’
‘yadi tumi AmAke hatyA karate AmAra dike hAta vAr3Ao, tavuo Ami teAmAke hatyA karate teAmAra dike hAta vAr3Ava nA| nizcaYai Ami vizvajagatera rava AllAhake bhaYa kari|’
‘nizcaYai Ami cAi ye, tumi vahana karave AmAra pApa o teAmAra pApa| phale tumi have jAhAnnAmIdera antarbhukta; eTAi sImAlaGghanakArIdera zAsti|’
ataHpara tAra pravRtti tAke bhrAtRhatyAYa prarocita karala| anantara se tAke hatyA karala; phale se kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe gela|

ataHpara AllAha ekaTi kAka pAThAlena, se mATi khu~r3achila yAte se tAke dekhAte pAre kIbhAve se lukAve bhAiYera mRtadeha| se valala, ‘hAYa AphaseAsa! Ami ki e kAkera mato hate pAralAma nA ye, Ami lukAte pAri AmAra bhAiYera mRtadeha?’ ataHpara se halo anutApakArIdera antarbhukta|

e kAraNei Ami vani isarAIlera prati (vidhAna) likhe diYechi, ye kAuke hatyA karave hatyAra vinimaYa vyatIta vA pRthivIte nairAjya sRSTi karA vyatIta, se yena sakala mAnuSakei hatyA karala; evaM ye kArao jIvana rakSA karala, se yena savAra jIvana rakSA karala| avazyai tAdera kAche AmAra rAsUlagaNa prakAzya nidarzanAvali niYe esechena| eraparao nizcaYai tAdera aneke pRthivIte sImAlaGghanakArI|

mUlata tAdera pratiphala—yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe yuddha kare evaM deze nairAjya sRSTi karate saceSTa haYa, tAdera zAsti haleA—tAderake hatyA karA have athavA zUle car3AneA have athavA tAdera hAta-pA viparIta dika theke keTe deoYA have athavA deza theke nirvAsita karA have| eTi halo tAdera janya duniYAYa lAJchanA Ara parakAle tAdera janya raYeche mahAzAsti|
kintu yArA tAovA kare teAmAdera pravalatAra pUrve, tave jene rekho, AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
he mu ’ minagaNa, AllAhake bhaYa karo, tA~ra naikaTya anveSaNa karo evaM tA~ra pathe jihAda karo, yAte teAmarA saphalakAma hao|

nizcaYai yArA kuphuri kareche, yadi tAdera kAche pRthivIra samudaYa sampada evaM Arao anurUpa sampada thAke Ara eguleAra vinimaYe kiYAmAtera zAsti theke paritrANa pete cAYa, tavuo tAdera theke tA kavula karA have nA| Ara tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
tArA cAYa ye, tArA vera have jAhAnnAma theke; athaca tArA tA theke vera hate pArave nA, tAdera janya raYeche cirasthAYI zAsti|
puruSa cora o nArI cora, ataHpara tAdera hAta keTe dAo tAdera kRtakarmera pratiphalasvarUpa o AllAhara pakSa theke dRSTAntamUlaka zAsti hiseve; AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tave ye tAovA kare tAra sImAlaGghanera para evaM nijeke saMzodhana kare neYa, nizcaYai AllAha tAra tAovA kavula karena| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
tumi ki jAno nA, nizcaYai AllAha, tA~ra janyai AsamAnasamUha o yaminera Adhipatya| tini yAke icchA zAsti dena evaM yAke icchA kSamA karena| nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

he rAsUla, tAdera kRtakarma tomAke yena duHkha nA deYa, yArA druta kuphurera dike dhAvita haYa; tArA mukhe vale, ‘ AmarA ImAna enechi, ’ athaca tAdera antara ImAna Aneni| evaM iYAhUdidera madhye yArA mithyA zravaNe adhika AgrahI, tomAra nikaTa Aseni emana eka bhinna dalera prati yArA kAna pete thAke, zavdagulo yathAyatha suvinyasta thAkAra parao tArA seguloke vikRta kare| tArA vale, ‘ yadi emana vidhAna deoYA haYa tave tA grahaNa karo Ara anurUpa nA deoYA haYa tave tA varjana karo| ’ AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karate cAna, tave tAra janya kakhano tumi AllAhara kAche kichu karate sakSama have nA| erAi tArA, yAdera antara AllAha vizuddha karate cAna nA| tAdera janya raYeche pArthiva jIvane lAJchanA evaM parakAle mahAzAsti|

tArA mithyA zravaNe adhika AgrahI, hArAma bhakSaNe adhika Asakta; ataeva, yadi tArA tomAra kAche Ase, tave tumi tAdera madhye phAYasAlA karo athavA tAderake upekSA karo| yadi tAderake upekSA karo, tave tArA kakhano tomAra kono kSati karate pArave nA| Ara yadi phAYasAlA karo, tave nyAYabhAve phAYasAlA karo| nizcaYai AllAha nyAYavicArakArIdera bhAlovAsena|
tArA tomAke kIbhAve vicAraka mAnave, athaca tAdera kAche raYeche tAorAta? tAte Ache AllAhara nirdeza, eraparao yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave tArA moTeo mu’mina naYa|

nizcaYai Ami tAorAta avatIrNa karechi, tAte raYeche hidAYAta o AleA; tAra mAdhyame iYAhUdidera phAYasAlA dita anugata navi, ravvAni o AlemarA; kenanA, tAderake AllAhara kitAvera rakSaka vAnAno haYechila, Ara tArA chila tAra opare sAkSI| ataeva, teAmarA mAnuSake bhaYa kareA nA varaM AmAke bhaYa karo evaM tomarA AmAra AYAtagulo svalpamUlye vikraYa karo nA| AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena, yArA tA anuyAYI phAYasAlA kare nA, tArAi kAphira|

Ami tAte tAdera opara Avazyaka karechi ye, nizcaYai prANera vinimaYe prANa, cokhera vinimaYe cokha, nAkera vinimaYe nAka, kAnera vinimaYe kAna, dA~tera vinimaYe dA~ta evaM AghAtera vinimaYe sama-AghAta| ataHpara ye tA kSamA kare, tave tA tAra pApamocanakArI| AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena, yArA tA anuyAYI phAYasAlA kare nA, tArAi sImAlaGghanakArI|

Ami tAdera pare mAraiYAma-tanaYa IsAke preraNa karechi, tAra sAmane tAorAtera yA-kichu vidyamAna tAra sa tyA YanakArIrUpe| Ami tAke inajIla pradAna karechi, tAte raYeche hidAYAta o AleA evaM tAra sAmane tAorAtera yA-kichu vidyamAna tAra sa tyA YanakArIrUpe; Ara tA muttAkidera janya hidAYAta o upadeza|
Ara inajIlera adhikArIdera ucita, AllAha tAte yA avatIrNa karechena se anuyAYI phAYasAlA karA| Ara AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena, yArA tA anuyAYI phAYasAlA kare nA, tArAi phAsika|

Ami tomAra prati kitAva avatIrNa karechi satyasaha, yA tAra sAmane Ache tAra satyAYanakArI evaM tAra viSaYavastura rakSaNAvekSaNakArI hiseve| ataeva, AllAha tomAra prati yA avatIrNa karechena, tA anuyAYI tAdera mAjhe phAYasAlA karo evaM tomAra nikaTa ye mahAsatya eseche tA cher3e tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa karo nA| Ami teAmAdera pratyekera janya nirdhAraNa karechi zariYAta o saralapanthA| yadi AllAha cAitena, tave teAmAdera savAike eka ummAta kare ditena, kintu tini teAmAderake yA diYechena se viSaYe tomAdera parIkSA karavena| ataeva, tomarA kalyANakara kAje pratiyogitA karo| AllAhara kAchei teAmAdera savAra pratyAvartanasthala| ataHpara tini tomAderake avahita karavena se viSaYa, yAte teAmarA matavireAdha karachile|

Ara tumi tAdera mAjhe AllAha yA avartINa karechena se anuyAYI phAYasAlA karo, tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa karo nA evaM tAdera theke satarka thAko yena tArA tomAke emana kono aMza theke vicyuta nA kare, yA AllAha tomAra prati avatIrNa karechena| ataeva, yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave jene rekho, AllAha tAderake vipade AkrAnta karavena tAdera kichu pApera kAraNe| Ara nizcaYai vahu saMkhyaka mAnuSa avazyai pApAcArI|
tArA ki jAheli yugera phAYasAlA kAmanA kare? Ara ke Ache vidhAna dAne AllAha apekSA uttama vizvAsI sampradAYera janya?

he mu ’ minagaNa, teAmarA iYAhUdi o khrisTAnaderake vandhu hiseve grahaNa kareA nA; tArA eke aparera vandhu| teAmAdera madhye ye tAderake vandhu vAnAve, se tAderai antarbhukta| nizcaYai AllAha sImAlaGghanakArIdera hidAYAta dAna karena nA|

tAi tumi tAderake dekhave yAdera antare reAga raYeche, tArA druta tAderai dike dhAvita haYa; tArA vale, ‘AmarA AzaGkA kari ye, AmAdera opara kono bhAgya viparyaYa patita have|’ ataeva, hate pAre AllAha vijaYa athavA nijera pakSa theke emana keAno viSaYa dAna karavena, phale tArA svIYa geApana maneAbhAvera janya anutapta have|
mu ’ minarA valave, ‘erAi ki tArA, yArA AllAhara nAme dRr3ha pratijJA karata ye, nizcaYai tArA teAmAdera sAthe Ache? ’ tAdera karmasamUha naSTa haYe geche; phale tArA kSatigrasta haYeche|

he mu ’ minagaNa, teAmAdera madhye ye svIYa dIna theke phire yAve, zIghrai AllAha emana sampradAYa Anavena, yAderake tini bhAlovAsavena evaM tArA tA~ke bhAlovAsave; tArA mu ’ minadera prati vinamra have evaM kAphiradera prati have kaTheAra; tArA AllAhara pathe jihAda karave evaM keAno tiraskArakArIra tiraskAre bhaYa pAve nA| eTA AllAhara anugraha| tini yAke i cchA dAna karena| AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|
teAmAdera vandhu teA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla evaM mu ’ minagaNa—yArA sAlAta pratiSThA kare, yAkAta pradAna kare e avasthAYa ye, tArA vinIta|
Ara yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla evaM mu ’ minaderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kare, tArAi AllAhara dala evaM tArAi vijaYI|

he mu ’ minagaNa, tomarA tAderake (vandhurUpe) grahaNa kareA nA, yArA grahaNa kareche teAmAdera dInake upahAsa o khelA hiseve, kitAvidera madhya theke tAderake evaM anyAnya kAphiraderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kareA nA| Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo, yadi teAmarA mu ’ mina hao|
Ara yakhana teAmarA sAlAtera janya AhvAna karo, takhana tArA tAke upahAsa o khelA hiseve grahaNa kare—e kAraNe ye, tArA vodha-vuddhi rAkhe nA|

he kitAvirA, tomarA ki AmAdera theke zudhu ekAraNe pratizodha niccha ye, AmarA ImAna enechi AllAhara prati, AmAdera opara avatIrNa kitAvera prati evaM yA pUrve avatIrNa karA haYeche; Ara teAmAdera adhikAMzai phAsika|

valo, ‘Ami ki teAmAdera avagata karava, AllAhara nikaTa pariNatira dika theke eraceYe vezi nikRSTatara vyApAre? yAdera prati AllAha abhisampAta karechena, yAdera prati tini kreAdhAnvita haYechena, yAdera katakake vAnara o zUkare rUpAntarita kare diYechena evaM yArA tAgUtera ArAdhanA kareche, tArAi maryAdAra dika diYe nikRSTatara evaM sarala patha theke adhika bhraSTatAYa nipatita|’

yakhana tArA teAmAdera kAche Ase takhana vale, ‘AmarA vizvAsa sthApana karechi|’ athaca tArA kuphara niYe esechila evaM kuphara niYei prasthAna kareche| Ara AllAha khuva jAnena yA tArA geApana karata|
Ara tumi tAdera anekake dekhave ye, pApa kAje, sImAlaGghane evaM hArAma bhakSaNe druta dhAvita haYa; tArA yA kare tA atyanta manda kAja|
rAvvAnirA o AlimarA kena tAderake pApa kathA valate evaM hArAma bhakSaNa karate niSedha kare nA? tArA yA kare tA khuvai manda kAja|

Ara iYAhUdirA vale, ‘AllAhara hAta vandha haYe geche; tAderai hAta vandha| e kathAra kAraNe tArA abhizapta haYeche; varaM tA~ra ubhaYa hAta unmukta|’ tini yerUpa icchA, vyaYa karena| tomAra prati pAlanakartAra pakSa theke ye kAlAma avatIrNa karA haYeche, tAra kAraNe tAdera anekera avAdhyatA o kuphara vRddhi pAve| Ami tAdera parasparera madhye kiYAmAta paryanta zatrutA o vidveSa saJcArita kare diYechi| tArA yakhanai yuddhera Aguna prajvalita kare, AllAha tA nirvApita kare dena| tArA pRthivIte nairAjya sRSTite saceSTa thAke| AllAha azAnti o vizRGkhalA sRSTikArIderake pachanda karena nA|
Ara yadi Ahale kitAvarA vizvAsa sthApana karata evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karata, tave Ami tAdera manda viSaYasamUha kSamA kare ditAma evaM tAderake niYAmAtera udyAnasamUhe praveza karAtAma|

tArA yadi tAorAta, inajIla evaM yA tAdera ravera pakSa theke tAdera prati avatIrNa karA haYeche, tA pureApuri pAlana karata, tave tArA opara theke evaM pAYera nica theke AhArya peta| tAdera kichu saMkhyaka leAka satpathera anugAmI evaM anekei manda kAja kare yAcche|

he rAsUla, tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke tomAra prati yA avatIrNa karA haYeche, tA pau~che dAo| Ara yadi tumi erUpa nA karo, tave tumi tA~ra paYagAma kichui pau~chAle nA| AllAha tomAke mAnuSera kAcha theke rakSA karavena| nizcaYai AllAha kAphiraderake pathapradarzana karena nA|

tumi valo, ‘he Ahale kitAvarA, teAmarA keAno kichura opara pratiSThita nao, yatakSaNa nA teAmarA tAorAta, inajIla evaM ye grantha teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke teAmAdera prati avatIrNa karA haYeche, tA pureApuri pAlana nA karo|’ tomAra ravera kAcha theke tomAra prati yA avartINa haYeche, tAra kAraNe tAdera anekera avAdhyatA o kuphuri vRddhi pAve| ataeva, e kAphira sampradAYera janya duHkha karo nA|

nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche, yArA iYAhUdi, sAviI vA khrisTAna, tAdera madhye yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare—AllAhara prati, kiYAmAtera prati evaM satkarma sampAdana kare, tAdera keAno bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhita have nA|

Ami vani isarAIlera kAcha theke aGgIkAra niYechilAma evaM tAdera kAche aneka rAsUla preraNa karechilAma| yakhanai tAdera kAche keAno rAsUla emana pratyAdeza niYe Asata yA tAdera manaHpUta hato nA, takhana tAdera anekera prati tArA mithyAreApa karata evaM anekake hatyA kare phelata|

tArA dhAraNA kareche ye, keAno aniSTa have nA; phale tArA Arao andha o vadhira haYe gela| ataHpara AllAha tAdera tAovA kavula karalena| eraparao tAdera adhikAMzai andha o vadhira haYe raila| AllAha dekhena tArA yA kichu kare|

nizcaYai tArA kuphuri kareche, yArA vale, ‘ mAraiYAma-tanaYa mAsIha-i AllAha; ’ athaca mAsIha vale, ‘he vani isarAIla, teAmarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo, yini AmAra rava evaM teAmAderao rava| ’ nizcaYai ye vyakti AllAhara sAthe aMzIdAra sAvyasta kare, AllAha tAra janya jAnnAta hArAma kare dena evaM tAra vAsasthAna haYa jAhAnnAma| yAlimadera keAno sAhAyyakArI nei|

nizcaYai tArA kAphira, yArA vale, ‘ AllAha tinera eka; ’ athaca eka upAsya chAr3A keAno upAsya nei| yadi tArA svIYa ukti theke nivRtta nA haYa, tave tAdera madhye yArA kuphurite aTala thAkave, tAderake yantraNAdAYaka zAsti sparza karave|
tave ki tArA AllAhara kAche tAovA evaM kSamAprArthanA karave nA? AllAha ye kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

mAraiYAma-tanaYa mAsIha rAsUla chAr3A Ara kichu naYa| tAra pUrve aneka rAsUla atikrAnta haYeche Ara tAra mAtA ekajana satyavAdinI| tArA ubhaYei khAvAra kheta| dekho, Ami tAdera janya kemana yukti-pramANa varNanA kari; AvAra dekho, tArA ulTA keAna dike yAcche!
valo, ‘ teAmarA ki AllAha vyatIta emana kichura ivAdAta karo, yA teAmAdera kono apakAra vA upakAra karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA? ’ athaca AllAha sava zonena o sava jAnena|

valo, ‘ he Ahale kitAvarA, teAmarA svIYa dharme anyAYa vAr3AvAr3i kareA nA evaM ete oi sampradAYera pravRttira anusaraNa kareA nA yArA pUrve pathabhraSTa haYeche evaM anekake pathabhraSTa kareche, Ara tArA sarala patha theke vicyuta haYe par3eche| ’
vani isarAilera madhye yArA kuphari kareche, tAderake dAUda o mAraiYAma-tanaYa IsAra mukhe abhisampAta karA haYeche| eTA ekAraNe ye, tArA avAdhyatA evaM sImAlaGghana karata|
tArA parasparake manda kAje niSedha karata nA, yA tArA karata| tArA yA karata tA avazyai manda chila|

tumi tAdera anekake dekhave, kAphiradera sAthe vandhutva kare| tArA nijedera janya yA pAThiYeche tA avazyai manda—tA ei ye, tAdera prati AllAha kreAdhAnvita haYechena evaM tArA cirakAla AyAve thAkave|
yadi tArA AllAha, navi evaM tAra nikaTa avatIrNa viSaYera prati vizvAsa sthApana karata, tave kAphiraderake vandhurUpe grahaNa karata nA; kintu tAdera madhye anekei phAsika|

avazyai tumi mAnuSera mAjhe mu ’ minadera prati ghoratara zatru hiseve pAve iYAhUdi o muzarikadera; AvAra mu ’ minadera sAthe vandhutve adhika nikaTavartI pAve tAderake yArA vale, ‘ AmarA khrisTAna, ’ era kAraNa ei ye—khrisTAnadera madhye raYeche dharmayAjaka, purohita evaM tArA ahaMkAra kare nA|

Ara rAsUlera prati yA avatIrNa karA haYeche, tArA yakhana tA zone, takhana tumi tAdera cokha azrusikta dekhate pAve; e kAraNe ye, tArA satya upalavdhi karate pereche| tArA vale, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA ImAna enechi| ataeva, AmAderakeo sAkSyadAnakArIdera antarbhukta karo| ’

‘AmAdera kI halo ye, AmarA AllAhara prati evaM ye satya AmAdera kAche eseche, tAra prati vizvAsa sthApana karava nA evaM e AzA karava nA ye, Amadera rava AmAderake satkarmazIladera mAjhe praveza karAvena? ’
ataHpara tAderake AllAha e uktira pratidAnasvarUpa emana udyAna devena—yAra taladeze naharasamUha pravAhita have; tArA sekhAne cirasthAYI have | eTAi satkarmazIladera pratidAna|
yArA kuphuri kareche evaM AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA valeche, tArAi jAhAnnAmera AdhivAsI|

he mu’ minagaNa, teAmarA oisava pavitra vastugulo hArAma kareA nA, yeguleA AllAha teAmAdera janya hAlAla karechena evaM sImAlaGghana kareA nA| nizcaYai AllAha sImAlaGghanakArIderake pachanda karena nA|
AllAha teAmAderake yesava riyika diYechena, tA theke hAlAla o pavitra vastu khAo evaM AllAhake bhaYa karo, yA~ra prati teAmarA ImAna rAkho|

AllAha teAmAderake pAkar3Ao karavena nA teAmAdera anarthaka zapathera janya; kintu pAkar3Ao karavena oi zapathera janya, yA teAmarA dRr3habhAve karo | ataeva, era kAphapharA ei ye, dazajana daridrake khAdya pradAna karave—madhyama zreNira khAdya, yA teAmarA svIYa parivArake diYe thAko; athavA tAderake vastra pradAna karave; athavA ekajana krItadAsa kiMvA dAsI mukta kare deve| ye vyakti sAmarthya rAkhe nA, se tina dina siYAma pAlana karave| eTA kAphaphArA teAmAdera zapathera, yakhana zapatha karave| teAmarA svIYa zapathasamUha rakSA karo| emanibhAve AllAha teAmAdera janya tA~ra AYAtasamUha varNanA karena, yAte teAmarA kRtajJatA prakAza karo|
he mu’ minagaNa, nizcaYai mada, juYA, pratimA evaM bhAgya-nirdhAraka tirasamUha—esava zaYatAnera apavitra kAja| ataeva, eguleA theke ve~ce thAko, yAte teAmarA saphalakAma hao|

zaYatAna to cAYa ye, mada o juYAra mAdhyame teAmAdera parasparera mAjhe zatrutA o vidveSa saJcArita karave evaM AllAhara smaraNa o sAlAta theke teAmAderake virata rAkhave| ataeva, teAmarA ki nivRtta have?
teAmarA AllAhara Anugatya karo, Ara Anugatya karo rAsUlera evaM satarka hao; tave yadi teAmarA vimukha hao, tave jene rekho, AmAra rAsUlera dAYitva spaSTabhAve pau~che deoYA|

yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkarma kareche, tArA yA bhakSaNa kareche, sejanya tAdera keAno pApa nei; yakhana tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, ImAna Ane evaM satkarma kare, erapara saMyata thAke evaM ImAna Ane, erapara saMyata thAke evaM ihasAna kare| AllAha muhasinadera bhAlovAsena|

he mu ’ minagaNa, AllAha teAmAderake emana kichu zikArera mAdhyame parIkSA karavena, yA tomAdera hAta o varzAgulora nAgAle Ase, yAte AllAha jene nena ye, ke tAke nA dekheo bhaYa kare| ataeva, eraparao ye sImAlaGghana karave, tAra janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|

he mu’ minagaNa, teAmarA iharAma avasthAYa zikAra kareA nA| teAmAdera madhye ye icchAkRtabhAve zikAra karave, tAra opara vinimaYa Avazyaka have, anurUpa gRhapAlita jantu| yAra phAYasAlA karave tomAdera madhyakAra dujana nyAYaparAYaNa vyakti; vinimaYera jantuTi ‘hAdi’ hiseve kA’ vAYa pau~chAte have| athavA tAra opara kAphaphArA Avazyaka have kaYekajana daridrake khAoYAneA athavA tAra samaparimANa siYAma pAlana karA, yAte se svIYa kRtakarmera pratiphala AsvAdana kare| yA gata haYe geche, AllAha tA kSamA karechena| Ara ye punarAYa emana karave, AllAha tAra kAcha theke pratizeAdha nevena| AllAha parAkramazAlI, pratizeAdha grahaNe sakSama|

teAmAdera janya samudrera zikAra o khAdya hAlAla karA haYeche teAmAdera evaM bhramaNakArIdera bhogera janya| Ara tomarA muharima thAkA paryanta tomAdera janya hArAma karA haYeche sthalabhAgera zikAra| AllAhake bhaYa karo, yAra kAche tomAderake ekatrita karA have|

AllAha sammAnita kA ‘ vA ghara evaM sammAnita mAsasamUha, ‘hAdi’ jantu o galAYa mAlA parAno pazuke mAnuSera kalyANera janya vAniYechena| era kAraNa halo, yena tomarA jAnate pAro, nizcaYai AllAha AsamAna o yaminera savakichu jAnena evaM AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|
jene rekho, nizcaYai AllAha zAstidAne kaTheAra evaM nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
rAsUlera dAYitva zudhu pau~chiYe deoYA| Ara AllAha jAnena, yA kichu teAmarA prakAzye karo evaM yA kichu geApana karo|
valo, ‘ apavitra o pavitra samAna naYa, yadio apavitrera Adhikya tomAke mohita kare| ataeva, he jJAnI sampradAYa, AllAhake bhaYa karo, yAte teAmarA saphalakAma hao| ’

he mu’ minagaNa, emana viSaYAdi jijJesa kareA nA, yA teAmAdera kAche parivyakta hale teAmAdera khArApa lAgave| yadi kuraAna avataraNakAle teAmarA esava viSaYa jijJesa karo, tave tA teAmAdera janya prakAza karA have| atIta viSaYa AllAha kSamA karechena| AllAha kSamAzIla, sahanazIla|
avazya teAmAdera pUrveo eka sampradAYa emana jijJesa karechila| ataHpara tArA esava viSaYe avizvAsI haYe geche|
AllAha ‘vAhIrA’ ‘sAYivA’ ‘oYAsIlA’ evaM ‘hAmi’ke zArI ‘ Atasiddha karenani; kintu yArA kuphuri kareche, tArA AllAhara opara mithyA apavAda AreApa kare; tAdera adhikAMzai viveka-vuddhi rAkhe nA|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘ AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena tAra dike evaM rAsUlera dike eso, ’ takhana tArA vale, ‘ AmAdera janya tA-i yatheSTa, yAra opara AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAke peYechi| ’ yadio tAdera vApa dAdArA keAno jJAna rAkhata nA evaM tArA hidAYAtaprApta chila nA| tavuo ki?

he mu’ minagaNa, tomAdera dAYitva tomAdera opara| ye pathabhraSTa haYeche se tomAdera kSati karate pArave nA, yakhana tomarA hidAYAtera opara thAkave| tomAdera sakalake AllAhara dikei pratyAvartana karate have| takhana tini teAmAderake avagata karavena yA-kichu teAmarA karate|

he mu’ minagaNa, yakhana teAmAdera kArao nikaTa mRtyu upasthita haYa, takhana oYAsI YyAtera samaYa teAmAdera madhyakAra nyAYaparAYaNa dujanake sAkSI rekheA| yadi tomarA dUradeze saphare thAko ataHpara tomAdera kAche mRtyura vipada pau~che, yadi tomarA sandeha karo tave ubhaYake sAlAtera para apekSamANa rAkhave, ataHpara ubhaYei AllAhara nAme zapatha kare valave, ‘ AmarA era vinimaYe kono mUlya grahaNa karava nA, yadio se haYa nikaTajana| Ara AmarA AllAra sAkSya gopana karava nA, yadi kari tave AmarA pApIdera antarbhukta hava| ’

ataHpara yadi e marme prakAza pAYa ye, tArA pApe lipta haYeche, tAhale tAdera madhyakAra yAdera svArthahAnI ghaTeche anya duvyakti prathamokta dujanera sthalAbhiSikta have| ataHpara tArA AllAhara nAme zapatha kare valave, ‘ avazyai AmAdera sAkSya tAdera sAkSya theke adhika satya| Ara AmarA sImAlaGghana karini| yadi kari, tAhale avazyai AmarA sImAlaGghanakArIdera antarbhukta haYe yAva| ’

eTi nikaTatama upAYa ye, tArA saThikatara sAkSya niYe Asave, athavA tArA bhaYa karave ye, tAdera zapathagulora para punarAYa zapatha karAno have| tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM zono; AllAha phAsika sampradAYake hidAYAta dena nA|
yedina AllAha sava rAsUlake ekatra karavena, ataHpara valavena, ‘ temAderake kI uttara deoYA haYechila? ’ tArA valave, ‘ AmAdera kono jJAna nei; nizcaYai Apanii adRzyera viSaYe mahAjJAnI| ’

smaraNa karo, yakhana AllAha valavena, ‘ he mAraiYAma-tanaYa IsA, teAmAra prati o teAmAra mAtAra prati AmAra anugraha smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami teAmAke rUhula kudasa dvArA zaktizAlI karechi, tumi mAnuSera sAthe dolanAra madhye thAkatei evaM pariNata vaYase kathA valate; Ara yakhana Ami teAmAke kitAva, hikamAta, tAorAta o inajIla zikSA diYechi; evaM yakhana tumi kAdAmATi diYe pAkhira mato pratikRti tairi karate AmAra Adeze, ataHpara tumi tAte phu~ dite, phale tA AmAra Adeze pAkhi haYe yeta evaM tumi AmAra Adeze janmAndha o kuSTha reAgIke nirAmaYa karate, Ara yakhana AmAra Adeze mRtaderake vera karate (jIvita karate); Ara yakhana Ami vani isarAIlake tomAra theke nivRtta rekhechilAma| Ara yakhana tumi tAdera kAche suspaSTa pramANAdi niYe esechile, ataHpara tAdera madhye yArA kuphuri kareche, tArA valala, ‘ eTA prakAzya jAdu chAr3A kichui naYa| ’
Ara yakhana Ami hAoYAridera mane preraNA dilAma ye, ‘ AmAra prati evaM AmAra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ano, ’ takhana tArA valate lAgala, ‘ AmarA ImAna enechi evaM sAkSI thAkena ye, AmarA musalima| ’

yakhana hAoYArirA valala, ‘ he mAraiYAma-tanaYa IsA, ApanAra rava ki sakSama ye, AmAdera janya AkAza theke khAdyabharti khAJcA avataraNa karavena? ’ se valala, ‘ yadi teAmarA mu’mina hao, tave AllAhake bhaYa karo| ’
tArA valala, ‘ AmarA tA theke AhAra karava, AmAdera antara paritRpta karava; Ara AmarA jene neva ye, tumi AmAderake satya valecha evaM AmarA hava sAkSyadAtAdera antarbhukta| ’

mAraiYAma-putra IsA valala, ‘ he AllAha, AmAdera rava, AmAdera prati AkAza theke khAdyabharti khAJcA avataraNa karAna| tA AmAdera janya evaM AmAdera pUrvavartI o paravartIdera janya have khuzira upalakSya evaM ApanAra pakSa theke ekaTi nidarzana| Apani AmAderake riyika dAna karena; Apanii zreSTha riyikadAtA| ’
AllAha valalena, ‘ nizcaYai Ami se khAJcA teAmAdera prati avataraNa karAva; ataHpara ye era pareo asvIkAra karave, Ami tAke emana zAsti deva, ye zAsti vizvajagatera apara kAuke deva nA| ’

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana AllAha valavena, ‘he IsA ivanu mAraiYAma, tumi ki leAkadera valechile ye, AllAhake cher3e AmAke o AmAra mAke ilAharUpe grahaNa karo?’ IsA valave, ‘Apani pavitra! AmAra janya zeAbhA pAYa nA ye, Ami emana kathA vali, yAra adhikAra AmAra nei| yadi Ami vale thAki, tave Apani avazyai parijJAta; Apani teA AmAra manera kathA jAnena; kintu Ami jAni nA yA ApanAra mane Ache; nizcaYai Apanii adRzya viSaYe jJAta|’

Ami teA tAderake kichui valini, zudhu se kathAi valechi yA Apani valate Adeza karechilena ye, ‘ teAmarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo, yini AmAra o teAmAdera rava| Ami tAdera samparke sAkSI chilAma, yatadina tAdera madhye chilAma; ataHpara yakhana Apani AmAke uThiYe nilena, takhana theke Apanii chilena tAdera paryavekSaka; Ara Apani savakichura pratyakSadarzI| ’
‘ yadi Apani tAderake zAsti dena, tave tArA to ApanArai vAndA! Ara yadi Apani tAderake kSamA karena, tave Apani to parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa| ’

AllAha valalena, ‘ Ajakera dine satyavAdIdera satyavAditA tAdera upakAre Asave| tAdera janya raYeche jAnnAta, yAra taladeze pravAhita have nada-nadI; tArA sekhAne sthAYI have| AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa, tA~rAo AllAhara prati santuSTa; eTii mahAsaphalatA| ’
AsamAna, yamina evaM e duYera madhye yA-kichu Ache, savakichura Adhipatya AllAharai; tini savakichura opara kSamatAvA na|
samasta prazaMsA AllAhara janya, yini AsamAnasamUha o yamina sRSTi karechena evaM sRSTi karechena Alo o andhakAra| tavuo yArA kuphuri kare, tArA tAdera ravera sAthe samakakSa sAvyasta kare|
tinii teAmAderake mATi theke sRSTi karechena, ataHpara nirdiSTa karechena ekaTi meYAda| Ara apara ekaTi meYAda nirdhArita Ache tA~ra kAche; tAraparao teAmarA sandeha karo|
AsamAna o yamine tinii AllAha| tini teAmAdera geApana o prakAzya viSaYa jAnena evaM tini jAnena, yA tomarA arjana karo|
yakhanai tAdera nikaTa tAdera ravera pakSa theke kono nidarzana Ase, tArA tA theke vimukha haYa|
ataHpara avazyai tArA satyake mithyA pratipanna kareche yakhanai tA tAdera nikaTa eseche| ataeva, zigagira tAdera nikaTa sei saMvAda Asave, yAra prati tArA upahAsa karata|

tArA ki dekheni ye, Ami tAdera pUrve mAnavagoSThI theke kata sampradAYake dhvaMsa kare diYechi, yAderake Ami pRthivIte erUpa pratiSThita karechilAma, yA teAmAderakeo karini| Ami tAdera opara muSaladhAre vRSTi varSaNa karechi evaM tAdera pAdadeze nada-nadI pravAhita karechi; ataHpara Ami tAderake tAdera pApera kAraNe dhvaMsa kare diYechi evaM tAdera pare sRSTi karechi anya sampradAYa|
Ara yadi Ami kAgaje likhita kitAvao tomAra prati avatIrNa karatAma, ataHpara tArA tA tAdera hAta diYe sparza karata; tavuo kAphirarA valata, ‘ eTA prakAzya jAdu chAr3A kichu naYa| ’

tArA vale, ‘ tAra nikaTa pherezatA kena avatIrNa karA halo nA? ’ Ara yadi Ami keAno pherezatA preraNa karatAma, tave avazyai sava viSaYera phAYasAlA haYe yeta| tArapara tAderake kono avakAza deoYA hato nA|
Ara yadi Ami tAke vAnAtAma pherezatArUpe, tave tAke mAnuSera AkArei vAnAtAma| evaM avazyai Ami tAderake vibhrame phelatAma, yemana vibhrame tArA par3e raYeche|
Ara avazyai tomAra pUrvavartI rAsUladera sAtheo upahAsa karA haYeche| phale tAdera madhyakAra yArA upahAsa kareche tAderake veSTana kare niYeche tAderai upahAsa|
valo, ‘ teAmarA pRthivIte paribhramaNa karo, ataHpara dekho, mithyAvAdIdera pariNAma kI haYeche? ’

valo, ‘AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA Ache tAra mAlika ke? ’ valo ‘ AllAha| ’ tini rahama karAke tA~ra nijera opara Avazyaka kare niYechena | tini avazyai teAmAdera kiYAmAtera dina ekatrita karavena, tAte keAno sandeha nei| yArA nijederake kSatigrasta kareche, tArA ImAna Anave nA|
Ara rAta o dine yA kichu sthiti lAbha kare, tA tA~rai| tinii sarvazreAtA, sarvajJa|

valo, ‘ yini AsamAnasamUha o yamine ra sraSTA, Ami ki sei AllAha chAr3A anyake avibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karava? yini savAike AhArya dAna karena kintu tA~ke AhArya deoYA haYa nA; ’ valo, ‘ nizcaYai Ami AdiSTa haYechi ye, sarvAgre Amii musalima hava| Ara tumi kakhano muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA| ’
valo, ‘ Ami yadi AmAra ravera avAdhyatA kari, tave nizcaYai Ami bhaYa kari mahAdivasera zAstira| ’
yAra kAcha theke oi dina e zAsti sariYe neoYA have, tAra prati AllAhara anukampA have| eTAi spaSTa saphalatA|
Ara yadi AllAha teAmAke keAno kaSTa dena, tave tini vyatIta tA apasAraNakArI keu nei| pakSAntare yadi teAmAra maGgala karena, tave tini sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tini parAkramazAlI svIYa vAndAdera opara| tini prajJAmaYa, sarvAdhika jJAta|

valo, ‘ ke sarvocca sAkSyadAtA hiseve? ’ valo, ‘ AllAha! AmAra o teAmAdera madhye sAkSI| AmAra prati e kuraAna avatIrNa karA haYeche, yAte Ami tA dvArA teAmAderake evaM yAdera kAche tA pau~chAve savAike sAvadhAna kari| ’ teAmarA ki satyii sAkSya dAo ye, AllAhara sAthe anyAnya ilAh raYeche? valo, ‘ Ami erUpa sAkSya dii nA| ’ valo, ‘ tinii ekamAtra ilAh; nizcaYai Ami tA theke mukta yA tomarA ziraka karo| ’
yAderake Ami kitAva dAna karechi, tArA tAke cene, yemanibhAve tArA cene tAdera santAnaderake| yArA nijederake kSatigrasta kareche, tArA ImAna Anave nA|
Ara tAraceYe ke adhika sImAlaGghanakArI ye AllAhara prati mithyA apavAda AreApa kare athavA tA~ra nidarzanAvalike mithyA vale? nizcaYai sImAlaGghanakArIrA saphalakAma have nA|
Ara yedina Ami tAdera savAike ekatrita karava, ataHpara yArA ziraka karechila, tAderake valava, ‘ teAmAdera zarikarA kothAYa, yAderake teAmarA (AllAhara aMzIdAra) dhAraNA karate? ’
ataHpara tAdera keAno ajuhAta thAkave nA; tave eTuku ye, tArA valave, ‘ AmAdera rava AllAhara kasama, AmarA muzarika chilAma nA| ’
dekho, tArA kIbhAve mithyA Aropa kare nijedera vipakSe evaM hAriYe yAve tAdera theke yA tArA mithyA racanA karata|

tAdera madhyakAra keu keu tomAra kathA kAna pete zone| Ami tAdera antarera opara AvaraNa rekhe diYechi, yena tArA vujhate nA pAre evaM tAdera kAne vadhiratA tairi karechi, yadi tArA sava nidarzana dekheo; tavu tArA ImAna Anave nA| emanaki tArA yakhana tomAra kAche Ase, teAmAra sAthe jhagar3A kare, takhana kAphirarA vale, ‘eTA (kuraAna) to pUrvavartIdera kicchA-kAhini vai kichui naYa| ’
tArA tA theke vAdhA pradAna kare evaM tA theke dUre thAke| tArA nijederai dhvaMsa kareche, athaca tArA vojhe nA|

Ara yadi tumi dekhate, yakhana tAderake dA~r3a karAneA have Agunera nikaTa, tArA valave, ‘ hAYa Aphasosa! yadi AmarA punarAYa prerita hatAma, tAhale AmarA AmAdera ravera nidarzanasamUhe mithyAreApa karatAma nA evaM AmarA mu’mi nadera antarbhukta hatAma| ’

varaM tAdera kAche prakAza peYeche itaHpUrve yA tArA gopana karechila; evaM yadi tAderake pherata pAThAno hato tave avazyai tArA oi viSaYera punarAvRtti karata, yA tAderake niSedha karA haYechila; Ara nizcaYai tArA mithyAvAdI|
tArA vale, ‘AmAdera pArthiva jIvanai AmAdera ekamAtra jIvana, AmarA Ara punarutthita hava nA|’

yadi tumi dekhate, yakhana tAderake tAdera ravera sAmane dA~r3a karAneA have, tini valavena, ‘eTA ki satya naYa?’ tArA valave, ‘hyA~, AmAdera ravera zapatha|’ tini valavena, ‘ataeva, zAsti AsvAdana karo ekAraNe ye, tomarA kuphuri karachile|’

nizcaYai tArA kSatigrasta haYeche, yArA AllAhara sAkSAtke mithyA Aropa kareche| emanaki haThAt yakhana kiYAmAta tAdera kAche Asave, tArA valave, ‘ hAYa! AphaseAsa oi viSaYe, yA AmarA truTi karechi| ’ tArA tAdera veAjhA nijedera piThe vahana karave| sAvadhAna, tA katai nA nikRSTa yA tArA vahana karave!
pArthiva-jIvana krIr3A o kautuka vyatIta kichui naYa| Ara avazyai parakAlera AvAsa muttAkidera janya zreSThatara; tavuo ki teAmarA vujhave nA?
nizcaYai Ami jAni, avazyai tA tomAke vyathita karave—yA tArA vale| nizcaYai, tArA tomAke mithyA pratipanna kare nA; varaM yAlimarA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare|

Ara nizcaYai tomAra pUrvavartI aneka rAsUlera opara mithyAropa karA haYeche; kintu tArA dhairyadhAraNa kareche tAderake mithyAropa o kaSTa deoYA sattveo| yatakSaNa nA tAdera kAche AmAra sAhAyya eseche| AllAhara vANI parivartana kArAra keu nei, avazya teAmAra nikaTa rAsUladera kichu saMvAda pau~cheche|

Ara yadi tAdera vimukhatA tomAra kAche kaSTakara haYa, tave tumi yadi bhUgarbhe keAno sur3aGga athavA AkAze keAno si~r3i anusandhAna karate samartha hao, ataHpara tAdera kAche keAno ekaTi nidarzana niYe Aso, tave Ano| AllAha icchA karale savAike hidAYAtera opara ekatrita karatena| ataeva, tumi nirveAdhadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
mUlata tArAi DAke sAr3A deYa, yArA zravaNa kare| Ara AllAha mRtaderake punarutthita karavena; ataHpara tArA tA~rai dike pratyAvartita have|
tArA vale, ‘ kena tAra prati tAra ravera pakSa theke keAno nidarzana avatIrNa haYani? ’ valo, ‘ nizcaYai AllAha nidarzana avataraNa karAte sakSama; ’ kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

Ara yata prANI pRthivIte vicaraNazIla evaM yata prakAra pAkhi du-DAnAYa ur3e cale, tArA savAi teAmAdera matoi prajAti| Ami ei kitAve keAno kichui vAda diini; ataHpara tAderake ravera nikaTa samaveta karA have|
yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA vale, tArA andhakArera madhye vovA o vadhira| AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena evaM yAke icchA sarala pathe paricAlita karena|
valo, ‘ tomarA bheve dekhecho ki, yadi teAmAdera opara AllAhara zAsti Apatita haYa kiMvA teAmAdera kAche kiYAmAta ese yAYa, tave teAmarA ki AllAha vyatIta anyake DAkave, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao? ’
‘ varaM teAmarA teA tA~kei DAkave, ataHpara ye vipadera janya tA~ke DAkacho, tini icchA karale tA dUra kare devena| Ara tomarA yAderake zarika sAvyasta karacha, tAdera bhule yAve| ’
Ara avazyai Ami tomAra pUrve aneka jAtira nikaTa rAsUla preraNa karechi, ataHpara Ami tAderake abhAva-anaTana o reAga-vyAdhi dvArA pAkar3Ao karechilAma, yAte tArA kAkuti-minati kare|
ataHpara tAdera kAche yakhana AmAra zAsti ela, takhana kena kAkuti-minati karala nA? kintu tAdera antara kaTheAra haYe gela evaM zaYatAna tAdera kAche suzeAbhita kare dekhiYeche yA tArA karachila|

ataHpara tArA yakhana oi upadeza bhule gela yA tAderake deoYA haYechila, takhana Ami tAdera sAmane savakichura dvAra unmukta kare dilAma; emanaki yakhana tArA ullasita halo tA niYe yA tAderake deoYA haYechila, takhanai Ami akasmAt tAderake pAkar3Ao karalAma| takhana tArA nirAza haYe gela|
ataHpara sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYera mUla upar3e phelA halo; samasta prazaMsA jagatsamUhera rava AllAharai janya|

valo, ‘ tomarA ki bheve dekhecho, yadi AllAha teAmAdera zravaNazakti o dRSTizakti chiniYe nena evaM teAmAdera antare meAhara e~Te dena, tave AllAha vyatIta kono ilAha Ache ki, ye teAmAderake eguleA ene deve? ’ dekho, Ami kIbhAve nAnAbhAve AYAtasamUha varNanA kari; tavuo tArA mukha phiriYe nicche |
valo, ‘ tomarA ki bheve dekhecho, yadi AllAhara zAsti Akasmika kiMvA prakAzye teAmAdera opara Ase, tave yAlima sampradAYa vyatIta Ara kAuke dhvaMsa karA have ki? ’
Ami rAsUladerake kevala susaMvAdadAtA o bhItipradarzakarUpe preraNa kari, ataHpara ye ImAna Ane evaM saMzeAdhita haYa, tAdera keAno zaGkA nei evaM tArA cintitao have nA|
yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalike mithyA pratipanna karave, tAderake zAsti sparza karave ekAraNe ye, tArA pApAcArI chila|

valo, ‘ Ami teAmAderake vali nA ye, AmAra kAche AllAhara khAyAnA raYeche, Ara Ami adRzya viSaYe avagata nai| Ami emanao vali nA ye, Ami pherezatA| Ami teA zudhu oi oYAhira anusaraNa kari, yA AmAra kAche Ase| ’ valo, ‘ andha o cakSuSmAna ki samAna hate pAre? ’ tave ki teAmarA cintA karo nA?

tumi era (kuraAna) dvArA tAderake satarka karo, yArA bhaYa kare ye, tAderake tAdera ravera kAche ekatrita karA have, Ara tAdera keAno abhibhAvaka o supArizakArI thAkave nA, AzA karA yAYa tAkaoYA avalamvana karave|

Ara tumi tAderake tAr3iYe deve nA yArA sakAla- sandhyAYa tAdera ravera ivAdAta kare, tA~ra santuSTi kAmanA kare| tAdera hisAva vindumAtrao tomAra opare naYa evaM tomAra hisAva vindumAtrao tAdera opare naYa; ataeva, yadi tumi tAderake tAr3iYe dAo, tave tumi yAlimadera antarbhukta have|
Ara ebhAvei Ami katakake katakera dvArA parIkSA karechi, yAte tArA vale ye, ‘ erAi ki tArA AmAdera madhya theke yAderake AllAha anugraha karechena? ’ AllAha ki kRtajJadera samparke suparijJAta nana?

AmAra AYAtasamUhe ImAna AnaYanakArIrA yakhana tomAra nikaTa Ase, takhana valo, ‘ teAmAdera opara zAnti; teAmAdera rava daYA karAke nijera opara Avazyaka kare niYechena | nizcaYai yekeu tomAdera madhye ajJatAvazata pApa kAja kare, erapara tAovA kare o saMzodhana kare, tave nizcaYai tini atyanta kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
Ara emanibhAve Ami AYAtasamUha vistArita varNanA kari, yAte aparAdhIdera patha suspaSTa prakAza pAYa|

valo, ‘ AmAke tAdera ivAdAta karate niSedha karA haYeche, teAmarA AllAhake cher3e yAdera upAsanA karo| ’ valo, ‘ Ami teAmAdera pravRttira anusaraNa karava nA| ’ yadi kari, tave Ami ye pathabhraSTadera antarbhukta haYe yAva evaM Ami hidAYAtaprAptadera antarbhukta thAkava nA|

valo, ‘ nizcaYai Ami AmAra ravera pakSa theke suspaSTa pramANera opara pratiSThita; athaca teAmarA tAke mithyA pratipanna karacho| teAmarA yA zIghra dAvi karacho, tA AmAra kAche nei| AllAhai ekamAtra vidhAnadAtA| tini satya varNanA karena evaM tinii uttama mImAMsAkArI| ’
valo, ‘ yadi AmAra kAche tA thAkata, yA teAmarA zIghrai dAvi karacha, tave AmAra o teAmAdera mAjhe viSaYaTira mImAMsA haYe yeta; AllAha sImAlaGghanakArIdera samparke samyaka jJAta| ’

tA~ra kAchei adRzyera cAvikAThi; Ara tA tini vyatIta keu jAne nA| sthale o jale yA Ache, tA tinii jAnena; Ara jhare par3e nA emana kono pAtA, yA tini jAnena nA| emana keAno zasyakaNAo mRttikAra andhakAre aGkurita haYa nA evaM nei kono rasayukta o nirasa vastu, yA suspaSTa kitAve nei|

tini emana sattA—yini rAtrivelAYa teAmAdera mRtyu dena evaM yA-kichu teAmarA dinera velAYa karo, tA jAnena| ataHpara dine teAmAderake tAra mAjhe jAgrata karena, yAte nirdiSTa meYAda pUrNa haYa| ataHpara tA~rai dike teAmAdera pratyAvartana| tini teAmAderake jAniYe devena oi viSaYa, yA teAmarA karachile|

tinii svIYa vAndAdera opara parAkramazAlI| tinii pAThAna teAmAdera nikaTa rakSaNAvekSaNakArI| emanaki yakhana teAmAdera kArao mRtyu Ase takhana AmAra prerita pherezatArA tAra AtmA hastagata kare neYa| ematAvasthAYa tArA bhula kare nA|
ataHpara sakalake satyikAra prabhu AllAhara kAche pherAno have| sAvadhAna, nirdezapradAnera kSamatA tA~rai Ara tini druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

valo, ke teAmAdera sthala o jalera ghora andhakAra theke uddhAra karena, yakhana teAmarA tA~ke vinItabhAve o cupisAre AhvAna karo ye, yadi Apani AmAderake e theke uddhAra karena, tave AmarA avazyai kRtajJadera antarbhukta haYe yAva|
valo, AllAhai teAmAdera tA theke evaM pratyeka durdazA theke mukti dena; kintu erapara teAmarA ziraka karo|

valo, tini teAmAdera opara athavA teAmAdera padatala theke zAsti preraNe athavA teAmAderake vibhinna dale vibhakta kare ekake anyera opara AkramaNera svAda AsvAdana karAte sakSama| dekho, Ami kemana ghuriYe-phiriYe nidarzanAvali varNanA kari, yena tArA anudhAvana karate pAre|
tomAra sampradAYa tAke mithyA valache, athaca tA satya| valo, Ami teAmAdera tattvAvadhAYaka nai|
pratyeka khavarera ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa raYeche evaM zigagira teAmarA tA jene neve|

yakhana tumi tAdera dekho, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha niYe upahAsa kare, takhana tAdera er3iYe calo, yatakSaNa nA tArA anya kathAYa pravRtta nA haYa, yadi zaYatAna tomAke bhuliYe deYa tave smaraNa haoYAra para sImAlaGghanakArIdera sAthe upavezana karave nA|
Ara yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, sImAlaGghanakArIdera keAno hisAva tAdera dAYitve nei| kintu tAdera kartavya—upadeza dAna karA; yAte tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare|

tAderake parityAga karo, yArA nijedera dharmake krIr3A o kautukarUpe grahaNa kareche evaM pArthiva jIvana yAderake dheA~kAYa phele rekheche| kuraAna dvArA tAderake upadeza dAo, yAte keu svIYa kRtakarmera janya dhvaMse nikSipta nA haYa, AllAha vyatIta tAra keAno abhibhAvaka o supArizakArI nei evaM yadi tArA jagatera samudaYa vinimaYao pradAna kare, tavuo tAdera kAcha theke tA grahaNa karA have nA| tArA oisava loka, yArA nijerAi svIYa kRtakarmera janya dhvaMse nikSipta haYeche| tAdera janye raYeche uSNa pAnIYa evaM yantraNAdAYaka zAsti e kAraNe ye tArA kuphuri karata|

valo, AmarA ki AllAha vyatIta emana vastuke AhvAna karava, ye AmAdera upakAra karate pAre nA evaM kSatio karate pAre nA evaM AllAha AmAdera hidAYAtadAnera para AmarA ki pazcAdapade phire yAva? oi vyaktira mato, yAke zaYatAnarA udbhrAnta kare diYeche, se pRthivIte dizehArA haYe phirache| tAra raYeche sahacara tArA tAke hidAYAtera dike Deke valache, Aso AmAdera kAche| valo, nizcaYai AllAhara hidAYAtai prakRta hidAYAta| AmarA jagatsamUhera ravera nikaTa atmasamarpaNe AdiSTa haYechi|
evaM tA ei ye, sAlAta pratiSThA karo evaM tA~ke bhaYa karo| tA~ra sAmanei tomAdera samaveta karA have|

tinii AsamAnasamUha o yamina sRSTi karechena yathAyathabhAve| yedina tini valavena, hao, phale tA haYe yAve| tA~ra kathAi satya| tA~rai Adhipatya ziGgAYa phutkAra karAra dineo| tini adRzya o dRzya viSaYe jJAta| tinii prajJAmaYa, savizeSa avahita|
smaraNa karo, yakhana ivarAhima tAra pitA Ajarake valala, tumi ki pratimAguloke upAsya mane karo? Ami dekhate pAcchi ye, tumi o teAmAra sampradAYa spaSTa bhraSTatAYa raYecha|
Ami ebhAvei ivarAhimake AsamAnasamUha o yamine ra atyAzcarya vastusamUha dekhAte lAgalAma, yAte se dRr3ha vizvAsI haYe yAYa|
yakhana rAtera andhakAra tAra opara samAcchanna halo, takhana se ekaTi tArakA dekhate pela, valala, eTA AmAra rava| ataHpara yakhana tA asta gela, takhana valala, Ami astagAmIdera bhAlovAsi nA|

ataHpara yakhana candrake jhalamala karate dekhala, valala, eTi AmAra rava| ataHpara yakhana tA astamita halo takhana valala, yadi AmAra rava AmAke hidAYAta nA karena, tave avazyai Ami vibhrAnta sampradAYera antarbhukta haYe yAva|

ataHpara yakhana sUryake jhalama le dekhala, valala, eTi AmAra rava eTi var3a| ataHpara yakhana tA Duve gela, takhana valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA yesava viSaYake zarika karo, Ami tA theke mukta|’
Ami ekaniSThabhAve sei sattAbhimukhI, yini AsamAnasamUha o yamina sRSTi karechena evaM Ami muzarikadera antarbhukta nai|

tA~ra sAthe tAra sampradAYa vitarka karala| se valala, ‘teAmarA ki AmAra sAthe AllAhara (ekAtmavAda) samparke vitarka karacha; athaca tini AmAke hidAYAta dAna karechena| teAmarA yAderake aMzIdAra sAvyasta karo, Ami tAderake bhaYa kari nA tave AmAra rava yadi keAno kichu cAna| AmAra rava pratyeka vastuke svIYa jJAna dvArA veSTana kare Achena| teAmarA ki upadeza grahaNa karave nA?’

Ami kIbhAve tomAdera zarikadera bhaYa pAva, athaca tomarA AllAhara sAthe emana zarika karAra vyApAre bhaYa pAccha nA, ye vyApAre tini tomAdera kAche kono pramANa avatIrNa karenani| ataeva, ubhaYa dalera mAjhe kona dalaTi nirApattAlAbhera adhika upayukta yadi tomarA jAnate|
yArA ImAna Ane evaM tAdera ImAnake zirakera sAthe mizrita kareni, tAdera janyei zAnti evaM tArAi hidAYAtaprApta|
eTi chila AmAra pramANa, yA Ami ivarAhImake tA~ra sampradAYera vipakSe pradAna karechilAma| Ami yAke icchA maryAdAYa samunnata kari| nizcaYa tomAra rava prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|

Ami tAke dAna karechi isahAka evaM iYA‘kUva| pratyekakei Ami hidAYAta dAna karechi evaM pUrve Ami nUhake hidAYAta dAna karechi, tA~ra santAnadera madhye dAUda, sulAimAna, AiYUva, iusupha, mUsA o hArUnake| ebhAve Ami ni SThAvAna satkarmazIladera pratidAna diYe thAki|
Arao yAkAriYA, iYAhaiYA, IsA evaM ilaYAsake| tArA savAi puNyavAnadera antarbhukta chila|
evaM isamAIla, iYAsA, iunusa, lUta—pratyekakei Ami sArA vizvera opara zreSThatva dAna karechi|
Arao tAdera kichu saMkhyaka pitRpuruSa, santAna-santati o bhAiderake maneAnIta karechi evaM sarala pathera dike hidAYAta di Yechi|
eTi AllAhara hidAYAta| svIYa vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA, hidAYAta dena| yadi tArA ziraka karata, tave tAdera kAja karma tAdera janye vyartha haYe yeta|
tAderakei Ami kitAva, zariYata o navuoYAta dAna karechi| ataeva, yadi erA ApanAra navuoYAta asvIkAra kare, tave era janya emana sampradAYa nirdiSTa karava, yArA ete avizvAsI have nA|
erAi tArA, yAderake AllAha hidAYAta dAna karechena| ataeva, tumio tAdera patha anusaraNa karo| valo, Ami teAmAdera kAche era janya keAno pratidAna cAi nA| eTi vizvajagatera janya ekaTi upadezamAtra|

tArA AllAhara yathArtha maryAdA upalavdhi kareni yakhana tArA valeche, AllAha mAnuSera prati keAno kichu avatIrNa karenani| valo, oi kitAva ke avatIrNa kareche, yA mUsA niYe esechila, mAnavajAtira janya Alo o hidAYAtasvarUpa, yA teAmarA kAgajasamUhe rekhe leAkadera janye prakAza karo evaM aneka aMzake geApana karo| teAmAderake emana aneka viSaYa zikSA deoYA haYeche, yA teAmarA evaM teAmAdera pUrvapuruSarA jAnate nA| valo, ‘AllAhai avatIrNa karechena|’ ataHpara tAderake cher3e dAo tAdera arthahIna AlocanAra mAjhe, tArA khelate thAkuka|

eTi emana kitAva, yA Ami avatIrNa karechi; varakatamaYa, pUrvavartI kitAvasamUhera satyAYanakArI hiseve evaM yAte tumi ‘ummula kurA’ (mAkkAvAsI) o pArzvavartIderake bhItipradarzana karate pAro| yArA parakAlera prati ImAna Ane, tArA e kitAvera prati ImAna Ane evaM sAlAtera hiphAjata kare|

oi vyaktira cAite var3a yAlima ke Ache, ye AllAhara prati mithyAreApa kare athavA vale, AmAra prati oYAhi avatIrNa haYeche| athaca tAra prati keAno oYAhi Aseni evaM ye dAvi kare ye, Amio avatIrNa kare dekhAcchi yemana AllAha avatIrNa karechena| Ara yadi tumi dekhate yakhana sImAlaGghanakArIrA mRtyuyantraNAYa thAke evaM pherezatArA svIYa hasta prasArita kare vale, vera karo svIYa AtmA! Ajai teAmAderake avamAnanAkara zAsti pradAna karA have| kAraNa, teAmarA AllAhara opara asatya valate evaM tA~ra AYAtasamUhera vyApAre ahaMkAra karate|

teAmarA AmAra kAche ekAkI Asave, yemana Ami prathamavAra teAmAderake sRSTi karechi| Ami teAmAderake yA diYechi, tA pe chanei rekhe esecha| Ami teA teAmAdera sAthe teAmAdera supArizakArIdera dekhachi nA| yAdera samparke teAmAdera dAvi chila ye, tArA teAmAdera vyApAre aMzIdAra| avazyai teAmAdera parasparera samparka chinna haYe geche evaM teAmAdera dhAraNA udhAo haYe geche|
nizcaYai AllAhai vIja o dAnA vidIrNakArI; tini jIvitake mRta theke vera karena o mRtake jIvita theke vera karena| tinii AllAha; ataeva, teAmarA keAthAYa vibhrAnta haccha?
tini prabhAta udbhAsita karena| tini rAtake karechena prazAnti evaM sUrya o candrake hisAva nirUpaka| eTi parAkramazAlI, mahAjJAnIra nirdhAraNa|
tinii teAmAdera janya tArAsamUha sRSTi karechena; yAte teAmarA sthale o jale andhakAre pathera dizA pAo| nizcaYai yArA jJAnI tAdera janye Ami nidarzanAvali vistArita varNanA kare diYechi|

tinii teAmAdera eka vyakti theke sRSTi karechena| anantara ekaTi hacche teAmAdera sthAYI ThikAnA o ekaTi hacche gacchita sthala| nizcaYai Ami pramANAdi vistAritabhAve varNanA kare diYechi tAdera janye, yArA cintA kare|

tinii AkAza theke vAri varSaNa karena ataHpara Ami tA dvArA sarvaprakAra udbhida utpanna karechi, ataHpara Ami tA theke savuja phasala nirgata karechi, yA theke yugma vIja utpanna kari| khejurera kA~di theke guccha vera kari, yA jhulanta thAke evaM AGurera vAgAna, jaYatuna, AnAra paraspara sAdRzyayukta evaM sAdRzyahIna| vibhinna gAchera phalera prati lakSa karo yakhana seguleA phalanta haYa evaM tA paripakva haYa| nizcaYai eguleAte nidarzana raYeche muminadera janya|
tArA jinaderake AllAhara aMzIdAra sthira kare; athaca tAderake tinii sRSTi karechena| tArA ajJatAvazata AllAhara putra o kanyA sAvyasta kare| tini pavitra o samunnata, tAdera varNanA theke|
tini nabheAmaNDala o bhUmaNDalera upamAvihIna sraSTA| kIrUpe AllAhara putra hate pAre, athaca tA~ra keAno saGgI nei! tini savakichu sRSTi karechena| tini sarva viSaYe jJAta|
tinii AllAha teAmAdera rava| tini vyatIta keAno upAsya nei| tinii savakichura sraSTA| ataeva, teAmarA tA~rai ivAdata karo| tini pratyeka vastura tattvAvadhAYaka|
dRSTisamUha tA~ke AYatta karate pAre nA, avazya tini sakala dRSTike AYatta karena| tini atyanta sUkSmadarzI, samyaka jJAta|
avazyai teAmAdera kAche ravera pakSa theke cAkSuSapramANa eseche| ataeva, ye pratyakSa karave, se nijerai upakAra karave evaM ye andha have, se nijerai kSati karave| Ami teAmAdera nai| saMrakSaka
ebhAve Ami nidarzanAvali ghuriYe-phiriYe varNanA kari, yAte tArA nA vale ye, tumi to eTA zikSA grahaNa karecha evaM yena Ami vivaraNa dii jJAnI lokadera janya|
tomAra ravera pakSa theke avatIrNa vANIra anusaraNa karo| tini vyatIta keAno ilAha nei| tumi muzarikadera upekSA karo|
yadi AllAha cAitena tave tArA ziraka karata nA| Ami tomAke tAdera saMrakSaka karini Ara tumi tAdera tattvAvadhAYakao nao|

AllAha vyatIta tArA yAdera upAsanA kare teAmarA tAderake gAli diYo nA, tAhale tArA sImAlaGghana kare ajJatAvazata AllAhake gAli deve| emanibhAve Ami pratyeka sampradAYera dRSTite svIYa kAjakarma suzeAbhita kare diYechi| ataHpara svIYa ravera kAche tAderake pratyAvartana karate have| takhana tini tAderake jAniYe devena yA kichu tArA karate chila|

tArA dRr3habhAve AllAhara nAme zapatha kare vale, yadi tAdera kAche keAno nidarzana Ase tave avazyai tArA ImAna Anave| valo, mUlata nidarzanAvali teA AllAhara kAche| Ara kI diYe tomAdera vojhAno yAve ye, yakhana tA Asave, takhana tArA ImAna Anave nA?
Ami phiriYe deva tAdera antara o dRSTisamUhake, yemana tArA era prati prathamavAra ImAna Aneni evaM Ami tAderake cher3e deva tAdera avAdhyatAYa, tArA udbhrAnta haYe ghure ver3Ave|

Ara Ami yadi tAdera kAche pherezatAderake avataraNa karAtAma, Ara tAdera sAthe mRtarA kathA valata evaM Ami sava vastuke tAdera sAmane ekatra karatAma, tavuo tArA ImAna Anata nA; tave yadi AllAha cAna; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai mUrkhatA prakAza karave |

emanibhAve Ami pratyeka navira janya zatru karechi mAnuSa o jinadera theke zaYatAnaderake| tArA dheA~kA deoYAra janye eke aparake cAkacikyamaYa kathA dvArA uskAni dite thAke| yadi tomAra rava cAitena, tave tArA e kAja karata nA; ataeva, tumi tAderake evaM tAdera mithyAropake parityAga karo|
yAte caturatAYa sAjAno vAkyera prati tAdera mana AkRSTa haYa, yArA parakAlera prati ImAna Ane nA| evaM tArA yena era oparao santuSTa thAke, evaM oisava apakarma kare, yA tArA ekhana karache|

tave ki Ami AllAha vyatIta a nya keAno vicAraka anusandhAna karava? athaca tinii teAmAdera prati vistArita kitAva avatIrNa karechena! Ara Ami yAderake kitAva pradAna karechi, tArA nizcita jAne ye, eTi tomAra prati ravera pakSa theke satyasaha avatIrNa haYeche| ataeva, tumi saMzaYavAdIdera antarbhukta haYo nA|
tomAra ravera kAlimA satyatA o suSamAYa pUrNatA lAbha kareche| tA~ra kAlimAra keAno parivartanakArI nei| tinii sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
Ara yadi tumi pRthivIra adhikAMza leAkera kathA mene nAo, tave tArA tomAke AllAhara patha theke vicyuta kare deve| tArA zudhu alIka kalpanAra anusaraNa kare evaM sampUrNa anumAnai kare|
nizcaYai tomAra rava tAdera samparke samyaka jJAta, yArA tA~ra patha theke vibhrAnta haYa evaM tini tAderakeo khuva bhAlo kare jAnena, yArA tA~ra hidAYAtera anusaraNa kare|
ataeva ye jantura opara AllAhara nAma uccArita haYa, tA theke bhakSaNa karo yadi teAmarA tA~ra vidhAnasamUhe vizvAsI hao|

tomAdera kI halo ye, tomarA AhAra karacho nA tA, yAte AllAhara nAma uccArita haYeche, athaca tini vizada vivaraNa diYechena, yeguleAke teAmAdera janya hArAma karechena; tave teAmarA khete nirupAYa haYe par3a| avazyai ajJatAvazata tAdera kheYAlakhuzi dvArA anekake pathabhraSTa kare; nizcaYai tomAra rava sImAlaGghanakArIdera vyApAre samyaka jJAta|
teAmarA prakAzya o aprakAzya pApa parityAga karo| nizcaYai yArA pApa karave, tAderake acirei pratidAna deoYA have ekAraNe ye, tArA kukarma karata|

yesava jantura opara AllAhara nAma uccArita haYa nA, seguleA kheYo nA; nizcaYai eTA pApera kAja| Ara zaYatAnarA tAdera vandhuderake uskAni deYa, yena tArA teAmAdera sAthe tarka kare| yadi teAmarA tAdera Anugatya karo; tave avazyai teAmarAo muzarika|

Ara emana vyakti—ye mRta chila, ataHpara Ami tAke jIvita karechi evaM tAke emana ekaTi AleA diYechi, yA niYe se mAnuSera madhye calApherA kare; se ki oi vyaktira mato—ye andhakArasamUhe raYeche, sekhAna theke se vera havAra naYa? emanibhAve kApheradera janya suzeAbhita kare deoYA haYeche yA tArA kare|
Ara emanibhAve Ami pratyeka janapade var3a var3a aparAdhIderake niyukta karechi, yena tArA sekhAne cakrAnta kare; kintu tArA nijedera viruddhei cakrAnta kare; athaca tArA tA upalavdhi karate pAre nA|

yakhana tAdera kAche keAno nidarzana pau~che, takhana vale, ‘AmarA kakhano ImAna Anava nA, yatakSaNa nA AmAderake deoYA have, yA AllAhara rAsUlagaNake deoYA haYeche|’ AllAha tA~ra risAlAtera dAYitva keAthAYa arpaNa karavena tinii bhAlo jAnena| acirei tAdera nikaTa pau~chAno have lAJchanA o kaTheAra zAsti yArA aparAdha kareche, ekAraNe ye tArA cakrAnta karata|

ataHpara AllAha yAke hidAYAta dAna karate cAna, tAra vakSake isalAmera janye ummukta kare dena evaM yAke vipathagAmI karate cAna, tAra vakSake saMkIrNa-saMkucita kare dena, yena se AkAze AreAhaNa karache| emanibhAve yArA ImAna Ane nA, AllAha tAderake zAsti dena|
Ara eTAi tomAra ravera sarala patha| Ami upadeza grahaNakArIdera janya nidarzanasamUha vistArita varNanA karechi|
tAdera janyai raYeche tAdera ravera nikaTa zAnti nivAsa| evaM tini tAdera abhibhAvaka ekAraNe ye, tArA yA karachila|

sedina tini sakalake ekatra karavena evaM valavena, he jina sampradAYa, nizcaYa teAmarA aneka mAnuSake tomAdera anugAmI karecho| tAdera mAnava-vandhurA valave, he AmAdera rava, AmAdera madhye kataka katakera dvArA lAbhavAna haYechi| Apani AmAdera janye ye samaYa nirdhAraNa karechilena, AmarA tAte upanIta haYechi| AllAha valavena, Aguna halo teAmAdera vAsasthAna| sekhAne teAmarA sthAYI; tave AllAha yA cAna| nizcaYai tomAra rava prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
emanibhAve Ami yAlimaderake eke aparera opara kartRtvazIla vAnAva tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe|

he jina o mAnava sampradAYa, teAmAdera kAche ki teAmAdera madhya theke rAsUlagaNa Agamana kareni, yArA teAmAderake AmAra vidhAnAvali varNanA karata evaM teAmAderake Ajakera e dinera sAkSAtera vyApAre satarka karata? tArA valave, AmarA sAkSya dicchi nijedera viruddhe| vastuta pArthiva-jIvana tAderake pratArita kareche| tArA nijedera viruddhe sAkSya deve ye, nizcaYai tArA kAphira chila|
eTA ejanya ye, tomAra rava keAno janapadera adhivAsIderake sImAlaGghanera kAraNe dhvaMsa karena nA ematAvasthAYa ye, sekhAnakAra adhivAsIrA anavahita|
pratyekera janya raYeche tArA ye karma kareche se anupAte maryAdA evaM tomAra rava tAdera karma samparke vekhavara nana|

tomAra rava amukhApekSI, asIma daYAmaYa| yadi tini icchA karena tave teAmAdera sakalake apasArita karavena evaM teAmAdera para yAke icchA teAmAdera sthalAbhiSikta karavena; yemana teAmAderake anya sampradAYera vaMzadhara theke sRSTi karechena|
nizcaYai ye pratizruti teAmAderake deoYA hacche, tA Asavei evaM teAmarA akSama karate pArave nA|

valo, he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA sva sva sthAne tomAdera Amala kare yAo, nizcaYai Amio kAja karachi| acirei jAnate pArave ye, kAra parakAla have kalyANamaYa| nizcaYai sImAlaGghanakArIrA saphala have nA|

AllAha yesava zasyakSetra o gavAdipazu sRSTi karechena, seguleA theke tArA eka aMza AllAhara janya nirdhAraNa kare ataHpara nija dhAraNA anusAre vale eTA AllAhara evaM eTA AmAdera zarikadera (upAsyadera) janya| ataeva yA tAdera zarikadera janya, tA AllAhara nikaTa pau~che nA varaM yA AllAhara tA tAdera upAsyadera dike pau~chAYa, katai nA nikRSTa tAdera phAYasAlA yA tArA kare|

emanibhAve aneka muzarikera dRSTite tAdera upAsyarA tAdera santAna hatyAke suzeAbhita kare diYeche, yena tArA tAderake vinaSTa kare deYa evaM tAdera dharmamatake tAdera kAche vibhrAnta kare deYa| yadi AllAha cAitena, tave tArA e kAja karata nA| ataeva, tumi tAderake evaM tAdera mithyA racanAke parityAga karo|

tArA tAdera dhAraNA anusAre valeche, e gavAdipazugulo o zasyakSeta surakSita| AmarA yAke cAi, se vyatIta eguleA keu khete pArave nA| Ara kichu gavAdipazura piThe AreAhaNa hArAma karA haYeche evaM kichu gavAdipazura opara tArA AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kare nA, tAdera mithyA racanAra kAraNe, acirei tini tAderake zAsti devena, ekAraNe ye, tArA mithyA racanA karata|

Ara tArA valeche, esava gavAdipazura peTe yA Ache, tA vizeSabhAve AmAdera puruSadera janya, AmAdera mahilAdera janya tA hArAma| yadi tA mRta haYa, tave tArA tAra mAjhe aMzIdAra have| acirei tini tAderake tAdera varNanAra zAsti devena| tini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|

nizcaYai tArA kSatigrasta haYeche, yArA nija santAnaderake nirvuddhitAvazata hatyA kareche evaM AllAha tAderake ye riyika diYechena, seguleAke tArA hArAma kare niYeche AllAhara prati mithyA racanA kare| nizcaYai tArA pathabhraSTa haYeche evaM tArA supathagAmI chila nA|

tinii udyAnasamUha sRSTi karechena, mAcAviziSTa, evaM mAcAvihIna| evaM khejuragAcha o zasyAdi yA vibhinna svAdaviziSTa evaM yAituna o AnAra sRSTi karechena, eke anyera sAdRzyazIla evaM sAdRzyahIna| eguleAra phala khAo, yakhana phalavAna haYa evaM phasala kATAra samaYe tAra haka pradAna karo| Ara apavyaYa kareA nA| nizcaYai tini apavyaYIderake bhAlovAsena nA|

Ara gavAdipazura madhye kichu veAjhA vahanakArI evaM kichu vichAnAra janya| AllAha teAmAderake ye riyika diYechena, tA theke khAo| zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa kareA nA, nizcaYa se teAmAdera prakAzya zatru|

ATa jor3A nara-mAdI| meSa dui prakAra o chAgalera madhye dui prakAra| valo, tini ki ubhaYa nara hArAma karechena, nAki ubhaYa mAdIke? nAki yA ubhaYa mAdIra peTe Ache? teAmarA AmAke jJAna dvArA avagata karo, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao|

uTera madhye dui jor3A evaM garura madhye dui jor3A| valo, tini ki ubhaYa nara hArAma karechena, nA ubhaYa mAdIke, nAki yA ubhaYa mAdIra peTe yA Ache? teAmarA ki upasthita chile, yakhana AllAha era nirdeza diYechilena? ataeva, se vyakti apekSA vezi sImAlaGghanakArI Ara ke, ye AllAha samparke mithyA racanA kare, yAte kare mAnuSake pathabhraSTa karate pAre ajJAtasAre, nizcaYai AllAha sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYake hidAYAta dAna karena nA|

valo, ye vidhAna oYAhi ra mAdhyame AmAra kAche pau~cheche, tAra madhye AhArakArIra janya Ami hArAma hiseve kono khAdya pAi nA—yA se AhAra kare; tave mRta, pravAhita rakta athavA zUkarera mAMsa| nizcaYa eTA apavitra, athavA AllAha chAr3A anyera janya (javAira samaYa) utsargera kAraNe avaidha; kintu ye bhakSaNa kare apAraga haYe, avAdhyatA evaM sImAlaGghana nA kare| tave tomAra rava kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

iYAhU didera janya Ami pratyeka nakhaviziSTa jantu hArAma karechi evaM chAgala o garura carvi tAdera janye hArAma karechi, tave piThera vA antre saMyukta athavA hAr3era sAthe milita carvi vyatIta| tAdera avAdhyatAra kAraNe Ami tAderake e zAsti diYechi| Ara nizcaYa Ami satyavAdI|
ataeva, tArA yadi tomAke mithyavAdI vale, tave valo, teAmAdera rava suprazasta karuNAra adhikArI| tA~ra zAsti aparAdhIdera opara theke pherAno have nA|

acirei muzarikarA valave, yadi AllAha icchA karatena, tave AmarA ziraka karatAma nA, evaM AmAdera vApa-dAdArAo nA evaM AmarA keAno vastuke hArAma karatAma nA| emanibhAve tAdera pUrvavartIrA mithyAreApa kareche, phale tArA AmAra zAstio AsvAdana kareche| valo, teAmAdera kAche ki keAno pramANa Ache yA AmAdera peza karave| teAmarA zudhu AndAjera anusaraNa karo evaM teAmarA anumAna kare kathA valeA|
valo, paripUrNa yukti AllAharai| tini icchA karale teAmAdera savAike hidAYAta dAna karatena|

valo, teAmAdera sAkSIdera niYe Aso, yArA sAkSya deYa ye, nizcaYa AllAha eTAke hArAma karechena| tArA yadio sAkSya deYa, tave tumi tAdera sAthe sAkSya diYo nA evaM tAdera kupravRttira anusaraNa karo nA, yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalike mithyA vale, yArA parakAle ImAna Ane nA evaM yArA svIYa ravera samakakSa sAvyasta kare|

valo, eso, Ami teAmAderake pATha kare zonAi, yeguleA teAmAdera rava teAmAdera janye hArAma karechena| tA ei ye, AllAhara sAthe kAuke zarika kareA nA, pitAmAtAra sAthe sadaYa vyavahAra kareA, santAnaderake dAridryera bhaYe hatyA kareA nA, Ami teAmAderake o tAderake AhAra dii, azlIlatAra kAcheo yeYeA nA, prakAzya heAka kiMvA aprakAzya| AllAha yAke hatyA karA hArAma karechena, tAke hatyA kareA nA; kintu nyAYasaGgata kAraNe| teAmAderake e nirdeza diYechena, yena teAmarA anudhAvana karate pAro|

iYAtImadera dhanasampadera kAcheo yeYeA nA; tave uttama panthAYa, yatakSaNa nA tArA prAptavaYaske pau~chAYa| tomarA nyAYaniSThAra sAthe ojana o mApa pUrNa karo| Ami kAro opara sAdhyAtIta kichu cApiYe dii nA| yakhana teAmarA kathA valo, takhana suvicAra karo, yadio se nikaTatmIYa haYa| AllAhara sAthe kRta aGgIkAra pUrNa karo, teAmAderake e nirdeza diYechena, yena teAmarA upadeza grahaNa karo|

nizcaYai eTi AmAra sarala-saThika patha; ataeva, tomarA tA anusaraNa karo evaM anyAnya pathe caleA nA| tA hale tomarA tA~ra patha theke vicchinna haYe yAve| teAmAderake e nirdeza diYechena, yAte teAmarA saMyata hao|

ataHpara Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechi, satkarmazIladera prati neYAmata pUrNa karAra janya, o pratyeka vastura vizada vivaraNa, hidAYAta evaM karuNA, yAte tArA svIYa ravera sAthe sAkSAtera prati ImAna Ane|
Ara Ami ei kitAva avatIrNa karechi, yA varakatamaYa| varakatamaYa| ataeva, tomarA tAra anusaraNa karo evaM bhaYa karo, yAte teAmarA karuNAprApta hao|
athavA yAte tomarA nA valate pAro ye, kitAva teA kevala AmAdera pUrvavartI du-sampradAYera pratii avatIrNa karA haYeche evaM AmarA seguleAra pATha o paThana samparke kichui jAnatAma nA|

athavA nA valate pAro, yadi AmAdera prati keAno kitAva avatIrNa karA hato, AmarA edera cAite adhika hidAYAta petAma| ataeva, teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke teAmAdera kAche suSpaSTa pramANa, hidAYAta o rahamAta ese geche| ataHpara se vyaktira cAite adhika sImAlaGghanakArI Ara ke have, ye AllAhara AYAtasamUhake mithyA vale evaM gA vA~ciYe cale| acirei Ami tAderake zAsti deva, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha theke vimukha haYechila, jaghanya zAsti tAdera vimukhatAra kAraNe|

tArA zudhu e viSaYera dike ceYe Ache ye, tAdera kAche pherezatAgaNa Agamana karave vA tomAra rava Agamana karavena athavA tomAra ravera keAno nidarzanAvalI Asave| yedina tomAra ravera keAno nidarzana Asave, sedina keAno vyaktira ImAna tAra janye phalaprasU have nA, ye pUrva theke ImAna Aneni vA svIYa ImAna anuyAYI keAnorUpa satkarma kareni| valo, teAmarA apekSA karo, nizcaYa AmarAo apekSAYa railAma|

nizcaYai yArA svIYa dharmake khaNDa-vikhaNDa kareche evaM tArA vahu dale vibhakta haYeche, tAdera sAthe tomAra keAno samparka nei| tAdera vyApAra AllAhara nikaTa samarpita| ataHpara tini tAdera avagata karavena yA tArA karachila|
ye ekaTi satkarma karave, se tAra dazaguNa pAve evaM ye, ekaTi manda kAja karave, se tAra samAna zAstii pAve| Ara tAdera prati avicAra karA have nA|
valo, ‘AmAra rava AmAke sarala-saThika pathe ivarAhImera ekaniSTha pratiSThita Ardaza dharmera prati hidAYAta dAna karechena| se muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA|’
valo, AmAra sAlAta, AmAra kuravAni evaM AmAra jIvana AmAra maraNa vizvera rava AllAharai janya|
tA~ra keAno zarika nei| Ara erai Adeza AmAke deoYA haYeche, evaM Ami prathama musalima|

valo, Ami ki AllAha vyatIta anya ravera kAmanA karava, athaca tinii savakichura rava? pratyeka vyakti yA upArjana kare, tAra dAYabhAra tAderai vahana karate have| keu aparera veAjhA vahana karave nA| ataHpara teAmAdera savAike ravera kAche pratyAvartana karate have| ataHpara tini teAmAderake vale devena, yesava viSaYe teA marA vireAdha karate|

tinii oi sattvA, yini teAmAderake pRthivIte pratinidhi karechena evaM ekajanake Arekajanera opara maryAdA samunnata karechena, yAte teAmAderake sesava viSaYe parIkSA karena, yA tini tomAderake diYechena| tomAra rava druta zAstidAtA evaM atyanta kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
Alipha, lAma, mIma, soYAda|
emana kitAva, yA tomAra prati avatIrNa karA haYeche, sutarAM yena tAra sarmpake tomAra mane kono saMkIrNatA nA haYa| yena tumi era mAdhyame satarka karate pAro | Ara tA muminadera janya upadeza|

teAmarA anusaraNa karo, yA teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke tomAdera prati avatIrNa karA haYeche evaM tomarA tAke chAr3A anya abhibhAvakera anusaraNa kareA nA, Ara teAmarA khuva alpai upadeza grahaNa karo|
kata janapada Ami dhvaMsa karechi| tAdera kAche AmAra zAsti rAtera velA ghumanta avasthAYa pau~cheche athavA dviprahare vizrAmarata avasthAYa|
yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra zAsti upasthita haYa, takhana tAdera dAvi ei chila ye, tArA valata, nizcaYa AmarA sImAlaGghanakArI chilAma|
ataeva, Ami avazyai tAderake jijJesa karava, yAdera kAche rAsUla prerita haYechila evaM Ami avazyai rAsUladerake jijJesa karava|
ataHpara Ami svajJAne tAdera kAche avasthA varNanA karava, Ara nizcaYai Ami anupasthita chilAma nA|
Ara sedina yathArtha have parimApa| ataHpara yAdera pAllA bhArI have, tArAi saphalakAma|
evaM yAdera pAllA hAlkA have, tArA oi sava loka, yArA nijedera kSati kareche, ekAraNe ye, tArA AmAra AYAtasamUhara sAthe sImAlaGghana karata|
Ami teAmAderake pRthivIte pratiSThita karechi evaM tomAdera janya tAra madhya theke jIvikAra vyavasthA karechi| teAmarA alpai kRtajJatA svIkAra karo|

Ara avazyai Ami teAmAdera sRSTi karechi, ataHpara AkRti dAna karechi| ataHpara Ami pherezatAdera valechi, ‘tomarA Adamake sijadAha karo; takhana ivalIsa vyatIta savAi sijadAha karala, se sijadAhakArIdera antarbhukta chila nA|

tini valalena, kIse tomAke vAdhA dila ye tumi sijadAha karale nA, yakhana Ami tomAke nirdeza diYechi?’ se valala, ‘Ami tAra apekSA zreSTha| Apani AmAke Aguna dvArA sRSTi karechena evaM tAke sRSTi karechena mATi dvArA|’
tini valalena, ‘tumi ekhAna theke neme yAo| ekhAne tomAra ahaMkAra karAra keAno adhikAra nei| ataeva, tumi vera haYe yAo| nizcaYa tumi adhamadera antarbhukta|’
se valala, ‘AmAke punarutthAna divasa paryanta avakAza dina|’
tini valalena, ‘nizcaYa tumi avakAzaprAptadera antarbhukta|’
ataHpara se valala, ‘ye kAraNe Apani AmAke pathabhraSTa karechena, Amio avazyai tAdera janye ApanAra sarala-saThika pathe vasavo|’
erapara avazyai Ami tAdera kAche Asava tAdera sAmanera dika theke, pechana dika theke, DAna dika theke evaM vAma dika theke| Apani tAdera adhikAMzake akRtajJa pAvena|’
tini valalena, ‘vera haYe yAo ekhAna theke lAJchita o vitAr3ita haYe| avazyai tAdera ye keu tomAke anusaraNa karave, avazyai Ami tomAdera sakalera dvArA jAhAnnAma pUrNa karavo|’
he Adama, tumi evaM teAmAra strI jAnnAte vasavAsa karo| ataHpara sekhAna theke yA icchA, khAo; tave e gAchera nikaTavartI haYo nA tA hale teAmarA sImAlaGghanakArIdera antarbhukta haYe yAve|

ataHpara zaYatAna ubhaYake kumantraNA dila, yena tAdera ubhaYera ye lajjAsthAna tAdera theke gopana rAkhA haYechila, tA tArA parasparera sAmane prakAza kare deYa| se valala, ‘teAmAdera rava teAmAderake e vRkSa theke niSedha karechena zudhu e kAraNe ye, teAmarA nA AvAra pherezatA haYe yAo, athavA tomarA dujane have cirasthAYIdera arntabhukta|’
se tAdera kAche zapatha kare valala, ‘Ami avazyai teAmAdera hitAkAGkSI|

ataHpara se ubhaYake adhaHpatita karala tAra pratAraNA dvArA| phale yakhana tArA sei gAchera svAda AsvAdana karala, takhana tAdera lajjAsthAna tAdera sAmane prakAza peYe gela evaM tArA jAnnAtera pAtA dvArA nijedera AvRta karate lAgala| tAdera rava tAderake Deke valalena, Ami ki teAmAdera e vRkSa theke niSedha karini? evaM tomAdera valini ye, nizcaYa zaYatAna teAmAdera prakAzya zatru |

tArA ubhaYe valala, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA nijedera prati avicAra karechi| yadi Apani AmAdera kSamA nA karena evaM AmAdera prati anugraha nA karena, tave AmarA avazyai kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe yAva|’
tini valalena, ‘neme yAo| teAmarA eke aparera zatrurUpe| teAmAdera janya pR thivIte vAsasthAna evaM bhoga-sAmagrI nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta|’
tini valalena, ‘teAmarA sekhAne jIvana yApana karave, sekhAnei mRtyuvaraNa karave evaM sekhAna thekei tomAderake vera karA have|

he vani Adama, Ami teAmAdera janya peAzAka avatIrNa karechi, yA teAmAdera lajjAsthAna AvRta kare evaM saundaryasvarUpa evaM tAkaoYAra peAzAka, eTi sarveAttama| eTi AllAhara nidarzanera anyatama, sambhavata tArA upadezagrahaNa karave|

he vani Adama, zaYatAna yena teAmAdera vibhrAnta nA kare; yebhAve se teAmAdera pitA-mAtAke jAnnAta theke vera kare diYeche ematAvasthAYa ye, tAdera peAzAka tAdera theke khule phele, tAdera dujanake tAdera lajjAsthAna dekhAnora janya| nizcaYa se evaM tAra dalavala teAmAdera dekhe, emanabhAve ye teAmarA tAdera dekho nA| Ami zaYatAnadera tAdera abhibhAvaka vAniYe diYechi, yArA ImAna Ane nA|

yakhana tArA keAno azlIla kAja kare, takhana vale AmarA vApa-dAdAke emanai karate peYechi evaM AllAhao AmAderake tAra nirdeza diYechena| valo, AllAha azlIlatAra Adeza dena nA| tomarA ki AllAhara vyApAre emana kathA valo—yA teAmarA jAno nA|

valo, AmAra rava nyAYavicArera nirdeza diYechena| Ara teAmarA pratyeka sAlAtera samaYa tomAdera cehArA sthira rAkho| evaM tArai Anugatyera janya tAke ekaniSThabhAve DAko| teAmAdera prathame yemana sRSTi karechena, tomarA temanibhAve phire Asave|

ekadalake hi dAYAta dAna karechena evaM aparadalera janye pathabhraSTatA avadhArita haYeche| nizcaYa tArA AllAhake cher3e zaYatAnadera abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kareche evaM dhAraNA kare ye, tArA saThikapathaprApta|
he vani Adama, teAmarA pratyeka sAlAtera samaYa sajjita pozAka paridhAna karo, Ara pAnAhAra karo, kintu apavyaYa kareA nA| nizcaYa tini apavyaYIdera pachanda karena nA|

valo, AllAha kartRka zobhAra vastuke—yA tini svIYa vAndAra janya vera karechena Ara jIvikA hate pavitravastusamUhake ke hArAma kareche? valo, esava niYAmAta muminadera janya pArthiva-jIvane evaM kiYAmAtera dina vizeSabhAve tAderai janya| ebhAve Ami nirdazanasamUha vistArita varNanA kari jJAnI sampradAYera janya|

valo, AmAra rava prakAzya o gopana azlIlatA hArAma karechena, Ara pApa, anyAYabhAve vidroha, evaM tomarA AllAhara sAthe emana vastuke zarika karA, yAra keAno pramANa tini avatIrNa karenani evaM AllAhara prati emana kathA AreApa karA, yA teAmarA jAno nA|
pratyeka jAtIra janya ekaTi nirdhArita samaYa raYeche| yakhana tAdera nirdhArita kSaNa ese yAve, takhana tArA nA eka muhUrta deri karate pArave, Ara nA egiYe nite pArave|

he vani Adama, yadi teAmAdera kAche teAmAderai madhya theke rAsUlagaNa Agamana kare teAmAderake AmAra AYAtasamUha zonAYa, tave ye tAkaoYA avalamvana karave evaM saMzodhana karave, tAdera keAno bhaYa nei evaM tArA cintitao have nA|
yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kareche evaM tA theke ahaMkAra kareche, tArAi jAhAnnAmera AdhivAsI evaM tArA sekhAne sthAYI|
