oi vyaktira apekSA adhika sImAlaGghanakArI ke, ye AllAhara prati mithyAreApa kare athavA tAra nirdazanAvalike mithyA pratipanna kare? oisava loka tAdera nikaTa pau~chave tAdera kitAvera nirdhArita aMza| zeSa payarnta yakhana tAdera nikaTa Asave AmAra pherezatArA tAdera prANa haraNa karate, takhana tArA valave, tArA keAthAYa gela, AllAha vyatIta yAderake teAmarA AhvAna karate? tArA valave, AmAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe geche, tArA nijedera viruddhe sAkSya deve ye, tArA avazyai kAphira chila|

tini valavena, tomAdera pUrve jina o mAnavajAtira yArA atIta haYeche teAmarA tAdera sAthe jAhAnnAme praveza karo| yakhanai praveza karave kono dala, takhana anyadalake abhizApa deve| avazeSe yakhana tAra madhye sakalake peYe yAve takhana paravartIrA pUrvavartIdera samparke valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, tArAi AmAdera pathabhraSTa kareche| ataeva, Apani tAdera jAhAnnAmera dviguNa zAsti dena|’ tini valavena ‘pratyekei dviguNa pAve; kintu teAmarA jAno nA|’
pUrvavartIrA paravartIdera valave, ‘AmAdera opara teAmAdera keAno zreSThatva chila nA| ataeva, nijedera karmera kAraNe zAsti bhoga karo|

nizcaYai yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kareche evaM eguleA theke ahaMkAra kareche, tAdera janya AkAzera dvAra unmukta karA have nA evaM tArA jAnnAte praveza karave nA| yatakSaNa nA sU~cera chidra diYe uTa praveza karave| emanibhAve Ami pApIdera zAsti pradAna kari|
tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera agnizayyA evaM opara theke AcchAdanasamUha| ebhAvei Ami sImAlaGghanakArIdera zAsti pradAna kari|
evaM yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche Ami kAuke tAra sAmarthyera cAite vezi veAjhA cApiYe dii nA| tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI| tArA sekhAne sthAYI|

Ara tAdera antare ye IrSA chila, Ami tA vera kare diYechi| tAdera taladeza diYe pravAhita have nada-nadI| tArA valave, sakala prazaMsA AllAhara janya, yini AmAdera era janya hidAYAta diYechena| AmarA kakhano hidAYAta petAma nA, yadi AllAha AmAdera hidAYAta nA karatena| nizcaYai AmAdera ravera rAsUlagaNa satyasaha esechilena; evaM tAderake Deke valA have ye ei sei jAnnAta tomAdera tAra uttarAdhikArI karA haYeche ekAraNe ye, tomarA yA karate|

jAnnAtirA jAhAnnAmidera Deke valave ye, ‘nizcaYa AmAdera sAthe AmAdera rava ye pratizruti diYechilena, tA yathAyathabhAve peYechi? teAmarAo ki teAmAdera ravera pratizruti yathAyatha bhAve peYecho? takhana tArA valave, ‘hyA~| ataHpara ekajana gheASaka ubhaYera mAjhakhAne gheASaNA karave, AllAhara lA’nata sImAlaGghanakArIdera opara|
yArA AllAhara pathe vAdhA dita evaM tAte vakratA anveSaNa karata| tArA chila parakAle avizvAsI|

ubhaYera mAjhakhAne ekaTi pardA thAkave evaM ArAphe kichu leAka thAkave, tArA pratyekake tAdera cihna dvArA cinave| tArA jAnnAtidera Deke valave, teAmAdera opara zAnti varSita heAka| tArA tAte praveza kareni, tave tArA AzAvAdI|
yakhana tAdera dRSTi jAhAnnAmidera dike pherAno have, takhana tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAdera e sImAlaGghanakArIdera sAthi kareA nA|
ArAphavAsI yAderake tAdera cihna dvArA cinave, tAderake Deke valave, teAmAdera dalavala o auddhatya teAmAdera keAno kAje Aseni|

erA ki tArAi; yAdera samparke teAmarA kasama kheYe valate ye, AllAha edera prati anugraha karavena nA? tAdera valA have, tomarA jAnnAte praveza karo| teAmAdera keAno bhaYa nei evaM teAmarA cintitao have nA|

jAhAnnAmirA jAnnAtidera Deke valave, AmAdera opara sAmAnya pAni Dhele dAo athavA AllAha teAmAdera ye rijika diYechena, tA theke kichu dAo| tArA valave, AllAha e duTi kAphiradera janye hArAma karechena|

yArA svIYa dharmake khela-tAmAzA hiseve grahaNa kareche evaM pArthiva-jIvana tAderake dheA~kAYa phele diYeche| ataeva, Ami Ajake tAderake bhule yAva; yemana tArA e dinera sAkSAtke bhule giYechila evaM yemana tArA AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karata|
Ara Ami avazai tAdera kAche emana kitAva niYe esechi, yA Ami svIYa jJAne vistArita varNanA karechi, yA mu’ minadera janye hidAYAta o rahamAta|

tArA zudhu zeSa pariNatirai apekSA karache, yedina pariNati cale Asave, pUrve yArA eke bhule giYechila, sedina tArA valave, vAstavei AmAdera ravera rAsUlagaNa satyasaha Agamana karechilena| ataeva, AmAdera janya Ache ki keAno supArizakArI? yArA AmAdera janya supAriza karave athavA AmAderake punaHrpreraNa karA have; yAte AmarA pUrve yA karatAma tAra viparIta Amala kare AsatAma| nizcaYai tArA nijedera kSatigrasta kareche| tArA managar3A yA valata, tA udhAo haYe yAve|

nizcaYai teAmAdera rava AllAha| yini AsamAna o yaminake chaYa dine sRSTi karechena| ataHpara Araze isatioYA grahaNa karechena| tini rAtake dinera opara ebhAve Acchanna karena ye, dina rAtera pechane chuTe Ase| Ara sUrya, candra o nakSatrarAjI tAra hukumera anugata| jene rekho, tArai janya sRSTi evaM Adeza| vArakAhamaYa AllAha, yini vizvajagatera rava|
teAmarA svIYa pratipAlakake DAka vinItabhAve evaM saMgeApane| tini sImAlaGghanakArIdera pachanda karena nA|
tomarA pRthivIte zRMkhalA sthApanera para tAte nairAjya sRSTi kareA nA| tAke AhvAna karo bhaYa o AzA niYe| nizcaYa AllAhara rahamata satkarmazIladera nikaTavartI|

tinii vRSTira pUrve susaMvAdasvarUpa vAYu pAThAna| emanaki yakhana vAYurAzi pAnipUrNa meghamAlA vaYe Ane, takhana Ami e meghamAlAke ekaTi mRta zaharera dike hA~kiYe dii| ataHpara e megha theke vRSTi varSaNa kari| tArapara pAni dvArA sava rakamera phala utpanna kari| emanibhAve Ami mRtadera vera kari, sambhavata teAmarA upadeza grahaNa karo|

utkRSTa bhUmi, se tAra pratipAlakera nirdeze utkRSTa udbhida utpanna kare evaM yA nikRSTa; tAte alpai phasala utpanna haYa| emanibhAve Ami AYAtasamUha ghuriYe-phiriYe varNanA kari kRtajJa sampradAYera janye|

nizcaYa Ami nUhake tAra sampradAYera kAche pAThiYechi| ataHpara se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo| tini vyatIta teAmAdera keAno ilAha nei| Ami teAmAdera janya eka mahAdivasera zAstira AzaGkA kari|
tAra sampradAYera netArA valala, ‘AmarA teAmAke prakAzya bhraSTatAra mAjhe dekhate pAcchi|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, Ami kakhano bhrAnta nai; varaM Ami vizvapratipAlakera rAsUla|’
Ami teAmAdera kAche AmAra ravera paYagAma pau~chAi evaM teAmAdera sadupadeza dii| Ami AllAhara pakSa theke emanasava viSaYa jAni, yeguleA te AmarA jAno nA|

teAmarA ki AzcaryaveAdha karacho ye, teAmAdera kAche tomAdera ravera pakSa theke upadeza eseche, teAmAdera madhya thekei ekajanera prati, yena se teAmAdera bhItipradarzana kare, evaM yAte teAmarA saMyata hao, haYato tomAdera prati anugraha karA have|

ataHpara tArA tAke mithyA pratipanna karala| phale Ami uddhAra karalAma tAke evaM tAra sAthe yArA naukAYa chila| evaM yArA AmAra AYAtake mithyAreApa karata, tAderake DuviYe dilAma| nizcaYai tArA chila eka andha sampradAYa|

‘Ada sampradAYera kAche preraNa karechi tAdera bhAi hUdake| se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo| tini vyatIta teAmAdera keAno ilAha nei|’ tavuo ki tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA|
tAra sampradAYera sardArarA valala, yArA kuphuri kareche, ‘AmarA teAmAke nirveAdha dekhate pAcchi evaM AmarA teAmAke mithyAvAdI mane kari|’
se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, Ami meATei nirveAdha nai, varaM Ami vizva pratipAlakera prerita rAsUla|
Ami teAmAdera kAche AmAra ravera vArtA pau~chAi evaM Ami teAmAdera vizvasta, hitAkAGkSI|

teAmarA ki Azcaryavodha karacha ye, teAmAdera kAche teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke upadeza eseche teAmAdera madhya thekei ekajanera prati, yAte se teAmAderake bhItipradarzana kare| teAmarA smaraNa karo, yakhana kaome nUhera para AllAha teAmAdera pratinidhi vAniYechena evaM sRSTira madhye teAmAdera AkRti o zaktite samRddha karechena| teAmarA AllAhara niYAmAtasamUha smaraNa karo, haYato tomarA saphalakAma have|

tArA valala, tumi ki AmAdera kAche ejanyei esecho ye AmarA eka AllAhara ivAdAta kari evaM AmAdera pUrva-pUruSa yAdera pujA karata tAderake varjana kari? ataeva, AmAdera kAche niYe Aso tumi—yAra pratizruti diYecho, yadi tumi satyavAdI haYe thAko|

se valala, avadhArita haYe geche teAmAdera opara teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke zAsti o kreAdha| tomarA ki AmAra sAthe emana kichu nAma niYe vitarka karacho, yAra nAmakaraNa tomarA o tomAdera pitRpuruSagaNai karecho ye vyApAre AllAha kono pramANa avatIrNa karenani| ataeva, tomarA apekSA karo, Amio teAmAdera sAthe apekSamANa|
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra saGgIderake svIYa anugrahe rakSA karalAma evaM yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe mithyAreApa karata tAdera mUla keTe dilAma| Ara tArA mu’mina chila nA|

sAmUda sampradAYera nikaTa preraNa karechi tAdera bhAi sAlehake| se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo, tini vyatIta teAmAdera keAno ilAha nei| avazyai teAmAdera nikaTa pau~chave teAmAdera pratipAlakera pakSa theke ekaTi spaSTa pramANa—eTi AllAhara uSTrI, teAmAdera janye nidarzanasvarUpa| ataeva, eke cher3e dAo, AllAhara yamine bhakSaNa karave| eke asatbhAve sparza karave nA| anyathAYa teAmAderake yantraNAdAYaka zAsti pAkar3Ao karave|

teAmarA smaraNa karo, yakhana tini ‘Ada -jAtira pare tomAdera sthalAbhiSikta karechena; evaM tini teAmAdera pRthivIte emanabhAve pratiSThita karechena ye, teAmarA samatala bhUmite aTTAlikA nirmANa karecho evaM parvata khanana kare prakeASTha /ghara nirmANa karecho| kAjei AllAhara anugrahake smaraNa karo evaM pRthivIte trAsa sRSTi kareA nA|

tAra sampradAYera dAmbhika sardArarA tAdera mAjhe daridra ImAnadAraderake valala teAmarA ki nizcitabhAve jAno? ye sAleha tAra rava kartRka prerita? tArA valala, AmarA teA tAra AnIta viSaYera prati vizvAsI|
dAmbhikarA valala, teAmarA ye viSaYe ImAna enecho, AmarA tA asvIkArakArI|
ataHpara tArA uTake hatyA karala evaM tAdera ravera Adeza amAnya kara la| tArA valala, he sAleha, tomAra pratizruta viSaYa tumi niYe eso, yadi tumi rAsuladera antarbhukta haYe thAko|
ataHpara pAkar3Ao karala tAderake bhUmikampa| phale sakAla velAYa nija nija gRhe upur3a haYe par3e raila|

ataH para sAleha tAdera kAcha theke prasthAna karala evaM valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, Ami teAmAdera kAche svIYa ravera paYagAma pau~chiYechi evaM teAmAdera maGgala kAmanA karechi; kintu teAmarA hitAkAGkSIdera bhAlovAso nA|
evaM Ami lUtake preraNa karechi| yakhana se tAra sampradAYake valala, teAmarA emana azlIla kAja karacho, yA teAmAdera pUrve sArA vizvera keu kareni|
teAmarA teA kAmavazata puruSadera kAche gamana karo nArIdera cher3e| varaM teAmarA to sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa|
tAra sampradAYera e vyatIta Ara kono javAva chila nA ye, tArA zudhu ei valata, ederake tomAdera janapada theke vera kare dAo, nizcaYa tArA var3a pavitra loka|
ataHpara Ami tAke o tA~ra parivAra-parijanake vA~ciYe dilAma, tAra strI vyatIta| se chila pazcAte avasthAnakArI|
Ami tAdera opara prastara vRSTi varSaNa karalAma| ataeva, lakSa karo, pApIdera pariNati ke mana chila|

Ami mAdaiYAnera prati tAdera bhAi zuYAivake preraNa karechi| se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo| tini vyatIta teAmAdera keAno upAsya nei| teAmAdera kAche teAmAdera pratipAlakera pakSa theke pramANa ese geche| ataeva, teAmarA pUrNabhAve parimApa karo evaM mAnuSake tAdera dravyAdi kama diYeA nA evaM pRthivIte zuddhi AnaYanera para tAte nairAjya sRSTi kareA nA| eTAi teAmAdera janya kalyANakara, yadi teAmarA vizvAsI hao|’

Ara teAmarA pratyeka rAstAYa ejanya vaso nA ye, yArA AllAhara opara ImAna Ane; tAdera tomarA bhaYa dekhAve o AllAhara patha hate vAdhA deve, evaM tAte vakratA anusandhAna karave| smaraNa karo, yakhana teAmarA saMkhyAYa alpa chile; ataHpara AllAha teAmAdera saMkhyAdhikya karechena evaM lakSa karo, kIrUpa chila viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera pariNati|

Ara yadi teAmAdera ekadala oi viSaYera prati ImAna Ane, yA niYe Ami prerita haYechi evaM anyadala ImAna nA Ane, tave savara karo; yatakSaNa nA AllAha AmAdera mAjhe phAYasAlA karena| tinii zreSTha phAYasAlAkArI|

tAra sampradAYera dAmbhika netArA valala, ‘he zuYAiva, AmarA avazyai teAmAke evaM teAmAra sAthe yArA ImAna eneche tAderake AmAdera janapada theke vera kare deva athavA avazyai teAmarA AmAdera dharme pratyAvartana karave|’ se valala, ‘AmarA yadio tA apachanda kari taveo ki?’

tave AmarA avazyai AllAhara prati mithyAropa karalAma yadi AmarA teAmAdera dharme pratyAvartana kari, era parao yakhana AllAha AmAdera tA hate mukti diYechena| AmAdera janya zobhanIYa naYa ye, AmarA tAra madhye phire yAva; kintu AmAdera rava AllAha yadi cAna| AmAdera rava pratyeka vastuke svIYa jJAna dvArA veSTana kare Achena| AmarA AllAhara pratii bharasA karechi| he AmAdera rava, AmAdera o AmAdera sampradAYera madhye yathArthabhAve phAYasAlA kare dina| Apanii uttama phaYasAlAkArI|
tAra sampradAYera kAphira sardArarA valala, yadi teAmarA zuYAivera anusaraNa karo, tave tomarA avazyai kSatigrasta|
ataHpara tAderake bhUmikampa pAkar3Ao karala| phale tArA sakAla velAYa nijedera gRhe upur3a haYe par3e raila|
Ara yArA zuYAivera prati mithyAreApa karechila kemana yena tArA keAno dina sekhAne vasavAsai kareni| yArA zuYAivera prati mithyAreApa karechila, tArAi chila kSatigrasta|

se tAdera theke mukha pherAlo, evaM valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, Ami avazyai teAmAdera AmAra ravera vANI pau~che diYechi evaM teAmAdera upadeza diYechi| ataeva, kIrUpe Ami duHkha karava emana sampradAYera janya—yArA kAphera|
Ara yakhanai Ami keAno janapade navi pAThiYechi, takhanai pratyeka janapadavAsIi vipada o durdazAra zikAra haYeche| yAte tArA nati svIkAra kare|

ataHpara Ami khArApa avasthAke bhAlo dvArA parivartana karechi| emanaki tArA prAcurya lAbha kareche| Ara tArA valala, nizcaYa AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderao sparza kareche kaSTa o svAcchandya, ataHpara Ami tAdera AkasmikabhAve pAkar3Ao karechi, ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA upalavdhio karate pArala nA|

Ara yadi se janapadera adhivAsIrA ImAna Anata evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karata, tave Ami tAdera prati AsamAna o yaminera neYAmatasamUha unmukta kare ditAma| kintu tArA mithyA pratipanna kareche| phale Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karechi tA saha, yA tArA upArjana karata kRtakarmera janya|
janapadera adhivAsIrA ki nirApada haYe geche ye, tAdera opara Asave AmAra zAsti rAtera velA, ematAvasthAYa ye tArA thAkave ghumanta|
nAki janapadera adhivAsIrA nirApada haYe geche, ye tAdera opara Asave AmAra zAsti pUrvAhNe, yakhana tArA khelAdhulA karave|
tArA ki AllAhara zAsti theke nirbhaYa haYe geche? athaca kSatigrasta sampradAYai AllAhara zAsti theke nirbhaYa hate pAre|

tAdera nikaTa ki ekathA prakAzita haYani, yArA uttarAdhikAra lAbha kareche, sekhAnakAra leAkerA vilupta havAra para| yadi Ami icchA karatAma, tave tAderake tAdera pApera daruna pAkar3Ao kare phelatAma| evaM Ami meAhara e~Te dite pAratAma tAdera antarasamUhera opara| phale tArA zunate peta nA|

e halo oi sakala janapadera vRttAnta, yAra kichu Ami tomAra nikaTa varNanA karechi, Ara avazyai tAdera kAche eseche tAdera rAsUlagaNa nidarzanasaha; kintu tArA ImAna AnAra chila nA, ekAraNe ye, tArA tA itaHpUrve mithyA pratipanna kareche| ebhAvei AllAha kAphiradera antare meAhara mere dena|
Ara Ami tAdera adhikAMzakei pratijJA vAstavAYanakArIrUpe pAini; varaM tAdera adhikAMzake peYechi pApAcArIrUpe|

ataHpara Ami tAdera paravartI samaYe mUsAke pAThiYechi nidarzanAvali-saha phiraAuna o tAra sabhAsadadera nikaTa| ataHpara tArA tA~ra sAthe sImAlaGghana kareche| sutarAM dekho, kemana chila viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera pariNati|
Ara mUsA valala, he phiraAuna, Ami vizvajagatera ravera pakSa theke rAsUla|
eTA nizcita ye, Ami AllAhara vyApAre satya vyatIta kichu valava nA| avazyai Ami teAmAdera ravera suspaSTa nidarzana niYe esechi| sutarAM tumi vani isarAilake AmAra sAthe pAThiYe dAo|
se valala, tumi keAno nidarzana niYe ese thAkale tA upasthita karo; yadi satyavAdI haYe thAko|
"tini lAThiTi nikSepa karatei tA eka virATa ajagare rUpAntarita haYe gela|"
Ara svIYa hAta vera karala phale tA haYe gela darzakadera ceAkhe zubhra-ujjvala|
phiraA unera netRvargarA valala, nizcaYa e vyakti vijJa jAdukara|
se teAmAderake teAmAdera deza theke vera kare dite cAYa| e vyApAre teAmAdera matAmata kI?
tArA valala, Apani tAke o tAra bhAike avakAza dena evaM leAkadera samaveta karAra janya zahare zahare ghoSaka pAThAna|
yAte tArA pratyeka vijJa jAdukaraderake tomAra nikaTa samaveta kare|
jAdukararA phiraAunera kAche upasthita haYe valala, nizcaYa AmAdera janya pratidAna thAkave to, yadi AmarA jaYalAbha kari?
se valala, hyA~, avazyai teAmarA AmAra sAnnidhyaprAptadera arntabhukta have|
tArA valala, he musA, haYa tumi nikSepa karo, athavA AmarA nikSepakArI|
se valala, teAmarAi nikSepa karo| yakhana tArA nikSepa karala takhana leAkadera ceAkhaguleAke jAdugrasta kare phelala| tAderake bhIta-santrasta kare tulala Ara tArA niYe elo mahA jAdu|
ataHpara Ami mUsAra nikaTa oYAhi pAThAlAma ye, tumi svIYa lAThi nikSepa karo| ataHpara tA gile phelala—yA tArA kRtrima sRSTi karechila|
Ara ebhAvei satya pratiSThita halo, evaM tArA yA karachila tA vAtila halo|
tArA sekhAnei parAjita halo, evaM lAJchita haYe phire gela|
evaM jAdukararA sijadAYa luTiYe par3ala|
tArA valala, AmarA ImAna Anachi vizvajagatera ravera prati|
yini mUsA o hArUnera rava|

phiraAuna valala, teAmarA ki AmAra anumati deoYAra Agei ImAna Anale! nizcaYa eTA pratAraNA, ye pratAraNA tomarA karecha nagarIte| yAte kare tA theke tAra adhivAsIdera vera kare dite pAre| sutarAM teAmarA zIghrai jAnate pArave|
avazyai Ami teAmAdera hAta o pA viparIta dika theke keTe deva| tArapara Ami te AmAdera savAike zUle car3Ava|
tArA valala, AmarA AmAdera ravera dikei pratyAvartanakArI|

Ara tumi AmAdera theke pratizodha grahaNa karacha zudhu ekAraNe ye, AmarA ImAna enechi AmAdera ravera nidarzanasamUhera prati, yakhana tA AmAdera nikaTa pau~cheche| he AmAdera rava, AmAdera dhairya dAna karuna evaM musalima hiseve mRtyu dAna karuna|

phiraAunera sampradAYera netRvRnda valala, tumi ki emanii cher3e deve mUsA o tAra sampradAYake? ye tArA pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi karave evaM ApanAke evaM ApanAra devatAderake parityAga kare| se valala, Ami acirei tAdera putra santAnaderake hatyA karava; Ara jIvita rAkhava meYederake| nizcaYa AmarA tAdera opara parAkramazAlI|

mUsA tAra jAtike valalena, tomarA AllAhara nikaTa sAhAyya prArthanA karo evaM dhairyadhAraNa karo| nizcaYai pRthivI AllAhara, tini svIYa vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA era uttarAdhikArI vAniYe dena evaM zubha pariNAma muttAkidera janya|

tArA valala, itopUrve AmAderake kaSTa deoYA haYeche, Ara tumi AsAra pareo| ti ni valalena, haYato zIghrai teAmAdera rava teAmAdera zakradera dhvaMsa karavena, evaM teAmAdera pRthivIte sthalAbhiSikta karavena| ataHpara tini dekhavena, teAmarA kIrUpa Amala karo|
Ara avazyai Ami pAkar3Ao karechi, phiraAunera anusArIdera kaYeka vachara durbhikSa evaM phala-phasalera kSaYa-kSatira mAdhyame, yena tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

ataHpara yakhana tAdera kAche pau~chata kalyANa, takhana tArA valata, eTA AmAdera janya| Ara yadi pau~chata akalyANa takhana tArA tAke mUsA evaM tA~ra saGgIdera alakSaNa vale mane karata| zune rAkho, prakRtapakSe tAdera kulakSaNa raYeche AllAhara kAche, kintu tAdera adhikAMza tA jAne nA|
tArA valala, AmAderake diYe jAdu karAvAra janya tumi ye nidarzanai niYe Aso nA kena, AmarA teAmAra opara ImAna AnaYanakArI nai|
phale Ami tAdera opara pAThiYechi tuphAna, paGgapAla, ukuna, vyAGa o rakta spaSTa nidarzanasvarUpa| tavuo tArA ahaMkAra karala| Ara tArA chila pApAcArI sampradAYa|

yakhana tAdera opara keAno zAsti patita hato, takhana tArA valata, he mUsA, AmAdera janya teAmAra ravera nikaTa du ‘ A karo, oi viSaYa yA tini teAmAra sAthe aGgIkAra karechena| yadi tumi AmAdera opara theke zAsti sariYe dAo tave avazyai AmarA ImAna Anava teAmAra opara evaM avazyai teAmAra sAthe vani isarAilake pAThAva|
ataHpara yakhana Ami tAdera opara theke zAsti tule nilAma ekaTi nirdhArita samaYa paryanta, ye paryanta tAderake pau~chAneA uddezya chila, takhana tArA pratizruti bhaGga karata|
phale Ami tAdera theke pratizodha grahaNa karalAma, tAderake sAgare DuviYe dilAma| e kAraNe ye, nizcaYa tArA mithyA pratipanna karechila AmAra nidarzanasamUhake evaM tArA chila tAra prati udAsIna|

Ara tAderake Ami pRthivIra pUrva o pazcimera uttarAdhikAra vAnAlAma yAderake durvala mane karA hato, yekhAne Ami vArakAha rekhechi| paripUrNa haYe geche teAmAra ravera pratizruta kalyANa vani isarAilera janya tAdera dhairyadhAraNera daruna| Ara dhvaMsa kare diYechi, yA nirmANa karechila phiraAuna o tAra sampradAYa evaM tArA ye suramya aTTAlikA nirmANa karata|

Ami vani isarAilake sAgara pAra kariYechi| ataHpara tArA emana eka sampradAYera kAche ela, yArA svIYa pratimAra upAsanAYa lipta chila, tArA valala, he mUsA, AmAdera janyao ilAha vAnAo yemana tAdera janya ilAha Ache se valala, nizcaYa tomarA mUrkha jAti|
nizcaYa tArA dhvaMsa have yAte tArA lipta evaM tA bhrAnta yA tArA karate chila|
tini valalena, tA hale ki AllAhake chAr3A teAmAdera janya anya keAno ilAha anusandhAna karava, athaca tinii teAmAderake vizvajagatera opara zreSThatva dAna karechena|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami teAmAdera phiraAunera anusArIdera kavala theke mukti diYechi; tArA teAmAdera zAsti dita nikRSTa zAsti, teAmAdera putrasantAnadera hatyA karata evaM tomAdera nArIdera jIvita rAkhata| ete chila teAmAdera prati teAmAdera ravera mahA parIkSA|

Ara Ami mUsAke pratizruti diYechi triza rAtrira evaM seguleAke pUrNa karechi Arao daza dvArA| Ara ebhAve tAra ravera nirdhArita samaYa calliza rAta pUrNa halo| mUsA tA~ra bhAi hArUnake valalena, tumi AmAra sampradAYera pratinidhitva karo| tAdera saMzeAdhana karo evaM viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera pathera anusaraNa karo nA|

ataHpara yakhana mUsA AmAra pratizruta samaYe upanIta halo, tA~ra sAthe tAra rava kathA valala, takhana se valala, he AmAra rava, AmAke dekhA dAo, Ami teAmAke dekhate cAi| tini valalena, tumi kakhano AmAke dekhate pAve nA, tave tumi pAhAr3era dike tAkAo, seTi yadi svasthAne sthira thAke, tavei tumi AmAke dekhate pAve| tArapara yakhana tAra rava pAhAr3era opara svIYa nUrera vikiraNa ghaTAlena, takhana tA tAke vidhvasta kare dila evaM mUsA ajJAna haYe par3e gela| ataHpara yakhana tAra jJAna phire pela, takhana se valala, teAmAra sattA pavitra, teAmAra nikaTa Ami tAovA karachi evaM Amii sarvaprathama mu’ mina|

tini valalena, he mUsA, nizcaYa Ami teAmAke mAnuSera madhye nirvAcana karechi AmAra risAlAta o vAkyAlApera janya| sutarAM yA-kichu Ami teAmAke dAna karechi, tA grahaNa karo evaM tumi hao kRtajJadera arntabhukta|

Ara Ami tAra janya phalakasamUhe likhe diYechi sarvaprakAra upadeza o pratyeka viSaYera vistArita vyAkhyA| ataeva, eguleAke dRr3habhAve dhAraNa karo evaM svajAtike nirdeza dAo era kalyANakara viSaYasamUha grahaNa karate| zIghrai Ami dekhAva tomAdera pApAcArIdera vAsasthAna|

acirei Ami AmAra nidarzanasamUha hate tAderake phiriYe deva, yArA pRthivIte anyAYabhAve ahaMkAra kare| yadi tArA samasta nidarzana pratyakSa kare phele, tavuo tAra prati tArA ImAna Anave nA| yadi tArA hidAYAtera patha dekhe tave tA nijedera patha hiseve grahaNa karave nA| athaca bhraSTatAra patha dekhale tAkei patha hiseve grahaNa kare| eTA ejanya ye, tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kareche, Ara tArA e vyApAre udAsIna chila|
yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha o AkhirAtera sAkSAtke mithyA pratipanna kareche, tAdera AmalasamUha dhvaMsa haYeche| tAderake tAdera karma anuyAYIi phala deoYA have|

Ara mUsAra sampradAYa tAra anupasthitite svIYa alaMkAra dvArA garura vAchurera ekaTi deha vAnAla, tAra chila hAmvA rava| tArA ki dekhe nA? nizcaYa eTA tAdera sAthe kathA valache nA evaM tAderake keAno pathao vAtale dicche nA! tathApi tArA seTike upAsya vAniYe nila| tArA chila sImAlaGghanakArI|

ataHpara yakhana tArA anutapta halo evaM tArA dekhala ye, tArA bhraSTa haYeche, takhana tArA valate lAgala, yadi AmAdera rava AmAdera kSamA nA karena evaM AmAdera prati karuNA nA karena tave avazyai AmarA kSatigrastadera arntabhukta haYe yAva|

tArapara yakhana mUsA rAgAnvita o anutapta haYe nija sampradAYera nikaTa phire elo, takhana se valala, AmAra pare tomarA AmAra kata nikRSTa pratinidhitva karecha| teAmarA ki tomAdera ravera vyApAre tAr3Ahur3o karale? se phalakagulo chur3e phelala evaM svIYa bhAiYera mAthA dhare nijera dike TAnate lAgala| se valala, he AmAra mAYera putra, nizcaYa sampradAYa AmAke durvala kare phelechila evaM AmAke mere phelate udyata halo| sutarAM zatrudera kAche AmAke hAsira pAtra vAniYo nA| Ara AmAke yAlima sampradAYera aarntabhukta kareA nA|
se valala, he AmAra rava, AmAke o AmAra bhAike kSamA karo, tomAra karuNAYa AmAderake praveza karAo, nizcaYa tumi sarvAdhika karuNAmaYa|

nizcaYa yArA garura vAchurake upAsya hiseve grahaNa kareche| acirei tAdera opara tAdera ravera pakSa theke pArthiva-jIvanei gajava o lAJchanA patita have| ebhAvei Ami pratidAna dii mithyA racanAkArIdera|
Ara yArA manda kAja kare, ataHpara tAovA kare evaM ImAna Ane, tave nizcaYai teAmAra rava tAra parao kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
ataHpara mUsAra rAga yakhana prazamita halo, takhana se phalakagulo tule nila| Ara tAte lipivaddha chila, hidAYAta o rahamata tAdera janya yArA nijedera ravake bhaYa kare|

mUsA tAra sampradAYa theke sattarajana leAka nirvAcana karala AmAra nirdhArita samaYera janya| ataHpara yakhana tAdera bhUmikampa pAkar3Ao karala, takhana valala, he AmAra rava, yadi cAitena tave AmAke o tAderake Agei dhvaMsa kare dite pAratena| Apani ki AmAdera mUrkhadera karmera kAraNe AmAdera dhvaMsa karavena? eTA ApanAra parIkSA; Apani yAke icchA patha bhraSTa karavena evaM yAke icchA hidAYAta devena| Apani AmAdera abhibhAvaka, sutarAM Apani AmAderake kSamA kare dina evaM AmAdera opara karuNA karena| evaM Apanii kSamAzIladera madhye sarvottama|

ei pArthiva-jIvane evaM AkhirAte AmAdera janya kalyANa likhe dina; nizcaYa AmarA ApanAra dike pratyAvartana karachi| tini valalena, AmAra AjAva tAkei diYe thAki, yAke Ami icchA kari| Ara AmAra rAhamAha sava jinisake parivyApta kare Ache| sutarAM tA Ami tAdera janya likhe deva—yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, jAkAta pradAna kare evaM AmAra AYAtasamUhera opara ImAna Ane|

yArA sei ummi navi-rAsUlera Anugatya kare, yAra kathA tArA nijedera kAche rakSita tAorAta o iJjile likhita pAYa, tini tAderake nirdeza dena satkarmera, vAraNa karena asatkarma theke; tAdera janya yAvatIYa pavitra vastu hAlAla gheASaNA karena o niSiddha karena hArAma vastusamUha evaM tAdera opara theke se veAjhA nAmiYe dena evaM vanditva apasAraNa karena—yA tAdera opara vidyamAna chila| sutarAM yArA tAra opara ImAna Ane o tAke sammAna kare, tAke sAhAyya kare evaM se nUrera anusaraNa kare yA tAra sAthe avatIrNa karA haYeche, zudhu tArAi saphalakAma|

valo, he mAnavamaNDalI, nizcaYa Ami teAmAdera savAra prati sei AllAhara rAsUla, yAra rAjatva AsamAnasamUha o yamine| tini chAr3A Ara kono ilAha nei| tini jIvana o mRtyu dAna karena| sutarAM teAmarA ImAna Ano AllAhara opara o tA~ra prerita ummi navira opara, yini ImAna rAkhena AllAhara evaM tA~ra samasta kAlAmera opara| evaM tA~ra anusaraNa karo, yena hidAYAtaprApta hao|
Ara mUsAra sampradAYe ekaTi dala raYeche; yArA hidAYAtera patha nirdeza kare evaM se matei vicAra kare thAke|

Ara Ami tAderake vAroTi dale vibhakta karechi| Ara se yakhana tAra jAtira janya pAni prArthanA karala, takhana tAke nirdeza dilAma, lAThi dvArA pAthare AghAta karate| ataHpara era theke utsArita halo vAroTi prasravaNa| pratiTi geAtra cine nila nija nija pAna-sthAna| Ara Ami tAdera opara meghera chAYA dAna karalAma| evaM tAdera janya avatIrNa karalAma ‘mAnnA’ o ‘sAlaoYA’ | Ami ye pavitra riyika tomAdera diYechi, sekhAna theke AhAra karo| Ara tArA AmAra opara keAno yuluma kareni, varaM nijedera oparai yuluma kareche|

Ara yakhana tAdera valA halo ye, teAmarA e nagarIte vasavAsa karo, yekhAna theke yA icchA khAo, evaM valo, AmAdera kSamA karena; Ara darajA diYe praveza karo nata haYe, tave Ami kSamA kare deva teAmAdera pApasamUha| avazya Ami satkarmazIladera vRddhi karava|
kintu tAdera madhye yArA sImAlaGghanakArI tArA kathA parivartana karala, yA tAderake valA haYechila| phale Ami AsamAna theke tAdera opara zAsti pAThiYechi, ekAraNe ye, tArA sImAlaGghana karata|

Ara tAdera samudra tIravartI janapadera avasthA samparke jijJesa karo| yakhana zanivArera vyApAre sImAlaGghana karala| yakhana zanivAra dina tAdera kAche mAcherA cale Asata bhese bhese, Ara zanivAra chAr3A anyadina Asata nA| ebhAve Ami tAderake parIkSA karechi| ekAraNe ye, tArA chila pApAcArI|

Ara yakhana tAdera madhye theke ekaTi sampradAYa valala, tomarA kena emana lokadera upadeza diccha, AllAha yAdera dhvaMsa karavena vA kaThina AjAva devena? tArA valala, teAmAdera ravera kAche ajuhAta peza karAra janya, yAte tArA saMyata haYa|

ataHpara tArA yakhana bhule gela, ye upadeza tAdera deoYA haYechila, takhana Ami manda kAja theke vAraNakArIdera mukti dilAma| Ara sImAlaGghanakArIdera Ami nikRSTa zAstite grephatAra karechi, ekAraNe ye, tArA pApAcArI chila|
ataHpara tArA yakhana auddhatya pradarzana karala niSiddha kAjera prati, takhana Ami nirdeza dilAma ye, teAmarA lAJchita vAnare pariNata hao|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana ApanAra rava ghoSaNA karalena, avazyai kiYAmata divasa paryanta tAdera opara emana leAka preraNa karate thAkavena, yArA tAdera nikRSTa zAsti dite thAkave| nizcaYai ApanAra rava druta zAstidAtA evaM tinii kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

Ara Ami tAderake pRthivIte vibhakta kare diYechi vibhinna zreNite, tAdera madhye kichu raYeche bhAlo Ara kichu raYeche anya rakama! tAchAr3A Ami tAderake parIkSA karechi bhAlo o mandera mAdhyame yAte tArA phire Ase|

ataHpara tAdera pare emana kichu apadArtha loka tAdera sthalAbhiSikta halo ye, tArA kitAverao uttarAdhikArI halo; tArA nikRSTa pArthiva upakaraNa grahaNa kare valata, AmAdera acirei kSamA kare deoYA have| Asale tAdera sAmane yadi emana Arao upasthita haYa, tAo tArA grahaNa karave| tAdera kAcha theke ki kitAvera aGgIkAra neoYA haYani? ye, AllAhara vyApAre satya vai kichui valave nA? evaM tArA pATha kareche, yA tAte lekhA raYeche| vastuta AkhirAtera gRha muttAkidera janya uttama—teAmarA ki tA veAjho nA?
Ara yArA sudRr3habhAve kitAvake dhAraNa kare evaM sAlAta pratiSThA kare, nizcaYai Ami vinaSTa karava nA satkarmIdera pratidAna|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami tAdera opara pAhAr3a tule dharalAma sAmiYAnAra mato evaM tArA dhAraNA karala, ye eTA tAdera opara patita have, takhana Ami valalAma, yA Ami teAmAdera diYechi, tA A~kar3e dharo, evaM tAte yA raYeche, smaraNa rekho, yAte teAmarA muttAki hate pAro|

Ara yakhana tomAra rava vani Adamera pRSThadeza theke vera karalena tAdera santAnadera evaM tAderake nijedera opara sAkSI rekhe valalena, Ami ki te AmAdera rava nai? tArA valala, avazyai, AmarA sAkSya dicchi| yena kiYAmatera dina nA vala ye, e viSaYe AmArA avahita chilAma nA|
athavA tomarA ekathA valave ye, itopUrve AmAdera pUrva puruSerA ziraka kareche, Ara AmarA halAma tAdera pazcAdvartI santAna-santati| tAhale ki bhraSTadera karmera kAraNe AmAdera dhvaMsa karavena?
Ara ebhAve Ami AYAtasamUha savistAre varNanA kari, yAte tArA phire Ase|

Ara tumi tAdera se i vyaktira kathA zuniYe dAo, yAke Ami AmAra nidarzanasamUha dAna karechilAma, athaca se tA theke veriYe geche| phale tAra pechane lege gela zaYatAna, Ara se pathabhraSTadera antarbhukta haYe gela|

avazya Ami cAile era mAdhyame tAra maryAdA samunnata karate pAratAma; kintu se pRthivIra prati jhu~ke par3eche evaM nijera pravRttira anusaraNa kareche| sutarAM tAra upamA halo kukurera mato; yadi tAke tAr3iYe dAo tavuo hA~pAve Ara yadi cher3e dAo tavuo hA~pAve| egulo sei lokadera janya udAharaNa; yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kareche| ataeva, tumi varNanA karo kAhinigulo, yAte tArA cintA kare|
katai nA nikRSTa upamA oi sampradAYera janya, yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kareche evaM tArA chila nijedera opara sImAlaGghanakArI|
yAke AllAha hidAYAta dena, sei hidAYAtaprApta have| Ara yAke tini pathabhraSTa karavena, se have kSatigrasta|

Ara Ami jAhAnnAmera janya sRSTi karechi vahu saMkhyaka jina o mAnuSa| tAdera antara raYeche, era dvArA tArA anudhAvana kare nA, tAdera ceAkha raYeche, tA dvArA tArA dekhe nA, Ara tAdera kAna raYeche, tA dvArA zeAne nA| tArA catuSpada jantura mato; varaM tAdera ceYeo tArA nikRSTatara| tArAi halo udAsIna|

Ara AllAhara janya raYeche sava uttama nAmasamUha| kAjei tomarA se nAma dharei tA~ke DAko| Ara tAdera varjana karo, yArA tA~ra nAmera vikRti ghaTAYa| ati zigagira tAderake tAdera kRtakarmera phala deoYA have|
Ara yAdera Ami sRSTi karechi, tAdera madhye emana eka dala raYeche, yArA hidAYAtera patha dekhAYa evaM se anuyAYI nyAYavicAra kare|
Ara AmAra AYAtasamUhake yArA mithyA pratipanna kareche, Ami tAderake kramAnvaYe pAkar3Ao karava emana jAYagA theke, yAra samparke tAdera dhAraNAo have nA|
Ara Ami tAderake avakAza dicchi| niHsandehe AmAra kauzala zaktizAlI|
tArA ki cintA kareni ye, tAdera saGgI leAkaTira mastiSke keAno ummAdanA nei? tini teA spaSTa bhItipradarzanakArI|

tArA ki pratyakSa kareni nabhomaNDala o bhUmaNDalera kartRtva samparke evaM AllAha yA-kichu sRSTi karechena, Ara cintA kare nA e vyApAre ye, tAdera sAthe kRta oYAdAra samaYa nikaTavartI haYe eseche? ataeva, Ara kona kathAra opara tArA ImAna Anave?
AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena| tAra keAno hidAYAtakArI nei| Ara AllAha tAderake tAdera avAdhyatAYa cher3e dena, tArA udabhrAnta haYe phirave|

tArA tomAke jijJesa kare, kiYAmAta kakhana anuSThita have? valo, tAra khavara ekamAtra AmAra raverai nikaTa raYeche| tinii tA prakAza karavena nirdhArita samaYe| nabheAmaNDala o bhUmaNDalera janya seTi ati kaThina viSaYa| tA teAmAdera opara AcamakA ese yAve| tomAke jijJesa kare, yena tumi tAra savizeSa avagata| valo, era khavara AllAharai nikaTa raYeche; kintu tA adhikAMza leAkai upalavdhi kare nA|

valo, AllAhara icchA vyatIta Ami AmAra nijera kalyANa o akalyANa sAdhanera mAlika nai| Ara Ami yadi gAYevera kathA jAnatAma, tAhale lAbha karatAma vahu kalyANa, phale AmAke kakhano kono amaGgala sparza karate pArata nA| Ami teA zudhu mu ‘ mina sampradAYera janya ekajana bhItipradarzaka o susaMvAdadAtA

tinii se sattA—yini teAmAdera sRSTi karechena ekaTimAtra sattA theke; Ara tAra thekei tairi karechena tAra strIke, yAte tAra kAche svasti pete pAre| ataHpara se yakhana tAra sAthe milita halo, takhana se hAlakA garbhavatI halo| eke niYei se calApherA kare| tArapara yakhana bhArI haYe gela, takhana ubhaYei AllAhake DAkala, yini tAdera rava ye, tumi yadi AmAdera uttama santAna dAna karo, tave AmarA teAmAra kRtajJa vAndA hava|
ataHpara tAdera yakhana uttama santAna dAna karalena, takhana dAnakRta viSaYe tArA zarika tairi karala| Ara AllAha mahAna ucca maryAdAvAna tAra theke tArA ye zarika kare|
tArA ki emana kAuke zarika sAvyasta kare, ye kono vastuo sRSTi kareni, varaM tArAi sRSTa|
tArA, nA tAdera sAhAyya karate pAre, nA nijera sAhAyya karate pAre|
teAmarA yadi tAderake hidAYAtera dike AhvAna karo, tave tArA teAmAdera anusaraNa karave nA| tAderake AhvAna jAnAneA kiMvA nIrava thAkA ubhaYaTii teAmAdera janya samAna|

nizcaYa AllAhake vAda diYe teAmarA yAderake DAko, tArA savAi teAmAdera matoi vAndA| sutarAM, teAmarA tAdera DAkate thAko, Ara tAdera ucita tomAdera DAke sAr3A deoYA, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI haYe thAko|

tAdera ki pA Ache, yadvArA tArA calApherA kare? kiMvA tAdera ki hAta Ache, yA dvArA tArA dhare? athavA tAdera ki ceAkha Ache yA dvArA tArA dekhate pAYa? kiMvA tAdera ki kAna Ache yA dvArA zunate pAYa? valo, teAmarA DAko teAmAdera aMzIdAradera, ataHpara AmAra viruddhe cakrAnta karo evaM AmAke avakAza diYo nA|
nizcaYa AmAra abhibhAvaka teA AllAha, yini kitAva avatIrNa karechena| vastuta tinii satkarmazIla vAndAdera abhibhAkatva karena|
Ara teAmarA tA~ke vAda diYe yAderake DAko, tArA nA teAmAdera keAno sAhAyya karate pArave, nA nijederao sAhAyya karate pArave|
Ara yadi tumi tAdera hidAYAtera pathe AhvAna karo, tave tArA zunave nA| tumi tAdera dekhave, tArA tomAra dike tAkiYe Ache, athaca tArA dekhate pAYa nA|
Ara kSamAzIlatA avalamvana karo, satkAjera nirdeza dAo evaM mUrkhadera upekSA karo|
Ara yadi zaYatAnera prareAcanA teAmAke prareAcita kare, tAhale AllAhara AzraYa cAo, nizcaYa tinii sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
nizcaYa yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, yakhana tAderake sparza kare zaYatAnera pakSa theke kumantraNA takhana tArA AllAhake smaraNa kare| phale tArA dekhate pAYa|
pakSAntare yArA tAdera bhAi, tAderake se kramAgata bhraSTatAra dike dhAvita kare evaM tAte keAno truTi kare nA|

Ara yakhana tumi tAdera nikaTa keAno nidarzana nA niYe Aso, tArA vale, tumi kena tA Anale nA| valo, Ami teA se matei cali—yA AmAra nikaTa oYAhi Ase AmAra ravera pakSa theke| eTA tomAdera ravera pakSa theke jJAnAloka, hidAYAta o rahamata tAdera janya yArA ImAna Ane|
Ara yakhana kuraAna pATha karA haYa, takhana tA manoyogasaha zono, evaM nizcupa thAka, yena tomarA daYAprApta hao|
svIYa ravake smaraNa karo sakAla o sandhyAYa vinItabhAve gopane, kathAra AoYAja ucca nA kare| Ara tumi udAsInadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
nizcaYai yArA teAmAra ravera nikaTe, tArA tA~ra ivAdAtera vyApAre ahaMkAra karena nA evaM tA~ra mahimA ghoSaNA kare; Ara tA~rai janya sijadAha karena|

tArA tomAke yuddhalavdha sampada samparke jijJesa kare| valo, yuddhalavdha sampada AllAhara evaM rAsUlera| ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM tomAdera madhyakAra avasthA saMzeAdhana karo| Ara AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karo, yadi tomarA mu’mina haYe thAka|

prakRtapakSe mu’mina tArA, yakhana AllAhara smaraNa karA haYa tAdera antara ke~pe oThe, Ara yakhana tAdera sAmane tA~ra AYAta tilAoYAta karA haYa, tAdera ImAna ver3e yAYa evaM tArA svIYa ravera prati bharasA rAkhe|
yArA sAlAta pratiSThA kare evaM Ami tAderake ye riyika diYechi tA theke vyaYa kare|
Ara tArAi prakRta mu’mina! tAdera janya raYeche tAdera ravera nikaTa maryAdAsamUha, kSamA evaM sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
yemana kare teAmAke teAmAra rava ghara theke vera karechena yathAyathabhAve, athaca mu’minadera ekaTi dala tA apachanda karechila|
tArA teAmAra sAthe vivAda karachila satyera viSaYe, tA prakAzita havAra para; tArA yena mRtyura dike dhAvita hacche ematAvasthAYa tArA pratyakSa karache|

Ara yakhana AllAha duTi dalera ekaTira vyApAre teAmAdera sAthe oYAdA karechilena ye, nizcaYa tA teAmAdera janya| Ara teAmarA kAmanA karachile nirastra dalaTi AYattAdhIna hoka; athaca AllAha cAcchilena, tAra nirdezera mAdhyame satyake pratiSThita karate evaM kAphiradera mUla kartana kare dite|
yAte kare satyake satya evaM mithyAke mithyA pratipanna kare dena, yadio pApIrA apachanda kare|
teAmarA yakhana tomAdera ravera kAche sAhAyya cAile, tini teAmAdera AhvAne sAr3A diYe valalena, Ami teAmAderake sAhAyya karava dhArAvAhikabhAve Agata hAjAra pherezatAra mAdhyame|
AllAha era mAdhyame zudhu tomAdera susaMvAda diYechena, yena tA dvArA teAmAdera mana prazAnta haYa| Ara sAhAyya kevala AllAhara pakSa thekei nizcaYa AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tini tomAdera opara tandrAcchannatA nAmiYechena tAra pakSa theke prazAntisvarUpa, erapara teAmAdera opara AkAza theke vRSTi varSaNa karalena, yena tA dvArA teAmAderake pavitra karena, evaM teAmAdera theke muche dena zaYatAnera apavitratA| Ara yena sudRr3ha kare dena tomAdera antara evaM sudRr3ha kare dite pArena teAmAdera pAguleA|

smaraNa karo, yakhana tomAra rava pherezatAdera prati oYAhi karalena, nizcaYa Ami tomAdera sAthe Achi, sutarAM tomarA avicala rAkho yArA ImAna eneche| Ara acirei Ami kAphiradera antare AtaGka Dhele deva; ataeva, tomarA gardAne AghAta karo evaM jor3AYa jor3AYa AghAta karo|
kAraNa, nizcaYa tArA AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitA kareche| Ara ye vyakti AllAha o rAsUlera virodhitA kare, niHsandehe AllAha zAsti pradAne atyanta kaTheAra|
eTAi tomAdera zAsti; tAi teAmarA AsvAdana kare nAo Ara nizcaYa kAphiradera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera zAsti|
he mu ‘ minagaNa, teAmarA yakhana kAphiradera sammukhIna have jihAdarata avasthAYa, takhana pazcAdapasaraNa karave nA|

ye vyakti sedina lar3AiYera kauzala parivartanakalpe vA ye nija sainyadera nikaTa AzraYa nite AsA vyatIta tAdera theke pazcAdapasaraNa karave, tave se AllAhara gajave patita have| Ara tAra ThikAnA halo jAhAnnAma| AzraYasthAna hiseve tA ati nikRSTa|

sutarAM teAmarA tAdera hatyA karani, varaM AllAhai tAderake hatyA karechena| Ara yakhana tumi nikSepa karecha, mUlata tumi nikSepa karoni| varaM AllAhai tA nikSepa karechilena, yAte tini tAra pakSa theke mu’minadera uttama parIkSA karena| nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
(eTA ghaTanA,) Ara nizcaYa AllAha kAphiradera kalAkauzala durvalakArI|

teAmarA yadi vijaYa kAmanA karo, tave nizcaYa teAmAdera nikaTa eseche vijaYa| yadi tomarA virata hao tave tA teAmAdera janya uttama| Ara tomarA yadi punarAvRtti karo, tave Amio punarAvRtti karavo| Ara teAmAdera dalavala tomAdera kakhano kAje Asave nA; yadio tA vezii heAka| nizcaYa AllAha mu’minadera sAthe Achena|
he mu ‘ minagaNa, AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karo evaM tA theke vimukha haYeA nA, athaca tomarA zunacha|
Ara tAdera mato haYeA nA, yArA vale ye, AmarA zunechi, athaca tArA zeAne nA|
nizcaYa AllAhara nikaTa nikRSTa prANI mUka o vadhira—yArA upaladdhi kare nA|
Ara AllAha yadi tAdera madhye kono kalyANa jAnatena, tave avazyai tAdera zonAtena| Ara yadio tAdera zonAtena, tave tArA avazyai mukha phiriYe rAkhata, ematAvasthAYa tArA upekSAkArI|

he muminagaNa, AllAha o tA~ra rAsulera DAke sAr3A dAo, yakhana tini tomAdera DAkena, yena tomAdera udIpta kare jene rekheA, nizcaYa AllAha mAnuSa o tAra antarera mAjhe antarAYa haYe thAkena| Ara nizcaYa tomAdera tA~rai nikaTa samaveta karA have|
Ara teAmarA emana phitanA theke dUre thAko, yA vizeSata zudhu tomAdera madhya theke sImAlaGghanakArIdera opara patita have nA| jene rekho, AllAha zAstidAne atyanta kaTheAra|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana teAmarA chile alpa, pRthivIte tomAdera bhAvA hato durvala, tomarA bhaYa karate ye, tomAdera mAnuSa nizcihna kare phelave| ataHpara tini teAmAdera AzraYa dilena, nija sAhAyye teAmAdera zaktizAlI karalena evaM jIvikA dAna karechena pavitra jinisa theke yAte teAmarA zukariYA AdAYa karo|
he mu ‘ minagaNa, tomarA vizvAsa bhaGga karo nA AllAhara o rAsUlera evaM nijedera pArasparika AmAnate kheYAnata karo nA, jJAtasAre|
Ara jene rekho, teAmAdera dhanasampada o santAnasantati parIkSAmAtra| Ara nizcaYa AllAhara nikaTa raYeche mahApratidAna|

he mu ‘ minagaNa, teAmarA yadi AllAhake bhaYa karo, tave tini teAmAdera devena phurakAna (satya-mithyAra pArkyakArI)| Ara mocana karavena tomAdera pApasamUha, evaM tomAdera kSamA karavena, nizcaYai AllAha mahAanugrahera adhikArI|

Ara kAphirarA yakhana tomAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra karechila ye tomAke vandi karave, athavA hatyA karave athavA nirvAsita karave Ara tArA Sar3ayantra kare evaM AllAha Sar3ayantrera uttara pradAna karena, Ara nizcaYai AllAha uttama kauzalI|
Ara yakhana tAdera nikaTa AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa, takhana tArA vale AmarA zunechi, icchA karale avazyai AmarAo emana valate pAri; e teA pUrvavartI kalpa-kAhini vyatIta kichui naYa|
Ara smaraNa karo—yakhana tArA valala, he AllAha, yadi eTA satya haYa ApanAra pakSa theke, tave AmAdera opara AkAza theke pAthara varSaNa karuna vA AmAdera opara yantraNAdAYaka zAsti avatIrNa karuna|

athaca AllAha kakhano tAdera opara zAsti avatIrNa karavena nA, yatakSaNa tumi tAdera mAjhe avasthAna karave| Ara tArA yatakSaNa kSamAprArthanA karate thAkave AllAha kakhano tAdera opara zAsti devena nA|

Ara tAdera ki adhikAra Ache ye AllAha tAdera zAsti devena nA, athaca tArA mAsajidula hArAme yete vAdhA deYa, Ara tArA tAra tattvAvadhAYakao naYa, era tattvAvadhAYaka zudhu muttAkirA| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
Ara kAvAra nikaTa tAdera sAlAta valate zisa deoYA Ara tAli vAjAneA chAr3A anya kichui nA| ataeva, tomarA zAsti bhoga karo, e kAraNe ye, tomarA kuphuri karate|

nizcaYa yArA kuphuri kareche, tArA nijedera dhana-sampada vyaYa kare zudhu AllAhara pathe vAdhA deoYAra janya| ataHpara acirei tArA Arao vyaYa karave| tArapara eTAi tAdera janya AkSepera kAraNa have; ataHpara tArA parAjita have| Ara kAphiradera jAhAnnAmera dike ekatra karA have|
yena AllAha apavitradera theke pavitradera pRthaka karena, Ara apavitradera ekaTAra opara ArekaTA rekhe savAike stUpe pariNata karena| erapara tAdera rAkhavena jAhAnnAme| tArAi prakRta kSatigrasta|
tumi kAphiradera vale dAo, tArA yadi virata haYa, tave yA kichu ghaTe geche tA kSamA karA have| pakSAntare yadi tArA punarAvRtti kare, tave nirdhArita haYeche pUrvavartIdera avasthA|

Ara tAdera sAthe yuddha karate thAka yatakSaNa paryanta nA phetanA nirmUla haYa Ara dvIna sAmagrikabhAve AllAhara janya pratiSThita haYa| ataHpara yadi tArA virata haYa, tave nizcaYa AllAha oi viSaYe samyaka draSTA, yA tArA kare|
Ara tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa, tave jene rAkho, AllAha teAmAdera abhibhAvaka; tini katai nA uttama abhibhAvaka, Ara katai nA uttama sAhAyyakArI|

Ara jene rAkho, teAmarA yA-kichu gAnImAta hiseve pAve, tAra eka-paJcamAMza halo AllAhara janya, Ara rAsulera janya, nikaTAtmIYa-svajanera janya evaM etima-asahAYa o musAphiradera janya; yadi tomarA ImAna ene thAko, AllAhara prati evaM tAra prati yA Ami avatIrNa karechi AmAra vAndAra opara satya-mithyAra pArthakyera dina, ye dina ubhaYa senAdala mukhomukhi haYechila, ‘Ara AllAha sarva viSaYe sarva zaktimAna|

smaraNa karo, yakhana teAmarA chile nikaTavartI prAnte Ara tArA chila dUravartI prAnte Ara ArohI kAphelA chila teAmAdera ceYe nimnabhUmite| e samaYa yadi teAmarA paraspare oYAdAvaddha hate, tave oYAdA pAlana karAra vyApAre matabheda karate; kintu AllAha tAderake ekatra karechena yena emana kAja sampanna karate pArena, yA haoYArai chila| yena yArA dhvaMsa haoYAra tArA yena dhvaMsa haYe yAYa spaSTa pramANa pAoYAra para, Ara ye ve~ce thAkAra, se yena ve~ce thAke spaSTa pramANa pAoYAra para Ara nizcaYai AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

smaraNa karo, yakhana AllAha tAdera parimANa tomAke svapne alpa dekhiYechena; Ara yadi tAdera dekhAtena adhika kare tave avazyai tomarA sAhasa hArAte evaM kAja sampAdane avazyai vivAda karate; kintu AllAha rakSA karechena| nizcaYai tini antarasamUhera avasthAra vyApAre sarvajJa|

Ara smaraNa karo, tomarA yakhana mukhomukhi hale, tini tAdera teAmAdera cokhe alpa dekhAlena, Ara tAdera cokhe tomAdera dekhAlena alpa saMkhyaka| yena AllAha sampanna karate pArena, yA haoYAra chila| Ara AllAhara nikaTa sava vyApAra pratyAvartIta have|
he mu’ minagaNa, teAmarA yakhana keAno vAhinIra mokAvelAYa lipta hao, takhana sudRr3ha thAko evaM AllAhake adhika parimANe smaraNa karo, yAte teAmarA saphalakAma hate pAro|
tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karo, Ara vivAde lipta haYo nA; tAhale tomarA sAhasa hArAve, dUra have tomAdera zakti| Ara tomarA dhai rya dharo, nizcaYai AllAha dhairyazIladera sAthe Achena|
teAmarA tAdera mato haYo nA, yArA veriYeche nijedera ghara theke garvabhare evaM leAka dekhAnora uddezye| Ara tArA AllAhara pathe vAdhA deYa| Ara AllAha oi samasta viSaYa veSTanakArI—yA tArA kare|

Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana zaYatAna zobhita karala tAdera dRSTite tAdera kAjaguloke evaM valala, Aja teAmAdera viruddhe keu vijaYI hate pArave nA, Ara Ami teAmAdera prativezI| ataHpara yakhana ubhaYa vAhinI sAmanAsAmani halo takhana se druta pAYe pechane pAliYe gela evaM valala, Ami teAmAdera theke dAYamukta, nizcaYa Ami yA dekhi, teAmarA tA dekho nA; Ami bhaYa kari AllAhake| Ara AllAha zAstidAne atyanta kaThora|
yakhana munAphikarA evaM yAdera antara vyAdhigrasta, tArA valala, edera dharma ederake dho~kA diYeche, Ara yArA AllAhara opara bharasA kare, nizcaYa AllAha parAkramazIla, mahAvijJa|
Ara yadi tumi dekhate, yakhana pherezatArA kAphiradera jAna-kavaja kare; tArA prahara kare, tAdera mukhe evaM tAdera pazcAtdeze Ara vale, jvalanta zAstira svAda grahaNa karo|
eTA ekAraNe, yA tomAdera hAta pUrve pAThiYeche| Ara nizcaYa AllAha vAndAra prati atyAcArI nana|

eTA phiraAunera vaMzadhara evaM tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNatira mato| tArA AllAhara nidarzanake asvIkAra kareche, phale AllAha tAderake tAdera pApera kAraNe pAkar3Ao karechena| nizcaYai AllAha mahAzaktizAlI o zAstidAne kaThora|

eTA ejanya ye, AllAha kono sampradAYera niYAmata parivartana karena nA, yA tini tAderake diYechena, yatakSaNa nA tArA nijedera parivartana kare, yA tAdera mAjhe Ache| nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

pherAunera vaMzadhara evaM tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNatira mato, tArA mithyA pratipanna karechila tAdera ravera nidarzanasamUhake| ataHpara Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kare diYechi tAdera pApera kAraNe, evaM phiraAunera parivArake DuviYe diYechi| Ara tArA sakalei chila sImAlaGghanakArI|
AllAhara nikaTa savaceYe nikRSTa vicaraNakArI prANI halo tArAi, yArA kuphuri kareche, ataHpara Ara ImAna Aneni|
tAdera madhya hate yAdera sAthe tumi sandhicukti karecha, tArA prativAra cukti bhaGga kare, evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kare nA|
sutarAM tumi yadi kakhaneA tAderake yuddhe AYatte pAo, tave tAdera dvArA tAdera vidhvasta karo, yArA tAdera pechane raYeche| yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
tave yadi keAno sampradAYera vyApAre dho~kAra AzaGkA karo, tave ekaibhAve tAdera cukti tAdera dike nikSepa karo| nizcaYai AllAha pratArakake pachanda karena nA|
Ara kAphirarA yena mane nA kare, tArA Age cale geche; nizcaYai tArA akSama karate pArave nA|

Ara tomarA sarvocca sAmarthya anuyAYI tAdera janya jihAdera prastuti nAo, gheAr3A o sAja-saraJjAma dvArA, yena tomarA tAra mAdhyame AllAhara evaM tomAdera zatrudera santrasta rAkhate pAro| evaM tArA vyatIta anyaderao, yAderake tomarA jAno nA, AllAha tAderake jAnena| Asale AllAhara pathe tomarA yA-kichu vyaYa karave, era pUrNa pratidAna tomAdera deoYA have| tomAdera prati avicAra karA have nA|
Ara yadi tArA sandhi karate Agraha kare tave tumio tAra janya AgrahI hao, evaM AllAhara opara bharasA karo| nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
Ara yadi tArA tomAke dho~kA dite cAYa tave nizcaYai tomAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa, tinii yini tomAke zaktizAlI karechena tAra sAhAyye o muminadera mAdhyame|

Ara tAdera antarera mAjhe samprIti sthApana karechena, tumi pRthivIra savakichu vyaYa kareo tAdera mAjhe samprIti sthApana karate pArate nA; kintu AllAha tAdera antare samprIti saJcAra karechena| niHsandehe tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
he navi, tomAra janya evaM yesava mu’ mina tomAra sAthe raYeche tAdera janya AllAhai yatheSTa|

he navi, tumi mu’ minaderake jihAdera janya utsAhita karo| yadi teAmAdera madhye vizajana dRr3hapada vyakti thAke, tave jaYI have duzora meAkAvelAYa| Ara yadi teAmAdera madhye thAke ekaza leAka, tave jaYI have hAjAra kAphirera opara; kAraNa, tArA emana sampradAYa—yArA vojhe nA|

ekhana AllAha hAlakA kare diYechena teAmAdera theke| tini jene niYechena, teAmAdera madhyakAra durvalatA| ataeva, teAmAdera madhye yadi dRr3hacitta ekaza leAka vidyamAna thAke, tave jaYI have duzora opara| Ara yadi teAmarA eka hAjAra hao tave AllAhara hukume jaYI have du-hAjArera opara| Ara AllAha dhairyazIladera sAthe Achena|

bhU-pRSTha theke raktapAta vandha nA haoYA paryanta navira janya zobhanIYa naYa ye loka vandi kare rAkhave, teAmarA pArthiva sampada kAmanA karo, athaca AllAha cAna AkhirAta| Ara AllAha hacchena parAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa|
yadi AllAhara pakSa theke Age theke pUrva phaYasAlA nA thAkata, tave teAmarA yA grahaNa karacha sejanya tomAdera pAkar3Ao karata mahA zAsti|
tave ekhana teAmarA arjita gAnImAta AhAra karo pavitra o hAlAlarUpe Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

he navi tomAra adhIna vandidera vale dAo, AllAha yadi teAmAdera antare keAno kalyANa raYeche vale jAnena, tave teAmAderake tAra ceYe vahuguNa vezi dAna karavena, yA teAmAdera kAcha theke vinimaYasvarUpa neoYA haYeche| tAchAr3A teAmAdera tini kSamA kare devena| AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
Ara yadi tArA teAmAra sAthe pratAraNA karate cAYa, avazya tArA AllAhara sAtheo itipUrve pratAraNA kareche, ataHpara tini tAdera opara tomAke zaktizAlI karechena| Ara AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche, hijarAta kareche, nijedera jAna o mAla dvArA AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche evaM yArA tAdera AzraYa diYeche o sAhAyya kareche, tArA eke aparera vandhu| Ara yArA ImAna eneche kintu hijarAta kareni; tAdera abhibhAvakatvera dAYitva teAmAdera nei, yatakSaNa nA tArA hijarAta kare| avazya yadi tArA dharmIYa vyApAre teAmAdera sahAYatA kAmanA kare, tave tAdera sAhAyya karA teAmAdera kartavya; kintu teAmAdera sAthe yAdera cukti vidyamAna raYeche, tAdera meAkAvelAYa naYa| AllAha oi viSaYe sarvadraSTA—yA tomarA karo|
Ara yArA kuphuri kareche tArA eke aparera vandhu| yadi teAmarA jihAda nA karo tave pRthivIte phitanA vistAra lAbha karave evaM char3iYe par3ave mahA viparyaYa|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche,o hijarAta kareche evaM AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche evaM yArA tAdera AzraYa diYeche, sAhAyya kareche, tA~rAi haleA prakRta mu’ mina| tAdera janye raYeche, kSamA o sammAnajanaka jIvikA|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche paravartI paryAYe evaM hijarAta kareche evaM teAmAdera sAthe sammilita jihAda kareche, tArAo teAmAderai antarbhukta| Ara yArA AtmIYa, AllAhara vidhAna mate tArA paraspara vezi hakadAra| nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvajJa|
AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera pakSa theke samparkacchedera ghoSaNA tAdera prati, yAdera sAthe tomarA cuktivaddha haYechile muzarikadera madhye theke|
ataHpara teAmarA yamine cAramAsa bhramaNa karo, Ara jene rAkho, tomarA AllAhake akSama karate pArave nA| Ara AllAha avazyai kAphiradera lAJcita karavena|

Ara var3a hAjjera dine AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera pakSa theke leAkadera prati gheASaNA deoYA hacche ye, AllAha muzarikadera theke dAYitvamukta evaM tA~ra rAsUlao| avazya yadi teAmarA tAovA karo, tave tA teAmAdera janya kalyANakara, Ara yadi mukha pherAo, tave jene rekheA, AllAhake teAmarA parAbhUta karate pArave nA| Ara kAphiradera yantraNAdAYaka zAstira susaMvAda dAo|

tave hyA~, ye muzarikadera sAthe teAmarA cuktivaddha, evaM teAmAdera vyApAre tArA keAno truTi kareni, kAuke sAhAyyao kareni teAmAdera viruddhe, tA hale tAdera sAthe kRta cukti tAdera deoYA meYAda paryanta pUrNa karo| avazyai AllAha muttAkidera bhAlovAsena|

ataHpara niSiddha mAsa ativAhita hale muzarikadera hatyA karo yekhAne tAdera pAo, tAdera vandi karo evaM avareAdha karo Ara pratyeka ghA~Tite tAdera sandhAne OMta pete thAka| tave yadi tArA tAovA kare, sAlAta pratiSThA kare, jAkAta pradAna kare, tave tAdera patha cher3e dAo| nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

Ara yadi muzarikadera keu teAmAra kAche AzraYa prArthanA kare, tave tAke AzraYa deve, yAte se AllAhara kAlAma zunate pAYa, ataHpara tAke tAra nirApada sthAne pau~che deve| eTi ejanya ye nizcaYa tArA emana sampradAYa yArA jJAna rAkhe nA|

muzarikadera cukti AllAhara nikaTa o tA~ra rAsUlera nikaTa kIbhAve valavat thAkave tave yAdera sAthe teAmarA cukti sampAdana karecha mAsajidula hArAmera nikaTa| ataeva, ye paryanta tArA teAmAdera janya cuktite dRr3ha. thAke, teAmarAo tAdera janya dRr3ha thAka| nizcaYa AllAha muttAkidera bhAlovAsena|

( kIbhAve valavat thAkave?) athaca tArA teAmAdera opara jaYI hale teAmAdera AtmIYatAra o aGgIkArera keAno maryAdA deve nA| tArA mukhera kathAYa teAmAdera santuSTa kare, kintu tAdera antarasamUha tA asvIkAra kare, Ara tAdera adhikAMza pApAcArI|
tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha nagaNya mUlye vikraYa kare, ataHpara tArA vAdhAdAna kare tA~ra patha theke, nizcaYa tA ati nikRSTa, yA tArA kare|
tArA mu’minadera kSetre AtmIYatAra kono maryAdA deYa nA, nA aGgIkArera| tArAi sImAlaGghanakArI|
avazya tArA yadi tAovA kare, sAlAta pratiSThA kare, Ara jAkAta pradAna kare, tave tArA teAmAdera dIni bhAi| Ara Ami jJAnI leAkadera janya nidarzanasamUha vistArita varNanA kari|

Ara yadi tArA cuktira para tAdera zapatha bhaGga kare, evaM vidrUpa kare teAmAdera dIna samparke, tave kAphira pradhAnadera sAthe jihAda karo| nizcaYa, tAdera kono zapatha nei, sambhavata tArA virata thAkave|

teAmarA ki emana sampradAYera sAthe jihAda karave nA; yArA bhaGga kareche svIYa zapatha evaM saMkalpa niYeche rAsUlake vahiSkArera? Ara tArAi prathama vAra (vivAdera) sUtrapAta kareche| teAmarA ki tAdera bhaYa karo? athaca AllAha adhika hakadAra ye tomarA tA~ke bhaYa karave| yadi teAmarA mu’mina hao|

tomarA tAdera sAthe jihAda karo, AllAha teAmAdera hAte tAdera zAsti devena| tAdera lAJchita karavena, tAdera viruddhe teAmAdera sAhAyya karavena evaM mumina sampradAYera antarasamUhe Arogya dAna karavena|
evaM tAdera antarera kSeAbha dUra karavena| Ara AllAha yAra icchA tAovA kavula karavena, AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

teAmarA ki mane karo ye, teAmAdera emanitei cher3e deoYA have? yatakSaNa nA AllAha jene nevena teAmAdera ke jihAda kareche evaM ke AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o muminadera vyatIta anya kAuke antaraGga vandhurUpe grahaNa karA theke virata raYeche| Ara teAmarA yA karo se viSaYe AllAha samyaka avahita|
muzarikadera adhikAra nei ye, AllAhara masajida AvAda karave, yakhana tArA nijedera kuphurira svIkRti dicche| tAdera Amala varavAda haYeche evaM tArA jAhAnnAmera sthAYI adhivAsI|

nizcaYa tArAi AllAhara mAsajida AvAda karave—yArA ImAna eneche AllAhara prati o kiYAmata-divasera prati evaM sAlAta pratiSThA kareche o jAkAta pradAna kareche; AllAha vyatIta Ara kAuke bhaYa kareni| ataeva, AzA karA yAYa, tArA hidAYAtaprAptadera antarbhukta have|

teAmarA ki hAjidera pAni pAna karAno o mAsajidula hArAma AvAdakaraNake sei leAkera mato mane karo, ye ImAna rAkhe AllAha o AkhirAtera prati evaM jihAda kareche AllAhara pathe| tArA AllAhara dRSTite samAna naYa, Ara AllAha sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYake hidAYAta dAna karena nA|
yArA ImAna eneche, hijarAta kareche evaM AllAhara pathe nijedera jAna o mAla dvArA jihAda kareche, tAdera samunnata maryAdA raYeche AllAhara kAche, Ara tArAi saphalakAma|
tAdera susaMvAda dicchena tAdera rava svIYa daYA o santuSTi evaM emana jAnnAtera sekhAne tAdera janya thAkave sthAYI niYAmata|
sekhAne tArA cirasthAYI| nizcaYa AllAhara kAche Ache mahApuraskAra|

he mu’ minagaNa, teAmarA nijedera pitA o bhAidera abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kareA nA, yadi tArA ImAna apekSA kuphara bhAlovAse| ataeva, teAmAdera madhye yArA tAdera abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kare tArAi sImAlaGghanakArI|

valo, teAmAdera nikaTa yadi teAmAdera pitA, teAmAdera santAna, teAmAdera bhAi, teAmAdera patnI, teAmAdera geAtra, teAmAdera arjita dhana-sampada, teAmAdera vyavasA—yA vandha haYe yAoYAra bhaYa karo evaM teAmAdera vAsasthAna, yAke teAmarA pachanda karo; AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o tA~ra rAstAYa jihAda apekSA adhika priYa haYa, tave apekSA karo, AllAhara vidhAna AsA paryanta, Ara AllAha pApAcArI sampradAYake hidAYAta dAna karena nA|

AllAha teAmAdera sAhAyya karechena aneka sthAne evaM hunAinera dineo, yakhana teAmAdera saMkhyAdhikya teAmAdera praphulla karechila, kintu tA teAmAdera keAno kAje Aseni evaM pRthivI prazasta haoYA sattveo teAmAdera janya tA saMkucita haYechila| ataHpara tomarA pRSThapradarzana kare pAliYechile |

tArapara AllAha, tA~ra rAsUlera prati o mu’mi nadera prati avatIrNa karalena prazAnti evaM avatIrNa karalena emana senAvAhinI yAdera teAmarA dekhate pAoni| Ara zAsti pradAna karalena kAphiradera evaM eTi halo kAphiradera karmaphala|
erapara AllAha yAdera icchA tAovA kavula karavena, Ara AllAha atIva kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

he muminagaNa, nizcaYa muzarikarA teA apavitra| sutarAM e vacharera para tArA yena mAsajidula hArAmera nikaTa nA Ase| Ara yadi teAmarA dAridryera AzaGkA karo, tave zigagira AllAha cAile nija anugrahe teAmAdera abhAvamukta kare devena| nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

teAmarA jihAda karo kitAvidera oi leAkadera sAthe, yArA AllAha o AkhirAtera prati ImAna rAkhe nA, AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla yA hArAma kare diYechena tA hArAma mane kare nA evaM Anugatya kare nA satya dInera, yatakSaNa nA karajeAr3e tArA jiyaiYA pradAna kare, emanabhAve ye tArA lAJchita|

iYAhUdirA vale ujAira AllAhara putra evaM nAsArArA vale mAsIha AllAhara putra| e hacche tAdera mukhera kathA| erA pUrvavartI kAphiradera mato kathA vale| AllAha tAdera dhvaMsa karuna| ye tArA ulTo pathe caleche|

tArA AllAha vyatIta tAdera yAjaka o dharmaguruderake rava hiseve grahaNa kareche, evaM mAraiYAma tanaYa mAsIhake o athaca tArA AdiSTa chila ekamAtra ilAhera ivAdatera janya| tini chAr3A keAno ilAh nei, tArA yeguloke zarika sAvyasta kare, tA theke tini pavitra|
tArA tAdera mukhera phutkAre AllAhara nUra nirvApita karate cAYa; kintu AllAha tA~ra nUrera pUrNatA chAr3A anya kichu pratyAkhyAna karena, yadio kAphirarA tA apachanda kare|
tinii yini preraNa karechena svIYa rAsUlake hidAYAta o satya dIna sahakAre, yena e dI nake anyAnya dInera opara jaYayukta karena, yadio muzarikarA tA apachanda kare|

he mu ‘ minagaNa, nizcaYa dharmayAjaka o saMsAra-virAgIdera aneke mAnuSera sampada anyAYabhAve bheAga kare calache evaM AllAhara patha theke leAkadera vAdhA dicche| Ara yArA sonA o rUpA jamA kare rAkhe evaM tA ‘ AllAhara pathe vyaYa nA kare, tAderake kaTheAra zAstira susaMvAda zuniYe dena|

sedina jAhAnnAmera Agune tA uttapta karA have evaM tA dvArA tAdera lalATa, pArzva o pRSThadezake dagdha karA have, sedina valA have, e to tAi—yA teAmarA nijedera janya jamA rekhechile, sutarAM ekhana AsvAdana karo—yA jamA kare rAkhate|

nizcaYai AllAhara vidhAna o gaNanAYa mAsa vAroTi, AsamAnasamUha o yamina sRSTira dina theke tAra madhye cAraTi sammAnita| eTii supratiSThita vidhAna; sutarAM era madhye teAmarA nijedera prati avicAra kareA nA| Ara muzarikadera sAthe teAmarA jihAda karo samavetabhAve, yemana tArAo teAmAdera sAthe yuddha kare yAcche samavetabhAve| Ara mane rekheA, nizcaYa AllAha muttAkidera sAthe|

prakRtapakSe ei mAsa pichiYe deoYA zudhu kupharira mAtrAi vRddhi kare, yAra phale kAphirarA bhraSTatAYa patita haYa| erA eTAke eka vachara hAlAla kare, Areka vachara hArAma kare, yena tArA AllAhara hArAmakRta mAsaguleAra gaNanA pUrNa kare neYa| ataHpara hAlAla kare neYa AllAhara hArAmakRta mAsaguleAke| tAdera mandakAjaguleA tAdera janya zeAbhanIYa kare deoYA haYeche| Ara AllAha kAphira sampradAYake hidAYAta dAna karena nA|

he mu ‘ minagaNa, teAmAdera kI halo, yakhana AllAhara pathe vera haoYAra janya teAmAdera valA haYa, takhana pravalabhAve jhu~ke par3o, teAmarA ki AkhirAtera parivarte pArthiva-jIvane santuSTa haYe gele? athaca AkhirAtera tulanAYa pArthiva-jIvanopakaraNa ati alpa|

yadi tomarA vera nA hao tave tini teAmAdera yantraNAdAYaka zAsti devena evaM apara jAti dvArA teAmAdera parivartana karavena| teAmarA tA~ra keAno kSati karate pArave nA, Ara AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

yadi teAmarA tAke sAhAyya nA karo, tave avazyai AllAha tAke sAhAyya karechilena, yakhana tAke kAphirarA vera karechila| tini chilena dujanera ekajana, yakhana tArA guhAra madhye chila| takhana tini Apana saGgIke valalena, duzcintA karo nA, nizcaYa AllAha AmAdera sAthe| ataHpara AllAha tAra prati prazAnti Dhele dilena evaM tA~ra sAhAyya karalena emana sainya vAhinI dvArA, yAdera teAmarA dekhani| Ara AllAha kAphiradera kathAke nicu kare dilena Ara AllAhara vANIi sadA samunnata evaM AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tomarA hAlakA o bhArI avasthAYa vera hao, evaM svIYa jAna-mAla diYe AllAhara pathe jihAda karo, eTAi tomAdera janya uttama yadi tomarA jAnate|

yadi Azu sampadalAbhera sambhAvanA thAkata evaM yAtrApatha sugama hateA, tave tArA avazyai ApanAra sahayAtrI hateA, kintu tAdera nikaTa kaSTasAdhya yAtrApatha sudIrgha mane halo| Ara acirei tArA AllAhara nAme zapatha kare valave, yadi AmAdera sAdhya thAkata tave avazyai teAmAdera sAthe vera hatAma, tArA nijerAi nijedera dhvaMsa karache, Ara AllAha jAnena—nizcaYa tArA mithyAvAdI|
AllAha tomAke kSamA karechena, tumi kena tAdera avyAhati dile, yatakSaNa nA tomAra kAche pariSkAra haYe yAYa yArA satya valeche evaM tumi jene nAo mithyAvAdIdera|
prakRtapakSe yAdera AllAha o AkhirAtera prati ImAna raYeche tArA mAla o jAna dvArA jihAda karA theke tomAra kAche avyAhati kAmanA kare nA, Ara AllAha muttAkidera viSaYa samyaka jJAta|
prakRtapakSe tArAi tomAra kAche avyAhati cAYa, yArA AllAha o AkhirAtera prati ImAna rAkhe nA evaM tAdera antara sandehagrasta haYe par3eche, sutarAM tArA sandehera Avarte ghurapAka khacche|

Ara yadi tArA vera havAra saMkalpa karata, tave avazyai kichu saraJjAma prastuta karata; kintu tAdera abhiyAtrA AllAha apachanda karechena, phale tAdera virata rAkhalena evaM valA halo tomarA vasA leAkadera sAthe vase thAko|

yadi tArA teAmAdera sAthe vera hato, tave teAmAdera aniSTa chAr3A Ara kichu vRddhi karata nA, Ara azva chuTAta teAmAdera madhye vibheda sRSTira uddezye| Ara teAmAdera mAjhe raYeche tAdera guptacara| Ara AllAha sImAlaGghanakArIdera vyapAre samyaka jJAta|
tArA pUrve thekei vibheda sRSTira suyeAga sandhAne chila evaM tomAra kAryasamUha ulaTa-pAlaTa kare dicchila| zeSa paryanta satya eseche evaM vijaYI halo AllAhara hukuma, athaca tArA apachandakArI|
Ara tAdera keu keu vale, AmAke avyAhati dina evaM AmAke viparyaYe phelavena nA| sAvadhAna! tArA teA pUrva thekei viparyaYe patita Ara nizcaYa jAhAnnAma avazyai kAphiradera pariveSTanakArI|
yadi tomAra keAno kalyANa haYa tave tArA kaSTa pAYa, evaM keAno vipada upasthita hale tArA vale, AmarA pUrva thekei nijedera kAja sAmale niYechi evaM phire yAYa ematAvasthAYa ye tArA ullasita|
valo, AllAha AmAdera janya yA lipivaddha kare rekhechena, tA chAr3A kakhano kono vipada AmAdera kAche pau~chAve nA| tini AmAdera abhibhAvaka, Ara mu’ minadera ucita AllAhara oparai bharasA karA|

valo, teAmarA to AmAdera janya duTi kalyANera ekaTi pratyAzA karo; Ara AmarA apekSA karachi teAmAdera janya ye, AllAha tomAdera tAra pakSa theke zAstira vyavasthA karavena athavA AmAdera hAta dvArA| sutarAM teAmarA apekSA karo, nizcaYa AmarAo teAmAdera sAthe apekSamANa|
valo, teAmarA icchAYa vA anicchAYa artha vyaYa karo, teAmAdera theke tA kakhaneA kavula have nA, nizcaYa tomarA pApAcArI sampradAYa|
tAdera artha vyaYa kavula nA haoYAra zudhu eTAi kAraNa ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati avizvAsI, tArA sAlAte Ase alasatAra sAthe o vyaYa kare saMkucita mane|
sutarAM tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati yena tomAke vismita nA kare| AllAha tA dvArA pArthiva-jIvane tAdera zAstite nipatita rAkhate cAna evaM tAdera AtmA cale yAYa ematAvasthAYa—tArA kAphira|
tArA AllAhara nAme halapha kare vale ye, tArA teAmAderai antarbhukta, athaca tArA teAmAdera antarbhukta naYa, avazya tArA emana sampradAYa yArA bhaYa kare|
yadi tArA keAno AzraYasthala athavA kono guhA vA mAthA geA~jAra ThA~i peta, tave sedike palAYana karata Ara tArA drutagatite chuTata|
tAdera madhye emana leAkao raYeche—yArA sadakA vaNTane ApanAke deASAropa kare| yadi tA theke kichu deoYA haYa santuSTa haYa evaM yadi nA deoYA haYa vikSuvdha haYa|

katai nA bhAlo hato, yadi tArA tAra opara santuSTa hato—yA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla tAdera dAna karechena evaM valata, AllAhai AmAdera janya yatheSTa, acirei AllAha AmAdera devena nija karuNAYa evaM tA~ra rAsUlao, nizcaYa AmarA AllAhara pratii anurakta|

prakRtapakSe yAkAta phakira, misakIna, yAkAta AdAYakArI o vidharmIdera AkarSaNera praYojane, evaM tA dAsamuktira janya, RNagrastadera janya, AllAhara pathe jihAdakArIdera janya evaM musAphiradera janya, ei halo AllAhara nirdhArita vidhAna| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara tAdera madhye kichu loka navike kaSTa deYa, evaM vale, e leAkaTi teA kAna kathAra zravaNakArI| valo, zravaNakArI haleo tA teAmAderai maGgalera janya, tini AllAhara opara ImAna Anena evaM AsthA rAkhena mu’minadera opara| Ara rAhamAta tAdera janya tomAdera madhyakAra yArA ImAna Ane| Ara yArA AllAhara rAsulake kaSTa deYa, tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
tArA teAmAdera sAmane AllAhara nAme zapatha kare yena tomAderara santuSTa karate pAre; kintu AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla adhika hakadAra ye, tArA tA~ke santuSTa karave, yadi tArA mumina haYe thAke|
tArA ki jAnate pAreni ye, nizcaYa ye AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe meAkAvelA kare tAhale tAra janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera Aguna, tArA sekhAne sthAYI| nizcaYa eTAi carama apamAna|

munAphikarA e vyApAre bhaYa kare ye, tAdera vyApAre emana kono sUrA avatIrNa karA have, yAte tAdera antarera geApana viSaYa jAniYe deve| su tarAM valo, ThATTA-vidrupa karate thAko; nizcaYai AllAha tA prakAzakArI—yA teAmarA bhaYa karacha|

Ara tumi tAdera jijJesa karale avazyai avazyai tArA valave, AmarA teA kathAra kathA valachilAma evaM kautuka karachilAma| valo, teAmarA ki AllAhara sAthe, tA~ra hukuma-AhakAmera sAthe evaM tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe ThATTA karachile?
tomarA ajuhAta peza karo nA, avazyai teAmarA ImAna AnaYanera para kuphuri karecha| teAmAdera madhye ekaTi dalake kSamA kare dileo anya dalake Thikai zAsti deva; kenanA, avazyai tArA chila avAdhya|

munAphika nara-nArI eke aparera aMza; tArA manda kAjera nirdeza deYa, kalyANakara kAja theke virata rAkhe| evaM guTiYe rAkhe tAdera hAta satkAja theke| tArA AllAhake bhule geche, phale tinio bhule gechena| nizcaYai munAphikarA pApAcArI|

AllAh oYAdA karechena munAphika puruSa o munAphika nArIdera evaM kAphiradera janya jAhAnnAmera Agunera| tArA sekhAne sthAYI| eTAi tAdera janya yatheSTa| Ara AllAha tAdera prati abhisampAta karechena evaM tAdera janya raYeche sthAYI zAsti|

yemana teAmAdera pUrvavartI leAkerA chila teAmAdera ceYe vezi zaktizAlI evaM adhika dhana-sampada o santAna-santatira adhikArIo; ataHpara tArA nijedera aMza bhoga kareche, sutarAM tomarAo tomAdera aMza upabhoga karo yemana tomAdera pUrvavartIrA tAdera aMza bhoga kareche, evaM tomarA temanai anarthaka valacha yemana tArA valechila| duniYA o AkhirAte tAdera Amala akejo haYe geche| Ara tArAi kSatigrasta|

tAdera kAche ki tAdera pUrvavartIdera saMvAda Aseni, nUha, A’da o sAmUda sampradAYera, evaM ivarAhImera sampradAYa o mAdaiYAnavAsIra? Ara sesava vidhvasta janapadera, yAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa spaSTa nidarzana niYe esechilena| Ara AllAha emana nana ye, tAdera opara avicAra karavena! kintu tArA nijerAi nijedera opara avicAra karata|

Ara mumina puruSa o mu’mina nArI eke aparera sahAYaka| tArA satkAjera nirdeza deYa evaM asat kAja theke vAdhA pradAna kare| sAlAta pratiSThA kare, jAkAta pradAna kare evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare| oisava loka acirei AllAha tAdera opara daYA karavena| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazIla, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha mu’mina puruSa o nArIdera pratizruti diYechena emana jAnnAtera yAra taladeze pravAhita haYa nada-nadI| tArA sekhAne sthAYI| Ara sthAYI jAnnAte thAkave tAdera uttama nivAsa| Ara savaceYe var3a halo AllAhara santuSTi| eTii mahAsaphalatA|
he navi, kAphiradera evaM munAphikadera sAthe jihAda karo o tAdera prati kaTheAra hao| tAdera ThikAnA halo jAhAnnAma evaM tA katai nA nikRSTa pratyArtanasthala|

tArA AllAhara nAme zapatha kare vale, tArA valeni, athaca tArA avazyai kuphuri kathA valeche evaM isalAmagrahaNera para AvAra kuphuri kareche| tArA kAmanA karechila emana vastura, yA tArA pAYani| tArA pratizodha nicche nA; kintu ejanya ye, AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla svIYa anugraha dvArA tAdera abhAvamukta karechena| yadi tArA tAovA kare eTA tAdera janyei bhAlo, Ara yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tave AllAha tAderake duniYA o AkhirAte yantraNAdAYaka zAsti bhoga karAvena| pRthivIte tAdera nei kono vandhu vA sAhAyyakArI|
tAdera madhye keu keu AllAhara sAthe oYAdA karechila ye, tini AmAdera prati anugraha karale avazyai AmarA vyaYa karava evaM antarbhukta haYe yAva| satkarmazIladera
ataHpara yakhana tAderake svIYa anugraha dAna karalena, takhana tAte kArpaNya karala evaM mukha phiriYe nila, ematAvasthAYa tArA viruddhabhAvApanna|
sutarAM tArai pariNatite tAdera antare kapaTatA sthAna kare niYeche, tAra sAthe sAkSAtera dina paryanta| kAraNa, tArA AllAhara sAthe kRta oYAdA laGghana karechila evaM mithyA valata|
tArA ki jAne nA ye, nizcaYa AllAha tAdera supta viSaYa o gopana parAmarza samparke avagata evaM AllAha samasta geApana viSaYa samparke samyaka jJAta|

yArA bhartsanA kare sesava mu ‘ minadera prati yArA mana khule sAdAkAkArI evaM tAdera prati yAdera kichui nei zudhu nijera parizrama chAr3A| tAi tArA tAdera prati ThATTA kare| AllAha tAdera ThATTAra javAva dena, evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

tumi tAdera janya kSamAprArthanA karo Ara nAi karo| yadi tumi tAdera janya sattaravArao kSamAprArthanA karo tave kakhano AllAha tAderake kSamA karavena nA| tA ejanya ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlake asvIkAra karata| Ara AllAha pApiSTha sampradAYake hidAYAta dena nA|

pazcAtvartIrA AllAhara rAsUlera vipakSe vase thAkate Ananda peYeche; tArA nijedera jAna o mAla dvArA jihAda karAke apachanda kareche| tArA vale, garamera madhye abhiyAne vera haYeA nA| valo, jAhAnnAmera Aguna uttApe pracaNDatama| yadi tArA vivecanA karata|
ataeva, tAdera ucita alpa hAsA evaM vezi kA~dA tAdera kRtakarmera pratiphalasvarUpa—yA tArA upArjana karata|

AllAha yadi tomAke tAdera kono dalera dike phiriYe Anena evaM tArA tomAra kAche abhiyAne ve ra haoYAra anumati cAYa, takhana valo, teAmarA kakhano AmAra sAthe vera have nA evaM AmAra pakSa haYe kakhano keAno zatrura sAthe jihAda karave nA, nizcaYa teA marA teA prathamavAra vase thAkA pachanda karecha, ataeva pechane par3e thAkA leAkadera sAthei vase thAko|

Ara tAdera kArao mRtyu hale tumi kakhano tAra sAlAta par3ave nA evaM tAra kavare dA~r3Ave nA| nizcaYa tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe kuphuri kareche| tArA mArA geche ematAvasthAYa ye—tArA pApAcArI|
tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna santati yena tomAke mugdha nA kare| prakRtapakSe AllAha cAna ye, tA dvArA pRthivItei tAdera zAsti devena, evaM tAdera prANa nirgata have kAphira avasthAYa|

Ara yakhanai kono sUrA avatIrNa haYa, ye teAmarA AllAhara prati ImAna Ano evaM tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe ekAtma haYe jihAda karo, takhana tAdera sAmarthyavAna lokerA tomAra kAche avyAhati cAYa| evaM tArA vale, AmAdera chAr3ena, AmarA upaviSTadera sAthe thAkava|
tArA pazcAtvartIdera sAthe thAkate pere Anandita haYeche| Asale meAhara e~Te deoYA haYeche tAdera antarasamUhera opara| phale tArA veAjhe nA|
kintu rAsUla evaM tA~ra sAthe yArA ImAna eneche, tArA jihAda kareche nijedera jAna o mAla dvArA| tAdera janya nirdhArita raYeche kalyANasamUha evaM tArAi saphalakAma|
AllAha tAdera janya tairi kare rekhechena emana jAnnAta, yAra taladeze pravAhita raYeche nada-nadI| tArA tAte sthAYI| eTAi mahA sAphalya|

Ara apAragatA prakAzakArI veduina leAkerA ela, yena tAdera avyAhati deoYA haYa, Ara vase thAkala, tAdera sAthe yArA AllAha o rAsUlake mithyA valeche| zigagira tAdera madhye yArA kAphira tAdera yantraNAdAYaka zAsti pau~chave|

durvala, rugaNa, vyaYabhAra vahane asamartha leAkadera janya keAno aparAdha nei, yakhana tArA AllAha o rAsUlera kSetre kalyANakAmI have| puNyavAnadera opara abhiyeAgera keAno patha nei| Ara AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

Ara yArA tomAra nikaTa eseche yena tumi tAdera vAhanera vyavasthA karo, evaM tumi valecha, AmAra kAche emana kichu nei, yAte teAmAdera ArohaNa karAva takhana tArA azrusikta cokhe phire geche e duHkhe ye, tArA kharaca karAra mato kichu pAcche nA|

prakRtapakSe abhiyeAga tAdera vyApAre, yArA tomAra nikaTa avyAhati cAYa; athaca tArA sampadazAlI| yArA pechane par3e thAkA leAkadera sAthe thAkate pere Anandita| Ara AllAha meAhara e~Te diYechena tAdera antarasamUhe| phale tArA jAnate pAre nA|

tomarA yakhana tAdera kAche phire Asave takhana tArA tomAdera kAche apAragatA prakAza karave| valo, ‘tomarA apAragatA dekhiYo nA, AmarA kakhano tomAdera kathA vizvAsa karava nA| AllAha tomAdera khavara AmAderake jAniYechena| AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla acirei tomAdera Amala dekhavena, erapara tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have dRzya o adRzyera jJAnI sattAra kAche; ataHpara tini tomAderake jAniYe devena sesava viSaYa yA tomarA karachile|’

acirei tArA tomAdera sAmane AllAhara nAme zapatha karave yakhana tomarA tAdera kAche phire yAve; yena tomarA tAdera viSaYaTA upekSA karo| sutarAM tomarA tAderake upekSA karo; nizcaYai tArA nApAka evaM tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma, sesavera pratiphalasvarUpa yA tArA karata|
tArA tomAdera sAmane zapatha karave, yena tAdera prati tomarA santuSTa hao| tave yadi tomarA tAdera prati santuSTao hao tavu kichutei AllAha ei pApAcArI jAtira prati santuSTa havena nA|

veduinarA kuphara o kapaTatAYa atyanta kaTheAra; evaM tArA adhika upayogI ye, AllAha tA~ra rAsUlera opara yA avatIrNa karechena tAra sImArekhA samparke tArA ajJa thAkave| Ara AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

AvAra kichu veduina Ache tArA yA-kichu (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kare tAke jarimAnA mane kare evaM tomAdera opara durdina AsAra apekSAYa thAke| vAstave tAderai opara durdina Ase| Ara AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

Ara kichu veduina Ache yArA ImAna Ane AllAhara opara, kiYAmAta divasera opara evaM yA-kichu nijerA vyaYa kare tA AllAhara naikaTya evaM rAsUlera du’A-lAbhera upAYa vale gaNya kare| mane rekho, nizcaYai tA tAdera janya naikaTya| AllAha acirei tAderake nijera rAhamAtera madhye praveza karAvena| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

Ara muhAjira o AnasAradera mAjhe yArA prathama agragAmI evaM yArA tAderake anusaraNa kareche satatAra sAthe AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa haYechena evaM tArAo tA~ra prati santuSTa haYeche| Ara tAdera janya tini prastuta karechena emana jAnnAta, yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita haYa nada-nadI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have cirakAla| eTAi halo mahA-saphalatA|

tomAdera AzepAzera kichu veduina Ache munAphika, Ara mAdInAra kichu adhivAsI atimAtrAYa lipta haYeche kapaTatAra madhye| tumi tAderake jAno nA, Ami tAderake jAni| Ami acirei tAderake duvAra zAsti deva, erapara tAderake bhaYAvaha zAstira dike pherAno have|

Ara apara kichu loka nijedera bhula svIkAra kareche, yArA satkarmera sAthe anyAYa kAjera mizraNa ghaTiYeche| AzA karA yAYa ye, AllAha tAdera tAovA kavula karavena; nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

tAdera sampada theke sAdAkA grahaNa kareA, yAra mAdhyame tumi tAderake pavitra o parizuddha karave evaM tAdera janya duA karave| nizcaYai tomAra duA tAdera janya eka parama prazAnti| Ara AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
tArA ki jAne nA ye, AllAha tAra vAndAdera theke tAovA kavula karena evaM (tAdera) dAna-khaYarAta grahaNa karena| Ara nizcaYai AllAha tAovA kavulakArI, asIma daYAlu|

valo, ‘teAmarA Amala karate thAko; acirei AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o mu’minagaNa tomAdera Amala dekhavena| evaM acirei tomAderake dRzya o adRzya samparke jJAta sattAra kAche phiriYe neoYA have, erapara tini tomAderake avagata karavena sesava viSaYe yA tomarA karate|
Ara apara kichu loka (samparke phAYasAlA) AllAhara nirdezera janya sthagita raYeche—haYato tini tAderake zAsti devena; athavA tAderake kSamA kare devena| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara yArA masajida nirmANa kareche kSatisAdhana, kuphuri evaM mu’minadera madhye vibheda sRSTira uddezye, Ara itaHpUrve AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhe ye lar3Ai kareche tAdera ghA~Ti hiseve, tArA avazyai zapatha kare (vale), ‘kalyANa vyatIta AmAdera Ara kono uddezya chila nA;’ Ara AllAha sAkSya dicchena—nizcaYai tArA mithyAvAdI|

tumi sekhAne (sAlAte) dA~r3Ave nA kakhano| avazyai ye mAsajida prathama dina theke sthApita haYeche tAkaoYAra opara, se sthAnai vezi hakadAra ye, tumi sekhAne dA~r3Ave| sekhAne raYeche emana aneka leAka yArA bhAlovAse ye, tArA uttamarUpe pavitratA arjana karave| Ara AllAha uttamarUpe pavitratA arjanakArIderake bhAlovAsena|

ye vyakti tAra gharera bhitti sthApana kareche AllAhara bhaYa o santuSTira opara se uttama, nAki oi vyakti ye tAra gharera bhitti sthApana kareche eka patanonmukha gartera kinArAYa, ataHpara tA tAke niYe dhvase par3ala jAhAnnAmera Agune? Ara AllAha sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYake hidAYAta dena nA|
tAdera nirmita ghara sadA tAdera antare sandehera udreka kare yAve, yatakSaNa nA tAdera antaraguleA caucira haYe yAYa| Ara AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYai AllAha kine niYechena mu ’ minadera theke tAdera jAna o mAla jAnnAtera vinimaYe| tArA yuddha kare AllAhara pathe, ataHpara tArA hatyA kare o tArA nihatao haYa| tAorAta, inajIla o kuraAne e viSaYe satya pratizruti raYeche| Ara ke Ache AllAhara ceYe adhika pratizruti rakSAkArI? sutarAM teAmarA tA~ra sAthe ye lenadena karecha se janya Anandita hao, Ara eTAi mahAsAphalya|

tArA tAovAkArI, ivAdAtakArI, (AllAhara) prazaMsAkArI, siYAma pAlanakArI, rukukArI, sijadAkArI, satkAjera Adeza dAnakArI o asatkAja theke niSedhakArI evaM AllAhara deoYA vidhAnasamUhera hiphAjatakArI; Ara (he navi, emana) mu ’ minaderake susaMvAda dAo|

kono navi o mu ’ minera janya zobhanIYa naYa ye, tArA mAgaphirAta kAmanA karave muzarikadera janya, yadio tArA nikaTAtmIYa haYa, yakhana tAdera kAche suspaSTa haYe geche ye, nizcaYai tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

Ara nija pitAra janya ivarAhImera mAgaphirAta kAmanA chila kevala sei pratizrutira kAraNe, yA se tAra sAthe karechila| ataHpara yakhana tAra kAche ekathA spaSTa haYe gela ye, se satyii AllAhara zatru, takhana se tAra theke samparka chinna kare nila| nizcaYai ivarAhIma chila var3a keAmala hRdaYa, sahanazIla|

Ara AllAha emana nana ye, tini pathabhraSTa karavena keAno jAtike hidAYAta karAra para, yatakSaNa nA tAdera janya spaSTa kare dena sesava viSaYa yA theke tAderake ve~ce thAkate have; nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvajJa|
nizcaYai AllAhara janyai AkAzasamUha o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatva; tinii jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna| Ara AllAha vyatIta teAmAdera janya nei kono abhibhAvaka evaM kono sAhAyyakArI|

avazyai AllAha tAovA kavula karechena navi, muhAjira o AnasAradera theke, yArA kaThina muhUrte navira anusaraNa kareche; tAdera madhya theke ekadalera antara Tale yAoYAra upakrama haYechila, era parao AllAha tAdera tAovA kavula karechena| nizcaYai AllAha tAdera prati snehazIla, asIma daYAlu|

evaM (tAovA kavula karechena) sei tinajanerao; yAdera vyApAre siddhAnta mulatuvi rAkhA haYechila; eka paryAYe yakhana pRthivI vistRta haoYA sattveo tAdera janya tA saMkucita haYe gela evaM tAdera jIvana durviSaha haYe uThala; takhana tArA vujhate pArala ye, nei keAno AzraYasthala AllAha vyatIta| tArapara tini tAdera tAovA kavula karalena, yena tArA phire Ase| nizcaYai AllAha adhika tAovA kavulakArI, asIma daYAlu|
