he yArA ImAna enecha, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM satyavAdIdera sAthe thAko|

mAdInAvAsI o pArzvavartI veduInadera vaidha chila nA ye, tArA AllAhara rAsUlera saGga tyAga kare pechane theke yAve evaM rAsUlera prANa theke nijedera prANake yena tArA adhika priYa mane nA kare| eTi ejanya ye—nizcaYai AllAhara pathe ye tRSNA, klAnti o kSudhA tAderake sparza kare evaM tAdera emana padakSepa—yA kAphiradera mane kreAdhera kAraNa haYa, Ara zatrudera pakSa theke tArA yA-kichu prApta haYa, tAra pratyekaTira parivarte tAdera janya likhita haYa neka Amala| nizcaYai AllAha niSThAvAna satkarmazIla leAkadera pratidAna naSTa karena nA|
Ara tArA alpa-vistara yA kichu vyaYa kare, yata prAntara tArA atikrama kare, tA savai tAdera nAme lekhA haYa— yena tArA yA kichu kare AllAha tAderake tAra uttama vinimaYa dAna karena|

Ara mu’minadera janya saMgata naYa ye, tArA sakale ekatre abhiyAne veriYe par3ave| tAi tAdera pratyeka dalera ekaTi aMza kena vera haleA nA, yena tArA dInera vyApAre gabhIra jJAna lAbha karate pAre evaM satarka karate pAre tAdera jAtike, yakhana tArA tAdera kAche pratyAvartana kare, yena tArA satarka haYa|

he yArA ImAna enecha, tomarA yuddha cAliYe yAo teAmAdera nikaTavartI kAphiradera viruddhe, emanabhAve yena tArA teAmAdera madhye kaTheAratA dekhate pAYa| Ara jene rekho, AllAha muttAkidera sAthe raYechena|

Ara yakhanai keAno sUrA avatIrNa haYa, takhana tAdera kichu loka vale, ‘e sUrA teAmAdera kAra kAra ImAna vRddhi karala?’ ataeva, yArA ImAna eneche, tAderai ImAna vRddhi kareche evaM tArA Anandita haYa|
Ara yAdera antare vyAdhi raYeche, e sUrA tAdera kaluSatAra sAthe Arao kaluSatA vRddhi kareche, Ara tArA mRtyuvaraNa kare ematAvasthAYa ye—tArA kAphira|
tArA ki lakSa kare nA ye, tArA parIkSAra mukhomukhi hacche prati vachara ekavAra kiMvA duvAra? tArA eraparao tAovA kare nA evaM upadeza grahaNa kare nA|

Ara yakhanai keAno sUrA avatIrNa haYa, takhana tAdera kataka katakera dike tAkAYa ye, ‘teAmAderake keu dekhache ki?’ ataHpara tArA sare par3e| AllAha odera antaraguloke satyavimukha kare diYechena| e-kAraNe ye, tArA emana sampradAYa—yArA anudhAvana kare nA|
avazyai teAmAdera kAche eseche teAmAderai madhya theke ekajana rAsUla| teAmAdera duHkha-kaSTa tAra pakSe duHsaha| tini teAmAdera khuvai maGgalakAmI, mu’minadera prati snehazIla, daYAlu|
tavuo yadi tArA vimukha haYe thAke, tave valo, ‘AllAhai AmAra janya yatheSTa, tini vyatIta Ara kono (satya) ilAha nei| Ami tA~ra oparai bharasA kari evaM tinii mahAna Arazera adhipati|’
Alipha lA-ma rA, eguleA prajJApUrNa kitAvera AYAtasamUha|

mAnuSera kAche ki Azcaryajanaka haYeche ye, Ami tAderai madhya theke ekajana lokera kAche oYAhi pAThiYechi ei marme ye, tumi mAnuSake satarka karo evaM susaMvAda dAo tAderake yArA ImAna eneche ye, nizcaYai tAdera janya raYeche prakRta maryAdA tAdera ravera kAche| kAphirarA valala, ‘nizcaYai e leAka ekaTA prakAzya jAdukara|’

nizcaYai teAmAdera rava AllAha, yini AsamAna o yamina chaYa dine sRSTi karechena; ataHpara tini Araze isatioYA karechena| tini sakala kArya paricAlanA karena| tA~ra anumati vyatIta kono supArizakArI nei| tinii AllAha, teAmAdera rava; ataeva, teAmarA tA~rai ivAdAta karo| tavuo ki teAmarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?

tA~rai kAche teAmAdera sakalake pratyAvartana (karate have); AllAhara oYAdA satya, nizcaYai tinii sRSTike astitve Anena, AvAra tinii punarutthita karavena, yena tini pratidAna dite pArena tAderake yArA ImAna eneche evaM neka kAja kareche inasAphera sAthe| Ara yArA kuphuri kareche, tAdera janya thAkave phuTanta pAnIYa evaM yantraNAdAYaka zAsti—tArA ye kuphuri karata tAra pratiphalasvarUpa|

tinii sei sattA, yini sUryake karechena dIptimaYa, Ara cA~dake diYechena snigdha AleA| ataHpara nirdhArita karechena era janya vibhinna manajila, yAte kare teAmarA cinate pAra vacharaguleAra saMkhyA o (samaYera) hisAva| AllAha tA sRSTi karenani yathAyatha paddhati chAr3A| tini vistArita varNanA karena AYAtasamUha sei sampradAYera janya yArA jJAna rAkhe|
nizcaYai rAta o dinera Avartana evaM yA-kichu tini sRSTi karechena AsamAna o yamine, esavera madhye avazyai aneka nidarzana raYeche emana sampradAYera janya yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare|
nizcaYai yArA AmAra sAkSAtera AzA/vizvAsa rAkhe nA, Ara tArA santuSTa haYe geche pArthiva jIvana niYei, Ara tAtei prazAnti anubhava kareche evaM yArA AmAra nirdazanasamUha samparke vekhavara;
tAdera ThikAnA halo jAhAnnAmera Aguna, sesavera kAraNe yA tArA upArjana karata|
nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche, tAdera rava tAderake patha dekhAvena tAdera ImAnera kAraNe niYAmAtapUrNa jAnnAtera dike, tAdera taladeza diYe pravAhita have nada-nadI|
sekhAne tAdera dhvani have, ‘he AllAha, ApanAra sattA pavitra’, Ara abhivAdana have ‘sAlAma’, evaM tAdera zeSa dhvani have, ‘sakala prazaMsA jagatsamUhera rava AllAhara janya’|

Ara yadi AllAha tAr3Ahur3A kare mAnuSake akalyANa dite cAitena, kalyANera vyApAre tAdera tAtkSaNika kAmanAra mato, tAhale tAdera AYu zeSa haYe yeta| sutarAM yArA AmAra sAkSAtera AzA kare nA, Ami tAderake tAdera avAdhyatAra mAjhe cher3e dii; phale tArA udbhrAnta haYe ghurApherA kare|

Ara yakhana sparza kare mAnuSake kaSTa, takhana se zuYe vase vA dA~r3iYe AmAke DAkate thAke| ataHpara yakhana Ami tAke tAra kaSTa dUra kare dii, takhana se emanabhAve cale, yena se kakhaneA keAno kaSTera sammukhIna haYe AmAke DAkeini| emanibhAve sImAlaGghanakArIdera kAche suzobhita karA haYeche yA tArA karata|

avazyai teAmAdera pUrve Ami vahu mAnavagoSThIke dhvaMsa kare diYechi, yakhana tArA sImAlaGghana kareche| Ara rAsUlagaNa tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzana niYe eseche; kintu tArA emana chila nA ye, tArA ImAna Anave| ebhAve Ami pApAcArI sampradAYake pratiphala diYe thAki|
ataHpara Ami tomAderake tAdera pare pRthivIte sthalAbhiSikta vAniYechi, yena Ami dekhi tomarA kemana Amala karo|

Ara yakhana tAdera kAche suspaSTa pramANasaha AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa, takhana AmAra sAthe yArA sAkSAtera pratyAzA kare nA, tArA vale, ‘eTi chAr3A anya kuraAna niYe eseA, athavA eke parivartana kare dAo|’ valo, ‘AmAra kAja naYa ye, Ami tA nijera pakSa theke parivartana karava| Ami se nirdezerai anusaraNa kari, yA AmAra kAche oYAhi Ase| yadi Ami AmAra ravera avAdhya hai, tave Ami mahAdivasera zAstira bhaYa kari|’

valo, ‘AllAha cAile Ami eTi teAmAdera sAmane tilAoYAta karatAma nA, evaM e samparke tini tomAderake avahita karatena nA| tAchAr3A avazyai Ami itaHpUrve tomAdera mAjhe ekaTA vaYasa vasavAsa karechi; tArapareo ki teAmarA vujhave nA?’
tAra ceYe var3a yAlima Ara ke Ache, ye AllAhara prati mithyAreApa kare vA tA~ra AYAtasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kare? nizcaYai pApIrA saphalakAma haYa nA|

Ara tArA AllAhake cher3e emana kichura upAsanA kare, yA tAdera keAno kSati karate pAre nA, upakArao karate pAre nA, evaM tArA vale, ‘erA AllAhara kAche AmAdera supArizakArI|’ valo, ‘teAmarA ki AllAhake emana viSaYe avahita karacha, yA tini jAnena nA AsamAna o yaminera madhye?’ tini pavitra o mahAna sesava theke, yA tArA zarika sAvyasta kare|

Ara sakala mAnuSa chila ekai ummAta, ataHpara tArA matabheda kareche| Ara yadi teAmAra ravera pakSa theke phAYasAlA pUrva-nirdhArita nA hato; tave tArA tAdera mAjhe ye viSaYa niYe matavireAdha karache tAra mImAMsA haYei yeta|

tArA vale, ‘kena tAra opara tAra ravera pakSa theke keAno nidarzana avatIrNa karA halo nA?’ vale dAo, ‘adRzya viSaYa ekamAtra AllAhai jAnena| tomarA apekSA karo, nizcaYai Amio teAmAdera sAthe apekSAYa railAma|’

Ara yakhana Ami mAnuSake anugrahera svAda AsvAdana karAi tAderake duHkha sparza karAra para, takhanai tArA AmAra AYAta niYe cakrAnta zuru kare| valo, ‘AllAha druta cakrAntera javAva dite sakSama|’ nizcaYai AmAra pherezatArA likhe rAkhache yA tomarA cakrAnta karo|

tinii, yini teAmAderake bhramaNa karAna sthale o jale| emanaki yakhana teAmarA nauyAne thAko, Ara tAderake niYe vaYe cale anukUla vAtAse evaM ete tArA Anandita haYa, Thika takhanai segulora upara Ase jhar3ohAoYA, Ara sarva dika theke seguleAra upara chuTe Ase uttAla taraGga, Ara tArA nizcita dhAraNA kare ye, tArA segulora mAjhe pariveSTita haYe par3eche, takhana tArA AllAhake DAke tAra janya dInake ekaniSTha kare| (tArA takhana vale) yadi Apani AmAdera e theke uddhAra karena, tA hale avazyai AmarA hava kRtajJadera antarbhukta|

tArapara tini yakhana tAdera uddhAra karalena, takhanai tArA pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi karala anyAYabhAve| he mAnuSa, zeAno, teAmAdera avAdhyatA teAmAdera opara par3ave, pArthiva jIvanera bheAga-vilAsa mAtra| ataHpara AmAra nikaTai tomAdera pratyAvartana| takhana Ami tomAdera jAniYe deva, yA teAmarA karachile|

pArthivajIvanera udAharaNa kevala emana pAnira mato, yA Ami AsamAna theke varSaNa karechi, ataHpara tA mizrita haYa yaminera udbhide, yA theke khAYa mAnuSa o jIva-janturA| emanaki yamina yakhana zobhita o susajjita haYa evaM tAra adhivAsIrA mane kare, nizcaYa tArA (tAra upare AYatta karate) sakSama| haThAt kare tAra opara AmAra nirdeza cale Ase rAte vA dine, tArapara seguloke emana kartita phasale pariNata kari, yena kAlao ekhAne keAno AvAda chila nA| ebhAvei Ami nidarzanasamUha vistArita varNanA kari se sampradAYera janya yArA cintA kare|
Ara AllAha zAnti-nivAsera prati AhvAna jAnAna evaM yAke icchA saralapathera dike hidAYAta dAna karena|
yArA satkarma kareche tAdera janya raYeche kalyANa evaM tArao ceYe vezi| tAdera cehArA Achanna karave nA malinatA vA apamAna| tArAi halo jAnnAtavAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI|

Ara yArA upArjana kareche manda, manda kAjera pratidAna tArai anurUpa, tAdera Acchanna karave lAJchanA| keu nei emana ye AllAhara hAta theke tAdera vA~cAte pAre| tAdera cehArA yena Dheke deoYA haYeche A~dhAra rAtera TukareA diYe| erA halo jAhAnnAmi| tArA sekhAne sthAYI|

Ara yedina Ami tAdera savAike samaveta karava; ataHpara yArA ziraka kareche, tAderake valava, teAmarA evaM teAmAdera zarikarA nijedera sthAnei thAko, erapara tAdera mAjhe viccheda ghaTAva, takhana tAdera zarikarA valave, teAmarA teA AmAdera upAsanA karate nA|
ataeva, AllAha AmAdera o teAmAdera mAjhe sAkSI hiseve yatheSTa| avazyai AmarA teAmAdera upAsanA samparke vekhavara chilAma|
sekhAne pratyeke tAra pUrvera kAja yAcAi kare neve| evaM tAdera prakRta abhibhAvaka AllAhara dike tAderake pratyAvartana karAno have| Ara tAdera theke hAriYe yAve tA, yA tArA mithyA racanA karata|

valo, AsamAna o yamina theke ke tomAdera riyika dAna kare, vA ke teAmAdera zravaNazakti o dRSTizaktira mAlika? ke jIvitake mRtera bhetara theke vera karena evaM kei-vA mRtake jIvitera madhya theke vera karena? Ara ke karena sakala viSaYa sampAdanera vyavasthApanA? takhana tArA vale uThave, AllAha! takhana valo, tavuo ki tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA?
sutarAM tinii AllAha yini teAmAdera prakRta rava| ataeva, satya prakAzera pare, bhraSTatA chAr3A Ara kI vAki thAkate pAre? sutarAM keAthAYa tomarA phire yAccha?
ebhAve vAstavAYita haYeche tomAra ravera vANI phAsikadera opara ye, kichutei tArA ImAna Anave nA|

tumi valo, teAmAdera zarikadera mAjhe keu ki Ache, ye sRSTike astitve Ane ataHpara AvAra punarAvartana ghaTAYa? valo, AllAhai sRSTike astitve Anena ataHpara tAra punarAvartana ghaTAna| sutarAM tomarA keAthAYa phire yAccha?

valo, teAmAdera zarikadera madhye keu ki Ache, ye satyera dike patha dekhAve? valo, AllAhai satyera dike hidAYAta dAna karena, sutarAM yini satyara dike hidAYAta devena, tini anusaraNera adhika upayukta nAki ye kono hidAYAta pAYa nA, hidAYAta karA vyatIta| ataeva, teAmAdera kI halo, kemana teAmAdera vicAra?
tAdera adhikAMzai zudhu anumAnera anusaraNa kare| nizcaYa anumAna satyera mukAvilAYa keAno kAje Ase nA| nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa oi vyApAre yA tArA kare|

Ara e kuraAna emana naYa ye, AllAha (nAjila karA) vyatIta keu tA racanA karate pArave; kintu tA pUrvavartI kitAvera satyAYanakArI o vidhAnasamUhera vizada vyAkhyA; yAte kono sandeha nei; yA vizvajagatera ravera pakSa theke|
nAki tArA vale se (navi) tA racanA kareche| valo, tave teAmarA anurUpa ekaTi sUrA niYe eseA| Ara tomarA AllAha vyatIta yAke icchA DAko, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao|

varaM tArA ye viSaYera jJAna AYatta karate pAreni, tA tArA mithyA pratipanna kareche| athaca ekhaneA tAra vizleSaNa tAdera kAche Aseni| anurUpa mithyA pratipanna kareche tAdera pUrvavartIrA| ataeva, dekho, kemana chila sImAlaGghanakArIdera pariNati|
tAdera madhya theke kataka tAra prati ImAna Ane evaM kataka tAra prati ImAna Ane nA| Ara tomAra rava adhika jJAta viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera vyApAre|

Ara yadi tArA tomAra prati mithyAropa kare, tave valo, AmAra janya AmAra Amala, Ara teAmAdera janya teAmAdera Amala| tomarA dAYamukta tA theke, yA Ami kari, Ara Amio tA theke dAYamukta yA tomarA karo|
Ara tAdera anekei tomAra dike manoyoga diYe zone; tave ki tumi vadhirake zeAnAve? yadio tArA Akala-vuddhi nA rAkhe|
AvAra tAdera madhye theke kataka teAmAra dike tAkiYe thAke; tave ki tumi andhadera hidAYAta dite pArave, yadio tArA dekhate nA pAYa?
nizcaYa AllAha mAnuSera opara avicAra karena nA; varaM mAnuSa nijei nijera opara avicAra kare|

Ara yedina tini tAderake samaveta karavena, tArA mane karave yena tArA zudhu dinera kichu aMza pRthivIte avasthAna karechila| tArA parasparake cinave| avazyai kSatigrasta haYeche yArA AllAhara sAkSAtke mithyA pratipanna kareche, evaM tArA hidAYAtaprAptao chila nA|
Ami tAdera ye pratizruti diYechi, tAra kichu aMza yadi tomAke dekhAi, vA tomAke mRtyu dAna kari, tavuo AmAra dikei tAdera pratyAvartanasthala| Ara AllAha sAkSI yA tArA kare|
Ara pratyeka sampradAYera janya ekajana rAsUla| ataeva, yakhana tAdera kAche rAsUla eseche takhana nyAYera sAthe tAdera mAjhe phAYasAlA karA haYeche, Ara tAdera opara kono avicAra karA have nA|
Ara tArA vale, kave Asave ei pratizruta viSaYa kave Asave, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI haYe thAko?

valo, Ami nijera kono kSati vA upakArera kSamatA rAkhi nA, AllAha yA icchA karena tA vyatIta| pratyeka sampradAYera janya ekaTi samaYa nirdiSTa| yakhana tAdera nirdhArita samaYa ese par3ave, takhana muhUrtakAla Age have nA, Ara muhUrtakAla pareo have nA|
valo, tomarA ki lakSa karecha, yadi teAmAdera opara tAra zAsti ese par3e rAte athavA dine, tave kena pApAcArIrA se vyApAre tAr3Ahur3o kare|
ataHpara yakhana tA ghaTave takhana ki tomarA tAte ImAna Anave? ekhana ki (tomarA ImAna Anacha)? athaca tomarA se samvandhe tAr3Ahur3A karate!
ataHpara tAdera uddezye valA have yArA sImAlaGghana kareche, tomarA AsvAdana karo sthAYI zAsti, tomarA yA karate tomAdera zudhu tArai pratiphala deoYA hacche|
Ara tArA tomAra nikaTa jAnate cAYa tA ki satya? valo, hyA~, AmAra ravera zapatha, nizcaYa tA avazyai satya, evaM tomarA vyartha kare dite sakSama nao|

Ara nizcaYa yadi pratyeka sImAlaGghanakArIra janya thAke pRthivIra savakichu, tave avazyai tA se muktipaNa hiseve diYe deve evaM tArA anutApa gopana karave yakhana tArA zAsti dekhave, Ara tAdera mAjhe nyAYabhittika mImAMsA karA have, evaM tAdera opara kono avicAra karA have nA|
jene rAkho, nizcaYa AsamAna o yamine yA-kichu Ache tA AllAharai janya, jene rAkho, nizcaYa AllAhara pratizruti satya, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
tinii jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna| evaM tA~rai dike tomAdera pratyAvartana have|
he mAnuSa, teAmAdera kAche eseche tomAdera ravera pakSa theke upadezavANI o antare yA kichu (roga) Ache tAra nirAmaYa| evaM mu’minadera janya hidAYAta o rahamata|
valo, AllAhara anugraha o daYAra janya tAdera anandita haoYA ucita| kAraNa, tArA yA kichu jamA kareche tAra ceYe tA aneka uttama|

valo, tomarA ki lakSa karecha? AllAha tomAdera janya ye jIvikA avatIrNa karechena, tomarA tA theke kichu hArAma o kichu hAlAla vAniYecha, tumi valo AllAha ki tomAdera anumati diYechena nAki AllAhara prati tomarA mithyA Aropa karacha?
Ara AllAhara prati yArA mithyA Aropa kare kiYAmAta divasa samparke tAdera kI dhAraNA? nizcaYai AllAha mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla, kintu tAdera adhikAMza kRtajJatA svIkAra kare nA|

Ara tumi ye avasthAtei thAko evaM kuraAna theke yA kichu tilAoYAta karo Ara tomarA yekono kAja karo nA kena, Ami teAmAdera opara sAkSI, yakhana teAmarA tAte AtmaniYeAga karo| Ara tomAra ravera theke geApana thAke nA AsamAna o yaminera yArarA parimANa kichui| Ara tA theke kSudratara athavA vRhattara kichui emana nei yA suspaSTa kitAve nei|
jene rekheA, nizcaYai yArA AllAhara vandhu, tAdera nA keAno bhaYa Ache, nA tAderake kono duzcintA karate have|
yArA ImAna eneche evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karata|
tAdera janya susaMvAda pArthiva-jIvane o parakAlIna jIvane| AllAhara kAlimAYa kono parivartana nei| eTAi mahA-saphalatA|
Ara tAdera kathA yena tomAke duHkha nA deYa| nizcaYai AllAhara janyai sakala maryAdA| tinii sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

jene rAkho, nizcaYa AkAzasamUhe o yamine yA-kichu Ache sava AllAharai janya| Ara yArA AllAhake vAda diYe zarikadera DAke, tArA kIsera anusaraNa kare| tArA zudhu anumAnera anusaraNa kare| evaM zudhu anumAnabhittika kathA vale|

tinii, yini teAmAdera janya rAta sRSTi karechena, yAte teAmarA tAte prazAnti lAbha karo, Ara dinake karechena AlokamaYa| nizcaYa tAte raYeche nidarzanAvali emana sampradAYera janya, yArA zravaNa kare|

tArA vale, AllAha putra grahaNa karechena, tini pavitra, tini amukhApekSI| AkAzasamUhe o pRthivIte yA-kichu raYeche sava to tA~rai| teAmAdera kAche e vyApAre keAno pramANa nei| teAmarA ki AllAhara vyApAre emana kathA valacha yA tomarA jAno nA|
valo, yArA AllAhara vyApAre mithyA racanA kare, tArA saphalakAma have nA|
pArthiva-jIvana sAmAnya upabhoga mAtra| ataHpara AmAra nikaTa tAderake pratyAvartana karate have| takhana Ami tAdera AsvAdana karAva kaThina zAsti, ekAraNe ye tArA kuphuri karata|

Ara tAdera sAmane nUhera saMvAda varNanA karo; yakhana se tAra sampradAYake valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, yadi teAmAdera mAjhe AmAra avasthAna evaM AllAhara AYAtasamUhera mAdhyame upadezadAna bhAri mane haYa, tave Ami AllAhara opara bharasA karachi| sutarAM tomarA nijeradera parikalpanA sthira karo evaM teAmAdera zarikadeke jar3o karo, ataHpara teAmAdera parikalpanA yena tomAdera kAche paritApera kAraNa nA haYa| avazeSe AmAra vyApAre siddhAnta cUr3Anta karo, evaM AmAke sAmAnya avakAza diYo nA|

tAraparao yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo, tave Ami teAmAdera kAche keAno pratidAna cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna zudhu AllAhara dAYitve| Ara AmAra prati nirdeza raYeche yena Ami AtmasamarpaNakArIdera antarbhukta hai|

ataHpara tArA tAra prati mithyAropa karala| sutarAM Ami tAke evaM tAra sAthe yArA nauyAne chila tAdera uddhAra karechi evaM tAderake vAniYechi sthalAbhiSikta| Ara tAdera DuviYe diYechi, yArA AmAra nidarzanake mithyA pratipanna kareche| sutarAM dekho, kemana pariNati varaNa kareche tArA yAdera sAvadhAna karA haYechila|

anantara Ami nUhera pare aneka rAsUla pAThiYechi tAdera sampradAYera prati| ataHpara tArA tAdera kAche eseche suspaSTa pramANa niYe, kintu tArA tAra sesava viSaYera prati ImAna AnaYana karata nA, ye vyApAre itaHpUrve tArA mithyAropa kareche| ebhAve Ami sImAlaGghanakArIdera antarera opara meAhara e~Te dii|
ataHpara Ami mUsA o hArUnake AmAra nidarzanasaha phiraAuna o tAra pariSadavargera kAche preraNa karechi; kintu tArA ahaMkAra karala, Ara tArA chila aparAdhI sampradAYa|
tArapara yakhana AmAra pakSa theke tAdera kAche satya viSaYa upasthita halo, takhana tArA valala, ‘nizcaYai eTA prakAzya jAdu|’
mUsA valala, ‘satyera vyApAre ekathA valacha, yakhana tA teAmAdera kAche eseche? eTA ki jAdu? Ara jAdukararA saphalakAma haYa nA|’

tArA valala, ‘tumi ki AmAdera kAche e janyai esecha ye, AmAdera tA theke sariYe deve, yAra opara AmarA peYechi AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera? Ara pRthivIte tomAdera dujanera pratipatti pratiSThita have? Ara AmarA teAmAdera prati ImAna AnaYanakArI nai|’
phiraAuna valala, ‘AmAra kAche pratyeka vijJa jAdukaradera niYe eso|’
tArapara yakhana jAdukararA ela mUsA tAdera valala, ‘tomarA nikSepa karo, teAmarA yA nikSepakArI|’
ataHpara yakhana tArA nikSepa karala, mUsA valala, ‘tomAdera Anita savakichui jAdu, nizcaYai AllAha ati druta tA vyartha kare devena| Ara AllAha viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera kAja parizuddha karena nA|’
AllAha satyake satye pariNata karena tAra nirdeze; yadio pApiSTharA tA apachanda kare|

kintu mUsAra prati keu-i ImAna Anala nA; kevala tAra sampradAYera kichu loka vyAtIta; e bhaYe ye, phiraAuna o tAra pariSadavarga tAderake niryAtana karave| nizcaYa phiraAuna pRthivIte auddhatya prakAza kareche| Ara se chila sImAlaGghanakArIdera antarbhukta|
mUsA valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA yadi AllAhara opara ImAna ene thAko, tave tArai opara bharasA karo, yadi teAmarA AtmasamarpaNakArI hao|’
ataHpara tArA valala, ‘AmarA AllAhara opara bharasA karechi| he AmAdera rava, Apani AmAderake sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYera niryAtanera pAtra vAnAvena nA|’
‘Ara AmAderake ApanAra anugrahe kAphira sampradAYa theke mukti dAna karuna|’

Ara Ami mUsA evaM tAra bhAiYera prati oYAhi pAThAlAma, ‘ teAmarA teAmAdera sampradAYera janya misare vAsasthAna nirmANa karo| Ara teAmAdera gharaguleAke kivalAmukhI karo evaM sAlAta pratiSThA karo, Ara yArA ImAnadAra, tAdera susaMvAda dAna karo|’

Ara mUsA valala, ‘he AmAra rava, nizcaYa tumi phiraAunake evaM tAra pariSadavargake pArthiva-jIvanera zobhA o sampada dAna karecha| he AmAra rava, esava diYecha, yAte tArA tomAra patha theke pathabhraSTa karate pAre! he AmAra rava, tumi tAdera dhanasampada nizcihna kare dAo evaM tAdera antaraguleAke kATheAra kare dAo; yAte kare tArA tatakSaNa paryanta ImAna nA Ane, yatakSaNa nA yantraNAdAYaka zAsti pratyakSa kare|’
tini valalena, ‘avazyai teAmAdera du ‘ A maJjura karA halo| ataeva, teAmarA dujana dRr3ha thAkeA evaM tomarA kakhano tAdera anusaraNa karo nA yArA ajJa|’

Ara vani isarAIlake Ami sAgara pAra kare diYechi| ataHpara tAdera pazcAddhAvana kareche phiraAuna o tAra senAvAhinI, sImAlaGghana kare o zatrutAvazata| emanaki yakhana Duve yAvAra upakrama halo, takhana valala, ‘Ami ImAna enechi; nizcaYa tini chAr3A keAno ilAh nei, yA~ra opara ImAna eneche vani isarAIla| Amio AtmasamarpaNakArIdera antarbhukta|’
‘ekhana ImAna Anacha, athaca itaHpUrve avAdhyatA karecha! Ara tumi chile viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera antarbhukta|’
‘ataeva, Aja Ami tomAra deha rakSA karava yAte tumi hao paravartIdera janya nidarzana| Ara nizcaYa aneka loka AmAra nidarzanasamUha theke udAsIna|’

Ara Ami vani isarAIlake dAna karechi uttama AvAsabhUmi; Ara Ami tAdera AhArya diYechi pavitra vastusAmagrI theke| ataHpara tArA matavireAdha kareni, yatakSaNa nA tAdera nikaTa jJAna ela| nizcaYa tomAra rava tAdera mAjhe mImAMsA kare devena kiYAmatera dina, ye viSaYa tArA matavirodha karata|

sutarAM Ami yA tomAra prati avatIrNa karechi, tA niYe tumi yadi sandehe thAko, tave yArA tomAra pUrvera kitAva pATha kare tAdera kAche jijJAsA karo| avazyai tomAra nikaTa satya eseche tomAra ravera pakSa theke| ataeva, tumi sandeha poSaNakArIdera arbhukta haYo nA|
Ara tumi tAdera antarbhukta haYeA nA, yArA mithyA pratipanna kareche AllAhara nidarzanasamUhake, tA hale tumi have kSatigrastadera antarbhukta|
yAdera vyApAre teAmAra ravera siddhAnta avadhArita haYe geche tArA ImAna Anave nA|
yadio tAdera sAmane samasta nidarzanAvali ese yAYa, yatakSaNa nA tArA yantraNAdAYaka zAsti pratyakSa karave|

sutarAM keAno janapada emana chila nA, yArA ImAna eneche evaM tAdera ImAna tAdera upakAre eseche, tave iunusera sampradAYa vyatIta| yakhana tArA ImAna eneche takhana Ami tAdera theke pArthiva-jIvane lAJchanAkara zAsti dUra kare diYechi| Ara tAdera upabhogera avakAza diYechi nirdhArita samaYa paryanta|
Ara teAmAra rava yadi cAitena, tave pRthivIte yArA raYeche, tAdera sakale samavetabhAve ImAna AnaYana karata| tumi ki mAnuSake vAdhya karave yatakSaNa nA tArA ImAna Anave?
Ara kArao pakSe sambhava naYa ye, AllAhara anumati vyatIta ImAna Anave| evaM tini apavitratA Dhele dena tAdera opara yArA anudhAvana kare nA|
valo, tomarA lakSa karo, AkAzasamUha o yamine kI raYeche? tave keAno nidarzana evaM keAno bhItiprardazanai kAje Ase nA emana sampradAYera janya yArA ImAna Ane nA|
tave ki tArA zudhu tAdera pUrve vigata lokadera anurUpa dinagulora apekSA karache? valo, tave tomarA apekSA karo, Amio tomAdera sAthe apekSamAna|
ataHpara Ami uddhAra karalAma rAsUlagaNake evaM tAderake yArA ImAna eneche, emanibhAve AmAra dAYitva mu’minadera uddhAra karA|

valo, he mAnavakula, teAmarA yadi AmAra dInera vyApAre sandihAna haYe thAko, tave jene rAkho, Ami tAdera ivAdAta kari nA; tomarA yAdera ivAdAta karo AllAha vyatIta; kintu Ami ivAdAta kari AllAhara, yini teAmAdera mRtyu ghaTAna| Ara Ami AdiSTa haYechi ye, Ami mu ’ minadera antarbhukta hava|
Ara tumi nijeke dInera opara pratiSThita rAkho ekaniSThabhAve| Ara tumi muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
Ara AllAha vyatIta emana kAuke Deko nA, ye teAmAra upakAra kiMvA kSati karate pAre nA| Ara yadi tumi emanaTi karo tave tumi have sImAlaGghanakArIdera antarbhukta|

Ara AllAha yadi tomAke dite cAna kono kaSTa, tA hale tini chAr3A tA mocanakArI keu nei| pakSAntare tini yadi tomAra janya kalyANera icchA karena tave tAra anugraha vAdhApradAnakArI keu nei| tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA anugraha karena| Ara tini kSamAzIla asIma daYAlu|

valo, he mAnavakula, avazyai teAmAdera kAche eseche satya teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke| ye hidAYAtera anusaraNa kare, se nijera janyei hidAYAtera pathe cale, Ara ye bhraSTa haYa, prakRtapakSe se pathabhraSTa haYa tArai janya| Ara Ami teAmAdera abhibhAvaka nai|
Ara tumi tAra anusaraNa karo yA tomAra opara avatIrNa karA haYeche Ara dhairya dharo, yatakSaNa nA AllAha mImAMsA karena| tinii sarvottama mImAMsAkArI|
Alipha, lA-ma, rA; eTA emana kitAva, yAra AYAtasamUha supratiSThita karA haYeche, ataHpara savistAre varNita haYeche prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa sattAra pakSa theke|
yena teAmarA AllAha vyatIta anya kArao ivAdAta nA karo| nizcaYai Ami teAmAdera prati tA~rai pakSa hate satarkakArI o susaMvAdadAtA|

Ara teAmarA nijedera ravera samIpe kSamAprArthanA karo| ataHpara tAra dikei phire eso, tini teAmAdera nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta utkRSTa jIvaneApakaraNa dAna karavena evaM vezi AmalakArIke tA~ra vAr3ati anugraha dAna karavena| Ara yadi mukha phiriYe nAo tave nizcaYa Ami tomAdera vyApAre eka mahA-divasera zAstira bhaYa karachi|
AllAhara dike teAmAdera pratyAvartanasthala, Ara tini sarva viSaYe sarva zaktimAna|

jene rAkho, nizcaYa tArA kuJcita kare tAdera vakSadeza, yAte tArA tAra theke gopana rAkhate pAre; jene rekho, tArA yakhana kApar3e nijedera AcchAdita kare, tini takhano jAnena, yA tArA gopana kiMvA prakAza kare| nizcaYai tini antarasamUhera vyApAre sarvajJa|
Ara pRthivIte emana keAno vicaraNazIla jIva nei yAra jIvikAra dAYitva AllAha kAche naYa| Ara tini jAnena tAra sthAYI avasthAna evaM tAra saMrakSita sthAna; sava kichui eka suspaSTa kitAve raYeche|

Ara tinii, yini AsamAnasamUha o yamina chaYa dine sRSTi karechena, Ara tA~ra Araza chila pAnira opare, yena tini teAmAderake parIkSA karate pArena teAmAdera madhye ke kaje uttama| Ara yadi tumi valo, ‘nizcaYai teAmAderake mRtyura pare utthita karA have,’ takhana avazyai yArA kuphuri kareche tArA valave, ‘eTA teA spaSTa jAdu!’

Ara avazyai yadi Ami eka nirdhArita samaYa paryanta tAdera theke zAsti sthagita rAkhi, tave avazyai tArA valave, ‘keAna jinise zAsti ThekiYe rAkhache?’ jene rekho, yedina tAdera opara zAsti ese par3ave, tA Ara tAdera theke pherAno yAve nA evaM tArA yA niYe upahAsa karata tA tAderake ghire rAkhave|
Ara avazyai yadi Ami AmAra pakSa theke mAnuSake kono anugrahera svAda AsvAdana karAi, ataHpara tA yadi tAra theke chiniYe nii; nizcaYai se avazyai hatAza o akRtajJa haYa|
Ara yadi Ami tAke anugraha AsvAdana karAi oi duHkha kaSTera pare yA tAke sparza kareche, tave avazyai se valave, ‘AmAra theke amaGgala dUra haYe geche,’ Ara nizcaYai se ati ullasita ahaMkArI|
tave yArA dhairyadhAraNa kareche evaM satkAja kareche tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o mahApratidAna|

Ara sambhavata tumi kichu aMza varjanakArI, yA tomAra opara oYAhira mAdhyame pAThAneA haYeche tAra, evaM se samparke tomAra mana saMkIrNakArI ye, tArA vale, ‘kena tAra opara keAno dhanabhAnDAra avatIrNa karA haYani athavA tAra sAthe Aseni kena keAno pherezatA?’ tumi to kevala satarkakArI; Ara AllAha sarva viSaYera opara karmavidhAYaka|
athavA tArA ki vale, ‘se tA racanA kareche,’ valo, ‘tave teAmarAo svaracita anurUpa dazaTi sUrA niYe eso evaM AllAha vyatIta yAke pAro DAko, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|’
ataHpara tArA yadi teAmAdera DAke sAr3A nA deYa tave tomarA jene rekho, tA AllAhara jJAna anusAre avatIrNa haYeche; Ara tini chAr3A anya keAno ilAh nei| ataeva, ekhana ki teAmarA AtmasamarpaNakArI?
ye vyakti pArthiva-jIvana o tAra cAkacikyai kAmanA kare, Ami ekhAnei tAdera Amalera pratiphala pUrNarUpe deva, evaM tAdera prati kamati karA have nA|
erAi tArA, yAdera janya parakAle Aguna chAr3A kichui nei evaM tArA sekhAne yA kichu kareche tA niSphala haYe geche| Ara tArA yA karata tA chila nirarthaka|

tave ki yArA tAra ravera pakSa theke suspaSTa pramANera opara raYeche, Ara anusaraNa kare tA~ra pakSa theke ekajana sAkSI, evaM yAra pUrve raYeche mUsAra kitAva pathanirdezaka o rahamatasvarUpa, tArAi tAra prati ImAna Ane| Ara anyAnya sampradAYera ye vyakti tA asvIkAra karave, tave jAhAnnAmai tAra pratizruta sthAna| ataeva, tumi tAte keAno sandIhAna haYo nA| nizcaYa tA tomAra ravera pakSa hate dhruva satya; kintu anekei ImAna Ane nA|

Ara tArace var3a sImAlaGghanakArI ke, ye AllAhara prati mithyAreApa kare| tAderake tAdera ravera sAmane upasthita karA have, Ara sAkSIgaNa valave, erAi tArA, yArA tAdera ravera prati mithyAreApa karechila| jene rAkho, sImAlaGghanakArIdera opara AllAhara abhisampAta|
yArA AllAhara pathe vAdhA deYa, Ara tAte vakratA khu~je, erAi AkhirAtake asvIkAra kare|
tArA pRthivIte AllAhake akSama karate pAreni Ara AllAha vyatIta tAdera keAno abhibhAvakao nei, tAdera janya dviguNa zAsti raYeche; tArA zunate sakSama chila nA Ara tArA chila nA cAkSuSmAnao|
tArA nijerAi nijedera kSatigrasta kareche, Ara tArA yA racanA karata, tA tAdera theke udhAo haYe geche|
eTA sunizcita ye tArA parakAle sarvAdhika kSatigrasta|
nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche o satkAja kareche evaM tAdera ravera samIpe vinaYAvanata haYeche| tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI|
ubhaYa dalera dRSTAnta hacche yemana andha o vadhira evaM ye cAkSuSmAna o zravaNakArI| ubhaYa tulanAYa samAna ki? tavuo ki teAmarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?
Ara avazyai Ami nUhake tAra jAtira prati preraNa karechi| tini valalena, nizcaYai Ami teAmAdera janya suspaSTa satarkakArI|
ye teAmarA AllAha vyatIta kArao ivAdAta karave nA| nizcaYai Ami teAmAdera vyApAre yantraNAdAYaka dinera zAstira bhaYa kari|

phale tAra sampradAYera pradhAnarA valala, yArA kuphuri kareche AmarA teA tomAke AmAdera mato ekajana mAnuSa vyatIta Ara kichui dekhi nA; Ara AmAdera madhye yArA nimna o sthUla-vuddhisampanna tArA vyatIta kAuke teA tomAra Anugatya karate dekhi nA| AmAdera opara tomAdera kono zreSThatva dekhi nA; varaM AmarA tomAdera sakalake mithyAvAdI mane kari|

se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, tomarA ki lakSa karecha Ami yadi AmAra ravera pakSa hate spaSTa dalIlera opara thAki, Ara tini tA~ra pakSa theke AmAke rahamata dAna kare thAkena, ataHpara tA theke tomAdera andha rAkhA haYa, tave ki Ami teAmAdera opara tA teAmAdera icchAra viruddhei cApiYe dite pAri?

he AmAra sampradAYa, Ami era vinimaYa teAmAdera kAche keAno pratidAna cAi nA; AmAra pratidAna teA AllAharai nikaTa| Ara Ami tAderake tAr3iYe dite pAri nA yArA ImAna eneche| nizcaYa tArA tAdera ravera sAthe sAkSAtkArI; varaM Ami teAmAderake mUrkha sampradAYa hisAve dekhachi|
he AmAra sampradAYa, Ami yadi tAdera tAr3iYe dii, tave AllAha zAsti theke ke AmAke rehAi deve? tavuo ki teAmarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?

Ara Ami teAmAdera vali nA ye, AmAra kAche AllAhara dhana-bhAnDAra raYeche Ara nA Ami adRzyera khavara jAni; evaM Ami ekathAo vali nA ye, Ami ekajana pherezatA; e kathAo valachi nA, teAmAdera dRSTite yArA lAJchita AllAha kakhano tAdera keAno kalyANa dAna karavena nA| AllAha oi vyApAre samyaka jJAta yA tAdera mane Ache| yadi emana kathA vali tave nizcaYa Ami hava sImAlaGghanakArIdera antarbhukta|

tArA valala, he nUha, AmAdera sAthe tumi tarka karecha, evaM atirikta vitarka karecha| ataeva, tumi niYe eso oi viSaYa, yAra vyApAre tumi AmAdera bhaYa dekhAccha| yadi tumi satyavAdIdera antarbhukta haYe thAko|
se valala, prakRtapakSe teAmAdera kAche AllAha tA niYe Asavena, yadi tini icchA karena, Ara teAmarA tA~ke akSamakArI (pratirodha karate sakSama) nao|

Ara yadi AllAha tomAdera pathabhraSTa karate cAna tave AmAra sadupadeza tomAdera kono upakAra deve nA, yadi Ami cAi ye Ami tomAdera upadeza deva| yadi AllAha teAmAdera geAmarAha karate cAna; tinii teAmAdera rava, evaM tA~ra kAche teAmAdera pratyAvartana have|
athavA tArA ki vale ye, se tA racanA kareche? valo, Ami yadi tA racanA kare thAki, tave se aparAdha AmAra, Ara teAmarA ye aparAdha karo tA theke Ami mukta|
Ara nUhera prati ei marme oYAhi prerita halo ye, yArA ImAna eneche, tArA chAr3A tomAra jAtira anya keu ImAna Anave nA| ataeva, tAdera kAryakalApe vimarSa have nA|
Ara tumi AmAra sAmane AmAra oYAhi meAtAveka ekaTi nauyAna tairi karo, Ara sImAlaGghanakArIdera vyApAre AmAke kichu valave nA| nizcaYa tArA Duvanta|

Ara se tairi karate lAgala nauyAna, Ara yakhanai tAra sampradAYera netRsthAnIYa vyaktirA tAra pAza diYe atikrama karata, tArA tAke vidrupa karata| se valata, yadi teAmarA AmAdera upahAsa karo, tave teAmarA yemana upahAsa karacha AmarAo temana teAmAdera upahAsa karava|
acirei jAnate pArave, kAra opara Asave emana zAsti yA tAke lAJchita karave evaM kAra janya avadhArita cirasthAYI zAsti|

avazeSe yakhana AmAra hukuma ela evaM ununa udvelita haYe uThala, Ami valalAma, sarvaprakAra prANI theke eka yugala, tomAra parivAra evaM yArA ImAna eneche tAderake nauyAne ArohaNa karAo, tave yAdera vyApAre pUrva siddhAnta avadhArita haYeche, tArA vyatIta| Ara khuva alpa saMkhyakai tAra sAthe ImAna enechila|
Ara se valala, teAmarA tAte AreAhaNa karo| AllAhara nAmei tAra calA o sthiti| nizcaYa AmAra rava ati kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

Ara tA tAdera vahana kare calate lAgala parvatasama DheuYera mAjhe, Ara nUha tAra putrake DAka dilena ‘se chila pRthaka sthAne,’ se valala, he priYa vatsa, AmAdera sAthe AreAhaNa karo, Ara kAphiradera sAthe thekeA nA|

se valala, Ami zigagira AzraYa neva emana keAno pAhAr3e, yA AmAke pAni theke rakSA karave| nUha valala, Ajakera dine AllAhara zAsti theke keAno rakSAkArI nei| ekamAtra tini yAke daYA karavena| emana samaYa ubhaYera mAjhe taraGga Ar3Ala haYe dA~r3Ala, phale se hala nimajjitadera arntabhukta|

Ara valA halo, he pRthivI, tumi gile phelo teAmAra pAni, Ara he AkAza, tumi kSAnta hao| Ara pAni zukiYe deoYA halo evaM vAstavAYita halo siddhAnta, avazeSe judi parvate tA bhir3ala evaM gheASaNA karA halo, dhvaMsa sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYera janya|
nUha tAra ravake Deke valala, he AmAra rava, AmAra chele AmAra parivArabhukta, Ara nizcaYa ApanAra oYAdA satya, Ara Apani to vicArakadera sarvottama vicAraka|

AllAha valena, he nUha, nizcaYa se tomAra parivArabhukta naYa| nizcaYai se durAcAra! sutarAM AmAra kAche emana AvadAra karo nA, yAra samparke tumi jAno nA| nizcaYa Ami tomAke upadeza dicchi, ye tumi ajJadera dalabhukta have nA|

se valala, he AmAra rava, se samparke ApanAra kAche prArthanA karA theke Ami ApanAra kAche AzraYa cAi ye vyApAre ye vyApAre AmAra kono jJAna nei, Apani yadi AmAke kSamA o anugraha nA karena, tave Ami kSatigrastadera arntabhukta hava|

valA halo, he nUha, AmAra pakSa theke nirApattAra sAthe avataraNa karo, Ara tomAra prati o tomAra sAthidera prati raila varakata| Ara kono kono sampradAYake Ami upabhoga karAvo pArthiva niYAmata, tArapara tAderake AmAra pakSa theke sparza karave yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

eTi adRzyera saMvAdasamUhera arntabhukta| Ami tomAra prati tA oYAhi karachi| yA itopUrve tomAra evaM tomAra sampradAYera chila ajAnA| ataeva, tumi dhairyadhAraNa karo| nizcaYai muttAkidera janyei zubha pariNAma|

Ara A’da sampradAYera prati Ami tAdera bhAi hUdake preraNa karechi; se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo, tini bhinna teAmAdera keAno ilAh nei, teAmarA to zudhu mithyA racanAkArI|
he AmAra sampradAYa, Ami ejanya teAmAdera kAche keAno pArizramika cAi nA; AmAra pArizramika tA~rai kAche yini AmAke sRSTi karechena; teAmarA ki vujhave nA?

Ara he AmAra sampradAYa, tomarA teAmAdera ravera kAche kSamAprArthanA karo, ataHpara tA~rai dike phire eso| tini AkAza theke teAmAdera opara vAri varSaNa karavena evaM teAmAdera zaktira opara zakti vRddhi karavena, Ara teAmarA aparAdhI haYe mukha phiriYe niYo nA|
tArA valala, he hUda, tumi AmAdera kAche keAno pramANa niYe Asoni, AmarA teAmAra kathAYa AmAdera deva-devIdera varjanakArI nai, Ara nai AmarA teAmAra prati ImAna AnaYanakArI|

varaM AmarAo teA vali ye, AmAdera keAno devatA tomAke amaGgale AkrAnta kareche| se valala, Ami AllAhake sAkSI karachi Ara teAmarAo sAkSI thAko ye, nizcaYa Ami tA theke mukta, yAdera teAmarA zarika karacha|
tAke chAr3A, teAmarA savAi mile AmAra aniSTa karAra praYAsa cAlAo, ataHpara AmAke keAno avakAza diYo nA|

nizcaYa Ami AllAhara opara bharasA karechi, yini AmAra evaM teAmAdera rava| pRthivIra vuke vicaraNakArI emana keAno prANI nei, yAra sAmanera jhuTi (niYantraNa) tA~ra hAte nei| nizcaYai AmAra rava nyAYanItite adhiSThita|

tAraparao yadi teAmarA mukha phiriYe nAo, tave Ami teAmAdera tA pau~chiYechi yA diYe AmAke teAmAdera prati prerita karA haYeche; Ara AmAra rava anya keAno sampradAYake teAmAdera sthalAbhiSikta karavena, kintu teAmarA tA~ra konoi kSati karate pArave nA; nizcaYai AmAra rava savakichura saMrakSaka|
Ara yakhana AmAra Adeza upasthita halo, takhana Ami svIYa rahamate hUda evaM tAra saGgI mu’minadera rakSA karechi| Ara tAdera rakSA karechi eka kaThina zAsti theke|
Ara erA chila A’da sampradAYa, yArA tAdera ravera AYAtake asvIkAra kareche, Ara tAra rAsUlagaNake amAnya kareche evaM anusaraNa kareche pratyeka uddhata svairAcArIdera nirdeza|

Ara pArthiva duniYAYa tAdera opara lA’nata avadhArita karA haYeche, evaM kiYAmatera dineo; jene rekho, A’da sampradAYa tAdera ravera kuphuri kareche, jene rekho, hUdera sampradAYa A ’ da jAtira janya dhvaMsa|

Ara sAmUdera prati tAdera bhAi sAlehake preraNa karechi; se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo, tini chAr3A teAmAdera keAno ilAh nei| tinii mATi theke teAmAdera sRSTi karechena, tAra mAjhe teAmAdera vasavAsa kariYechena| ataeva, tomarA tA~ra kAche kSamAprArthanA karo, ataHpara tA~rai dike phire eso| nizcaYa AmAra rava ati nikaTavartI, sAr3A dAnakArI|

tArA valala, he sAleha, itopUrve tumi chile AmAdera AzAra pAtra| AmAdera pUrvapuruSerA yAra upAsanA karata tumi ki AmAderake tAra upAsanA karate niSedha kara? Ara tumi AmAdera yAra dike AhvAna karacha, nizcaYa AmarA se vyApAre ghora sandehera madhye Achi|

se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA ki mane karo, Ami yadi AmAra ravera pakSa theke spaSTa pramANera opara thAki, Ara tini AmAke tAra pakSa theke rahamata dAna karena, eraparao Ami tAra avAdhya hale, ke AmAke AllAha zasti theke sAhAyya karave? ataeva, teAmarA teA AmAra zudhu kSatii vRddhi karave|

Ara he AmAra sampradAYa, AllAhara e uTanI yA teAmAdera janya nidarzana; ataeva, tomarA tAke cher3e dAo, se AllAhara yamine care khAve, tAke manda uddezye sparza karave nA| anyathAYa ati satvara teAmAdera pAkar3Ao karave zAsti|
tavuo tArA tAke hatyA karala| takhana se valala, teAmarA svIYa gRhe tinadina upabheAga karo| eTA emana pratizruti yA mithyA haoYAra naYa|

ataHpara yakhana AmAra nirdeza ela, takhana Ami sAlehake o tAra sAthe yArA ImAna enechila tAderake AmAra rahamate rakSA karalAma, mukti dAna karalAma sedinakAra apamAna theke| nizcaYai tomAra rava sarvazaktimAna parAkramazAlI|
Ara pracaNDa zavda tAdera pAkar3Ao kareche yArA sImAlaGghana kareche, phale tArA nija ghare upur3a haYe par3e raila|
yena tArA tAra madhye vasavAsai kareni| jene rAkho, nizcaYai sAmUda jAti tAdera ravera kuphuri kareche| jene rAkho, dhvaMsa sAmUda jAtira janya|
Ara avazyai AmAra prerita pherezatArA ivarAhImera kAche susaMvAda niYe esechila| tArA valala sAlAma, seo valala, sAlAma| ataHpara alpakSaNera madhyei se ekaTi bhunA karA vAchura niYe ela|

ataHpara yakhana se dekhala ye, khAdyera dike tAdera hAta prasArita hacche nA, takhana se saMzaYita halo, evaM mane mane tAdera samparke bhaYa anubhava karala| tArA valala, bhaYa pAvena nA| AmarA lutera sampradAYera prati prerita haYechi|
tAra strIo dA~r3iYechila, se hese phelala| ataHpara Ami tAke isahAkera sukhavara dilAma evaM isahAkera pare iYAkUverao|
se valala, hAYa, kI Azcaryakara, Ami ki santAna prasava karava? athaca Ami ekajana vRddhA Ara AmAra svAmIo vRddha, nizcaYa eTA to eka adbhuta viSaYa|
tArA valala, tumi AllAhara nirdeza samparke vismaYaveAdha karacha? teAmAdera opara AllAhara rahamata o prabhUta varakata| he gRhavAsIrA, nizcaYai AllAha prazaMsita mahimAnvita|
ataHpara yakhana ivarAhImera AtaGka dUra halo evaM se susaMvAdaprApta halo, takhana se AmAra sAthe lUta jAti samparke tarka zuru karala|
nizcaYa ivarAhIma chila var3ai dhairyazIla, keAmala antara, AllAhamukhI|
ivarAhIma, tumi eTA theke virata hao; nizcaYa ese geche tomAra ravera nirdeza, evaM tAdera opara emana zAsti Apatita have, yA kakhaneA pratihata havAra naYa|

Ara yakhana AmAra prerita pherezatAgaNa lUtera nikaTa upasthita halo| takhana tAdera vyApAre se ducintAgrasta halo, nijeke tAdera rakSAYa asamartha mane karala evaM se valate lAgala, Aja atyanta bhaYAnaka dina|

Ara tAra sampradAYa tAra dike druta chuTe ela| pUrva thekei tArA chila kukarme tatpara| se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, erA AmAra kanyA, tArA teAmAdera janya adhika pavitra| sutarAM teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM atithidera vyApAre AmAke lajjita kareA nA, teAmAdera madhye ki keAno bhAlo mAnuSa nei|
tArA valala Apani to avazyai jAnena, ApanAra kanyAdera vyApAre AmAdera keAno Agraha nei| Ara nizcaYa Apani avazyai jAnena AmarA kI cAi|
se valala, teAmAdera viruddhe yadi AmAra zakti thAkata athavA Ami keAno sUdRr3ha stambhera AzraYa grahaNa karate sakSama hatAma|

tArA valala, he lUta, AmarA ApanAra ravera pakSa theke prerita pherezatA| erA kakhaneA ApanAra dike pau~chAte pArave nA| sutarAM Apani rAtera kono eka aMze ApanAra parivAra niYe veriYe par3una| Ara ApanAdera keu yena pechane phire nA tAkAYa| ApanAra strI vyatIta; nizcaYai tAra upara tA-i Asave yA tAdera nikaTa pau~chAve| nizcaYa sakAlai tAdera pratizruta samaYa, prabhAta ki khuva nikaTe naYa?
avazeSe yakhana AmAra nirdeza ese gela, takhana Ami ukta janapadera uparibhAgake nice kare dilAma evaM tAra upara kramAgata kaMkara pAthara varSaNa karalAma|
yAra pratiTi teAmAra ravera nikaTa cihnita| Ara tA yAlimadera theke dUre naYa|

Ara mAdaiYAnavAsIdera prati tAdera bhAi zuYAivake preraNa karechi| se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo, tini vyatIta tomAdera keAno ilAh nei| Ara parimApe o ojane kama karo nA, nizcaYa Ami teAmAdera bhAlo avasthAYai dekhachi; kintu nizcaYa Ami teAmAdera opara pariveSTanakArI zAstira dinera AzaGkA karachi|
he AmAra sampradAYa, tomarA nyAYaniSThAra sAthe parimApa o ojana pUrNa karo| Ara leAkadera tAdera jinisapatre kama diYo nA, Ara pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi kare ver3Ave nA|
AllAhapradatta avaziSTa teAmAdera janya uttama, yadi teAmarA mu ’ mina hao, Ara Ami teA teAmAdera tattvAvadhAYaka nai|

tArA valala, he zuYAiva, tomAra sAlAta ki tomAke nirdeza deYa ye, AmarA sesava upAsyadera tyAga karava, yAdera upAsanA karata AmAdera pUrvapUruSarA athavA AmarA karava AmAdera dhana-sampade icchAmato vyaYa karava? nizcaYa tumi teA avazyai ekajana sahiSNu, nyAYaparAYaNa vyakti!

se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA ki bheve dekhecha, Ami yadi AmAra ravera pakSa theke suspaSTa pramANera opara pratiSThita hai, Ara tini yadi nija pakSa theke AmAke uttama riyika (navuota) dAna karena, Ami cAi nA, teAmAdera yA theke vAraNa karA haYeche, Ami nijei tAra anyathA kari| Ami AmAra sAdhyamato saMzodhana karate cAi| AmAke tAophikadAtA kevala AllAha| Ami tAra opara bharasA kari, Ami tArai abhimukhI|

Ara he AmAra sampradAYa, AmAra prati haThakAritA tomAdera yena emana aparAdhe prarocita nA kare ye, tomAdera opara Apatita have yemana Apatita haYechila nUha vA hUda athavA sAleha-era sampradAYera opara| Ara lUtera jAti teA teAmAdera theke khuva dUre naYa|
Ara teAmAdera ravera kAche kSamA cAo evaM tA~rai pAne phire ese nizcaYai AmAra rava asIma daYAlu, premamaYa|

tArA valala, he zuYAiva, tumi yA valo, tAra aneka kichui AmarA vujhi nA, Ara nizcaYa AmArA teA tomAke AmAdera madhye durvala mane kari| Ara yadi tomAra svajanavarga nA thAkata, tave AmarA tomAke prastarAghAte hatyA karatAma| AmAdera dRSTite tumi keAno prabhAvazAlI vyakti nao|

se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, AmAra bhAi svajanavarga ki teAmAdera kAche AllAhara theke adhika prabhAvazAlI? Ara teAmarA tAke avahelA bhare pechane phele rekhecha, nizcaYai teAmAdera kAryakalApa AmAra ravera AYatte raYeche|

Ara he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA nija nija sthAne kAja kare yAo, Amio kAja karachi, acirei jAnate pArave kAra opara Asave emana zAsti yA tAke apamAna karave, Ara ke mithyAvAdI? Ara teAmarAo apekSAYa thAko, Amio teAmAdera sAthe apekSAYa railAma|

Ara yakhana AmAra Adeza ela, Ami zuYAiva o tAra sAthe yArA ImAna eneche svIYa rahamate tAdera rakSA karalAma Ara sImAlaGghanakArIdera pAkar3Ao karala vikaTa garjana| phale tArA nijedera ghare upur3a haYe par3e raila|
yena tArA sekhAne vasavAsai kareni| jene rAkho, nizcaYa sAmUdera prati abhisampAtera mateA mAdaiYAnavAsIra opareo abhisampAta|
Ara Ami mUsAke preraNa kari AmAra nidarzanAdi o suspaSTa pramANasaha|
phiraAuna o tAra pariSadavargera kAche, tavuo tArA phiraAunera kRtakarmera anusaraNa karala| athaca phiraAunera kRtakarma nyAYasaGgata chila nA|
kiYAmatera dina se tAra sampradAYera leAkadera sAmane thAkave evaM tAdera jAhAnnAme pau~che deve| Ara seTA atIva nikRSTa sthAna, yekhAne tArA pau~cheche|
Ara e jagateo tAdera pechane abhizApa lAgiYe deoYA haYeche evaM kiYAmatera dineo; atyanta jaghanya puraskAra yA tAdera puraskRta karA have|
e hacche kaYekaTi janapadera itivRtta yA Ami tomAra nikaTa varNanA karachi| era madhye kichu vidyamAna Ara kichu samUle utpATita|

Ami tAdera prati avicAra karini; varaM tArA nijerAi nijera opara avicAra kareche| phale AllAhake vAda diYe tArA yesava upAsyake DAkata, tArA tAdera kono kAje Aseni, yakhana eseche AllAhara nirdeza; varaM tArA zudhu viparyaYai vRddhi karala|
Ara tomAra rava yakhana keAno sImAlaGghanakArI janapadake pAkar3Ao karena, takhana emanai karena| nizcaYai tA~ra pAkar3Ao kaTheAra yantraNAdAYaka|
nizcaYai era madhye nidarzana raYeche tAra janya, ye AkhirAtera zAstike bhaYa kare| eTA emana ekadina, ye dina sava mAnuSai samaveta have, ye dina sakalake upasthita karA have|
Ara Ami tA vilamvita kari, zudhu ekaTi nirdhArita samaYera janya|
yakhana sedina Asave, takhana tAra anumati vyatIta kono vyakti kathA valate pArave nA| ataHpara tAdera kataka have hatabhAgya Ara kataka have saubhAgyavAna|
ataeva, yArA hatabhAgya tArA jAhAnnAme yAve, tAdera janya tAra mAjhe thAkave ArtanAda o citkAra|
tArA sekhAne sthAYI have, yatadina AsamAnasamUha o yamina vidyamAna thAkave| tave teAmAra rava yA icchA karena| nizcaYai tomAra rava sampAdanakArI yA icchA karena|
Ara yArA saubhAgyavAna tArA thAkave jAnnAte, sekhAne tArA sthAYI, yatadina AsamAnasamUha o yamina vidyamAna thAkave| tave teAmAra rava yA icchA karena| eTA eka niravacchinna puraskAra|

ataeva, tArA ye savera upAsanA kare tumi se vyApAre keAnorUpa saMzaYera mAjhe thAkave nA| tAdera pUrvapuruSa yemana upAsanA karata, tArAo temana karache| Ara nizcaYai Ami tAderake tAdera aMza puropuri diYe deva kichumAtrao kama nA kare|

Ara Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma, ataHpara tAte matabheda sRSTi halo; yadi tomAra rava kartRka ekaTi kAlimA pUrva nirdhArita nA hato, tave avazyai tAdera mAjhe mImAMsA kare deoYA hato| nizcaYai tArA se vyApAre tIvra sandehera mAjhe|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava pratyekakei tAdera karmaphala sampUrNarUpe pradAna karavena| tini tAdera Amala samparke samyaka jJAta|
ataeva, tumi o tomAra sAthe yArA tAovA kareche avicala thAko, yebhAve AdiSTa haYecha| Ara sImAlaGghana karo nA| nizcaYa tini oi viSaYa pUrNa dRSTi rAkhena yA tomarA karo|
Ara tomarA jhu~kave nA tAdera prati yArA sImAlaGghana kareche, tA hale tomAdera sparza karave Aguna| Ara AllAha vyatIta teAmAdera keAno abhibhAvaka nei| ataeva, tomAdera kono sAhAyya karA have nA|
Ara sAlAta pratiSThA karo dinera dui prAnte evaM rAtera prAntabhAge| nizcaYai puNya kAja manda kAjake muche deYa| eTA upadeza grahaNakArIdera janya upadeza|
Ara dhairyadhAraNa karo, nizcaYai AllAha puNyavAnadera pratidAna vinaSTa karena nA|

ataeva, teAmAdera pUrvavatI prajanmasamUhe emana prajJAvAna kena halo nA, yArA pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi karate vAdhA dita; tave muSTimeYa vyatIta yAderake Ami tAdera madhya hate rakSA karechi| Ara yArA sImAlaGghana kareche tArA anusaraNa karata tAdera ye ArAma-AYeza deoYA haYechila, Ara tArA chila aparAdhI|
Ara tomAra rava emana nana ye, janavasatiguleAke anyAYabhAve dhvaMsa kare devena, sekhAnakAra adhivAsIrA saMzodhanakArI haoYA sattveo|
Ara teAmAra rava yadi icchA karatena, tave avazyai sava mAnuSake ekai jAtisattAYa pariNata karate pAratena| kintu tArA sarvadA matavirodhakArI hato|

tave yAdera ke tomAra rava anugraha karechena tArA vyatIta, Ara ekAraNe tini tAdera sRSTi karechena, tomAra ravera ei kAlimA sampUrNa haYeche ye, avazyai Ami jAhAnnAmake jina o mAnuSa dvArA ekayeAge bharti karava|
Ara Ami rAsUlagaNera yata sava vRttAntai teAmAke valachi, tA dvArA teAmAra antarake majavuta karachi| Ara ebhAve teAmAra nikaTa mahAsatya evaM mu’minadera janya upadeza o sAvadhAnavANI eseche|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane nA, tAderake valo, teAmarA nija nija avasthAne kAja kare yAo nizcaYa AmarAo kAja kare yAcchi|
Ara teAmarAo apekSA karo, nizcaYa AmarAo apekSamAna|

Ara AsamAnasamUha o yamine adRzyera jJAna AllAharai Ache| Ara sakala viSaYera pratyAvartana tA~rai dike; ataeva, tomarA tA~rai ivAdAta karo evaM tA~ra opara bharasA rAkho, Ara teAmarA yA karo, se samvandhe tomAra rava anavahita nana|
Alipha-lA-ma-rA; eguleA suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
nizcaYa Ami tA avatIrNa karechi, kuraAnarUpe AravibhaSAYa, yAte teAmarA vujhate pAra|
Ami tomAra nikaTa uttama kAhini varNanA karachi, e kuraAna, yA oYAhira mAdhyame tomAra prati avatIrNa karechi| yadio tumi itopUrve anavahitadera antarbhukta chile|
yakhana iusupha tAra pitAke valala, he AmAra pitA, nizcaYa Ami svapne dekhechi egAroTi nakSatrake, sUrya evaM candrake| Ami tAderake AmAra uddeze sijadArata avasthAYa dekhechi|
se valala, he AmAra chele, teAmAra bhAidera kAche tomAra svapna varNanA kareA nA tave tArA teAmAra viruddhe cakrAnta karave| nizcaYai zaYatAna mAnuSera prakAzya zatru|

ebhAvei teAmAra rava teAmAke maneAnIta karavena evaM teAmAke svapnera vyAkhyA zekhAvena| teAmAra prati pUrNa karavena tAra anugraha o iYAkUvera parivAra-parijanera prati; yemana itopUrve teAmAra pitRpuruSa ivarAhIma o isahAkera prati pUrNa karechena| nizcaYai teAmAra rava sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
avazyai iusupha o tAra bhAidera kAhinite jijJAsudera janye raYeche samUha nidarzana|
yakhana tArA valala, avazyai iusupha o tAra bhAi AmAdera pitAra kAche AmAdera cAite adhika priYa athaca AmarA ekaTA susaMhata dala| nizcaYai AmAdera pitA spaSTa bhrAntite raYechena|
tomarA iusuphake hatyA karo kiMvA phele eso keAno sthAne| tave teAmAdera pratii teAmAdera pitAra maneAyeAga niviSTa have evaM erapara teAmarA haYe yAve satkarmazIla loka|
tAdera madhya theke ekajana valala, teAmarA iusuphake hatyA kareA nA, varaM tAke phele dAo gabhIra kUpe, tAke tule neve kono pathika dala, yadi tomarA hao karmasampAdanakArI|
tArA valala, he AmAdera pitA, ApanAra ki haYeche, Apani iusuphera vyApAre AmAdera vizvAsa karena nA? athaca nizcaYa AmarA teA tAra hitAkAGkSI|
AgAmIkAla tAke AmAdera sAthe preraNa karena, tRptisaha khAve evaM khelAdhulA karave| Ara nizcaYa AmarA avazyai tAra rakSaNAvekSaka|
se valala, nizcaYa AmAra avazyai zcintA lAge ye, teAmarA tAke niYe yAve evaM Ami AzaGkA kari ye, nekar3e tAke kheYe phelave evaM teAmarA tAra theke amanoyogI thAkave|
tArA valala, AmarA ekaTi zaktizAlI dala etadasattveo yadi nekar3e tAke kheYe phele, tave nizcai AmarAi kSatigrasta havo|

ataHpara tArA yakhana tAke niYe calala evaM gabhIra kUpe nikSepa karate ekamata halo evaM Ami tAke oYAhi preraNa karalAma ye, avazyai tumi tAdera e kAjera vivaraNa jAniYe deve, athaca tArA tA anubhava karate pArave nA|
tArA rAtera velAYa kA~date kA~date tAdera pitAra kAche ela|

tArA valala, he AmAdera pitA, nizcaYa AmarA daur3a pratiyeAgitA karate giYechilAma, AmarA iusuphake rekhe giYechilAma AsavAvapatrera kAche| ataHpara tAke nekar3e vAghe kheYe pheleche| Apani teA AmAdera vizvAsa karavena nA, yadio AmarA satyavAdI|

tArA tAra jAmAYa mithyA rakta lAgiYe Anala| se valala, varaM teAmAdera mana teAmAdera e kAja sAjiYe diYeche| sutarAM ekhana dhairya dharAi zreYa| teAmarA yA varNanA karacha, se viSaYe AllAhai AmAra sAhAyyasthala|

Ara Asala ekaTi yAtrIdala, ataHpara tArA pAThAla tAdera pAni saMgrAhakake| takhana se nAmiYe dila tAra vAlati| se valala, kI Ananda, e ye ekaTi chele! tArA tAke paNyarUpe lukAla| AllAha samyaka jJAta—yA tArA karache|
tArA tAke ati nagaNya mUlye vikri karala kaYeka dirahAmera vinimaYe| tArA tAra vyApAre chila alpatuSTadera arntabhukta|

misare ye vyakti tAke kraYa karala, se tAra strIke valala, eke sammAne rAkho| sambhavata se AmAdera upakAre Asave athavA AmarA tAke putrarUpe grahaNa kare neva| ebhAvei Ami pRthivIte iusuphake pratiSThita karalAma, yena Ami tAke svapnera vyAkhyA zikSA dii| Ara AllAha nija kAja sampAdane pravala, kintu adhikAMza leAka tA jAne nA|
yakhana se pUrNa yauvane pau~che gela, takhana tAke prajJA o jJAna dAna karalAma| emananibhAve Ami satkarmaparAYaNa lokadera pratidAna dii|

Ara ye mahilAra ghare se chila, se tAke nijera dike praluvdha karala evaM darajA vandha kare valala, eso| se valala, AllAhara AzraYa cAi; nizcaYa tini AmAra rava, AmAra janya uttama nivAsera vyavasthA karechena| nizcaYai sImAlaGghanakArIrA saphala haYa nA|

Ara avazyai se tAra prati Asakta haYeche, seo tAra prati Asakta hato, yadi nA se tAra ravera mahimA avaleAkana karata| ebhAvei Ami tAra theke phiriYe rekhechi manda o azlIlatA| nizcaYai se AmAra ekaniSTha vAndAdera arntabhukta|

tArA ubhaYe daur3e gela darajAra dike evaM se tAra jAmA pechana dika theke chi~r3e phelala| ubhaYe tAra svAmIke darajAra kAche pela| mahilA valala, ye vyakti teAmAra parijanera sAthe kukarmera icchA kare, tAke kArAgAre pAThAneA athavA anya keAno yantraNAdAYaka zAsti deoYA chAr3A Ara kI zAsti hate pAre?

se valala, sei AmAke tAra dike praluvdha kareche| tAra parivAre eka sAkSyadAtA sAkSya pradAna karala, yadi tAra jAmA sAmanera dika theke chinna thAke, tave se satyavAdinI evaM se mithyAvAdIdera arntabhukta|
Ara yadi tAra jAmA pechanera dika theke chinna thAke, tave se mithyAvAdinI evaM se satyavAdIdera arntabhukta|
ataHpara se yakhana dekhala, tAra jAmA pechana dika theke chinna; takhana se valala, nizcaYai eTA teAmAdera chalanA| nizcaYa teAmAdera chalanA mahA-bhaYAnaka|
iusupha, e prasaGga upekSA karo! Ara tumi tomAra pApera janya kSamAprArthanA karo| nizcaYa tumii pApAcAriNIdera arntabhukta|
zaharera mahilArA valAvali karate lAgala, Ajijera strI nijera dike svIYa golAmake praluvdha kareche| se tAra preme ummatta haYe geche| nizcaYa AmarA teA tAke prakAzya bhrAntite dekhate pAcchi|

ataHpara yakhana se tAdera cakrAnta zunala, takhana tAderake Deke pAThAla evaM tAdera janye prastuta karala vasAra Asana| Ara dila tAdera pratyekake ekaTi churi evaM valala, tumi tAdera sAmane vera hao| yakhana tArA tAke dekhala, hatabhamva haYe gela evaM Apana hAta keTe phelala| tArA valala, AllAhara mahimA, e to mAnava naYa| e teA keAno sammAnita pherezatA|

se valala, e-i se, yAra janye teAmarA AmAke bhartsanA karachile| Ami tAke praluvdha karechi; kintu se nijeke nivRtta rekheche| Ara se yadi AmAra Adeza anuyAYI kAja nA kare, tave avazyai se kArAgAre prerita have evaM se have lAJcitadera arntabhukta|

se valala, he AmAra rava, tArA AmAke ye kAjera dike AhvAna kare, tAra cAite kArAgArai AmAra kAche adhika pachandera| yadi Apani tAdera chalanA AmAra opara theke pratihata nA karena, tave Ami tAdera prati AkRSTa haYe par3ava evaM ajJadera antarbhukta haYe yAva|
ataHpara tAra rava tAra du’A kavula kare nilena| Ara tAdera chalanA tAra theke pratihata karalena| nizcaYai tini sarvazreAtA o sarvajJa|
ataHpara nidarzana dekhAra para tAdera kAche bhAlo mane halo ye, kichu samaYera janya tArA tAke avazyai kArAruddha karave|

tAra sAthe kArAgAre dujana yuvaka praveza karala| tAdera ekajana valala, Ami svapne dekhalAma ye, Ami mada niMr3Acchi| aparajana valala, Ami dekhalAma ye, nija mAthAYa ruTi vahana karachi| pAkhi tA theke ThukariYe khAcche| AmAderake era vyAkhyA valena| nizcaYa AmarA ApanAke satkarmazIladera arntabhukta dekhate pAcchi|

se valala, teAmAdera ye khAdya deoYA haYa, tA teAmAdera kAche AsAra Agei Ami tAra vyAkhyA vale deva| oi jJAna theke, yA AmAra rava AmAke zikSA diYechena| Ami oisava jAtira dharma parityAga karechi, yArA AllAhara prati ImAna Ane nA| Ara tArAi parakAle avizvAsI|

Ami svIYa pitRpuruSa ivarAhIma, isahAka o iYAkUvera dharma anusaraNa karechi| AmAdera janya zeAbhA pAYa nA ye, keAno vastuke AllAhara aMzIdAra sAvyasta kari| eTA AmAdera prati evaM anya sava leAkera prati AllAhara anugraha; kinta adhikAMza mAnuSa kRtajJatA svIkAra kare nA|
he kArAgArera saGgIrA, pRthaka pRthaka aneka upAsya bhAlo, nA parAkramazAlI ekaka AllAha?

teAmarA tA~ke cher3e nichaka kataguleA nAmera ivAdAta kare thAko, seguleA teAmarA evaM teAmAdera pitR-puruSarA nAmakaraNa kareche| AllAha edera vyApAre keAno pramANa avatIrNa karenani| AllAha chAr3A kArao vidhAna deoYAra kSamatA nei| tini Adeza diYechena, tAra vyatIta anya kArao ivAdata kareA nA| eTAi sarala patha; kintu adhikAMza leAka tA jAne nA|

he kArAgArera saGgIdvaYa, teAmAdera ekajana svIYa prabhuke madapAna karAve evaM dvitIYajanake zule car3AneA have| ataHpara tAra mastaka theke pAkhi AhAra karave| teAmarA ye viSaYe jAnate AgrahI tAra siddhAnta haYe geche|

ye vyakti samparke dhAraNA chila ye, se mukti pAve, tAke se valala, svIYa prabhura kAche AmAra AleAcanA karave| ataHpara zaYatAna tAke prabhura kAche AleAcanAra kathA bhuliYe dila| Ara se kaYeka vachara kArAgAre thAkala|

vAdazAha valala, nizcaYa Ami svapne dekhechi, sAtaTi meATAtAjA gAbhI, tAderake sAtaTi kSINakAYa gAbhI bhakSaNa karache evaM sAtaTi savuja zISa o anyaguleA zuSka| he pariSadavarga, teAmarA AmAke AmAra svapnera vyApAre abhimata dAo, yadi teAmarA svapnera vyAkhyAYa pAradarzI haYe thAko|
tArA valala, eTA arthahIna svapna| emana svapnera vyAkhyA samvandhe AmarA abhijJa nai|
dujana kArAruddhera madhya theke ye vyakti mukti peYechila evaM dIrghakAla para smaraNa hale, se valala, Ami teAmAdera era vyAkhyA samvandhe avagata karavo| ataeva, teAmarA AmAke preraNa karo|

(se kArAgAre pau~che valala,) he satyavAdI iusupha, sAtaTi meATAtAjA gAbhI, tAdera khAcche sAtaTi zIrNakAYa gAbhI evaM sAtaTi savuja zISa o anyaguleA zuSka; Apani AmAdera e svapna samparke samAdhAna dena| yAte Ami lokadera kAche phire yete pAri yena tArA jAnate pAre|
se valala, teAmarA sAta vachara ekAdhAre cASAvAda karave| ataHpara yA tomarA phasala kATave, tAra madhye ye sAmAnya parimANa teAmarA khAve—tA chAr3A avaziSTa zasya zISasaha rekhe deve|
erapare Asave kaThina durbhikSera sAta vachara; tArA e dinera janye yA saJcaYa kare rekhechila, sava kheYe phelave, kintu alpa parimANa vyatIta, yA teAmarA tule rAkhave|
era parei Asave ekavachara, ete mAnuSera opara vAri varSita have evaM tAte tArA rasa niMr3Ave|

vAdazAha valala, tAke AmAra kAche niYe eso| ataHpara dUta yakhana tAra kAche elo, se valala, tumi tomAra munivera kAche phire yAo, tAke sei nArIdera kathA jijJesa karo, yArA nijedera hAta keTechila| nizcaYai AmAra rava tAdera cakrAnta samparke samyaka jJAta|

tini valalena, teAmAdera abhivyakti kI, yakhana teAmarA iusuphake nijedera dike praluvdha karechile? tArA valala, mahimA AllAhara, AmarA tAra samparke manda kichu jAni nA| AyIya-patnI valala, ekhana satya prakAza haYeche| Amii tAke nijera dike praluvdha karechi Ara nizcaYa se chila satyavAdIdera arntabhukta|
eTA ejanya, yAte se (AyIya) jene neYa ye, nizcaYa Ami geApane tAra sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karini| Ara nizcaYa AllAha vizvAsaghAtakadera pratAraNA saphala hate dena nA|

‘Ara Ami nijeke nirdeASa mane kari nA; nizcaYai mAnuSera mana kramAgata mandera dikei nirdeza diYe thAke, vyatikrama (se) yAra prati AmAra rava anugraha karena| nizcaYai AmAra rava ati kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|’

vAdazAha valala, ‘tAke AmAra kAche niYe eseA; Ami tAke nijera janya vizeSabhAve grahaNa karava| ataHpara yakhana tAra sAthe kathA valala, se valala, ‘nizcaYai Apani Aja AmAdera kAche ekajana vizvasta maryAdAvAna vyakti|’
se (iusupha) valala, ‘AmAke Apani dezera dhanabhAnDArera dAYitve niyukta karuna; nizcaYai Ami ekajana vizvasta rakSaka o suvijJa|’

emanibhAve Ami iusuphake sei deze pratiSThita karechi| se sekhAnakAra yekhAne icchA avasthAna karate pArata| Ami yAke icchA anugraha dAna kari evaM Ami Antarika puNyavAnadera pratidAna vinaSTa kari nA|
Ara tAdera janya parakAlera pratidAna uttama, yArA ImAna eneche Ara tAkaoYA avalamvana kare cale|
iusuphera bhAiYerA Agamana karala, ataHpara tArA tAra nikaTa upasthita halo | se tAderake cinala, kintu tArA tAke cinate pArala nA|
se tAderake tAdera rasada prastuta kare diYe valala, ‘teAmAdera vaimAtreYa bhAike AmAra kAche niYe eseA| teAmarA ki dekhacha nA, nizcaYai Ami pUrNamAtrAYa mepe dicchi evaM Ami uttama athitiparAYaNa|’
‘ataeva yadi tAke AmAra kAche nA niYe Aso, tave AmAra kAche teAmAdera keAno varAdda nei evaM teAmarA AmAra kAcheo Asave nA|’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA zIghrai tAra vyApAre tAra pitAke sammata karAra ceSTA karava evaM nizcaYai AmarA tA vAstavAYana karava|’
evaM se bhRtyaderake valala, ‘tAdera paNyamUlya tAdera rasadapatrera madhye rekhe dAo, haYato tArA parivArera kAche pau~che tA cinate pArave evaM sambhavata tArA punarvAra Asave|’

ataHpara yakhana tArA tAdera pitAra kAche phire ela, tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera pitA, AmAdera janye varAdda niSiddha karA haYeche| ataeva, Apani AmAdera bhAike AmAdera sAthe pAThAna, yAte AmarA varAdda Anate pAri evaM AmarA avazyai tAra hiphAjata karavai|’
se valala, ‘Ami ki tAra samparke teAmAderake sebhAve vizvAsa karava, yemana itaHpUrve tAra bhAiYera vyApAre vizvAsa karechilAma? sutarAM AllAhai uttama hiphAjata kArI evaM tinii sarvAdhika daYAlu|’

Ara yakhana tArA tAdera sAmAnapatra khulala, takhana dekhate pela ye, tAderake tAdera paNyamUlya pherata deoYA haYeche| tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera pitA, AmarA Ara kI cAite pAri! ei AmAdera paNyamUlya, AmAderake pherata deoYA haYeche| ekhana AmarA (AvAra) AmAdera parivAravargera janya rasada Anate pArava evaM AmarA AmAdera bhAiYera hiphAjata karava evaM eka uTa vojhAi parimANa varAdda AmarA atirikta Anava| eTA sahaja varAdda|

se (pitA) valala, ‘tAke Ami kichutei teAmAdera sAthe pAThAva nA, yatakSaNa nA teAmarA AmAke AllAhara nAme aGgIkAra dAo ye, tAke avazyai AmAra kAche phiriYe niYe Asave; tave tomAderake yadi pariveSTita karA haYa seTA bhinna kathA|’ ataHpara yakhana tArA tAke aGgIkAra dila, takhana se valala, ‘AmarA yA valalAma se vyApAre AllAhai karmavidhAYaka|’

se valala, ‘he AmAra chelerA, tomarA ekai pravezadvAra diYe praveza karave nA, varaM pRthaka pRthaka darajA diYe praveza karave| AllAhara siddhAntera viparIte Ami tomAdera janya sAmAnyatama kAje Asava nA| vidhAna deoYAra kSamatA AllAha chAr3A kAro nei; tA~rai opara Ami bharasA kari evaM bharasAkArIdera tA~ra oparai bharasA karA ucita|’

yakhana tArA praveza karala, yebhAve tAdera pitA Adeza karechila, takhana AllAhara vidhAnera viparIte tA tAdera kono kAje ela nA; kintu iYA‘kUvera manera ekaTi icchA chila, yA se pUrNa kareche| Ara nizcaYai se chila jJAnasampanna; kAraNa Ami tAke tA zikhiYechi; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa tA jAne nA|
yakhana tArA iusuphera kAche upasthita halo, takhana se Apana bhAike nijera kAche niYe valala, ‘ nizcaYai Ami teAmAra saheAdara, sutarAM duHkha kareA nA sesava niYe yA tArA karata|’

ataHpara yakhana iusupha tAdera rasadasAmagrI prastuta kare dila, takhana se tAra sahodara bhAiYera mAlapatrera madhye pAnapAtra rekhe dila| ataHpara ekajana gheASaka ghoSaNA karala, ‘he yAtrIdala, avazyai teAmarA ceAra|’
tArA tAdera dike egiYe ese valala, ‘teAmarA kI hAriYecha?’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA vAdazAhara pAnapAtra pAcchi nA, evaM ye-keu tA khu~je ene deve se eka uTa veAjhAi parimANa mAla ( puraskAra ) pAve evaM Ami e vyApAre jAmina|’
tArA valala, ‘AllAhara kasama, teAmarA teA jAno, AmarA edeze phAsAda sRSTi karate Asini evaM AmarA ceAra nai|’
tArA valala, ‘yadi teAmarA mithyAvAdI hao, tave tAra kI zAsti?’
tArA valala, ‘era zAsti halo—yAra mAlapatrera madhye tA pAoYA yAve, se-i tAra vinimaYa| AmarA ebhAvei sImAlaGghanakArIdera zAsti diYe thAki|’

ataHpara se tAra bhAiYera pAtrera pUrve tAdera pAtra tallAzi zuru karala| avazeSe tA tAra bhAiYera pAtra theke vera karala| emanibhAve Ami iusuphera janya kauzala karalAma| se tAra bhAike rekhe dite pArata nA vAdazAhara Aine, AllAha icchA nA karale| Ami yAke icchA maryAdAYa unnIta kari evaM pratyeka jJAnIra opare Achena eka mahAjJAnI sattA|

tArA valala, ‘yadi se curi kare thAke, tave tAra bhAio itaHpUrve curi kareche| takhana iusupha prakRta vyApAra nijera mane gopana rAkhala evaM tAderake tA prakAza karala nA; se (mane mane) valala, ‘avasthAna hisAve teAmarA nitAnta manda evaM AllAha adhika jJAta se vyApAre yA teAmarA varNanA karacha|’
tArA valala, ‘he AyIya, nizcaYai tAra pitA ekajana atizaYa vRddha; sutarAM Apani AmAdera ekajanake tAra sthale rekhe dina| AmarA to ApanAke anugrahazIladera antarbhukta dekhate pAcchi|’
se valala, ‘AmarA yAra kAche AmAdera mAla peYechi, tAke chAr3A Ara kAuke dhare rAkhA theke AllAhara AzraYa cAcchi|’ tAhale nizcaYai AmarA sImAlaGghanakArIdera antarbhukta haYe yAva|’

ataHpara yakhana tArA tAra theke nirAza halo, takhana parAmarzera janya ekAnte vasala| tAdera var3ajana valala, ‘teAmarA ki jAno nA ye, nizcaYai tomAdera pitA teAmAdera kAcha theke AllAhara nAme aGgIkAra niYechena, Ara pUrva thekeo teAmarA iusuphera vyApAre anyAYa karecha? ataeva, Ami teA kichutei edeza tyAga karava nA, yatakSaNa nA AmAra pitA AmAke anumati dena athavA AllAha AmAra janya keAno mImAMsA karena; Ara tinii sarveAttama vicAraka|’

“teAmarA teAmAdera pitAra kAche phire yAo evaM valo, ‘he AmAdera pitA, nizcaYai ApanAra chele curi kareche| AmarA yA jAni tArai pratyakSa vivaraNa dilAma| Ara AmarA to adRzyera vyApAre saMrakSaNakArI nai|’
Ara ‘jijJesa karuna sei janapadera leAkaderake, yekhAne AmarA chilAma evaM sei yAtrIdalake, yAdera sAthe AmarA esechi| nizcaYai AmarA satyavAdI|’”

se (iYA‘kUva) valala, ‘varaM tomAdera mana tomAderake ekaTi viSaYa sAjiYe diYeche, sutarAM dhairyai sundara| haYato AllAha tAdera savAike ekasaGge AmAra kAche niYe Asavena| nizcaYai tini sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|’
evaM se tAdera dika theke mukha phiriYe nila, Ara valala, ‘hAYa AphaseAsa iusuphera janya;’ evaM duHkhe tAra ducokha sAdA haYe gela; yadio se chila saMvaraNakArI|
tArA valala, ‘AllAhara kasama, Apani teA avirAma iusuphera smaraNa karatei thAkavena, yatakSaNa nA mumUrSu hana vA mRtyuvaraNa karena|’
se valala, ‘Ami teA AmAra duHkha o asthiratA AllAhara samIpei nivedana karachi evaM AllAhara pakSa theke Ami yA jAni, tA teAmarA jAno nA|’

‘he AmAra chelerA, tomarA yAo, ataHpara tomarA iusupha o tAra bhAiYera kho~ja-khavara nAo evaM AllAhara daYA theke nirAza haYeA nA; nizcaYai AllAhara daYA theke kAphira sampradAYa vyatIta anya keu nirAza haYa nA|’

ataHpara yakhana tArA tAra kAche pau~chala, takhana valala, ‘he AyIya, AmAdera o AmAdera parivAravargake duryoga sparza kareche evaM AmarA aparyApta pu~ji niYe esechi; tavuo Apani AmAderake pureApuri varAdda dina evaM AmAderake dAna karuna; nizcaYai AllAha dAtAdera pratidAna diYe thAkena|’
se valala, ‘teAmAdera ki jAnA Ache yA teAmarA iusupha o tAra bhAiYera sAthe karecha, yakhana teAmarA chile apariNAmadarzI?’

tArA valala, ‘tave ki tumii iusupha?’ se valala, ‘Amii iusupha evaM e AmAra bhAi; AllAha AmAdera prati anugraha karechena| nizcaYai ye tAkaoYA avalamvana kare evaM savara kare, tave nizcaYai AllAha satkarmazIladera pratidAna vinaSTa karena nA|’
tArA valala, ‘AllAhara kasama, avazyai AmAdera opara AllAha teAmAke prAdhAnya diYechena evaM AmarA avazyai aparAdhI chilAma|’
se valala, ‘Aja teAmAdera viruddhe keAno abhiyeAga nei| AllAha teAmAderake kSamA karuna| tinii sarvottama anugrahazIla|’
‘teAmarA AmAra e jAmATi niYe yAo, eTi AmAra pitAra mukhamaNDalera upara rekhe dAo, ete tini dRSTizakti phire pAvena| Ara teAmAdera parivAravargera savAike AmAra kAche niYe eso|’
yakhana kAphelA veriYe par3ala, takhana tAdera pitA valala, ‘yadi teAmarA AmAke aprakRtistha nA valo, tave vali, nizciYai Ami iusuphera ghrANa pAcchi|’
tArA valala, ‘AllAhara kasama, Apani teA sei puroneA bhrAntitei par3e Achena|’

ataHpara yakhana susaMvAdadAtA ela evaM se jAmATi tAra cehArAra upara rAkhala, amani se dRSTizakti phire pela| se valala, ‘Ami ki teAmAderake valini ye, Ami AllAhara pakSa theke yA jAni teAmarA tA jAno nA?’
tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera pitA, AmAdera janya kSamA prArthanA karuna| nizcaYai AmarA aparAdhI chilAma|’
se valala, ‘zigagirai Ami AmAra ravera kAche teAmAdera janya kSamA prArthanA karava| nizcaYai tini ati kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|’
ataHpara yakhana tArA iusuphera nikaTa upasthita halo, takhana se pitA-mAtAke nijera kAche sthAna dila evaM valala, ‘AllAha cAna teA nirApada avasthAYa ApanArA misare praveza karuna|’

evaM se pitA-mAtAke siMhAsanera upara vasAla evaM tArA savAi tAra sAmane (sammAnasUcaka) sijadAvanata halo| se valala, ‘he AmAra pitA, e hacche AmAra itaHpUrvekAra svapnera vyAkhyA; AmAra rava tAke satye pariNata karechena evaM tini AmAra prati anugraha karechena AmAke kArAgAra theke vera kare evaM ApanAderake niYe esechena maruprAnta theke, zaYatAna AmAra o AmAra bhAidera madhye kalaha sRSTi kare deoYAra parao| AmAra rava yA cAna, tA vAstavAYane tini sUkSmadarzI; nizcaYai tini sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|’

‘he AmAra rava, Apani AmAke rASTrakSamatAra aMza diYechena evaM AmAke svapnera vyAkhyA zikhiYechena| he AsamAnasamUha o yaminera sraSTA, Apanii AmAra abhibhAvaka ihakAla o parakAle| AmAke musalima avasthAYa mRtyu dAna karuna evaM AmAke satkarmazIladera sAthe milita karuna|’
(he navi), eguleA hacche adRzyera khavara, Ami tA tomAra kAche oYAhi kare pAThAi| tumi to tAdera kAche chile nA, yakhana tArA tAdera kAje ekajoTa haYechila evaM tArA cakrAnta karachila|
Ara tumi yatai cAo nA kena, adhikAMza leAka ImAna AnaYanakArI naYa|
tumi to tAdera kAche keAno vinimaYa cAccha nA| eTA teA sArA vizvajagatera janya upadeza chAr3A kichu naYa|
katai nA nidarzana raYeche AsamAnasamUha o yamine yeguleAra opara diYe tArA atikrama kare; athaca tArA esava theke upekSAkArI|
tAdera adhikAMzai AllAhara prati ImAna Ane nA, ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA zirakeo lipta haYe thAke|
tArA ki nirApada haYe geche ye, tAdera opara AllAhara pakSa theke sarvagrAsI zAsti Asave nA athavA tAdera kAche haThAt kiYAmAta AsA theke, athaca tArA Terao pAve nA?
valo, ‘ei eTAi AmAra patha| Ami o AmAke yArA anasaraNa kare AllAhara pathe DAki vicakSaNatAra sAthe| AllAha pavitra; Ara Ami muzarikadera antarbhukta nai|’

Ara tomAra pUrve janapadavAsIdera madhya theke puruSadera chAr3A kAuke rAsUla hiseve pAThAini, yAdera kAche Ami oYAhi pAThAtAma| tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kareni, yAte tArA dekhate peta kI pariNati haYechila tAdera pUrve yArA chila? yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare cale tAdera janya parakAlera AvAsai uttama; tomarA ki veAjho nA?

emanaki yakhana rAsUlagaNa nirAza haYe gela evaM kApherarA dhAraNA karala ye, avazyai tAdera mithyA pratizruti deoYA haYeche, takhana tAdera kAche AmAra sAhAyya ela| ataHpara Ami yAke ceYechi se muktiprApta haYeche| aparAdhI sampradAYa theke AmAra zAsti pratihata karA yAYa nA|

avazyai tAdera ghaTanAsamUhera madhye vuddhimAnadera janya raYeche zikSaNIYa viSaYa, (e kuraAna) emana keAno kathA naYa—yA racanA karA yAYa, varaM satyAYanakArI tAdera pUrvekAra (kitAvasamUhera) evaM pratyeka jinisera vistArita vivaraNa Ara hidAYAta o rAhamAta se jAtira janya—yArA ImAna Ane|
Alipha lA-ma mi-ma rA; eguleA kitAvera AYAta, yA tomAra ravera pakSa theke tomAra prati avatIrNa haYeche—tA satya; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa ImAna Ane nA|

tinii AllAha, yini samucca karechena AkAzamaNDalIke stambha vyatIta—teAmarA tA dekho| ataHpara tini Araze isatioYA karechena evaM sUrya o candrake niYamAdhIna karechena; pratiTi nirdiSTa samaYa anusAre Avartana kare| tini sakala viSaYa paricAlanA karena, vizada varNanA karena AYAtasamUha, yena teAmarA tomAdera ravera sAkSAtera vyApAre nizcita vizvAsa karo|

tinii—yini bhUpRSThake vistRta karechena evaM tAra madhye pAhAr3a-parvata o nada-nadI sthApana karechena Ara sarva prakAra phala sRSTi karechena jor3AYa jor3AYa| tini dinake rAta dvArA AvRta karena| nizcaYai tAte sei sampradAYera janya aneka nidarzana raYeche, yArA cintAbhAvanA kare|

evaM pRthivIte Ache paraspara saMlagna bhUkhaNDa evaM AGurera vAgAnasamUha, Ache zasyakSetra o khejura vAgicA, yAra kichu ekai mUla theke udgata vA bhinna bhinna mUla theke udgata; eguleAke ekai pAni dvArA seca karA haYa| Ara Ami svAde ekaTike aparaTira cAite utkRSTatara kare dii| eguleAra madhye nidarzana raYeche emana sampradAYera janya yArA vuddhi-vivecanA rAkhe|

yadi tumi vismita hao, tave tAdera kathAo vismaYakara ye, ‘AmarA yakhana mATite pariNata hava, takhano ki AmarA natunabhAve jIvita hava?’ orAi tArA yArA tAdera ravera sAthe kuphuri kareche, Ara oi sava lokera gardAnei zikala par3ave evaM tArAi jAhAnnAmi; tAte tArA sthAYI have|

Ara tArA tomAra kAche maGgalera pUrve druta amaGgala kAmanA kare| athaca avazyai tAdera pUrve atikrAnta haYeche vahu dRSTAnta| nizcaYai tomAra rava mAnuSera janya kSamAzIla tAdera sImAlaGghana sattveo| Ara nizcaYai tomAra rava zAsti dAne avazyai kaThora|

evaM yArA kuphuri kareche tArA vale, ‘tAra (navira) prati tAra ravera pakSa theke keAno nidarzana avatIrNa haYa nA kena?’ tumi zudhu ekajana satarkakArI| Ara pratyeka sampradAYera janya raYeche ekajana pathapradarzaka|
AllAha jAnena—pratyeka nArI yA garbhadhAraNa kare evaM garbhAzaYe yA saMkucita o prasArita haYa; evaM tA~ra kAche pratyeka vasturai raYeche ekaTA nirdhArita parimApa|
tini sakala geApana o prakAzya viSaYe avagata; maheAttama, sarveAcca maryAdAvAna|
teAmAdera madhye ye kathA geApana rAkhe vA tA prakAza kare, Ara rAtera andhakAre se AtmageApana karuka vA dinera AloYa vicaraNa karuka, savAi tA~ra nikaTa samAna|

tA~ra pakSa theke raYeche tAra sAmane o pechane dhArAvAhika praharI, AllAhara nirdeze tArA tAke hiphAjata kare| nizcaYai AllAha keAno jAtira avasthA parivartana karena nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA tAdera nijedera avasthA parivartana kare| AllAha yakhana keAno jAtira opara vipada cAna, takhana tA pratihata karA sambhava naYa evaM tini vyatIta tAdera keAno abhibhAvaka nei|
tinii—yini teAmAderake vidyut dekhAna bhaYa o AzAra janya evaM sRSTi karena ghana meghamAlA|

tA~ra prazaMsAra mahimA varNanA kare vajra evaM pherezatArA—tA~ra bhaYe| Ara tini vajrapAta pAThAna, ataHpara yAke icchA tAke tA dvArA AghAta karena; tavu tArA AllAha samparke vitarka kare, athaca tini kaThina pAkar3AokArI|

satyera AhvAna tA~rai janya evaM yArA tA~ke chAr3A anyaderake DAke, tArA tAderake kono sAr3Ai deYa nA; tave oi vyaktira mato, ye prasAritakArI tAra duhAta pAnira dike, yena pAni tAra mukhe pau~che—athaca tA tAra kAche pau~chAvAra naYa; kAphiradera AhvAna kevala bhraSTatAYa nipatita|
Ara AllAhara prati sijadAvanata haYa AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA kichu Ache, icchAYa o anicchAYa evaM tAdera chAYAguloo sakAla o sandhyAYa|

valo, ‘AsamAnasamUha o yaminera rava ke?’ valo, ‘AllAha!’ valo, ‘tave ki teAmarA tA~ke vyatIta emana abhibhAvaka sthira karecha, yArA nijedera bhAlo evaM manda karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA?’ valo, ‘andha o cakSuSmAna ki samAna athavA samAna haYa ki andhakAra o AleA?’ tave ki tArA AllAhara janya emana aMzIdAra sthira kareche ye, tArA sRSTi kareche tA~ra sRSTira nyAYa, phale sRSTi tAdera kAche ekarakama vodha haYeche? valo, ‘AllAhai pratyeka vastura sraSTA evaM tini ekaka, parAkramazAlI|’

tini AkAza theke vAri varSaNa karena, phale plAvita haYa upatyakAsamUha tAra parimANa anuyAYI, ataHpara plAvana vahana kare phenArAzi uparibhAge| evaM ye vastuke tArA Agune uttapta kare alaMkAra athavA taijasapatrera janye tAteo thAke temani phenArAzi| ebhAvei AllAha satya o asatyera dRSTAnta pradAna karena| ataeva, phenA tA akejo haYe niHzeSa haYe yAYa evaM yA mAnuSera upakAre Ase, tA jamite avaziSTa theke yAYa| AllAha emanibhAve dRSTAntasamUha varNanA karena|

maGgala tAdera janya—yArA tAdera ravera AhvAne sAr3A deYa| Ara yArA tA~ra DAke sAr3A deYa nA, yadi tAdera kAche jagatera savakichu thAkata evaM era sAthe Arao samaparimANa thAkata, tave tArA savai muktipaNasvarUpa tA pradAna karata; tAdera janya raYeche manda hisAva, tAdera AzraYasthala have jAhAnnAma, tA katai nA nikRSTa AzraYasthala |
tomAra prati tomAra ravera pakSa theke yA avatIrNa haYeche, tA satya vale ye vyakti jAne, se ki oi vyaktira mato ye andha? vivekasampannarAi prakRtapakSe zikSA grahaNa kare|
yArA AllAhara pratizruti pUrNa kare evaM aGgIkAra bhaGga kare nA|
evaM yArA akSuNNa rAkhe oi samparka, ye samparka akSuNNa rAkhate AllAha Adeza diYechena evaM tArA tAdera ravake bhaYa kare, Ara tArA AzaGkA kare (parakAle) manda hisAvera|

evaM yArA tAdera ravera santuSTira janya dhairya dhare, sAlAta pratiSThA kare, Ara Ami tAderake yA diYechi tA theke geApane o prakAzye vyaYa kare evaM yArA mandake bhAlo dvArA pratihata kare, tAdera janyai raYeche parakAlera ghara (jAnnAta) |
sthAYI jAnnAta, tAte tArA praveza karave evaM tAdera vApa-dAdA svAmI-strI o santAna-santatidera madhye yArA satkarma kareche tArAo evaM pherezatArA tAdera kAche upasthita have pratyeka darajA diYe|
(valave) ‘teAmAdera opara zAnti varSita heAka, ye dhairya tomarA dhAraNa karecha tAra vinimaYe; Ara teAmAdera e zeSa nivAsa katai nA camatkAra!’

Ara yArA AllAhara sAthe aGgIkAra pAkApeAkta karAra para tA bhaGga kare, AllAha ye samparka vajAYa rAkhate Adeza karechena tA chinna kare evaM pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi kare, tArA oi samasta leAka, yAdera janya raYeche abhisampAta evaM manda AvAsa|
AllAha yAra janya icchA riyika prazasta karena evaM saMkucita karena| tArA to Anandita haYeche pArthiva-jIvana niYe; Ara pArthiva-jIvana parakAlera tulanAYa ati nagaNya sampada chAr3A kichu naYa|

yArA kuphuri kareche tArA vale, ‘tAra prati tAra rava theke kono nidarzana avatIrNa haYa nA kena?’ valo, ‘AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena evaM ye tA~ra abhimukhI, tAke tA~ra dike patha dekhAna |’
‘yArA ImAna Ane evaM tAdera antara AllAhara smaraNa dvArA prazAnti lAbha kare; jene rekho, AllAhara smaraNa dvArAi antarasamUha prazAnti lAbha kare|’
‘yArA ImAna Ane evaM satkarma sampAdana kare, tAdera janya raYeche susaMvAda evaM maneArama pratyAvartanasthala|’

ebhAve Ami tomAke emana eka jAtira madhye preraNa karechi, yAra pUrve aneka jAti atikrAnta haYeche, yAte tumi tAdera nikaTa tilAoYAta karo—yA Ami tomAra nikaTa oYAhi karechi| tavu tArA daYAmaYera sAthe kuphuri kare| valo, ‘tinii AmAra rava| tini vyatIta Ara kono ilAh nei| Ami tA~ra oparai bharasA karechi evaM tA~ra dikei AmAra pratyAvartana|’

Ara nizcaYai yadi keAno kuraAna emana hato, yAra sAhAyye pAhAr3ake calamAna karA yeta athavA pRthivIke vidIrNa karA yeta athavA tA dvArA mRtyera sAthe kathA valA yeta, (tavu tArA ImAna Anata nA) varaM sakala kartRtva AllAhara hAte| tave ki yArA ImAna eneche tArA e vyApAre nirAza haYe geche ye, yadi AllAha icchA karena, tave sava mAnuSake avazyai hidAYAta ditena? yArA kuphuri kareche tArA yA kareche tAra kAraNe tAdera opara viparyaYa Asatei thAkave athavA tA tAdera gharera nikaTavartI sthAne neme Asave, yatakSaNa nA AllAhara oYAdA Ase| nizcaYai AllAha pratizrutira vyatikrama karena nA|
avazyai tomAra pUrveo rAsUladera sAthe upahAsa karA haYeche, tavuo yArA kuphuri kareche tAderake Ami avakAza diYechi| era para tAderake pAkar3Ao karechi; ataeva kemana chila AmAra zAsti!

tave ki pratyeka prANI yA arjana kareche tAra yini paryavekSaka (tini ki tAra mato ye kichui jAne nA?) athaca tArA AllAhara janya zarika vAniYeche! tumi valo, ‘tAdera nAmadhAma valo, nAki tAke tomarA pRthivIra emana kichu jAnAte cAo yA tini jAnena nA, nAki tA kevala mukhera kathA?’ kAphiradera janya tAdera cakrAnta suzobhita karA haYeche evaM phiriYe rAkhA haYeche (saThika) patha theke| Ara yAke AllAha vipathagAmI karena, tAra janya kono pathapradarzaka nei|
pArthiva-jIvane tAdera janya raYeche eka zAsti, Ara avazyai parakAlera zAsti kaTheAratama| Ara AllAhara zAsti theke tAdera keAno rakSAkArI nei|
muttAkidera janya pratizruta jAnnAtera upamA halo—tAra taladeza diYe pravAhita haYa nada-nadI| tAra phalasamUha cirasthAYI evaM chAYAo| eTA muttAkidera pratidAna evaM kAphiradera pratiphala agni|

evaM yAderake Ami kitAva diYechi, tArA tomAra prati yA avatIrNa karA haYeche tA niYe Anandita haYa; kintu keAno keAno dala tAra kichu viSaYa asvIkAra kare| valo, ‘AmAke emanai Adeza deoYA haYeche, yena Ami AllAhara ivAdAta kari evaM tA~ra sAthe aMzIdAra sthApana nA kari, Ara Ami tA~ra dikei DAki evaM tA~ra kAchei AmAra pratyAvartanasthala|’
