ebhAvei Ami tA Aravi bhASAYa vidhAnarUpe avatIrNa karechi| avazyai yadi tumi tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa karo, tomAra kAche jJAna AsAra pareo, tave AllAhara (zAsti) theke tomAra nA thAkave keAno sAhAyyakArI Ara nA keAno rakSAkArI|

avazyai tomAra pUrve Ami aneka rAsUla preraNa karechi evaM tAderake diYechi strI-patnI o santAna-santati| keAno rAsUlera emana sAdhya nei ye, AllAhara nirdeza chAr3A keAno AYAta niYe Asave| pratyeka viSaYera nirdhArita kAla lipivaddha|
AllAha yA icchA nizcihna kare dena evaM yA icchA pratiSThita rAkhena evaM tA~ra kAchei raYeche ummula kitAva|
Ami tAdera sAthe ye oYAdA karechi, tAra kichu yadi tomAke dekhiYe dii vA (era Agei) tomAke uThiYe nii—prakRtapakSe tomAra dAYitva teA kevala pau~che deoYA evaM AmAra dAYitva hisAva neoYA|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami tAdera dezake caturdika theke saMkucita kare Anachi? AllAha nirdeza dena; tA~ra nirdeza pUnarvivecanAkArI keu nei; Ara tini hisAva grahaNe drutatara|

tAdera pUrve yArA chila, tArA cakrAnta kareche; athaca sakala cakrAnta teA AllAhara adhIne| tini jAnena pratyeka vyakti yA upArjana kare evaM kAphirarA acirei jAnave, parajIvanera uttama AvAsasthala kAdera janya raYeche|
kAphirarA vale, ‘tumi prerita nao|’ valo, ‘AmAra o teAmAdera madhye sAkSI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa evaM yAra nikaTa raYeche kitAvera jJAna|’

Alipha lA-ma rA, ei kitAva, yA Ami tomAra prati avatIrNa karechi, yena tumi vera kare Anate pAro mAnuSake tAdera ravera nirdeze andhakAra theke AleAra dike, mahAparAkramazAlI, sarvaprazaMsita (ravera) pathe|
AllAha; AsamAna o yamine yA kichu raYeche sava tA~rai| kAphiradera janya raYeche kaThina zAstira durbhoga|
yArA parakAlera cAite pArthiva-jIvanake prAdhAnya deYa, AllAhara pathe vAdhA deYa evaM tAte vakratA khu~je ver3AYa, tArA to sudUra vibhrA ntite raYeche|

Ami kono rAsUlakei tAra nija jAtira bhASA chAr3A preraNa karini, yena se tAdera kAche suspaSTarUpe varNanA kare; ataeva, AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena evaM yAke icchA hidAYAta dAna karena, Ara tinii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

avazyai Ami mUsAke nidarzanAvalI diYe preraNa karechi ye, ‘tomAra jAtike andhakAra theke AleAra dike vera kare Ano evaM tAderake AllAhara dinasamUha dvArA upadeza dAo|’ nizcaYai ete pratyeka dhairyazIla kRtajJera janya raYeche nidarzanAvalI|

Ara sma yakhana mUsA tAra jAtike valala, ‘teAmAdera prati AllAhara anugraha smaraNa karo, yakhana tini teAmAderake phiraAuna sampradAYera kavala theke mukti diYechena| tArA teAmAderake atyanta nikRSTa dharanera zAsti dita, teAmAdera chelederake javAi karata evaM meYederake jIvita rAkhata; era madhye tomAdera janya chila eka mahAparIkSA teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke|
yakhana teAmAdera rava gheASaNA karalena, ‘yadi teAmarA kRtajJatA svIkAra karo, tave teAmAderake adhika deva evaM yadi akRtajJa hao, tave nizcaYai AmAra zAsti atyanta kaTheAra|’
mUsA valala, ‘teAmarA evaM pRthivIra sakale yadi kuphuri karo, tave jene rekho, AllAha abhAvamukta prazaMsita|’

‘teAmAdera kAche ki teAmAdera pUrvavartI nUha, Ada o sAmUda sampradAYera evaM tAdera paravartIdera khavara Aseni? tAdera viSaYe AllAha chAr3A Ara keu jAne nA| tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa pramANAdisaha eseche, takhana tArA tAdera hAta nijedera mukhe rekhe diYe valata, ‘yA-kichu-saha teAmAderake preraNa karA haYeche, AmarA tA pratyAkhyAna kari; Ara avazyai AmarA gabhIra sandeha poSaNa kari se viSaYe, yAra prati tomarA AmAderake AhvAna karacha|’

tAdera rAsUlagaNa valechila, ‘AllAha samparke ki kono sandeha Ache, yini AsamAnasamUha o yaminera sraSTA? tini teAmAderake AhvAna karena, yena teAmAdera gunAha kSamA karena evaM nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta teAmAderake avakAza dena|’ tArA valata, ‘teAmarA teA AmAdera matoi mAnuSa! teAmarA AmAderake oi ilAh theke virata rAkhate cAo, yAra upAsanA karata AmAdera pitRpuruSagaNa| ataeva, teAmarA keAno suspaSTa pramANa AmAdera kAche niYe eso|’

tAdera rAsUlagaNa tAderake valala, ‘AmarA teAmAdera mato mAnuSa vyatIta kichu nai, kintu AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhya theke yAra opara icchA anugraha karena| AllAhara nirdeza vyatIta teAmAdera kAche pramANa niYe AsA AmAdera kAja naYa; mu’minadera AllAhara opara bharasA karA ucita|’

‘Ara AmAdera AllAhara opara bharasA nA karAra kI kAraNa thAkate pAre? athaca tinii AmAderake pathera hidAYAta diYechena| teAmarA AmAderake ye pIr3ana karecha, sejanya AmarA dhairya dhAraNa karava| Ara nirbharakArIgaNera AllAhara oparai nirbhara karA ucita|’

kAphirarA rAsUladera valechila, ‘AmarA avazyai teAmAderake AmAdera deza theke vera kare deva athavA teAmarA AmAdera dharme phire Asave|’ ataHpara tAdera kAche tAdera rava oYAhi pAThAlena, ‘Ami avazyai sImAlaGghanakArIdera dhvaMsa kare deva|’
‘tAdera pare Ami teAmAderake deze pratiSThita karavai; eTA tAdera janya yArA AmAra sAmane dA~r3Ate bhaYa kare evaM bhaYa kare AmAra zAstike|’
tArA vijaYa kAmanA karala Ara pratyeka uddhata svairAcArI vyartha halo|
tAra pechane raYeche jAhAnnAma evaM pAna karAneA have pu~ja mizAneA pAni|

se ati kaSTe DheAka gile tA pAna karave evaM galAra bhetare praveza karAno prAYa asambhava haYe par3ave| pratyeka dika theke tAra kAche mRtyu Asave; kintu se marave nA| tAra pechaneo raYeche kaTheAra zAsti|

yArA tAdera ravera sattAYa avizvAsI, tAdera avasthA ei ye, tAdera karmasamUha chAibhasmera mato, tIvra vAtAsa yA ur3iYe niYe yAYa pravala jhar3era dina| tAdera upArjanera keAno aMzai tAdera karatalagata have nA| eTAi cUr3Anta pathabhraSTatA|
tumi ki dekha ni ye, AllAha nabheAmaNDala o bhUmaNDala nipuNabhAve sRSTi karechena? yadi tini icchA karena, tave teAmAdera astitva vilupta karate pArena, evaM eka natuna sRSTi astitve Anate pArena|
eTA AllAhara pakSe Adau kaThina naYa|

savAi AllAhara sAmane daNDAYamAna have evaM durvalerA dAmbhikadera valave, AmarA teA teAmAdera anusArI chilAma| ataeva, teAmarA AllAhara zAsti theke AmAdera sAmAnya ekaTuo rakSA karate pArave? tArA valave, yadi AllAha AmAdera satpatha dekhAtena, tave AmarA avazyai teAmAdera satpatha dekhAtAma| ekhana AmarA dhairyacyuta hai kiMvA dhairyazIla hai, savai AmAdera janye samAna| AmAdera kono niskRti nei|

yakhana sava kichura mImAMsA haYe yAve, takhana zaYatAna valave, nizcaYai AllAha teAmAdera diYechilena satya pratizruti evaM Ami teAmAdera pratizruti diYechi, kintu Ami tomAdera pradatta pratizruti rakSA karini; AmAra to tomAdera opara kono Adhipatya chila nA, Ami zudhu tomAdera AhavAna karechilAma, Ara tomarA AmAra AhavAne sAr3A diYechile; sutarAM tomarA AmAke doSAropa karo nA, tomarA tomAderakei doSAropa karo; Ami tomAdera uddhArakArI nai, tomarAo AmAra uddhArakArI nao| tomarA ye pUrve AmAke zarika karechile nizcaYa Ami tA asvIkAra karachi| nizcaYai yArA sImAlaGghanakArI tAdera janye raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

Ara yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma sampAdana kare, tAdera emana jAnnAte praveza karAneA have, yAra pAdadeza diYe pravAhita have nada-nadI, tArA tAte svIYa ravera nirdeze anantakAla avasthAna karave| yekhAne tAdera sambhASaNa have ‘sAlAma’|
tumi ki lakSa karo nA ye, AllAha kIbhAve upamA varNanA karena! uttama kAlimAra upamA utkRSTa vRkSera mato| tAra mUla sudRr3ha evaM yAra zAkhA prazAkhA urdhva vistRta|
yA pratyeka maosume phala dAna kare tAra ravera anumatikrame| AllAha mAnuSera janye dRSTAnta varNanA karena, yAte tArA zikSAgrahaNa kare|
Ara neAMrA kathAra upamA haleA manda vRkSera mato| yAke mATira upara theke samUle upar3e phelA haYeche| yAra keAno sthiti nei|
yArA ImAna eneche AllAha tAderake duniYAra jIvane o parajIvane zAzvata vANI dvArA avicala rAkhena| evaM AllAha sImAlaMGghanakArIdera pathabhraSTa karena| AllAha yA icchA, tA karena|
tumi ki tAdera dekha ni, yArA AllAhara neYAmatake kuphari kare parivartana kareche evaM tAdera jAtike sammukhIna kareche dhavaMsAlaYera|;
jAhAnnAmera, tArA tAte praveza karave, seTA katai nA manda AvAsa|
tArA AllAhara janye samakakSa vAniYeche, yAte tArA tAra patha theke vicyuta karate pAre| valo, majA upabheAga karo| ataHpara nizcaYa agnii tomAdera pratyAvartanasthala|

AmAra vAndAdera madhye yArA ImAna eneche tAderake valo tArA yena sAlAta pratiSThA kare evaM AmAra pradatta rijika theke geApane o prakAzye vyaYa kare oidina AsAra pUrve—yedina keAno vecAkenA evaM vandhutva thAkave nA|

tinii AllAha, yini AsamAnasamUha o yamina sRjana karechena evaM AkAza theke pAni varSaNa kare, tA dvArA teAmAdera jIvikAra janye phala-mUla utpanna karechena evaM nauyAnake karechena teAmAdera niYantraNAdhIna, yena tA~ra Adeze samudre tA calApherA kare evaM nadIguloke tomAdera kalyANe niYojita rekhechena|
evaM teAmAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena sUrya o candrake—yArA avirAma ekai niYamera anuvartI| Aro niYejita karechena rAta-dinake|

Ara teAmarA tA~ra kAche yA ceYecha, tAra pratyekaTi thekei tini teAmAdera diYechena| yadi tomarA AllAhara niYAmAta gaNanA karo, tave gune zeSa karate pArave nA| nizcaYai mAnuSa atyanta sImAlaMGghanakArI, adhika akRtajJa|
Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana ivarAhima valala, he AmAra rava! e zaharake zAntimaYa kare dina evaM AmAke o AmAra santAnasantatike mUrtipUjA theke dUre rAkhena|
he AmAra rava, nizcaYa tArA vipathagAmI kareche aneka mAnuSake; ataeva, ye AmAra anusaraNa kare, se AmAra dalabhukta evaM keu AmAra avAdhyatA karale, nizcaYai Apani kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

he AmAdera rava, AmAra vaMzadharadera katakake ApanAra pavitra gharera kAche cASAvAdahIna upatyakAYa vasati sthApana kariYe esechi| he AmAdera rava, yAte tArA sAlAta kAYema kare| ataeva, Apani kichu leAkera antarake tAdera prati anurAgI karuna evaM tAdera phalAdi dvArA jIvikA dena, AzA karA yAYa tArA kRtajJatA prakAza karave|
he AmAdera rava, Apani teA jAnena AmarA yA-kichu geApane evaM yA prakAzye kari| AllAhara kAche AsamAna o yamine keAno kichui geApana naYa|
sakala prazaMsA AllAharai, yini AmAke ei vArdhakya sattveo isamAila o isahAkake dAna karechena| nizcaYai AmAra rava duA zravaNakArI|
he AmAra rava, AmAke sAlAta kAYemakArI karuna evaM AmAra santAnadera madhye thekeo| he AmAdera rava, kavula karuna AmAra duA|
he AmAdera rava, AmAke, AmAra pitA-mAtAke evaM sava muminake kSamA kare dina, yedina hisAva neoYA have|
sImAlaGghanakArIrA yA kare, se samparke AllAhake kakhano vekhavara mane kareA nA| tAderake teA oi dina paryanta avakAza dicchena, yedina cakSusamUha visphArita have|
tArA mAthA opare tule bhIta-vihavala citte daur3Ate thAkave| tAdera dike tAdera dRSTi phirave nA evaM tAdera antara have zUnya|

mAnuSake sei dinera vyApAre satarka karo, yedina tAdera kAche zAsti Asave| takhana sImAlaGghanakArIrA valave, he AmAdera rava, AmAderake nikaTavartI meYAda paryanta avakAza dena, yAte AmarA ApanAra AhvAne sAr3A dite evaM rAsuladera anusaraNa karate pAri| teAmarA ki itipUrve zapatha karate thAkate nA ye, tomAdera kono dhvaMsa nei|

teAmarA tAdera vAsabhUmitei vasavAsa karate, yArA nijedera opara avicAra kareche evaM teAmAdera suvidita chila ye, Ami tAdera sAthe kemana vyavahAra karechi, Ara Ami teAmAdera nikaTa tAdera dRSTAntao upasthita karechilAma|
tArA bhISaNa cakrAnta kareche, evaM AllAhara kAche saMrakSita Ache tAdera kucakrAnta| yadio chilo tAdera cakrAnta yena Tale yAve tAra dvArA pAhAr3a|
ataeva, AllAhake tA~ra rAsuladera sAthe kRta oYAdA bhaGgakArI bhevo nA| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, daNDavidhAYaka|
yedina parivartita karA have e pRthivIke anya pRthivIte evaM parivartita karA have AkAzasamUhake Ara leAkerA eka parAkramazAlI, AllAhara sAmane upasthita have|
tumi oidina pApIdera paraspare zRGkhalAvaddha dekhave|
tAdera jAmA have dAhya AlakAtarAra evaM tAdera mukhamaNDalake Aguna Acchanna kare phelave|
yAte AllAha pratyeka vyakti yA upArjana kareche tAke tAra pratidAna dena| nizcaYai AllAha druta hisAva grahaNakArI|
eTA mAnuSera janya ekaTi saMvAdanAmA, era dvArA tAdera sartaka karA hacche yena tArA jene neYa, tini ekaka ilAh evaM yAte vodhazaktisampannarA upadeza grahaNa kare|
Alipha-lA-ma-rA; eguleA kitAva o suspaSTa kuraAnera AYAta|
acirei kAphirarA AkAGkSA karave ye, yadi tArA musalima hato!
tumi tAderake cher3e dAo, kheYe nika, upabhoga kare nika, Ara AzA-AkAGkSA tAderake mohAcchanna rAkhuka; ati zIghrai tArA jAnate pArave|
Ami keAno janapada dhvaMsa karini tAra janya nirdiSTa likhita samaYa chAr3A|
keAno sampradAYa tAra nirdiSTa samaYake tvarAnvita karate pAre nA evaM vilamvitao karate pAre nA |
tArA valala, ‘he sei vyakti, yAra prati kuraAna nAyila haYeche, nizcaYai tumi teA ekajana unmAda|’
‘AmAdera kAche kena pherezatAderake niYe eso nA, yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|’
Ami pherezatAderake preraNa kari nA yathAyatha kAraNa chAr3A; Ara (tArA upasthita hale) takhana tAderake avakAza deoYA have nA|
nizcaYa Amii e kuraAna nAyila karechi evaM Amii tAra saMrakSaka|
avazyai tomAra Age Ami pUrvavartI sampradAYera madhye rAsUla preraNa karechi|
odera kAche emana keAno rAsUla Ase ni, yAra sAthe tArA ThATTA-vidrupa kareni|
emanibhAve Ami tA (e dharanera AcaraNa) pApIdera antare vaddhamUla kare dii|
tArA tAra (kuraAnera) prati ImAna Anave nA, Ara pUrvavartIderao emanai rIti chila|
yadi Ami odera janya AkAzera keAno darajAo khule dii, Ara tAte orA dinabhara AreAhaNao karate thAke|
tavuo orA e kathAi valave, ‘AmAdera dRSTike sammohita karA haYeche; nA, varaM AmarA jAdugrasta sampradAYa|’
nizcaYai Ami AkAze kakSapatha sRSTi karechi evaM tAke darzakadera janya suzeAbhita kare diYechi|
evaM Ami AkAzake pratyeka vitAr3ita zaYatAna theke nirApada kare diYechi|
kintu ye keu curi kare zunate cAYa, tAra pazcAddhAvana kare jvalanta ulkApiNDa|
Ara Ami pRthivIke vistRta karechi, tAra opara sthApana karechi parvatamAlA evaM tAte pratyeka vastu suparimitabhAve utpanna karechi|
Ami teAmAdera janya tAte jIvikAra upakaraNa sRSTi karechi evaM tAdera janyao yAdera riyikadAtA teAmarA nao|
AmAra kAche pratyeka vastura bhAnDAra raYeche| Ami tA suSama parimANei saravarAha kare thAki|
Ami vRSTivAhI vAYu pAThAi, ataHpara AkAza theke vRSTi varSaNa kari, erapara teAmAderake tA pAna karAi; Ara teAmarA tAra bhAnDAra rakSaka nao|
Amii jIvana dAna kari evaM mRtyu ghaTAi evaM Amii (cUr3Anta) oYArisa|
nizcaYai Ami jAni teAmAdera pUrvavartIderake evaM Ami jAni tomAdera paravartIderake|
tomAra ravai tAderake ekatrita karavena; nizcaYai tini prajJAvAna, sarvajJa|
Ami mAnuSake sRSTi karechi kAlace kAdAra zukano ThanaThane mATi theke|
evaM itaHpUrve Ami jina sRSTi karechi prakhara zikhAyukta Aguna theke|
Ara smaraNa karo, tomAra rava yakhana pherezatAderake valalena, ‘Ami kAlace kAdAra zukano ThanaThane mATi theke mAnuSa sRSTi karava|’
‘ataHpara yakhana tAke pUrNAGga rUpa deva evaM tAte phu~ke deva AmAra rUha, takhana teAmarA tAra sAmane sijadAvanata haYe par3ave|’
ataHpara pherezatArA sakalei sijadA karala|
ivalIsa vyatIta; se sijadAkArIdera antarbhukta hate asvIkRti jAnAla|
tini (AllAha) valalena, ‘he ivalIsa, teAmAra kI haleA ye, tumi sijadAkArIdera antarbhukta hale nA?’
, se valala, ‘Ami emana nai ye, ekajana mAnuSake sijadA karava, yAke Apani kAlace kAdAra ThanaThane zukano mATi dvArA sRSTi karechena|’
tini valalena, ‘tave tumi ekhAna theke vera haYe yAo, nizcaYai tumi abhizapta|’
‘evaM teAmAra prati vicArera divasa paryanta abhisampAta|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Apani AmAke punarutthAna divasa paryanta avakAza dina|’
AllAha valalena, ‘tAhale nizcaYai tumi avakAzaprAptadera antarbhukta|’
‘sei dina paryanta—yeTA avadhArita samaYa|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Apani ye kAraNe AmAke pathabhraSTa karechena, Amio tAdera janya pRthivIte susajjita karava (pApa kAja) evaM tAdera savAike pathabhraSTa kare deva|’
‘ApanAra maneAnIta vAndAdera vyatIta|’
tini (AllAha) valalena, ‘eTA AmAra paryanta pau~chAra seAjA patha|’
‘nizcaYai AmAra vAndAdera opara tomAra keAno kSamatA nei; kintu pathabhraSTadera madhye ye tomAra anusaraNa karave, se chAr3A|
‘nizcaYai tAdera savAra pratizruta sthAna have jAhAnnAma|’
‘tAra raYeche sAtaTi darajA, pratyeka darajAra janya eka ekaTi pRthaka dala Ache|’
nizcaYai muttAkirA thAkave jAnnAta o jharNAsamUhera mAjhe|
(valA have,) ‘tomarA tAte praveza karo nirApattAra sAthe prazAntacitte|’
tAdera antare ye kreAdha chila, Ami tA dUra kare deva; tArA bhAi-bhAiYera mato sAmanA-sAmani Asane vasave|
sekhAne tAderake klAnti sparza karave nA evaM tArA sekhAna theke vahiSkRtao have nA|
tumi AmAra vAndAderake jAniYe dAo ye, Ami atyanta kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
Ara nizcaYai AmAra zAsti—yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
tumi tAderake ivarAhImera atithidera avasthA zuniYe dAo|
yakhana tArA tAra gRhe praveza kare valala, ‘sAlAma’| se valala, ‘AmarA teAmAdera vyApAre AtaGkita|’
tArA valala, ‘bhaYa karavena nA, AmarA ApanAke ekajana jJAnavAna putrasantAnera susaMvAda dicchi|’
se valala, ‘teAmarA ki AmAke ematAvasthAYa susaMvAda diccha, yakhana Ami vArdhakye pau~che gechi? tave tomarA kI dharanera susaMvAda diccho?’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA ApanAke satya susaMvAda dicchi; ataeva, Apani nirAza havena nA|’
se valala, ‘pathabhraSTarA chAr3A Ara ke tAra ravera rAhamAta theke nirAza haYa?’
se valala, ‘teAmAdera Ara kI uddezya, he AllAhara preritagaNa?’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA eka aparAdhI sampradAYera prati prerita haYechi|’
‘kintu lUtera parivAra-parijana vyatIta, AmarA avazyai tAdera savAike rakSA karava|’
‘tave tAra strI vyatIta; AmarA Thika karechi, nizcaYai se pazcAtgAmIdera dalabhukta|’
ataHpara yakhana prerita pherezatArA lUtera parivArera kAche pau~chala|
se valala, ‘teAmarA teA aparicita leAka|’
tArA valala, ‘nA, varaM AmarA ApanAra kAche esechi sei viSaYa niYe, ye samparke tArA sandeha karata|’
‘AmarA ApanAra kAche satya viSaYa niYe esechi evaM nizcaYai AmarA satyavAdI|’

‘ataeva, Apani zeSarAte parivArera sakalake niYe cale yAna evaM Apani tAdera pechana theke anusaraNa karavena evaM ApanAdera keu yena pechane phire nA dekhe| ApanArA yekhAne AdezaprApta hacchena sekhAne cale yAna|’
Ami lUtake e viSaYa jAniYe dii ye, sakAla halei tAderake samUle vinAza kare deoYA have|
zaharavAsI Ananda-ullAsa karate karate ela|
lUta valala, ‘tArA AmAra atithi; ataeva, tomarA AmAke lAJchita kareA nA|’
‘teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra sammAna naSTa kareA nA|’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA ki ApanAke jagadvAsIra (mehamAnadAri karate) niSedha karini?’
se valala, ‘erA AmAra kanyA; yadi teAmarA kichu karate cAo|’
tomAra prANera kasama, tArA Apana nezAYa pramatta chila|
ataHpara sUryeAdaYera samaYa tAderake vikaTa zavda ese pAkar3Ao karala|
ataHpara Ami janapadaTi opara-nica ulaTe dilAma evaM tAdera upara pAthara varSaNa karalAma|
nizcaYai ete cintAzIladera janya nidarzanAvali raYeche|
Ara nizcaYai tA (janapadaTi) pathera pAze avasthita raYeche|
nizcaYai ete mu’minadera janya Ache nidarzana|
nizcaYai AikAra adhivAsIrA chila yAlima|
ataHpara Ami tAdera kAcha thekeo pratizeAdha niYechi, Ara ubhaYa janapadai halo suspaSTa dRSTAnta|
nizcaYai hijarera vAsindArAo rAsUladera prati mithyA Aropa kareche|
Ami tAderake AmAra nidarzanAvali diYechi, ataHpara tArA eguleA theke mukha phiriYe niYeche|
tArA pAhAr3a keTe ghara vAnAta nirApada vasavAsera janya|
ataHpara eka sakAle tAdera opara vikaTa zavda ese AghAta karala|
takhana keAno upakAre ela nA, yA tArA arjana karechila|
Ami AsamAnasamUha o yamina evaM e duTira madhyavartI yA kichu Ache, tA yathAyatha prakriYA chAr3A sRSTi karini evaM kiYAmAta avazyai Asave| ataeva, parama saujanyera sAthe tumi tAderake upakSeA karo|
nizcaYai tomAra rava mahAsraSTA, sarvajJa|
Ami tomAke diYechi sAtaTi vAra vAra paThitavya AYAta evaM mahA kuraAna|
tumi cokha tule tA dekhave nA, yA Ami tAdera madhye kaYeka zreNira leAkake bheAgasAmagrI diYechi, tAdera janya cintita have nA, Ara mu’minadera janye tomAra (mamatAra) DAnA nAmiYe dAo|
Ara valo, ‘Ami prakAzya satarkakArI|’
yemana Ami avatIrNa karechi vibhaktakArIdera opara|
yArA kuraAnake khaNDa khaNDa kareche|
ataeva, tomAra ravera kasama, Ami avazyai tAdera savAike jijJAsAvAda karava,
se samparke, yA tArA karata|
ataeva, tumi prakAzye zuniYe dAo yA tomAke Adeza karA haYa evaM muzarikaderake upekSA karo|
vidrupakArIdera vipakSe Amii tomAra janya yatheSTa|
yArA AllAhara sAthe anya ilAh sAvyasta kare, ati-satvara tArA jAnate pArave|
Ami jAni ye, tArA yA kichu vale se kAraNe tomAra antara saMkIrNa haYe par3e|
ataeva, tomAra ravera prazaMsA dvArA tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karo evaM sijadAkArIdera antarbhukta hao|
tomAra ravera ivAdAta karo yatakSaNa nA tomAra kAche mRtyu upasthita haYa|
AllAhara nirdeza Asavei; ataeva, tA druta Anate ceYo nA| tini mahimAnvita evaM tArA yA zarika sAvyasta karache tini tAra Urdhve|
tini tA~ra nirdeze vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA, oYAhisaha pherezatAderake preraNa karena ei marme ye, tomarA tAderake satarka karo, nizcaYai Ami chAr3A keAno ilAh nei; ataeva, AmAke bhaYa karo|
tini AsamAna o yamina sRSTi karechena yathAyathabhAve; tArA yA zarika kare tini tA theke vahu Urdhve|
tini mAnuSake zukrANu theke sRSTi karechena; tavuo se prakAzya vitarkakArI|
tini catuSpada jantu sRSTi karechena; ete teAmAdera janya zItavastrera upakaraNa Ara aneka upakAra Ache evaM tA theke teAmarA AhAra karo|
era mAjhe raYeche tomAdera janya saundarya yakhana godhUlilagne cAraNabhUmi theke niYe Aso evaM prabhAte cAraNabhUmite niYe yAo|

evaM erA teAmAdera veAjhAsamUha emana zahara paryanta vahana kare niYe yAYa, yekhAne teAmarA prANAntakara parizrama vyatIta pau~chate pArate nA| nizcaYai teAmAdera rava atyanta karuNAmaYa, asIma daYAlu|
tini sRSTi karechena gheAr3A, khaccara o gAdhA yena tomarA segulote ArohaNa karate pAro evaM zeAbhA hiseve, Ara tini emana jinisa sRSTi karena, yA teAmarA jAno nA|
sarala patha AllAha paryanta pau~chAYa evaM pathaguleAra madhye kichu vakra pathao raYeche| tini icchA karale teAmAdera sakalake hidAYAtera pathe paricAlita karate pAratena|
tinii yini varSaNa karena teAmAdera janya AkAza theke pAni| tA theke teAmarA pAo pAnIYa evaM tA thekei udbhida utpanna haYa, yAra madhye teAmarA pazucAraNa karo|
tini tA dvArA udgata karena tomAdera janya phasala, yAituna, khejura, AGura o sava dharanera phala| nizcaYai ete cintAzIla lokadera janya raYeche nidarzana|
tinii teAmAdera kAje niYeAjita karechena rAta, dina, sUrya evaM candrake; Ara tArakArAji tA~rai nirdeze niYeAjita raYeche| nizcaYai era mAjhe raYeche jJAnIdera janya nidarzanAvali|
evaM teAmAdera janya pRthivIte yesava vastu sRSTi karechena, vibhinna rakama yAra raM; nizcaYai seguleAte nidarzana raYeche tAdera janya yArA zikSA grahaNa kare|

tinii yini tomAdera adhIna karechena samudrake, yena tA theke teAmarA tAjA (mAchera) gozata khete pAra evaM tA theke vera karate pAra alaMkAra (era ratnAvali) yA tomarA paridhAna karo; tumi tAte jalayAnasamUhake pAni vidIrNa kare calate dekhave, yena teAmarA AllAhara kRpA anveSaNa karo evaM tA~ra zokara AdAYa karo|
evaM tini pRthivIra vuke sthApana karechena parvatasamUha, yena tA teAmAderake niYe Andolita nA haYa evaM nada-nadI o patha tairi karechena, yena teAmarA saThika gantavye yete pAro|
Ara patha-nirNAYaka vahu cihna evaM tArakA dvArAo tArA pathera nirdeza pAYa|
ataeva, yini sRSTi karena, tini ki tAra mato ye sRSTi karate pAre nA? tavuo ki teAmarA cintA karave nA?
yadi tomarA AllAhara niYAmAta gaNanA karo, tA gune zeSa karate pArave nA| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
AllAha jAnena, yA teAmarA geApana karo o yA prakAza karo|
evaM yArA AllAhake cher3e anyaderake DAke, tArA keAno vastui sRSTi karate pAre nA; varaM orA nijerAi sRjita|
tArA mRta-prANahIna evaM kave tAderake punarutthita karA have, tAdera se dhAraNA nei|
tomAdera ilAha ekaka ilAha; sutarAM yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA, tAdera antara satyavimukha evaM tArA ahaMkAra pradarzanakArI|
nizcaYai AllAha tA avagata yA tArA geApana kare evaM yA prakAza kare| nizcaYai tini ahaMkArIderake pachanda karena nA|
yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘ teAmAdera rava kI avatIrNa karechena?’ tArA vale, ‘pUrvavartIdera kisasA-kAhini!’
phale tArA kiYAmAtera dina pUrNamAtrAYa vahana karave tAdera pApabhAra evaM tAdera pApera vojhAo yAderake tArA vipathagAmI kareche ajJAtasAre| jene rekho, katai nA nikRSTa veAjhA tArA vahana karave!

tAdera pUrvavartIrAo cakrAnta kareche, ataHpara AllAha tAdera cakrAntera kAThAmora bhittimUle AghAta karechilena; ataHpara tAdera upara theke chAda dhvase par3ala evaM tAdera opara emana sthAna theke zAsti ela yA tArA upaladdhio karate pArala nA|

ataHpara kiYAmAtera dina tini tAderake lAJchita karavena evaM valavena, ‘keAthAYa AmAra aMzIdArarA, yAdera vyApAre teAmarA khuva haThakAritA karate?’ yAderake jJAna deoYA haYechila tArA valave, ‘nizcaYai Ajakera dine lAJchanA o durgati kAphiradera janya|’

pherezatArA tAdera prANa haraNa karave, yArA nijedera opara sImAlaGghanakArI; takhana tArA Anugatya prakAza kare valave, ‘AmarA teA keAno manda kAja karatAma nA|’ hyA~, nizcaYai AllAha avagata Achena, yA teAmarA karate|
ataeva, tomarA jAhAnnAmera darajAsamUha diYe praveza karo, tAte sthAYI haYe; Ara ahaMkArIdera AvAsasthala katai nA nikRSTa!

Ara yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche tAderake valA have, ‘teAmAdera rava kI avatIrNa karechena?’ tArA valeve—’mahAkalyANa|’ yArA ei duniYAYa satkAja kare tAdera janya raYeche kalyANa evaM AkhirAtera nivAsa Arao uttama; muttAkidera nivAsa katai nA camatkAra!
sthAYI jAnnAta, tArA tAte praveza karave; tAra pAdadeza diYe pravAhita nada-nadI; tArA yA kichu kAmanA karave tAte tAdera janya tA-i thAkave| ebhAvei AllAha muttAkiderake pratidAna diYe thAkena|
pherezatA yAdera mRtyu ghaTAYa pavitra thAkA avasthAYa| pherezatArA vale, ‘teAmAdera prati zAnti varSita heAka; teAmarA yA Amala karate tAra vinimaYe jAnnAte praveza karo|’

kAphirarA ki apekSA karache ye, tAdera kAche pherezatArA Asave vA tomAra ravera nirdeza Asave? tAdera pUrvavartIrA emanai karechila| AllAha tAdera prati avicAra karenani, varaM tArAi nijedera prati sImAlaGghana karata|
sutarAM tArA yA kareche tAra manda pariNati tAderake AkrAnta kareche evaM tArA yA niYe upahAsa karata tA tAderake ghire pheleche|

yArA ziraka kareche tArA valala, ‘yadi AllAha cAitena, tave AmarA o AmAdera pUrvapuruSarA tA~ke chAr3A anya kichura ivAdAta karatAma nA, evaM tA~ra nirdeza chAr3A keAno jinisai AmarA hArAma karatAma nA|’ Asale tAdera pUrvavartIrAo emanai kareche| sutarAM rAsUlera dAYitva teA zudhu suspaSTa vANI pau~che deoYA|

Ami pratyeka ummAtera madhyei rAsUla preraNa karechi ei marme ye, ‘teAmarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo evaM tAgUtake varjana karo|’ ataHpara tAdera theke kAuke AllAha hidAYAta dAna karechena evaM kAro opara vipathagAmitA avadhArita haYeche; sutarAM teAmarA pRthivIte bhramaNa karo evaM dekho mithyAropakArIdera kI pariNati haYeche?
yadio tumi tAderake hidAYAtera vyApAre khuvai AgrahI hao, tavuo AllAha yAke vipathagAmI karechena tini tAke hidAYAta devena nA evaM tAdera keAno sAhAyyakArIo nei|
tArA AllAhara nAme kaTheAra zapatha kare vale, ‘yAra mRtyu haYa AllAha tAke punarujjIvita karavena nA|’ avazyai tA~ra pratizruti satya, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jJAna rAkhe nA|
yAte tini tAdera sAmane spaSTa karena yA niYe tArA matAnaikya kare evaM yArA kuphuri kareche tArA yena jene neYa tArA mithyAvAdI chila|
Ami yakhana keAno kichu karAra icchA kari, takhana tAke kevala etaTukui vali—‘haYe yAo|’ Ara amani tA haYe yAYa|
yArA niryAtita haoYAra para AllAhara janya hijarAta kareche, Ami avazyai tAderake duniYAte uttama AvAsa deva, Ara AkhirAtera pratidAna to zreSTha; yadi tArA jAnata!
yArA savara kareche evaM tAdera ravera opara bharasA kareche|
Ara tomAra pUrveo puruSadera chAr3A kAuke rAsUla hiseve pAThAini, yAdera kAche Ami oYAhi preraNa karatAma| ataeva, jJAnera adhikArIderake jijJesa karo, yadi tomarA nA jAno|
(preraNa karechi) spaSTa nidarzanAvali o kitAvasamUha evaM tomAra prati avatIrNa karechi kuraAna, yAte tumi mAnuSera nikaTa spaSTabhAve varNanA karo, yAte tArA cintA-bhAvanA kare|
yArA nikRSTa cakrAnta kare, tArA ki e viSaYe nirApada haYe geche ye, AllAha tAderasaha bhUmike vilIna kare devena nA vA tAdera kAche zAsti Asave nA emana dika theke yA tArA dhAraNAo kare nA?
athavA calApherAra madhyei tAderake pAkar3Ao karavena nA? tArA tA vyartha karate pArave nA|
athavA bhIta-santrasta avasthAYa tAderake pAkar3Ao karavena nA? tave nizcaYai teAmAdera rava atyanta snehazIla, asIma daYAlu|
tArA ki lakSa kare nA tAra prati yA AllAha sRSTi karechena, yAra chAYA DAne o vAme jhu~ke par3e AllAhara prati vinItabhAve sijadAvanata haYa?
evaM AllAhara prati sijadA kare yA-kichu Ache AsamAnasamUhe o yamine vicaraNazIla prANikula, Ara pherezatArAo; tArA ahaMkAra kare nA|
tArA tAdera opara parAkramazAlI tAdera ravake bhaYa kare evaM tArA tA-i kare yA tAderake Adeza karA haYa|
AllAha valalena, ‘teAmarA dui ilAh grahaNa kareA nA; tinii teA ekamAtra ilAh| sutarAM tomarA AmAkei bhaYa karo|’
AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA-kichu Ache tA tA~rai evaM niravacchinna Anugatya tA~rai janya| teAmarA ki AllAha vyatIta anya kAuke bhaYa karave?
teAmAdera kAche yata niYAmAta Ache tA AllAharai pakSa theke; ataHpara teAmAderake yakhana duHkha-kaSTa sparza kare takhana tA~ra kAchei tomarA minati karo|
anantara yakhana teAmAdera kaSTa dUrIbhUta kare dena, takhanai teAmAdera ekadala tAdera ravera sAthe aMzIdAra sAvyasta karate thAke|
yena Ami tAderake yA diYechi tAra kuphuri karate pAre| ataeva, upabheAga kare nAo; satvarai teAmarA jAnate pArave|

Ara Ami tAderake ye jIvikA diYechi tAra ekaTi aMzake tArA nirdhAraNa kare emana sattAra janya, yAdera vyApAre tArA jAnei nA| AllAhara zapatha, tomAderake jijJAsA karA have oi viSaYe yA tomarA mithyA racanA karacha|
tArA AllAhara janya nirdhAraNa kare kanyAsantAna, tini (tA theke) pUta-pavitra evaM tAdera janya tA-i, yA tArA pachanda kare|
yakhana tAdera kAuke kanyA-santAnera susaMvAda deoYA haYa, takhana tAdera mukha kAlo haYe yAYa evaM ye se haYa duzcintAgrasta|

tAke ye susaMvAda deoYA haYeche, glAnira kAraNe se nija sampradAYa theke Atmagopana kare| (se bhAve), apamAna sattveo ki tAke rekhe deve, nA tAke mATira nice pu~te phelave! jene rekho| katai nA nikRSTa yA tArA siddhAnta neYa!
yArA AkhirAtera prati ImAna rAkhe nA tAdera janya raYeche nikRSTa upamA, Ara AllAhara janya halo sarvocca upamA; tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha yadi mAnuSake tAdera sImAlaGghanera kAraNe (sAthe sAthe) pAkar3Ao karatena, tave tAte (bhUpRSThe) calamAna keAno prANIkei chAr3atena nA; kintu tAderake avakAza dena nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta| ataHpara yakhana nirdhArita samaYa ese yAve, takhana muhUrtakAlao vilamvita vA tvarAnvita karate pArave nA|

yA tArA nijedera janya apachanda kare tA tArA AllAhara janya sAvyasta kare evaM tAdera jihvA mithyA varNanA kare ye, nizcaYai tAdera janya raYeche kalyANa| svataHsiddha kathA halo, tAdera janya raYeche Aguna evaM tArA sekhAne nikSipta have|

AllAhara zapatha, Ami tomAra pUrve vibhinna sampradAYera prati rAsUla preraNa karechi; ataHpara zaYatAna tAdera karmasamUhake tAdera kAche zeAbhanIYa karechila; Aja se-i tAdera abhibhAvaka evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
Ara Ami tomAra prati ejanyai kitAva avatIrNa karechi, ye viSaYe tArA matavireAdha karache tA tAdera kAche suspaSTa kare deve, Ara hidAYAta o anugraha emana sampradAYera janya yArA ImAna Ane|
AllAha AkAza theke vAri varSaNa karena, phale tA dvArA yaminake tAra mRtyura para punarjIvita karena| nizcaYai tAte emana sampradAYera janya nidarzana raYeche, yArA zravaNa kare|
nizcaYai teAmAdera janya catuSpada jantudera madhye raYeche zikSA| Ami teAmAderake tAra peTera bhetarera geAvara o raktera madhyakhAna theke dudha pAna karAi, yA khA~Ti o pAnakArIdera janya supeYa|
Ara khejuragAchera phala o AGura theke teAmarA mAdaka o uttama khAdya grahaNa kare thAko; nizcaYai sei jAtira janya nidarzana raYeche yArA vuddhi rAkhe |
Ara tomAra rava maumAchira prati pratyAdeza karechena ye, ‘pAhAr3e, gAcha-pAlAYa evaM u~cu aTTAlikAYa ghara vAnAo|’

‘erapara sarvaprakAra phala theke bhakSaNa karo evaM Apana ravera sahaja (nirdezita) paddhati vinItabhAve anusaraNa karo|’ tAra peTa theke vibhinna raGera pAnIYa nirgata haYa; tAte mAnuSera janya raYeche reAgera pratikAra| nizcaYai ete raYeche nidarzana tAdera janya yArA cintA-phikira kare|

AllAha teAmAderake sRSTi karechena; erapara teAmAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena evaM teAmAdera madhye katakake upanIta karA have jarAgrasta akarmaNya vaYase, yena tAra ajAnA haYe yAYa savakichu jJAna lAbhera pareo| nizcaYai AllAha sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|

AllAha jIvaneApakaraNera kSetre tomAdera katakake katakera opara zreSThatva diYechena| ataeva, yAderake zreSThatva deoYA haYeche, tArA nijedera adhInastha dAsa-dAsIderake tAdera jIvikA deYa nA, e viSaYe tArA tAdera samAna haYe yAve vale| tave ki tArA AllAhara niYAmAta asvIkAra kare?

AllAha teAmAdera janya teAmAderai theke yugala sRSTi karechena evaM teAmAdera yugala theke teAmAdera chelepule o nAtiputi sRSTi karechena evaM teAmAderake dAna karechena pavitra jIvaneApakaraNa| ataeva, tArA ki mithyAra prati ImAna Anave evaM AllAhara anugraha asvIkAra karave?
tArA AllAha vyatIta emana kichura ivAdAta kare, ye tAderake AsamAnasamUha o yamina theke sAmAnya riyika deoYArao kSamatA rAkhe nA evaM tArA sakSama haveo nA|
ataeva, AllAhara keAno sadRza sAvyasta kareA nA; nizcaYai AllAha jAnena evaM teAmarA jAno nA|

Ara AllAha upamA varNanA karachena—aparera mAlikAnAdhIna eka geAlAmera, ye keAno kichura opara kSamatA rAkhe nA evaM emana ekajana yAke Ami AmAra pakSa theke utkRSTa riyika dAna karechi| ataeva, se tA theke vyaYa kare geApane o prakAzye; tArA ubhaYe ki samAna? sakala prazaMsA AllAhara; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

Ara AllAha du-vyaktira dRSTAnta varNanA karachena—tAdera ekajana veAvA, se kono kichura opara kSamatA rAkhe nA evaM se mAlikera opara veAjhA; yedikei tAke pAThAno haYa, se bhAlo kichu niYe Asate pAre nA; se ki samAna have oi vyaktira, ye nyAYera nirdeza deYa evaM ye sarala pathe pratiSThita raYeche?
AsamAnasamUha o yaminera adRzyera jJAna AllAharai raYeche evaM kiYAmAtera vyApAraTi teA ceAkhera palakera mato athavA tAra cAiteo nikaTavartI| nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe sarva zaktimAna|
AllAha teAmAderake teAmAdera mAtRgarbha theke vera karechena (emana avasthAYa ye,) teAmarA kichui jAnate nA| tini teAmAderake karNa, cakSu o antara diYechena, yAte teAmarA kRtajJatA svIkAra karo|

tArA ki lakSa kare nA AkAzera zUnye niYantraNAdhIna (ur3anta) pAkhigulora prati? AllAha chAr3A keu eguleAke (zUnye) dhare rAkhe nA| nizcaYai ete aneka nidarzana raYeche sei sampradAYera janya yArA ImAna Ane|

AllAha tomAdera janya tomAdera gharaguloke vAniYechena prazAntira jAYagA, tomAdera janya catuSpada jantura cAmar3A dvArA tA~vura gharera vyavasthA karechena, teAmarA eguleAke sapharakAle o avasthAnakAle hAlakA mane karo| tini tomAdera janya vyavasthA karena tAdera pazama, loma o keza hate kichukAlera janya gRhasAmagrI o vyavahAra-upakaraNa|

AllAha yA-kichu sRSTi karechena tA theke tomAdera janya chAYA kare diYechena, pAhAr3asamUhe teAmAdera janya kare diYechena AzraYasthala evaM teAmAdera janya peAzAka-AzAka tairi kare diYechena, yA teAmAderake tApa theke rakSA kare evaM varmera vyavasthA karechena, yA tomAderake rakSA kare tomAdera yuddhe| ebhAvei tini tomAdera opara tA~ra anugraha pUrNa karena, yAte tomarA anugata hao|
ataHpara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave tomAra dAYitva suspaSTabhAve pau~che deoYA mAtra|
tArA AllAhara anugraha anudhAvana kare; tAraparao tA asvIkAra kare evaM tAdera adhikAMzai akRtajJa|
yedina Ami pratyeka jAti theke ekajana sAkSI utthita karava, takhana tAderake anumati deoYA have nA yArA kuphuri kareche evaM tAdera santuSTi lAbhera suyogao deoYA have nA|
yakhana tArA dekhave zAsti yArA sImAlaGghana kareche, takhana tAdera theke tA laghu karA have nA evaM tAdera keAno avakAza deoYA have nA|

muzarikarA yakhana tAdera zarikadera dekhave, takhana tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, erAi tArA yAdera AmarA ApanAra sAthe zarika karechilAma; AmarA yAderake DAkatAma ApanAke cher3e|’ takhana orA tAdera valave, ‘nizcaYai teAmarA mithyAvAdI|’
sedina tArA AllAhara prati Anugatya nivedana karave evaM tArA ye mithyA apavAda dita tA tAdera theke udhAo have|
yArA kuphuri kareche evaM AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi kareche, Ami tAdera opara zAstira para zAsti vRddhi karava| kAraNa, tArA viparyaYa sRSTi karata|

Ara sedina pratyeka jAti theke ekajana sAkSI utthita karava tAdera vipakSe tAdera madhya thekei evaM tAdera viSaYe tomAke sAkSIsvarUpa upasthApana karava| Ami tomAra prati avatIrNa karechi kitAva yA pratyeka vastura suspaSTa varNanA, hidAYAtao rAhamAta evaM musalamAnadera janya susaMvAdasvarUpa|

nizcaYai AllAha nyAYaparAYaNatA, sadAcaraNa evaM nikaTajanaderake dAna karAra Adeza dena evaM tini azlIlatA, apakarma kAja evaM avAdhyatA karate vAraNa karena| tini teAmAdera upadeza dena yAte teAmarA zikSA grahaNa karo|

AllAhara nAme aGgIkAra karAra para se aGgIkAra pUrNa karo evaM dRr3ha zapatha karAra para tA bhaGga kareA nA, athaca teAmarA AllAhake tomAdera abhibhAvaka karecha| nizcaYai teAmarA yA karo AllAha tA jAnena|

teAmarA oi nArIra mato haYeA nA, ye tAra sutA majavuta kare pAkAnora para TukareA TukareA kare chi~r3e phele, teAmarA nijedera kasamasamUhake pArasparika pravaJcanAra vAhAnArUpe grahaNa karecha, yAte eka dala anya dala apekSA adhika kSamatAvAna haYa| era mAdhyame AllAha zudhu teAmAdera parIkSA karena| nizcaYai tini tomAdera janya kiYAmAtera dina prakAza kare devena ye viSaYe teAmarA matavirodha karate|

AllAha icchA karale teAmAdera savAike eka jAti kare dite pAratena, kintu tini yAke icchA vipathagAmI karena evaM yAke icchA hidAYAta dAna karena| teAmarA yA karo se viSaYe avazya avazyai jijJAsita have|

teAmarA tomAdera aGgIkAramUhake pArasparika pravaJcanAra mAdhyama hiseve grahaNa karo nA| tave dRr3habhAve pratiSThita haoYAra para pA phasake yAve evaM teAmarA zAstira svAda AsvAdana karave e kAraNe ye, teAmarA AmAra pathe vAdhA diYecha| Ara teAmAdera janya Ache mahA zAsti|
teAmarA AllAhara aGgIkArera vinimaYe sAmAnya mUlya grahaNa kareA nA| nizcaYai AllAhara kAche yA Ache, tA teAmAdera janya uttama yadi teAmarA jAnate|
teAmAdera kAche yA Ache niHzeSa haYe yAve evaM AllAhara kAche yA Ache, tA sthAYI| yArA savara kareche, Ami tAdera prApya pratidAna deva tAdera uttama karmera pratidAnasvarUpa, yA tArA karata|
ye satkarma kare puruSa heAka kiMvA nArI ematAvasthAYa ye se mu’mina, Ami tAke avazyai pavitra jIvana dAna karava evaM tAderake tAdera uttama kAjera janya uttama puraskAra dAna karava|
ataeva, yakhana tumi kuraAna pATha karo, takhana vitAr3ita zaYatAna theke AllAhara AzraYa prArthanA karo|
tAra Adhipatya nei tAdera opara yArA ImAna eneche evaM Apana ravera opara bharasA kare|
tAra Adhipatya teA tAdera oparai cale, yArA tAke vandhu vAniYe neYa evaM yArA tAke tAra sAthe zarika sAvyastakArI|

evaM yakhana Ami eka AYAtera sthale anya AYAta upasthita kari evaM AllAha yA avatIrNa karena tinii se samparke bhAlo jAnena; takhana tArA vale, ‘mUlata tumi managar3A ukti karo;’ varaM tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

valo, ‘tinii tA avatIrNa karechena rUhula kudasa tomAra ravera pakSa theke satyasaha avatIrNa karechena, yAte tAderake pratiSThita karena yArA ImAna Ane evaM eTA musalimadera janya pathanirdeza o susaMvAdasvarUpa|’
Ami teA bhAlobhAvei jAni ye, nizcaYai tArA vale, ‘tAke janaika vyakti zikSA deYa|’ yAra dike tArA iGgita kare, tAra bhASA teA Aravi naYa; athaca e kuraAna pariSkAra AravibhASAYa|
yArA AllAhara nirdazanasamUhera prati ImAna Ane nA, tAderake AllAha hidAYAta dAna karena nA evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
mithyA kevala tArA racanA kare, yArA AllAhara nirdazanasamUhera prati ImAna Ane nA evaM tArAi mithyAvAdI|

ye ImAna AnAra para AllAhara sAthe kuphuri kareche evaM yAra antara kuphurira janya unmukta kareche, tAdera opara AllAhara gayava evaM tAra janya raYeche mahA zAsti, tave tAra janya naYa, yAke kuphurira janya vAdhya karA haYeche| kintu tAra antara ImAnera opara avicala|
eTA e janya ye, tArA ihajIvanake parajIvanera opara prAdhAnya diYeche| nizcaYai AllAha kAphira sampradAYake hidAYAta dAna kare nA|
erAi tArA, AllAha tAderai antara, karNa o cakSura opara meAhara mere diYechena evaM tArAi kANDajJAnahIna|
kono sandeha nei AkhirAte tArAi kSatigrasta|

ataHpara tomAra rava tAdera janya yArA niryAtita haoYAra para hijarAta kareche, ataHpara jihAda kareche evaM dhairyadhAraNa kareche, nizcaYai tomAra rava esava kichura para avazyai kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
yedina pratyeka vyakti nijera pakSe yukti-tarka niYe upasthita have evaM pUrNa mAtrAYa deoYA have pratyaka vyaktike yA se kareche evaM tAra prati kono avicAra karA have nA|

AllAha dRSTAnta varNanA karechena ekaTi janapadera, yA chila nirApada o nizcinta, tathAYa sarvadika theke Asata pracura jIvaneApakaraNa| ataHpara tArA AllAhara niYAmAtera prati akRtajJatA prakAza karala| takhana AllAha tAderake tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe kSudhA o bhItira svAda AsvAdana karAlena|
tAdera kAche tAdera madhya thekei ekajana rAsUla Agamana karechila; kintu tArA tAra prati mithyAreApa karala| phale tAderake pAkar3Ao karala zAsti| Ara nizcaYai orA chila sImAlaGghanakArI|
ataeva, AllAha teAmAdera yesava hAlAla o pavitra vastu diYechena, tA teAmarA AhAra karo evaM AllAhara anugrahera janya kRtajJatA prakAza karo; yadi teAmarA tA~rai ivAdAtakArI haYe thAko|

tini to zudhu teAmAdera janya hArAma karechena rakta, zUkarera mAMsa evaM yA (javAiYera samaYa) AllAhara parivarte anyera nAma uccAraNa karA haYeche| avazya keu vidrohI o sImAlaGghanakArI nA haYe ananyopAYa haYe par3ale tave AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

teAmAdera mukha theke sAdhAraNata yesava mithyA vera haYe Ase sebhAve teAmarA AllAhara viruddhe mithyAreApa kare valo nA, ‘eTA hAlAla evaM oTA hArAma|’ nizcaYai yArA AllAhara nAme mithyA racanA kare, tArA saphala have nA|
ati sAmAnya bhogasAmagrI| tAdera janye raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
iYAhUdidera janya Ami teA kevala tAi hArAma karechilAma yA itaHpUrve tomAra nikaTa ullekha karechi| Ami tAdera prati keAno avicAra karini, kintu tArAi nijedera opara avicAra karata|

ataHpara nizcaYai tomAra rava tAdera janya yArA ajJatAvazata manda kAja kare, ataHpara tAovA kare evaM nijeke saMzeAdhana kare neYa, tomAra rava esavera pare tAdera janya avazyai kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
nizcaYai ivarAhIma chila eka sampradAYera pratIka, AllAhara janya anugata o ekaniSTha, evaM se muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA|
se tA~ra anugrahera prati kRtajJatA prakAzakArI chila| AllAha tAke maneAnIta karechilena evaM sarala pathe paricAlita karechilena|
Ami tAke duniYAte dAna karechi kalyANa evaM tini parakAleo satkarmazIladera antarbhukta|
ataHpara tomAra prati pratyAdeza preraNa karechi ye, ekaniSThabhAve ivarAhImera dIna anusaraNa karo, Ara se muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA|
zanivAra pAlana kevala nirdhArita haYechila tAdera janya, yArA ete matavireAdha karechila| tomAra rava kiYAmAtera dina tAdera madhye mImAMsA karavena, ye viSaYe tArA matavireAdha karata|

tomAra ravera pathe AhvAna karo prajJAra sAthe evaM sundara upadezera mAdhyame; evaM tAdera sAthe vitarka karo uttama panthAYa| nizcaYai tomAra rava oi vyakti samparke sarvAdhika avagata, ye tA~ra patha theke vicyuta haYeche evaM tinii bhAlo jAnena yArA hidAYAtaprApta|
Ara yadi teAmarA pratizeAdha grahaNa karo, tave oi parimANa pratizeAdha grahaNa karave, ye parimANa teAmAdera kaSTa deoYA haYeche| yadi savara karo, tave tA savarakArIdera janya uttama|
tumi savara karo| tomAra savara zudhui AllAhara sAhAyye, tAdera janye duHkha karo nA evaM tAdera cakrAntera kAraNe manaHkSuNna haYo nA|
nizcaYai AllAha tAdera saGge Achena, yArA muttAki evaM yArA satkarmaparAYaNa|

mahimAnvita oi sattA, yini tA~ra vAndAke rAtera velAYa bhramaNa kariYechilena mAsajide hArAma theke mAsajide AkasA paryanta; yAra cArapAze Ami paryApta vArakAha dAna karechi yena Ami tAke AmAra kichu nidarzana dekhAi| nizcaYai tini sarvazrotA o sarvadraSTA|
Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechi evaM seTike vAniYechi vani isarAIlera janya hidAYAta, yena teAmarA AmAke chAr3A kAuke karmavidhAYaka grahaNa nA kareA|
teAmarA tAdera vaMzadhara, yAderake Ami nUhera sAthe ArohaNa kariYechilAma| nizcaYai se chila kRtajJa vAndA|
Ami vani isarAIlake kitAve pratyAdeza dvArA jAniYe diYechi, nizcaYai teAmarA pRthivIra vuke duvAra nairAjya sRSTi karave evaM tomarA atizaYa uddhata have|

ataHpara yakhana sei pratizruta prathama samaYaTi ela, takhana Ami teAmAdera viruddhe pAThAlAma AmAra kaTheAra zaktidhara vAndAdera| ataHpara tArA pratiTi ghare ghare dhvaMsayajJa cAliYechila| e oYAdA vAstavAYana haoYArai chila|
ataHpara Ami teAmAdera janya tAdera viruddhe pAlA ghuriYe dilAma, teAmAdera dhana-sampada o putrasantAna dvArA sAhAyya karalAma evaM teAmAdera ekaTA vizAla vAhinIte pariNata karalAma|

teAmarA yadi bhAlo karo, tave nijederai bhAlo karave evaM yadi manda karo tave tAo nijedera viruddhe| erapara yakhana dvitIYa pratizruta samaYaTi ela, (takhana anya vAndAdera preraNa karalAma,) yena teAmAdera mukhamaNDala malina kare deYa, Ara mAsajide Dhuke par3e yemana prathamavAra Dhukechila evaM yekhAnei jaYI haYa, sekhAnei pureApuri dhvaMsayajJa cAlAYa|
haYato teAmAdera rava teAmAdera prati anugraha karavena; kintu yadi punarAYa temana karo, Amio punarAYa tA-i karava| Ami jAhAnnAmake kAphiradera janya kArAgAra vAniYechi|
nizcaYai ei kuraAna sedike pathapradarzana kare, yA sarvAdhika sudRr3ha evaM satkarmaparAYaNa mu ’ minadera susaMvAda deYa ye, tAdera janya raYeche mahApuraskAra|
Ara nizcaYai yArA parajagatera prati ImAna Ane nA, Ami tAdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti prastuta karechi|
mAnuSa yebhAve kalyANa kAmanA kare, sebhAvei akalyANa kAmanA kare| mAnuSa teA khuvai tvarA-pravaNa|

Ami vAniYechi rAta o dinake duTi nidarzana| ataHpara niSprabha kare diYechi rAtera nidarzana evaM dinera nidarzanake karechi dRzyamAna, yena teAmarA teAmAdera ravera anugraha anveSaNa karate pAra o jAnate pAro vacharasamUhera gaNanA o hisAva| Ara Ami sava viSaYake vistAritabhAve varNanA karechi|
Ami pratyeka mAnuSera kRtakarma tAra galAYa jhuliYe rekhechi| kiYAmAtera dina Ami tAra janya vera karava eka kitAva yA se unmukta avasthAYa pAve|
tumi teAmAra kitAva par3o | Aja teAmAra hisAva grahaNera janye tumii yatheSTa|

ye-keu hidAYAtera pathe cale, se to nijera maGgalera janyei hidAYAtera pathe cale| Ara ye pathabhraSTa haYa, se to nijera amaGgalera janyai pathabhraSTa haYa| keu kAro veAjhA vahana karave nA| Ara keAno rAsUla nA pAThAneA paryanta Ami zAsti dii nA|

yakhana Ami keAno janapadake dhvaMsa karAra icchA kari takhana tAra samRddhazAlI vyaktidera sat kAja karate Adeza dii, athaca tArA tAte pApAcAre mete oThe| takhana tAdera opara AmAra zAsti nyAYasaMgata haYe yAYa| takhana Ami tAdera samUle dhvaMsa kare dii|
nUhera para Ami aneka jAtike dhvaMsa karechi| tomAra ravai vAndAdera pApAcArera saMvAda rAkhA o paryavekSaNera janya yatheSTa|
ye keu pArthiva sukha-sambhoga kAmanA kare Ami tAke yA icchA yataTuku icchA satvara diYe dii| ataHpara tAdera janya jAhAnnAma nirdhAraNa kari| tArA tAte nindita-vitAr3ita avasthAYa praveza karave|
Ara yArA parakAla kAmanA kare evaM mu’mina avasthAYa tAra janya yathAyatha ceSTA-sAdhanA kare, emana leAkadera ceSTA svIkRta haYe thAke|
edera evaM odera pratyekake Ami anugraha dAna kari, Ara tomAra ravera dAna kArao janya niSiddha naYa|
dekho, Ami tAdera katakake katakera opara kIbhAve zreSThatva dAna karalAma| parakAla teA nizcaYai martavAYa zreSThatara evaM maryAdAYa zreSThatama|
AllAhara sAthe anya keAno ilAha sthira kareA nA| tA hale tumi nindita o lAJchita haYe vase par3ave|

tomAra rava vidhivaddha karechena ye, tA~ke chAr3A anya kArao ivAdAta kareA nA evaM pitA-mAtAra sAthe sadvyavahAra karo| tAdera madhye keu athavA ubhaYei yadi teAmAra jIvaddazAYa vArdhakye upanIta haYa; tave tAderake ‘uha’ zavdaTio valeA nA; tAdera dhamaka diYo nA; evaM tAdera sAthe vinIta bhASAYa kathA valo|
tAdera sAmane bhAlovAsAvazata namanIYatAra DAnA nata karo evaM valo, ‘he AmAra rava, tAdera ubhaYera prati rahama karo, yemana tArA AmAke zaizavakAle lAlana-pAlana karechena|’
teAmAdera rava teAmAdera antare yA Ache tA bhAlo karei jAnena| yadi teAmarA sat karmaparAYaNa hao, tave tini to (tAra dike) pratyAvarnakArIdera janye kSamAzIla|
AtmIYa-svajanake tAdera prApya diYe dAo evaM abhAvagrasta o musAphirakeo| Ara kichutei apacaYa kareA nA|
nizcaYai apacaYakArIrA zaYatAnadera bhAi| Ara zaYatAna tAra ravera prati atizaYa akRtajJa|
Ara teAmAra ravera karuNAra pratyAzAYa yadi keAno samaYa tAdera theke vimukha hate cAo, takhana tAdera sAthe naramabhAve kathA valo|
tomAra hAta tomAra galAra nikaTa Avaddha rekho nA evaM ekevAre muktahastao haYeA nA| tAhale tumi tiraskRta, niHsva haYe vase thAkave|
nizcaYai tomAra rava yAke icchA jIvaneApakaraNe prAcurya dAna karena evaM saMkucitao karena| nizcaYai tini tA~ra vAndAdera samparke sAmyaka jJAta, sarvadraSTA|
dAridryera bhaYe tomarA teAmAdera santAnadera hatyA kareA nA| tAdera evaM teAmAdera Amii riyika diYe thAki| nizcaYai tAdera hatyA karA mahApApa|
Ara tomarA vyabhicArera kAcheo yeYeA nA| nizcaYai eTA azlIlatA evaM manda panthA|

se prANake hatyA kareA nA, yAke AllAha hArAma karechena; kintu nyAYabhAve| ye vyakti niryAtita haYe nihata haYa, Ami tAra uttarAdhikArIke (kisAsa grahaNera) adhikAra diYechi| ataeva, se yena hatyAra vyApAre sImAlaGghana nA kare| nizcaYai se sAhAyyaprApta haYeche|

Ara iYAtImera sampadera kAcheo yeYeA nA, yatakSaNa nA se paripakvatAYa upanIta haYa; tave emana panthAYa, yA (tAra janya) kalyANakara evaM aGgIkAra pUrNa karo| nizcaYai aGgIkAra samparke kaiphiYAta talava karA have|
mepe deoYAra samaYa pUrNa mApe dAo evaM Thika dA~r3ipAllAYa ojana karave| eTAi uttama; evaM pariNAme zubha|
ye viSaYe teAmAra keAno jJAna nei tAra pechane par3eA nA| nizcaYai kAna, cokha o hRdaYa edera pratyekaTira vyapAre jijJAsita have|
pRthivIte dambhabhare calo nA| nizcaYai tumi pRthivIke kakhanoi vidIrNa karate pArave nA evaM kakhanoi parvata-samAna uccatAYa pau~chate pArave nA|
esavera madhye yeguleA mandakAja, seguleA teAmAra ravera kAche ghRNita|
eTA oi hikamAtera antarbhukta, yA tomAra rava tomAke oYAhira mAdhyame dAna karechena| AllAhara sAthe anya keAno ilAh sthira karo nA| tAhale abhiyukta o vitAr3ita avasthAYa jAhAnnAme nikSipta have|
teAmAdera rava ki teAmAdera janya putra-santAna nirdhArita karechena evaM nijera janya pherezatAdera kanyArUpe grahaNa karechena? nizcaYai teAmarA gurutara kathAvArtA valo|
Ami ei kuraAne vAra vAra varNanA karechi yena tArA upadeza grahaNa kare| athaca ete tAdera kevala vimukhatAi vRddhi pAYa|
valo, ‘yadi tA~ra sAthe anyAnya ilAh thAkata tave tArA Arazera mAlika paryanta pau~chAra patha anveSaNa karata|’
tini nehAYeta pavitra o mahimAnvita evaM tArA yA vale thAke tA theke vahu Urdhve|

sapta AkAza o pRthivI evaM eguleAra madhye yA-kichu Ache, savai tA~ra saprazaMsa pavitratA gheASaNA kare evaM emana kichu nei yA tAra saprazaMsA pavitratA gheASaNA kare nA; kintu tAdera saprazaMsa pavitratA gheASaNA teAmarA vujhate pAra nA| nizcaYai tini ati sahanazIla, kSamAparAYaNa|
yakhana tumi kuraAna pATha karo, takhana Ami tomAra madhye o parakAlera prati yArA ImAna Ane nA tAdera madhye pracchanna pardA phele dii|

Ami tAdera antarera opara AvaraNa rekhe dii, yAte tArA eke upalavdhi karate nA pAre evaM tAdera kAnasamUhe vadhiratA cApiYe dii| yakhana tumi kuraAne ravera ekatva AvRtti karo, takhana tArA ghRNAvazata piTha pherAYa|

yakhana tArA utkarNa haYe tomAra kathA zeAne, takhana tArA kena utkarNa haYe zeAne, tA Ami bhAlo jAni Ara geApana parAmarze yakhana sImAlaGghanakArIrA vale, ‘teAmarA teA eka jAdugrastha vyaktira anusaraNa karacha|’
lakSa karo, tArA tomAra janya kemana upamA deYa| tArA pathabhraSTa haYeche| ataeva, tArA patha pete pAre nA|
tArA vale, ‘yakhana AmarA hADDite pariNata o cUrNa-vicUrNa haYe yAva, takhano ki natuna kare sRSTi haYe utthita hava?’
valo, ‘teAmarA pAthara haYe yAo vA leAhA|’

‘athavA emana keAno vastu, yA teAmAdera dhAraNAYa khuvai kaThina; tavu tArA valave, AmAdera punarvAra ke sRSTi karave|’ valo, ‘tinii yini teAmAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechena|’ ataHpara tArA tomAra sAmane mAthA nAr3Ave evaM valave, ‘eTA kave have?’ valo, ‘sambhavata zigagira have|’
yedina tini teAmAderake AhvAna karavena, ataHpara teAmarA tA~ra prazaMsA karate karate sAr3A deve evaM teAmarA anumAna karave ye, sAmAnya samaYai avasthAna karechile|
AmAra vAndAdera vale dAo, tArA yena uttama kathAi vale| nizcaYai zaYatAna tAdera madhye uskAni deYa| nizcaYai zaYatAna mAnuSera prakAzya zatru|
teAmAdera rava teAmAdera samparke bhAlobhAve jJAta Achena| tini yadi cAna, teAmAdera prati rAhamAta karavena vA yadi cAna, teAmAdera zAsti devena| Ami tomAke tAdera abhibhAvaka hiseve pAThAini|
tomAra rava tAdera samparke bhAlobhAve jJAta Achena, yArA AsamAnasamUha o yamine raYeche| Ami navidera madhye kAuke kAro opara zreSThatva dAna karechi evaM dAUdake dAna karechi yAvUra|
valo, ‘AllAha vyatIta yAdera teAmarA ilAha mane karo, tAdera AhvAna karo|’ vastuta tArA teAmAdera kaSTa dUra karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA evaM tA parivartanao karate pAre nA|

yAdera tArA AhvAna kare, tArA nijerAi teA tAdera ravera naikaTyalAbhera janya madhyasthatA tAlAza kare ye, tAdera madhye ke adhika nikaTavartI | tArA tA~ra rAhamAtera AzA kare evaM tA~ra zAstike bhaYa kare| nizcaYai tomAra ravera zAsti bhaYAvaha|
emana keAno janapada nei, yAke Ami kiYAmAta divasera pUrve dhvaMsa karava nA athavA yAke kaTheAra zAsti deva nA| tA kitAve lipivaddha Ache|

pUrvavartIgaNa kartRka nidarzana kuphuri karAra phalei AmAke nidarzanAvali pAThAno theke virata rekheche| Ami spaSTa nidarzanasvarUpa sAmUdake diYechi ekaTi uSTrI| ataHpara tArA tAra prati avicAra kareche| Ami bhItipradarzanera uddezyei nidarzana pAThAi|

smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami tomAke valalAma ye, tomAra rava mAnuSake pariveSTana kare Achena| Ami ye dRzya tomAke dekhiYechi o kuraAne ullikhita abhizapta gAcha tA kevala mAnuSera parIkSAra janya| Ami tAderake bhItipradarzana kari; kintu ete tAdera ghora avAdhyatAi vRddhi pAYa|

smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami pherezatAdera valalAma, ‘Adamake sijadA karo,’ takhana ivalIsa vyatIta savAi sijadA karala| se valala, ‘Ami ki emana vyaktike sijadA karava, yAke Apani mATi dvArA sRSTi karechena?’

se valala, ‘dekhena teA, ei vyaktikei Apani AmAra ceYe ucca maryAdA diYechena| yadi Apani AmAke kiYAmAta divasa paryanta samaYa dena, tave Ami alpa saMkhyaka chAr3A tAra vaMzadharadera vibhrAnta deva|’
AllAha valalena, ‘cale yAo| tAdera madhya theke yArA tomAra anugAmI have, jAhAnnAmai have tomAdera pratiphala; pUrNa pratiphala|’

tAdera mAjhe yAke pAro tomAra AoYAja dvArA satyacyuta karo, tomAra azvAreAhI o padAtika vAhinI niYe tAdera AkramaNa karo, tAdera artha-sampada o santAna-santatite zarika haYe yAo evaM tAdera pratizruti dAo| zaYatAna tAdera ye pratizruti deYa tA chalanA mAtra|
AmAra vAndAdera opara tomAra keAno kSamatA nei| abhibhAvaka hiseve tomAra ravai yatheSTa|
teAmAdera rava tinii yini teAmAdera janya samudre jalayAna cAlanA karena, yAte teAmarA tAra anugraha anveSaNa karate pAreA| niHsandehe tini teAmAdera prati parama daYAlu|

yakhana samudre teAmAderake sparza kare vipada takhana tini vyatIta yAdera teAmarA AhvAna karo, tArA udhAo haYe yAYa| ataHpara tini yakhana teAmAdera uddhAra kare sthale pau~che dena, takhana teAmarA mukha phiriYe nAo| Ara mAnuSa var3ai akRtajJa|

teAmarA ki nirApada haYecha ye, tini teAmAdera sthalabhAge keAthAo dhvasiYe devena nA athavA teAmAdera opara zilA varSaNakArI ghUrNijhar3a pAThAvena nA, takhana teAmarA nijedera janya keAno sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|

nAki tomarA e vyApAre nizcinta ye, tini teAmAdera ArekavAra samudre niYe yAvena nA, ataHpara teAmAdera uddezye pravala vAYujhar3a pAThAvena nA, tArapara tomarA ye kuphuri karecha sekAraNe teAmAdera nimajjita karavena nA, ataHpara takhana teAmarA AmAra viruddhe e viSaYe sAhAyyakArI kAuke pAve nA|

nizcaYai Ami Adama-santAnake maryAdA dAna karechi, Ami tAderake sthale o jale calAcalera vAhana dAna karechi; tAdera uttama jIvaneApakaraNa pradAna karechi evaM tAdera aneka sRSTira opara zreSThatva dAna karechi|

smaraNa karo, yedina Ami pratyeka dalake tAdera netAsaha AhvAna karava, ataHpara yAderake tAdera DAna hAte AmalanAmA deoYA have, tArA nijedera AmalanAmA pATha karave evaM tAdera prati sAmAnya parimANao avicAra karA have nA|
ye vyakti ihakAle andha se parakAleo andha evaM adhikatara pathabhraSTa|

Ami tomAra prati yA avatIrNa karechi, tA theke tArA tomAke phetanAYa prAYa phelate yAcchila, yena tumi AmAra prati bhinna kichu mithyA racanA karo| tave tArA tomAke antaraGga vandhurUpe grahaNa karata|
Ami tomAke dRr3hapada nA rAkhale tumi tAdera prati kichuTA jhu~kei par3ate|
takhana Ami avazyai tomAke ihajIvane o parajIvane dviguNa zAsti AsvAdana karAtAma| e samaYa tumi AmAra meAkAvelAYa keAno sAhAyyakArI pete nA|
tArA teAmAke bhUkhaNDa theke utkhAta karAra cUr3Anta ceSTA karechila, yena tArA tomAke tA theke vahiSkAra karate pAre| tAhale tArAo tomAra para sekhAne alpakAlai mAtra Tike thAkata|
tomAra Age Ami yata rAsUla pAThiYechi, tAdera kSetreo emana niYama chila| tumi AmAra niYamera keAno vyatikrama pAve nA|
sUrya Dhale par3Ara samaYa theke rAtera andhakAra paryanta sAlAta kAYema karo evaM kAYema karave phajarera kuraAna pAThao| nizcaYai phajarera kuraAna pATha pherezatAdera upasthitira samaYa|
rAtera kichu aMze tAhAjjuda AdAYa karo| eTA tomAra janya atirikta (kartavya)| acirei tomAra rava tomAke pratiSThita karavena prazaMsita sthAne|
valo, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke praveza karAna satya dvAre evaM AmAke vera karuna satya-prasthAne evaM AmAke dAna karuna ApanAra pakSa theke sAhAyyakArI zaktizAlI pramANa|’
valo, ‘satya eseche evaM mithyA vilupta haYeche| nizcaYai mithyA vilupta haoYArai|’
Ami kuraAne emana viSaYa avatIrNa kari yA upazamakArI evaM rAhamAta mu ’ minera janya| evaM tA sImAlaGghanakArIdera zudhu kSatii vRddhi kare|
yakhana Ami mAnuSake niYAmAta dAna kari takhana se mukha phiriYe neYa evaM ahaMkAre dUre sare yAYa evaM yakhana tAke keAno aniSTa sparza kare, takhana se hatAza haYe par3e|
valo, ‘pratyekei nija rIti anuyAYI kAja kare|’ ataHpara tomAra rava sarvAdhika jJAta ke sarvApekSA nirbhula pathe paricAlita|
tArA tomAke rUha samparke jijJesa kare| valo, ‘rUha AmAra ravera nirdeza mAtra| e viSaYe teAmAdera sAmAnya jJAnai dAna karA haYeche|’
yadi Ami icchA karatAma tave avazyai pratyAhAra karate pAratAma oi viSaYa yA Ami tomAra nikaTa oYAhi pAThiYechi| tave tumi e-viSaYa AmAra viruddhe kono karmavidhAYaka pete nA|
tave eTA tomAra ravera anugraha| nizcaYai tomAra prati tA~ra karuNA atizaYa var3a|
valo, ‘yadi mAnuSa o jina ei kuraAnera anurUpa AnAra janya jar3eA haYa, tavuo tArA kakhano tAra anurUpa racanA karate pArave nA evaM yadio tArA parasparera sAhAyyakArI haYa|’
Ami ei kuraAne mAnuSera janya pratyeka prakArera upamA vistArita varNanA karechi; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa amAnya nA kare kSyAnta halo nA|
tArA vale, ‘AmarA kakhano tomAke vizvAsa karava nA, yatakSaNa nA tumi bhUmi theke AmAdera janya ekaTi prasravaNa utsArita karave|’
‘athavA tomAra janya khejurera o AGurera ekaTi vAgAna have, ataHpara tumi tAra madhye ajasra dhArAYa nahara pravAhita karave|’
‘athavA tumi yemana vale thAko, sebhAve AmAdera opara AsamAnake khaNDa-vikhaNDa kare phele deve; athavA AllAha o pherezatAdera sAmanAsAmani niYe Asave|’

‘athavA tomAra cAkacikyamaYa tairi ghara have athavA tumi AkAze AreAhaNa karave Ara AmarA tomAra AkAze AreAhaNake kakhano vizvAsa karava nA, yatakSaNa nA tumi avatIrNa karave AmAdera prati eka kitAva, yA AmarA pATha karava| valo, ‘AmAra rava ati pavitra, Ara Ami zudhui ekajana mAnuSa o rAsUla|’
evaM yakhana tAdera kAche hidAYAta Ase, takhana mAnuSake virata rAkheni eTA vyatIta anya kichu ye, tArA valeche, AllAha ki ekajana mAnuSake rAsUla kare pAThiYechena?
valo, ‘yadi pRthivIte pherezatArA tAdera nikaTa svAcchandye vicaraNa karata, tave avazyai Ami AkAza theke pherezatAke rAsUla kare pAThAtAma|’
valo, ‘AmAra o teAmAdera madhye sAkSI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa| tini tAra vAndAdera vyApAre savizeSa avagata o sarvadraSTA|’

AllAha yAke hidAYAta dAna karena, sei teA hidAYAtaprApta; Ara yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAdera janya tumi AllAha chAr3A keAno sAhAyyakArI pAve nA| Ami kiYAmAtera dina tAdera samaveta karava tAdera mukhe bhara diYe calA avasthAYa, andha avasthAYa, mUka evaM vadhira avasthAYa| tAdera AvAsasthala jAhAnnAma| yakhanai nirvApita haoYAra upakrama have takhana Ami tAdera janya Aguna Arao vRddhi kare deva|
eTAi tAdera pratiphala| kAraNa, tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha asvIkAra kareche evaM valeche, ‘AmarA yakhana hADDite pariNata o cUrNa-vicUrNa haYe yAva, takhanao ki AmarA natuna sRSTirUpe utthita hava?’

tArA ki dekheni ye, nizcaYai AllAha, yini AsamAnasamUha o yamina sRSTi karechena, tini tAdera mato mAnuSao punarAYa sRSTi karate sakSama? tini tAdera janya sthira karechena ekaTi nirdiSTa kAla, ete keAno sandeha nei; ataHpara sImAlaGghanakArIrA kuphuri karA chAr3A kSAnta halo nA|
valo, ‘yadi AmAra ravera rAhamAtera bhAnDAra teAmAdera mAlikAnAYa thAkata, tave vyaYa haYe yAoYAra AzaGkAYa avazyai tA dhare rAkhate|’ mAnuSa teA atizaYa kRpaNa!

tumi vani isarAIlake jijJesa karo, Ami mUsAke naYaTi prakAzya nidarzana dAna karechi| yakhana tAdera kAche prakAzya nidarzana esechila, phiraAuna tAke valala, ‘he mUsA, nizcaYai AmAra dhAraNA tumi teA jAdugrasta|’
se valala, ‘tumi jAno ye, AsamAnasamUha o yaminera ravai esava nidarzanAvali pratyakSa pramANasvarUpa avatIrNa karechena| nizcaYai he phiraAuna, AmAra dhAraNAYa tumi dhvaMsa hate calecha|’
ataHpara se vani isarAIlake deza theke utkhAta karate cAila, takhana Ami tAke o tAra saGgIdera savAike nimajjita kare dilAma|
tArapara Ami vani isarAIlake valalAma, ‘e deze teAmarA vasavAsa karo| yakhana parakAlera oYAdA vAstavAYita have, takhana teAmAdera jar3eA kare upasthita karA have|’
Ami satyasaha tA avatIrNa karechi evaM satyasahai eTA avatIrNa haYeche| Ami teA tomAke zudhu susaMvAdadAtA o bhItipradarzaka karei pAThiYechi|
Ami kuraAnake pRthaka pRthakabhAve pAThera upayeAgI karechi, yena tumi tA leAkadera kAche dhIre dhIre pATha karo evaM Ami tAke yathAyathabhAve avatIrNa karechi|

valo, ‘teAmarA tAra prati ImAna Ano athavA ImAna nA Ano; nizcaYai itaHpUrve yAderake era jJAna deoYA haYeche, yakhana tAdera kAche tilAoYAta karA haYa, takhana tArA natamastake sijadAYa luTiYe par3e|’
Ara tArA vale, ‘AmAdera rava pavitra, mahimAnvita| nizcaYai AmAdera ravera oYAdA avazyai pUrNa have|’
tArA kA~date kA~date natamastake (mATite) luTiYe par3e evaM tAdera vinaYabhAva Arao vRddhi pAYa|

valo, ‘AllAha vale AhvAna karo kiMvA rAhamAna vale, ye nAmei AhvAna karo nA kena, sava sundara nAma tA~rai| tumi tA uccaiHsvare tomAra sAlAte par3o nA evaM niHzavdeo par3o nA|’ e duYera madhyamapanthA avalamvana karo|

valo, ‘samasta prazaMsA AllAhara yini nA-keAno santAna grahaNa karechena, nA-tA~ra sArvabhaumatve keAno zarika Ache evaM yini durdazAgrasta hana nA, ye kAraNe tA~ra keAno sAhayyakArIra praYeAjana haYa nA|’ sutarAM tumi tA~ra mAhAtmya varNanA karo|
sakala prazaMsA AllAhara yini tA~ra vAndAra prati e kitAva avatIrNa karechena evaM tAte keAno asaGgati rAkhenani|
(nAjila karechena) saralarUpe tA~ra kaThina zAsti samparke satarka karAra janya evaM mu ’ minadera yArA satkarma kare tAdera susaMvAda deoYAra janya ye, tAdera janya raYeche uttama pratidAna|
sekhAne tArA cirakAla avasthAna karave|
evaM tAdera bhItipradarzana karAra janya, yArA vale, ‘AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena|’
e samparke tAdera keAno jJAna nei evaM nA tAdera pUrvapuruSaderao| tAdera mukhaniHsRta vAkya katai nA udbhaTa| tArA zudhu mithyAi vale|
yadi tArA ei viSaYavastura prati vizvAsa sthApana nA kare, tave tAdera pichane sambhavata tumi paritApa karate karate AtmavinAzI haYe par3ave|
Ami pRthivIra savakichu tAra janye suzabhita karechi, yena tAdera parIkSA kari ye, tAdera madhye karme ke adhika sundara|
nizcaYai era madhyakAra savakichuke Ami udbhidazUnya mATite pariNata kare deva|
tumi ki mane kara ye, guhA evaM ‘rakIme’ra adhivAsIrA AmAra nidarzanAvalira madhye vismaYakara?

yakhana yuvakarA guhAYa AzraYagrahaNa karala takhana tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera rava, tomAra pakSa theke AmAdera rAhamAta dAna karo evaM AmAdera janya AmAdera kAjake saThikabhAve paricAlanAra vyavasthA karo|’
ataeva, Ami kaYeka vachara guhAYa tAdera kAnera opara ghumera pardA phele dilAma|
ataHpara Ami tAdera punarutthita karechi, ekathA jAnAra janya ye, dui dalera madhye keAna dala tAdera avasthitikAla saThikabhAve nirNaYa karate pAre|
tomAra kAche tAdera vRttAnta saThikabhAve varNanA karachi| nizcaYai tArA chila kaYekajana yuvaka| tArA tAdera ravera prati ImAna enechila evaM Ami tAdera satpathe calAra zakti vRddhi karechi|

Ami tAdera antara dRr3ha karechi, yakhana tArA uThe dA~r3iYechila| ataHpara tArA valala, ‘AmAdera rava o AsamAna-yaminera rava, AmarA kakhano tA~ra parivarte anya keAno ilAhake AhvAna karava nA| yadi kari, tave tA atyanta garhita kAja have|’

‘erA AmAderai svajAti, tArA tA~ra parivarte aneka ilAh grahaNa kareche| tArA edera samparke spaSTa pramANa upasthita kare nA kena? ye AllAha samparke mithyA udbhAvana kare, tAra cAite adhika sImAlaGghanakArI Ara ke?’

teAmarA yakhana tAdera theke pRthaka hale evaM tArA AllAhara parivarte yAdera ivAdAta kare tAdera theke; ataeva, teAmarA guhAYa AzraYagrahaNa karo| teAmAdera rava teAmAdera janya daYA vistAra karavena evaM tini teAmAdera janya teAmAdera karmake phalaprasU karAra vyavasthA karavena|

Ara tumi sUrya dekhave, yakhana udita haYa, tAdera guhAra DAna pAza keTe atikrama kare evaM yakhana asta yAYa, tAdera theke vAma pAza keTe atikrama kare, e avasthAYa tArA guhAra prazasta catvare chila| eTA AllAhara nidarzanAvalira anyatama| AllAha yAke hidAYAta dAna karena, sei hidAYAtaprApta evaM tini yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tumi kakhano tAra janya pathapradarzaka o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|

tumi mane karave tArA jAgrata, athaca tArA ghumanta| Ami tAderake pArzva parivartana karAi DAna dike o vAma dike| tAdera kukura chila sAmanera pA duTi guhAdvAre prasArita kare| yadi tumi u~ki diYe tAdera dekhate, tave pechana phire pAlAte evaM tAdera dekhe tomAra madhye AtaGka saJcArita hata|

Ami emanibhAve tAdera jAgrata karalAma, yena tArA paraspara jijJAsAvAda kare| tAdera ekajana valala, ‘teAmarA katakAla avasthAna karecha?’ tAdera keu keu valala, ‘ekadina athavA ekadinera kichu aMza avasthAna karachi|’ tArA valala, ‘teAmAdera ravai bhAlo jAnena teAmarA katakAla avasthAna karecha| ekhana teAmAdera ekajanake teAmAdera ei mudrAsaha zahare pAThAo; se yena dekhe keAna khAdya adhika pavitratama| ataHpara tA theke kichu khAdya niYe Ase teAmAdera janya; se yena vicakSaNatA sahakAre yAYa o kichutei teAmAdera khavara kAuke vujhate nA deYa|’
‘tArA yadi teAmAdera khavara jAnate pAre, tave nizcaYai pAthara mere teAmAdera hatyA karave, athavA teAmAderake tAdera dharme phiriYe neve| tAhale teAmarA kakhanoi sAphalya lAbha karave nA|’

ebhAve Ami tAdera khavara prakAza kare dilAma, yena tArA jAne ye, AllAhara oYAdA satya evaM kiYAmAte keAno sandeha nei| yakhana tArA nijedera kartavya viSaYe paraspara vitarka karachila, takhana tAdera keu keu valala, ‘tAdera opara saudha nirmANa karo| tAdera rava tAdera viSaYe bhAlo jAnena|’ tAdera kartavya viSaYe yAdera mata pravala halo, tArA valala, ‘AmarA avazyai tAdera sthAne mAsajida nirmANa karava|’

acirei tAdera keu keu valave, ‘tArA chila tinajana caturthaTi chila kukura|’ AvAra aneke adRzyera opara dhAraNAvazata valave, ‘tArA chila pA~cajana, SaSThaTi chila kukura|’ Ara kichu mAnuSa valave, ‘tArA chila sAtajana, aSTamaTi chila kukura|’ valo, ‘AmAra rava tAdera saMkhyA samparke sarvAdhika jJAta| alpasaMkhyaka mAnuSa vyatIta tAdera samparke keu jAne nA|’ sutarAM sAdhAraNa AlocanA chAr3A tAdera vyApAre vitarka karave nA, Ara tAdera vyApAre tAdera kArao nikaTa theke jAnateo cAive nA|
tumi kakhano keAno viSaYe valave nA ‘nizcaYai Ami eTi AgAmIkAla karava|’
tave ‘AllAha icchA karale’| yakhana bhule yAo, takhana tomAra ravake smaraNa karo evaM valo, ‘AzA kari AmAra rava AmAke era cAiteo nikaTatama satyera pathanirdeza karavena|’
Ara tArA avasthAna kareche tAdera guhAra madhye tinazata vachara evaM era sAthe atirikta haYechila ‘naYa’|

valo, ‘tArA katakAla avasthAna kareche, tA AllAhai bhAlo jAnena| AsamAnasamUha o yamine adRzya viSaYera jJAna tA~rai raYeche| tini katai uttama draSTA o zrotA| tini vyatIta tAdera kono abhibhAvaka nei| tini kAuke nija kartRtve zarika karena nA|’
tomAra prati tomAra ravera ye kitAva oYAhi karA haYeche, tA par3o| tA~ra kathA parivartanakArI keu nei| tA~ke vyatIta tumi pAve nA keAno AzraYasthala|

tumi nijeke tAdera saMsarge Avaddha rAkho, yArA sakAla o sandhyAYa tAdera ravake tA~ra santuSTi arjanera uddezye AhvAna kare evaM tumi pArthiva-jIvanera saundarya kAmanA kare tAdera theke nijera dRSTi phiriYe niYo nA| yAra manake AmAra smaraNa theke amanoyogI kare diYechi evaM se svIYa pravRttira anusaraNa kare evaM yAra kAryakalApa sImA atikrama kare, tumi tAra Anugatya karave nA|

valo, ‘satya teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke Agata|’ ataeva, yAra icchA, ImAna Anave evaM yAra icchA pratyAkhyAna karave| Ami sImAlaGghanakArIdera janya Aguna prastuta kare rekhechi, yAra zikhA tAdera pariveSTana kare thAkave| yadi tArA pAnIYa prArthanA kare, tave telera gAdera mato pAnIYa deoYA have yA tAdera mukhamaNDala jhalase deve| kata nikRSTa pAnIYa evaM atizaYa manda AzraYasthala|
yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM satkarma sampAdana kare Ami satkarmazIladera puraskAra naSTa kari nA|

tAderai janya Ache sthAYI jAnnAta yAra pAdadeze pravAhita haYa nada-nadI| tAderake sekhAne svarNa-kaGkane alaMkRta karA have evaM tArA parave sUkSma o sthUla rezamera savuja vastra evaM samAsIna have susajjita Asane; katai nA camatkAra pratidAna evaM katai nA uttama AzraYasthala!
tumi tAdera kAche duvyaktira upamA varNanA karo| Ami tAdera ekajanake duTi AGurera vAgAna diYechi, e duTike pariveSTita karechi khejuragAcha dvArA evaM duYera mAjhakhAne karechi zasyakSeta|
ubhaYa vAgAnai phaladAna karata evaM tA theke kichui hrAsa karata nA evaM ubhaYera mAjhakhAne Ami nahara pravAhita karechi|
tAra chila pracura dhana-sampada| ataHpara kathAprasaGge saGgIke valala, ‘AmAra dhana-sampada teAmAra cAite vezi evaM janavale Ami adhika zaktizAlI|’
se tAra vAgAne praveza karala nijera prati sImAlaGghanakArI avasthAYa, valala, ‘AmAra mane haYa nA ye, e vAgAna kakhano dhvaMsa have|’
‘evaM Ami mane kari nA ye, kiYAmAta anuSThita have| yadi kakhano AmAra ravera kAche Ami pratyAvartita hai, tave avazyai sekhAne era cAite utkRSTa pratyAvartanasthala pAva|’
tAra saGgI tAke kathA prasaGge valala, ‘tumi ki emana (sattAke) asvIkAra karacha, yini teAmAke sRSTi karechena mATi theke, ataHpara vIrya theke, ataHpara pUrNAGga karechena teAmAke mAnavAkRtite?’
‘kintu Ami teA ekathAi vali, AllAhai AmAra rava evaM Ami kAuke AmAra ravera sAthe zarika kari nA|’

‘yakhana tumi teAmAra vAgAne praveza karale, takhana ekathA kena valale nA; AllAha yA cAna, (tA-i haYa)| sava kSamatAra mAlika kevala AllAha| yadio tumi AmAke sampade o santAne teAmAra cAite kama dekho|’
‘AzA kari, AmAra rava AmAke teAmAra vAgAna apekSA utkRSTatara kichu devena evaM teAmAra vAgAnera upara AsamAna theke viparyaYa pAThAvena| ataHpara sakAla velAYa tA haYe yAve udbhidazUnya mATi|’
‘athavA sakAle tAra pAni zukiYe yAve| ataHpara tumi tA tAlAza kare Anate pArave nA|’

tAra phala-phalAdike ghire phelA halo| phale tAte se yA vyaYa kareche, tAra janya hAta kacalAte lAgala Ara seTi dhvaMsa haYechila tAra mAcAra upara| Ara se valala, ‘hAYa, Ami yadi kAuke AmAra ravera sAthe zarika nA karatAma|’
AllAha vyatIta tAke sAhAyya karAra keAno dala chila nA evaM se nijeo pratikAra karate pArala nA|
prakRtapakSe e kSetre sAhAyya karAra adhikAra AllAhara, yini satya| puraskAra dAne o pariNAma nirdhAraNe tinii zreSTha|

tAdera kAche pArthiva-jIvanera upamA varNanA karo| tA pAnira mato, yA Ami AkAza theke varSaNa kari| ataHpara mizrita haYa mATira udbhida ataHpara tA emana bhusi haYe yAYa yA vAtAsa ur3iYe niYe yAYa| AllAha e savakichura opara zaktimAna|
dhana-sampada o santAna-santati pArthiva-jIvanera saundarya| tave sthAYI satkarmasamUha tomAra ravera pratidAne o pratyAzAteo uttama|
Ara yedina Ami parvatasamUhake calamAna karava evaM tumi pRthivIke dekhave ekaTi unmukta prAntara evaM Ami mAnuSake ekatra karava, tAdera kAuke chAr3ava nA|

Ara tAderake tomAra ravera sAmane sArivaddhabhAve upasthita karA have; (valA have), ‘ teAmarA AmAra kAche esecha; yemana teAmAdera prathama vAra sRSTi karechilAma| varaM teAmarA teA bhevechile, Ami kichutei teAmAdera janya keAno pratizruta samaYa karava nA|

Ara AmalanAmA upasthita karA have| tAte yA Ache; tAra kAraNe tumi aparAdhIdera bhIta-santrasta dekhave| tArA valave, ‘hAYa AphaseAsa, e kemana kitAva| e ye cheATa-var3a keAno kichui vAda deYani, savai saMrakSaNa kareche,’ tArA tAdera kRtakarma sAmane upasthita pAve| Ara tomAra rava kAro prati avicAra karavena nA|

smaraNa karo, yakhana Ami pherezatAderake valalAma, ‘Adamake sijadA karo,’ takhana savAi sijadA karala ivalIsa vyatIta| se chila jinadera antarbhukta, se tAra ravera Adeza amAnya karala| ataeva, teAmarA ki AmAra parivarte tAke evaM tAra vaMzadharake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karacha? athaca tArA teAmAdera zatru| eTA sImAlaGghanakArIdera janya khuvai nikRSTa vikalpa|
AsamAnasamUha o yaminera sRSTikAle Ami tAderake sAkSI rAkhini evaM tAdera nijedera sRSTikAleo nA| Ami emanao nai ye, vibhrAntakArIderake sAhAyyakArIrUpe grahaNa karava|
sedina tini valavena, ‘teAmarA yAderake AmAra zarika mane karate tAderake DAko|’ tArA takhana tAdera DAkave, kintu tArA e DAke sAr3A deve nA| Ami tAdera madhyasthale rekhe deva ekaTi dhvaMsa-gahvara|
aparAdhIrA Aguna dekhe vujhe neve ye, tAdera tAte patita hate have evaM tArA tA theke pAlonora kono jAYagA pAve nA |
nizcaYai Ami e kuraAne mAnuSake nAnAbhAve vibhinna upamAra dvArA AmAra vANI vujhiYechi; kintu mAnuSa adhikAMza kSetre tarkapriYa|

hidAYAta AsAra para e pratIkSAi zudhu mAnuSake ImAna AnA theke evaM tAdera ravera kAche kSamAprArthanA karA theke virata rAkhe ye, kakhana Asave tAdera kAche pUrvavartIdera rItinIti athavA kakhana tAdera kAche Asave upasthita zAsti|

Ami rAsUlagaNake susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe pAThiYechi| tave kAphirarA mithyA avalamvane vitarka kare, tA dvArA satyake vyartha kare deoYAra uddeze| sarvopari tArA AmAra nidarzanAvali evaM yA dvArA tAdera satarka karA haYa, seguleAke ThATTArUpe grahaNa kareche|

tAra cAite adhika sImAlaGghanakArI Ara ke hate pAre, yAke tAra ravera kAlAma dvArA veAjhAneA haYa, ataHpara se tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa evaM tAra pUrvavartI kRtakarmasamUha bhule yAYa? Ami tAdera antarera opara pardA rekhe diYechi, yena tA vujhate nA pAre evaM tAdera kAne raYeche vadhiratA| yadi tumi tAdera hidAYAtera dike AhvAna karo, tave kakhanoi tArA satpathe Asave nA|

Ara tomAra rava kSamAzIla, daYAlu, yadi tini tAdera kRtakarmera janya pAkar3Ao karate cAitena tave tAdera zAsti tvarAnvita karatena, kintu tAdera janya raYeche ekaTi pratizruta samaYa, yA theke tArA sare yAoYAra jAYagA pAve nA|
esava janapadake Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechi, yakhana tArA sImAlaGghana kareche evaM Ami tAdera dhvaMsera janya ekaTi pratizruta samaYa nirdiSTa karechilAma|
yakhana mUsA tAra saGgIke valala, ‘dui samudrera mohanAYa nA pau~chA paryanta Ami kSAnta hava nA| athavA Ami yuga yuga dhare calate thAkava|’
ataHpara yakhana tArA dui samudrera mohanAYa pau~chala, takhana tArA nijedera mAchera kathA bhule gela| tatakSaNe mAchaTi samudre sur3aGga patha sRSTi kare neme gela|
yakhana tArA se sthAnaTi atikrama kare gela, mUsA saGgIke valala, ‘AmAdera nAzatA Ano| AmarA ei saphare parizrAnta haYe par3echi|’

se valala, ‘Apani ki lakSa karechena, AmarA yakhana zilAkhaNDe vizrAma niYechilAma, takhana Ami mAchera kathA bhule giYechilAma| zaYatAnai AmAke ekathA smaraNa rAkhate bhuliYe diYechila| mAchaTi AzcaryajanakabhAve samudre nijera patha dharala|’
mUsA valala, ‘AmarA teA e sthAnaTii khu~jachilAma|’ ataHpara tArA nijedera cihna dhare phire calala|
tArA AmAra vAndAdera madhye emana ekajanera sAkSAt pela, yAke Ami AmAra pakSa theke rAhamAta dAna karechilAma o AmAra pakSa theke tAke zikhiYechilAma eka vizeSa jJAna|
mUsA tAke valala, ‘Ami ki e zarte ApanAra anusaraNa karate pAri ye, satyapathera ye jJAna ApanAke zekhAneA haYeche, tA theke AmAke kichu zikSA devena?’
se valala, ‘Apani AmAra sAthe kichutei dhairyadhAraNa kare thAkate pAravena nA|’
‘ye viSaYa ApanAra kAche kono jJAna nei, se vyapAre Apani kIbhAve dhairyadhAraNa karavena?’
mUsA valala, ‘AllAha cAna teA Apani AmAke dhairyazIla pAvena evaM Ami ApanAra keAno Adeza amAnya karava nA|’
se valala, ‘yadi Apani AmAra anusaraNa karatei cAna, tave keAno viSaYe AmAke prazna karavena nA, yatakSaNa nA Ami nijei se samparke ApanAke kichu vali|’

ataHpara tArA calate lAgala, avazeSe yakhana tArA naukAYa AreAhaNa karala, takhana se tA chidra kare dilo| mUsA valala, ‘Apani ki era AreAhIderake DuviYe deoYAra janya tA chidra kare dilena? nizcaYai Apani ekaTi manda kAja karalena|’
se valala, ‘Ami ki valini ye, Apani AmAra sAthe dhairya dharate pAravena nA?’
mUsA valala, ‘Ami yA bhule giYechi sekAraNe AmAke dharavena nA evaM AmAra kAje AmAra opara kaTheAratA AreApa karavena nA|’

ataHpara tArA calate lAgala| avazeSe yakhana ekaTi vAlakera sAkSAt pela, takhana se tAke hatyA karala| mUsA valala, ‘Apani ki ekaTi niSpApa jIvana hatyA karalena prANera vinimaYa chAr3Ai? nizcaYai Apani teA eka gurutara anyAYa kAja karalena|’
se valala, ‘Ami ki valini ye, Apani AmAra sAthe kichutei dhairya dhare thAkate pAravena nA|’
mUsA valala, ‘erapara yadi Ami ApanAke keAno viSaYe prazna kari, tave Apani AmAke sAthe rAkhavena nA| AmAra pakSa theke Apani pau~che gechena ojara Apattira (cUr3Anta paryAYa)|’

ataHpara tArA calate lAgala, avazeSe yakhana ekaTi janapadera adhivAsIdera kAche pau~che tAdera kAche khAvAra cAila, takhana tArA tAdera AtitheYatA karate asvIkAra karala| ataHpara tArA sekhAne ekaTi prAcIra dekhate pela, yeTi cAcchila ye seTi bheGe par3ave; se seTi seAjA kare dA~r3a kariYe dila| mUsA valala, ‘Apani icchA karale tAdera kAcha theke era pArizramika AdAYa karate pAratena|’
se valala, ‘ekhAnei AmAra o ApanAra madhye viccheda ghaTache| ekhana ye viSaYe Apani dhairya dharate pArenani, Ami tAra tAtparya vale dicchi|’

‘Ara naukATira vyApAre—oTA chila kaYekajana daridra vyaktira| tArA samudre kAja karata; Ami icchA karalAma, oTA truTiyukta kare dii| tAdera aparadike chila eka vAdazAha, se valapraYeAge pratyekaTi naukA chiniYe nita|’
‘vAlakaTira vyApAra—tAra pitA-mAtA chila mu ’ mina| Ami AzaGkA karalAma ye, se avAdhyatA o kuphara dvArA tAdera prabhAvita karave|’
‘ataHpara Ami icchA karalAma, tAdera rava tAdera eka santAna dAna karuka—ye have tAra ceYe pUta-pavitra o bhAlovAsAYa ghaniSThatara|’

‘prAcIrera vyApAra oTA chila nagarera dujana pitRhIna vAlakera| era nice chila tAdera guptadhana evaM tAdera pitA chila satkarmaparAYaNa| sutarAM ApanAra pAlanakartA daYAvazata icchA karalena, tArA yauvane padArpaNa karuka evaM nijedera guptadhana uddhAra karuka| Ami nija mate eTA karini| Apani ye viSaYe dhairyadhAraNa karate akSama haYechilena, ei halo tAra vyAkhyA|’
tArA teAmAke yulakAranAina samparke jijJAsA kare| valo, ‘Ami acirei teAmAdera kAche tAra kichu varNanA pATha kare zonAva|’
Ami tAke pRthivIte pratiSThita karechilAma evaM pratyeka viSaYera kAryeApakaraNa dAna karechilAma|
ataHpara se eka patha avalamvana karala|

ataHpara se yakhana sUryera astAcale pau~chala; takhana se sUryake eka kardamaYa jalAzaYe asta yete dekhala| se sekhAne eka sampradAYake dekhate pela| Ami valalAma, ‘he yulakAranAina, tumi tAdera zAsti dite pAra athavA tAdera kSetre sadaYa vyavahAra grahaNa karate pAra|’
se valala, ‘ye keu sImAlaGghana karave Ami tAke zAsti deva| ataHpara tAke tAra ravera kAche pherAno have| punarAYa tini tAke kaTheAra zAsti devena|’
tave ye ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tAra janya pratidAnasvarUpa raYeche kalyANa| evaM acirei Ami tAra prati AmAra viSaYa theke sahaja nirdeza deva|
ataHpara se eka panthA avalamvana karala|
avazeSe se yakhana sUryera udaYAcale pau~chala, takhana se tAke emana eka sampradAYera opara udaYa hate dekhala, yAdera janya sUryera viparIte Ami keAno pardA sRSTi karini|
prakRta ghaTanA emanai| tAra vRttAnta Ami samyaka jJAta|
AvAra se eka patha dharala|
avazeSe yakhana se dui parvata prAcIrera madhyasthale pau~chala, takhana se sekhAne eka jAtike pela, yArA tAra kathA ekevArei vujhate pArachila nA|

tArA valala, ‘he yulakAranAina, nizcaYai iYAjuja o mAjuja deze azAnti sRSTi kareche| tave AmarA ki ApanAra janya kichu kara dhArya karava? ei zarte ye, Apani AmAdera o tAdera madhye ekaTi prAcIra nirmANa kare devena|’
se valala, ‘AmAra rava AmAke ye sAmarthya diYechena, tA-i yatheSTa| ataeva, teAmarA AmAke zrama diYe sAhAyya karo| Ami teAmAdera o tAdera madhye ekaTi sudRr3ha prAcIra nirmANa kare deva|’

‘teAmarA AmAke leAhAra pAta ene dAo|’ avazeSe yakhana ubhaYa pAhAr3era madhyavartI phA~kA sthAna pUrNa kare dilo, takhana se valala,’ teAmarA phu~ dite thAko|’ avazeSe yakhana tini tA Agune pariNata karalena, takhana se valala, ‘teAmarA galita tAmA niYe eso, Ami tA tAra upare Dhele dii|’
ataHpara tArA (iYAjuja o mAjuja) tAra upare AreAhaNa karate pArala nA evaM tA bheda karate o sakSama halo nA|
se valala, ‘eTA AmAra ravera anugraha| yakhana AmAra ravera pratizruti (kiYAmAta) Asave, takhana tini eke cUrNa-vicUrNa kare devena evaM AmAra ravera pratizruti satya|’
Ami sedina tAdera emana avasthAYa cher3e deva ye, eka dala apara dalera upara DheuYera mato par3ave evaM ziGgAYa phu~tkAra deoYA have| ataHpara Ami tAdera savAike ekatra kare Anava|
sedina Ami kAphiradera kAche jAhAnnAmake pratyakSabhAve upasthita karava|
AmAra smaraNa theke yAdera cakSusamUhera opara pardA chila evaM yArA zunateo sakSama chila nA|
