kAphirarA ki mane kare ye, tArA AmAra parivarte AmAra vAndAdera abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karave? Ami kAphiradera abhyarthanAra janya prastuta kare rekhechi jAhAnnAma|
valo, ‘Ami ki teAmAderake tAdera saMvAda deva, yArA karmera dika diYe khuvai kSatigrasta|’
‘pArthiva jIvane yAdera praceSTA vyartha haYeche, athaca tArA mane kare ye, tArA satkarma kareche|’

orAi tArA yArA tAdera ravera nidarzanAvali evaM tA~ra sAthe sAkSAt asvIkAra kareche| phale niSphala haYeche tAdera karma| sutarAM kiYAmAtera dina tAdera janya Ami keAno parimApadaNDa sthApana karava nA|
jAhAnnAma eTAi tAdera pratiphala; kAraNa, tArA kuphuri kareche evaM AmAra nidarzanAvali o rAsUlagaNake grahaNa kareche vidrupera viSaYarUpe|
nizcaYai yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma sampAdana kare, tAdera abhyarthanAra janya raYeche jAnnAtula phiradAusa|
sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave, sekhAna theke sthAna parivartana karate cAive nA|

valo, ‘AmAra ravera kathA (lekhAra janya) yadi samudrera pAni kAli haYa, tave AmAra ravera kathA zeSa haoYAra Agei se samudra niHzeSita haYe yAve| yadio sAhAyyArthe anurUpa ArekaTi samudra ene deoYA haYa|’

valo, ‘prakRtapakSe Amio teAmAdera matoi ekajana mAnuSa, AmAra prati oYAhi pAThAno haYa ye, teAmAdera ilAha ekamAtra ilAha|’ ataeva, ye vyakti tAra ravera sAkSAt kAmanA kare, se yena satkarma sampAdana kare evaM tAra ravera ivAdAte kAuke zarika nA kare|
kA-pha hA iYA A-ina sA-da
eTA tomAra ravera anugrahera vivaraNa tA~ra vAndA yAkAriYAra prati|
yakhana se tA~ra ravake AhvAna karechila nibhRte|
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAra hADDi durvala haYeche; vArdhakye AmAra mAthAra culagulo sAdA haYeche; he AmAra rava, tomAke Deke Ami kakhano vyartha haini|’
‘AmAra para AmAra gotrera vyApAre bhaYa karachi, Ara AmAra strI vandhyA; ataeva, tumi tomAra pakSa theke AmAke ekajana uttarAdhikArI dAna karo|’
‘ye AmAra uttarAdhikArI have evaM iYAkUva-vaMzera uttarAdhikArI have| AmAra rava, Apani tAke santeASabhAjana karuna|’
‘he yAkAriYA, Ami teAmAke eka putrera susaMvAda dicchi, tAra nAma have iYAhaiYA| itaHpUrve ei nAme Ami kAro nAmakaraNa karini|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, kIbhAve AmAra putra have, athaca AmAra strI vandhyA, Ara Amio vArdhakyera zeSa prAnte upanIta|’
tini valalena, ‘ebhAvei have| teAmAra rava vale diYechena, eTA AmAra pakSe sahaja| Ami teA pUrve teAmAke sRSTi karechi, takhana tumi kichui chile nA|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke ekaTi nidarzana dina|’ tini valalena, ‘teAmAra nidarzana ei ye, tumi sustha avasthAYa tina dina mAnuSera sAthe kathAvArtA valave nA|’
ataHpara se miharAva theke vera haYe tAra sampradAYera kAche ela evaM iGgite tAderake sakAla-sandhyAYa AllAhara mahimA ghoSaNA karate valala|
‘he iYAhaiYA dRr3hatAra sAthe kitAvaTi dhAraNa karo|’ Ami tAke zaizavei prajJA dAna karechilAma|
evaM nijera pakSa theke sahAnubhUti o pavitratA diYechi| se chila muttAki|
pitA-mAtAra anugata; chila nA uddhata, avAdhya|
tAra prati zAnti; yedina se janmagrahaNa kare evaM yedina mRtyuvaraNa karave evaM yedina tAke jIvitAvasthAYa punarutthita karA have|
ei kitAve mAraiYAmera kathA varNanA karo, yakhana se tAra parivArera leAkajana theke pRthaka haYe gela pUrvadike eka sthAne|
ataHpara tAdera theke nijeke Ar3Ala karAra janya se pardA karala| ataHpara Ami tAra kAche AmAra rUha pAThAlAma, se tAra nikaTa pUrNa mAnavAkRtite AtmaprakAza karala|
mAraiYAma valala, ‘Ami teAmAra theke daYAmaYera AzraYa prArthanA kari yadi tumi AllAhabhIru hao|’
se valala, ‘Ami teAmAra ravera prerita, esechi teAmAke eka pavitra putra dAna karate|’
maraiYAma valala, ‘kIbhAve AmAra putra have, athaca keAno puruSa AmAke sparza kareni evaM Ami vyabhicAriNIo nai?’
se valala, ‘ebhAvei have|’ teAmAra rava valechena, ‘eTA AmAra janya sahaja| Ami tAke mAnuSera janya ekaTi nidarzana o AmAra pakSa theke anugrahasvarUpa karate cAi| eTi ekaTi sthirIkRta siddhAnta|’
ataHpara se garbhe santAna dhAraNa karala evaM tAke-saha eka dUravartI sthAne cale gela|
prasava vedanA tAke eka khejuragAchera mUlera kAche niYe ela| se valala, ‘hAYa, Ami yadi era pUrve mare yetAma evaM haYe yetAma sampUrNarUpe vismRta!’
ataHpara pherezatA tAke nicera dika theke DAka dila ye, ‘tumi duHkha kareA nA| teAmAra rava teAmAra (avasthAnera) taladeze ekaTi nahara pravAhita karechena|’
‘Ara tumi nijera dike khejuragAchera kANDe nAr3A dAo, tA teAmAra opara tAjA pAkA khejura phelave|’

‘sutarAM tumi AhAra karo, pAna karo evaM cakSu zItala karo| yadi mAnuSera madhye kAuke tumi dekha, tave vale diYo—‘Ami AllAhara uddeze sAomera mAnata karechi| sutarAM Aja Ami kichutei keAno mAnuSera sAthe kathA valava nA|’
ataHpara se santAnake niYe tAra sampradAYera kAche upasthita halo| tArA valala, ‘he mAraiYAma, tumi ekaTi adbhuta kANDa ghaTiYe esecha|’
‘he hArUnera vona, teAmAra vAvA asat vyakti chilena nA evaM teAmAra mAo chilena nA vyabhicAriNI|’
ataHpara se santAnera dike iGgita karala| tArA valala, ‘kIbhAve emana zizura sAthe AmarA kathA valava ye Ache dolanAra madhye?’
se valala, ‘Ami AllAhara vAndA| tini AmAke kitAva diYechena evaM AmAke vAniYechena navi|’
‘Ami yekhAnei thAki, tini AmAke varakatamaYa karechena| tini AmAke nirdeza diYechena, yatadina jIvita thAki, tatadina sAlAta o yAkAta AdAYa karate|’
‘evaM mAYera anugata thAkate evaM AmAke tini uddhata o hatabhAgya vAnAnani|’
‘AmAra prati sAlAma yedina Ami janmagrahaNa karechi, yedina mRtyuvaraNa karava evaM yedina AmAke jIvita avasthAYa punarutthita karA have|’
ei mAraiYAma-putra IsA| eTi emana satyakathA, ye samparke leAkerA vitarka kare|
AllAha emana nana ye, santAna grahaNa karavena, tini pavitra-mahimAmaYa sattA, tini yakhana keAno kAja karA siddhAnta karena takhana valena ‘hao’, phale tA haYe yAYa|
nizcaYai AllAha AmAra o teAmAdera rava| ataeva, teAmarA tA~ra ivAdAta karo| eTAi sarala patha|
ataHpara dalaguleA nijedera mAjhe matabheda karala; sutarAM mahAdivasa AgamanakAle kApheradera janya dhvaMsa|
sedina tArA kata camatkAra zunave evaM dekhave, yedina tArA AmAra kAche Asave| kintu Aja sImAlaGghanakArIrA prakAzya vibhrAntite raYeche|
Ara tumi tAdera paritApera divasa samparke satarka karo, yakhana sava vyApArera mImAMsA haYe yAve| ekhana tArA raYeche udAsInatAra madhye evaM tArA ImAna Ane nA|
nizcaYai Amii uttarAdhikArI hava pRthivIra evaM tAra upare yA kichu Ache, evaM AmArai dike tArA pratyAvartita have|
tumi ei kitAve ivarAhImera kathA smaraNa karo| nizcaYai se chila satyavAdI, navi|
yakhana se tAra pitAke valala, ‘he AmAra pitA, ye zeAne nA, dekhe nA evaM teAmAra keAno upakAre Ase nA, tumi tAra ivAdAta kena karo?’
‘he AmAra pitA, AmAra kAche emana jJAna eseche; yA teAmAra kAche Aseni, sutarAM AmAra anusaraNa karo, Ami teAmAke sarala patha dekhAva|’
‘he AmAra pitA, zaYatAnera ivAdAta kareA nA| nizcaYai zaYatAna daYAmaYera avAdhya|’
‘he AmAra pitA, Ami AzaGkA kari, daYAmaYera zAsti teAmAke sparza karave, ataHpara tumi zaYatAnera saGgI haYe yAve|’

pitA valala, ‘he ivarAhIma, tumi ki AmAra upAsyadera theke mukha phiriYe niccha? yadi tumi virata nA hao, Ami avazyai pAtharera AghAte teAmAke hatyA karava| tumi ciratare AmAra kAcha theke dUra haYe yAo|’
ivarAhIma valala, ‘teAmAra opara zAnti varSita heAka, Ami AmAra ravera kAche teAmAra janya kSamAprArthanA karava| nizcaYai tini AmAra prati anugrahazIla|’
‘Ara Ami parityAga karachi teAmAdera evaM teAmarA AllAha vyatIta yAdera ivAdAta karo tAderake; Ami AmAra ravake DAkava| AzA kari, AmAra ravake Deke Ami vaJcita hava nA|’
ataHpara se yakhana tAdera evaM tArA AllAha vyatIta yAdera ivAdAta karata, tAdera savAike parityAga karala, takhana Ami tAke dAna karalAma isahAka o iYAkUva evaM pratyekake vAnAlAma navi|
Ami tAdera dAna karalAma AmAra anugraha evaM dilAma samucca sukhyAti|
ei kitAve mUsAra kathA smaraNa karo, se chila maneAnIta, Arao chila rAsUla, navi|
Ami tAke AhvAna karalAma tUra pAhAr3era DAna dika theke evaM ekAnte kathAra janya nikaTavartI karalAma|
Ami nija anugrahe tAra bhAi hArUnake navi vAnAlAma|
ei kitAve isamAIlera kathA varNanA karo, se pratizruti pAlane satyAzraYI evaM chila rAsUla, navi|
se tAra parivAravargake sAlAta o yAkAta AdAYera nirdeza dita evaM se tAra ravera kAche chila santoSabhAjana|
ei kitAve idarIsera kathA AleAcanA karo, se chila satyavAdI navi|
Ami tAke unnIta karechi samunnata maryAdAYa|

erAi tArA—navigaNera madhya theke yAderake AllAha tA ‘ AlA niYAmAta dAna karechena| erA Adamera vaMzadhara evaM yAdera Ami nUhera sAthe naukAYa AreAhaNa kariYechilAma, tAdera vaMzadhara evaM ivarAhIma o isarAIlera vaMzadhara evaM yAdera Ami hidAYAta dAna karechi o maneAnIta karechi, (tAdera vaMzeAdbhUta)| tAdera kAche yakhana daYAmaYera AYAtasamUha pATha karA hato, takhana tArA kA~date kA~date sijadAYa luTiYe par3ata|
ataHpara tAdera pare tAdera sthalAbhiSikta halo nikRSTa uttarAdhikArIrA; tArA sAlAta naSTa karala evaM kupravRttira anuvartI halo| sutarAM tArA acirei zAsti pratyakSa karave|
kintu tArA vyatIta, yArA tAovA kareche, ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche| sutarAM tArA jAnnAte praveza karave evaM tAdera opara keAno avicAra karA have nA|
tAdera nivAsa have sthAYI jAnnAta, yAra pratizruti daYAmaYa tA~ra vAndAdera adRzyabhAve diYechena| nizcaYai tA~ra pratizruta viSaYa avazyai Asave|
tArA sekhAne ‘sAlAma’ vyatIta keAno asAra kathAvArtA zunave nA evaM sekhAne sakAla-sandhyA tAdera janya thAkave jIvikA|
eTA oi jAnnAta, yAra adhikArI karava AmAra vAndAdera madhye muttAkiderake|

(jivarAIla valala), ‘Ami ApanAra ravera Adeza vyatIta avataraNa kari nA, yA AmAdera sAmane Ache, yA AmAdera pechane Ache evaM yA e duiYera madhyasthale Ache, (savai tAra) evaM ApanAra rava vismRta haoYAra nana|’
tini AkAzamAlA o pRthivIra evaM ubhaYera madhyavartI savAra rava| sutarAM tA~rai ivAdAta karo evaM tAte dRr3ha thAko tumi ki tA~ra samakakSa kAuke jAno?
mAnuSa vale, ‘yakhana Ami mRtyuvaraNa karava takhana ki AvAra jIvita haYe punarutthita hava?’
mAnuSa ki smaraNa kare nA ye, Ami tAke itaHpUrve sRSTi karechi takhana se kichui chila nA|
sutarAM tomAra ravera zapatha, Ami avazyai tAderake evaM zaYatAnaderake ekatre samaveta karava, ataHpara avazyai tAderake natajAnu avasthAYa upasthita karava jAhAnnAmera cArapAze|
ataHpara pratyeka sampradAYera madhye ye daYAmaYa AllAhara sarvAdhika avAdhya Ami tAke pRthaka kare neva|
tAdera madhye yArA jAhAnnAme pravezera adhika yeAgya, Ami tAdera viSaYe bhAleA jAni|
teAmAdera madhye emana keu nei ye oTA atikrama karave nA| eTA tomAra ravera anivArya phAYasAlA|
ataHpara Ami muttAkiderake uddhAra karava evaM sImAlaGghanakArIderake sekhAne natajAnu avasthAYa cher3e deva|
yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karA haYa, takhana kAphirarA mu ’ minadera vale, ‘dui dalera madhye keAnaTi maryAdAYa zreSTha evaM kAra majalisa utkRSTa?’
tAdera pUrve kata mAnavageASThIke Ami vinAza karechi, tArA tAdera cAite sampade o vaibhave zreSTha chila|

valo, ‘yArA pathabhraSTatAYa Ache, daYAmaYa tAdera yatheSTa avakAza devena; avazeSe tArA pratyakSa karave, ye viSaYe tAdera oYAdA deoYA hacche, tA hate pAre zAsti athavA kiYAmAta| takhana tArA jAnate pArave ke maryAdAYa nikRSTa o janazaktite durvalatama|’
yArA satpathe cale AllAha tAdera hidAYAta vRddhi karena| Ara sthAYI satkarmasamUha tomAra ravera kAche saoYAvera dika diYe zreSTha evaM pratidAne utkRSTa|
tumi ki tAke lakSa karecha, ye AmAra nidarzanAvalike asvIkAra kare evaM vale, ‘AmAke avazyai artha-sampada o santAna-santati deoYA have|’
se ki adRzya viSaYa jene pheleche, nAki daYAmaYa AllAhara nikaTa theke keAno pratizruti prApta haYeche?
nA, eTA Thika naYa| se yA vale Ami tA likhe rAkhava evaM tAra zAsti dIrghAYita karate thAkava|
se yA vale, (mRtyura para) Ami tAra adhikArI hava evaM se AmAra kAche Asave ekAkI|
tArA AllAha vyatIta anyAnya ilAha grahaNa kareche, yAte tArA tAdera janya sAhAyyakArI haYa|
kakhanoi naYa, tArA tAdera ivAdAta asvIkAra karave evaM tAdera vipakSe cale yAve|
tumi ki lakSa karani ye, Ami kAphiradera opara zaYatAnaderake cher3e diYechi| tArA tAdera (vizeSabhAve mandakarme) prarocita kare|
sutarAM tAdera vyApAre tumi tAr3Ahur3A karave nA| Ami teA tAdera gaNanA pUrNa karachi mAtra|
sedina daYAmaYera kAche muttAkidera atithirUpe samaveta karava|
evaM aparAdhIdera pipAsArta avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera dike hA~kiYe niYe yAva|
ye daYAmaYa AllAhara kAcha theke pratizruti grahaNa kareche, se vyatIta Ara keu supAriza karAra adhikArI have nA|
tArA vale, ‘daYAmaYa AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena|’
nizcaYai teAmarA eka adbhuta kANDa karecha|
haYateA era kAraNei AkAza pheTe par3ave, pRthivI khaNDa-vikhaNDa have evaM parvatamAlA cUrNa-vicUrNa have|
e kAraNe ye, tArA daYAmaYa AllAhara janya santAna dAvi kare|
athaca santAna grahaNa karA daYAmaYera janya zeAbhanIYa naYa|
AkAzasamUha o pRthivIte emana keu nei, ye daYAmaYa AllAhara kAche upasthita have nA vAndArUpe|
tA~ra kAche tAdera pariveSTana kare rekhechena evaM tini tAderake gaNanA kare rekhechena|
kiYAmAtera dina tAdera savAi tA~ra kAche ekAkI avasthAYa Asave|
yArA ImAna Ane evaM satkarma sampAdana kare, tAderake daYAmaYa AllAha bhAlovAsA devena|
Ami kuraAnake tomAra bhASAYa sahaja kare diYechi, yena tumi era dvArA muttAkidera susaMvAda dAo evaM kalahapriYa sampradAYake satarka karo|
tAdera pUrve Ami kata mAnavageASThIke dhvaMsa karechi| tumi ki tAdera kArao sAr3A pAo, athavA tAdera kSINatama AoYAjao zunate pAo?
tva-hA
tomAke kaSTa deoYAra janya Ami tomAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa karini|
varaM tAdera upadeza-svArthe yArA bhaYa kare|
eTA tA~ra nikaTa theke avatIrNa, yini sRSTi karechena suucca AkAzasamUha o pRthivI |
tini parama daYAmaYa, Araze isatioYA karechena|
AkAzasamUha o pRthivIte yA-kichu Ache, Ara yA-kichu Ache ubhaYera madhyavartI sthAne o sikta mATira nice yA Ache—sava tA~rai|
tumi yadi u~cu AoYAje kathA vala, nizcaYai tini to gopana o ati supta viSaYao jAnena|
AllAha—tini vyatIta keAno ilAha nei| sava sundara nAmasamUha tA~rai|
mUsAra vRttAnta tomAra kAche pau~cheche ki?

yakhana se Aguna dekhala, takhana tAra parivAravargake valala, ‘teAmarA ekhAne avasthAna karo Ami Aguna dekhechi| sambhavata Ami tA theke teAmAdera kAche kichu aGgAra niYe Asava athavA Agunera kAche pathera sandhAna pAva|’
ataHpara yakhana se Agunera kAche pau~chala, takhana tAke DAkA halo ‘he mUsA’,
‘Amii teAmAra rava; ataeva, tumi jutA khule phelo, tumi pavitra upatyakA tuoYAYa raYecha|’
‘Ara Ami teAmAke maneAnIta karechi| ataeva, yA pratyAdeza karA hacche, tA manoyeAgasaha zono|’
‘Amii AllAha Ami vyatIta keAno ilAha nei| ataeva, AmAra ivAdAta karo evaM AmAra smaraNArthe sAlAta pratiSThA karo|’
‘nizcaYai kiYAmAta avazyai Asave, Ami tA geApana rAkhate cAi; yena pratyekei tAra karmAnuyAYI phala lAbha kare|’
‘sutarAM tomAke yena tA theke nivRtta nA kare, ye vyakti tAra prati ImAna Ane nA evaM svIYa pravRttira anusaraNa kare, tave tumi dhvaMsa haYe yAve|’
‘he mUsA, teAmAra DAna hAte oTA kI?’
se valala, ‘eTA AmAra lAThi, Ami era upara bhara dii evaM era dvArA AmAra chAgalapAlera janya gAchera pAtA pAr3i evaM eTA AmAra anyAnya kAjeo lAge|’
AllAha valalena, ‘he mUsA, tumi oTA nikSepa karo|’
ataHpara se tA nikSepa karala, amani tA sApa haYe choTAchuTi karate lAgala|
tini valalena, ‘tumi oTA dharo evaM bhaYa kareA nA, acirei Ami eke pUrvAvasthAYa phiriYe deva|’
‘teAmAra hAta vagale rAkho, tA vera haYe Asave nirmala ujjvala haYe anya eka nidarzanarUpe; keAno truTi chAr3Ai|’
(eTA ejanya ye), ‘Ami teAmAke dekhAte cAi AmAra mahA nidarzanAvalira kichu|’
‘phiraAunera nikaTa yAo, nizcaYai se sImAlaGghana kareche|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAra vakSa prazasta kare dina|’
‘sahaja kare dina AmAra kAja|’
‘AmAra jihvA theke jar3atA dUra kare dina|’
‘yena tArA AmAra kathA vujhate pAre|’
‘evaM AmAra parivAravargera madhya theke AmAra ekajana sAhAyyakArI kare dina|’
‘AmAra bhAi hArUnake|’
‘tAra dvArA AmAra zakti sudRr3ha karuna|’
‘evaM tAke AmAra kAje aMzIdAra karuna|’
‘yena AmarA vezi kare ApanAra pavitratA o mahimA gheASaNA karate pAri|’
‘evaM vezi parimANe ApanAke smaraNa karate pAri|’
‘Apani teA AmAdera avasthA savai dekhachena|’
tini valalena, ‘he mUsA, tumi yA ceYecha tA teAmAke deoYA halo|’
‘Ami teAmAra prati Arao ekavAra anugraha karechilAma|’
‘yakhana Ami teAmAra mAke yA nirdeza deoYAra nirdeza diYechilAma’;

‘ye, tumi mUsAke sinduke rAkho, ataHpara tA dariYAYa bhAsiYe dAo, ataHpara dariYA tAke tIre Thele deve| tAke AmAra zatru o tAra zatru uThiYe neve| Ami teAmAra prati sneha saJcArita karechi AmAra pakSa theke, yena tumi AmAra dRSTira sAmane pratipAlita hao|’

“yakhana teAmAra vona ese valala, ‘Ami ki teAmAdera sandhAna deva, ye tAke lAlana-pAlana karate pArave|’ ataHpara Ami teAmAke teAmAra mAYera kAche phiriYe dilAma, yena tAra cokha zItala haYa evaM duHkha nA pAYa| tumi eka vyaktike hatyA karechile, ataHpara Ami teAmAke ei duzcintA theke mukti diYechi; Ami teAmAke aneka parIkSA karechi| ataHpara tumi kaYeka vachara mAdaiYAnavAsIra madhye avasthAna karechile; he mUsA, ataHpara tumi nirdhArita samaYe esecha|”
‘Ami teAmAke AmAra risAlAtera janya manonIta karechi|’
‘tumi o teAmAra bhAi AmAra nidarzanAvalisaha yAo evaM AmAra smaraNe zaithilya kareA nA|’
‘teAmarA ubhaYe phiraAunera kAche yAo nizcaYai se sImAlaGghana kareche|’
‘ataHpara teAmarA tAke narama kathA valo, haYateA se cintA-bhAvanA karave athavA bhIta have|’
tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA AzaGkA kari ye, se AmAdera prati yuluma karave kiMvA aiddhatya pradarzana karave|’
AllAha valalena, ‘teAmarA bhaYa kareA nA, Ami teAmAdera sAthe Achi, Ami zunava o dekhava|’

ataeva, teAmarA tAra kAche yAo evaM valo, ‘AmarA ubhaYei teAmAra ravera prerita rAsUla; ataeva, AmAdera sAthe vani isarAIlake yete dAo evaM tAdera nipIr3ana kareA nA| AmarA teAmAra ravera kAcha theke nidarzana niYe teAmAra kAche esechi| ye hidAYAtera patha anusaraNa kare, tAra prati zAnti|’
‘nizcaYai AmAdera prati pAThAno haYeche ye, zAsti tAra janya ye mithyAreApa kare evaM mukha phiriYe neYa|’
se valala, ‘tave he mUsA, teAmAdera rava ke?’
mUsA valala, ‘AmAdera rava tini, yini pratyeka vastuke tAra AkRti dAna karechena, ataHpara hidAYAta dAna karechena|’
phiraAuna valala, ‘tAhale atIta yugera leAkadera avasthA kI?’
mUsA valala, ‘tAdera khavara AmAra ravera kAche Ache ekaTi granthera madhye| AmAra rava bhule yAna nA evaM vismRtao hana nA|’
‘tini teAmAdera janya pRthivIke karechena zayyA evaM tAte karechena calAra patha, Ara AkAza theke vAri varSaNa karechena’ evaM tA dvArA Ami vibhinna prakAra udbhida utpanna karechi|
teAmarA AhAra karo evaM teAmAdera catuSpada jantu carAo| nizcaYai ete vivekavAnadera janya raYeche nidarzana|
e mATi thekei Ami teAmAdera sRSTi karechi, etei teAmAdera phiriYe deva evaM punarAYa e thekei Ami Aro ekavAra teAmAdera utthita karava|
avazyai Ami to tAke AmAra sava nidarzana dekhiYechi, ataHpara se mithyA pratipanna kareche evaM asvIkAra kareche|
se valala, ‘he mUsA, tumi ki jAdura jeAre AmAdera deza theke vahiSkAra karAra janya esecha?’

‘ataeva, AmarAo teAmAra meAkAvelAYa teAmAra nikaTa anurUpa jAdu upasthita karava| sutarAM AmAdera o teAmAra madhye ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa Thika karo, yAra khelApha AmarAo karava nA evaM tumio karave nA; eka samatala prAntare|’
mUsA valala, ‘utsavera dinai teAmAdera nirdhArita dina evaM pUrvAhne leAkajana samaveta have|’
ataHpara phiraAuna phire gela evaM tAra sava kalAkauzala jamA kare upasthita halo|
mUsA tAderake valala, ‘durbhAgya teAmAdera; teAmarA AllAhara prati mithyAreApa kareA nA| tAhale tini teAmAdera zAsti dvArA dhvaMsa kare devena| ye mithyA udbhAvana kare, sei viphala haYeche|’
ataHpara tArA nijedera kAje nijedera madhye vitarka karala evaM geApane parAmarza karala|
tArA valala, ‘ei duijanai nizcita jAdukara, tArA cAYa tAdera jAdu dvArA teAmAderake teAmAdera deza theke vahiSkAra karate evaM teAmAdera utkRSTa jIvanavyavasthA dhvaMsa karate|’
‘ataeva, teAmarA teAmAdera kalAkauzala susaMhata karo, ataHpara sArivaddha haYe eso| Aja ye jaYI have, sei saphalakAma have|’
tArA valala, ‘he mUsA, haYa tumi nikSepa karo, nA haYa AmarA prathame nikSepa kari|’
mUsA valala, ‘varaM teAmarAi nikSepa karo|’ tAdera jAdura prabhAve akasmAt tAra mane halo, yena tAdera raziguleA o lAThiguleA choTAchuTi karache|
ataHpara mUsA mane mane kichuTA bhIti anubhava karala|
Ami valalAma, ‘bhaYa kareA nA, nizcaYai tumi vijaYI have|’

‘Ara teAmAra DAna hAte yA Ache tumi tA nikSepa karo; tArA yA-kichu vAniYeche eTA savakichuke grAsa kare phelave| tArA teA kevala jAdukarera kauzala avalamvana kareche| jAdukara yebhAvei Asuka, saphala have nA|’
ataHpara jAdukararA sijadAYa par3e gela| tArA valala, ‘AmarA hArUna o mUsAra ravera prati ImAna AnalAma|’

phiraAuna valala, ‘Ami tomAdera anumati devAra pUrvei ki teAmarA tAra prati ImAna Anale; se teAmAdera pradhAna, ye teAmAdera jAdu zikSA diYeche| ataeva, Ami avazyai teAmAdera hAta-pA viparIta dika theke kATava evaM Ami teAmAdera khejuragAchera kANDe zUle car3Ava| teAmarA avazyai jAnate pArave AmAdera madhye kAra zAsti kaTheAratara evaM adhika sthAYI|’

jAdukararA valala, ‘AmAdera kAche ye suspaSTa pramANa eseche tAra opara evaM yini AmAderake sRSTi karechena, tA~ra opara AmarA kichutei teAmAke prAdhAnya deva nA| ataeva, tumi yA icchA vicAra karate pAra| tumi teA zudhu ei pArthiva-jIvanei vicAra karave|’
‘nizcaYai AmarA AmAdera ravera prati ImAna enechi, yena tini AmAdera pApa evaM tumi AmAderake ye jAdu karate vAdhya karecha, tA mArjanA karena| AllAha sarvottama o cirasthAYI|’
nizcaYai ye tAra ravera kAche aparAdhI haYe Ase, tAra janya raYeche jAhAnnAma| sekhAne se maraveo nA evaM vA~caveo nA|
Ara yArA tA~ra kAche Ase mu ’ mina avasthAYa; evaM satkAjao kareche, tAdera janya raYeche suucca maryAdA|
sthAYI jAnnAta, yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita haYa nada-nadI| sekhAne tArA sthAYI, eTA tAdera puraskAra, yArA parizuddha haYeche|

Ami mUsAra prati ei marme oYAhi pAThAlAma ye, ‘AmAra vAndAderake niYe rAte vera haYe yAo evaM tAdera janya samudre zuSkapatha nirmANa karo| (pechana theke ese) teAmAdera dhare phelAra AzaGkA kareA nA evaM bhaYa kareA nA|’
ataHpara phiraAuna tAra sainyavAhinI niYe tAdera pichu nila evaM samudra tAderake sampUrNarUpe nimajjita karala|
phiraAuna tAra sampradAYake vibhrAnta karechila evaM hidAYAtera patha dekhAYani|

he vani isarAIla, Ami teAmAderake teAmAdera zatrura kavala theke uddhAra karechi, tUra pAhAr3era dakSiNa pAze teAmAderake pratizruti diYechi evaM teAmAdera nikaTa ‘mAnnA’ o ‘sAlaoYA’ avatIrNa karechi|

(valechi), Ami tomAdera yesava pavitra vastu riyika diYechi tA theke khAo evaM ete sImAlaGghana kareA nA, tAhale teAmAdera opara AmAra kreAdha neme Asave; Ara yAra opara AmAra kreAdha neme Ase se dhvaMsa haYe yAYa|
Ara ye tAovA kare, ImAna Ane evaM satkAja kare, ataHpara satpathe aTala thAke, Ami tAra prati avazyai kSamAzIla|
he mUsA, teAmAra sampradAYake pechane phele tomAke tvarA karate vAdhya karala kIse?
se valala, ‘ei teA tArA AmAra pechane Asache evaM he AmAra rava, Ami druta teAmAra kAche elAma, yena tumi santuSTa hao|’
tini valalena, ‘nizcaYai Ami teAmAra paravartI samaYe tomAra sampradAYake parIkSAYa phelechi evaM sAmeri tAdera pathabhraSTa kareche|’

ataHpara mUsA tAra sampradAYera kAche phire gela kruddha o anutapta avasthAYa| se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmAdera rava ki teAmAdera ekaTi uttama pratizruti denani? tave ki pratizrutira samaYakAla teAmAdera kAche dIrgha haYeche, nAki teAmarA ceYecha ye, teAmAdera opara teAmAdera ravera kreAdha neme Asuka, ye kAraNe teAmarA AmAra sAthe kRta oYAdA bhaGga karale?’

tArA valala, ‘AmarA teAmAra sAthe kRta oYAdA AmAdera icchAYa bhaGga karini; kintu AmAdera opara (phiraAuni) lokadera alaMkArera veAjhA cApiYe deoYA haYechila| ataHpara AmarA tA nikSepa karechi| emanibhAve sAmerio nikSepa kareche|’
ataHpara se tAdera janya vera karala ekaTi garura vAchura avaYava, yAra madhye ‘hAmvA’ zavda chila| ataHpara tArA valala, ‘eTA teAmAdera ilAh evaM mUsArao ilAh, kintu se bhule geche|’
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, tAdera prati phire Ase nA (uttara deYa nA) keAno kathAra evaM tAdera keAno kSati o upakArera kSamatAo rAkhe nA?
hArUna tAderake pUrvei valechila, ‘he AmAra kaoma, teAmAdera e dvArA parIkSA karA hacche| teAmAdera rava daYAmaYa, ataeva, teAmarA AmAra anusaraNa karo evaM AmAra Adeza mene calo|’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA vase thAkava yatakSaNa nA mUsA AmAdera kAche phire Ase, AmarA se vyapAre kichutei virata hava nA|’
mUsA valala, ‘he hArUna, tumi yakhana tAdera pathabhraSTa hate dekhale, takhana teAmAke kIse nivRtta karala’
‘ye, tumi AmAra Anugatya karave nA? tave tumi ki AmAra Adeza amAnya karecha?’
se valala, “he AmAra sahodara, AmAra zmazru o mAthAra keza dharo nA, Ami AzaGkA karechilAma ye, tumi valave, ‘tumi vani isarAIlera madhye vibheda sRSTi karecha evaM AmAra kathA smaraNe rAkhani|’”
mUsA valala, ‘he sAmeri, ekhana teAmAra vaktavya kI?’
se valala, ‘Ami emana kichu dekhechi, yA anyerA dekheni| Ami sei prerita vyaktira padacihnera nica theke eka muThi mATi niYe tA nikSepa karalAma| AmAke AmAra mana ei mantraNAi dila|’

mUsA valala, “dUra hao, teAmAra jIvaddazAYa e zAstii raila ye, tumi valave; ‘AmAke sparza kareA nA’, evaM teAmAra janya Ache ekaTi nirdiSTa kAla, yAra vyatikrama have nA| tumi lakSa karo tomAra upAsyera prati, yAra prati tumi uvu haYe thAkate| avazyai AmarA seTi jvAliYe deva| ataHpara tAke vikSipta kare sAgare char3iYe deva|”
teAmAdera ilAha teA kevala AllAhai, tini vyatIta anya keAno ilAha nei| sava kichuke tA~ra jJAna parivyApta kare Ache|
ebhAve, pUrve yA ghaTeche, tAra saMvAda Ami tomAra kAche varNanA kari| Ami AmAra pakSa theke tomAke dAna karechi upadeza|
ye e theke mukha phiriYe neve, se kiYAmAtera dina veAjhA vahana karave|
tArA tAte sthAYI evaM kiYAmAtera dina ei veAjhA tAdera janya katai nA manda have|
yedina siGgAYa phutkAra deoYA have, sedina Ami aparAdhIdera samaveta karava nIla cakSu avasthAYa|
tArA cupisAre paraspare valAvali karave, ‘teAmarA mAtra daza dina avasthAna karachile|’
tArA kI vale tA Ami bhAleAbhAve jAni| tAdera madhye ye apekSAkRta uttama pathera anusArI se valave, ‘teAmarA mAtra ekadina avasthAna karechile|’
tArA tomAke pAhAr3a samparke prazna kare| vale dAo, ‘AmAra rava pAhAr3asamUhake samUle utpATana kare vikSipta karavena|’
‘ataHpara pRthivIke masRNa samatala bhUmite pariNata karavena|’
‘tumi tAte vakratA o uccatA dekhate pAve nA|’
sedina tArA AhvAnakArIra anusaraNa karave, yAra kathA edika-sedika have nA evaM daYAmaYa AllAhara sAmane sava zavda kSINa haYe yAve| sutarAM mRdu guJjana vyatIta tumi kichui zunate pArave nA|
daYAmaYa AllAha yAke anumati devena evaM yAra kathAYa santuSTa havena se chAr3A kArao supAriza sedina keAno upakAre Asave nA|
tini jAnena, yA-kichu tAdera sAmane o pechane Ache evaM tArA tAke jJAna dvArA AYatta karate pAre nA|
sei ciraJjIva cirasthAYIra sAmane sava mukha avanamita have evaM se vyartha have ye atyAcArera veAjhA vahana karave|
ye mu ’ mina avasthAYa satkAja sampAdana kare, se yuluma o kSatira AzaGkA karave nA|
ebhAve Ami Aravi bhASAYa kuraAna avatIrNa karechi evaM tAte vizadabhAve satarkavANI vyakta karechi, yena tArA AllAhabhIru haYa athavA tAdera janya upadeza sRSTi kare|
sutarAM AllAha mahAna, satyikAra adhipati| tomAra prati oYAhi sampUrNa haoYAra pUrve tumi kuraAnera vyApAre tAr3Ahur3A karave nA evaM valo, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAra jJAna vRddhi karuna|’
Ami itaHpUrve Adamake nirdeza diYechilAma| ataHpara se bhule giYechila evaM Ami tAra madhye dRr3hatA pAini|
yakhana Ami pherezatAderake valalAma, ‘teAmarA Adamake sijadAha karo’, takhana ivalIsa vyatIta savAi sijadAha karala| se amAnya karala|
ataHpara Ami valalAma, ‘he Adama, nizcaYai e teAmAra o teAmAra strIra zatru, sutarAM se yena teAmAdera jAnnAta theke vera kare nA deYa| tAhale teAmarA kaSTe par3ave|’
‘tumi ekhAne kSudhArta have nA evaM vastrahIna have nA|’
‘tumi tRSNArta have nA evaM rodeo kaSTa pAve nA|’
ataHpara zaYatAna tAke kumantraNA diYe valala, ‘he Adama, Ami ki teAmAke vale deva cirantana jIvanera ei gAcha samandhe evaM avinazvara rAjatvera vyApAre?’

ataHpara tArA ubhaYei era phala khela, takhana tAdera sAmane tAdera lajjAsthAna khule gela evaM tArA jAnnAtera gAchera pAtA dvArA nijedera AvRta karate zuru karala| Adama tAra ravera nirdezera kSetre bhula karala, phale se vibhrAnta haYe gela|
erapara tAra rava tAke maneAnIta karalena, tAra tA ovA kavula karalena evaM tAke supathe Analena|

tini valalena, ‘teAmarA ubhaYei ekhAna theke eka saGge neme yAo| teAmarA eke aparera zatru| erapara yadi AmAra pakSa theke teAmAdera kAche hidAYAta Ase, takhana ye AmAra varNita hidAYAtera anusaraNa karave, se pathabhraSTa have nA evaM kaSTe par3ave nA|’
‘evaM ye AmAra smaraNa theke mukha phiriYe neve, tAra jIvikA saMkIrNa have evaM Ami tAke kiYAmAtera dina andha avasthAYa utthita karava|’
se valave, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke kena andha avasthAYa utthita karalena? Ami teA cakSuSmAna chilAma!’
tini valavena, ‘ebhAvei, teAmAra kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha esechila, tave tumi seguleA bhule giYechile| anurUpa Aja tomAke bhule yAoYA halo |’
ebhAve Ami tAke pratiphala deva, ye sImAlaGghana kare evaM ravera kathAYa ImAna Ane nA| parakAlera zAsti kaTheAratara evaM adhika sthAYI|
Ami edera pUrve aneka sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechi| yAdera vAsabhUmite erA vicaraNa kare, eTAo ki edera satpatha pradarzana karala nA? nizcaYai ete vuddhimAnadera janya raYeche samUha nidarzana|
tomAra ravera pakSa theke pUrva siddhAnta evaM ekaTi kAla nirdiSTa nA thAkale zAsti avazyambhAvI haYe yeta|

sutarAM tArA yA vale se viSaYe dhairya dhAraNa karo evaM tomAra ravera prazaMsA pavitratA o mahimA gheASaNA karo sUryeAdaYera pUrve evaM tA astera pUrve evaM pavitratA o mahimA gheASaNA karo rAtera kichu aMza o dinera, sambhavata tAte tumi santuSTa have|

tumi sesava vastura prati dRSTi prasArita karo nA, yA Ami pArthiva jIvanera saundaryasvarUpa bheAga-vilAsera upakaraNa diYechi tAdera vibhinna prakAra leAkake; tA dvArA tAdera parIkSA karAra janya| tomAra ravera deoYA riyika utkRSTa o adhika sthAYI|
tumi svIYa parivArake sAlAtera Adeza dAo evaM nijeo era opara avicala thAko| Ami tomAra kAche keAno riyika cAi nA| Ami tomAke riyika dii evaM zubha pariNAma muttAkidera janya|
erA vale, ‘se AmAdera kAche tAra ravera nikaTa theke keAno nidarzana Ane nA kena?’ tAdera kAche ki pramANa Aseni, yA pUrvavartI kitAvasamUhe Ache?

yadi Ami ederake itaHpUrve keAno zAsti dvArA dhvaMsa karatAma, tave erA valata, ‘he AmAdera rava, Apani AmAdera kAche ekajana rAsUla pAThAlena nA kena? tAhale teA AmarA apamAnita o lAJchita haoYAra pUrvei ApanAra nidarzanasamUha mene calatAma|’
valo, ‘pratyekei apekSA karache, tomarAo apekSA karo| tomarA acirei jAnate pArave, ke chila saThika pathera anusArI evaM ke chila hidAYAtaprApta|’
mAnuSera hisAvera samaYa nikaTavartI haYe geche; athaca tArA udAsInatAYa vimukha haYe Ache|
tAdera kAche tAdera ravera pakSa theke yakhanai keAno natuna upadeza Ase, takhana tArA tA khelAra chale zone|
tAdera antara amanoyogI| yArA yuluma kareche tArA geApane parAmarza kareche| (tArA vale,) ‘se ki teAmAdera matoi ekajana mAnuSa vyatIta kichu; tavuo ki tomarA dekhezune jAdura kavale Asave?’
se valala, ‘AmAra rava AsamAna o yaminera sakala kathA jAnena| Ara tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|’
tArA Arao valala, ‘(eTA) alIka svapna; varaM se nijei tA racanA kareche, se ekajana kavi| ataeva, se AmAdera kAche keAno nidarzana niYe Asuka, yemana prerita haYechila pUrvavartIgaNa|’
tAdera pUrve ye janapadai Ami dhvaMsa karechi, tAra adhivAsIrA ImAna Aneni, tAhale ki tArA ImAna Anave?
tomAra pUrve Ami Ami rAsUla karini mAnuSa vyatIta kAuke, yAdera kAche Ami oYAhi pAThAtAma| ataeva, jJAnIdera jijJesa karo, yadi tomarA nA jAno|
Ami tAdera emana dehaviziSTa karini ye, tArA khAdya khAve nA evaM tArA chila nA cirasthAYI|
ataHpara Ami tAdera prati AmAra pratizruti pUrNa karalAma, erapara tAdera evaM yAdera icchA mukti dilAma Ara dhvaMsa karalAma sImAlaGghanakArIderake|
avazyai Ami teAmAdera prati emana kitAva avatIrNa karechi; tAte teAmAdera (janya raYeche) upadeza| tavuo ki teAmarA vujhave nA?
Ami dhvaMsa karechi kata janapada, yAra adhivAsIrA chila sImAlaGghanakArI evaM tAdera para sRSTi karechi anya jAti|
ataHpara tArA AmAra zAsti anubhava karala takhana tArA tA theke palAYana karate lAgala|
tomarA palAYana kareA nA, varaM phire eso tomAdera bhoga sambhAra hiseve yA deoYA haYeche tAra kAche o teAmAdera AvAsagRhe; haYato tomarA jijJAsita have|
tArA valala, ‘hAYa, durbheAga AmAdera, nizcaYai AmarA chilAma sImAlaGghanakArI!’
calate thAkala tAdera ei ArtanAda, yatakSaNa nA Ami tAdera kare dilAma kATA zasya o nirvApita Agunera mato|
AsamAna yamina evaM e duYera mAjhe yA-kichu Ache, tA Ami khelAcchale sRSTi karini|
yadi Ami cAitAma ye Ami khelAra upakaraNarUpe grahaNa karava, tAhale AmAra nikaTa thekei tA grahaNa karatAma| tA Ami karini|
varaM Ami satya dvArA mithyAra opara AghAta hAni, ataHpara tA mithyAke cUrNa-vicUrNa kare deYa, phale takhana tA nizcihna haYe yAYa| teAmarA yA mithyAropa karacha, se janya teAmAdera janya durbheAga|
AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA kichu Ache sava tA~rai adhIna| Ara yArA tA~ra sAnnidhye Ache tArA tA~ra ivAdAte ahaMkAra kare nA evaM parizrAnta haYa nA|
tArA rAta o dina tA~ra tAsavIha kare evaM klAnta haYa nA|
tArA ki mATi diYe tairi upAsya grahaNa kareche, ye tArA jIvita karave?
yadi (AsamAna yamina) ei duYera madhye AllAha vyatIta anyAnya upAsya thAkata, tave ubhaYaTi dhvaMsa haYe yeta| ataeva, tArA yA vale, tA theke Arazera adhipati AllAha pavitra|
tini tAra kAja samparke jijJAsita havena nA, varaM tArA jijJAsita have|

tArA ki tA~ke vyatIta anyAnya ilAh grahaNa kareche? valo, ‘teAmarA teAmAdera pramANa Ano| eTAi AmAra saGgIdera kathA evaM eTAi AmAra pUrvavartIdera upadeza;’ varaM tAdera adhikAMzai satya jAne nA; phale tArA mukha phiriYe neYa|
tomAra pUrve Ami ye rAsUlai preraNa karechi, tAke e Adezei preraNa karechi ye, Ami vyatIta anya keAno ilAh nei| sutarAM tomarA AmArai ivAdAta karo|
tArA vale, ‘daYAmaYa santAna grahaNa karechena|’ tini (tA theke) mahApavitra; varaM tArA teA tA~ra sammAnita vAndA|
tArA Age ver3e kathA valate pAre nA evaM tArA to tA~ra Adezei kAja kare thAke|
tAdera sammukhe o pazcAte yA Ache, tA tini jAnena| tArA zudhu tAdera janya supAriza kare, yAdera prati tini santuSTa evaM tArA tA~ra bhaYe bhIta|
tAdera madhye ye valave— ‘tini vyatIta Amii ilAh’, tAke Ami pratidAnasvarUpa deva jAhAnnAma| Ami sImAlaGghanakArIderake ebhAvei pratiphala diYe thAki|

yArA kuphuri kareche tArA ki bheve dekheni, AsamAnasamUha o yamina milita chila, ataHpara Ami ubhaYaTike pRthaka kare diYechi evaM jIvanta savakichu Ami sRSTi karalAma pAni theke| eraparao ki tArA ImAna Anave nA?
Ami pRthivIra madhye sthApana karechi sudRr3ha parvatamAlA; yena tAdera niYe tA hele nA par3e, evaM tAte vAniYechi prazasta rAstAsamUha, yena tArA gantavye pauchate pAre|
Ami AsamAnake karechi surakSita chAda; athaca tArA tAra nidarzanAvali theke mukha phiriYe nicche|
Ara tinii sRSTi karechena rAta o dina evaM sUrya o candra| pratyekei nija nija kakSapathe santaraNa karache|
Ami tomAra pUrve keAno mAnuSake ananta jIvana dAna karini| sutarAM tumi yadi mRtyuvaraNa karo tAhale tArA ki ciraJjIva have?
pratyeka prANai mRtyura svAda AsvAdanakArI| Ara Ami teAmAdera manda o bhAlo dvArA parIkSA kari evaM AmArai kAche tomAdera phiriYe AnA have|

Ara yArA kuphuri kareche tArA yakhana tomAke dekhe takhana tArA tomAke zudhu ThATTAra pAtra hisevei grahaNa kare; vale—‘e ki sei vyakti, ye teAmAdera deva-devIra samAleAcanA kare?’ athaca tArA rAhamAna-era kathAra (kuraAna) viruddhAcaraNa kare|
mAnuSake sRSTi karA haYeche tvarA pravaNatA diYe; Ami satvarai teAmAderake AmAra nidarzanAvali dekhAva| ataeva, teAmarA AmAra kAche (tA) druta kAmanA karo nA|
evaM tArA vale, ‘kakhana ei oYAdA (pUrNa have)? yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao|’
hAYa, yArA kuphuri kareche tArA yadi jAnata oi samaYaTira kathA, yakhana tArA tAdera sAmane o pechana theke AsA Aguna pratireAdha karate pArave nA evaM tArA sAhAyyaprAptao have nA|
varaM tA Asave tAdera opara atarkite, ataHpara tAderake tA hatavuddhi kare deve, takhana tArA sakSama have nA tA reAdha karateo evaM tAdera avakAzao deoYA have nA|
tomAra pUrvera rAsUladera sAtheo ThATTA-vidrupa karA haYeche| phale tArA yA niYe ThATTA karata—tA ThATTAkArIdera oparai Apatita haYechila|
valo, ‘rAhamAna theke ke teAmAderake rakSA karave rAte o dine?’ tavuo tArA tAdera ravera upadeza theke mukha phiriYe nicche|
nAki Ami vyatIta tAdera aneka upAsya Ache—yArA tAderake rakSA karave? tArA teA nijederai sAhAyya karate sakSamatA rAkhe nA, Ara nA AmAra viruddhe tArA kono pratirakSA pAve|

varaM Ami tAdera evaM tAdera pUrvapuruSadera bheAga sambhAra diYechilAma, emanaki tAdera AYuSkAlao dIrgha haYechila| tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami tAdera dezake caturdika theke saMkIrNa kare Anachi| tavuo ki tArA vijaYI have?
tumi valo, ‘Ami teA kevala oYAhira mAdhyamei teAmAderake satarka kari;’ kintu vadhiradera yakhana satarka karA haYa, takhana tArA (satarkavANI) zeAne nA|
Ara avazyai yadi tomAra ravera zAstira kichumAtrao tAdera sparza karata tave tArA valata, ‘hAYa, AmAdera durbhAgya, nizcaYai AmarA sImAlaGghanakArI chilAma!’

Ara Ami kiYAmAtera dina mAnadaNDa sthApana karava nyAYavicArera; sutarAM kArao prati kichumAtra avicAra karA have nA| Ara yadi sariSAra dAnA parimANao haYa (neka vA vada Amala), Ami tA upasthita karava evaM hisAva grahaNakArIrUpe Amii yatheSTa|
Ami mUsA o hArUnake dAna karechilAma phurakAna, jyoti o upadeza muttAkidera janya|
yArA nA dekhe tAdera ravake bhaYa kare evaM kiYAmAtera bhaYe zaGkita|
evaM eTA ekaTA varakatamaYa upadeza, yA Ami avatIrNa karechi| tavuo ki teAmarA tA asvIkArakArI?
Ara Ami itaHpUrve ivarAhImake sarala pathera jJAna dAna karechilAma Ara Ami tAra samparke chilAma avagata|
yakhana se tA~ra pitA o tA~ra sampradAYake valechila, ‘ei mUrtiguleA kI, yAdera sAmane tomarA pUjAYa rata?’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA peYechi AmAdera pitRpuruSadera egulora pUjA karA avasthAYa|’
se valala, ‘teAmarA evaM tomAdera pitRpuruSerAo spaSTa bhrAntira madhye Acha|’
tArA valala, ‘tumi ki AmAdera kAche satyasaha Agamana karecha, nA tumi kautukakArIdera antarbhukta?’
se valala, ‘varaM tomAdera rava to AsamAna o yaminera rava, yini tAderake sRSTi karechena| Ara Ami ei viSaYera sAkSyadAtA|’
‘AllAhara kasama! yakhana teAmarA cale yAve takhana avazyai Ami teAmAdera mUrtiguleAra vyApAre ekaTA kauzala avalamvana karava|’
ataHpara se seguleAke cUrNavicUrNa kare dila; tave pradhAnaTi vyatIta, yAte tArA seTira kAche phire Ase|
tArA valala, ‘AmAdera upAsyadera sAthe ei kAja ke karala? nizcaYai se sImAlaGghanakArIdera antarbhukta|’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA zunechi eka yuvakera kathA, se tAdera samparke samAleAcanA kare; tAke DAkA haYa ivarAhIma (nAme)|’
tArA valala, ‘tAke upasthita karo mAnuSera sAmane, yena tArA sAkSya dite pAre|’
tArA valala, ‘he ivarAhIma, tumii ki AmAdera upAsyadera sAthe eTA karecha?’
se valala, ‘varaM tAdera pradhAnaTAi to eTA kareche, tomarA tAderake jijJAsA karo, yadi tArA kathA valate pAre|’
takhana tArA phire ela nijedera manera kAche| evaM (eke aparake) valate lAgala; ‘teAmarAi to satyii sImAlaGghanakArI|’
ataHpara tArA avanata haYe gela tAdera mAthAra (pUrva jAhiliYAtera) prati; evaM valala, ‘avazyai tumi to jAno, tArA kathA valate pAre nA|’
se valala, ‘teAmarA ki AllAhara parivarte emana kichura ivAdAta karo—yA teAmAdera keAno upakArao karate pAre nA evaM kSatio karate pAre nA?’
‘dhika teAmAdera janya evaM teAmarA AllAha vyatIta yegulora ivAdAta karo, odera janya| teAmarA ki vujhave nA?’
tArA valala, ‘tomarA tAke pur3iYe dAo evaM teAmAdera upAsyadera sAhAyya karo, yadi teAmarA haYe thAko kichu karaneoYAlA|’
Ami valalAma, ‘he Aguna, tumi ivarAhImera opara zItala o zAntimaYa haYe yAo|’
tArA ivarAhImera viruddhe karate cAila eka cakrAnta, kintu Ami tAderakei kare dilAma sarvAdhika kSatigrasta|
Ami tAke o lUtake uddhAra kare sei deze pau~che dilAma, yAra madhye Ami vizvavAsIra janya kalyANa rekhechi|
Ami tAke dAna karalAma isahAka o puraskArasvarUpa dilAma iYAkUvake evaM pratyekake vAniYechi satkarmaparAYaNa|

Ami tAderake vAnAlAma imAma| tArA AmAra nirdeza anusAre pathapradarzana karata| Ami tAdera prati oYAhi nAyila karalAma satkarma karAra, sAlAta kAYema karAra evaM yAkAta dAna karAra| tArA chila AmAra ivAdAtakArI|
evaM Ami lUtake diYechilAma prajJA o jJAna evaM tAke oi janapada theke uddhAra karechilAma, yArA manda kAja karata| nizcaYai tArA chila manda o pApiSTha sampradAYa|
Ami tAke AmAra rAhamAtera madhye praveza karAlAma| nizcaYai se satkarmazIladera antarbhukta|
evaM nUhakeo; yakhana se era pUrve Akuti jAniYechila| takhana Ami tAra DAke sAr3A diYechi, ataHpara tAke o tAra parivAravargake mahA saMkaTa theke uddhAra karechilAma|

evaM Ami tAke oi sampradAYera vipakSe sAhAyya karechilAma, yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalike mithyApratipanna karechila| nizcaYai, tArA chila eka manda sampradAYa| ataHpara Ami tAdera savAike nimajjita karechilAma|
evaM dAUda o sulAimAnakeo; yakhana tArA zasyakSetra samparke vicAra karechila| tAte rAtrikAle kichu leAkera meSa Dhuke par3echila| tAdera vicArera samaYa Ami chilAma paryavekSaka|

Ami sulAimAnake tA vujhiYe diYechi; Ara Ami ubhaYake prajJA o jJAna diYechilAma| Ami pAhAr3a o pAkhiderake dAUdera anugata kare diYechilAma; tArA AmAra pavitratA o mahimA gheASaNA karata| Ara Amii tAra karma sampAdanakArI|
Ami tAke teAmAdera janya varma nirmANa zikSA diYechilAma, yAte tA yuddhe teAmAderake rakSA kare| tavuo ki teAmarA kRtajJa have nA?
Ara sulAimAnera janya (adhIna kare diYechilAma) pravala vAYuke; tA tAra Adeze pravAhita hato oi dezera dike, yekhAne Ami kalyANa dAna karechi| Ami sava kichu samparke avagata|
Arao adhIna karechi (tAra janya) kichu zaYatAnake, yArA tAra janya Duvurira kAja karata e chAr3A anya Arao aneka kAja karata| Ara Ami chilAma tAdera opara saMrakSaka|
Ara smaraNa karo AiYUvera kathA, yakhana se tAra ravake Deke valala, ‘dUrArogya vyAdhi AmAke sparza kareche, Ara Apanii sarvazreSTha daYAvAna|’

ataHpara Ami tAra AhvAne sAr3A dilAma, dUra kare dilAma tAra vyAdhi| evaM tAke tAra parivarAvarga phiriYe dilAma, tAdera sAthe Arao tAdera samaparimANa dilAma AmAra pakSa theke anugrahasvarUpa evaM ivAdAtakArIdera janya upadezasvarUpa|
evaM isamAIla, idarIsa o yulakiphalera kathA smaraNa karo, tArA pratyekei chila savarakArI|
Ami tAderake AmAra anugrahe praveza kariYechilAma, tArA chila satkarmaparAYaNa|

Ara mAchaoYAlAra kathA smaraNa karo, yakhana se kruddha haYe cale giYechila, ataHpara se mane karechila ye, Ami kakhano tAke pAkar3Ao karava nA| ataHpara se andhakAre Akuti jAnAla, ‘tumi vyatIta keAno ilAh nei; tumi ati pavitra, Ami anyAYakArIdera antarbhukta|’
ataHpara Ami tAra AhvAne sAr3A dilAma evaM tAke duzcintA theke mukti dilAma| Ami ebhAvei mu’minaderake uddhAra kare thAki|
evaM yAkAriYAra kathA smaraNa karo, yakhana se tAra ravake AhvAna karechila; ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke ekA phele rAkhavena nA| Apani teA sarvottama uttarAdhikArI|’

ataHpara Ami tAra DAke sAr3A dilAma, Ara tAke dAna karalAma iYAhaiYAke evaM tAra janya tAra strIke upayogI vAnAlAma| tArA vibhinna kalyANakara kAje druta AguYAna hato| tArA AzA o bhIti niYe AmAke DAkata evaM tArA chila AmAra prati vinIta|
evaM sei nArIra kathA smaraNa karo, ye tAra satItva rakSA karechila, ataHpara Ami tAra madhye AmAra sRSTa rUha phu~ke diYechilAma evaM tAke o tAra putrake karechilAma vizvavAsIra janya nidarzana|
nizcaYai tomAdera ei jAti ekai jAti, Ami tomAdera rava; ataeva, AmArai ivAdAta karo|
tArA pArasparika viSaYe nijedera mAjhe vibhakti sRSTi kareche| pratyekei AmAra kAche pratyAvartita have|
ataHpara ye mu’mina avasthAYa satkAja kare, tAra praceSTA pratyAkhyAta have nA evaM Ami tA lipivaddha kare rAkhi|
yesava janapadake Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechi, tAra adhivAsIdera phire nA AsA avadhArita|
ye paryanta nA iYAjuja o mAjujake vandhanamukta kare deoYA have evaM tArA pratyeka uccabhUmi theke druta chuTe Asave|

satya pratizruti (kiYAmAta)nikaTavartI hale AkasmAt visphArita have tAdera cakSu ucce sthira haYe yAve; (tArA valave,) ‘hAYa AmAdera durbhAgya, e viSaYe AmarA chilAma gAphalatira madhye; varaM AmarA chilAma sImAlaGghanakArI|’
nizcaYai tomarA evaM AllAhara parivarte teAmarA yAdera pUjA karo, seguleA have jAhAnnAmera indhana| teAmarAi tAte praveza karave|
ei mUrtirA yadi upAsya hato, tave jAhAnnAme praveza karata nA| pratyekei tAte sthAYI|
sekhAne thAkave tAdera ArtanAda; kintu tArA sekhAne kichui zunate pAve nA|
nizcaYai yAdera janya AmAra pakSa theke pUrvei kalyANa nirdhArita haYeche, tadera tA theke dUre rAkhA have|
tArA tAra kSINatama zavdao zunave nA evaM tArA tAdera manera AkAGkhA anuyAYI cirakAla thAkave|
mahA AtaGka tAdera duzcintAYa phelave nA evaM pherezatArA tAdera abhyarthanA karave—Aja teAmAdera sei dina, ye dinera oYAdA teAmAdera deoYA haYechila|

sedina Ami AkAzake guTiYe neva, yebhAve goTAneA haYa likhita kAgajapatra| yebhAve Ami prathamavAra sRSTi karechilAma, sebhAve punarAYa sRSTi karava| oYAdA pAlana AmAra kartavya, Ami tA avazyai pUrNa karava|
Ara avazyai Ami yAvUre likhe diYechi upadezera para ye, pRthivIra adhikArI have AmAra satkarmaparAYaNa vAndAgaNa|
nizcaYai tAte raYeche vANI; ivAdAtakArI sampradAYera janya|
Ami tomAke vizvavAsIra janya rAhamAtasvarUpai preraNa karechi|
valo, ‘AmAke teA e Adezai deoYA haYeche ye, teAmAdera ilAh ekamAtra ilAh| sutarAM teAmarA ki AtmasamarpaNakArI have?’
ataHpara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave vale dAo, ‘Ami teAmAderake yathAyathabhAve jAniYe diYechi evaM Ami jAni nA, teAmAdera ye oYAdA deoYA haYeche, tA nikaTavartI nA dUravartI|’
tini jAnena, ye kathA sazavde valo evaM ye kathA teAmarA geApana karo|
‘Ami jAni nA, sambhavata eTA teAmAdera janya ekaTi parIkSA evaM nirdhArita samaYa paryanta bheAga karAra suyeAga|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, tumi nyAYAnuga phAYasAlA kare dAo| Ara AmAdera rava to daYAmaYa; teAmarA yA valacha, se viSaYe sahAYasthala|’
he leAkasakala, teAmAdera ravake bhaYa karo| nizcaYai kiYAmAtera prakampana mahA bhaYaMkara eka vyApAra|

yedina teAmarA tA pratyakSa karave, sedina pratyeka stanyadAtrI tAkeo bhule yAve yAke se dudha pAna karAYa; evaM pratyeka garbhavatI tAra garbhera santAnake bhUmiSTha kare deve| tumi mAnuSake dekhave mAtAla; athaca tArA mAtAla naYa| kintu AllAhara zAsti atyanta kaThina|
kichu mAnuSa jJAna chAr3A AllAha samparke vitarka kare evaM pratyeka uddhata zaYatAnera anusaraNa kare|
tAra janya ei vidhAna deoYA haYeche ye, ye keu tAra sAthe vandhutva karave nizcaYai se tAke vibhrAnta karave evaM dagdhakArI zAstira dike paricAlita karave|

he leAkasakala, teAmarA yadi punarutthAnera vyApAre sandihAna hao, (tave bheve dekho,) nizcaYai Ami teAmAdera sRSTi karechi mRttikA theke| erapara zukra theke, erapara raktapiNDa theke, erapara pUrNAGga o apUrNAGga AkRtiviziSTa mAMsapiNDa theke, yena Ami teAmAdera kAche varNanA kari| Ara Ami yA icchA eka nirdiSTa kAlera janya mAtRgarbhe sthitizIla kari, erapara Ami teAmAderake zizurUpe vera kari; yena tomarA paravartI samaYe yauvane padArpaNa karate pAro| tomAdera madhye keu mRtyumukhe patita haYa evaM kAuke jarAgrasta vArdhakyera vaYasa paryanta pau~chAno haYa, phale se jAnAra para jJAta viSaYa samparke ajJa haYe yAYa| tumi bhUmike patita dekhate pAo, ataHpara Ami yakhana tAte vAri varSaNa kari, takhana tA sateja o sphIta haYe yAYa evaM sarvaprakAra naYanAbhirAma udbhida utpanna kare|
eTA e kAraNe ye, nizcaYai AllAha tinii prakRta satya, nizcaYai tini mRtake jIvita karena evaM nizcaYai tini sarva viSaYe sarva zaktimAna|
Ara nizcaYai kiYAmAta avazyambhAvI, ete kono sandeha nei| Ara yArA kavare Ache, nizcaYai AllAha tAdera punarutthita karavena|
Ara mAnuSera mAjhe keu keu AllAha samparke vitarka kare jJAna vyatireke; Ara tAdera nA Ache pramANa o nA Ache diptimaYa kitAva|
se vitarka kare ghAr3a vA~kiYe; yAte AllAhara patha theke vibhrAnta kare deYa| tAra janya duniYAte Ache lAJchanA evaM kiYAmAtera dina Ami tAke dahana-yantraNA AsvAdana karAva|
eTA e kAraNe, yA teAmAra dui hAta agre preraNa kareche, tomAra dui hAta; Ara AllAha vAndAdera prati avicArakArI nana|

kichu mAnuSa AllAhara ivAdAta kare prAntika avasthAYa| yadi tAra kalyANa Ase, tave svasti lAbha kare; Ara yadi tAra opara keAno parIkSA Ase, tave tAra (Asala) cehArAYa phire yAYa| se ihakAla o parakAle kSatigrasta halo; eTAi to spaSTa kSati|
se AllAhara parivarte emana kichuke DAke, ye tAra apakArao karate pAre nA evaM upakArao karate pAre nA| eTA carama pathabhraSTatA|
se emana kichuke DAke, yAra apakAra upakArera ceYe adhika nikaTavartI| kata manda ei abhibhAvaka evaM kata manda ei sahacara|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare, AllAha tAdera emana jAnnAte praveza karAvena, yAra taladeza diYe naharasamUha pravAhita haYa| AllAha yA icchA tA-i karena|

ye vyakti dhAraNA kare, AllAha ihakAle o parakAle tAke (rAsUlake) kakhano sAhAyya karavena nA, se ekaTi razi AkAza paryanta jhuliYe nika; erapara keTe dika; ataHpara dekhuka dUra kare ki nA tAra ei kauzala tAra AkreAzake|
ebhAve Ami suspaSTa AYAtarUpe tA (kuraAna) avatIrNa karechi evaM AllAha-i yAke icchA karena hidAYAta karena|
yArA ImAna eneche, Ara yArA iYAhUdi haYeche, Ara sAveYi, khriSTAna, agnipUjaka evaM yArA muzarika, kiYAmAtera dina AllAha avazyai tAdera madhye phAYasAlA kare devena| AllAha savakichu pratyakSakArI|

tumi ki dekhani, AllAhake sijadA kare yA-kichu Ache AsamAnasamUhe, Ara yA-kichu Ache yamine, sUrya, candra, tArakArAji parvatamAlA vRkSalatA, jIvajantu evaM mAnuSera mAjhe aneke| AvAra anekera opara avadhArita haYeche zAsti| AllAha yAke lAJchita karena, tAra sammAnadAtA keu nei| Ara AllAha yA icchA tA-i karena|
ei dui vivadamAna pakSa, tArA tAdera rava samparke vitarka kare| ataeva, yArA kuphuri kareche tAdera janya pozAka tairi karA haYeche Aguna diYe| tAdera mAthAra upara phuTanta pAni Dhele deoYA have|
yA dvArA tAdera peTe yA Ache, tA evaM carma vigalita karA have|
tAdera janya Ache leAhAra hAtur3i|
tArA yakhanai yantraNAYa atiSTha haYe jAhAnnAma theke vera hate cAive, takhanai tAdera tAte phiriYe deoYA have| valA have—‘dahana-yantraNA AsvAdana karo|’

nizcaYai yArA ImAna Ane evaM satkarma kare, AllAha tAdera emana jAnnAte praveza karAvena, yAra taladeza diYe nada-nadI pravAhita| tAdera sekhAne svarNa-kaGkaNa o muktA dvArA alaMkRta karA have evaM sekhAne tAdera peAzAka have rezami|
tArA paricAlita haYechila uttama kathAra dike evaM paricAlita haYechila prazaMsita sattAra pathera dike|

yArA kuphuri kareche o AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi kare evaM mAsajide hArAma theke vAdhA deYa, yAke Ami prastuta karechi sthAnIYa o vahirAgata sakala mAnuSera janya samabhAve evaM ye tAra madhye (mAsajide hArAme) anyAYabhAve pApAcArera icchA kare, Ami tAke yantraNAdAYaka zAsti AsvAdana karAva|

yakhana Ami ivarAhImake se gharera (vAitullAhara) sthAna Thika kare diYechilAma, takhana valechilAma ye—‘AmAra sAthe kono kichuke zarika kareA nA evaM AmAra gharake pavitra rAkho tAoYAphakArIdera janya, sAlAte daNDAYamAnadera janya evaM raku-sijadAkArIdera janya|’
‘evaM mAnuSera madhye hAjjera gheASaNA dAo| tArA teAmAra kAche Asave pAYe he~Te evaM sarvaprakAra kSINakAYa uTera piThe saoYAra haYe dUra-dUrAnta theke|’

yAte tArA pratyakSa kare tAdera kalyANasamUha evaM tini tAdera catuSpada jantu theke ye riyika dAna karechena tAra kAraNe nirdiSTa dinaguleAte AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karate pAre| ataHpara teAmarA tA theke AhAra karo evaM duHstha-abhAvagrasthake AhAra karAo|
erapara tArA yena tAdera aparicchannatA dUra kare, tAdera mAnata pUrNa kare evaM ei prAcIna gharera tAoYApha kare|

eTAi vidhAna; Ara ye keu AllAhara (nirdhArita) sammAnayeAgya jinisagulora prati sammAna pradarzana karala tave tAra ravera nikaTa tAra janya tA-i uttama| teAmAdera janya catuSpada jantu hAlAla karA haYeche eguli vyatIta—yA tomAdera pATha kare zonAno haYeche| sutarAM teAmarA mUrtidera apavitratA theke ve~ce thAko evaM dUre thAko mithyAkathana theke;

AllAhara janya ekaniSTha haYe, tA~ra sAthe zarika sAvyastakArI nA haYe; evaM ye keu AllAhara sAthe zarika karala; se yena AkAza theke chiTake par3ala, ataHpara pAkhi tAke cheA~ mere niYe gela athavA vAtAsa tAke ur3iYe niYe phele deYa keAno dUravartI sthAne|
(eTAi vidhAna), keu AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera prati sammAna pradarzana karale tA tAra hRdaYera tAkaoYArai vahiHprakAza|
ete (catuSpada jantusamUhe) teAmAdera janya nirdiSTakAla paryanta upakAra raYeche| ataHpara egulora jAYagA halo prAcIna gharera dike|

Ami pratyeka ummAtera janya dharmIYa anuSThAnAdi nirdhAraNa karechi, yAte tini tAdera catuSpada jantu theke ye riyika dAna karechena, tAra opara AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karate pAre| ataeva, teAmAdera ilAha teA ekamAtra ilAha; sutarAM tA~rai prati samarpita thAko evaM vinaYIgaNake susaMvAda dAo;
yakhana AllAhara smaraNa karA haYa takhana yAdera antara prakampita haYa| Ara yArA tAdera vipadApade dhairyadhAraNa kare evaM yArA sAlAta kAYema kare o tAdera Ami yA diYechi, tA theke vyaYa kare|

evaM uTake karechi teAmAdera janya AllAhara nidarzanAvalira anyatama| ete raYeche teAmAdera janya maGgala| sutarAM sArivaddhabhAve vA~dhA avasthAYa tAdera javei karAra samaYa teAmarA AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karo| ataHpara yakhana tArA kAta haYe par3e takhana tA theke teAmarA AhAra karo evaM AhAra karAo alpetuSTa abhAvagrasta o yAJcAkArI abhAvagrasta vyaktike| ebhAve Ami eguleAke teAmAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechi, yAte teAmarA kRtajJatA prakAza karo|

kakhanoi AllAhara kAche pau~che nA eguleAra geAzata o rakta kintu pau~che tA~ra kAche teAmAdera tAkaoYA| emanibhAve tini eguleAke teAmAdera vaza kare diYechena, yAte teAmarA AllAhara zreSThatva gheASaNA karo e kAraNe ye, tini teAmAderake hidAYAta dAna karechena| sutarAM satkarmazIladera susaMvAda zuniYe dena|
nizcaYai AllAha pratirakSA karena tAdera theke—yArA ImAna eneche| AllAha keAno vizvAsaghAtaka akRtajJake pachanda karena nA|
(yuddhe) anumati deoYA halo tAdera, yArA yuddhera zikAra hacche; kAraNa, tAdera prati avicAra karA haYeche| Ara AllAha avazyai tAdera sAhAyya karate sakSama|

yAderake tAdera ghara-vAr3i theke anyAYabhAve vahiSkAra karA haYeche zudhu ei aparAdhe, tArA vale—‘AmAdera rava AllAha|’ AllAha yadi mAnavajAtira ekadalake apara dala dvArA pratihata nA karatena, tave sanyAsIdera Azramagulo, girjAgulo, iYAhUdidera upAsanAlaYa evaM mAsajidasamUha vidhvasta haYe yeta, yAte AllAhara nAma adhika smaraNa karA haYa| AllAha nizcaYai tAderake sAhAyya karavena, yArA AllAhara sAhAyya kare| nizcaYai AllAha atIva zaktidhara parAkramazAlI|
tArA emana leAka—yAdera Ami yadi pRthivIte pratiSThita kari tArA sAlAta kAYema karave, yAkAta pradAna karave evaM satkAjera Adeza o asatkAje niSedha karave| sakala kAjera pariNAma AllAharai adhikAre|
tArA yadi tomAke asvIkAra kare tave tAdera pUrveo asvIkAra kareche nUha, Ada, sAmUda sampradAYa|
ivarAhIma o lUtera sampradAYao|
evaM mAdaiYAnera adhivAsIrA evaM asvIkAra karA haYechila mUsAkeo| ataHpara Ami kAphiradera suyeAga diYechilAma erapara tAdera pAkar3Ao karechilAma| ataeva, kemana chila AmAra zAsti|
Ami kata janapada dhvaMsa karechi; kAraNa tArA chila sImAlaGghanakArI; ei sava janapada tAdera chAdasaha dhvaMsastUpe pariNata haYeche evaM kata kUpa parityakta haYeche Ara kata sudRr3ha prAsAdao|

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kareni? tAhale tAdera antara hato emana ye tA diYe tArA upalavdhi karata, athavA tAdera kAna hato emana yA diYe tArA zunata! vastuta, cakSu teA andha naYa; varaM vakSasthita antarai andha|
Ara tArA tomAke druta zAsti niYe Asate vale| athaca AllAha kakhano tA~ra oYAdA bhaGga karena nA| nizcaYai tomAra ravera nikaTa ekadina teAmAdera gaNanAra hAjAra vacharera mato|
evaM Ami kata janapadake avakAza diYechi ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA chila sImAlaGghanakArI| erapara tAdera pAkar3Ao karechi evaM pratyAvartana AmArai nikaTa
valo, ‘he leAkasakala, Ami teA teAmAdera janya suspaSTa satarkakArI|’
sutarAM yArA ImAna Ane evaM satkAja kare, tAdera janya kSamA o sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vyartha karAra ceSTA kare, tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

Ami tomAra pUrve ye samasta rAsUla o navi preraNa karechi, tArA yakhanai kichu AkAGkSA kareche, takhanai zaYatAna tAdera AkAGkSAYa kichu mizraNa kare diYeche| ataHpara AllAha dUra kare dena zaYatAna yA mizraNa kare| erapara AllAha tA~ra AYAtasamUha supratiSThita karena evaM AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

eTA e kAraNe ye, zaYatAna yA mizraNa kare, tini tA parIkSAsvarUpa kare dena tAdera janya, yAdera antara vyAdhigrasta evaM yArA pASANa hRdaYa; Ara nizcaYai sImAlaGghanakArIrA cUr3Anta bhraSTatAYa lipta|

Ara e kAraNeo ye, yAderake jJAna dAna karA haYeche; tArA yena jAne ye eTA pakSa theke satya tomAra ravera; ataHpara tArA yena tAte ImAna Ane evaM tAdera antara yena tAra prati anugata haYa| Ara nizcaYai AllAhai sarala pathapradarzana karena tAdera, yArA ImAna Ane|
kAphirarA sarvadAi thAkave sandehera madhye, yatakSaNa nA tAdera kAche AkasmikabhAve kiYAmAta ese par3ave; athavA ese par3e tAdera kAche vandhyA dinera zAsti|
sedina AllAharai Adhipatya; tinii tAdera vicAra karavena| ataeva, yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM satkAja kare tArA thAkave niYAmAtapUrNa jAnnAte|
evaM yArA kuphuri kare evaM AmAra AYAtasamUha mithyA pratipanna kare, tAdera janya raYeche lAJchanAkara zAsti|
yArA AllAhara pathe hijarAta kareche, erapara tAderake hatyA karA haYeche athavA mArA geche; AllAha tAderake avazyai utkRSTa jIvikA dAna karavena evaM AllAhai sarvottama riyikadAtA|
tAdera avazyai emana eka sthAne praveza karAvena, yA tArA pachanda karave evaM AllAha sarvajJa, sahanazIla|
eTAi niYama, ye vyakti nipIr3ita haYe nipIr3ana parimANe pratizeAdha grahaNa kare evaM vAr3AvAr3i karA haYa tAra opara, AllAha avazyai tAke sAhAyya karavena| nizcaYai AllAha mArjanAkArI kSamAzIla|
eTA e janya ye, nizcaYai AllAha rAtake dinera madhye evaM dinake rAtera madhya praviSTa karAna Ara AllAha sarvazrotA o sarvadraSTA|
eTA e kAraNeo ye, AllAhai satya; Ara tA~ra parivarte tArA yAke DAke, tA mithyA Ara AllAha; tinii to samunnata, sumahAna|
tumi ki dekheAni, nizcaYai AllAha AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karena, ataHpara yamina savuja-zyAmala haYe oThe| nizcaYai AllAha sUkSmadarzI, samyaka jJAta|
AsamAna o yamine yA-kichu Ache, sava tA~rai evaM AllAha abhAvamukta prazaMsita|

tumi ki dekheAni, nizcaYai AllAha bhUpRSThera savakichuke tomAdera adhIna kare diYechena, Ara samudre nauyAnasamUha calamAna tAra nirdeze| tini AkAzake sthira rAkhena, yena tA~ra Adeza vyatIta bhUpRSThera upara nA par3e yAYa| nizcaYai AllAha mAnuSera prati karuNAmaYa, asIma daYAlu|
tinii teAmAdera jIvita karechena, ataHpara tinii teAmAdera mRtyu dAna karavena o punarAYa jIvita karavena| nizcaYai mAnuSa var3ai akRtajJa|

Ami pratyeka ummAtera janya ivAdAtera paddhati nirdhAraNa kare diYechi, yA tArA pAlana kare| ataeva, tArA yena e vyApAre tomAra sAthe vitarka nA kare| tumi tAdera ravera dike AhvAna karo| nizcaYai tumi sarala pathei Acha|
tArA yadi tomAra sAthe vitarka kare, tave valo, ‘teAmarA yA karo, se sarmpake AllAha samyaka jJAta|’
teAmarA ye viSaYe matavireAdha karacha, AllAha kiYAmAtera dina sei viSaYe teAmAdera madhye phAYasAlA karavena|
tumi ki jAno nA ye, AsamAna o yaminera savakichu AllAha jAnena| esava lipivaddha Ache eka kitAve| nizcaYai eTA AllAhara nikaTa sahaja|
tArA AllAhara parivarte emana kichura upAsanA kare, yAra keAno pramANa tini avatIrNa karenani evaM se samparke tAdera keAno jJAna nei| Ara sImAlaGghanakArIdera keAno sAhAyyakArI nei|

yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karA haYa, takhana tumi kAphiradera cehArAYa asanteASa pratyakSa karave| yArA tAdera kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha kare, tArA tAdera prati AkramaNa karAra upakrama haYe oThe| valo, ‘tave ki Ami teAmAderake tAra ceYeo manda kichura saMvAda deva? Aguna; AllAha kAphiradera era pratizruti diYechena| eTA katai nA nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala|’

he leAkasakala, ekaTi upamA varNanA karA haleA; ataeva, teAmarA tA maneAyeAga diYe zeAno; nizcaYai teAmarA yAderake DAko parivarte AllAhara, tArA kakhano ekaTi mAchio sRSTi karate pArave nA, yadio tArA sakale ekatra haYa| Ara mAchi yadi tAdera kAcha theke keAno kichu chiniYe neYa, tave tArA tAra kAcha theke tA uddhAra karate pArave nA, katai nA durvala ei upAsaka o upAsya|
tArA AllAhara yathAyeAgya maryAdA upalavdhi kareni| nizcaYai AllAha zaktidhara, mahAparAkramazIla|
AllAha pherezatA o mAnuSera madhya theke vArtAvAhaka maneAnIta karena| AllAha sarvazreAtA, sarvadraSTA!
tini jAnena—yA tAdera sAmane Ache evaM yA pazcAte Ache evaM savakichu AllAhara dike pratyAvartita|
he mu’minagaNa, teAmarA ruku karo, sijadA karo, teAmAdera ravera ivAdAta karo evaM satkAja karo, yAte teAmarA saphalakAma hate pAra|

tomarA AllAhara janya jihAda karo yathAyathabhAve| tini teAmAderake nirvAcana karechena evaM dharmera vyApAre teAmAdera opara keAno saMkIrNatA Aropa karenani| eTA tomAdera pitA ivarAhImera dharma| tinii teAmAdera nAma musalima rekhechena; pUrveo evaM ei kuraAneo, yAte rAsUla teAmAdera janya sAkSI haYa evaM teAmarA sAkSI hao mAnavamaNDalIra janya| sutarAM teAmarA sAlAta kAYema karo, yAkAta pradAna karo evaM AllAhake zaktabhAve dhAraNa karo| tinii teAmAdera abhibhAvaka| ataeva, tini katai nA uttama abhibhAvaka evaM katai nA uttama sAhAyyakArI|
avazyai saphalakAma haYeche mu’minarA,
yArA nijedera sAlAtera madhye vinaYI;
yArA anarthaka kathA-vArtA theke vimukha,
yArA yAkAta pradAne sakriYa|
evaM yArA nijedera yaunAGga hiphAjatakArI|
tave tAdera strI athavA yA tAdera DAna hAta yAra mAlika haYeche (dAsI) vyatIta; ete tArA tiraskRta have nA|
ataHpara yArA era vAire kAmanA karave tArAi sImAlaGghanakArI|
evaM yArA nijedera AmAnata o aGgIkArera vyApAre vizvasta |
evaM yArA tAdera sAlAtera hiphAjata kare|
tArAi uttarAdhikArI|
tArA (jAnnAtula) phiradAusera uttarAdhikAra lAbha karave, tArA sekhAne cirakAla thAkave|
Ami mAnuSake mATira niryAsa theke sRSTi karechi|
ataHpara Ami tAke zukrANurUpe eka saMrakSita sthAne sthApana karechi|

erapara Ami zukravinduke jamATa raktarUpe sRSTi karechi, ataHpara jamATa raktake mAMsapiNDe pariNata karechi, erapara sei mAMsapiNDa theke asthi sRSTi karechi, ataHpara asthike mAMsa dvArA AvRta karechi, avazeSe tAke dA~r3a kariYechi apara sRSTite| nipuNatama sRSTikartA AllAha katai nA kalyANamaYa|
erapara teAmarA avazyai mRtyuvaraNa karave|
ataHpara kiYAmAtera dina tomarA punarutthita have|
Ami teAmAdera opara saptapatha sRSTi karechi evaM Ami sRSTi samvandhe udAsIna nai|
Ami AkAza theke parimita vRSTi varSaNa kari; ataHpara Ami tA yamine saMrakSaNa kari evaM Ami tA apasAraNao karate sakSama|
ataHpara Ami tA dvArA teAmAdera janya khejura o AGurera vAgAna sRSTi karechi| teAmAdera janya ete pracura phala Ache evaM teAmarA tA theke AhAra kare thAko|
evaM (oi vRkSa sRSTi karechi), yA sinAi parvate utpanna haYa evaM AhArakArIdera janya taila o vyaJjana utpanna kare|

catuSpada jantusamUhera madhye teAmAdera janya eka zikSA raYeche| Ami teAmAderake tAdera udarasthita vastu theke pAna karAi evaM teAmAdera janya tAdera madhye pracura upakAritA raYeche| teAmarA tAdera katakake bhakSaNa karo|
tAdera upara o nauyAne teAmarA AreAhaNa kare thAko|
Ami nUhake tAra sampradAYera nikaTa preraNa karechi| se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo| tini vyatIta teAmAdera keAno ilAha nei| teAmarA ki bhaYa karo nA|’

takhana tAra sampradAYera netArA, yArA kuphuri kareche tArA valala, ‘e teA teAmAderai mato ekajana mAnuSa vai kichu naYa| se teAmAdera opara zreSThatva arjana karate cAYa| AllAha icchA karale pherezatAi pAThAtena| Ara AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera itihAse erUpa kathA zunini|’
‘se to eka pAgala chAr3A Ara kichu naYa| sutarAM kichukAla tAra vyApAre apekSA karo|’
nUha valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke se viSaYe sAhAyya karo yA niYe tArA AmAke mithyA sAvyasta kareche|’

ataHpara Ami tAra kAche Adeza preraNa karalAma, ‘tumi AmAra tattvAvadhAne evaM AmAra nirdeze naukA tairi karo| erapara yakhana AmAra Adeza Asave evaM culA plAvita have, takhana naukAYa tule neve pratyeka jeAr3A theke duTo kare evaM teAmAra parivAravargake| tave yAdera viruddhe pUrve siddhAnta neoYA haYeche tArA vyatIta| Ara yArA sImAlaGghana kareche tAdera samparke AmAke kichu valeA nA| nizcaYai tArA nimajjita|’
“‘yakhana tumi o teAmAra saGgIrA AreAhaNa karave naukAYa, takhana valave, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAhara—yini AmAdera sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYera kavala theke uddhAra karechena|’”
Arao valo, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke kalyANamaYa kare avatAraNa karAo| Ara tumii zreSTha avatAraNakArI|’
ete nidarzanAvali raYeche evaM Ami tAdera parIkSAkArI|
ataHpara tAdera para Ami anya eka sampradAYa sRSTi karechilAma|

evaM tAderai ekajanake tAdera madhye rAsUlarUpe preraNa karechilAma ei vale ye, ‘teAmarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo| tini vyatIta teAmAdera anya keAno ilAh nei| tavuo ki teAmarA tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA?’

tAra sampradAYera netArA, yArA kuphuri kareche evaM mithyA sAvyasta kareche AkhirAtera sAkSAt evaM yAdera Ami pArthivajIvane sukha-svAcchandya diYechilAma, tArA valala, ‘e teA AmAdera mato ekajana mAnuSa vai kichu naYa| teAmarA yA AhAra karo, seo tAi AhAra kare evaM teAmarA yA pAna karo, seo tA-i pAna kare|’
‘Ara yadi teAmarA teAmAdera matoi ekajana mAnuSera Anugatya karo, tave teAmarA nizcita kSatigrasta have|’
‘se ki teAmAderake ei oYAdA deYa ye, teAmarA mArA gele evaM mATi o hADDite pariNata hale teAmAderake punarujjIvita karA have?’
‘dUra, vahu dUre se viSaYa yA niYe teAmAdera oYAdA deoYA hacche|’
‘AmAdera pArthiva jIvanai ekamAtra jIvana| AmarA mari o vA~ci (ekhAnei) evaM AmarA punarutthita hava nA|’
‘se teA kevala ekajana mAnuSa, ye AllAha samvandhe mithyA racanA kareche evaM AmarA tAra opara ImAna AnaYanakArI nai|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke sAhAyya karuna; kAraNa, tArA AmAke mithyA sAvyasta kareche|’
AllAha valalena, ‘acirei tArA anutapta have|’
ataHpara satya satyai eka vikaTa zavda tAderake hatacakita karala evaM Ami tAderake AvarjanAsadRza kare dilAma| dhvaMsa heAka sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYa|
erapara tAdera pare Ami anyAnya vahu sampradAYa sRSTi karechi|
keAno sampradAYa tAra nirdiSTa samaYake egiYe Anate pAre nA evaM vilamvitao karate pAre nA|

erapara Ami ekera para eka AmAra rAsUladerake preraNa karechi| yakhanai keAno ummAtera kAche tAra rAsUla Agamana kareche, takhanai tArA tAke mithyApratipanna kareche| ataHpara Ami tAdera katakera para kataka dhvaMsa karechi evaM tAderake kAhinira viSaYe pariNata karechi| sutarAM dhvaMsa heAka emana jAti—yArA ImAna Ane nA|
ataHpara Ami mUsA o hArUnake preraNa karechi AmAra nidarzanAvali o suspaSTa pramANasaha|
phiraAunera o tAra rAjanyavargera nikaTa; kintu tArA ahaMkAra karala evaM tArA chila uddhata sampradAYa|
tArA valala, ‘AmarA ki AmAdera matoi dui vyaktite vizvAsa sthApana karava? athaca tAdera sampradAYa AmAdera dAsa|’
ataHpara tArA ubhaYake mithyAsAvyasta karala, phale tArA dhvaMsaprAptadera antarbhukta halo|
Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma; yAte tArA satpatha pAYa|
evaM Ami mAraiYAma-tanaYa o tAra mAtAke vAniYechi nidarzana evaM tAderake eka avasthAnayeAgya svaccha pAni viziSTa ucca bhUmite AzraYa diYechilAma|
he rAsUlagaNa, pavitra vastu theke AhAra karo evaM satkAja karo| tomarA yA karo—se viSaYe Ami parijJAta|
nizcaYai tomAdera ei jAti to ekai jAti, Ara Amii tomAdera rava, sutarAM AmAke bhaYa karo|
tArapara lokerA tAdera mAjhe nijedera dIna vahubhAge vibhakta kareche| pratyeka dalai tAdera kAche yA Ache, tA niYe santuSTa|
ataeva, tAderake nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta bhrAntite cher3e dAo|
tArA ki mane kare ye, Ami tAderake sAhAyya kari dhana-sampada o santAna-santati dvArA?
tAte kare tAdera druta maGgalera dike niYe yAcchi? varaM tArA veAjhe nA|
nizcaYai yArA tAdera ravera bhaYe santrasta,
yArA tAdera ravera nidarzanAvalite ImAna Ane|
yArA tAdera ravera sAthe kAuke zarika nA kare|
evaM yArA tAdera yA dAna karavAra, tA dAna kare ematAvasthAYa tAdera hRdaYa bhIta-kampita e janya ye, tArA tAdera ravera kAche pratyAvartana karave|
tArAi kalyANa arjane druta dhAvita haYa evaM tArA tAte agragAmI|
Ami kAuke tAra sAdhyAtIta dAYitva arpaNa kari nA| AmAra nikaTa Ache eka kitAva, yA satya vyakta kare evaM tAdera prati avicAra karA have nA|
varaM tAdera antarasamUha e viSaYe bhrAntite Acchanna, e chAr3A tAdera Arao kAja raYeche, yA tArA kare thAke|
Ara Ami yakhana tAdera aizvaryazAlI leAkaderake zAsti dvArA pAkar3Ao karava, takhanai tArA ArtanAda kare uThave|
Aja ArtanAda kareA nA| nizcaYai teAmAderake AmAra pakSa theke sAhAyya karA have nA|
AmAra AYAtasamUha tomAdera nikaTa tilAoYAta karA hato, takhana teAmarA pechana phire sare par3ate|
ahaMkAra vaze e viSaYe arthahIna galpa-gujava karate karate|
tave ki, tArA ei kAlAma samparke cintA-bhAvanA karave nA? nAki tAdera kAche emana kichu eseche yA Aseni tAdera pitRpuruSadera kAche?
nAki tArA tAdera rAsUlake cene nA, phale tArA tAke asvIkAra kare?
nAki tArA vale ye, ‘tAra sAthe jina raYeche?’ vastuta se tAdera kAche satya niYe eseche evaM tAdera adhikAMzai satyake apachanda kareche|
satya yadi tAdera pravRttira anugAmI hato, tave AsamAna-yamina o era madhyakAra savakichu dhvaMsa haYe yeta; varaM Ami tAderake dAna karechi upadeza, kintu tArA upadeza theke vimukha|
nAki tumi tAdera kAche keAno pratidAna cAo? tomAra ravera pratidAnai uttama evaM tinii uttama riyikadAtA|
nizcaYai tumi tAderake sarala pathe AhvAna karacha;
Ara yArA parakAle ImAna Ane nA, tArA to sarala patha theke avazyai vicyuta|
yadi Ami tAdera prati daYA kari evaM tAdera kaSTa dUra kare dii, tavuo tArA tAdera avAdhyatAYa dizehArA haYe ghurate thAkave|
Ara avazyai Ami tAderake zAsti dvArA pAkar3Ao karechi, kintu tArA tAdera ravera sAmane nata haYani evaM kAkuti-minatio kareni|
avazeSe yakhana Ami tAdera janya kaThina zAstira dvAra khule deva, takhana tAte tArA hatAza haYe yAYa|
tinii teAmAdera janya kAna, ceAkha o antaHkaraNa sRSTi karechena; teAmarA ati alpai kRtajJatA svIkAra kare thAko|
tinii teAmAderake pRthivIte vistRta karechena evaM tA~rai nikaTa teAmAdera samaveta karA have|
Ara tinii prANa dAna karena evaM mRtyu ghaTAna evaM dina-rAtera vivartana tA~rai kAja, tavuo ki teAmarA vujhave nA?
varaM tArA vale yemana valechila pUrvavartIrA|
tArA vale, ‘yakhana AmarA mare yAva evaM mRttikA o asthite pariNata hava, takhano ki AmarA punarutthita hava?’
‘AmarA era pratizruti peYechi, itaHpUrve AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderakeo era pratizruti deoYA haYechila| esava to AgerakAra lokadera rUpakathA chAr3A kichui naYa|’
jijJAsA karo, ei pRthivI evaM pRthivIte yArA Ache, tArA kAra? yadi teAmarA jAno|
satvara tArA valave—‘AllAhara’| valo, ‘tavuo ki teAmarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?’
jijJAsA karo, ‘ke saptAkAzera rava o mahA Arazera mAlika ke?’
tArA valave—‘AllAha’| valo, ‘tavuo ki teAmarA tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA?’
jijJAsA karo, ‘kAra hAte kartRtva sava kichura? Ara tini AzraYa dena; athaca tAra mokAvelAYa kono AzraYadAtA nei, yadi tomarA jAnate|’
satvarai tArA valave, ‘AllAha’| valo, ‘tavuo teAmAderake kothA theke vibhrAnta karA hacche?’
varaM Ami tAdera kAche esechi satya niYe, Ara nizcaYai tArA mithyAvAdI|

AllAha keAno santAna grahaNa karenani evaM tA~ra sAthe keAno ilAh nei| yadi thAkata, tave avazyai pratyeka ilAh nija nija sRSTi niYe pRthaka haYe cale yeta evaM tAdera kataka katakera opara pravala haYe yeta| tArA yA Aropa kare, tA theke AllAha pavitra|
tini dRzya o adRzyera jJAnI| tArA yA ziraka kare tA theke tini Urdhve|
valo, ‘he AmAra rava, ye viSaYe tAderake oYAdA deoYA haYeche tA yadi AmAke dekhAna;’
‘he AmAra rava, tave Apani AmAke aparAdhI sampradAYera antarbhukta karavena nA|’
Ami tAderake ye viSaYera oYAdA diYechi, tA tomAke dekhAte avazyai sakSama|
mandake pratirodha karo tAra dvArA, yA uttama| tArA yA vale Ami se viSaYe savizeSa avagata|
valo, ‘he AmAra rava, ApanAra AzraYa prArthanA kari Ami zaYatAnera prareAcanA theke;’
‘he AmAra rava, AzraYa prArthanA kari ApanAra AmAra kAche tArA upasthita have|’
yakhana tAdera kArao kAche mRtyu upasthita haYa, takhana se vale, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke punarAYa duniYAte preraNa karo|’
‘yAte Ami satkarma karate pAri, sesava viSaYa yA Ami karini|’ kakhano naYa, e teA tAra ekaTA kathA mAtra, se tAra pravaktA| tAdera sAmane raYeche vArayAkha—punarutthAna divasa paryanta|
ataHpara yakhana ziGgAYa phutkAra deoYA have, sedina tAdera pArasparika AtmIYatAra vandhana thAkave nA evaM eke anyera samparke kichu jAnateo cAive nA|
anantara yAra pAllA bhArI have, tArAi have saphalakAma|
evaM yAdera pAllA hAlakA have, tArAi nijedera kSatisAdhana kareche, tArA jAhAnnAme sthAYI|
Aguna tAdera mukhamaNDala dagdha karave evaM tArA tAte vIbhatsa AkAra dhAraNa karave|
teAmAdera sAmane ki AmAra AYAtasamUha paThita hato nA? teAmarA teA seguleAke mithyA sAvyasta karate|
tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA durbhAgyera hAte parAbhUta chilAma evaM AmarA chilAma vibhrAnta jAti|’
‘he AmAdera rava, e theke AmAderake vera kare nAo; AmarA yadi punarAYa tA kari, tave to AmarA avazyai sImAlaGghanakArI|’
AllAha valavena, ‘teAmarA dhikRta avasthAYa sekhAnei par3e thAko evaM AmAra sAthe keAno kathA valeA nA|’
nizcaYai chila AmAra vAndAdera ekadala valata—‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA ImAna enechi| ataeva, tumi AmAderake kSamA karo o AmAdera prati rahama karo| tumii teA zreSTha daYAlu|’
ataHpara tomarA tAderake ThATTAra pAtrarUpe grahaNa karate| emanaki tA teAmAderake AmAra smaraNa bhuliYe diYechila evaM teAmarA tAdera sAthe parihAsa karate|
nizcaYai Aja Ami tAderake tAdera savarera kAraNe emana pratidAna diYechi| nizcaYai tArAi saphalakAma|
AllAha valavena, ‘tomarA pRthivIte katadina avasthAna karechile vacharera gaNanAYa?’
tArA valave, ‘AmarA ekadina athavA dinera kichu aMza avasthAna karechi| ataeva, Apani gaNanAkArIderake jijJesa karuna|’
AllAha valavena, ‘teAmarA tAte sAmAnya kadinai avasthAna karecha, yadi teAmarA jAnate?’
‘teAmarA ki bhevecha ye, Ami teAmAderake anarthaka sRSTi karechi evaM tomAderake AmAra kAche phiriYe AnA have nA?’
ataeva, mahimAnvita AllAha, yini prakRta mAlika, tini vyatIta (satya) keAno ilAh nei| tinii sammAnita Arazera adhipati|
ye keu AllAhara sAthe anya ilAhake DAke, tAra kAche se vyApAre kono pramANa nei, tAra hisAva kevala tAra ravera kAche| nizcaYai kAphirarA saphalakAma have nA|
Ara valo, ‘he AmAra rava, kSamA karuna o rahama karuna| Ara Apani zreSTha daYAlu|’
eTA ekaTA sUrA; yA Ami avatIrNa karechi evaM era vidhAnake aparihArya karechi| ete Ami suspaSTa AYAtasamUha avatIrNa karechi, yAte teAmarA upadeza grahaNa karo|

vyabhicAriNI o vyabhicArI; tAdera pratyekake ekaza kare vetrAghAta karo| AllAhara vidhAna vAstavAYane tAdera prati yena teAmAderake daYA peYe nA vase, yadi teAmarA AllAha o parakAlera prati ImAna ene thAko| Ara mu’minadera ekaTi dala yena tAdera dujanera zAsti pratyakSa kare|
vyabhicArI kevala vyabhicAriNI athavA muzarikA nArIkei viYe kare evaM vyabhicAriNIke kevala vyabhicArI athavA muzarika puruSai viYe kare evaM ederake mu’minadera janya hArAma karA haYeche|
yArA satI-sAdhvI nArIra prati apavAda AreApa kare ataHpara cArajana sAkSI upasthita nA kare, tAderake AziTi vetrAghAta karave evaM kakhano tAdera sAkSya kavula karave nA evaM tArAi phAsika|
kintu yArA erapara tAovA kare evaM saMzeAdhita haYa, tave nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

Ara yArA tAdera strIdera prati (vyabhicArera) apavAda AreApa kare evaM tArA nijerA chAr3A tAdera keAno sAkSIrA nA thAke, takhana tAdera pratyekera sAkSya ebhAve have ye, se AllAhara nAme zapatha kare cAravAra sAkSya deve ye, se avazyai satyavAdI|
evaM paJcamavAra valave ye, yadi se mithyAvAdI haYa tave nizcaYai tAra opara AllAhara abhizApa|
Ara strIra zAsti rahita haYe yAve yadi se AllAhara nAme zapatha kare cAravAra sAkSya deYa ye, nizcaYai se (tAra svAmI) avazyai mithyAvAdI;
Ara paJcamavAre vale ye, yadi tAra svAmI satyavAdI haYa tave tAra opara AllAhara gayava neme Asuka|
Ara teAmAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA hato (tave keu-i avyAhati pete nA;) Ara nizcaYai AllAha tAovA kavulakArI, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYai yArA mithyA apavAda raTanA kareche, tArA teAmAdera ekaTi kSudra dala| teAmarA eke nijedera janya khArApa mane kareA nA; varaM eTA teAmAdera janya maGgalajanaka| tAdera pratyekera janya tataTuku Ache yataTuku se gunAha kareche evaM tAdera madhye ye e vyApAre agraNI bhUmikA niYeche, tAra janya raYeche bhaYAvaha eka zAsti|
kena nA tArA ekathA zunala, takhana ImAnadAra puruSa o nArIgaNa kena nijedera leAka samparke uttama dhAraNA karala nA evaM valala nA ye, eTA teA suspaSTa apavAda|
tArA kena e vyApAre cArajana sAkSI upasthita kareni; ataHpara yehetu tArA sAkSI upasthita kareni, sehetu tArAi AllAhara kAche mithyAvAdI|
yadi ihakAle o parakAle teAmAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkata, tave teAmarA yA carcA karachile, sejanya teAmAdera gurutara zAsti sparza karata|
yakhana teAmarA mukhe mukhe tA char3Acchile evaM mukhe emana viSaYa uccAraNa karachile, yAra keAno jJAna teAmAdera nei| teAmarA eke tuccha mane karachile, athaca eTA AllAhara kAche gurutara viSaYa|
teAmarA yakhana e kathA zunale takhana kena valale nA ye, ‘AmAdera janya ucita have nA ye e viSaYe AmarA kathA valava| Apani pavitra, mahAna| eTA teA eka gurutara apavAda!’
AllAha teAmAdera upadeza dicchena, ‘teAmarA yadi mu’mina hao, tave kakhano anurUpa AcaraNera punarAvRtti kareA nA|’
AllAha teAmAdera janya AYAtasamUha spaSTa kare varNanA karena| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
nizcaYai yArA bhAlovAse ye, yArA ImAna eneche tAdera madhye vyabhicAra prasAra lAbha karuka, tAdera janya ihAkAla o parakAle yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche evaM AllAha jAnena, teAmarA jAno nA|
yadi teAmAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkata, (tave keu avyAhati pete nA;) Ara nizcaYai AllAha daYArdra, asIma daYAlu|

he yArA ImAna enecha, teAmarA zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa kareA nA| Ara ye keu zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa karave, tave nizcaYai se azlIla o manda kAjerai Adeza karave| yadi AllAhara anugraha o daYA teAmAdera prati nA thAkata, tave teAmAdera keu kakhano pavitra hate pArate nA| kintu AllAha yAke icchA pavitra karena| Ara AllAha sarvazrotA o sarvajJa|

teAmAdera madhye yArA uccamaryAdA o Arthika prAcuryera adhikArI, tArA yena kasama nA kare ye, tArA AtmIYasvajanake, abhAvagrastake evaM AllAhara pathe hijarAtakArIderake kichui deve nA| tAdera kSamA karA evaM deASatruTi upekSA karA ucita| teAmarA ki pachanda karo nA ye, AllAha teAmAderake kSamA karena? AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
nizcaYai yArA satI-sAdhvI, avalA ImAnadAra nArIdera prati apavAda AreApa kare, tArA ihakAle o parakAle abhizapta evaM tAdera janya raYeche mahAzAsti|
sedina tAdera viruddhe sAkSya deve tAdera jihvA, tAdera hAta o tAdera pA, tAdera kRtakarma samvandhe|
sedina AllAha tAderake tAdera nyAyya pratidAna pureApuri devena evaM tArA jAnate pArave ye, AllAhai suspaSTa satya|

duzcaritrA nArIrA duzcaritra puruSadera janya evaM duzcaritra puruSarA duzcaritrA nArIdera janya| puNyavatI nArIrA pUNyavAna puruSadera janya evaM caritravAna puruSarA puNyavatI nArIdera janya| tAdera samparke leAke yA vale, se vyApAre tArA niSkalaGka| tAdera janya kSamA o sammAnajanaka jIvikA|

he yArA ImAna enecha, teAmarA nijedera ghara vyatIta anyera ghare praveza kareA nA, yatakSaNa nA anumati cAo evaM gharavAsIdera sAlAma dAo| eTAi teAmAdera janya uttama, yena teAmarA upadeza grahaNa karo|

yadi teAmarA ghare kAuke nA pAo, tave anumati grahaNa nA karA paryanta sekhAne praveza kareA nA| yadi teAmAdera valA haYa phire yAo, tave tomarA phire yAve| eTA teAmAdera janya pavitratama| Ara teAmarA yA karo, AllAha se samparke samyaka jJAta|
—emana ghare praveza karAte teAmAdera keAno pApa nei, ye gRhe keu vAsa kare nA evaM yAte teAmAdera jinisapatra Ache; Ara AllAha jAnena, teAmarA yA prakAza karo evaM yA geApana karo|
tumi mu’minadera valo, tArA yena tAdera dRSTi nata rAkhe evaM tAdera yaunAGgera hiphAjata kare| eTA tAdera janya parizuddhitAra mAdhyama| nizcaYai tArA yA kare AllAha se vyApAre samyaka jJAta|

Ara tumi mu’mina nArIderake valo, tArA yena tAdera dRSTi nata rAkhe evaM tAdera yaunAGgera hiphAjata kare| tArA yena yA sAdhAraNata prakAzamAna, tA chAr3A tAdera saundarya pradarzana nA kare evaM tArA yena tAdera mAthAra or3anA vakSadezera upara phele rAkhe | evaM tArA yena tAdera svAmI, pitA, zvazura, putra, svAmIra putra (satchele), bhAi, bhAtijA, bhAginA, tAdera (dharmera) nArI, adhikArabhukta dAsI, kAmanAmukta puruSa, o emana vAlaka, yArA nArIdera geApana aGga samparke ajJa, tArA yena sajeAre pA nA phele prakAzera uddezye—tAdera sei saundarya; yA tArA gopana kare rAkhe| teAmarA savAi AllAhara nikaTa tAovA karo, he mu’minarA, yAte teAmarA saphalakAma hate pAra|

teAmAdera madhye yArA vandhanahIna, tAdera vivAha sampAdana kare dAo evaM teAmAdera dAsa o dAsIdera madhye yArA satkarmaparAYaNa, tAderao| tArA yadi daridra haYa, tave AllAha nija anugrahe tAdera sacchala kare devena| AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|

Ara yArA vivAhe sAmarthya rAkhe nA, tArA yena saMyama avalamvana kare yatakSaNa nA AllAha nija anugrahe tAdera abhAvamukta kare dena| teAmAdera adhikArabhuktadera madhye yArA muktira janya likhita cukti karate cAYa, tAdera sAthe teAmarA likhita cukti karo yadi jAno ye, tAdera madhye kalyANa Ache| AllAha teAmAdera ye sampada diYechena, tA theke tAdera dAna karo| teAmAdera dAsIrA nijedera pavitratA rakSA karate cAile pArthivajIvanera sampadera lAlasAYa tAdera vyabhicAre vAdhya kAreA nA| ye tAdera vAdhya karave, se jene rAkhuka, AllAha tAra vAdhya karAra parao tAdera prati kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
Ami teAmAdera prati avatIrNa karechi suspaSTa AYAtasamUha, teAmAdera pUrvavartIdera kichu dRSTAnta evaM muttAkidera janya upadeza|
