AllAha nUra AsamAnasamUha o yaminera, tA~ra nUrera udAharaNa yena ekaTi dIpAdhAra, yAte Ache ekaTi pradIpa, pradIpaTi ekaTi kAcapAtre sthApita, kAcapAtraTi ujjvala nakSatrasadRzya| tA prajvalita karA haYa varakatamaYa yAituna vRkSera tela dvArA, yA pUrvamukhI naYa evaM pazcimamukhIo naYa| Aguna sparza nA karaleo tAra tela yena AleAkita hate cAYa| nUrera opara nUra| AllAha yAke icchA patha dekhAna tA~ra nUrera dike| AllAha mAnuSera janya dRSTAntasamUha varNanA karena evaM AllAha sava viSaYe jJAta|
yesava ghara, AllAha nirdeza diYechena ye samunnata karA have evaM tAra nAma smaraNa karA have sekhAne; sakAla o sandhAYa tA~ra pavitratA ghoSaNA kare sekhAne,

emana leAkerA, yAdera vyavasA-vANijya o kraYa-vikraYa AllAhara smaraNa theke, sAlAta kAYema karA theke evaM yAkAta pradAna karA theke virata rAkhe nA| tArA bhaYa kare sei dinake, yedina antara o dRSTisamUha ulaTe yAve|
tArA AllAhara pavitratA gheASaNA kare, yena AllAha tAdera kAjera sarvottama pratidAna dena evaM nija anugrahe Arao vAr3iYe dena| AllAha yAke icchA kono hisAva chAr3A riyika dAna karena|

yArA kAphira, tAdera karma marubhUmira marIcikAra mato, yAke pipAsArta vyakti pAni mane kare| ataHpara yakhana se tAra kAche yAYa se kichui pAYa nA; varaM sekhAne pAYa AllAhake, ataHpara AllAha tAra hisAva pUrNa mAtrAYa diYe dena| Ara AllAha hisAva grahaNe tatpara|

athavA tAdera karma, samudrera gabhIrera andhakArera mato yAke Acchanna kare taraGgera opara taraGga, yAra opare ghana kAleA megha Ache| andhakArera para andhakAra| yakhana se tAra hAta vera kare, takhana tAke ekevArei dekhate pAYa nA| AllAha yAke Alo dAna karena nA, tAra keAno Alo nei|

tumi ki dekhoni, AsamAnasamUha o yamine yArA Ache, tArA evaM DAnA mele ur3anta pAkhirA AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA gheASaNA kare? pratyekei tAra sAlAta evaM tAsavIha karAra paddhati jene niYeche| tArA yA kare, AllAha se viSaYe samyaka jJAta|
AsamAnasamUha o yaminera rAjatva AllAharai evaM AllAharai dike pratyAvartana|

tumi ki dekhoni, AllAha meghamAlAke saJcAlita karena, ataHpara tAke puJjIbhUta karena, ataHpara tAke rAkhena; stare stare, erapara tumi dekho, tAra madhya theke vAridhArA nirgata haYa| tini AkAzasthita zilAstUpa theke zilA varSaNa karena evaM tA dvArA yAke icchA AghAta karena evaM yAra kAcha theke icchA, tA anyadike phiriYe dena| tAra vidyutjhalaka dRSTizakti yena vilIna kare dite cAYa|
AllAha dina o rAtrira Avartana ghaTAna| ete antardRSTi-sampannadera janya zikSA raYeche|

AllAha pratyeka vicaraNazIla prANIke pAni dvArA sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tAdera kataka peTe bhara diYe cale, kataka dui pAYe bhara diYe cale evaM kataka cAra pAYe bhara diYe cale; AllAha yA icchA sRSTi karena| nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
Ami teA suspaSTa AYAtasamUha avartIrNa karechi| AllAha yAke icchA sarala pathe paricAlita karena|
tArA vale, ‘AmarA AllAha o rAsUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana karechi evaM Anugatya karechi;’ kintu tArapara tAdera ekadala mukha phiriYe neYa; tArapara tAdera theke; Asale tArA mu’mina naYa|
tAdera madhye phAYasAlA karAra janya yakhana tAderake AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera dike AhvAna karA haYa takhana tAdera ekadala mukha phiriYe neYa|
Ara yadi satya tAdera svapakSe haYa tave tArA vinItabhAve rAsUlera kAche chuTe Ase|
tAdera antare ki reAga Ache? nAki tArA saMzaYa poSaNa kare? nAki tArA bhaYa kare ye, AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla tAdera prati avicAra karavena? varaM tArAi teA yAlima|

vastuta mu’minadera kathA to ei, yakhana tAdera madhye phAYasAlA karAra janya AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera dike tAdera AhvAna karA haYa, takhana tArA vale, ‘AmarA zunalAma o Anugatya karalAma|’ Ara tArAi to saphalakAma|
Ara yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare AllAhake bhaYa kare o tA~ra vyApAre parihAra kare—tArAi kRtakArya|

tArA dRr3habhAve AllAhara zapatha kare vale ye, tumi tAdera Adeza karale tArA vera havei| valo, ‘teAmarA zapatha karo nA (tomAdera) Anugatya (ye mithyA tA savArai) paricita, teAmarA yA kichu karo, AllAha se viSaYe jJAta|’

valo, ‘AllAhara Anugatya karo evaM rAsUlera Anugatya karo|’ tave yadi teAmarA mukha phiriYe nAo, tave tAra opara vartAYa kevala tAra prati arpita dAYitva evaM teAmAdera opara arpita dAYitvera janya teAmarAi dAYI| teAmarA yadi tA~ra Anugatya karo, tave hidAYAta pAve| rAsUlera dAYitva teA kevala suspaSTarUpe pau~che deoYA|

teAmAdera madhye yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kare, AllAha tAdera oYAdA diYechena ye, tAderake avazyai pRthivIte kartRtva dAna karavena, yemana tini kartRtva dAna karechena tAdera pUrvavartIdera evaM tini avazyai sudRr3ha karavena tAdera dInake, yA tini tAdera janya pachanda karechena evaM tAdera bhaYa-bhItira parivarte avazyai tAderake zAnti dAna karavena| tArA AmAra ivAdAta karave evaM AmAra sAthe kono kichuke zarika karave nA| erapara yArA kuphuri karave, tArAi avAdhya|
Ara tomarA sAlAta kAYema karo, yAkAta pradAna karo evaM rAsUlera Anugatya karo, yAte teAmarA anugrahaprApta hao|
yArA kuphuri kareche tAderake teAmarA pRthivIte parAkramazAlI mane kareA nA| tAdera ThikAnA Aguna| katai nA nikRSTa ei pratyAvartanasthala!

he yArA ImAna enecha, teAmAdera dAsa-dAsIrA evaM yArA prApta vaYase pau~cheni teAmAdera madhye, tArA yena tina samaYe teAmAdera kAche anumati grahaNa kare, phajarera sAlAtera pUrve, dupure yakhana teAmarA pozAka khule rAkho evaM izAra sAlAtera para| ei tina samaYa teAmAdera gopanIYatAra samaYa| anya samaYa teAmAdera o tAdera janya keAno deASa nei| teAmArA eke aparera kAche teA yAtAYAta karo| emanibhAve AllAha teAmAdera kAche suspaSTa AYAtasamUha vivRta karena| Ara AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

teAmAdera santAna-santatirA yakhana vaYaHprApta haYa, tArAo yena tAdera pUrvavartIdera mato anumati cAYa| emanibhAve AllAha tA~ra AYAtasamUha teAmAdera kAche varNanA karena| Ara AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

evaM vRddha nArI, yArA vivAhera AzA rAkhe nA, yadi tArA tAdera saundarya prakAza nA kare tAdera vastra khule rAkhe| tAdera janya deASa nei, tave e theke virata thAkAi tAdera janya uttama| AllAha sarvazreAtA, sarvajJa|

andhera opara deASa nei, khaJjera opara deASa nei, reAgIra opara deASa nei evaM teAmAdera nijedera oparao deASa nei ye, teAmarA AhAra karave teAmAdera ghara theke athavA teAmAdera pitAdera ghare athavA teAmAdera mAtAdera ghare athavA teAmAdera bhAidera ghare athavA teAmAdera vonadera ghare athavA teAmAdera pitRvyadera ghare athavA teAmAdera phupudera ghare athavA teAmAdera mAmAdera ghare athavA teAmAdera khAlAdera ghare athavA sei ghare, yAra cAvi Ache teAmAdera mAlikAnAYa; athavA teAmAdera vandhudera ghare| teAmarA ekatre AhAra karo athavA pRthakabhave AhAra karo, tAte teAmAdera keAno deASa nei| ataHpara yakhana teAmarA ghare praveza karo, takhana teAmAdera nijedera prati sAlAma deve| eTA AllAhara nikaTa theke abhivAdanasvarUpa varakatamaYa, pavitra| emanibhAve AllAha teAmAdera janya AYAtasamUha vizadabhAve varNanA karena, yena tomarA anudhAvana karo|

mu’mina teA tArAi; yArA AllAha o rAsUlera prati ImAna Ane evaM rAsUlera sAthe keAno samaSTigata kAje zarika hale tAra kAcha theke anumati grahaNa vyatIta cale yAYa nA| yArA tomAra kAche anumati prArthanA kare, tArAi AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ane| ataeva, tArA tomAra kAche tAdera keAno paristhitira kAraNe anumati cAile tumi tAdera madhye yAke icchA anumati deve evaM tAdera janya kSamAprArthanA karave AllAhara kAche; AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

rAsUlera AhvAnake teAmarA teAmAdera eke aparake AhvAnera mato gaNya kareA nA| AllAha tAdera jAnena, yArA teAmAdera madhye cupisAre sare par3e| ataeva, yArA tA~ra Adezera viruddhAcaraNa kare, tArA e viSaYe satarka heAka ye, viparyaYa tAdera sparza karave athavA yantraNAdAYaka zAsti tAdera grAsa karave|

mane rekheA, AsamAna o yamine yA Ache, tA AllAharai| teAmarA ye avasthAYa Acha—tA tini jAnena| yedina tArA tA~ra kAche pratyAvartita have, sedina tini vale devena tArA yA kareche| AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvajJa|
atIva varakatamaYa tini, yini tA~ra vAndAra prati phurakAna avatIrNa karechena, yena se vizvajagatera janya satarkakArI hate pAre|

yini nabheAmaNDala o bhUmaNDalera sArvabhaumatvera adhikArI, tini keAno santAna grahaNa karenani| tA~ra rAjatve keAno aMzIdAra nei| tini pratyeka vastu sRSTi karechena, ataHpara pratyekake parimita karechena yathAyatha anupAte|

tArA grahaNa kareche, tA~ra parivarte kata ilAh, yArA kichui sRSTi kare nA; varaM tAderakei sRSTi karA haYeche| Ara tArA nijedera upakAra karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA, mandao karate pAre nA| jIvana, maraNa o utthAnerao tArA mAlika naYa|
kAphirarA vale, ‘eTA mithyA vyatIta kichui naYa, yA se racanA kareche evaM anya leAkerA tAke sAhAyya kareche|’ avazyai tArA avicAra o mithyAra AzraYa niYeche|
tArA vale, ‘eguleA teA Adi yugera rUpakathA, yA se likhe rekheche| eguleA sakAla-sandhyAYa tAra kAche tilAoYAta karA haYa|’
valo, ‘eke tinii avatIrNa karechena, yini nabheAmaNDala o bhUmaNDalera geApana rahasya samparke avagata Achena| tini kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|’
Ara tArA vale, ‘e kemana rAsUla, ye khAvAra khAYa evaM hATa-vAjAre calApherA kare? tAra kAche kena keAno pherezatA nAyila karA halo nA, ye tAra sAthe satarkakArI haYe thAkata?’
‘athavA Dhele deoYA hato tAke dhana-bhAnDAra, athavA thAkata tAra ekaTi vAgAna, yA theke tini AhAra karatena?’ yAlimarA vale, ‘teAmarA teA ekajana jAdugrasta vyaktirai anusaraNa karacha|’
dekho, tArA tomAra kemana dRSTAnta varNanA kare! vastuta tArA pathabhraSTa haYeche, phale tArA patha pete sakSama have nA|
varakatamaYa tini, yini icchA karale tomAke tAra ceYe uttama vastu dite pArena; tA emana jAnnAta—yAra taladeze pravAhita haYa nada-nadI Ara dite pArena tomAke prAsAdasamUha|
varaM tArA kiYAmAtake asvIkAra kare evaM ye kiYAmAtake asvIkAra kare, AmarA tAra janya jvalanta Aguna prastuta karechi|
yakhana Aguna dUra theke tAdera dekhave, takhana tArA tAra garjana o huMkAra zunate pAve|
yakhana eka zikale kaYekajanake vA~dhA avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera keAno saMkIrNa sthAne nikSepa karA have, takhana sekhAne tArA mRtyuke DAkave|
valA have—‘Aja teAmarA eka mRtyuke DekeA nA; aneka mRtyuke DAko|’
valo, ‘eTA uttama, nA sthAYI vasavAsera jAnnAta; muttAkidera yAra susaMvAda deoYA haYeche?’ seTA have tAdera pratidAna o pratyAvartanasthAna|
sekhAne tArA yA kAmanA karave tA-i pAve evaM tArA sthAYI, e pratizruti pUraNa tomAra raverai dAYitve|

sedina AllAha ekatra karavena tAderake evaM tArA AllAhara parivarte yAdera ivAdAta karata tAderake, sedina tini tAdera upAsyaderake jijJAsA karavena, ‘teAmarAi ki AmAra ei vAndAderake vibhrAnta karechile, nA tArA nijerAi pathabhrAnta haYechila?’

tArA valave, ‘Apani pavitra, AmAdera janya ucita chila nA AmarA ApanAra parivarte anyake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karava; kintu Apanii teA tAderake evaM tAdera pitRpuruSaderake bheAga sambhAra diYechilena, phale tArA ApanAra smRti vismRta haYechila evaM tArA pariNata haYechila eka dhvaMsaprApta jAtite|’

AllAha muzarikaderake valavena—‘tomarA yA valacha tA tArA mithyA sAvyasta kareche, sutarAM teAmarA zAsti pratireAdha karate pArave nA evaM sAhAyyao pAve nA| teAmAdera madhye ye sImAlaGghana karave, Ami tAke gurutara zAsti AsvAdana karAva|’

tomAra pUrve yata rAsUla preraNa karechi, tArA savAi khAdya grahaNa karata evaM hATa-vAjAre calApherA karata| Ami teAmAdera ekake aparera janya parIkSAsvarUpa karechi| teAmarA savara karave ki? Ara tomAra rava sarvadraSTA|

yArA AmAra sAkSAt AzA kare nA, tArA vale, ‘AmAdera kAche kena pherezatA avatIrNa karA halo nA? athavA AmarA AmAdera ravake kena dekhi nA?’ tArA nijedera antare ahaMkAra peASaNa kare evaM gurutararUpe sImAlaGghana kare|
yedina tArA pherezatAderake dekhave, sedina aparAdhIdera janya keAno susaMvAda thAkave nA evaM tArA valave, ‘ durbhedya keAno vAdhA yadi tA ATake rAkhata|’
Ami tAdera kRtakarma vivecanA karava, ataHpara seguleAke vikSipta dhUlikaNAYa pariNata karava|
sedina jAnnAtidera vAsasthAna have uttama evaM vizrAmasthala have maneArama|
sedina AkAza meghamAlAsaha vidIrNa have evaM sedina pherezatAdera yathAyathabhAve nAmiYe deoYA have|
sedina satyikAra rAjatva have daYAmaYera evaM kAphiradera janya dinaTi have kaThina|
sImAlaGghanakArIrA sedina Apana dui hAta daMzana karate karate valave, ‘hAYa AphaseAsa! Ami yadi rAsUlera patha avalamvana karatAma|’
‘hAYa AmAra durbhAgya, Ami yadi amukake vandhurUpe grahaNa nA karatAma|’
‘AmAra kAche upadeza AsAra para nizcaYai se AmAke tA theke vibhrAnta karechila|’ Ara zaYatAna mAnuSake vipadakAle dheA~kA deYa|
rAsUla valave, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAra sampradAYa ei kuraAnake parityAjya sAvyasta kareche|’
ebhAve pratyeka navira janya Ami aparAdhIdera madhya theke zatru karechi| tomAra janya tomAra ravai pathapradarzaka o sAhAyyakArIrUpe yatheSTa|

satya pratyAkhyAnakArIrA vale, ‘kena tAra prati samagra kuraAna ekadaphAYa avatIrNa halo nA?’ (Ami emanibhAve avatIrNa karechi) tomAra antakaraNake majavuta karAra janya evaM krame krame AvRtti kariYechi|
tArA tomAra kAche emana keAno samasyA niYe Ase nA ― Ami tomAke yAra saThika jAoYAva o sundara vyAkhyA dAna karini|
yAderake mukha thuvar3e par3e thAkA avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera dike ekatra karA have, tAderai sthAna have ati nikRSTa evaM tArAi atizaYa pathabhraSTa|
Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechi evaM tAra sAthe tAra bhAi hArUnake sAhAyyakArI karechi|
ataHpara Ami valechi, ‘teAmarA sei sampradAYera kAche yAo, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA abhihita kareche|’ ataHpara Ami tAdera samUle dhvaMsa kare diYechi|

evaM nUhera sampradAYa, yakhana tArA rAsUlagaNera prati mithyAreApa karala, takhana Ami tAderake nimajjita karalAma evaM tAderake mAnavamaNDalIra janya nidarzana kare dilAma| yAlimadera janya Ami prastuta kare rekhechi yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
Ara Ami dhvaMsa karechi Ada, sAmUda o AsahAve rAsa evaM tAdera madhyavartI aneka sampradAYake|
evaM Ami tAdera pratyekera janyai dRSTAnta varNanA karechi evaM pratyekakei samUle dhvaMsa karechi|
tArA teA sei janapadera upara diYei yAtAYAta kare, yAra opara varSita haYeche manda vRSTi| tave ki tArA tA pratyakSa kare nA? varaM tArA punarutthAna sambhava vale mane kare nA|
tArA yakhana tomAke dekhe, takhana tomAke kevala vidrupera pAtrarUpe grahaNa kare, (o vale), “e-i ki se, yAke AllAha ‘rAsUla’ kare pAThiYechena?”
‘se teA AmAdera upAsyadera kAcha theke AmAderake sariYei dita, yadi AmarA tAderake A~kar3e dhare nA thAkatAma|’ tArA yakhana zAsti pratyakSa karave, takhana jAnate pArave ke adhika pathabhraSTa|
tumi ki tAke dekho nA, ye tAra pravRttike upAsyarUpe grahaNa kare? tavuo ki tumi tAra yimmAdAra have?
tumi ki mane karo ye, tAdera adhikAMza zeAne athavA veAjhe? tArA teA catuSpada jantura mato; varaM tArA atyadhika pathabhraSTa|
tumi ki lakSa karo nA, teAmAra ravake; tini kIbhAve chAYAke pralamvita karena? tini icchA karale eke sthira rAkhate pAratena| erapara Ami sUryake karechi era nirdezaka|
ataHpara Ami eke nijera dike dhIre dhIre guTiYe Ani|
tinii teA teAmAdera janya rAtake karechena AvaraNasvarUpa, ghumake vizrAmasvarUpa evaM dinake karechena jAgaraNera janya|
tinii tA~ra rAhamAtera pUrve susaMvAdavAhIrUpe vAtAsa pAThAna evaM Ami AkAza theke vizuddha vAri varSaNa kari|
tA dvArA mRta yaminake saJjIvita karAra janya evaM AmAra sRSTira jIva-jantu o aneka mAnuSake tA pAna karAi |
evaM Ami tA tAdera madhye (vibhinnabhAve) vitaraNa kari, yena tArA upadeza grahaNa kare; kintu adhikAMza leAkai var3a akRtajJa|
Ami icchA karale pratyeka janapade ekajana satarkakArI pAThAte pAratAma|
ataeva, tumi kAphiradera Anugatya karo nA evaM tAdera sAthe era sAhAyye kaTheAra saMgrAma karo|
tinii samAntarAle dui samudra pravAhita karechena, eTi miSTa, tRSNA nivAraka o ekaTi leAnA, visvAda; Ara tini rekhechena ubhaYera mAjhakhAne ekaTi antarAYa, ekaTi durbhedya Ar3Ala|
tinii mAnuSake pAni theke sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tAke vaMzagata o vaivAhika samparkazIla karechena| teAmAra rava savakichu karate sakSama|
Ara tArA AllAhara parivarte emana kichura ivAdAta kare, yA tAdera upakArao karate pAre nA evaM kSatio karate pAre nA| kAphira tAra ravera viruddhe sAhAyyakArI|
Ara Ami tomAke kevala susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe pAThiYechi|
valo, ‘Ami teAmAdera kAche era keAno vinimaYa cAi nA, yAra icchA, se tAra ravera patha avalamvana karuka|’
tumi sei ciraJjIvera opara bharasA karo, yAra mRtyu nei evaM tA~ra prazaMsAsaha pavitratA gheASaNA karo| tAra vAndAra gunAha samparke avagatira janya tinii yatheSTa|
tini AsamAna-yamina o ubhaYera antarvartI savakichu chaYa dine sRSTi karechena, ataHpara Araze isatioYA haYechena| daYAmaYa| ataeva, tA~ra samparke avahita vyaktike jijJesa karo|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘daYAmaYake sijadAha karo’, takhana tArA vale, ‘daYAmaYa AvAra ke? tumi kAuke sijadAha karAra Adeza karalei ki AmarA sijadAha karava?’ ete tAdera palAYanaparatAi vRddhi pAYa|
kalyANamaYa tini, yini AsamAne rAzicakra sRSTi karechena evaM tAte sthApana karechena sUrya o jyotirmaYa candra|
Ara yArA upadeza grahaNa karate cAYa athavA kRtajJa hate cAYa tAdera janya tini rAta o dina sRSTi karechena parasparera anugAmIrUpe|
rAhamAna-era vAndA tArAi, yArA pRthivIte naramabhAve calApherA kare, Ara tAderake yakhana ajJa lokerA samvodhana kare takhana tArA vale ‘sAlAma’|
evaM yArA rAta ativAhita kare tAdera ravera uddezye sijadAvanata haYe o dA~r3iYe theke;
Ara yArA vale, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAdera theke jAhAnnAmera zAsti phiriYe nina| nizcaYai era zAsti halo vinAza|’
AzraYasthala o vasati hiseve tA kata nA nikRSTa|
Ara tArA yakhana vyaYa kare, takhana apavyaYa kare nA, kRpaNatAo kare nA| varaM era madhyavartI panthA avalamvana kare|

Ara yArA AllAhara sAthe anya ilAhake DAke nA, AllAha yAra hatyA avaidha karechena, saMgata kAraNa vyatIta tAke hatyA kare nA evaM vyabhicAra kare nA| Ara yArA ekAja kare, tArA zAstira sammukhIna have|
kiYAmAtera dina tAra zAsti dviguNa karA have evaM sekhAne se sthAYI have hIna avasthAYa|
kintu yArA tAovA kare ImAna Ane evaM satkarma kare, AllAha tAdera pApake puNya dvArA parivartana kare devena| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
ye tAovA kare o satkAja kare, tave se to sampUrNarUpe AllAhara abhimukhI haYa|
Ara yArA mithyA sAkSya pradAna kare nA evaM yakhana asAra kriYAkarmera pAza diYe yAYa, takhana nija maryAdAra sAthe tA parihAra kare cale|
Ara yAderake tAdera ravera AYAtasamUha smaraNa karAno hale tAte vadhira o andha sadRza AcaraNa kare nA|
Ara yArA vale, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAderake emana strI o emana santAna dAna karo, yArA have AmAdera janya cakSu zItalakArI evaM AmAderake muttAkidera janya imAma vAniYe dAo|’
tAderake pratidAnasvarUpa deoYA have jAnnAta; yehetu tArA dhairyadhAraNa kareche | sekhAne tAdera abhyarthanA karA have abhivAdana o sAlAmasaha|
tArA sekhAne cirakAla vasavAsa karave| avasthAnasthala o vAsasthAna hiseve tA katai nA uttama!
valo, ‘AmAra rava kono paraoYA karena nA, yadi teAmarA tA~ke nA DAko| yehetu teAmarA mithyA valecha| ataeva, satvara neme Asave anivArya zAsti|’
tvA sI-na mI-ma|
eguleA suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
tArA mu ’ mina hacche nA vale tumi haYateA (marmavyathAYa) AtmavinAzI haYe par3ave|
Ami icchA karale AkAza theke tAdera kAche eka nidarzana pAThAtAma| phale tAdera grIvA tAra prati nata haYe par3ata|
yakhanai tAdera prati daYAmaYera keAno natuna upadeza Ase, takhanai tArA tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa|
ataeva, tArA teA mithyA sAvasta kareche; sutarAM ye viSaYa niYe tArA ThATTA-vidrupa karata, tAra yathArtha vArtA zigagira tAdera kAche pau~che yAve|
tArA ki yaminera prati dRSTipAta kare nA? Ami tAte pratyeka prakArera kata utkRSTa udbhida udgata karechi|
nizcaYai tAte Ache nizcita nidarzana, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai mu ’ mina naYa|
Ara nizcaYai tomAra rava, tini to parAkramazAlI asIma daYAlu|
smaraNa karo, yakhana tomAra rava mUsAke Deke valalena, ‘tumi yAlima sampradAYera nikaTa yAo;’
‘phiraAunera sampradAYa; tArA ki bhaYa karave nA?’
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Ami AzaGkA karachi ye, tArA AmAke mithyApratipanna karave|’
‘Ara AmAra vakSa saMkIrNa haYe par3ave evaM AmAra jihvA to sAvalIla naYa| sutarAM hArUnera kAcheo pratyAdeza pAThAna|’
‘AmAra viruddhe tAdera abhiyeAga Ache| ataeva, Ami AzaGkA kari ye, tArA AmAke hatyA karave|’
AllAha valalena, ‘kakhanoi naYa, teAmarA ubhaYe AmAra nidarzanAvali niYe yAo| nizcaYai Ami teAmAdera saGge Achi zravaNakArI|’
“ataeva, teAmarA phiraAunera kAche yAo evaM valo, ‘AmarA vizvajagatera ravera rAsUla|’”
‘yena tumi vani isarAIlake AmAdera sAthe pAThAo|’
phiraAuna valala, ‘AmarA ki teAmAke zaizave AmAdera madhye lAlana-pAlana karini? evaM tumi AmAdera madhye jIvanera vahu vachara kATiYecha|’
‘tumi, tomAra ye kAja karAra, tA to karecha| Ara tumi akRtajJa|’
mUsA valala, ‘Ami tA karechi, yakhana Ami ajJa chilAma|’
‘ataHpara Ami yakhana tomAdera bhaYe bhIta halAma takhana teAmAdera kAcha theke pAlAlAma| erapara AmAra rava AmAke prajJA dAna karechena evaM AmAke karechena rAsUladera antarbhukta|’
‘AmAra prati teAmAra ye anugrahera kathA valacha, tA ei ye, tumi vani isarAIlake geAlAma vAniYe rekhecha|’
phiraAuna valala, ‘vizvajagatera rava AvAra ke?’
mUsA valala, ‘tini AkAzamaNDala o pRthivI o ubhaYera madhyavartI savakichura rava yadi teAmarA nizcita vizvAsI hao|’
phiraAuna tAra pariSadavargake valala, ‘teAmarA ki zunacha nA?’
se (mUsA) valala, ‘tini teAmAdera rava evaM teAmAdera pUrvavartIderao rava|’
(phiraAuna) valala, ‘nizcaYai teAmAdera rAsUla yAke teAmAdera prati pAThAno haYeche avazyai pAgala|’
(mUsA) valala, ‘tini pUrva, pazcima o ubhaYera madhyavartI savakichura rava, yadi teAmarA anudhAvana karate|’
(phiraAuna) valala, ‘yadi tumi AmAra parivarte anyake ilAharUpe grahaNa kara, tave Ami avazyai teAmAke kArAruddha karava|’
(mUsA) valala, ‘Ami teAmAra kAche keAno spaSTa viSaYa niYe eleo ki?’
(phiraAuna) valala, ‘tave tumi tA upasthita karo yadi satyavAdI hao|’
ataHpara se tAra lAThi nikSepa karala tatkSaNAt tA suspaSTa ajagara haYe gela|
Ara se tAra hAta vera karala, tatkSaNAt tA darzakadera dRSTite zubhra pratibhAta haleA|
(phiraAuna) tAra upasthita pariSadavargake valala, ‘nizcaYai e ekajana sudakSa jAdukara|’
‘se tAra jAdu vale teAmAdera deza theke teAmAderake vahiSkAra karate cAYa| sutarAM tomarA kI karAra parAmarza dAo?’
tArA valala, ‘tAke o tAra bhAike kiJcita avakAza dina evaM zahare zahare saMgrAhakadera pAThAna|’
‘tArA yena ApanAra kAche pratyeka dakSa jAdukarake upasthita kare|’
ataHpara eka nirdiSTa dine nirdhArita samaYe jAdukaraderake ekatra karA halo|
evaM janagaNake valA halo, ‘teAmarAo samaveta haccha to?’
‘yena AmarA jAdukaradera anusaraNa karate pAri, yadi tArAi vijaYI haYa|’
ataHpara yakhana jAdukararA ela, takhana tArA phiraAunake valala, ‘yadi AmarA vijaYI hai, tave AmAdera puraskAra thAkave teA?’
(phiraAuna) valala, ‘hyA~ evaM takhana teAmarA AmAra naikaTyazIladera antarbhukta have|’
mUsA tAderake valala, ‘nikSepa karo teAmarA yA nikSepa karave|’
ataHpara tArA tAdera razi o lAThi nikSepa karala evaM valala, ‘phiraAunera ijjatera kasama, AmarAi vijaYI hava|’
ataHpara mUsA tAra lAThi nikSepa karala, tatkSaNAt tA tAdera alIka sRSTiguleAke grAsa karate lAgala|
takhana jAdukararA sijadAvanata haYe par3ala|
tArA valala, ‘AmarA rAvvula AlAmInera prati ImAna AnalAma|’
‘yini mUsA o hArUnera rava|’

(phiraAuna) valala, ‘AmAra anumati deoYAra pUrvei ki teAmarA tAra prati ImAna Anale? nizcaYai se teAmAdera pradhAna, ye teAmAdera jAdu zikhiYeche| acirei teAmarA (pariNAma) jAnate pArave| Ami avazyai teAmAdera hAta o pA viparIta dika theke keTe phelava| evaM teAmAdera savAike zUlaviddha karavai|’
tArA valala, ‘keAno kSati nei| AmarA AmAdera ravera nikaTa pratyAvartana karava|’
‘AmarA AzA kari, AmAdera rava AmAdera truTi-vicyuti mArjanA karavena| kAraNa, AmarA ImAna AnaYanakArIdera madhye agraNI|’
Ami mUsAke Adeza karalAma ye, ‘AmAra vAndAdera niYe rAtera velA vera haYe yAo, nizcaYai teAmAdera pichu neoYA have|’
ataHpara phiraAuna zahare zahare saMgrAhakadera pAThAla|
‘nizcaYai erA (vani isarAIla) kSudra ekaTi dala|’
‘Ara tArA AmAdera kreAdhera udreka kareche|’
‘Ara AmarA savAi sadA zaGkita|’
ataHpara Ami tAderake tAdera vAga-vAgicA o jharanAsamUha theke vahiSkAra karalAma|
evaM dhana-bhAnDAra o maneArama sthAnasamUha theke|
emanai haYechila evaM vani isarAIlake kare dilAma esavera mAlika|
ataHpara sUryeAdaYera samaYa tArA tAdera pichu nila|
ataHpara yakhana ubhaYa dala parasparake dekhala, takhana mUsAra saGgIrA valala, ‘AmarA ye dharA par3e yAcchi|’
mUsA valala, ‘kakhanoi naYa, AmAra sAthe Achena AmAra rava| satvara tini AmAke patha dekhAvena|’
ataHpara Ami mUsAra prati Adeza pAThAlAma, ‘teAmAra lAThi dvArA samudre AghAta karo|’ phale tA vidIrNa haYe gela evaM pratyeka bhAga vizAla parvatasadRza haYe gela|
Ami sekhAne apara dalake pau~chiYe dilAma|
evaM mUsA o tA~ra saGgIdera savAike vA~ciYe dilAma|
ataHpara apara dalaTike nimajjita karalAma|
nizcaYai ete ekaTi nidarzana Ache Ara tAdera adhikAMzai mu ’ mina naYa|
tomAra rava avazyai parAkramazAlI, asIma daYAlu|
Ara tAdera nikaTa ivarAhImera vRttAnta varnA karo|
se yakhana tAra pitA o tAra sampradAYake valala, ‘teAmarA kIsera ivAdAta kara?’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA pratimAra pUjA kari evaM sArA dina ederakei niSThAra sAthe A~kar3e thAki|’
ivarAhIma valala, ‘teAmarA yakhana AhvAna karo, takhana tArA ki zeAne?’
‘athavA tArA ki teAmAdera upakAra kiMvA kSati karate pAre?’
tArA valala, ‘nA, tave AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSadera peYechi, tArA emanai karata|’
ivarAhIma valala, ‘teAmarA ki tAdera samparke bheve dekhecha, yAdera pUjA kare Asacha|’
‘teAmarA evaM teAmAdera atIta pitRpuruSerA?’
‘phale nizcaYai tArA savAi AmAra zatru, jagatasamUhera rava vyatIta|’
‘yini AmAke sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tinii AmAke hidAYAta dAna karena|’
‘yini AmAke khAoYAna evaM pAna karAna|’
‘yakhana Ami reAgAkrAnta hai, takhana tinii AreAgya dAna karena|’
‘yini AmAra mRtyu ghaTAvena, ataHpara punarjIvita karavena|’
‘Ami AzA kari tinii vicArera dine AmAra truTi-vicyuti mApha karavena|’
‘he AmAra rava, AmAke prajJA dAna karuna evaM AmAke satkarmazIladera antarbhukta karuna|’
‘Ara AmAke paravartIdera madhye satyabhASI karo|’
‘Ara AmAke niYAmAtapUrNa jAnnAtera adhikArIdera antarbhukta karo|’
‘Ara AmAra pitAke kSamA karuna| tini teA pathabhraSTadera antarbhukta|’
‘Ara punarutthAna divase AmAke lAJchita karavena nA,’
‘ye divase dhana-sampada o santAna-santati keAno upakAre Asave nA;’
‘kintu ye sustha antara niYe AllAhara kAche Asave|’
Ara jAnnAta muttAkidera nikaTavartI karA have|
evaM vipathagAmIdera sAmane ummeAcita karA have jAhAnnAma|
tAdera valA have, ‘tArA keAthAYa, teAmarA yAdera pUjA karate|’
‘AllAhara parivarte tArA ki teAmAdera sAhAyya karate pAre, athavA tArA AtmarakSA karate sakSama?’
ataHpara tAderake evaM pathabhraSTaderake nimnamukhI kare nikSepa karA have jAhAnnAme|
Ara ivalIsa vAhinIra sakalakeo|
tArA sekhAne vitarke lipta haYe valave,
‘AllAhara kasama, AmarA prakAzya vibhrAntite lipta chilAma|’
‘yakhana AmarA teAmAderake jagatasamUhera ravera samatulya gaNya karatAma|’
‘Ara pApiSTharAi AmAderake geAmarAha karechila|’
‘ataeva, AmAdera keAno supArizakArI nei|’
‘evaM keAno sahRdaYa vandhuo nei|’
‘hAYa, yadi AmAdera ekavAra suyeAga ghaTata, tave AmarA mu ’ minadera antarbhukta haYe yetAma|’
nizcaYai tAte raYeche nidarzana evaM tAdera adhikAMzai mu ’ mina naYa|
tomAra rava mahA parAkramazAlI, asIma daYAlu|
nUhera sampradAYa rAsUladera mithyAreApa kareche|
yakhana tAdera bhAi nUha tAderake valala, ‘tomarA ki tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA?’
‘nizcaYai Ami teAmAdera janya vizvasta rAsUla|’
‘ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya karo|’
‘Ami teAmAdera kAche era janya keAno pratidAna cAi nA, AmAra pratidAna teA jagatasamUhera ravera nikaTai raYeche|’
‘ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya karo|’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA ki tomAra prati ImAna Anava yakhana teAmAra anusaraNa karache nimnazreNira lokerA?’
se valala, ‘tArA kI kAja karata, tA AmAra jAnA nei|’
‘tAdera hisAva grahaNa AmAra raverai kAja; yadi teAmarA vujhate!’
‘Ami mu’minagaNake tAr3iYe deoYAra leAka nai|’
‘Ami teA zudhu ekajana suspaSTa satarkakArI|’
tArA valala, ‘he nUha, yadi tumi nivRta nA hao, tave avazyai tumi prastarAghAte nihatadera antarbhukta have|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, nizcaYai AmAra sampradAYa AmAke mithyA sAvyasta karache|’
‘ataeva, AmAra o tAdera madhye keAno phAYasAlA karuna evaM AmAke o AmAra saGgI mu ’ minaderake rakSA karuna|’
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra sAthe yArA veAjhAi naukAYa chila tAderake rakSA karalAma|
erapara avaziSTa savAike nimajjata karalAma|
nizcaYai ete raYeche nidarzana Ara tAdera adhikAMzai mu ’ mina naYa|
nizcaYai tomAra rava, tinii to parAkramazAlI, asIma daYAlu|
Ada sampradAYa paYagamvaragaNake mithyA sAvyasta kareche|
yakhana tAdera bhAi hUda tAderake valala, ‘tomarA ki tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA?’
‘Ami teAmAdera prati vizvasta rAsUla|’
‘ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya karo|’
‘Ami teAmAdera kAche era janya pratidAna cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna teA jagatasamUhera ravera nikaTa raYeche|’
‘teAmarA ki pratiTi u~custhAne ayathA smRti-stambha nirmANa karacha?’
‘evaM var3a var3a prAsAda nirmANa karacha, yena teAmarA sthAYI hao?’
‘yakhana teAmarA AghAta hAno, takhana niSThurera mato AghAta hAno|’
‘ataeva, AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra anugatya karo|’
‘bhaYa karo tA~ke, yini teAmAdera sesava vastu diYechena, yA teAmarA jAno|’
‘teAmAderake diYechena catuSpada jantu o putra-santAna,’
‘evaM udyAna o prasravaNa|’
‘Ami teAmAdera janya AzaGkA kari mahAdivasera zAstira|’
tArA valala, ‘tumi upadeza dAo vA upadeza nA-i dAo, ubhaYai AmAdera janya samAna|’
‘eTA to pUrvavartIderai svabhAva|’
‘AmarA zAstiprAptadera antarbhukta nai|’
ataeva, tArA tAke mithyAvAdI valate lAgala evaM Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kare dilAma| ete avazyai nidarzana Ache; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsI naYa|
Ara tomAra rava, avazyai tini parAkramazAlI, asIma daYAlu|
Ara sAmUda sampradAYa paYagamvaragaNake mithyA sAvyasta kareche|
yakhana tAdera bhAi sAleha, tAderake valala, ‘teAmarA ki bhaYa karo nA?’
‘Ami teAmAdera janya eka vizvasta rAsUla|’
‘ataeva, AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya karo|’
‘Ami era janya teAmAdera kAche keAno pratidAna cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna teA jagatasamUhera ravera nikaTa raYeche|’
‘teAmAderake ki e jagatera (bheAga-vilAsera) madhye nirApade cher3e deoYA have?’
‘udyAne o prasravaNasamUhe?’
‘zasyakSetera madhye evaM maJjurita khejura vAgAne?’
‘teAmarA pAhAr3a keTe ghara nirmANa karacha naipuNyera sAthe|’
‘sutarAM teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra anugatya karo|’
‘evaM sImAlaGghanakArIdera Adeza mAnya karo nA;’
‘yArA pRthivIte anartha sRSTi kare evaM zAnti sthApana kare nA;’
tArA valala, ‘tumi teA jAdugrastadera ekajana|’
‘tumi teA AmAdera matoi ekajana mAnuSa vai nao| sutarAM keAno nidarzana niYe upasthita hao yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|’
sAleha valala, ‘eTA ekaTi uSTrI, era janya Ache pAni pAnera pAlA evaM teAmAdera janya Ache pAni pAnera pAlA nirdiSTa dine|’
‘teAmarA eke sparza karo nA aniSTa sAdhanera janya tAhale teAmAdera mahAdivasera zAsti pAkar3Ao karave|’
tArA tAke vadha karala| phale, tArA anutapta halo|
erapara AyAva tAdera pAkar3Ao karala| nizcaYai ete nidarzana Ache; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai mu ’ mina naYa|
tomAra rava, tini parAkramazAlI, asIma daYAlu|
lUtera sampradAYa rAsUladera mithyApratipanna kareche|
yakhana tAdera bhAi lUta tAdera valala, ‘teAmarA ki bhaYa karave nA?’
‘Ami teAmAdera prati vizvasta rAsUla|’
‘ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya karo|’
‘Ami era janya teAmAdera kAche keAno pratidAna cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna jagatasamUhera ravera nikaTa raYeche|’
‘vizvavAsIra madhye to tomarAi puruSera sAthe milita hao|’
‘evaM teAmAdera rava teAmAdera janya ye strIgaNake sRSTi karechena, tAderake varjana karo? varaM teAmarAi to sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYa|’
tArA valala, ‘he lUta, tumi yadi virata nA hao, tave avazyai teAmAke nirvAsita karA have|’
lUta valala, ‘Ami teAmAdera ei kAjake ghRNA kari|’
‘he AmAra rava, AmAke evaM AmAra parivAravargake tArA yA kare, tA theke rakSA karo|’
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra parivAravargake rakSA karalAma|
eka vRddhA vyatIta, se chila (pechane) avasthAnakArIdera antarbhukta|
ataHpara dhvaMsa karalAma anyaderake|
tAdera opara (zAstimUlaka) vRSTi varSaNa karalAma| bhIti-pradarzitadera janya ei vRSTi chila katai nA nikRSTa!
nizcaYai ete nidarzana raYeche; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai mu ’ mina naYa|
Ara nizcaYai tomAra rava parAkramazAlI, asIma daYAlu|
AikAvAsIrA rAsUladera mithyApratipanna kareche|
yakhana zu‘Aiva tAderake valala, ‘teAmarA ki bhaYa karo nA?’
‘Ami teAmAdera janya vizvasta rAsUla|’
‘ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya karo|’
‘Ami teAmAdera kAche era janya keAno pratidAna cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna jagatasamUhera ravera nikaTa raYeche|’
‘tomarA mApe pUrNa mAtrAYa dAo evaM mApe hrAsakArIdera antarbhukta haYeA nA|’
‘ojana karo saThika dA~r3ipAllAYa|’
‘mAnuSake tAdera prApya vastu kama diYo nA evaM pRthivIte anartha sRSTi kare phireA nA|’
‘bhaYa karo tA~ke, yini teAmAdera evaM teAmAdera pUrvavartI leAka-sampradAYake sRSTi karechena|’
tArA valala, ‘tumi teA jAdugrastadera antarbhukta|’
‘tumi AmAdera mato mAnuSa vai teA kichu nao| AmAdera dhAraNA—tumi mithyAvAdIdera antarbhukta|’
‘sutarAM, AkAzera eka khaNDa AmAdera upara phele dAo yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|’
se valala, ‘teAmarA yA karo, se samparke AmAra rava bhAlorUpe avahita|’
ataHpara tArA tAke pratyAkhyAna karala, phale tAdera meghAcchanna divasera zAsti pAkar3Ao karala| nizcaYai seTA chila eka mahAdivasera zAsti|
nizcaYai ete nidarzana raYeche; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai mu ’ mina naYa|
nizcaYai tomAra rava parAkramazAlI, asIma daYAlu|
ei kuraAna teA vizva-jagatera ravera nikaTa theke avatIrNa|
vizvasta pherezatA eke niYe avataraNa kareche|
tomAra antare, yena tumi bhIti pradarzanakArIdera antarbhukta hao,
suspaSTa Aravi bhASAYa|
nizcaYai era ullekha Ache pUrvavartI kitAvasamUhe|
tAdera janya eTA ki nidarzana naYa ye, vani isarAIlera AlimagaNa eTA avagata Ache?
yadi Ami eke keAno bhinna bhASIra prati avatIrNa karatAma,
ataHpara se tA tAdera kAche pATha karata, tavuo tArA ete mu ’ mina hato nA|
ebhAve Ami saJcAra karechi gunAhagAradera antare (avizvAsa)|
tArA era prati ImAna Anave nA, ye paryanta nA pratyakSa karave marmantuda zAsti|
ataHpara tA AkasmikabhAve tAdera kAche ese par3ave, tArA tA vujhateo pArave nA|
takhana tArA valave, ‘AmarA ki avakAza pAva nA?’
tave ki tArA AmAra zAsti druta kAmanA kare?
tumi ki bheve dekhecha, yadi Ami tAderake vacharera para vachara bheAga-vilAsa karate dii?
ataHpara ye viSaYe tAdera oYAdA deoYA hato, tA tAdera kAche ese par3e|
takhana tAdera pradatta bheAga-vilAsera upakaraNa tAdera keAno kAje Asave ki?
Ara Ami emana keAno janapada dhvaMsa karini; yAdera janya satarkakArI chila nA|
upadezasvarUpa evaM Ami anyAYAcaraNakArI nai|
ei zaYatAnarA eTAsaha avatIrNa haYani|
Ara tAdera janya eTi sambhava naYa evaM tArA era sAmarthyao rAkhe nA|
tAdera teA zravaNera jAYagA theke dUre rAkhA haYeche|
ataeva, tumi AllAhara sAthe anya ilAhake AhvAna karave nA, tave tumi zAstiprAptadera antarbhukta have|
tumi tomAra nikaTatama AtmIYaderake satarka karo|
Ara tomAra anusArI mu ’ minadera prati sadaYa hao|
yadi tArA tomAra avAdhyatA kare, tave valo, ‘teAmarA yA karo, tA theke Ami mukta|’
tumi bharasA karo parAkramazAlI, asIma daYAlura opara|
yini tomAke dekhena yakhana tumi (sAlAte) dA~r3Ao,
Ara sijadAkArIdera sAthe tomAra oThAvasA|
nizcaYai tini sarvazreAtA, sarvajJAnI|
Ami ki tomAderake valava, kAra nikaTa zaYatAnarA avataraNa kare?
tArA avatIrNa haYa pratyeka mithyAvAdI, pApAcArIra nikaTa|
tArA kAna pete thAke evaM tAdera adhikAMzai mithyAvAdI|
vibhrAnta leAkerAi kaviderake anusaraNa kare|
tumi ki dekho nA ye, tArA prati upatyakAYa udbhrAnta haYe phere?
nizcaYai tArA emana kathA vale, yA tArA kare nA|

tave tArA vyatIta, yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare evaM AllAhake adhika smaraNa kare evaM nipIr3ita haoYAra para pratizeAdha grahaNa kare| Ara nipIr3anakArIrA zigagira jAnate pArave, kona gantavyasthale tArA phire yAve|
tvA sI-na; eguleA kuraAna evaM suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
mu’minadera janya pathanirdeza o susaMvAda|
yArA sAlAta kAYema kare, yAkAta pradAna kare evaM parakAlera prati nizcita vizvAsI|
nizcaYai yArA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA, Ami tAdera dRSTite tAdera karmakANDake suzeAbhita karechi| phale, tArA vibhrAntite ghure ver3AYa|
tAdera janyai raYeche nikRSTa zAsti, Ara tArAi parakAle sarvAdhika kSatigrasta|
Ara tomAke kuraAna pradAna karA haYeche prajJAmaYa, sarvajJera nikaTa theke|

smaraNa karo, yakhana mUsA tAra parivAravargake valala, ‘Ami Agunera sandhAna peYechi| acirei Ami sekhAna theke teAmAdera janya keAno khavara Anava athavA Anava teAmAdera janya jvalanta aGgAra| yena teAmarA Aguna peAhAte pAro|’
ataHpara yakhana se Agunera kAche ela takhana ghoSita halo; ‘dhanya se, ye Ache Agunera madhye Ara yArA Ache Agunera cArapAze| Ara jagatasamUhera rava AllAha pavitra o mahimAnvita|’
‘he mUsA, nizcaYai Amii AllAha, parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|’

‘tumi tomAra lAThi nikSepa karo|’ ataHpara yakhana se tAke sApera mato choTAchuTi karate dekhala, takhana se pechanera dike chuTate lAgala evaM pechana phireo dekhala nA| valA halo, ‘he mUsA, bhaYa peYo nA| nizcaYai Ami (emana) ye AmAra sAnnidhye rAsUlagaNa bhaYa pAYa nA|’
‘tave ye sImAlaGghana karAra para manda karmera parivarte satkarma kare, tave to nizcaYai Ami kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|’

‘tomAra hAta tomAra vagale praveza karAo; tA vera have sAdA haYe truTihIna avasthAYa eguleA phiraAuna o tAra sampradAYera kAche AnIta naYaTi nidarzanera antargata| nizcaYai tArA chila pApAcArI sampradAYa|’
ataHpara yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra ujjvala nidarzanAvali ela, takhana tArA valala, ‘eTA teA suspaSTa jAdu|’
Ara tArA anyAYa o ahaMkAra kare nidarzanAvalike pratyAkhyAna karala, yadio tAdera antara eguleA satya vale vizvAsa karechila| ataeva, dekho, nairAjya sRSTikArIdera pariNAma kemana haYechila?
Ami avazyai dAUda o sulAimAnake jJAna dAna karechilAma| tArA valechila, ‘AllAhara prazaMsA, yini AmAdera tA~ra aneka mu ’ mina vAndAra opara zreSThatva dAna karechena|’
sulAimAna dAUdera uttarAdhikArI haYechila| valechila, ‘he leAkasakala, AmAke zikSA deoYA haYeche pAkhidera bhASA evaM AmAke sava kichu deoYA haYeche| nizcaYai eTA suspaSTa anugraha|’
sulAimAnera sAmane tAra vAhinIke samaveta karA halo| jina-mAnuSa o pAkhiderake, ataHpara tAderake vinyasta karA halo (vibhinna sArite)|

yakhana tArA pau~chAla pi~par3A adhyuSita upatyakAYa, takhana eka pi~par3A valala, ‘he pi~par3Ara dala, teAmarA teAmAdera ghare praveza karo| anyathAYa sulAimAna o tAra vAhinI ajJAtasAre teAmAderake piSTa kare nA phele|’

sulAimAna tAra kathA zune mucaki hAsala evaM valala, ‘he AmAra rava, tumi AmAke tAophika dAo, yena Ami teAmAra sei niYAmAtera kRtajJatA prakAza karate pAri, yA tumi AmAke o AmAra pitA-mAtAke dAna karecha evaM yena Ami teAmAra pachandanIYa satkAja karate pAri evaM AmAke nija anugrahe teAmAra satkarmaparAYaNa vAndAdera antarbhukta karo|’
Ara se (sulAimAna) pAkhidera kheA~ja-khavara nila, ataHpara valala, ‘AmAra kI halo, Ami hudahudake dekhachi nA? nA ki se anupasthita?’
‘Ami avazyai tAke kaTheAra zAsti deva vA hatyA karava athavA se darzAve upayukta kAraNa|’
anativilamve hudahuda ese valala, ‘Apani yA avagata nana tA Ami avagata haYe esechi evaM sAvA theke nizcita saMvAda niYe esechi|’
‘Ami eka nArIke sAvAvAsIdera opara rAjatva karate dekhechi| tAke savakichui deoYA haYeche Ara tAra raYeche virATa siMhAsana|’

‘Ami tAke o tAra sampradAYake AllAhara parivarte sUryake sijadAha karate dekhechi| zaYatAna tAdera dRSTite tAdera kAryAvali suzeAbhita kare diYeche evaM tAdera satpatha theke nivRtta kareche| phale tArA hidAYAta pAcche nA|’
‘yena tArA AllAhake sijadAha nA kare yini AsamAnasamUha o yaminera geApana vastu prakAza karena evaM jAnena yA teAmarA geApana kara o yA prakAza kara|’
‘AllAha vyatIta keAno ilAh nei; tini mahAArazera rava|’
se (sulAimAna) valala, ‘ekhana Ami dekhava tumi satya valacha, nA tumi mithyavAdI|’
‘tumi AmAra ei patra niYe yAo evaM eTA tAdera kAche arpaNa karo| ataHpara tAdera kAcha theke sare par3o evaM dekho, tArA kI pratikriYA dekhAYa |’
(vilakIsa) valala, ‘he pAriSadavarga, AmAke ekaTi sammAnitapatra deoYA haYeche|’
‘sei patra sulAimAnera pakSa theke evaM tA parama karuNAmaYa asIma daYAlu, AllAhara nAme|’
‘AmAra meAkAvelAYa ahaMkAra pradarzana kareA nA evaM vazyatA svIkAra kare AmAra kAche upasthita hao|’
se (vilakIsa) valala, ‘he pAriSadavarga, AmAke AmAra ei viSaYe parAmarza dAo| teAmAdera upasthiti vyatIta Ami keAno kAje siddhAnta grahaNa kari nA|’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA zaktizAlI evaM kaTheAra yeAddhA| tave siddhAnta grahaNera kSamatA ApanArai| ataeva, Apani bheve dekhuna, AmAdera kI Adeza karavena|’
se valala, ‘rAjA-vAdazAharA yakhana keAno janapade praveza kare, takhana tAke viparyasta kare deYa evaM sekhAnakAra sambhrAnta vyaktivargake apadastha kare| tArAo emanai karave|’
‘Ami tA~ra kAche kichu upaDhaukana pAThAcchi; dekhi dUterA kI niYe phire Ase|’

ataHpara yakhana (dUta) sulAimAnera kAche ela, takhana sulAimAna valala, ‘teAmarA ki dhana-sampada dvArA AmAke sAhAyya karate cAo? athaca AllAha AmAke yA diYechena, tA teAmAderake deoYA vastu theke uttama; varaM teAmarAi teAmAdera upaDhaukana niYe sukhe thAko|’

‘phire yAo tAdera kAche| ekhana avazyai Ami tAdera viruddhe eka sainyavAhinI niYe Asava, yAra meAkAvelA karAra zakti tAdera nei| Ami avazyai tAdera apadastha kare sekhAna theke vahiSkRta karava evaM tArA have avanamita|’
se (sulAimAna) valala, ‘he pAriSadavarga, tArA AtmasamarpaNa kare AmAra kAche AsAra pUrve tomAdera ke vilakIsera siMhAsana AmAke ene deve?’
janaika daitya-jina valala, ‘Apani ApanAra sthAna theke oThAra pUrve Ami tA ene deva evaM Ami ekAje zaktivAna, vizvasta|’

kitAvera jJAna yAra chila, se valala, ‘Apani ceAkhera palaka phelAra pUrvei Ami tA ApanAke ene deva|’ ataHpara sulAimAna yakhana tA sAmane rakSita dekhala, takhana valala, ‘eTA AmAra ravera anugraha, yena tini AmAke parIkSA karena ye, Ami ki kRtajJatA prakAza kari, nAki akRtajJatA prakAza kari! ye kRtajJatA prakAza kare, se nijera upakArera janyai kRtajJatA prakAza kare evaM ye akRtajJatA prakAza kare se jAnuka ye, AmAra rava abhAvamukta mahAnubhava|’
se (sulAimAna) valala, ‘tAra siMhAsanera (AkAra-AkRti) vadale dAo, dekhi se ki saThika dizA pAYa, nAki se tAdera antarbhukta haYa, yArA vibhrAnta|’

ataHpara yakhana se ese gela, takhana tAke valA halo, ‘teAmAra siMhAsana ki emanai?’ se valala, ‘eTA to yena seTAi|’ vastuta AmAderake itaHpUrvei jJAna dAna karA haYaYeche evaM AmarA AtmasamarpaNa karechi|
AllAhara parivarte se yAra ivAdAta karata, se-i tAke ImAna theke nivRtta karechila| nizcaYai se kAphira sampradAYera antarbhukta chila|

tAke valA halo, ‘ei prAsAde praveza karo|’ yakhana se tA dekhala, se dhAraNA karala ye, eTA svaccha agabhIra jalAzaYa| se tAra pAYera geAchA anAvRta kare phelala| se (sulAimAna) valala, ‘eTA teA svaccha sphaTika nirmita mejheYa|’ se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Ami teA nijera prati yuluma karechi! Ami sulAimAnera sAthe jagatasamUhera rava AllAhara nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karalAma|’
Ami sAmUda sampradAYera kAche tAdera bhAi sAlehake (ei marme) pAThiYechi ye, teAmarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo| ataHpara tArA dvidhAvibhakta haYe vitarke pravRtta halo|
se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA kalyANera pUrve kena druta akalyANa kAmanA karacha? teAmarA kena AllAhara kAche kSamAprArthanA karacha nA? sambhavata teAmarA anugrahabhAjana have|’

tArA valala, ‘teAmAke evaM teAmAra sAthe yArA Ache, tAderake AmarA akalyANera pratIka mane kari|’ se (sAleha) valala, ‘teAmAdera amaGgala AllAhara kAche; varaM teAmarA emana sampradAYa, yAderake parIkSA karA hacche|’
Ara sei zahare chila emana naYajana vyakti, yArA dezamaYa trAsa sRSTi kare ver3Ata evaM saMzeAdhana karata nA|

tArA valala, ‘teAmarA paraspare AllAhara nAme zapatha grahaNa karo ye, AmarA rAtera velA tAke o tAra parivAravargake hatyA karava| ataHpara tAra abhibhAvakake vale deva ye, tAra parivAravargera hatyAkANDa AmarA pratyakSa karini, Ara AmarA nizcaYai satyavAdI|’
tArA eka cakrAnta karechila evaM Amio cakrAntera ucita zikSA diYechi; kintu tArA vujhate pAreni|
ataeva, dekho tAdera cakrAntera pariNAma, Ami avazyai tAdera evaM tAdera sampradAYake nAstAnAvuda kare diYechi|
ei teA tAdera vAr3i-ghara tAdera sImAlaGghanera kAraNe janazUnya avasthAYa par3e Ache| nizcaYai ete jJAnI sampradAYera janya avazyai nidarzana Ache|
yArA ImAna enechila evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karata, tAderake Ami uddhAra karechi|
smaraNa karo lUtera kathA, yakhana se tA~ra kaomake valechila, ‘teAmarA kena azlIla kAja karacha? athaca (era pariNatira kathA) teAmarA pratyakSa karacha|’
‘teAmarA ki kAmatRptira janya nArIdera parivarte puruSe upagata haccha? varaM teAmarA teA eka ajJa sampradAYa|’
uttare tAra kaoma zudhu e kathATii valala, ‘lUta-parivArake teAmAdera janapada theke vera kare dAo| ei lokerA zudhu pavitra thAkate cAYa|’
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra parivAravargake uddhAra karalAma; tAra strI vyatIta| kAraNa, tAra janya dhvaMsaprAptadera bhAgyai nirdhArita karechilAma|
Ara tAdera upara varSaNa karechilAma muSaladhAre vRSTi| bhIti pradarzitadera janya katai nA mArAtmaka chila se vRSTi!
valo, ‘sakala prazaMsAi AllAhara evaM zAnti tAra maneAnIta vAndAgaNera prati|’ zreSTha ki AllAha, nAki odera sAvyasta karA zarikarA?

athavA ke sRSTi karechena AsamAnasamUha o yamina evaM AkAza theke teAmAdera janya varSaNa karechena vAri; ataHpara tA dvArA Ami sRSTi karechi maneArama vAgAna| tomAdera emana kSamatA nei ye tomarA tAra gAchapAlA utpanna karave| ataeva, AllAhara sAthe anya keAno ilAh Ache ki? varaM tArA emana eka sampradAYa yArA samakakSa sAvyasta kare|

athavA ke pRthivIke vasavAsera upayogI karechena evaM tAra mAjhe nada-nadI (pravAhita) karechena evaM tAke sthita rAkhAra janya parvata sthApana karechena evaM dui samudrera mAjhakhAne antarAYa rekhechena| ataeva, AllAhara sAthe anya keAno ilAh Ache ki? varaM tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

athavA ke niHsahAYera DAke sAr3A deYa yakhana se DAke evaM vipada-Apada dUrIbhUta karena evaM teAmAderake pRthivIte pUrvavartIdera sthalAbhiSikta karena| sutarAM AllAhara sAthe anya keAno upAsya Ache ki? teAmarA ati sAmAnyai upadeza grahaNa karo|

athavA ke teAmAderake jale o sthalera andhakAre patha dekhAna evaM yini tA~ra (vRSTirUpa) rAhamAtera pUrve susaMvAdavAhI vAtAsa preraNa karena? ataeva, AllAhara sAthe anya keAno upAsya Ache ki? tArA yAdera zarika kare, AllAha tA theke vahu Urdhve|

athavA ke (prathamavAra) sRSTi karena, ataHpara tAke punarAYa sRSTi karavena evaM ke teAmAderake AkAza o pRthivI theke riyika dAna karena? sutarAM AllAhara sAthe anya keAno upAsya Ache ki? valo, ‘teAmarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave teAmAdera pramANa upasthita karo|’
valo, ‘AllAha vyatIta AsamAna o yamine keu gAYavera khavara jAne nA evaM tArA jAne nA ye, tAdera kakhana punarutthita karA have|’
varaM parakAla samparke tAdera jJAna nAgAla pAYani; varaM tArA e viSaYe sandigdha, varaM e viSaYe tArA andha|
kAphirarA vale, ‘yakhana AmarA o AmAdera vApa-dAdArA mRttikA haYe yAva, takhano ki AmAderake punarutthita karA have?’
‘ei viSaYe AmAderake o pUrve AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderakeo bhIti pradarzana karA haYeche, eTA teA pUrvavartIdera rUpakathA chAr3A kichu naYa!’
valo, ‘pRthivI paribhramaNa karo evaM dekho, kemana haYechila aparAdhIdera pariNati|’
tAdera kAraNe tumi duHkhita haYo nA evaM tArA ye cakrAnta kare tA niYe (manera) saMkIrNatAra madhye thAkave nA|
tArA vale, ‘teAmarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave valo, kave Asave sei pratizruta viSaYa?’
valo, ‘sambhavata hacche ye tAra kichu viSaYa teAmAdera (piThera opara) kAche ese geche, teAmarA yA druta kAmanA karacha|’
Ara nizcaYai tomAra rava mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA|
tAdera antara yA geApana kare evaM tArA yA prakAza kare tomAra rava avazyai tA jAnena|
AkAze o pRthivIte emana keAno geApana viSaYa nei, yA suspaSTa kitAve nei|
ei kuraAna vani isarAIlera kAche varNanA kare, tArA ye viSaYe matabheda kare tAra adhikAMza viSaYa|
evaM nizcaYai eTA mu’minadera janya hidAYAta o rAhamAta|
tomAra rava tAra vidhAna anuyAYI tAdera madhye phAYasAlA kare devena| tini parAkramazAlI, sarvajJa|
ataeva, tumi AllAhara opara bharasA karo| nizcaYai tumi spaSTa satyera opara pratiSThita|
tumi AhvAna zeAnAte pArave nA mRtaderake evaM vadhirakeo naYa, yakhana tArA pRSTha pradarzana kare cale yAYa|
tumi andhaderake tAdera pathabhraSTatA theke phiriYe satpathe Anate pArave nA| tumi kevala tAderake zeAnAte pArave, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhera prati ImAna Ane| tArAi AtmasamarpaNakArI|

evaM yakhana pratizruti (kiYAmAta) samAgata have, takhana Ami tAdera sAmane bhUgarbha theke ekaTi jIva nirgata karava| se mAnuSera sAthe kathA valave| e kAraNe ye mAnuSa AmAra nidarzanasamUhe vizvAsa karata nA|
yedina Ami ekatrita karava pratyeka sampradAYa theke eka-ekaTi dalake yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA sAvyasta karata; ataHpara tAderake vibhinna dale vibhakta karA have|

avazeSe yakhana tArA upasthita have, takhana AllAha valavena, ‘teAmarA ki AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA sAvyasta karechile? athaca jJAnagata dika theke eguleA samparke tomAdera kono dhAraNA chila nA| nA teAmarA anya kichu karachile?’
tAdera opara (zAstira) oYAdA ese geche, ekAraNe ye tArA yuluma kareche| phale tArA keAno kichu valate pArave nA|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami rAta sRSTi karechi tAdera vizrAmera janya evaM dinake karechi AleAkamaYa| nizcaYai ete sei sampradAYera janya aneka nidarzana raYeche yArA ImAna Ane|
yedina siGgAYa phutkAra deoYA have, AllAha yAderake icchA karavena, tArA vyatIta AkAze o yamine yArA Ache, tArA savAi bhItavihvala haYe par3ave evaM sakalei tA~ra kAche Asave vinIta avasthAYa|

tumi parvatamAlAke dekho, mane karo tA sthira, athaca eguleA meghamAlAra calAra mato calamAna have; eTA AllAhara sRSTinaipuNya, yini savakichuke karechena susaMhata| teAmarA yA kichu karacha, tini se samparke samyaka avagata|
ye satkarma niYe Asave, se tAra ceYe utkRSTa pratidAna pAve evaM sedina tArA bhItasantrastatA theke nirApada thAkave|
evaM ye mandakAja niYe Asave, tAke adhaHmukhe nikSepa karA have Agunera madhye| teAmarA yA karachile, tArai pratiphala teAmarA pAve|
Ami teA kevala ei nagarIra ravera ivAdAta karate AdiSTa haYechi, yini eke sammAnita karechena evaM savakichu tA~rai| Ami Arao AdiSTa haYechi yena Ami AtmasamarpaNakArIdera antarbhukta hai|
evaM yena Ami kuraAna tilAoYAta kari; sutarAM ye vyakti satpathe cale, se nijera kalyANArthei satpathe cale evaM keu pathabhraSTa hale tumi vale dAo, Ami teA kevala ekajana bhItipradarzanakArI|
evaM tumi valo, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAhara| satvarai tini tA~ra nidarzanasamUha teAmAderake dekhAvena| takhana teAmarA tA cinate pArave|’ Ara teAmarA yA karo, se samparke tomAra rava udAsIna nana|
tva sI-na mI-ma|
eguleA suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
Ami tomAra kAche mUsA o phiraAunera vRttAnta satyasaha varNanA karachi emana sampradAYera janya yArA ImAna Ane|

nizcaYai phiraAuna yamine uddhata haYechila evaM se dezavAsIke aneka dale vibhakta kare tAdera ekaTi dalake durvala kareche| se tAdera putra-santAnaderake hatyA kareche evaM nArIderake jIvita rekheche| nizcaYai se chila viparyaYa sRSTikArI|
Ami tAderake anugraha karAra icchA karalAma yAderake jamine durvala kare rAkhA haYechila, tAderake netRtva dAna karate evaM tAderake dezera uttarAdhikArI karate|
Ara tAderake dezera kSamatAYa AsIna karava evaM phiraAuna, hAmAna o tAdera sainya-vAhinIke tA dekhiYe deva, yA tArA sei durvala dalera tarapha theke AzaGkA karata|

Ara Ami mUsA-jananIke iGgite nirdeza karalAma ye, ‘tAke dudhapAna karAte thAko| ataHpara yakhana tumi tAke niYe vipadera AzaGkA karo, takhana tAke dariYAYa nikSepa karo evaM bhaYa kareA nA, duHkhao kareA nA| Ami avazyai tAke teAmAra kAche phiriYe deva evaM tAke rAsUladera antarbhukta karava|’
ataHpara phiraAunera parivAra mUsAke kur3iYe nila, yena se tAdera zatru o duHkhera kAraNa haYa| nizcaYai phiraAuna, hAmAna, o tAdera sainyavAhinI chila aparAdhI|
phiraAunera strI valala, ‘e zizu AmAra o teAmAra cokhera zItalatA, tAke hatyA kareA nA| e AmAdera upakAre Asate pAre athavA AmarA tAke putra kare nite pAri, Ara tArA pariNAma anubhava karate pAreni|’
mUsAra mAYera antara asthira haYe par3ala| yadi Ami tAra hRdaYe dRr3hatA nA ditAma, tave se tAra asthiratA prakAza karei dita| dRr3ha karalAma, yAte se haYa mu’minadera antarbhukta|
se tAra vonake valala, ‘tAra pichu nAo|’ se tAdera ajJAtasAre dUra theke tAke dekhe yete lAgala|

Age thekei mUsAra opara Ami dhAtrIstanya pAna niSiddha kare rekhechilAma| phale se valala, ‘Ami teAmAderake emana eka parivArera kathA valava ki, yArA teAmAdera janya eke lAlana-pAlana karave evaM tArA have tAra hitAkAGkSI?’
ataHpara Ami tAke tAra mAYera kAche phiriYe dilAma, yena tAra cakSu jur3AYa evaM se duHkha nA kare evaM yena se jene nAYa ye, AllAhara oYAdA satya, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
yakhana mUsA yauvane padArpaNa karala evaM tAra yauvana pariNata halo takhana Ami tAke prajJA o jJAna dAna karalAma| ebhAve Ami satkarmIdera pratidAna diYe thAki|

se (ekadina) zahare praveza karala, yakhana tAra adhivAsIrA asatarka chila| sekhAne se dui vyaktike lar3Airata dekhala| edera ekajana chila tAra nija dalera evaM anyajana tAra zatrudalera| ataHpara ye tAra nija dalera se tAra zatrudalera leAkaTira viruddhe tAra kAche sAhAyya prArthanA karala| takhana mUsA tAke ghuSi mArala evaM etei cuke gela tAra vyApAra (mRtyu halo|) se valala, ‘eTA zaYatAnera kAja| nizcaYai se prakAzya zatru, vibhrAntakArI|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, nizcaYai Ami nijera opara sImAlaGghana karechi| ataeva, AmAke kSamA karuna|’ phale tini tAke kSamA karalena| nizcaYai tini kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Apani AmAra prati ye anugraha karechena, erapara Ami kakhanao aparAdhIdera sAhAyyakArI hava nA|’

ataHpara bhIta-zaGkita avasthAYa ukta nagarIte prabhAta halo| haThAt se dekhala, gatakAla ye vyakti tAra sAhAyya ceYechila, se citkAra kare (AvArao) tAke DAkache| mUsA tAke valala, ‘tumi teA ekajana prakAzya pathabhraSTa vyakti|’

ataHpara mUsA yakhana ubhaYera zatruke zAYestA karate cAila, takhana se valala, ‘gatakAla tumi yemana eka vyaktike hatyA karechile, se rakama AmAkeo ki hatyA karate cAo? tumi e vyatIta kichu cAo nA ye tumi teA pRthivIte svairAcArI hate cAccha evaM tumi cAo nA ye tumi saMzodhanakArIdera antarbhukta have|’
zaharera prAnta theke eka vyakti daur3e ela evaM valala, ‘he mUsA, rAjyera pAriSadavarga teAmAke hatyA karAra paramarza karache| ataeva, tumi vera haYe yAo| Ami teAmAra kalyANakAmIdera antarbhukta|’
ataHpara se sekhAna theke bhIta avasthAYa vera halo patha dekhate dekhate| se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYera kavala theke rakSA karuna|’
yakhana se mAdAYena abhimukhe raonA halo takhana valala, ‘AzA karA yAYa AmAra rava AmAke sarala patha dekhAvena|’

yakhana se mAdaiYAnera kUpera dhAre pau~chala, takhana kUpera kAche ekadala leAkake pela tArA jantudera (pAni) pAna karAneAra kAje rata evaM tAdera pechane dujana strIleAkake dekhala, tArA tAdera (jantudera) Agale rAkhache| se valala, ‘teAmAdera vyApAra kI?’ tArA valala, ‘AmarA (AmAdera jantudera pAni) pAna karAte pAri nA, yatakSaNa nA rAkhAlarA (tAdera jantudera) niYe sare yAYa| AmAdera pitA ati vRddha|’
se takhana tAdera jantudera pAni pAna karAla| ataHpara se chAYAra nice AzraYa grahaNa kare valala, ‘he AmAra rava, tumi AmAra prati yA avatIrNa karave anugraha theke, Ami tAra mukhApekSI|’

takhana tAdera dujanera ekajana lajjAvanata avasthAYa tAra kAche he~Te ela| valala, ‘AmAra pitA ApanAke DAkachena, yena Apani ye AmAdera pAni pAna kariYechena, tAra vinimaYe pArizramika pradAna karena|’ ataHpara se yakhana tAra kAche gela evaM vRttAnta varNanA karala, takhana se valala, ‘bhaYa kareA nA, tumi sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYa theke rakSA peYecha|’
tAdera dujanera ekajana valala, ‘he AmAra pitA, tAke zramika niyukta karena| kenanA, Apani zramika hiseve yAke niyukta karavena se-i uttama have, ye zaktizAlI o vizvasta|’

pitA mUsAke valala, ‘Ami AmAra ei dui kanyAra ekajanake teAmAra kAche viYe dite cAi ei zarte ye, tumi ATa vachara AmAke zrama deve| yadi tumi daza vachara pUrNa karo, tAhale teAmAra pakSa theke (tA aicchika)| Ami cAi nA ye teAmAra opara Ami kaSTa cApiYe deva| AllAha cAna teA tumi AmAke satkarmaparAYaNa pAve|’

mUsA valala, ‘AmAra o ApanAra madhye ei cukti sthira halo| duTi meYAdera madhya theke ye keAno ekaTi pUrNa karale AmAra viruddhe keAno abhiyeAga thAkave nA| AmarA yA valachi, tAte AllAhara opara bharasA|’

ataHpara mUsA yakhana sei meYAda pUrNa karala evaM tAra parivAra niYe yAtrA karala, takhana se dekhate pela Aguna tUra parvatera dika theke; se tAra parivAravargake valala, ‘teAmarA apekSA karo, Ami Aguna dekhechi| AzA karachi Ami sekhAna theke teAmAdera kAche keAno khavara niYe Asava athavA Agunera aGgAra Anate pArava, yena teAmarA Aguna peAhAte pAro|’
yakhana se tAra kAche pauchala, takhana varakatamaYa bhUmite avasthita upatyakAra DAna prAntera gAcha theke tAke AoYAja deoYA halo, ‘he mUsA, Ami AllAha, jagatasamUhera rava|’

‘tumi teAmAra lAThi nikSepa karo|’ ataHpara yakhana se lAThike dekhala tA daur3Acche sApera mato, se phire gela pRSTha pradarzana kare; Ara se phire tAkAla nA; (Ami valalAma) ‘he mUsA, sAmane eso, evaM bhaYa karo nA; nizcaYai tumi nirApadadera antarbhukta|’

‘teAmAra hAta tomAra vagalera madhye rAkho| tA truTimukta avasthAYa zubhrojjvala haYe veriYe Asave evaM bhaYa theke rakSAra janya tomAra hAta nijera sAthe melAo| ei duTi phiraAuna o tAra pAriSadavargera prati teAmAra ravera pakSa theke pramANa| nizcaYai tArA pApAcArI sampradAYa|’
mUsA valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Ami tAdera eka vyaktike hatyA karechi| tAi Ami bhaYa karachi ye, tArA AmAke hatyA karave|’
‘AmAra bhAi hArUna, se bhASAYa AmAra ceYe spaSTabhASI| ataeva, tAke AmAra sAthe sAhAyyera janya preraNa karuna| se AmAke samarthana jAnAve| Ami AzaGkA kari ye, tArA AmAke mithyA sAvyasta karave|’

tini valalena, ‘satvara Ami teAmAra vAhu zaktizAlI karava teAmAra bhAike diYe evaM teAmAdera kSamatA dAna karava| phale, tArA teAmAra kAche pau~chate pArave nA| AmAra nidarzanAvalira zaktite teAmarA evaM teAmAdera anusArIrA pravala thAkave|’
ataHpara mUsA yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra suspaSTa nidarzanAvali niYe pau~chala, takhana tArA valala, ‘e teA alIka jAdu vyatIta kichu naYa| AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera madhye e kathA zunini|’
mUsA valala, ‘AmAra rava adhika avagata ye, ke tAra nikaTa theke hidAYAta niYe Agamana kareche evaM kAra janya have zubha pariNAma| nizcaYai sImAlaGghanakArIrA saphalakAma have nA|’

phiraAuna valala, ‘he pAriSadavarga, Ami jAni nA, Ami vyatIta teAmAdera keAno upAsya Ache| he hAmAna, tumi AmAra janya Aguna jvAlAo mATira upara (iTa peAr3Ao), ataHpara AmAra janya ekaTi prAsAda nirmANa karo, yAte Ami mUsAra ilAhera dike u~ki mere dekhate pAri| AmAra teA dhAraNA ei ye, se ekajana mithyAvAdI|’
phiraAuna o tAra vAhinI anyAYabhAve pRthivIte ahaMkAra karate lAgala evaM tArA mane karala ye, tAderake AmAra kAche phiriYe AnA have nA|
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra vAhinIke pAkar3Ao karalAma evaM tAderake dariYAra madhye nikSepa karalAma| dekho, sImAlaGghanakArIdera pariNAma kemana chila!
Ami tAderake netA karechilAma| tArA jAhAnnAmera dike AhvAna karata| kiYAmAtera dina tAderake kono sAhAyya karA have nA|
Ami ei pRthivIte abhizApake tAdera pazcAte lAgiYe diYechi evaM kiYAmAtera dina tArA have durdazAgrasta|
Ami pUrvavartI aneka sampradAYake dhvaMsa karAra para mUsAke kitAva diYechi yA mAnuSera janya jJAnavartikA, hidAYAta o rAhamAtasvarUpa, yena tArA smaraNa rAkhe|
mUsAke yakhana Ami nirdezanAmA diYechilAma, takhana tumi pazcima prAnte chile nA evaM chile nA tumi pratyakSadarzIo|

kintu Ami aneka sampradAYa sRSTi karechilAma, ataHpara tAdera aneka yuga ativAhita haYeche| Ara tumi mAdaiYAnera adhivAsIdera madhye vAsindA chile nA ye, tAdera kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karave; kintu Amii chilAma rAsUla preraNakArI|

Ami yakhana mUsAke DAka diYechilAma, takhana tumi tUra parvatera pArzve chile nA| kintu eTA tomAra ravera rAhamAtasvarUpa, yAte tumi emana eka sampradAYake bhItipradarzana karo, yAdera kAche tomAra pUrve keAno bhItipradarzanakArI Agamana kareni, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe tAdera opara kono vipada Asale tArA yena valate nA pAre—‘he AmAdera rava, AmAdera kAche ekajana rAsUla preraNa karalena nA kena? tAhale AmarA ApanAra AYAtera anusaraNa karatAma, evaM haYe yetAma mu’minadera antarbhukta|’

ataHpara AmAra kAcha theke yakhana tAdera kAche satya Agamana karala, takhana tArA valala, ‘mUsAke yerUpa deoYA haYechila, ei rAsUlake serUpa deoYA halo nA kena?’ pUrve mUsAke yA deoYA haYechila, tArA ki tA asvIkAra kareni? tArA valechila, ‘ubhaYaTAi jAdu, parasparake samarthana kare|’ tArA Arao valechila, ‘AmarA savagulokei asvIkAra karachi|’
valo, ‘teAmarA satyavAdI hale ekhana AllAhara kAcha theke keAno kitAva Ano, yA seduTi theke uttama pathapradarzaka haYa| Ami sei kitAva anusaraNa karava|’

ataHpara tArA yadi tomAra kathAYa sAr3A nA deYa, tave jAnave, tArA zudhu nijedera pravRttira anusaraNa kare| tAra cAite adhika pathabhraSTa Ara ke? AllAhara hidAYAtera parivarte ye nija pravRttira anusaraNa kare, nizcaYai AllAha sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYake patha dekhAna nA|
Ami tAdera kAche dhArAvAhikabhAve vANI pau~chiYechi| yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
kuraAnera pUrve Ami yAdera kitAva diYechi, tArA tAra prati ImAna Ane|
yakhana tAdera kAche eTA pATha karA haYa, takhana tArA vale, ‘AmarA tAra prati ImAna AnalAma| eTA AmAdera ravera pakSa theke satya| AmarA era pUrveo AtmasamarpaNakArI chilAma|’
tAderake deoYA have tAdera puraskAra duivAra, ye dhairya tArA dhAraNa kareche tAra vinimaYe| tArA mandake bhAlo diYe pratihata kare evaM Ami tAderake ye riyika diYechi, tA theke vyaYa kare|

yakhana tArA kono anarthaka kathAvArtA zone takhana tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa evaM vale, ‘AmAdera janya AmAdera kAja evaM teAmAdera janya teAmAdera kAja| teAmAdera prati sAlAma| AmarA mUrkha hate cAi nA|’
tumi yAke bhAlovAsa, tAkei hidAYAta dite pArave nA; varaM AllAha yAke icchA hidAYAta dAna karena| Ara hidAYAtaprAptadera samparke AllAhai savace vezi avagata|

tArA vale, ‘yadi AmarA tomAra sAthe supathera anusaraNa kari, tave AmAderake utkhAta karA have AmAdera deza theke;’ Ami ki tAderake ekaTi nirApada sammAnita sthAne pratiSThita karini? sekhAne sarvaprakAra phala-mUla AmadAni haYa AmAra pakSa theke deoYA riyikasvarUpa| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

Ami aneka janapada dhvaMsa karechi, yAra adhivAsIrA tAdera jIvana-jIvikA niYe ahaMkAra karata| eguleAi ekhana tAdera ghara-vAr3i| tAdera para eguleAte sAmAnyai vasavAsa karA haYeche| avazeSe Amii uttarAdhikArI raYechi|

tomAra rava janapadasamUhake dhvaMsa karena nA, yatakSaNa nA tAra kendrasthale rAsUla preraNa karena, ye tAdera kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha kare evaM Ami janapadasamUhake takhanai dhvaMsa kari, yakhana tAra vAsindArA sImAlaGghanakArI|
teAmAdera yA-kichu deoYA haYeche, tA kevala pArthivajIvanera kSaNikera bheAga o zeAbhA| Ara AllAhara kAche yA Ache, tA uttama o sthAYI| teAmarA ki veAjho nA?
yAke Ami uttama pratizruti diYechi, se tA pAve, se ki oi vyaktira mato, yAke Ami pArthiva jIvanera kSaNikera bheAga-sambhAra diYechi, ataHpara tAke kiYAmAtera dina aparAdhIrUpe hAyira karA have?
yedina AllAha tAderake DAka diYe valavena, ‘teAmarA yAderake AmAra zarika dAvi karate, tArA keAthAYa?’

yAdera janya zAsti avadhArita haYeche, tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA edera vibhrAnta karechi; AmarA tAdera vibhrAnta karechilAma, yemana AmarA haYechilAma| AmarA ApanAra sAmane dAYamukta hacchi| tArA zudhu AmAderai upAsanA karata nA|’
valA have, ‘teAmarA teAmAdera zarikaderake AhvAna karo|’ takhana tArA DAkave| ataHpara tArA tAdera DAke sAr3A deve nA, varaM tArA zAsti dekhave| hAYa! tArA yadi hidAYAta peta!
sedina tini tAderake Deke valavena, ‘teAmarA rAsUladerake kI uttara diYechile?’
tAdera kathAvArtA vandha haYe yAve evaM tArA eke aparake kichu jijJAsAo karate pArave nA|
tave ye tAovA kare, ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, AzA karA yAYa, se saphalakAma have|
tomAra rava yA icchA o nirvAcana karena tA-i sRSTi karena| tAdera keAno kSamatA nei| AllAha pavitra evaM tArA yAke zarika kare, tA theke Urdhve|
tAdera antara yA geApana kare evaM yA prakAza kare, tomAra rava tA jAnena|
tinii AllAha, tini vyatIta keAno ilAh nei| zuru o zeSe tA~rai prazaMsA| tinii vidhAna praNetA evaM tA~rai kAche tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have|
valo, ‘tomarA ki bheve dekhecha, AllAha yadi rAtake kiYAmAtera dina paryanta sthAYI karena, tave AllAha vyatIta emana ilAh ke Ache, ye teAmAdera AleA ene devena? tavuo ki teAmarA zunave nA?’

valo, ‘tomarA ki bheve dekhecha, AllAha yadi dinake kiYAmAtera dina paryanta sthAYI karena, tave AllAha vyatIta emana ilAh ke Ache, ye teAmAderake rAtri dAna karate pAre, yAte teAmarA vizrAma karave? teAmarA ki tavuo bheve dekhave nA?’
tinii tA~ra rAhamAte teAmAdera janya rAta o dina karechena, yAte teAmarA tAte vizrAma grahaNa karo o tA~ra anugraha anveSaNa karo evaM yAte teAmarA kRtajJatA prakAza karo|
yedina AllAha tAdera Deke valavena, ‘teAmarA yAderake AmAra zarika mane karate, tArA keAthAYa?’

pratyeka sampradAYa theke Ami ekajana sAkSI AlAdA karava; tArapara valava, ‘teAmAdera pramANa Ano;’ takhana tArA jAnate pArave ye, satya AllAharai janya evaM tA tAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe yAve yA tArA mithyA racanA karata|

kArUna chila mUsAra sampradAYabhukta| tavuo se tAdera sAthe uddhata AcaraNa karala| Ami tAke eta dhana-bhAnDAra dAna karechilAma yAra cAvi vahana karate giYe kaYekajana zaktizAlI nuYe par3ata| yakhana tAra sampradAYa tAke valala, ‘dambha kareA nA, AllAha dAmbhikadera bhAlovAsena nA|’

‘AllAha teAmAke yA dAna karechena, tA dvArA parakAlera nivAsa anusandhAna karo, tave ihakAla theke teAmAra aMza bhule yeYeA nA| tumi anugraha karo, yemana AllAha teAmAra prati anugraha karechena evaM pRthivIte phAsAda sRSTira patha kho~jo nA| nizcaYai AllAha phAsAda sRSTikArIdera pachanda karena nA|’

se valala, ‘ei dhana AmAke AmAra nija jJAna-garimAra kAraNei deoYA haYeche|’ se ki jAne nA ye, AllAha tAra pUrve aneka sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechena, yArA zaktite chila tAra cAite pravala evaM dhana-sampade adhika prAcuryazIla? pApIdera ki tAdera aparAdha samparke jijJesa karA have nA|

ataHpara kArUna saundarye sajjita avasthAYa tAra sampradAYera sAmane veriYe ela| yArA pArthivajIvana kAmanA karata tArA valala, ‘hAYa, kArUnake yA deoYA haYeche AmAdera yadi tA thAkato! nizcaYai se mahA bhAgyera adhikArI|’

Ara yArA jJAnaprApta haYechila, tAra valala, ‘dhika teAmAdera, yArA ImAna eneche evaM neka Amala kareche tAdera janya AllAhara deoYA pratidAnai utkRSTa| eTA dhairyazIladera chAr3A kAuke deoYA haYa nA|’
ataHpara Ami kArUnake o tAra prAsAdake bhUgarbhe dhasiYe dilAma| AllAha vyatIta tAra emana kono dala chila nA, yArA tAke sAhAyya karate pAre, se nijeo AtmarakSA karate pAreni|

gatakAla yArA tAra mato haoYAra AkAGkSA karechila, tArA pratyuSe valate lAgala, ‘hAYa, AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra janya icchA riyika vardhita karena o parimita kare dena| yadi nA AllAha AmAdera prati anugraha karatena AmAderakeo bhUgarbhe vilIna kare ditena| hAYa Aphasosa! kAphirarA saphalakAma have nA|’
ei parakAla Ami tAdera janya nirdhArita kari, yArA duniYAra vuke auddhatya prakAza karate o nairAjya sRSTi karate cAYa nA| muttAkidera janya zubha pariNAma|
ye satkarma niYe Asave, se tadapekSA uttama phala pAve evaM ye manda karma niYe Asave, erUpa manda karmIrA se manda karma parimANei pratiphala pAve|
yini tomAra prati kuraAnera vidhAna pharaya karechena, tini avazyai tomAke phiriYe Anavena pherAra jAYagAYa| valo, ‘AmAra rava bhAlo jAnena ke hidAYAta niYe eseche evaM ke prakAzya vibhrAntite Ache|’
tumi to AzA karate nA ye tomAra prati kitAva avatIrNa have| eTA kevala tomAra ravera pakSa theke rAhamAta| ataeva, tumi kAphiradera sAhAyyakArI have nA|
kAphirarA yena tomAke AllAhara AYAta theke virata nA rAkhate pAre seguleA tomAra prati avatIrNa haoYAra para| tumi tomAra ravera dike AhvAna karo evaM kichutei muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
tumi AllAhara sAthe anya ilAhake AhvAna karo nA| tini vyatIta anya keAno ilAh nei| AllAhara sattA vyatIta savakichu dhvaMsazIla| vidhAna tA~rai evaM teAmarA tA~rai kAche pratyAvartita have|
Alipha lA-ma mI-ma|
mAnuSa ki mane kareche ye, tArA ekathA valei avyAhati peYe yAve ye, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’ evaM tAderake parIkSA karA have nA?
Ami tAderakeo parIkSA karechi, yArA tAdera pUrve chila| AllAha avazyai jene nevena yArA satyavAdI evaM nizcaYai jene nevena mithyukaderake|
yArA manda kAja kare, tArA ki mane kare ye, tArA AmAra hAta theke ve~ce yAve? tAdera phAYasAlA khuvai manda|
ye AllAhara sAkSAt kAmanA kare, AllAhara sei nirdhArita kAla avazyai Asave| tini sarvazreAtA, sarvajJAnI|
ye kaSTa svIkAra kare, se teA nijera janyai kaSTa svIkAra kare| nizcaYai AllAha jagatasamUha (era savakichu) theke amukhApekSI|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, Ami avazyai tAdera manda kAjaguleA miTiYe deva evaM tAderake karmera utkRSTatara pratidAna deva|

Ami mAnuSake pitA-mAtAra sAthe sadvyavahAra karAra nirdeza diYechi| yadi tArA teAmAke AmAra sAthe emana kichu zarika karAra jeAra praceSTA cAlAYa, yAra samparke teAmAra keAno jJAna nei, tave tAdera Anugatya kareA nA| AmArai dike teAmAdera pratyAvartana| ataHpara Ami teAmAderake jAniYe deva yA-kichu teAmarA karate|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare, Ami avazyai tAderake antarbhukta karava madhye nekakAradera|

kichu leAka vale, ‘AmarA AllAhara opara ImAna enechi;’ kintu AllAhara pathe yakhana kaSTa deoYA haYa, takhana tArA mAnuSera niryAtanake AllAhara zAstira mato mane kare| yakhana tomAra ravera kAcha theke keAno sAhAyya Ase takhana tArA valate thAke, AmarA teA teAmAdera sAthei chilAma| sRSTikulera antare yA Ache, AllAha ki tA samyaka jJAta nana?
AllAha avazyai jene nevena yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche evaM nizcaYai jene nevena yArA munAphika|

yArA kuphuri kareche tArA tAderake vale yArA ImAna eneche ye tomarAo AmAdera patha anusaraNa karo| AmarA teAmAdera pApera vojhA vahana karava| athaca tArA pApabhAra kichutei vahana karave nA| nizcaYai tArA mithyAvAdI|
tArA nijedera pApabhAra evaM tAra sAthe Arao kichu pApabhAra vahana karave| avazya tArA ye sava mithyA kathA udbhAvana karata, se samparke kiYAmAtera dina jijJAsita have|
Ami nUhake tAra sampradAYera kAche preraNa karechi| se tAdera madhye paJcAza kama eka hAjAra vachara avasthAna karechila| ataHpara tAderake mahAplAvana grAsa karala| tArA chila pApI|
ataHpara Ami tAke o naukAra ArohIderake rakSA karalAma evaM vizvavAsIra janya naukAke nidarzana karalAma|
smaraNa karo ivarAhImake| yakhana se tAra sampradAYake valala, ‘teAmarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo evaM tA~ke bhaYa karo| eTAi teAmAdera janya uttama yadi teAmarA veAjho|’

‘teAmarA teA AllAhara parivarte kevala mUrtisamUhera pUjA karacha evaM mithyA udbhAvana karacha| teAmarA AllAhara parivarte yAdera ivAdAta karacha, tArA teAmAdera riyika deoYAra kSamatA rAkhe nA| kAjei AllAhara kAche riyika tAlAza karo, tA~ra ivAdAta karo evaM tA~ra kRtajJatA prakAza karo| tA~rai kAche teAmarA pratyAvartita have|’
‘teAmarA yadi mithyAvAdI valo, tave teAmAdera pUrvavartIrAo teA mithyAvAdI valeche| spaSTabhAve vArtA pau~che deoYAi teA rAsUlera dAYitva|’
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, AllAha kIbhAve sRSTi zuru karena ataHpara tAke punarAvRtti karena? eTA AllAhara janya sahaja|
valo, ‘teAmarA pRthivIte bhramaNa karo evaM dekho, kIbhAve tini sRSTi zuru karechena| ataHpara AllAha punarvAra sRSTi karavena| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|’
tini yAke icchA zAsti dena evaM yAra prati icchA rahama karena| tA~rai dike teAmarA pratyAvartita have|
teAmarA sthale o antarIkSe AllAhake apAraga karate pArave nA evaM AllAha vyatIta teAmAdera keAno abhibhAvaka nei, sAhAyyakArIo nei|
yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha o tA~ra sAkSAt asvIkAra kare, tArAi AmAra rAhamAta theke nirAza haYe geche evaM tAdera janyai yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|

takhana ivarAhImera sampradAYera echAr3A keAno jaoYAva chila nA ye tArA valala, ‘tAke hatyA karo athavA agnidagdha karo|’ ataHpara AllAha tAke agni theke rakSA karalena| nizcaYai ete tAdera janya nidarzanAvali raYeche yArA ImAna Ane|

ivarAhIma valala, ‘pArthiva jIvane teAmAdera pArasparika bhAlovAsA rakSAra janya teAmarA AllAhara parivarte pratimAguleAke upAsyarUpe grahaNa karecha| erapara matera dina tomAdera kataka katakake asvIkAra karave evaM tomAdera kataka katakake abhisampAta karave| Ara teAmAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma evaM teAmAdera keAno sAhAyyakArI nei|’
ataHpara tAra prati ImAna Anala lUta| ivarAhIma valala, ‘hijarAta karachi Ami AmAra ravera uddeze; nizcaYai tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|’
Ami tAke dAna karalAma isahAka o iYAkUvake; tAra vaMzadharadera madhye navuoYyAta o kitAva rAkhalAma evaM duniYAte tAke dilAma tAra puraskAra| nizcaYai parakAle o se satleAkadara antarbhukta|
Ara preraNa karechi lUtake| yakhana se tAra sampradAYake valala, ‘teAmarA emana azlIla kAja karacha, yA teAmAdera pUrve pRthivIra keu kareni|’

‘teAmarA ki puruSadera kAche Asacha (yauna cAhidA pUraNera janya), rAhAjAni karacha evaM nijedera mAjalise garhita karma karacha?’ jaoYAve tA~ra sampradAYa kevala ekathA valala, ‘AmAdera opara AllAhara zAsti niYe eso, yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, duSkRtakArI sampradAYera viruddhe AmAke sAhAyya karo|’
yakhana AmAra prerita pherezatArA susaMvAda niYe ivarAhImera kAche Agamana karala, takhana tArA valala, ‘AmarA ei janapadera adhivAsIdera dhvaMsa karava| nizcaYai era adhivAsIrA sImAlaGghanakArI|’

se valala, ‘ei janapade teA lUtao raYeche|’ tArA valala, ‘sekhAne yArA Ache tAdera samparke AmarA bhAlo jAni AmarA avazyai tAke o tAra parivAravargake rakSA karava tAra strI vyatIta; se dhvaMsaprAptadera antarbhukta|’

yakhana AmAra prerita pherezatAgaNa lUtera kAche Agamana karala, takhana tAdera kAraNe se viSanna haYe par3ala evaM tAra mana saMkIrNa haYe gela| tArA valala, ‘bhaYa karavena nA evaM duHkha karavena nA| nizcaYai AmarA ApanAke o ApanAra parivAravargake rakSA karava ApanAra strI vyatIta, se dhvaMsa prAptadera antarbhukta|’
‘AmarA ei janapadera adhivAsIdera opara AkAza theke zAsti nAyila karava; ekAraNe ye tArA pApAcArI|’
Ami jJAnIdera janya ete ekaTi spaSTa nidarzana rekhechi|

Ami mAdaiYAnavAsIdera prati tAdera bhAi zuAivake preraNa karechi| se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA AllAhara ivAdAta karo, zeSa divasera AzA rAkho evaM pRthivIte vizRGkhalAkArI haYe golayoga sRSTi kareA nA|’
kintu tArA tAke mithyAvAdI valala; ataHpara tAdera pAkar3Ao karala bhUmikampa; evaM nijedera gRhe upur3a haYe par3e raila|

Ami Ada o sAmUdake dhvaMsa kare diYechi| tAdera vAr3i-ghara thekei tAdera avasthA teAmAdera kAche spaSTa haYe geche| zaYatAna tAdera karmake tAdera kAche suzeAbhita karechila, ataHpara tAderake satpatha avalamvane vAdhA diYechila evaM tArA chila hu~ziYAra|
Ami kArUna, phiraAuna o hAmAnake dhvaMsa karechi| mUsA tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzanAvali saha Agamana karechila; ataHpara tArA deze dambha karechila; kintu tArA AmAra zAsti er3Ate pAreni|

Ami pratyekakei tAra aparAdhera kAraNe pAkar3Ao karechi| tAdera kArao prati preraNa karechi pAthure vAtAsa, kAuke peYeche vajrapAta, kAuke Ami dhasiYe diYechi bhUgarbhe evaM kAuke karechi nimajjita| AllAha tAdera prati avicAra karenani; kintu tArA nijerAi nijedera prati sImAlaGghana kareche|
yArA AllAhara parivarte aparake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kare tAdera udAharaNa mAkar3asAra mato| se ghara vAnAYa| Ara sava gharera madhye mAkar3asAra gharai teA savaceYe durvala, yadi tArA jAnata|
tArA AllAhara parivarte yA-kichuke DAke, AllAha tA jAnena| tini zaktizAlI, prajJAmaYa|
e sakala udAharaNa Ami mAnuSera janya dii; tave jJAnIrA vyatIta keu tA veAjhe nA|
AllAha yathArtharUpe AsamAnasamUha o yamina sRSTi karechena| ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche mu’minadera janya|

tumi tilAoYAta karo kitAva theke yA tomAra prati pratyAdeza karA haYeche evaM sAlAta kAYema karo| nizcaYai sAlAta azlIla o garhita kAja theke virata rAkhe| AllAhara smaraNa sarvazreSTha| AllAha jAnena teAmarA yA karo|

teAmarA kitAvadhArIdera sAthe tarka-vitarka karave nA uttama panthA vyatIta; tave tArA vyatIta yArA tAdera madhye yuluma kareche evaM valo, ‘AmAdera prati o teAmAdera prati yA avatIrNa karA haYeche, tAte AmarA ImAna enechi| AmAdera ilAh o teAmAdera ilAh ekai evaM AmarA tA~rai prati AtmasamarpaNakArI|’

ebhAvei Ami tomAra prati kitAva avatIrNa karechi| ataHpara yAderake Ami kitAva diYechi, tArA eke mene cale evaM ederao (mAkkAvAsIderao) keu keu tAte ImAna Ane| Ara kAphirarA vyatIta keu AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare nA|
tumi teA era pUrve keAno kitAva pATha karate nA evaM nijera DAna hAta dvArA keAno kitAva likhate nA; emana hale vAtilapanthirA avazyai sandeha peASaNa karata|
varaM tAdera antare eTi (kuraAna) teA spaSTa AYAta yAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche; sImAlaGghanakArI chAr3A AmAra AYAta keu asvIkAra kare nA|
tArA vale, ‘tAra ravera pakSa theke tAra prati kichu nidarzana avatIrNa halo nA kena?’ valo, ‘nidarzana kevala AllAhara icchAdhIna| Ami teA ekajana suspaSTa satarkakArI mAtra|’
eTA ki tAdera janya yatheSTa naYa ye, Ami tomAra prati kitAva avatIrNa karechi, yA tAdera kAche pATha karA haYa| ete avazyai tAdera janya raYeche rAhamAta o upadeza yArA ImAna rAkhe|
valo, ‘AmAra madhye o teAmAdera madhye AllAhai sAkSIrUpe yatheSTa| tini jAnena—yA-kichu AsamAnasamUha o yamine Ache| Ara yArA mithyAYa vizvAsa kare o AllAhara sAthe kuphuri kare, tArAi kSatigrasta|’

tArA tomAra kAche druta zAsti kAmanA kare| yadi zAstira samaYa nirdhArita nA thAkata, tave zAsti tAdera opara ese yeta| nizcaYai AkasmikabhAve tAdera kAche zAsti ese yAve athaca tArA vujhateo pArave nA|
tArA tomAra kAche druta zAsti kAmanA kare; athaca nizcaYai jAhAnnAma kAphiradera gherAo karache|
yedina zAsti tAderake Acchanna karave mAthAra opara theke evaM pAYera nica theke| AllAha valavena, ‘teAmarA yA karate tAra svAda grahaNa karo|’
he AmAra vAndArA, yArA ImAna enecha, AmAra pRthivI nizcaYai prazasta| ataeva, teAmarA AmArai ivAdAta karo|
jIva mAtrai mRtyura svAda grahaNa karave| ataHpara teAmarA AmArai kAche pratyAvartita have|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, Ami avazyai tAderake jAnnAtera suucca prAsAde sthAna deva, yAra taladeze pravAhita haYa nada-nadI| sekhAne tArA sthAYI| katai nA uttama puraskAra satkarmazIladera!
yArA savara kare evaM tAdera ravera opara bharasA kare|
emana aneka jantu Ache, yArA tAdera khAdya saJcita rAkhe nA| AllAhai riyika dena tAdera evaM teAmAderao| tini sarvazreAtA, sarvajJa|
yadi tumi tAdera jijJesa karo, ‘ke AsamAnasamUha o yamina sRSTi karechena, candra o sUryake niYamAdhIna karena?’ tave tArA avazyai valave—‘AllAha’| tAhale keAthAYa tAdera phiriYe neoYA hacche?
AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra janya icchA riyika prazasta kare dena evaM yAra janya icchA hrAsa karena; nizcaYai, AllAha sarvaviSaYe samyaka parijJAta|

yadi tumi tAderake jijJesa karo, ‘ke AkAza theke vAri varSaNa karena, ataHpara tA dvArA yaminake tAra mRtyura para saJjIvita karena?’ tave tArA avazyai valave—‘AllAha’| valo, ‘samasta prazaMsA AllAharai; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai tA veAjhe nA|’
ei pArthiva-jIvana krIr3A-kautuka vai teA kichui naYa| parakAlera gharai prakRta jIvana; yadi tArA jAnata|
tArA yakhana jalayAne AreAhaNa kare takhana ekaniSThabhAve AllAhake DAke; tA~rai Anugatya svIkAra kare| ataHpara tini yakhana sthale ene tAdera uddhAra karena, takhanai tArA zarika karate thAke|
yena tAdera prati Ami yA dAna karechi tA tArA asvIkAra kare evaM bheAga-vilAse Duve thAke| satvarai tArA jAnate pArave|

tArA ki dekhe nA, Ami ‘ hArAma ’-ke ekaTi nirApada AzraYasthala karechi; athaca era cArapAze yArA Ache, tAderake cho~ mere niYe yAoYA haYa| tave ki tArA mithyAra pratii vizvAsa karave evaM AllAhara niYAmAta asvIkAra karave?

Ara ke tAra ceYe adhika yAlima, ye AllAhara nAme mithyA racanA kare athavA tAra kAche satya AsAra para tA asvIkAra kare? tAra ki smaraNa rAkhA ucita naYa—jAhAnnAmei sesava kAphiradera AzraYasthala have?
yArA AmAra pathe sAdhanAYa AtmaniYeAga kare, Ami avazyai tAderake AmAra pathe paricAlita karava| nizcaYai AllAha satkarmaparAYaNadera sAthe Achena|
Alipha lA-ma mI-ma,
reAmakarA parAjita haYeche,
nikaTavartI elAkAYa evaM tArA tAdera parAjaYera para atisatvara vijaYI have,
kaYeka vacharera madhye| pUrvera o parera nirdeza (deoYAra cUr3Anta kSamatA) AllAhara janyai | sedina mu’minagaNa Anandita have|
AllAhara sAhAyye| tini yAke icchA sAhAyya karena evaM tini parAkramazAlI, asIma daYAlu|
(eTi) AllAhara pratizruti| AllAha tA~ra pratizruti khelApha karavena nA; kintu adhikAMza leAka jAne nA|
tArA pArthiva-jIvanera vAhyika dika jAne; kintu parakAlera vyApAre tArA udAsIna|

tArA ki nijedera vyApAre bheve dekhe nA, AllAha AsamAnasamUha o yamina o e duYera madhyavartI savakichu sRSTi karechena yathAyatharUpe o nirdiSTa samaYera janya, kintu aneka mAnuSa tAdera ravera sAkSAte avizvAsI|

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kare nA? tAhale dekhata ye; tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma kemana chila? tArA chila edera cAite zaktite pravalatara, tArA yamina cASa karata evaM tAdera theke vezi AvAda karata| tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa nidarzana niYe esechila| vastuta AllAha tAdera prati avicArakArI chilena nA; kintu tArA tAdera nijedera prati yuluma karachila|
ataHpara yArA manda kAja karata, tAdera pariNAma haYeche manda| kAraNa, tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake mithyA sAvyasta karata evaM seguleA niYe ThATTA-vidrupa karata|
AllAha prathamavAra sRSTi karena, ataHpara tini punarAvRtti karena| erapara teAmarA tA~rai dike pratyAvartita have|
ye dina kiYAmAta saMghaTita have, sedina aparAdhIrA hatAza haYe yAve|
