tAdera deva-devIguleA tAdera janya supArizakArI have nA evaM tArA tAdera devIguloke asvIkAra karave|
yedina kiYAmAta saMghaTita have, sedina mAnuSa vibhakta haYe par3ave|
ataeva, yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, tArA jAnnAte samAdRta have
Ara yArA kuphuri kareche evaM AmAra AYAtasamUha o parakAlera sAkSAtke mithyA valache, tAderakei zAstira madhye upasthita karA have|
ataeva, AllAhara mAhAtmya o pavitratA (smaraNa karo) sandhyAYa o sakAle|
evaM aparAhne o madhyAhne AsamAnasamUha o yamine tA~rai sakala prazaMsA|
tini mRta theke jIvitake vera kare Anena, jIvita theke mRtake vera kare Anena, evaM bhUmira mRtyura para tAke punarujjIvita karena| ebhAve teAmarA utthita have|
Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalira madhye raYeche ye, tini mATi theke teAmAderake sRSTi karechena| ekhana teAmarA mAnuSa, pRthivIte char3iYe par3echa|

Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalira madhye raYeche ye, tini teAmAdera janya teAmAdera madhya theke teAmAdera saGginIdera sRSTi karechena, yena teAmarA tAdera kAche prazAnti pete pAro evaM tini teAmAdera madhye samprIti o daYA sRSTi karechena| nizcaYai ete cintAzIla leAkadera janya nidarzanAvali raYeche|
Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalira madhye raYeche AsamAnasamUha o yamina sRSTi evaM teAmAdera bhASA o varNera vaicitrya| nizcaYai ete jJAnIdera janya raYeche nidarzanAvali|
Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalira madhye raYeche rAte o dine teAmAdera nidrA evaM tA~ra kRpA anveSaNa| nizcaYai ete sei emana lokadera janya nidarzanAvali raYeche yArA zravaNa kare|

Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalira madhye raYeche, tini teAmAderake dekhAna vidyut, bhaYa o AzAra janya evaM AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karena, ataHpara tA dvArA bhUmira mRtyura para tAke jIvita karena| nizcaYai ete emana leAkadera janya nidarzanAvali raYeche yArA vuddhi rAkhe|
Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalira madhye raYeche ye, tA~rai Adeze AkAza o pRthivI pratiSThita Ache| ataHpara yakhana tini mATi theke oThAra janya teAmAderake DAka devena, takhana teAmarA uThe Asave|
AsamAnasamUha o yamine yArA Ache, savAi tA~ra adhIna| savAi tA~ra kAche natamukhI|
tinii prathamavAra sRSTi karechena, ataHpara punarAYa phiriYe Anavena| eTA tA~ra janya sahaja| AkAza o pRthivIte sarveAcca maryAdA tA~rai evaM tinii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha teAmAdera janya teAmAderai madhya theke ekaTi dRSTAnta varNanA karechena, teAmAderake Ami ye jIvikA diYechi, teAmAdera adhikArabhukta dAsa-dAsIrA ki tAte samAna aMzIdAra? teAmarA ki tAdera temana bhaYa karo, yemana bhaYa karo parasparake? ebhAve Ami emana sampradAYera janya nidarzanAvali vistArita varNanA kari yArA vuddhi rAkhe|
varaM yArA sImAlaGghana kareche tArA nA jenei tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa kare thAke| ataeva, AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, ke tAke patha dekhAve? tAdera keAno sAhAyyakArI nei|

tumi ekaniSThabhAve nijeke dInera opara pratiSThita rAkho| eTAi AllAha pradatta prakRti, yAra opara tini mAnuSa sRSTi karechena| AllAhara sRSTira kSetre keAno parivartana nei| eTAi supratiSThita jIvanavyavasthA, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|
savAi tA~ra abhimukhI haYe tA~ke bhaYa karo, sAlAta kAYema karo evaM muzarikadera antarbhukta haYeA nA|
yArA tAdera dharme vibheda sRSTi kareche evaM aneka dale vibhakta haYe par3eche| pratyeka dalai nija nija matavAda niYe ullasita|

mAnuSake yakhana duHkha-kaSTa sparza kare, takhana tArA tAdera ravake AhvAna kare tA~rai abhimukhI haYe| ataHpara tini yakhana tAdera rAhamAtera svAda AsvAdana karAna, takhana tAdera ekadala tAdera ravera sAthe aMzIdAra sAvyasta kare|
yena tArA asvIkAra kare yA Ami tAderake diYechi| ataeva, upabhoga kare nAo, ziggira jAnate pArave|
Ami ki tAdera kAche emana keAno dalIla avatIrNa karechi, yA tAderake zarika karate vale?
Ara yakhana Ami mAnuSake rAhamAtera svAda AsvAdana karAi, tArA tAte Anandita haYa evaM tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe yadi keAno durdazA tAdera kAche pau~che, tave tArA hatAza haYe par3e|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, AllAha yAra janya icchA riyika vRddhi karena evaM hrAsa karena; nizcaYai era madhye emana sampradAYera janya nidarzanAvali raYeche yArA ImAna rAkhe|
etaeva AtmIYa-svajanake tAdera prApya dAo evaM misakIna o musAphiraderakeo| eTA tAdera janya uttama, yArA AllAhara santuSTi kAmanA kare| tArAi saphalakAma|
Ara tomarA vRddhira janya mAnuSera sampade ye suda diYe thAka, tA mUlata AllAhara kAche vRddhi pAYa nA| Ara AllAhara santuSTi kAmanA kare tomarA ye yAkAta diYe thAka, tArAi vahuguNa samRddhazAlI|

AllAhai teAmAdera sRSTi karechena, ataHpara riyika diYechena, erapara teAmAdera mRtyu devena, AvAra teAmAderake jIvita karavena| teAmAdera zarikadera madhye emana keu Ache ki, ye esavera keAno kichu karate pArave? tArA yA kichu zarika kare, AllAha tA theke pavitra o mahAna|
jale-sthale ye viparyaYa prakAza pAYa, tA mAnuSera hAtera upArjana| phale tini tAderake tAdera karmera kichu zAsti AsvAdana karAna, yena tArA phire Ase|
valo, ‘teAmarA pRthivIte bhramaNa karo evaM dekho teAmAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma kI haYeche| tAdera adhikAMzai chila muzarika|’
Ara tumi nijeke sarala dIne pratiSThita rAkho, sedina AsAra pUrve, AllAha theke yA pherAno yAve nA| sedina tArA vibhakta haYe par3ave|
ye kuphuri kare, tAra kuphara tArai opara vartAYa evaM ye satkarma kare, tArA nijedera janya zayyA tairi kare nicche|
yena (AllAha) nija anugrahe tAdera pratidAna dena, yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche| nizcaYai tini kAphiradera bhAlovAsena nA|

Ara tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye raYeche ye, tini susaMvAdavAhI vAtAsa pAThAna, yena tini tA~ra anugraha teAmAdera AsvAdana karAna evaM yena tA~ra nirdeze jAhAjasamUha vicaraNa kare, yena teAmarA tA~ra anugraha tAlAza karo evaM tA~ra prati kRtajJa hao|

tomAra pUrve Ami rAsUlagaNake tA~dera nija nija sampradAYera kAche pAThiYechi| tA~rA tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzanAvali niYe esechila| ataHpara aparAdhI sampradAYa theke Ami pratizodha niYechi, Ara mu’minadera sAhAyya karA AmAra dAYitva|

AllAha, yini vAtAsa pAThAna, ataHpara tA meghamAlAke saJcArita kare| ataHpara tini meghamAlAke yebhAve icchA AkAze char3iYe dena evaM tA khaNDa-vikhaNDa karena| erapara tumi dekhate pAo tAra madhya theke nirgata haYa vRSTidhArA| tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAdera icchA pau~chAna; takhana tArA Anandita haYa|
yadio tArA tAdera prati vRSTi varSita haoYAra pUrve nirAza chila|
ataeva, AllAhara rAhamAtera prabhAva lakSa karo, kIbhAve tini mATira mRtyura para tAke jIvita karena| nizcaYai tini mRtaderake jIvita karavena Ara nizcaYai tini sarva viSaYe sarva zaktimAna|
Ami yadi emana vAtAsa pAThAi, yAra phale tArA dekhe zasyake haluda raM dhAraNa karate, takhana tArA akRtajJa haYe yAYa|
ataeva, tumi mRtaderake zeAnAte pArave nA evaM vadhirakeo AhvAna zeAnAte pArave nA, yakhana tArA pRSThapradarzana kare phire yAYa|
tumi andhaderake tAdera pathabhraSTatA theke patha dekhAte pArave nA| tumi kevala tAderai zeAnAte pArave, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe ImAna Ane| kAraNa, tArA AtmasamarpaNakArI|

AllAha sei sattA, yini teAmAderake durvala avasthA theke sRSTi karena ataHpara durvalatAra para zakti dAna karena, ataHpara zaktira para dena durvalatA o vArdhakya| tini yA icchA sRSTi karena evaM tini sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|
yedina kiYAmAta saMghaTita have, sedina aparAdhIrA kasama kheYe valave ye, tArA eka muhUrterao vezi avasthAna kareni| ebhAve tArA satyavimukha hato|
yAdera jJAna o ImAna deoYA haYeche tArA valave, ‘AmarA AllAhara kitAva-mate punarutthAna divasa paryanta avasthAna karechi| eTAi punarutthAna divasa, kintu teAmarA tA jAnate nA|’
tave yArA sImAlaGghana kareche sedina tAdera apAragatA tAdera keAno upakAre Asave nA evaM tArA tAovA karAra suyoga pAve nA|
Ami ei kuraAnera madhye mAnuSera janya sarvaprakAra dRSTAnta varNanA karechi| tumi yadi tAdera kAche keAno nidarzana niYe eso, tave kAphirarA avazyai valave, ‘teAmarA savAi vAtilapanthi|’
ebhAve yArA jJAna rAkhe nA AllAha tAdera hRdaYera opara mohara mere dena|
ataeva, tumi dhairyadhAraNa karo| AllAhara pratizruti satya| yArA iYAkIna rAkhe nA tArA yena tomAke vicalita karate nA pAre|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|
eguleA prajJAmaYa kitAvera AYAta|
hidAYAta o rahamatasvarUpa satkarmaparAYaNadera janya;
yArA sAlAta kAYema kare, yAkAta pradAna kare evaM AkhirAtera prati dRr3ha vizvAsa rAkhe|
tArAi tAdera ravera pakSa theke supathe pratiSThita evaM tArAi saphalakAma|

Ara kichu mAnuSa raYeche avAntara kAhini kine (grahaNa kare) neYa ajJatAvazata AllAhara patha theke vibhrAnta karAra janya evaM eTAke grahaNa kare ThATTAcchale| edera janya raYeche avamAnanAkara zAsti|

yakhana tAra nikaTa AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa, takhana se dambhabhare emanabhAve mukha phiriYe neYa, yena se tA zunatei pAYani athavA yena odera kAna duTi vadhira| sutarAM tAke marmantuda zAstira su saMvAda dAo|
nizcaYai yArA ImAna Ane Ara satkarma kare tAdera janya raYeche niYAmAtapUrNa jAnnAta|
sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| AllAhara oYAdA yathArtha| tini parAkramazAlI o prajJAmaYa|

tini stambha vyatIta AkAzamaNDalI sRSTi karechena; teAmarA tA dekhacha| tinii pRthivIte sthApana karechena parvatamAlA, yena tA teAmAdera niYe Dhale nA par3e evaM ete char3iYe diYechena sarvaprakAra jIva-jantu| Ami AkAza theke vAri varSaNa karechi, ataHpara tAte udgata karechi sakala prakAra jor3A-jor3A kalyANakara udbhidarAji|
eTA AllAhara sRSTi| ataHpara tini vyatIta anyerA kI sRSTi kareche, tA AmAke dekhAo; varaM sImAlaGghanakArIrA suspaSTa pathabhraSTatAYa raYeche|
Ami lukamAnake prajJA dAna karechi ei marme ye, AllAhara prati kRtajJa hao| ye kRtajJa haYa, se teA kevala nija kalyANera janyai kRtajJa haYa| Ara keu akRtajJa hale, AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|
Ara smaraNa karo—yakhana lukamAna upadezacchale tAra cheleke valala, ‘he AmAra chele, AllAhara sAthe kono zarika kareA nA| nizcaYai ziraka karA mahA anyAYa|’

Ara Ami mAnuSake tAra pitA-mAtAra sAthe sadvyavahArera nirdeza diYechi| tAra mAtA tAke kaSTera para kaSTa kare garbhe dhAraNa kareche| tAra dudha chAr3AneA haYa duvachare| sutarAM AmAra prati o teAmAra pitA-mAtAra prati kRtajJa hao| pratyAvartana AmArai nikaTa|

Ara tArA yadi teAmAke AmAra sAthe emana viSaYake aMzIdAra sthira karate vAdhya karate ceSTA kare, yAra jJAna teAmAra nei; tave tumi tAdera Anugatya karave nA; tave duniYAte tAdera sAthe sadbhAve sahAvasthAna karave| ye AmAra abhimukhI haYa, tAra patha anusaraNa karave| ataHpara teAmAdera pratyAvartana AmArai nikaTa evaM teAmarA yA karate, Ami se viSaYe teAmAdera avagata karava|

‘he AmAra chele, keAno vastu yadi sariSAra dAnA parimANao haYa, ataHpara tA yadi thAke pAtharera bhetara athavA AkAze athavA mATira madhye, tave AllAha tAo upasthita karavena| nizcaYai AllAha sUkSmadarzI, samyaka avagata|’
‘he AmAra chele, sAlAta kAYema karo, satkAjera Adeza dAo, mandakAje niSedha karo evaM vipadApade dhairyadhAraNa karo| nizcaYai eTA dRr3hasaMkalpera kAja|’
‘Ara tumi dambhabhare mAnuSera dike tomAra ghAr3a phiriYo nA evaM pRthivIte uddhatabhAve vicaraNa kareA nA| nizcaYai AllAha keAno dAmbhika ahaMkArIke pachanda karena nA|’
‘padacAraNAYa madhyavartitA avalamvana karo evaM nicu karo kaNThasvara, niHsandehe gAdhAra svarai sarvApekSA aprItikara|’

teAmarA ki dekho nA AsamAna o yamine yA-kichu Ache, AllAha sava kichuke teAmAdera kAje niYeAjita karechena evaM teAmAdera prati tA~ra prakAzya o aprakAzya niYAmAtasamUha paripUrNa kare diYechena? Ara mAnuSera madhye keu keu ajJatAvazata AllAha samparke vAka-vitaNDA kare, yAdera nA Ache pathanirdeza o yAdera nA Ache ujjvala kitAva|

tAdera yakhana valA haYa, ‘AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena, teAmarA tAra anusaraNa karo,’ takhana tArA vale, ‘varaM AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera ye viSaYera opara peYechi, tArai anusaraNa karava|’ zaYatAna yadi tAdera jAhAnnAmera zAstira dike AhvAna kare, tavuo ki?
ye vyakti satkarmaparAYaNa haYe nijeke AllAhara kAche soparda kare, se dRr3habhAve dhAraNa karala eka majavuta hAtala| sakala karmera pariNAma AllAhara kAche|

Ara keu kuphuri karale tAra kuphuri yena tomAke cintita nA kare| AmArai dike tAdera pratyAvartana, ataHpara Ami tAdera karma samparke tAderake avahita karava| nizcaYai AllAha antarera avasthA samparke parijJAta|
Ami tAdera svalpakAlera janya bheAga-vilAsa karate deva, ataHpara tAdera vAdhya karava gurutara zAsti bheAga karate|
tumi yadi tAdera jijJesa karo, AsamAna o yamina ke sRSTi karechena? tArA avazyai valave, ‘AllAhai’| valo, ‘sakala prazaMsAi AllAhara’; varaM tAdera adhikAMzai jJAna rAkhe nA|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA-kichu raYeche—savai AllAhara| AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|
pRthivIra sava gAcha yadi kalama haYa Ara samudra kAli haYa evaM era sAthe Arao sAta samudra yukta haYe, tavuo AllAhara kathA niHzeSa have nA| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
teAmAdera sRSTi o punarutthAna ekaTi prANera (sRSTi o punarutthAnera) anurUpa| nizcaYai AllAha sarvazrotA samyaka draSTA|

tumi ki dekhoni, AllAha rAtake dine praveza karAna evaM dinake rAte praveza karAna? tini candra o sUryake niYojita rekhechena| pratyekaTii nirdiSTakAla paryanta paribhramaNa kare| Ara teAmarA yA karo, AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|
eTAi pramANa ye, AllAhai satya evaM AllAha vyatIta tArA yAdera DAke, sava vAtila| AllAha sarveAcca, mahAna|
tumi ki dekhoni, AllAhara anugrahe jAhAja samudre calAcala kare, yena tini teAmAderake tA~ra nidarzanAvali pradarzana karena! nizcaYai ete pratyeka sahanazIla, kRtajJera janya nidarzana raYeche|

yakhana meghamAlA-sadRza taraGga tAdera AcchAdita kare neYa, takhana tArA AllAhake DAke tA~ra dIne vizuddhacitta haYe| ataHpara tini yakhana tAderake sthalabhAgera dike uddhAra kare Anena, takhana tAdera keu keu sarala pathe thAke| kevala mithyAcArI, akRtajJa vyaktii AmAra nidarzanAvali asvIkAra kare|

he mAnavajAti, teAmarA teAmAdera ravake bhaYa karo evaM bhaYa karo emana eka dinake, yakhana pitA putrera keAno kAje Asave nA evaM putrao tAra pitAra keAno upakAra karate sakSama have nA| niHsandehe AllAhara oYAdA satya| ataeva, pArthiva-jIvana yena teAmAderake dheA~kA nA deYa evaM AllAha samparke pratAraka (zaYatAnao) yena teAmAderake pratArita nA kare|

nizcaYai kiYAmAtera jJAna kevala AllAhara nikaTai raYeche| tinii vAri varSaNa karena evaM tini tA jAnena—yA jarAYute Ache| keu jAne nA—AgAmI kAla se kI upArjana karave evaM keu jAne nA—keAna deze se mRtyuvaraNa karave| AllAha sarvajJa, sarvaviSaYe avahita|
Alipha lA-ma mI-ma|
e kitAva jagatasamUhera ravera nikaTa theke avatIrNa—ete keAno sandeha nei|

tave ki tArA vale, ‘eTA se mithyA racanA kareche?’ varaM eTA tomAra ravera pakSa theke satya, yena tumi emana eka sampradAYake satarka karo, yAdera kAche tomAra pUrve keAno satarkakArI Aseni| sambhavata tArA hidAYAta pAve|

AllAha; yini AsamAnasamUha o yamina evaM e duYera madhyavartI savakichu chaYa dine sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tini Araze isatioYA karechena| tini vyatIta teAmAdera keAno abhibhAvaka o supArizakArI nei| tavuo ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?
tini AkAza theke pRthivI paryanta sava viSaYa paricAlanA karena, ataHpara tA tA~ra nikaTa samutthita have emana eka dine, yAra parimANa teAmAdera gaNanAYa hAjAra vacharera samAna|
tinii yini dRzya o adRzyera vyApAre jJAta, parAkramazAlI, asIma daYAlu,
yini tA~ra pratyekaTi sRSTike sundara karechena evaM kAdAmATi theke mAnava-sRSTira sUcanA karechena|
ataHpara tini tAra (sRSTira) vaMzadhara sRSTi karena tuccha pAnira niryAsa theke|
ataHpara tini tAke suThAma karena, evaM tAte phu~ke dena tAra (sRSTa) rUha evaM teAmAdera diYechena kAna, cokha o hRdaYa| teAmarA sAmAnyai kRtajJatA prakAza karo|
tArA vale, ‘AmarA yakhana mATite mize yAva takhana ki AmarA natuna kare sRSTi hava?’ varaM tArA tAdera ravera sAkSAt asvIkAra kare|
valo, ‘teAmAdera prANaharaNera dAYitve niYeAjita pherezatA teAmAdera prANa haraNa karave| ataHpara teAmarA teAmAdera ravera kAche pratyAvartita have|’

yadi tumi dekhate! yakhana aparAdhIrA tAdera ravera sAmane natazira haYe valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA dekhalAma o zunalAma| ekhana AmAdera punarAYa pAThiYe dina, AmarA satkarma karava; AmarA dRr3havizvAsI|’
Ami yadi icchA karatAma tave pratyekake saThika dika-nirdeza ditAma; kintu AmAra e kathA avadhArita satya ye, Ami avazyai jAhAnnAma pUrNa karava jina o mAnava dvArA ekasAthe|
ataeva, tomarA zAsti AsvAdana karo, e kAraNe ye tomarA e dinera sAkSAtera kathA bhule giYechile, Amio teAmAderake bhule gelAma, teAmarA yA karachile se kAraNe sthAYI zAsti bheAga karo|

vastuta tArAi AmAra AYAtasamUhera prati ImAna Ane, yArA tA (AYAtasamUha) dvArA yakhana upadezaprApta haYa, takhana sijadAYa luTiYe par3e evaM tAdera ravera saprazaMsa pavitratA varNanA kare Ara tArA ahaMkAra kare nA|
tAdera pArzva zayyA theke AlAdA thAke| tArA tAdera ravake DAke bhaYe o AzAYa evaM Ami tAderake ye riyika diYechi, tA theke vyaYa kare|
athaca keu jAne nA tAdera janya cakSusamUha zItalakArI yA supta Ache, tAdera kAjera pratidAnasvarUpa|
tave ki ye vyakti mu’mina, se ki pApAcArIra mato? tArA samAna naYa|
anantara yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tAdera janya raYeche tArA yA karata tAra (vinimaYe) ApyAYanasvarUpa sthAYI vAsasthAna jAnnAta|

pakSAntare yArA pApAcAra kareche, tAdera avasthAnasthala Aguna| yakhanai tArA tA theke vera hate cAive, takhanai tAdera sekhAne phiriYe deoYA have evaM valA have, ‘tomarA sei Agunera zAsti bhoga karo, yA tomarA mithyA sAvyasta karate|’
bhaYAvaha zAstira pUrve Ami avazyai tAderake laghu zAsti AsvAdana karAva, yena tArA pratyAvartana kare|
tAra ceYe adhika yAlima Ara ke, ye vyaktike tAra ravera AYAtasamUha dvArA upadeza deoYA haYa, ataHpara se tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa| nizcaYai Ami aparAdhIdera theke pratizodha grahaNakArI|
Ara Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechi; ataeva, tumi tAra prApti samvandhe sandihAna haYo nA| Ami eke vani isarAIlera janya pathapradarzaka karechilAma|
tArA savara karata vidhAYa Ami tAdera madhya theke netA maneAnIta karechilAma, yArA AmAra Adeze pathapradarzana karata| tArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe dRr3ha vizvAsa rAkhata|
nizcaYai kiYAmAtera dina tomAra rava tAdera madhye se viSaYe phAYasAlA karavena, ye viSaYe tArA matavireAdha karache|
eTAo ki tAdera hidAYAta dila nA ye, Ami tAdera pUrve kata sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechi, yAdera vAr3i-ghare erA vicaraNa kare| avazyai ete nidarzanAvali raYeche| tavuo ki tArA zunave nA?
tArA ki lakSa kare nA ye, Ami USara bhUmite pAni pravAhita kare zasya udgata kari, yA theke AhAra kare tAdera janturA evaM tArAo, tavuo ki tArA dekhe nA?
Ara tArA vale teAmarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave valo; ‘kave have ei phAYasAlA?’
valo, ‘yArA kuphuri kareche phAYasAlAra dine tAdera ImAna (grahaNa) tAdera keAno kAje Asave nA evaM tAdera avakAzao deoYA have nA|’
ataeva, tumi tAderake upekSA karo evaM apekSA karo, tArAo apekSA karache|
he navi, AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM kAphira o munAphikadera Anugatya karo nA| nizcaYai AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa;
tomAra ravera pakSa theke yA avatIrNa haYa, tumi tAra anusaraNa karo| nizcaYai AllAha tomarA yA karo se viSaYa samyaka avahita|
tumi AllAhara opara bharasA karo| abhibhAvaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|

AllAha keAno mAnuSera janya tAra abhyantare duTi hRdaYa sRSTi karenani| teAmAdera strIgaNa, yAdera sAthe teAmarA yihAra karo, tAderake tini teAmAdera jananI karenani evaM teAmAdera peASyaputraderake teAmAdera putra karenani| eguleA teAmAdera mukhera kathA mAtra| AllAha nyAYa kathA valena evaM tini sarala patha pradarzana karena|

teAmarA tAderake tAdera pitR-paricaYe DAko| eTAi AllAhara kAche nyAYasaMgata, yadi teAmarA tAdera pitR-paricaYa nA jAno, tave tArA teAmAdera dharmIYa bhAi o vandhu, e vyApAre teAmAdera keAno vicyuti hale tAte teAmAdera keAno pApa nei, tave tomAdera antare saMkalpa thAkale (aparAdha have), Ara AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

navi mu’minadera nikaTa tAdera nijedera apekSA ghaniSThatara evaM tAra strIgaNa tAdera mAtA| AllAhara vidhAna anuyAYI mu’mina o muhAjiragaNera madhye yArA AtmIYa, tArA paraspare ghaniSThatama| tave teAmarA yadi teAmAdera vandhudera prati bhAlo vyavahAra karate cAo (karate pAra), eTA kitAve lipivaddha|

evaM smaraNa karo yakhana Ami navidera nikaTa theke aGgIkAra niYechilAma, evaM tomAra nikaTa theke evaM nUha, ivarAhIma, mUsA o mAraiYAma-tanaYa IsAra nikaTa theke aGgIkAra nilAma evaM aGgIkAra nilAma tAdera kAcha theke dRr3ha aGgIkAra|
yena tini jijJesa karate pArena satyavAdIdera satyavAditA samparke| tini kAphiradera janya prastuta rekhechena yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

he yArA ImAna enecha, teAmarA teAmAdera prati AllAhara niYAmAtera kathA smaraNa karo, yakhana zatruvAhinI teAmAdera nikaTa esechila, ataHpara Ami tAdera viruddhe jhaJcAvAYu evaM emana sainyavAhinI pAThiYechilAma—yAderake teAmarA dekhoni| tomarA yA karo AllAha se samparke samyaka draSTA|

yakhana tArA teAmAdera nikaTavartI haYechila uparera dika o nicera dika theke evaM yakhana teAmAdera dRSTibhrama hacchila o prANa kaNThanAlite pau~chechila evaM teAmarA AllAha samparke nAnA virUpa dhAraNA peASaNa karachile|
takhana mu’minagaNa parIkSita haYechila evaM bhISaNabhAve prakampita hacchila|
Ara yakhana munAphika o yAdera antare vyAdhi chila tArA valachila, ‘AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla AmAdera ye pratizruti diYechena—tA pratAraNA vyatIta kichui naYa|’

evaM yakhana tAdera ekadala valechila, ‘he iYAsarivavAsI, tomAdera kono pratirodhazakti nei, teAmarA phire calo|’ tAderai ekadala navira kAche avyAhati ceYe valechila, ‘AmAdera vAr3i-ghara ArakSita’, athaca naYa seguleA arakSita, pAliYe yAoYAi chila tAdera uddezya|
yadi tAdera viruddhe cAradika theke zatrupakSera praveza ghaTAno hato ataHpara vidreAha karate prareAcita karA hato, tave tArA avazyai vidreAha karata evaM tArA meATei vilamva karata nA|
athaca tArA pUrvei AllAhara sAthe aGgIkAra karechila ye, tArA pRSThapradarzana karave nA| Ara AllAhara aGgIkAra samparke jijJAsita have|
valo, ‘teAmarA yadi mRtyu athavA hatyAra bhaYe pAlAo, tave e pAliYe yAoYA teAmAdera kono kAje Asave nA| sekSetre teAmAderake sAmAnyai bheAga karate deoYA have|’

valo, ‘ke teAmAderake AllAha theke rakSA karave—yadi tini teAmAdera amaGgala icchA karena athavA teAmAdera prati anukampAra icchA karena?’ tArA AllAha vyatIta nijedera keAno abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
avazyai AllAha jAnena teAmAdera madhye kArA vAdhAdAnakArI evaM kArA tAdera bhAiderake vale, ‘AmAdera kAche eso|’ tAdera kamasaMkhyakai yuddhe Ase|

teAmAdera prati kRpaNatAvazata| yakhana vipada Ase, takhana tumi dekhave sei vyaktira mato ceAkha ulaTiYe tArA tomAra prati tAkiYe Ache yAra opara acetanatA cepe vaseche| ataHpara yakhana vipada cale yAYa, takhana tArA dhana-sampadera lobhavazata teAmAdera saGge tIkSNa bhASA niYe milita haYa| tArA kakhano ImAna Aneni, tAi AllAha tAdera karmasamUha niSphala kare diYechena| eTA AllAhara janya sahaja|

tArA mane kare zatruvAhinI cale yAYani| Ara yadi zatruvAhinI AvAra ese par3e, tave tArA kAmanA karave ye, yadi tArA veduInadera madhya theke teAmAdera sArvika khavara jene nita! tArA teAmAdera mAjhe avasthAna karaleo khuva sAmAnyai yuddha karata|
nizcaYai AllAhara rAsUlera mAjhe tomAdera janya raYeche sarvottama Adarza, tAdera janya yArA AllAha o zeSa divasera AzA rAkhe evaM AllAhake adhika smaraNa kare|

yakhana mu’minarA zatruvAhinIke dekhala, takhana tArA valala, ‘AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla erai oYAdA AmAderake diYechilena evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla satya valechena|’ ete tAdera ImAna o AtmasamarpaNai vRddhi pela|
mu’minadera madhye kichu loka AllAhara sAthe kRta oYAdA pUrNa kareche| tAdera keu keu zAhAdAtavaraNa kareche evaM keu keu pratIkSA karache| tArA tAdera saMkalpe parivartana kareni|
eTA ejanya, yena AllAha satyavAdIderake tAdera satyavAditAra kAraNe pratidAna dena evaM icchA karale munAphikaderake zAsti dena athavA kSamA karena| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
Ara AllAha kAphiraderake rAgAnvita avasthAYa phiriYe dilena| tArA keAno kalyANa pAYani| yuddhe mu’minadera janya AllAhai yatheSTa| Ara AllAha zaktidhara, parAkramazAlI|

Ahale kitAvadera madhye yArA kAphiradera pRSThapeASakatA karechila, tAderake tini tAdera durga theke nAmiYe dilena evaM tAdera antare bhIti saJcAra karalena| phale teAmarA ekadalake hatyA karecha evaM ekadalake karecha vandi|
tini tAdera bhUmira, ghara-vAr3ira, dhana-sampadera evaM emana eka bhUmira adhikArI kare diYechena teAmAderake, yekhAne teAmarA ekhano padArpaNa karoni| AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
he navi, tumi tomAra strIderake valo, ‘teAmarA yadi pArthiva-jIvana o tAra vilAsitA kAmanA karo, tave eso, Ami teAmAdera bheAgera vyavasthA kare dii evaM uttama panthAYa teAmAderake vidAYa dii|’
‘Ara yadi teAmarA AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o parakAla kAmanA karo, tave teAmAdera madhye satkarmaparAYaNadera janya AllAha mahApuraskAra prastuta kare rekhechena|’
he navira strIrA, teAmAdera madhye keu prakAzya azlIla kAja karale tAke dviguNa zAsti deoYA have evaM eTA AllAhara janya sahaja|
teAmAdera madhye ye keu AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera anugata have evaM satkarma karave, Ami tAke duvAra puraskAra deva evaM tAra janya Ami sammAnajanaka riyika prastuta rekhechi|

he navi-patnIgaNa, teAmarA anya nArIdera mato nao; yadi teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo, tave (parapuruSera sAthe) keAmala (o AkarSaNIYa) bhaGgite kathA valeA nA, tAhale yAra antare vyAdhi raYeche, se kAmanA karave, sutarAM teAmarA nyAYasaMgata kathA valave|

teAmarA tomAdera ghare avasthAna karo, jAhili yugera pradarzanera mato nijederake pradarzana kare ver3Ave nA| sAlAta kAYema karo, yAkAta pradAna karo evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karo| he navi-parivAra, AllAha kevala cAna teAmAdera theke apavitratA dUra karate evaM teAmAderake pUrNarUpe pavitra rAkhate|
Ara smaraNa karave AllAhara ye AYAtasamUha o jJAnagarbha kathA teAmAdera ghare paThita haYa seguleA| nizcaYai AllAha sUkSmadarzI, sarva viSaYe avahita|

nizcaYai AtmasamarpaNakArI, AtmasamarpaNakAriNI, vizvAsI o vizvAsinI, AnugatyazIla o AnugatyazIlA, satyavAdI o satyavAdinI, dhairyazIla o dhairyazIlA, vinIta o vinItA nArI, dAnazIla o dAnazIlA, siYAma pAlanakArI o siYAma pAlanakAriNI, yaunAGga hiphAjatakArI o yaunAGga hiphAjatakAriNI, AllAhara adhika smaraNakArI o adhika smaraNakAriNI; tAdera janya AllAha prastuta rekhechena kSamA o mahApuraskAra|

AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla yakhana keAno phAYasAlA karena, keAno ImAnadAra puruSa o ImAnadAra nArIra se viSaYe bhinnamatera kono ikhatiYAra nei| ye AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Adeza amAnya kare tave se to prakAzya bhraSTatAYa patita haYa|

Ara AllAha yAke anugraha karechena evaM tumio yAke anugraha karecha; tAke yakhana tumi valechile, teAmAra strIke teAmAra kAchei rekhe dAo evaM AllAhake bhaYa karo| tumi antare emana kichu geApana karachile, yA AllAha prakAza kare devena; tumi leAkanindAra bhaYa karechile athaca AllAhakei adhika bhaYa karA ucita| ataHpara yAida yakhana tAra sAthe samparka chinna karala, takhana Ami tAke tomAra sAthe vivAhavandhane Avaddha karalAma; yena mu’minadera peASyaputrarA tAdera strIra sAthe samparka chinna karale tAdera vivAha karAra vyApAre mu’minadera keAno asuvidhA nA thAke| AllAhara nirdeza kAryakarI havArai|

navira janya nei kono asuvidhA tAra madhye yA AllAha tAra janya nirdhAraNa karechena; eTAi AllAhara cirAcarita vidhAna tAdera kSetre yArA pUrve vigata haYeche| Ara AllAhara Adeza nirdhArita, avadhArita|
yArA AllAhara vANI pracAra karata o tA~ke bhaYa karata, Ara tArA AllAha vyatIta anya kAuke bhaYa karata nA| hisAvagrahaNakArI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|
muhAmmAda teAmAdera keAno puruSera pitA naYa; varaM se AllAhara rAsUla evaM zeSa navi| AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|
he yArA ImAna enecha, teAmarA AllAhake adhika parimANe smaraNa karo|
evaM sakAla-sandhyA AllAhara pavitratA varNanA karo|

tinii sei sattA yini teAmAdera prati rAhamAta karena evaM tA~ra pherezatAgaNao rAhamAtera du‘A karena; yena tini tomAderake andhakAra theke AleAra dike vera kare Anena| tini mu’minadera prati asIma daYAlu|
yedina tArA tA~ra sAthe milita have sedina tAdera abhivAdana have ‘sAlAma’| tini tAdera janya sammAnajanaka puraskAra prastuta rekhechena|
he navi, nizcaYai Ami tomAke preraNa karechi sAkSIrUpe susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe|
evaM AllAhara anumatikrame tA~ra dike AhvAnakArIrUpe evaM ujjvala pradIparUpe|
tumi mu’minaderake susaMvAda dAo ye, tAdera janya raYeche AllAhara pakSa theke virATa anugraha|
Ara tumi kAphira o munAphikadera Anugatya karo nA| tAdera utpIr3ana upekSA karo o AllAhara opara bharasA karo| abhibhAvaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|

he mu’minagaNa, teAmarA yakhana mu’mina nArIdera vivAha karo, ataHpara tAdera sparza karAra pUrve tAlAka diYe dAo, takhana tAdera iddatapAlane vAdhya karAra adhikAra teAmAdera nei| ataHpara teAmarA tAdera kichu (upahAra)-sAmagrI deve evaM sundarabhAve tAderake vidAYa dAo|

he navi, nizcaYai Ami tomAra janya vaidha karechi tomAra strIderake, yAderake tumi prApya meAharAnA pradAna karecha| Ara vaidha karechi tAderake yAdera mAlika haYeche tomAdera DAnahAta (dAsIdera), yAderake AllAha tomAra karAYatta kare diYechena evaM vivAhera janya vaidha karechi tomAra cAcAra kanyA, phuphura kanyA, mAmAra kanyA, khAlAra kanyAke yArA tomAra sAthe hijarAta kareche| Ara yekeAno mu’minA nArI yadi nijeke navira kAche samarpaNa kare, Ara navi yadi cAYa ye tAke vivAha karave seo hAlAla| eTA vizeSa kare tomArai janya, anya mu’minadera janya naYa| mu’minagaNera strI o dAsIdera vyApAre yA nirdhArita karechi tA AmAra jAnA Ache, yena tomAra kono saMkoca nA haYa, Ara AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

tumi tAdera madhye yAke icchA dUre rAkhate pAra evaM yAke icchA kAche rAkhate pAra| tumi yAke dUre rekhecha, tAke kAmanA karale tAte tomAra keAno deASa nei| ete adhika sambhAvanA Ache ye, tAdera cakSu zItala thAkave; tArA duHkha pAve nA evaM tumi yA pradAna karave, tAte tArA sakalei santuSTa thAkave| teAmAdera antare yA Ache, AllAha tA bhAlo jAnena| AllAha sarvajJa, sahanazIla|

erapara tomAra janya keAno nArI vaidha naYa evaM eTAo vaidha naYa ye tumi tAderake parivartana kare neve anya strIlokadera diYe; yadio tAdera rUpalAvaNya tomAke mugdha kare; tave dAsIra vyApAra bhinna| Ara AllAha sava kichura opara tIkSNa paryavekSaka|

he yArA ImAna enecha, tomarA navira ghare praveza karo nA yadi nA anumati deoYA haYa tomAdera khAvArera janya, tA prastutera apekSA vyatIta; ataHpara tomarA praveza karo yakhana tomAderake DAkA haYa; tArapara yakhana khAnApinA zeSa haYe yAYa takhana veriYe eso, kathAvArtAYa lipta nA haYe| nizcaYai tomAdera ei kAja navike kaSTa deYa, tave tini tomAdera kSetre saMkocavodha karena, kintu AllAha satya prakAze saMkoca karena nA| yakhana tomarA tAdera kAche kono sAmagrI cAo, takhana pardAra Ar3Ala theke cAo| eTA tomAdera o tAdera antarera janya adhika pavitratama| tomAdera janya samIcIna naYa ye, tomarA AllAhara rAsUlake kaSTa deve evaM vaidha naYa ye tomarA tAra pare tAra strIderake kakhano viYe karave| nizcaYai eTi AllAhara kAche eka gurutara viSaYa|
teAmarA yadi kichu prakAza karo athavA geApana rAkho, (seTA kono viSaYa naYa) AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|

tAdera (navi-patnIgaNera) janya tAdera pitA putra, bhrAtA, bhrAtuSputra, bhagni putra, khAdemA evaM adhikArabhukta dAsadAsIgaNera sAmane yAoYAra vyApAre kono doSa nei| (navi-patnIgaNa) teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo| nizcaYai AllAha savakichura opara paryavekSaka|
AllAha o tA~ra pherezatAgaNa navira prati rAhamAta pAThAna| he yArA ImAna enecha, teAmarA navira prati rAhamAta prArthanA karo evaM tAra prati tomarA adhikahAre sAlAma preraNa karo|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlake kaSTa deYa, AllAha tAdera prati duniYA o AkhirAte abhisampAta karena evaM tAdera janya prastuta rekhechena lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|
evaM yArA mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina nArIderake kaSTa deYa, emana aparAdhera janya yA tArA kareni tave tArA mithyA apavAda o prakAzya pApa vahana karala|

he navi, tumi tomAra strIdera o kanyAderake evaM mu’minadera strIderake valo, tArA yena tAdera cAdarera kiYadaMza nijedera opara Tene neYa; ete tAdera sahaje cenA yAve, phale tAdera utyakta karA have nA| AllAha kSamAzIla asIma daYAlu|

munAphikarA evaM yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache evaM mAdInAYa gujava raTanAkArIrA yadi virata nA haYa, tave Ami avazyai tAdera viruddhe tomAke pravala karava| ataHpara ei zahare tomAra prativezI hisAve tArA alpai thAkave|
(tArA thAkave) abhizapta avasthAYa; tAdera yekhAnei pAoYA yAve, dharA have evaM nirmamabhAve hatyA karA have|
itaHpUrve yArA atIta haYe geche, tAdera vyApAre eTAi chila AllAhara rIti| Ara tumi AllAhara rItira kSetre kakhano parivartana pAve nA|
leAkerA tomAke kiYAmAta samparke jijJAsA kare| valo, ‘era jJAna AllAhara kAchei|’ tumi tA kIbhAve jAnave, haYato kiYAmAta nikaTei|
nizcaYai AllAha kAphiraderake abhisampAta karechena evaM tAdera janya prastuta rekhechena jvalanta Aguna|
sekhAne tArA sthAYI thAkave cirakAla evaM keAno abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
yedina Agune tAdera mukhamaNDala olaTa-pAlaTa karA have; sedina tArA valave, ‘hAYa, AmarA yadi AllAhara Anugatya karatAma o rAsUlera Anugatya karatAma!’
tArA Arao valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA AmAdera netA o var3adera kathA menechilAma, ataHpara tArA AmAdera pathabhraSTa karechila|’
‘he AmAdera rava, tAderake dviguNa zAsti dina evaM tAderake mahA abhisampAta karuna|’
he yArA ImAna enecha, mUsAke yArA kaSTa diYeche teAmarA tAdera mato haYeA nA| tArA yA raTanA karechila; erapara AllAha tA theke tAke nirdeASa karechilena| se AllAhara kAche chila maryAdAvAna|
he yArA ImAna enecha, AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM saThika kathA valo|
tini teAmAdera AmalasamUha saMzeAdhana kare devena evaM teAmAdera pApasamUha kSamA karavena| ye keu AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare, se avazyai mahAsAphalya arjana karala|

Ami AkAza pRthivI o parvatamAlAra sAmane ei AmAnata peza karechilAma, ataHpara tArA eke vahana karate asvIkAra karala evaM se vyApAre zaGkita halo; kintu mAnuSa tA vahana karala| nizcaYai se atizaYa yAlima, jAhila|
yena AllAha munAphika puruSa, munAphika nArI, muzarika puruSa, muzarika nArIderake zAsti dena evaM mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina nArIderake kSamA karena| AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
sakala prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA Ache, savakichura mAlika evaM tA~rai prazaMsA AkhirAte| tini prajJAmaYa, sarva viSaYe avahita|
tini jAnena yA bhUgarbhe praveza kare, yA sekhAna theke nirgata haYa, yA AkAza theke varSita haYa evaM yA AkAze utthita haYa| tini asIma daYAlu kSamAzIla|

Ara yArA kuphuri kareche tArA valeche, ‘AmAdera opara kiYAmAta Asave nA|’ valo, ‘AmAra ravera zapatha! avazyai tA Asave tomAdera opara|’ tini adRzya samparke jJAta; tAra agocare thAke nA AsamAnasamUha o yaminera aNu parimANa kichu| erace kSudra vA erace var3a emana kono vastu nei, yA spaSTa kitAve nei|
yena tini tAdera pratidAna dena yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma sampAdana kareche| tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vyartha karAra janya uThepar3e legeche, tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
Ara yAdera jJAna deoYA haYeche tArA tomAra ravera nikaTa theke avatIrNa kuraAnake satya jJAna kare evaM eTA mAnuSake parAkramazAlI, prasaMzita AllAhara dike pathapradarzana kare|

kAphirarA vale, ‘AmarA ki teAmAdera emana vyaktira sandhAna deva, ye teAmAderake khavara deYa ye teAmarA sampUrNa chinna-vicchinna have (tArapara) nizcaYai tomarA AvAra natuna sRSTi hiseve punarutthita have|’
se AllAha samparke mithyA racanA kareche, nAki tAra sAthe jina Ache! yArA parakAlera prati vizvAsa rAkhe nA tArA zAstite o gheAra pathabhraSTatAYa patita Ache|

tArA ki tAdera sAmanera o pechanera AkAza o pRthivIra prati lakSa kareni? yadi Ami icchA kari tAderakesaha bhUgarbhe dhasiYe deva athavA AkAza theke keAno khaNDa tAdera opara phelava| AllAha-abhimukhI pratyeka vAndAra janya ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche|

Ami dAUdera prati anugraha karechilAma (ei marme Adeza diYe ye,) ‘he parvatamAlA, teAmarA dAUdera sAthe AmAra pavitratA gheASaNA karo evaM he pAkhidera dala, teAmarAo|’ Ami tAra janya lohAke narama kare diYechilAma|
(evaM tAke Ami valechilAma,) ‘prazasta varma tairi karo, parimApa rakSA kare kar3A yukta karo evaM satkarma sampAdana karo| teAmarA yA-kichu karo, Ami tA dekhi|’

Ara Ami sulAimAnera janya (adhIna karechilAma) vAYuke, yA sakAle eka mAsera patha evaM vikAle eka mAsera patha atikrama karata| Ami tAra janya galita tAmAra jharanA pravAhita karechilAma| kichu jina tAra (dui hAtera mAjhe) sAmane kAja karata tAra ravera Adeze| tAdera ye-keu AmAra Adeza amAnya kare vakra pathe yeta, Ami jvalanta Agunera zAsti AsvAdana karAtAma|

tArA sulAimAnera icchA anuyAYI durga, bhAskarya, hAujasadRza vRhadAkAra pAtra evaM culAra opara sthApita vizAla Dega nirmANa karata| he dAUda-parivAra, kRtajJatAra sAthe teAmarA kAja kare yAo| AmAra vAndAdera madhye alpasaMkhyakai kRtajJa|

yakhana Ami tAra mRtyura phAYasAlA karalAma, takhana kevala uipeAkAi jinaderake tAra mRtyu samparke jAniYeche, yeTi tAra lAThi kheYe yAcchila| yakhana se mATite par3e gela, takhana jinerA vujhate pArala ye, adRzya viSaYera jJAna thAkale tArA ei lAJchanApUrNa zAstira madhye par3e thAkata nA|

sAvAra adhivAsIdera janya tAdera vAsabhUmite chila eka nidarzana; duTi udyAna, ekaTi DAnadike, ekaTi vAmadike| teAmarA teAmAdera ravera riyika khAo evaM tA~ra prati kRtajJatA prakAza karo| uttama zahara evaM kSamAzIla rava|

ataHpara tArA mukha phiriYe nila; phale Ami tAdera opara pAThAlAma pravala vanyA| Ara tAdera udyAna duTike parivartana kare dilAma emana dui udyAne, yena udgata haYa visvAda phalamUla, kichu jhAugAcha, Ara kichu evaM sAmAnya kulavRkSa|
Ami tAderake e zAsti diYechi ekAraNe ye tArA akRtajJatA kareche| Ami akRtajJa vyatIta kAuke zAsti dii nA|

tAdera evaM yesava janapadera madhye Ami vArAkAha dAna karechilAma seguleAra madhyavartI sthAne aneka dRzyamAna janapada sthApana karechilAma evaM seguleAte bhramaNa nirdhArita karechilAma| teAmarA esava janapade rAte o dine nirApada avasthAYa bhramaNa karo|

ataHpara tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAdera sapharagulora madhye dUratva sRSTi kare dAo|’ tArA tAdera nijedera prati yuluma karechila| phale Ami tAderake upAkhyAne pariNata karalAma evaM sampUrNarUpe chinna-vicchinna kare dilAma| nizcaYai ete pratyeka dhairyazIla kRtajJera janya raYeche aneka nidarzana|
Ara tAdera opara ivalIsa tAra anumAna satya hiseve pratiSThita karala| phale tAdera madhye mu’minadera ekaTi dala vyatIta sakalei tAra patha anusaraNa karala|
yadio tAdera opara zaYatAnera keAno kSamatA chila nA, tave ke parakAlera prati ImAna Ane evaM ke tAte sandeha kare, Ami tA jAnate ceYechi| tomAra rava savakichura rakSaka|

valo, ‘teAmarA tAdera AhvAna karo, AllAha vyatIta yAdera (ilAha) mane karate|’ tArA AsamAnasamUhera aNu parimANa keAno kichura mAlikAnA rAkhe nA, evaM nA yaminerao; ete tAdera keAno aMzao nei evaM tAdera keu AllAhara sAhAyyakArI naYa|

Ara kono supAriza kAje Asave nA, tave yAra janya anumati deoYA haYa se vyatIta| yakhana tAdera mana theke bhaYa-bhIti dUra haYe yAve, takhana tArA valave, ‘teAmAdera rava kI valalena?’ tArA valave, ‘tini satya valechena evaM tinii samunnata, mahAna|’
valo, ‘AsamAnasamUha o yamina theke ke teAmAderake riyika deYa?’ tumi valo, ‘ AllAha| AmarA athavA teAmarA satpathe sthira athavA spaSTa vibhrAntite patita|’
tumi valo, ‘AmarA ye aparAdha karechi se samparke teAmarA jijJAsita have nA, evaM teAmarA yA-kichu karo se samparke AmarA jijJAsita hava nA|’
valo, ‘AmAdera rava AmAderake samaveta karavena, ataHpara tini AmAdera madhye saThikabhAve phAYasAlA karavena| tini sarvottama phAYasAlAkArI, sarvajJa|’
valo, ‘teAmarA yAderake AllAhara sAthe aMzIdArarUpe saMyukta karecha, tAderake ene AmAke dekhAo; varaM tinii AllAha, parAkramazIla, prajJAmaYa|’
Ami tomAke samagra mAnavajAtira janya susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe pAThiYechi; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa tA jAne nA|
tArA vale, ‘teAmarA yadi satyavAdI hao, tave valo, e oYAdA kakhana vAstavAYita have?’
valo, ‘teAmAdera janya ekaTi dinera oYAdA raYeche yAke teAmarA eka muhUrtao vilamvita karate pArave nA evaM tvarAnvitao karate pArave nA|’

yArA kuphuri kareche tArA vale, ‘AmarA kakhano e kuraAne vizvAsa karava nA evaM era pUrvavartI kitAveo naYa|’ tumi yadi pApiSThadera dekhate, yakhana tArA thAkave tAdera ravera sAmane dA~r3a karAneA, takhana tArA paraspara kathA kATAkATi karave| yAdera durvala mane karA hato, tArA ahaMkArIderake valave, ‘teAmarA yadi nA thAkate AmarA avazyai mu’mina hatAma|’
yArA ahaMkAra karechila tArA tAderake valave yAdera durvala mane karA hato, ‘teAmAdera kAche yakhana hidAYAta esechila AmarA ki teAmAderake vAdhA diYechilAma? varaM teAmarAi teA chile aparAdhI!’

Ara yAderake durvala mane karA haYa tArA ahaMkArIderake valave, ‘varaM (era kAraNa chila tomAdera) dina-rAtera cakrAnta; yakhana tomarA AmAderake nirdeza dite yena AmarA AllAhara sAthe kuphuri kari evaM tA~ra sAthe samakakSa sAvyasta kari|’ tArA yakhana zAsti dekhave takhana lajjA gopana karave Ami kAphiradera galAYa ver3i parAva| tAderake zudhu tAdera karmera pratiphalai deoYA have|
keAno janapade satarkakArI pAThAno halei tAra vittazAlI adhivAsIrA valeche, ‘teAmarA ye viSaYasaha prerita haYecha, AmarA tA pratyAkhyAnakArI|’
tArA Arao valeche, ‘AmarA dhana-sampada o santAna-santatite samRddha, sutarAM AmarA zAstiprApta hava nA|’
tumi valo, ‘nizcaYai AmAra rava yAke icchA riyika vAr3iYe dena evaM saMkIrNa karena; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa tA veAjhe nA|’

teAmAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati teAmAderake AmAra nikaTavartI karave nA| tave yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tArA tAdera karmera vahuguNa pratidAna pAve evaM tArA suucca prAsAde nirApade thAkave|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vyartha karAra apapraYAse lipta haYa, tArA zAsti bhoga karate thAkave|
valo, ‘AmAra rava yAke icchA riyika vAr3iYe dena tA~ra vAndAdera madhye evaM saMkIrNa karena| teAmarA yA-kichu vyaYa karo, tini tAra pratidAna dena| vastuta tinii uttama riyikadAtA|’
yedina tini tAdera sakalake ekatra karavena evaM pherezatAderake valavena, ‘erA ki teAmAderai upAsanA karata?’
pherezatArA valave, ‘Apani mahAna pavitra! Apanii AmAdera abhibhAvaka, tArA naYa; varaM tArA jinadera pUjA karata| tAdera adhikAMzai tAdera prati vizvAsI|’

ataeva, Ajakera dine teAmAdera keu kAro keAno upakAra kiMvA kSati karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA; Ara yArA sImAlaGghana kareche tAderake Ami valava, ‘teAmarA se Agunera zAsti AsvAdana karo yA tomarA mithyA sAvyasta karate|’

yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa, takhana tArA vale, ‘e vyakti emana ekajana loka, ye cAYa ye tomAdera vAdhA deve tA theke yAdera upAsanA karata teAmAdera vApa-dAdArA|’ tArA Arao vale, ‘eTA managar3A mithyA chAr3A kichu naYa|’ Ara yArA asvIkAra kareche satyake yakhana tA tAdera kAche eseche, takhana tArA vale, ‘eTA suspaSTa jAdu|’
Ami tAderake keAno kitAva diini, yA tArA adhyaYana karave evaM tomAra pUrve tAdera kAche keAno satarkakArI pAThAini|
tAdera pUrvavartIrAo mithyAreApa kareche| Ami tAderake yA diYechilAma, erA tAra eka dazamAMzao pAYani| eraparao tArA AmAra rAsUlagaNake mithyA valeche| ataeva, kemana haYeche AmAra zAsti|

valo, ‘Ami teAmAderake ekaTi viSaYe upadeza dicchi—teAmarA AllAhara janya eka ekajana o du-dujana kare dA~r3Ao, ataHpara cintA-bhAvanA karo, teAmAdera saGgIra mAjhe kono ummAdanA nei| se teA Asanna kaTheAra zAsti samparke teAmAdera janya ekajana satarkakArI mAtra|’
valo, ‘Ami teAmAdera kAche keAno pArizramika cAini; varaM tA teAmarAi rAkho; AmAra pratidAna AllAhara kAche| Ara tini pratyeka jinisera pratyakSadarzI|’
valo, ‘AmAra rava satya dvArA AghAta karena (mithyAke)| tini adRzya samparke sarvAdhika avagata|’
valo, ‘satya Agamana kareche Ara asatya nA pAre kono natuna kichu sRjana karate Ara nA pare punarAvRtti karate|’

valo, ‘yadi Ami pathabhraSTa hai tAhale to nijera kSatira janyei pathabhraSTa havo; Ara yadi Ami hidAYAtaprApta hai, tave tA ekAraNe ye, AmAra rava AmAra prati oYAhi pAThAna| nizcaYai tini sarvazreAtA, nikaTavartI|’
yadi tumi dekhate, yakhana tArA bhIta-santrasta haYe par3ave, ataHpara pAliYeo vA~cate pArave nA evaM nikaTavartI sthAna theke pAkar3Ao karA have|
tArA valave, ‘AmarA tAra prati ImAna AnalAma; kintu tArA eta dUra theke tAra nAgAla pAve kemana kare?’
athaca tArA pUrva theke tA asvIkAra karachila| Ara tArA dUravartI sthAna theke ajJAta viSaYera opara mantavya karata|
tAdera o tArA yA kAmanA kare tAra madhye antarAla haYe geche, yemana tAdera satIrthadera sAtheo karA haYeche, yArA tAdera pUrve chila| tArA chila vibhrAntikara sandehera madhye patita|

sakala prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AsamAnasamUha o yaminera sraSTA evaM pherezatAgaNake karechena vArtAvAhaka; tArA dui dui, tina tina o cAra cAra pAkhAviziSTa| tini sRSTira madhye yA icchA vRddhi karena| nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe zaktimAna|
AllAha mAnuSera janya ye anugraha unmukta karena, tA pherAvAra keu nei evaM tini yA ATake rAkhena, tA tAra pare pAThAnora keu nei| tini parAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa|

he mAnuSa, teAmAdera prati AllAhara niYAmAta smaraNa karo| AllAha vyatIta emana keAno sraSTA Ache ki, ye teAmAdera AsamAna o yamina theke riyika dAna kare? tini vyatIta kono ilAha nei| ataeva, tomAdera keAthAYa phiriYe neoYA hacche?
tArA yadi tomAke mithyA sAvyasta kare, tave tomAra pUrvera rAsUladerakeo mithyA pratipanna karA haYeche| AllAhara dikei yAvatIYa viSaYa pherAno have|
he mAnuSa, nizcaYai AllAhara pratizruti satya| sutarAM, pArthivajIvana yena teAmAderake pratArita nA kare evaM sei pravaJcaka yena kichutei teAmAderake AllAha samparke pravaJcita nA kare|
nizcaYai zaYatAna teAmAdera zatru; ataeva, tAke zatru hisevei grahaNa karo| se tAra dalavalake AhvAna kare, yena tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsIdera antarbhukta haYa|
yArA kuphuri kareche tAdera janya raYeche kaTheAra zAsti| Ara yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o mahApuraskAra|

yAra kAche zeAbhanIYa karA haYeche tAra mandakAja, phale se seTAke uttama mane kare, (se ki oi vyaktira mato, ye manda kAjake mandai mane kare; kenanA,) nizcaYai AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena evaM yAke icchA hidAYAta dAna karena| sutarAM tomAra prANa yena nA yAYa tAdera janya anutApa kare kare| nizcaYai AllAha samyaka jJAta se samparke yA tArA kare|
AllAhai vAYu pAThAna, se vAYu meghamAlA saJcArita kare| erapara Ami tA mRta bhU-khaNDera dike saJcAlita kari, tA dvArA se bhU-khaNDake tAra mRtyura para saJjIvita kare dii| ebhAvei have punarutthAna|

ye sammAna cAYa se yena jene rAkhe, sakala sammAna AllAharai janya| tA~rai dike AreAhaNa kare uttama vAkya evaM satkarma tA unnIta kare| yArA manda kAjera cakrAnta kare, tAdera janya raYeche kaTheAra zAsti| tAdera cakrAnta vyartha have|

AllAha teAmAderake sRSTi karechena mATi theke, ataHpara zukrANu theke, tArapara karechena teAmAderake yugala| Ara kono nArI garbhadhAraNa kare nA evaM prasava kare nA tAra jJAna vyatIta; yekeAno vaYaska vyakti vaYasa pAYa nA evaM tAra vaYasa theke hrAsa karA haYa nA kichu, tave avazyai tA likhita Ache kitAve| nizcaYai eTA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|

duTi samudra samAna haYa nA; eTi miThA o tRSNAnivAraka evaM aparaTi leAnA, lavaNAkta; ubhaYaTi thekei teAmarA (mAchera) tAjA geAzata AhAra karo evaM alaMkArAdi AharaNa karo, yA tomarA paridhAna karo| tumi tAte tAra vuka cire jAhAja calate dekho, yena teAmarA tAra anugraha anveSaNa karo; yena teAmarA kRtajJatA prakAza karo|

tini rAtake dinera madhye praviSTa karena evaM dinake rAtera madhye praviSTa karena| tini sUrya o candrake niYantraNAdhIna karechena| pratyekaTi Avartana kare eka nirdiSTa samaYa anuyAYI| ini AllAha; teAmAdera rava, rAjatva tA~rai| tA~ra parivarte teAmarA yAderake DAko, tArA kono khejura A~Tira AvaraNerao mAlikAnA rAkhe nA|

teAmarA yadi tAdera DAko tArA teAmAdera DAka zunate pAYa nA; yadi tArA zunateo peta, teAmAdera DAke sAr3A dita nA| kiYAmAtera dina tArA teAmAdera ziraka asvIkAra karave| vastuta AllAhara mato teAmAke keu avahita karate pArave nA|
he mAnavajAti, teAmarA AllAhara prati mukhApekSI, Ara AllAhai ekamAtra abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|
tini yadi icchA karena teAmAdera vilupta kare devena evaM eka natuna sRSTira udbhava karavena|
eTA AllAhara pakSe kono kaThina kichu naYa|

kono vahanakArI aparera veAjhA vahana karave nA| kono bhArAkrAnta vyakti yadi tAra vojhA vahana karate anyake AhvAna kare tavuo tAra theke kono kichu vahana karA have nA; yadi se nikaTavartI AtmIYao haYa| tumi kevala tAdera satarka karate pAro, yArA tAdera ravake adRzyabhAve bhaYa kare evaM sAlAta kAYema kare; ye nije parizuddha haYa, se parizuddha haYa nijera janyai| AllAhara nikaTai sakalera pratyAvartana|
samAna hate pAre nA dRSTimAna o dRSTihIna;
nA andhakAra o AleA;
nA chAYA o taptareAda|
Arao samAna hate pAre nA jIvita o mRta| AllAha zravaNa karAna yAke tini icchA karena| tumi sakSama nao tAderake zonAte yArA Ache kavare|
tumi teA ekajana satarkakArI vyatIta keu nao|
Ami tomAke satyasaha pAThiYechi susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe| Ara nei keAno jAti, yAdera mAjhe kono satarkakArI Aseni|
tArA yadi tomAra prati mithyAreApa kare, tave tAdera pUrvavartIrAo mithyAreApa karechila| tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa spaSTa nidarzana, sahIphA evaM ujjvala kitAvasaha esechila|
ataHpara tAderake Ami pAkar3Ao karechilAma yArA kuphuri karechila| kemana chila AmAra zAsti!

tumi ki dekhoni ye AllAha AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karechena, ataHpara tA dvArA Ami vibhinna raGera phalaphalAdi udgata karechi| parvatamAlAra madhye raYeche vibhinna varNera giripatha, sAdA-lAla o nikaSa kAleA|
anurUpa vibhinna varNera mAnuSa, jantu, catuSpada prANI raYeche| AllAhara vAndAdera madhye AlimarAi kevala tA~ke bhaYa kare| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI kSamAmaYa|
yArA AllAhara kitAva pATha kare, sAlAta kAYema kare evaM Ami yA diYechi, tA theke geApane o prakAzye vyaYa kare, tArA emana vyavasA AzA kare, yAte kakhano leAkasAna have nA|
phale AllAha tAdera pUrNamAtrAYa pratidAna devena evaM tA~ra anugraha theke tAderake Arao vAr3iYe devena| nizcaYai tini kSamAzIla, guNagrAhI|
Ami tomAra prati ye kitAva pratyAdeza karechi, tA satya, tAra pUrvavartI kitAvera satyAYanakArI, nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera vyApAre sava jAnena, dekhena|

ataHpara Ami kitAvera adhikArI karechi tAdera, yAderake Ami AmAra vAndAdera madhya theke maneAnIta karechi| tAdera madhye keu raYeche nijera prati atyAcArI, keu madhyapanthA avalamvanakArI evaM tAdera madhye keu keu AllAhara nirdezakrame kalyANera pathe egiYe geche| eTAi mahA anugraha|
sthAYI jAnnAta, tArA sekhAne praveza karave| sekhAne tArA svarNanirmita, meAtikhacita kaGkaNa dvArA alaMkRta have| sekhAne tAdera peAzAka have rezamera|
Ara tArA valave, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AmAdera duHkha dUra karechena| nizcaYai AmAdera rava kSamAzIla, guNagrAhI|’
‘yini tA~ra anugrahe AmAdera janya pratiSThita karechena sthAYI AvAsa; ekhAne kono kaSTa AmAderake sparza kare nA evaM sparza kare nA kono klAnti|’

Ara yArA kuphuri kareche, tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera Aguna| tAdera opara ei phAYasAlA karA have nA ye tArA mRtyu varaNa karave evaM tAdera theke lAghava karA have nA tAra zAstio; Ami pratyeka akRtajJake ebhAvei zAsti dii|

sekhAne tArA citkAra kare valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAderake vera karuna, AmarA satkAja karava, pUrve yA karatAma, tA karava nA|’ AllAha valavena, ‘ Ami ki teAmAderake etaTA vaYasa dAna karini, sekhAne ye upadeza grahaNa karate cAYa se upadeza grahaNa karate pArate? uparantu teAmAdera kAche satarkakArIo esechila; ataeva, AsvAdana karo (zAsti); sImAlaGghanakArIdera janya nei keAno sAhAyyakArI|’
nizcaYai AllAha AsamAnasamUha o yaminera adRzya viSaYa samparke jJAta| tini antarera viSaYa samparkeo savizeSa avahita|

tinii teAmAderake pRthivIte pratinidhi karechena| ataeva, ye kuphuri karave tAra kuphuri tAra oparai vartAve| kAphiradera kuphara kevala tAdera ravera kAche kreAdhai vRddhi kare evaM kAphiradera kuphara kevala tAdera kSatii vRddhi kare|

valo, ‘teAmarA ki teAmAdera se zarikadera kathA bheve dekhecha, yAderake AllAhara parivarte teAmarA DAko? tArA pRthivIte kI sRSTi kareche AmAke dekhAo| nA ki AsamAnera sRSTite tAdera keAno aMza Ache, nA Ami tAderake keAno kitAva diYechi ye, tArA tAra theke kono dalIlera opara raYeche?’ varaM sImAlaGghanakArIrA eke aparake kevala pratAraNAmUlaka pratizruti diYe thAke|
nizcaYai AllAha AsamAnasamUha o yaminake sthira rAkhena, yena tA Tale nA yAYa| yadi eguleA Tale yeta tave tini vyatIta ke eguleAke sthira rAkhata? nizcaYai tini sahanazIla, kSamAzIla|

tArA AllAhara nAme dRr3ha zapatha kare valata, tAdera kAche keAno satarkakArI ele tArA anya yekeAno sampradAYa apekSA adhikatara satpathe calave| ataHpara yakhana tAdera kAche satarkakArI ela, takhana tAdera ghRNA chAr3A kichu vRddhi kareni|

pRthivIte auddhatyera kAraNe evaM kucakrera kAraNe| kucakra kevala kucakrIderakei ghire dhare| tArA kevala pUrvavartIdera dazArai apekSA karache| ataeva, tumi AllAhara vidhAne parivartana pAve nA evaM AllAhara rIti-nItite keAno rakama vicyutio pAve nA|

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kareni? tAhale dekhata, tAdera pUrvavartIdera kI pariNAma haYeche| athaca tArA tAdera apekSA adhikatara zaktizAlI chila, AsamAnasamUha o yamine keAno kichui AllAhake apAraga karate pAre nA| nizcaYai tini sarvajJa sarvazaktimAna|

yadi AllAha mAnuSake (sAthe sAthe) pAkar3Ao karatena sekAraNe yA tArA kareche, tave bhUpRSThe vicaraNazIla kono prANIkei cher3e ditena nA; kintu tini eka nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta tAderake avakAza dena| ataHpara yakhana se nirdiSTa samaYa ese yAve, nizcaYai AllAha tAra vAndAdera vyApAre samyaka draSTA|
iYA sI-na
prajJAmaYa kuraAnera zapatha|
nizcaYai tumi rAsUlagaNera antarbhukta|
sarala-sudRr3ha pathera opara (pratiSThita)|
mahA parAkramazAlI asIma daYAlura tarapha theke avatIrNa,
yena tumi emana eka sampradAYake satarka karate pAro, yAdera pitRpuruSaderake satarka karA haYani| phale tArA udAsIna|
tAdera adhikAMzera janya (zAstira) kathA/siddhAnta avadhArita haYeche| sutarAM tArA ImAna Anave nA|
nizcaYai Ami tAdera gardAne ver3i pariYechi evaM tA civuka paryanta| phale tArA UrdhvamukhI haYe geche|
Ara Ami tAdera sAmane eka prAcIra o pechane eka prAcIra sthApana karechi, ataHpara tAderake AvRta kare diYechi; phale tArA dekhate pAYa nA|
tumi tAderake satarka karo vA nA karo, tAdera pakSe ubhaYai samAna; tArA ImAna Anave nA|
vastuta tumi kevala tAkei satarka karate pArave, ye upadeza anusaraNa kare evaM daYAmaYake nA dekhe bhaYa kare| ataeva, tumi tAke susaMvAda dAo kSamA o sammAnajanaka puraskArera|
nizcaYai Amii mRtaderake jIvita kari evaM lipivaddha kari tAdera kIrtisamUha evaM tArA yA agre preraNa kare o yA pazcAte rekhe yAYa| Ara Ami pratyeka jinisa spaSTa kitAve saMrakSita rekhechi|
tumi tAdera kAche se janapadera adhivAsIdera dRSTAnta varNanA karo, yakhana sekhAne rAsUlagaNa Agamana karechila|

yakhana Ami tAdera nikaTa dujana rAsUla pAThiYechilAma, takhana tArA tAdera dujanake mithyA pratipanna karala| ataHpara Ami tAderake zaktizAlI karalAma tRtIYa ekajanera mAdhyame| tArA savAi valala, ‘nizcaYai AmarA teAmAdera prati prerita haYechi|’
tArA valala, ‘teAmarA teA AmAdera mato mAnuSa vyatIta kichu nao, rAhamAna to kichui avatIrNa kareni| teAmarA kevala mithyAi valacha|’
rAsUlagaNa valala, ‘AmAdera rava jAnena, avazyai AmarA teAmAdera prati prerita|’
‘AmAdera opara suspaSTa pau~che deoYA vyatIta kono dAYitva nei|’

tArA valala, ‘AmarA to teAmAdera akalyANakara mane karachi| yadi teAmarA virata nA hao, tave avazyai teAmAderake prastarAghAte hatyA karava evaM avazyai AmAdera pakSa theke teAmAderake yantraNAdAYaka zAsti sparza karave|’
tArA (rAsUlagaNa) valala, ‘teAmAdera akalyANa teAmAdera sAthei! eTA ki ejanya ye, teAmAderake sadupadeza deoYA haYeche? varaM teAmarA eka sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYa|’
ataHpara zaharera prAntabhAga theke eka vyakti daur3e ela, se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA rAsUladerake anusaraNa karo|’
‘anusaraNa karo tAderake, yArA teAmAdera kAche keAno vinimaYa cAYa nA evaM yArA hidAYAtaprApta|’
‘AmAra kI halo ye, Ami tA~ra ivAdAta karava nA, yini AmAke sRSTi karechena evaM tA~ra kAche teAmarA pratyAvartita have?’
‘Ami ki tA~ra parivarte anya ilAha grahaNa karava? karuNAmaYa yadi AmAke kono kSati karAra icchA karena, tave tAdera supAriza AmAra keAnoi kAje Asave nA evaM tArA AmAke rakSAo karate pArave nA|’
‘(emana karale) Ami avazyai spaSTa bhraSTatAYa par3ava|’
‘Ami nizcaYai teAmAdera ravera prati ImAna enechi| ataeva, tomarA AmAra kathA zono|’
(mRtyura para) tAke valA halo, ‘jAnnAte praveza karo|’ se valala, ‘hAYa! AmAra sampradAYa yadi jAnate pArata!’
‘ye kAraNe AmAra rava AmAke kSamA karechena evaM AmAke sammAnitadera antarbhukta karechena|’
tAra para Ami tAra sampradAYera opara AkAza theke keAno vAhinI avatIrNa karini; Ara Ami (vAhinI) avatIrNakArI nai|
vastuta e chila eka vikaTa AoYAja| phale saGge saGge savAi nistavdha haYe gela|
hAYa! AkSepa vAndAdera janya, tAdera kAche emana keAno rAsUlai Aseni, yAdera prati tArA vidrupa karata nA|
tArA ki dekhe nA, tAdera pUrve Ami kata sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechi ye, tArA tAdera kAche Ara phire Asave nA?
Ara nizcaYai tAdera savAike ekatre AmAra kAche upasthita karA have|
tAdera janya ekaTi nidarzana mRta pRthivI, Ami eke saJjIvita kari evaM tA theke utpanna kari zasya, phale tA theke tArA AhAra kare|
Ami tAte sRSTi kari khejura o AGurera vAgAna evaM pravAhita kari tAte kichu jharanAdhArA|
yena tArA tAra phalamUla theke khete pAre, Ara tAdera hAta egulo sRSTi kareni; tavuo ki tArA kRtajJatA prakAza karave nA?
pavitra o mahAna tini, yini yamina theke utpanna samasta udbhida evaM tAdera nijederake (mAnuSake) yugalavaddha kare sRSTi karechena; Ara segulokeo, ye samparke tArA jAne nA|
Ara tAdera janya eka nidarzana rAta, Ami tA theke dinake apasArita kari, takhanai tArA andhakArAcchanna haYe yAYa|
sUrya tAra nirdiSTa avasthAne Avartana kare| eTA mahA parAkramazAlI, sarvajJera niYantraNa|
Ara cA~dera janya Ami vibhinna sthAna (mAnayila) nirdhAraNa karechi; avazeSe se purAtana khejura zAkhAra anurUpa haYe yAYa|
sUryera pakSe sambhava naYa ye, se nAgAla pAve cA~dera evaM rAta atikramakArI hate pAre nA dinera; evaM pratyekei (Apana Apana) kakSapathe santaraNa kare|
tAdera janya ekaTi nidarzana ei ye, Ami tAdera santAna-santatike veAjhAikRta naukAYa AreAhaNa kariYechi|
evaM tAdera janya naukAra anurUpa yAnavAhana sRSTi karechi, yAte tArA AreAhaNa kare|
Ami icchA karale tAderake nimajjita karate pAri, takhana tAdera janya keAno sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA evaM tArA paritrANao pAve nA|
yadi nA AmAra pakSa theke daYA evaM kichu samaYera janya jIvaneApabheAgera suyoga deoYA haYa|
Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘yA tomAdera sAmane Ache o yA tomAdera pechane Ache (zAsti), se samvandhe bhaYa karo, yena teAmAdera prati anugraha karA haYa|’
Ara tAdera ravera nidarzanAvalira madhya theke yakhanai keAno nidarzana tAdera kAche Ase, takhanai tArA tA theke mukhe phiriYe neYa|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘AllAha teAmAderake ye riyika diYechena, tA theke vyaYa karo|’ takhana kAphirarA mu’minagaNake vale, ‘AmarA ki tAke khAoYAva, AllAha icchA karalei yAke khAoYAte pAratena? teAmarA teA spaSTa bhrAntite raYecha|’
tArA vale, ‘teAmarA yadi satyavAdI hao, (tave valo), ei pratizruti kave pUrNa have?’
tArA to kevala ekaTA vikaTa AoYAjera apekSA karache, yA tAdera pAkar3Ao karave e avasthAYa—tArA paraspare vAka-vitaNDA karache|
takhana tArA asiYata karateo sakSama have nA| evaM tAdera parivAra-parijanera kAche phireo yete pArave nA|
Ara ziGgAYa phu~ka deoYA have, takhanai tArA kavara theke tAdera ravera dike chuTe calave|
tArA valave, ‘hAYa AmAdera durbheAga! ke AmAderake nidrAsthala theke uThAla? rAhamAna teA erai pratizruti diYechilena evaM rAsUlagaNa satya valechilena|’
tA have kevala eka vikaTa AoYAja| se muhUrtei tAdera savAike AmAra sAmane upasthita karA have|
Aja kArao prati kono yuluma karA have nA evaM teAmarA yA karate, kevala tArai pratidAna deoYA have|
nizcaYai Aja jAnnAtera adhivAsIrA Anande mazagula thAkave|
tArA o tAdera strIrA chAYAra madhye susajjita Asane helAna diYe upaviSTa thAkave|
sekhAne tAdera janya thAkave phala-mUla evaM yA cAive|
karuNAmaYa ravera pakSa theke valA have ‘sAlAma’|
(AllAha valavena,) ‘he aparAdhIrA, Aja teAmarA AlAdA haYe yAo|’
he vani-Adama, Ami ki teAmAderake nirdeza diini ye, zaYatAnera ivAdAta kareA nA, se teAmAdera prakAzya zatru?
evaM AmArai ivAdAta karo eTAi sarala-sudRr3ha patha|
evaM nizcaYai zaYatAna teAmAdera aneka dalake pathabhraSTa kareche| tavuo ki teAmarA vujhate pAroni?
ei sei jAhAnnAma, yAra pratizruti teAmAderake deoYA hateA|
teAmarA ye kuphuri karate, ekAraNe Aja ete praveza karo|
Aja Ami tAdera mukhe meAhara e~Te deva; tAdera hAta AmAra sAthe kathA valave evaM tAdera pA se samparke sAkSya deve, yA tArA upArjana karata|
Ami yadi icchA karatAma, tAdera dRSTizakti lopa kare dite pAratAma; takhana tArA pathera dike daur3Ate cAile kemana kare dekhate peta!
Ara Ami yadi icchA karatAma, tAdera sva sva sthAne tAderake vikRta karate pAratAma, phale tArA Ageo calate pArata nA evaM pechaneo phire yete pArata nA|
Ami yAke dIrgha jIvana dAna kari, tAra sRSTi-avaYave Ami parivartana ghaTAi| tavuo ki tArA vojhe nA?
Ami rAsUlake kavitA zekhAini evaM tA tAra janya zeAbhanIYao naYa| eTA teA eka upadeza o spaSTa kuraAna|
yena se jIvitaderake satarka karate pAre evaM kAphiradera viruddhe pratiSThita haYa abhiyeAga|
tArA ki dekheni, AmAra hAte tairi vastusamUhera madhye Ami tAdera janya catuSpada jantu sRSTi karechi, ataHpara tArAi eguleAra mAlika|
evaM Ami eguleAke tAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechi| phale edera kichu tAdera vAhana evaM kichu tArA AhAra kare|
tAdera janya catuSpada jantura madhye aneka upakAra o pAnIYa raYeche| tavuo ki tArA kRtajJa have nA?
tArA AllAhara parivarte aneka ilAha grahaNa kareche; yena tArA sAhAyyaprApta hate pAre|
erA (ilAha) tAderake sAhAyya karate sakSama have nA evaM eguleA tAdera vAhinIrUpe upasthita karA have|
ataeva, tAdera kathA yena tomAke duHkhita nA kare| Ami jAni—yA tArA geApane kare evaM yA tArA prakAzye kare|
mAnuSa ki dekhe nA, Ami tAke sRSTi karechi vIrya theke? erapara se haYe gela prakAzya vitarkakArI|
se AmAra samparke upamA racanA kareche, athaca se nijera sRSTira kathA bhule yAYa| se vale—‘ke hAr3asamUhe prANa saJcAra karave, yakhana seguleA pacAgalA jarAjIrNa haYe yAve?’
valo, ‘yini prathamavAra seguleAke sRSTi karechena, tinii tA jIvita karavena| Ara tini sarvaprakAra sRSTi samparke samyaka avagata|’
yini teAmAdera janya savuja gAcha theke Aguna utpanna karena| phale teAmarA tA theke prajvalita karo|
yini AsamAna o yamina sRSTi karechena, tinii ki tAdera anurUpa sRSTi karate sakSama nana? hyA~, tini mahAsraSTA, sarvajJa|
tA~ra vyApAra zudhu ei, tini yakhana keAno kichura icchA karena, takhana tAke valena, ‘hao’ takhanai tA haYe yAYa|
ataeva, pavitra tini, yA~ra hAte savakichura sArvabhaumatva evaM tA~rai dike teAmarA pratyAvartita have|
zapatha tAdera yArA sArivaddhabhAve dA~r3Ano|
yArA hA~kiYe niYe yAYa yathAyathabhAve|
zapatha tAdera yArA kuraAna AvRtti kare|
nizcaYai teAmAdera ilAha eka|
yini AsamAnasamUha, yamina o e duTira madhyavartI savakichura rava evaM rava udaYAcalasamUhera|
nizcaYai Ami duniYAra AkAzake tArakArAjira saundarya dvArA suzeAbhita karechi|
evaM saMrakSaNa karechi pratyeka avAdhya zaYatAna theke|
phale tArA Urdhva jagatera kichu zunate pAre nA evaM sarvadika theke tAdera prati (ulkA) nikSepa karA haYa|
tAr3Anora janya| Ara tAdera janya raYeche virAmahIna zAsti|
tave keu cheA~ mere kichu zune phelale jvalanta ulkApiNDa tAra pechane dhAoYA kare|
tumi tAderake jijJesa karo, tAdera sRSTi karA kaThinatara, nAki Ami anya yA sRSTi karechi? Amii tAderake sRSTi karechi AThAlo mATi theke|
varaM tumi vismaYaveAdha karo Ara tArA vidrupa kare|
yakhana tAdera upadeza deoYA haYa, takhana tArA upadeza grahaNa kare nA|
tArA yakhana keAno nidarzana dekhe, takhana vidrupa kare|
evaM vale, ‘eTA spaSTa jAdu chAr3A kichui naYa|’
‘AmarA yakhana mArA yAva, evaM mATi o hAr3e pariNata hava, takhanao ki AmarA punarutthita hava?’
‘evaM AmAdera pUrvavartI pitRpuruSagaNao ki?’
valo, ‘hyA~ evaM teAmarA have lAJchita|’
mUlata tA (utthAna) have ekaTi mAtra vikaTa zavda, takhanai tArA dekhate pAve|
evaM valave, ‘hAYa durbhAgya AmAdera! eTAi teA pratiphala divasa|’
eTAi phAYasAlAra dina, yAke teAmarA mithyA valate|
ekatra karo tAderake yArA sImAlaGghana kareche, tAdera deAsaradera evaM yAdera ivAdAta tArA karata|
AllAha vyatIta; sutarAM tAdera paricAlita karo jAhAnnAmera pathe|
tAderake thAmAo, nizcaYai tArA jijJAsita have;
teAmAdera kI halo ye, teAmarA eke aparera sAhAyya karacha nA?
varaM tArA Aja AtmasamarpaNakArI|
tArA eke aparera dike mukha kare parasparake jijJAsAvAda karave|
tArA valave, ‘teAmarA teA AmAdera kAche DAnadika theke Asate!’
tArA valave, ‘varaM teAmarA teA mu’minai chile nA!’
‘evaM teAmAdera opara AmAdera keAno kartRtva chila nA, varaM teAmarAi chile sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYa|’
‘tAi AmAdera vipakSe AmAdera ravera uktii satya haYeche| AmAdera avazyai (zAstira) svAda AsvAdana karate have|’
‘vAstave AmarA teAmAderake pathabhraSTa karechilAma| kAraNa, AmarA nijerAi pathabhraSTa chilAma|’
tArA savAi sedina zAstite zarika have|
aparAdhIdera sAthe Ami emanai kare thAki|
tAderake yakhana valA hato, ‘AllAha vyatIta keAno ilAha nei’, takhana tArA auddhatya pradarzana karata|
evaM valata, ‘AmarA ki eka ummAda kavira janya AmAdera ilAhadera parityAga karava|’
varaM, se satyasaha eseche evaM rAsUlagaNera satyAYana kareche|
teAmarA avazyai yantraNAdAYaka zAsti AsvAdana karave|
teAmarA yA karate, tArai pratiphala pAve|
AllAhara niSThAvAna vAndArA vyatIta|
tAdera janya raYeche nirdhArita jIvikA|
phala-mUla evaM tArA sammAnita|
niYAmAtapUrNa udyAnasamUhe|
mukheAmukhi haYe Asane AsIna have|
tAderake ghurephire parivezana karA have svaccha pAnapAtra|
zubhra ujjvala; pAnakArIdera janya susvAdu|
tAte kSatikara upAdAna nei evaM tArA tAte mAtAlao have nA|
tAdera kAche thAkave, Anata-naYanA sundara cakSuviziSTa (huravRnda)|
yena tArA surakSita Dima|
ataHpara tArA eke aparera dike mukhomukhi haYe paraspara jijJAsA karave|
tAdera madhya theke ekajana kathaka valave, ‘AmAra eka saGgI chila|’
se valata, ‘tumi ki (AkhirAtake) satyAYanakArIdera antarbhukta?’
‘AmarA yakhana mare yAva evaM mATi o hADDite pariNata hava, takhano ki AmarA pratiphalaprApta hava?’
(AllAha) valavena, ‘teAmarA ki tAke u~ki diYe dekhate cAo?’
ataHpara se u~ki diYe dekhave evaM tAke jAhAnnAmera mAjhakhAne dekhate pAve|
se valave, ‘AllAhara kasama, tumi teA AmAke prAYa dhvaMsai kare diYechile!’
‘yadi AmAra ravera anugraha nA hato, tave Amio (jAhAnnAme) upasthitadera antarbhukta hatAma!’
‘nizcaYai AmarA Ara mRtyuvaraNa karava nA!’
‘prathama mRtyu vyatIta evaM AmarA zAstiprAptao hava nA|’
nizcaYai eTA mahAsAphalya|
era anurUpa sAphalyera janya parizramIdera parizrama karA ucita|
ApyAYanera janya eTAi ki uttama, nAki yAkkumagAcha?
nizcaYai Ami tA vAniYechi sImAlaGghanakArIdera parIkSArthe|
nizcaYai eTi ekaTi gAcha, yA udgata haYa jAhAnnAmera taladeza theke|
era mocA yena zaYatAnera mAthA|
nizcaYai tArA (kAphirarA) tA theke khAve evaM tA diYe peTa bharti karave|
tArapara tAdera janya tadupari thAkave phuTanta pAnira mizraNa,
ataHpara tAdera pratyAvartana have jAhAnnAmera dike|
tArA tAdera pitRpuruSadera peYechila pathabhraSTa|
ataHpara tArA tadera padAGka anusaraNe tatpara chila|
tAdera Age pUrvavartIdera adhikAMza vipathagAmI haYechila|
Ami tAdera madhye bhItipradarzanakArI pAThiYechilAma|
ataeva, lakSa karo, yAderake bhItipradarzana karA haYechila, tAdera pariNati kI haYechila|
tave AllAhara manonIta vAndArA chAr3A|
Ara nUha AmAke Dekechila| sutarAM Ami katai nA uttama sAr3AdAnakArI|
Ami tAke o tAra parivAravargake eka mahAsaMkaTa theke rakSA karechilAma|
evaM tAra vaMzadharaderakei Ami avaziSTa rekhechilAma|
Ami tA paravartIdera AlocanAYa rekhechi|
vizvavAsIra madhye nUhera prati zAnti varSita heAka!
ebhAvei Ami satkarmaparAYaNaderake puraskRta kare thAki|
se chila AmAra mu’mina vAndAdera anyatama|
ataHpara Ami anyaderake DuviYe diYechilAma|
Ara ivarAhIma chila tAra anugAmIdera antarbhukta|
yakhana se tAra ravera nikaTa vizuddha antara niYe upasthita haYechila,
yakhana se tAra pitA o sampradAYake valechila, ‘teAmarA kIsera upAsanA karacha?’
‘teAmarA ki AllAha vyatIta mithyA ilAha kAmanA karacha?’
‘vizvajagatera rava samparke teAmAdera dhAraNA kI?’
ataHpara se ekavAra tArakAdera prati lakSa karala|
evaM valala, ‘Ami pIr3ita|’
ataHpara tArA tAra dike piTha phiriYe cale gela|
ataHpara se tAdera devatAdera kAche giYe valala, ‘teAmarA khAccha nA kena?’
‘teAmAdera kI halo, tomarA kathA valacha nA?’
ataHpara se savale tAdera opara AghAta hAnala|
takhana leAkajana tAra dike chuTe ela (bhIta-santrasta pade)|
se valala, ‘teAmarA ki tAdera pUjA karacho, yA tomarA pAthara khodAi kare tairi karo?’
‘athaca AllAha teAmAderake evaM teAmarA yA nirmANa karacha, savAike sRSTi karechena|’
tArA valala, ‘tomarA era janya ekaTi sthApanA nirmANa karo, ataHpara tAke jvalanta Agune nikSepa karo|’
tArapara tArA tAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra A~Tate cAila, kintu Ami tAderakei parAbhUta kare dilAma|
Ara se valala, ‘Ami AmAra ravera dike calalAma, tini AmAke pathapradarzana karavena|’
he AmAra rava, ‘AmAke eka satkarmazIla putra dAna karuna|’
sutarAM Ami tAke eka sahanazIla putrera susaMvAda dAna karalAma|

ataHpara se yakhana pitAra sAthe calApherA karAra vaYase upanIta halo, takhana se (ivarAhIma) valala, ‘he AmAra putra, Ami svapne dekhi ye, Ami teAmAke yaveha karachi; ataeva dekho, tumi kI mane karo?’ se valala, ‘he AmAra pitA, ApanAke yA Adeza karA haYeche, tA-i karuna| AllAha cAna teA Apani AmAke dhairyazIladera antarbhukta pAvena|’
yakhana tArA ubhaYe Anugatya prakAza karala evaM ivarAhIma tAke (yaveha karAra janya) kAta kare zuiYe dila|
takhana Ami tAke Deke valalAma, ‘he ivarAhIma’,
‘tumi teA svapnake satye pariNata karecha!’ Ami ebhAvei satkarmIdera pratidAna diYe thAki|
nizcaYai eTA eka suspaSTa parIkSA|
Ami tAke mukta karalAma eka virATa jantu yavehera vinimaYe|
Ara Ami tAra janya paravartIdera mAjhe pracalana rekhe dilAma|
ivarAhImera prati sAlAma varSita heAka|
ebhAve Ami satkarmIderake pratidAna diYe thAki|
nizcaYai se chila AmAra mu’mina vAndAdera anyatama|
Ami tAke susaMvAda diYechi isahAkera, se chila ekajana satkarmazIla navi|
tAke evaM isahAkake Ami varakata dAna karechi evaM tAdera ubhaYera vaMzadharadera madhye keu satkarmI o keu tAra nijera opara spaSTa sImAlaGghanakArI|
Ara nizcaYai Ami anugraha karechilAma mUsA o hArUnera prati|
tAderake o tAdera sampradAYake uddhAra karechi mahAsaMkaTa theke|
Ami tAderake sAhAyya karechilAma, phale tArAi chila vijaYI|
Ami ubhaYake diYechilAma suspaSTa kitAva|
evaM Ami tAderake sarala pathapradarzana karechilAma|
Ami tAdera janya paravartIdera madhye sunAma rekhe diYechi|
mUsA o hArUnera prati sAlAma varSita heAka|
ebhAve Ami satkarmIderake pratidAna diYe thAki|
tArA ubhaYei chila AmAra mu’mina vAndAdera antarbhukta|
nizcaYai ilaYAsa chila rAsUladera ekajana|
yakhana se tAra sampradAYake valala, ‘teAmarA ki bhaYa karo nA?’
‘teAmarA ki (murti) vA‘Alake AhvAna karave evaM sarveAttama sraSTAke parityAga karave?’
‘AllAha teAmAdera rava evaM teAmAdera pUrvavartI pitRpuruSadera rava?’
ataHpara tArA tAke mithyA pratipanna karala| phale avazyai tAderake upasthita karA have|
AllAhara ekaniSTha vAndAgaNa vyatIta|
Ami tAra janya paravartIdera madhye sukhyAti rekhe dilAma|
ilaYAsera prati sAlAma varSita heAka!
ebhAvei Ami satkarmazIladerake pratidAna diYe thAki|
se chila AmAra mu’mina vAndAdera antarbhukta|
nizcaYai lUta chila rAsUlagaNera antarbhukta|
yakhana Ami tAke o tAra parivArera savAike uddhAra karechilAma;
pechane avasthAnakArIdera antarbhukta eka vRddhA vyatIta|
ataHpara avaziSTaderake Ami samUle dhvaMsa karechilAma|
teAmarA tAdera dhvaMsastUpera upara diYe atikrama kare thAko sakAle|
evaM rAteo, tavuo ki teAmarA veAjha nA?
Ara iunusao chila rAsUlagaNera antarbhukta|
yakhana se ekaTi veAjhAi naukAra dike pAliYe giYechila|
ataHpara se laTArite aMza nila evaM se parAstadera antarbhukta halo|
ataHpara ekaTi mAcha tAke gile phelala evaM se (nijeke) dhikkAra dicchila|
Ara se yadi AllAhara tAsavIha pAThakArIdera antarbhukta nA hato,
tAhale yedina tAdera punarutthAna karA have, se paryanta tAke tAra peTei thAkate hato|
ataHpara Ami tAke eka vistIrNa-vijana prAntare nikSepa karalAma, takhana se chila rugNa|
Ami tAra pAze eka latAviziSTa vRkSa udgata karalAma|
evaM Ami tAke lakSa vA tatadhika leAkera prati pAThAlAma|
tArA vizvAsa sthApana karala ataHpara Ami tAderake nirdhArita samaYa paryanta jIvaneApabheAga karate dilAma|
tAdera jijJesa karo, ‘teAmAra ravera janya ki kanyA santAna evaM tAdera janya putra-santAna?’
nAki Ami pherezatAderake nArIrUpe sRSTi karechilAma evaM tArA tA dekhachila?
jene rAkho, avazyai tArA tAdera managar3A kathA vale ye,
‘AllAha santAna janma diYechena|’ nizcaYai tArA mithyAvAdI|
tini ki putra-santAnera sthale kanyA-santAna pachanda karechena?
teAmAdera kI halo, teAmarA kemana sindhAnta niccha?
teAmarA ki anudhAvana kara nA?
nAki teAmAdera kAche suspaSTa keAno dalIla raYeche?
ataeva tomarA teAmAdera kitAva niYe eso, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao|
tArA tAra o jinadera madhye samparka sAvyasta kareche, athaca jinerA jAne ye, nizcaYai tAderakeo upasthita karA have|
tArA yA vale tA theke AllAha pavitra|
tave AllAhara niSThAvAna vAndArA vyatIta,
ataeva, teAmarA evaM teAmarA yAdera upAsanA karo tArA,
teAmarA tAke vibhrAnta karate pArave nA|
tave se vyatIta, ye jvalanta Agune pravezakArI|
Ara AmAdera madhye emana keu nei—yAra janya nirdiSTa sthAna nei|
Ara avazyai AmarA sArivaddha|
evaM AmarAi AllAhara pavitratA gheASaNA kari|
Ara tArA teA valata—
‘yadi AmAdera kAche pUrvavartIdera mato keAno upadeza thAkata,
tave AmarA avazyai AllAhara maneAnIta vAndA hatAma|’
vastuta tArA tAke (ei kuraAnake) asvIkAra kareche| phale ziggira tArA jAnate pArave,
Ara nizcaYai AmAra prerita vAndAdera janya AmAra kathA pUrva nirdhArita haYeche ye,
avazyai tArA sAhAyyaprApta have|
Ara AmAra vAhinIi haYa vijaYI|
ataeva, kichukAla paryanta tumi tAdera upekSA karo|
evaM tAdera dekhate thAko| ziggira tArAo (era pariNAma) dekhave|
AmAra zAsti ki tArA druta kAmanA kare?
ataHpara yakhana tAdera AGinAYa zAsti avatIrNa have, takhana satarkaprAptadera sakAla velATi khuvai manda have|
tumi kichukAla paryanta tAdera upekSA karo|
evaM dekhate thAko, ziggira tArAo (era pariNAma) dekhave|
tArA yA varNanA kare, tA theke tomAra rava pavitra, sammAnera mAlika|
rAsUladera prati sAlAma varSita heAka|
samasta prazaMsA jagatasamUhera rava AllAharai janya|
sa-da; zapatha upadezapUrNa kuraAnera,
varaM yArA kuphuri kareche, tArA ahaMkAra o vireAdhitAYa lipta|
tAdera Age Ami kata janageASThIke dhvaMsa karechi, ataHpara tArA ArtanAda karate zuru kareche; kintu niSkRtilAbhera Ara samaYa chila nA|
tArA vismaYaveAdha kare ye, tAderai kAche tAdera madhya theke ekajana satarkakArI eseche| Ara kAphirarA vale ‘e teA eka jAdukara mithyAcArI|’
‘se ki vahu ilAhake eka ilAha vAniYe niYeche? nizcaYai eTA eka vismaYakara vyApAra|’
tAdera kichu viziSTa vyakti ekathA vale cale gela ye, ‘teAmarA cale yAo evaM teAmAdera upAsyadera upAsanAYa dRr3ha thAko| nizcaYai e viSaYaTi uddezyapraNeAdita|’
‘AmarA to anya dharmAdarze emana kathA zunini| eTA managar3A kathA chAr3A kichui naYa|’
‘AmAdera madhya theke zudhu ki tArai prati upadeza vANI avatIrNa halo?’ vastuta tArA AmAra upadeza samparke sandehe raYeche; varaM tArA ekhano AmAra zAsti AsvAdana kareni|
nAki tAdera kAche tomAra parAkramazAlI daYAvAna ravera rAhamAtera keAno bhAnDAra raYeche?
nAki AsamAna, yamina o e duTira madhyavartI savakichura opara tAdera sAmrAjya raYeche? thAkale upAYa avalamvana kare ArohaNa karuka|
ekSetre vahu vAhinIra madhye oderao eka vAhinI Ache, yA parAjita have|
tAdera pUrveo mithyAreApa karechila nUhera sampradAYa, Ada, vahu aTTAlikAra mAlika phiraAuna,
sAmUda o lUtera sampradAYa evaM AikAra leAkerA| erAi chila eka vizAla vAhinI|
edera pratyekei rAsUladera prati mithyAreApa kareche| phale AmAra zAsti vAstavAYita haYeche|
Ara tArA to kevala ekaTi vikaTa zavdera apekSA karache, yAte kono virAma thAkave nA|
tArA vale, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAdera prApya hisAva divasera Agei druta diYe dAo|’
tArA yA vale tAte tumi dhairyadhAraNa karo evaM AmAra zaktizAlI vAndA dAUdake smaraNa karo| nizcaYai se chila AmAra abhimukhI|
Ami parvatamAlAke niYojita karechilAma, tArA sakAla-sandhyAYa tAra sAthe pavitratA gheASaNA karata;
Ara samaveta pAkhiderakeo| tArA pratyekei chila tAra abhimukhI|
Ami tAra sAmrAjyake sudRr3ha karechilAma evaM tAke diYechilAma prajJA o phAYasAlAkArI vAgmitA|
tomAra kAche vivadamAnadera vRttAnta pau~cheche ki? yakhana tArA prAcIra DiGiYe ivAdAtakhAnAYa praveza karechila|

yakhana tArA dAUdera kAche praveza karala, takhana tAdera kAraNe se santrasta haYe par3ala| tArA valala, ‘bhaYa karavena nA; AmarA vivadamAna duTi pakSa, eke aparera prati vAr3AvAr3i karechi| ataeva, AmAdera madhye nyAYavicAra karuna, avicAra karavena nA| AmAderake sarala pathapradarzana karuna|’
“e AmAra bhAi, tAra raYeche nirAnavvaiTi dumvA Ara AmAra Ache mAtra ekaTi mAdI dumvA| eraparao se vale, ‘eTio AmAke diYe dAo’| se kathAvArtAYa AmAra opara vala praYeAga kare|”

dAUda valala, ‘se teAmAra dumvATike nijera dumvAguleAra sAthe saMyukta karAra dAvi kare teAmAra prati avicAra kareche| zarikadera anekei eke aparera prati sImAlaGghana kare thAke| tave tArA kare nA, yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma sampAdana kare evaM tArA saMkhyAYa alpa|’ dAUda vujhate pArala ye, Ami tAke parIkSA karachi| ataHpara se tAra ravera kAche kSamAprArthanA karala, se sijadAYa luTiYe par3ala o tA~ra abhimukhI halo|
ataHpara Ami tAra se aparAdha kSamA karalAma| nizcaYai AmAra kAche tAra janya raYeche naikaTyera maryAdA o sundara AvAsasthala|

‘he dAUda, Ami teAmAke pRthivIte pratinidhi karechi, ataeva, tumi mAnuSera mAjhe nyAYavicAra karo evaM pravRttira anusaraNa kareA nA| tA teAmAke AllAhara patha theke vicyuta kare deve|’ nizcaYai yArA AllAhara patha theke vicyuta haYa, tAdera janya raYeche kaTheAra zAsti, e kAraNe ye, tArA hisAva-divasake bhule yAYa|
Ami AsamAna-yamina o e duTira madhyavartI keAno kichu ayathA sRSTi karini| eTA kAphiradera dhAraNA| ataeva, kAphiradera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera durbheAga|
Ami ki mu’mina o satkarmIderake pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera samatulya kare deva? nAki muttAkiderake aparAdhIdera mato kare deva|
ei kitAva Ami tomAra prati varakatamaYa kare avatIrNa karechi, yena tArA era AYAtagulo niYe gaveSaNA kare evaM yena jJAnIrA tA theke upadeza grahaNa kare|
Ami dAUdake dAna karechi sulAimAna, katai nA uttama vAndA; nizcaYai se AllAha-abhimukhI|
yakhana tAra sAmane aparAhne utkRSTa azvarAji peza karA haleA,
takhana se valala, ‘Ami teA AmAra ravera smaraNa theke vimukha haYe aizvarya-prItite lipta haYe par3echi| emanaki sUrya Ar3Ale adRzya haYe geche|’
‘eguleA AmAra kAche phiriYe Ano|’ ataHpara se tAdera pAYera gochA o galadeza chedana karate zuru karala|
Ara Ami sulAimAnake parIkSA karalAma evaM rekhe dilAma tAra siMhAsanera upara ekaTi deha| ataHpara se AllAha-abhimukhI haleA|
se (sulAimAna) valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke kSamA karuna evaM AmAke emana sAmrAjya dAna karuna—yA AmAra pare Ara kArao janya zobhanIYa have nA| nizcaYai Apani mahAdAtA|’
takhana Ami vAtAsake tAra anugata kare dilAma, yA tAra hukume mRdumandabhAve pravAhita hato; yekhAne se pau~chAte cAita|
Ara pratyeka prAsAda nirmANakArI o Duvuri zaYatAnaderakeo (tAra adhIna kare dilAma)|
evaM zekale Avaddha Arao anekake (adhIna kare dilAma)|
eguleA AmAra anugraha; ataeva, kAuke dAo athavA nije rAkho, kono hisAva chAr3A|
Ara nizcaYai tAra janya AmAra kAche raYeche naikaTyera maryAdA o manorama AvAsa|
smaraNa karo, AmAra vAndA AiYUvake, yakhana se tAra ravake AhvAna kare valala, ‘zaYatAna AmAke yantraNA o kaSTa dvArA sparza kareche|’
(Ami valalAma,) ‘tumi teAmAra pA diYe bhUmite AghAta karo| eTA gosalera suzItala pAni o pAnIYa|’
Ami tAke dilAma tAra parijanavarga o tAdera saGge tAdera anurUpa anekake, AmAra pakSa theke rAhamAtasvarUpa evaM vuddhimAnadera janya upadezasvarUpa|
tumi teAmAra hAte ekamuTheA tRNazalAkA nAo, tA dvArA AghAta karo, Ara zapatha bhaGga kareA nA| Ami tAke pelAma savarakArI| katai nA uttama vAndA| nizcaYai se chila AmAra abhimukhI|
Ara smaraNa karo, karmadakSa o dUradarzI AmAra vAndA ivarAhIma, isahAka o iYAkUvake|
Ami tAdera eka svatantra vaiziSTya dAna karechilAma—tA halo parakAlera smaraNa|
Ara tArA AmAra kAche maneAnIta o uttama vyaktivargera antarbhukta|
smaraNa karo, isamAIla, Ala-iYAsA o yulakiphalake| tArA pratyekei chila ati uttamadera antarbhukta|
e eka smaraNa| Ara muttAkidera janya raYeche uttama ThikAnA—
Adana jAnnAta; tAra darajAsamUha tAdera janya ummukta|
sekhAne tArA helAna diYe vasave| tArA sekhAne cAive aneka phala-mUla o pAnIYa|
tAdera kAche thAkave Anata-naYanA samavaYasI nArIrA|
teAmAderake erai pratizruti deoYA hacche vicAra divasera janya|
nizcaYai eTA AmAra deoYA riyika—yAra kono zeSa nei|
eTA (to zunale)| Ara nizcaYai avAdhyadera janya raYeche nikRSTa ThikAnA—
jAhAnnAma| tArA sekhAne praveza karave| kata nikRSTa sei AvAsasthala!
eTA (sImAlaGghanakArIdera janya)| ataeva, tArA eke AsvAdana karuka uttapta pAni o pu~ja|
Arao raYeche e dharanera aneka rakama zAsti|
ei teA ekadala teAmAdera sAthe praveza karache| tAdera janya abhinandana nei| tArA teA jAhAnnAme praveza karave|
tArA valave, ‘varaM tomarAo; teAmAdera janyao teA nei kono abhinandana! teAmarAi AmAdera e vipadera sammukhIna karecha| ataeva, eTi katai nA ghRNya AvAsasthala!’
tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, ye AmAderake era sammukhIna kareche, Apani jAhAnnAme tAra zAsti dviguNa vAr3iYe dina|’
tArA Arao valave, ‘AmAdera kI haleA ye, AmarA yAderake manda leAka gaNya karatAma, tAdera ekhAne dekhachi nA!’
‘AmarA ki tAderake ThATTAra pAtrarUpe grahaNa karechilAma, nAki tAdera vyApAre AmAdera dRSTi bhula kareche?’
e to nizcita satya—jAhAnnAmera adhivAsIdera ei pArasparika vAkavitaNDA|
