valo, ‘Ami teA ekajana satarkakArI mAtra evaM AllAha vyatIta keAno ilAha nei tini ekaka, mahAparAkramazAlI|’
‘tini AsamAna-yamina o e-duTira madhyavartI savakichura rava, parAkramazAlI, mArjanAkArI|’
valo, ‘eTi eka mahAsaMvAda’,
‘yA theke teAmarA mukha phiriYe niYecha|’
‘Urdhvajagat samparke AmAra keAno jJAna chila nA; yakhana pherezatArA vAdAnuvAda karachila|’
‘AmAra kAche e oYAhi-i Ase ye, Ami ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI|’
yakhana tomAra rava pherezatAgaNake valalena, ‘Ami mATi theke mAnuSa sRSTi karava|’
‘yakhana Ami tAke suSama karava evaM tAte AmAra rUha phu~ke deva, takhana teAmarA tAra sammukhe sijadAYa nata haYe yeYeA|’
ataHpara sakala pherezatAi sijadAYa nata haleA,
ivalIsa vyatIta; se ahaMkAra karala evaM asvIkArakArIdera antarbhukta haYe gela|
tini valalena, ‘he ivalIsa, Ami AmAra dui hAte yAke sRSTi karechi, tAra sammukhe sijadA karate teAmAke kIse vAdhA dila? tumi ki ahaMkAra karale, nA tumi ucca maryAdAsampanna?’
se valala, ‘Ami tAra ceYe uttama; Apani AmAke Aguna dvArA sRSTi karechena, Ara tAke sRSTi karechena mATi dvArA|’
AllAha valalena, ‘vera haYe yAo ekhAna theke| kAraNa, tumi vitAr3ita|’
‘teAmAra prati AmAra e abhizApa vicAra-divasa paryanta|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Apani AmAke tAdera punarutthita havAra dina paryanta avakAza dina|’
AllAha valalena, ‘tAhale tumi avakAzaprAptadera antarbhukta hale’,
‘avadhArita samaYa upastita haoYAra dina paryanta|’
se valala, ‘ApanAra sammAnera kasama, Ami avazyai tAdera savAike vipathagAmI kare deva|’
‘tave tAdera madhye ApanAra khA~Ti vAndArA chAr3A|’
AllAha valalena, ‘tAi Thika, Ara Ami satya valachi’—
‘teAmAra dvArA evaM tAdera madhye yArA teAmAra anusaraNa karave tAdera sakalera dvArA Ami jAhAnnAma pUrNa karava|’
valo, ‘Ami teAmAdera kAche tAra vinimaYe keAno pratidAna cAi nA Ara Ami laukikatAkArIdera antarbhukta nai|’
eTA teA vizvavAsIra janya eka upadezamAtra|
teAmarA kichu kAla pare era saMvAda avazyai jAnate pArave|
kitAvaTi avatIrNa haYeche parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAhara pakSa theke|
nizcaYai Ami tomAra prati e kitAva yathArtharUpe avatIrNa karechi| ataeva, tumi AllAhara ivAdAta karo tA~ra Anugatye vizuddhacitta haYe|

jene rekheA, niSThApUrNa Anugatya kevala AllAhara janya| yArA AllAha vyatIta aparake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karache evaM vale ye, ‘AmarA tAdera ivAdAta e janyai kari, yena tArA AmAderake AllAhara nikaTavartI kare deYa|’ nizcaYai AllAha tAdera madhye phAYasAlA kare devena, yA niYe tArA virodha karache| AllAha tAke satpathe paricAlita karena nA, ye mithyAvAdI kAphira|
AllAha yadi icchA karatena ye tini santAna grahaNa karavena, tave tini yA sRSTi karechena, tAra madhya theke yA-kichu icchA maneAnIta karatena, mahimAmaYa tini! tini AllAha, ekaka, parAkramazAlI|

tini AsamAna o yamina sRSTi karechena yathAyathabhAve| tini rAtake dina dvArA AcchAdita karena evaM dinake rAta dvArA AcchAdita karena evaM tini sUrya o candrake niYantraNAdhIna karechena; pratyekei vicaraNa kare nirdiSTa samaYakAla paryanta| jene rekheA, tini mahAparAkramazAlI, atIva kSamAzIla|

tini sRSTi karechena teAmAdera ekai vyakti theke| ataHpara tAra theke tAra yugala sRSTi karechena evaM tini teAmAdera janya avatIrNa karechena ATa prakAra catuSpada jantu| tini teAmAderake sRSTi karechena teAmAdera mAYera garbhe; eka sRSTira para Areka sRSTi, trividha andhakAre| tini AllAha, teAmAdera rava, rAjatva tA~rai| tini vyatIta keAno ilAha nei| e sattveo teAmAdera keAthAYa pherAno hacche?

yadi teAmarA kuphuri karo, tave AllAha teAmAdera theke amukhApekSI| tini tA~ra vAndAdera janya kuphuri pachanda karena nA| pakSAntare yadi teAmarA kRtajJa hao, tave tini teAmAdera janya tA pachanda karena| keu anyera pApabhAra vahana karave nA| ataHpara teAmAdera ravera kAche teAmAdera pratyAvartana, ataHpara tomarA yA karate, tini teAmAderake se samvandhe avahita karavena| nizcaYai tini antarera viSaYa samparkeo avagata|

yakhana mAnuSake duHkha-kaSTa sparza kare, takhana se tAra ravake DAke ekAgracitte, ataHpara tini yakhana tAke nijera pakSa theke niYAmAta dAna karena, takhana se vismRta haYe yAYa, yAra janya pUrve Dekechila evaM AllAhara samakakSa sthira kare; aparake AllAhara patha theke vibhrAnta karAra janya| valo, ‘tumi teAmAra kuphara sahakAre kichukAla jIvaneApabheAga kare nAo| nizcaYai tumi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsIdera antarbhukta|’

ye vyakti rAtera velAYa sijadAvanata haYe o dA~r3iYe Anugatya prakAza kare, parakAlera AzaGkA rAkhe evaM tAra ravera rAhamAta pratyAzA kare, (se ki tAra mato, ye emana kare nA?) valo—‘yArA jAne evaM yArA jAne nA; tArA ki samAna hate pAre?’ kevala vuddhimAnerAi upadeza grahaNa kare|

valo, ‘he AmAra mu’mina vAndAgaNa, teAmarA teAmAdera ravake bhaYa karo| yArA e duniYAte satkAja kare, tAdera janya raYeche kalyANa| Ara AllAhara yamina prazasta| dhairyadhAraNakArIrA agaNita (hisAva chAr3A) puraskAra lAbha kare|’
valo, ‘Ami AdiSTa haYechi, yena AllAhara ivAdAta kari tA~ra janya Anugatye niSThAvAna haYe|’
‘Arao AdiSTa haYechi ye, yena Amii hai sarvaprathama AtmasamarpaNakArI|’
valo, ‘Ami AmAra ravera avAdhya hale eka mahAdivasera zAstira bhaYa kari|’
valo, ‘Ami AllAharai ivAdAta kari, tA~ra janya AmAra Anugatye ekaniSTha haYe|’
ataeva, teAmarA AllAhara parivarte yAra icchA tAra ivAdAta karo| valo, ‘kSatigrasta to tArAi—yArA kiYAmAtera dina nijedera o parivAravargera kSatisAdhana karave| jene rekho, eTAi suspaSTa kSati|’
tAdera janya uparera dika theke evaM nicera dika theke Agunera AcchAdana thAkave| e dvArA AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera satarka karena ye, ‘he AmAra vAndAgaNa, tomarA AmAke bhaYa karo|’
yArA tAgUtera upAsanA parihAra kare evaM AllAha-abhimukhI haYa, tAdera janya raYeche susaMvAda| ataeva, susaMvAda dAo AmAra vAndAderake|
yArA utkarNa haYe kathA zone, ataHpara yA uttama, tAra anusaraNa kare| tAderakei AllAha hidAYAta dAna karena evaM tArAi vuddhimAna|
yAra janya zAstira hukuma avadhArita haYeche, tumi ki tAke mukta karate pArave—ye Agune Ache?

kintu yArA tAdera ravake bhaYa kare, tAdera janya nirmita raYeche prAsAdera upara prAsAdasamUha| yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita haYa nada-nadI| AllAhara pratizruti; AllAha pratizrutira khelApha karo nA|

tumi ki dekhoni ye, AllAha AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karena, ataHpara se pAni yamine prasravaNarUpe pravAhita karena, erapara tA dvArA vibhinna raGera phasala utpanna karena, ataHpara tA zukiYe yAYa, phale teAmarA tA pItavarNa dekhate pAo| erapara AllAha tAke khar3a-kuTAYa pariNata kare dena| nizcaYai ete vuddhimAnadera janya upadeza raYeche|

AllAha yAra vakSa isalAmera janya ummukta kare diYechena, ataHpara se tAra ravera pakSa theke AleAra mAjhe raYeche; (se ki tAra mato, ye emana naYa?) yAdera antara AllAhara smaraNera vyApAre kaTheAra, tAdera janya durbheAga| tArA suspaSTa bhrAntite raYeche|

AllAha uttama vANI avatIrNa karechena, sAmaJjasyapUrNa ekaTi kitAva, punaHpuna paThita| yArA tAdera ravake bhaYa kare ete tAdera loma ziure oThe, erapara tAdera cAmar3A o antara AllAhara smaraNe vinamra haYa| eTAi AllAhara pathanirdeza, era mAdhyame tini yAke icchA hidAYAta karena| Ara AllAha yAke vibhrAnta karena, tAra keAno hidAYAtakArI nei|

ye vyakti kiYAmAtera dina tAra mukha dvArA kaThina zAsti theke paritrANa pete cAive, (se ki tAra mato, ye emana naYa)? evaM sImAlaGghanakArIdera valA have, ‘teAmarA yA karate tAra svAda AsvAdana karo|’
tAdera pUrvavartIrAo mithyAreApa karechila, phale tAdera opara zAsti emanabhAve ela, yA tArA kalpanAo karate pAreni|
ataHpara AllAha tAdera pArthiva-jIvane lAJchanA AsvAdana karAlena, Ara parakAlera zAsti have Arao bhaYaMkara, yadi tArA jAnata!
Ami e kuraAne mAnuSera janya sava dRSTAntai varNanA karechi, yena tArA anudhAvana kare;
Aravi bhASAYa e kuraAna vakratAmukta, yena tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare|

AllAha ekaTi dRSTAnta varNanA karechena, ekajana leAkera kaYajana mAlika; yArA paraspara vireAdhI, Areka vyakti mAtra eka janera nikaTa samarpita, tAdera ubhaYera avasthA ki samAna? samasta prazaMsA AllAhara| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
nizcaYai tumi maraNazIla evaM tArAo maraNazIla
ataHpara kiYAmAtera dina teAmarA savAi teAmAdera ravera sAmane vivAda karave|

tAra ceYe adhika sImAlaGghanakArI Ara ke have? ye vyakti AllAhara viruddhe mithyA valeche evaM tAra kAche satya AsAra para tAra prati mithyAropa kareche, kAphiradera vAsasthAna ki jAhAnnAmera madhye naYa?
ye satya niYe esechila evaM tAke satye pratipanna kare| tArAi halo muttAki|
tAdera janya ravera kAche tAi raYeche, yA tArA cAive| eTA satkarmIdera puraskAra|
yena AllAha tAdera se manda kAjasamUha mArjanA karena yA tArA karechila, evaM tAdera uttama karmera puraskAra devena, yA tArA karata|
AllAha ki tA~ra vAndAra pakSe yatheSTa nana? athaca tArA tomAke AllAhara parivarte anyAnya ilAhadera bhaYa dekhAYa| Ara AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAra keAno hidAYAtakArI nei|
Ara AllAha yAke hidAYAta karena, tAke pathabhraSTakArI keu nei| AllAha ki parAkramazAlI, pratizeAdha grahaNakArI nana?

tumi yadi tAdera jijJesa karo, ‘AsamAna o yamina ke sRSTi kareche?’ tArA avazyai valave, ‘AllAha’| valo, ‘teAmarA bheve dekhecha ki, yadi AllAha AmAra aniSTa karAra icchA karena, tave teAmarA AllAha vyatIta yAdera DAko, tArA ki se aniSTa dUra karate sakSama? athavA tini AmAra prati rAhamAta karAra icchA karale tArA ki se rAhamAta reAdha karate pArave?’ valo, ‘AmAra pakSe AllAhai yatheSTa| nirbharakArIrA tA~rai opara nirbhara kare|’
valo, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA tomAdera jAYagAYa kAja karo, Amio kAja karachi| satvarai jAnate pArave|’
‘yAra opara emana AyAva Asave yA tAke lAJcita karave, Ara tAra opara AvadhArita have sthAYI zAsti|’

Ami tomAra prati satyasaha kitAva avatIrNa karechi mAnuSera janya| ataHpara ye satpathe Ase, se nijera kalyANera janyai Ase, Ara ye pathabhraSTa haYa, se nijerai aniSTera janya pathabhraSTa haYa| Ara tumi tAdera karmavidhAYaka nao|

AllAha mAnuSera prANa haraNa karena tAra mRtyura samaYa, Ara ye mare nA, tAra nidrAkAle| ataHpara yAra mRtyu avadhArita karena, tAra prANa rekhe dena evaM anyAnyadera cher3e dena eka nirdiSTa samaYera janya| nizcaYai ete emana leAkadera janya nidarzanAvali raYeche yArA cintA kare|
tArA ki AllAha vyatIta supArizakArI grahaNa kareche? valo, ‘tAdera keAno kSamatA nA thAkaleo evaM tArA nA vujhaleo?’
valo, ‘samasta supAriza AllAharai ikhatiYAre; AsamAna o yamine tA~rai sAmrAjya| ataHpara tA~rai kAche tomAdera phiriYe neoYA have|’

Ara yakhana ekaka AllAharai AlocanA karA haYa, takhana yArA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA, tAdera antara vitRSNAYa saMkucita haYe yAYa, Ara yakhana AllAha vyatIta anyadera nAma uccAraNa karA haYa, takhana tArA Anande ullasita haYe oThe|
valo, ‘he AllAha, AsamAna o yaminera sraSTA, dRzya o adRzyera jJAnI, tumi tomAra vAndAdera madhye phAYasAlA karave, ye viSaYe tArA matavireAdha karata|’

Ara yArA yuluma kareche yadi tAdera thAke pRthivIra samudaYa sampada evaM tAra sAthe samaparimANa Arao, tave avazyai tArA kiYAmAtera dina nindita AyAva theke niSkRti pAoYAra janya muktipaNa hiseve savakichui diYe deve| athaca tAdera sAmane prakAza pAve, AllAhara pakSa theke emana kichu yA tArA kalpanAo kareni|
Ara tAdera sAmane prakAza have tAdera duSkarmasamUha yA tArA kareche evaM ye viSaYe tArA ThATTA-vidrupa karata, tA tAdera ghire neve|

mAnuSake yakhana duHkha-kaSTa sparza kare, takhana se AmAke DAkate zuru kare, erapara Ami yakhana tAke AmAra pakSa theke niYAmAta dvArA abhiSikta kari, takhana se vale, ‘AmAke to eTA deoYA haYeche AmAra jJAnera kAraNe|’ athaca eTA eka parIkSA, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
tAdera pUrvavartIrAo tAi valata, tArapara tAdera kono upakAre Aseni yA-kichu arjana karata|

yA-kichu mandakAja tArA kareche tAra zAsti tAdera oparai patita haYeche, Ara edera madhya theke yArA yuluma kare, ati satvara tAdera duSkarmera zAsti tAdera oparao Apatita have, tArA tA pratirodhe sakSama naYa|
tArA ki jAneni ye, AllAha yAra janya icchA riyika vRddhi karena evaM sImita karena? nizcaYai ete nidarzanAvali raYeche se sampradAYera janya yArA ImAna rAkhe|
valo, ‘he AmAra vAndAgaNa yArA nijedera opara avicAra karecha teAmarA AllAhara rAhamAta theke nirAza haYeA nA| nizcaYai AllAha sakala gunAha mApha kare devena| tini kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|’
teAmarA teAmAdera ravera abhimukhI hao evaM tA~ra nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karo teAmAdera nikaTa zAsti AsAra pUrve| erapara teAmarA sAhAyyaprApta have nA|

teAmAdera prati tomAdera ravera pakSa theke yA avatIrNa karA haYeche tAra madhye uttama viSaYera anusaraNa karo, teAmAdera kAche atarkite zAsti AsAra pUrve emana avasthAYa tomarA tA anudhAvanao karate pArate nA|
yena kAuke valate nA haYa, ‘hAYa Aphasosa! AllAhara prati AmAra kartavye Ami ye zithilatA karechi tAra janya! Ara Ami to ThATTAkArIdera antarbhukta chilAma|’
athavA keu nA vale, ‘AllAha yadi AmAke hidAYAta karatena, tave avazyai Ami muttAkidera antarbhukta hatAma|’
athavA zAsti dekhAra samaYa nA vale, ‘yadi keAnorUpe ekavAra phire yete pAri, tave Ami satkarmaparAYaNa haYe yAva|’
hyA~, teAmAra kAche AmAra nidarzanAvali esechila; ataHpara tumi tAke mithyA pratipanna karechile, ahaMkAra karechile evaM tumi chile kAphiradera antarbhukta|
yArA AllAhara prati mithyA valeche, kiYAmAtera dina tumi dekhave tAdera mukha kAlo| ahaMkArIdera AvAsasthala jAhAnnAme naYa ki?
Ara yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana karata AllAha tAderake sAphalyera sAthe mukti devena, aniSTa tAdera sparza karave nA evaM tArA cintitao have nA|
AllAha savakichura sraSTA evaM tini savakichura karmavidhAYaka|
AsamAna o yaminera cAvi tA~rai kartRtve| Ara yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare, tArAi kSatigrasta|
valo, ‘he mUrkhera dala, teAmarA ki AmAke AllAha vyatIta anyera ivAdAta karate Adeza karacha?’
athaca tomAra prati evaM tomAra pUrvavartIdera prati pratyAdeza haYeche, ‘yadi AllAhara zarika sthira karo, tave tomAra karma niSphala have evaM avazyai tumi have kSatigrastadera antarbhukta|’
‘varaM AllAharai ivAdAta karo evaM kRtajJadera antarbhukta hao|’

tArA AllAhara yathAyatha mUlyAYana kareni| kiYAmAtera dina geATA pRthivI thAkave tA~ra hAtera muTheAte evaM AsamAnasamUha bhA~ja karA avasthAYa thAkave tA~ra DAna hAte| tini pavitra| Ara tArA yAke zarika kare, tA theke tini aneka Urdhve|

ziGgAYa phu~ka deoYA have, phale AsamAna o yamine yArA Ache savAi vehu~za haYe yAve, tave AllAha yAke icchA karena| ataHpara AvAra ziGgAYa phu~ka deoYA have, tatkSaNAt tArA daNDAYamAna haYe dekhate thAkave|
pRthivI tAra ravera nUre udbhAsita have, AmalanAmA peza karA have, navigaNa o sAkSIgaNake AnA have evaM sakalera madhye nyAYavicAra karA have evaM tAdera prati avicAra karA have nA|
pratyekera kRtakarmera pUrNa pratiphala deoYA have| tArA yA kichu kare, se samparke AllAha adhika avagata|

Ara yArA kuphuri kareche tAderake jAhAnnAmera dike dale dale hA~kiYe neoYA have| tArA yakhana sekhAne pau~chAve, takhana tAra darajAsamUha khule deoYA have evaM jAhAnnAmera rakSIrA tAderake valave, ‘teAmAdera kAche ki teAmAdera madhya theke rAsUlagaNa Aseni, yArA teAmAdera kAche teAmAdera ravera AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karata evaM satarka karata e dinera sAkSAtera vyApAre?’ tArA valave, ‘hyA~’| kintu avadhArita haYeche kAphiradera prati zAstira hukumai|
valA have, ‘teAmarA jAhAnnAmera darajA diYe praveza karo, sekhAne cirakAla avasthAnera janya| kata nikRSTa ahaMkArIdera AvAsasthala!’

yArA tAdera ravake bhaYa kare caleche tAdera dale dale jAnnAtera dike niYe yAoYA have| yakhana tArA sekhAne pau~chave evaM tAra darajAsamUha khule deoYA have, jAnnAtera rakSIrA tAderake valave, “teAmAdera prati ‘sAlAma’, teAmarA sukhe thAko, ataHpara cirasthAYI vasavAsera janya teAmarA jAnnAte praveza karo|”

tArA valave, ‘samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AmAdera prati tA~ra oYAdA pUrNa karechena evaM AmAderake e bhUmira uttarAdhikArI karechena| AmarA jAnnAtera yekhAne icchA vasavAsa karava|’ mehanatakArIdera puraskAra katai nA camatkAra!

Ara tumi pherezatAderake dekhate pAve ye, tArA Arazera catuSpArzve ghire tAdera ravera saprazaMsA pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare| Ara tAdera sakalera vicAra karA have nyAYera sAthe| valA have, ‘prazaMsA jagatasamUhera rava AllAhara janya|’
hA mI-ma|
ei kitAva avatIrNa AllAhara pakSa theke, yini parAkramazAlI, sarvajJa|
yini pApa kSamAkArI, tAovA kavulakArI, kaTheAra zAstidAtA o anugrahakArI| tini vyatIta keAno ilAha nei| pratyAvartana tA~rai nikaTa|
yArA kuphuri kareche tArA chAr3A keu AllAhara AYAta samparke vitarka kare nA| kAjei nagare nagare tAdera vicaraNa yena tomAke vibhrAntite nA phele|

tAdera pUrve nUhera sampradAYa mithyAreApa karechila; tAdera pare anya aneka dala o pratyeka ummAta nija nija rAsUladera niYe abhisandhi karechila ye tAke pAkar3Ao karave evaM tArA mithyA vitarke pravRtta haYechila, yena satyake vyartha kare dite pAre| ataHpara Ami tAdera pAkar3Ao karalAma; ataeva, kemana chila AmAra zAsti|
Ara ebhAve yArA kuphuri kareche tAdera vyApAre tomAra ravera vAkya satya halo ye, tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

yArA Araza vahana kare evaM yArA tAra cArapAze Ache, tArA tAdera ravera saprazaMsa pavitratA varNanA kare, tAra prati ImAna Ane evaM mu’minadera janya kSamAprArthanA kare vale, ‘he AmAdera rava, ApanAra rAhamAta o jJAna savakichute parivyApta| ataeva, yArA tAovA kare evaM ApanAra pathe cale, tAderake kSamA karuna evaM jAhAnnAmera zAsti theke rakSA karuna|’

‘he AmAdera rava, Ara tAderake praveza karAna sthAYI jAnnAte, yAra pratizruti Apani tAderake diYechena evaM tAdera pitA-mAtA, pati-patnI o santAnadera madhye yArA satkarma kare tAderakeo| nizcaYai Apani parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|’
‘evaM Apani tAderake amaGgala theke rakSA karuna; Apani yAke sedina amaGgala theke rakSA karavena, tAra prati anugrahai karalena| eTAi to mahAsAphalya!’

Ara yArA kuphuri kareche tAderake Deke valA have, ‘teAmAdera nijedera prati teAmAdera e kSeAbha apekSA AllAra kSeAbha adhika chila, yakhana teAmAdera ImAna Anate valA haYechila, ataHpara teAmarA kuphuri karachile|’
tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, Apani AmAderake du’vAra mRtyu diYechena evaM du’vAra jIvana diYechena| ekhana AmAdera aparAdha svIkAra karachi| ataHpara ekhano niSkRtira keAno upAYa Ache ki?’

(tArA valave,) ‘teAmAdera vipada e kAraNe ye, yakhana AllAhake DAkA hato tAra ekatvera sAthe, takhana teAmarA avizvAsa karate yakhana tAra sAthe zarika karA hato takhana teAmarA vizvAsa sthApana karate| ekhana kartRtva AllAhara, yini sarveAcca, mahAna|’
tinii teAmAderake tA~ra nidarzanAvali dekhAna evaM teAmAdera janya AkAza theke avatIrNa karena jIvikA| AllAhara-abhimukhI vyatIta keu upadeza grahaNa kare nA|
ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake DAko tAra janya Anugatya ekaniSTha kare, yadio kAphirarA tA apachanda kare|
tinii sumahAna maryAdAvAna, Arazera adhipati, tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA oYAhi avatIrNa karena tAra Adezasaha, yena se sAkSAtera dina samparke sakalake satarka karate pAre|
yedina tArA vera haYe par3ave, AllAhara kAche tAdera kichui geApana thAkave nA| Aja rAjatva kAra? AllAharai yini ekaka, pravala parAkramazAlI
Aja pratyekakei pratidAna deoYA have se anuyAYI, yA se arjana kareche| Aja kono avicAra nei| nizcaYai AllAha hisAvagrahaNe tatpara|

tumi tAdera Asanna dina samparke satarka karo, yakhana manastApe prANa kaNThAgata haoYAra upakrama have| pApiSThadera janya emana keAno vandhu evaM supArizakArIo thAkave nA; yAra supAriza gRhIta have|
ceAkhera khiYAnata evaM antarera geApana viSaYa tini avahita|
AllAhai phAYasAlA karena saThikabhAve, AllAhara parivarte tArA yAdera DAke, tArA kono phAYasAlA karate pAre nA| nizcaYai AllAha tinii sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

tArA ki yamine bhramaNa kare nA? phale dekhate peta tAdera pUrvasUridera pariNAma kemana haYeche? tArA zakti o kIrtite pRthivIte edera apekSA pravalatara| ataHpara AllAha tAderake tAdera pApera kAraNe pAkar3Ao karechilena evaM AllAha theke tAdera rakSAkArI keu chila nA|
eTA ejanya ye, tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa nidarzanAvali niYe Asata, tavuo tArA kuphuri karala; ataHpara AllAha tAderake pAkar3Ao karalena| nizcaYai tini zaktidhara, zAstidAne kaTheAra|
Ara avazyai Ami AmAra nidarzanAvali o spaSTa pramANasaha mUsAke pAThiYechi|
phiraAuna, hAmAnera kAche o kArUnera; ataHpara tArA valala, ‘se teA jAdukara, atizaYa mithyAvAdI|’

ataHpara yakhana se AmAra kAcha theke satyasaha tAdera kAche pau~chAla; takhana tArA valala, ‘yArA tAra saGgI haYe vizvAsa sthApana kareche, tAdera putra santAnaderake hatyA karo, Ara tAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkho|’ Ara kAphiradera cakrAnta vyartha havArai|

phiraAuna valala, ‘ teAmarA AmAke chAr3o, Ami mUsAke hatyA kari, se yena tAra ravake AhvAna kare! Ami AzaGkA kari ye, se teAmAdera dharma parivartana kare deve athavA se dezamaYa viparyaYa sRSTi karave|’
mUsA valala, ‘yArA hisAva divase ImAna Ane nA emana pratyeka ahaMkArI theke Ami AmAra o teAmAdera ravera AzraYa grahaNa karechi|’

phiraAuna geAtrera eka mu’mina vyakti, ye tAra ImAna geApana rAkhata, se valala, ‘teAmarA ki ekajanake hatyA karave ejanya ye, se vale, ‘AmAra rava AllAha; athaca se teAmAdera ravera nikaTa theke spaSTa pramANasaha teAmAdera kAche eseche? yadi se mithyAvAdI haYa, tave tAra mithyAvAditA tAra oparai cApave, Ara yadi se satyavAdI haYa, tave se ye zAstira kathA valache, tAra kichu nA kichu teAmAdera opara par3avei|’ nizcaYai AllAha emana kAuke hidAYAta dAna karena nA ye sImAlaGghanakArI, mithyAvAdI|

‘he AmAra sampradAYa, Aja edeze teAmAderai rAjatva, dezamaYa teAmarAi vicaraNa karacha; kintu ke AmAderake sAhAyya karave theke AllAhara zAsti; yadi tA Ase AmAdera kAche?’ phiraAuna valala, ‘Ami yA vujhi, teAmAdera tA-i veAjhAi, Ara Ami teAmAdera maGgalera patha vyatIta anya kono pathe paricAlanA karachi nA|’
Ara ye vyakti ImAna eneche se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, Ami teAmAdera janya pUrvavartI sampradAYasamUhera matoi vipadasaMkula dinera AzaGkA kari|’
‘yemana nUhera sampradAYa, Ada, sAmUda o tAdera paravartIdera avasthA haYechila| AllAha cAna nA vAndAdera prati keAno avicAra karate|’
‘he AmAra sampradAYa, Ami teAmAdera janya AzaGkA kari, ArtanAda-dinera|’
‘yedina teAmarA pechane phire pAlAte cAive; kintu AllAha theke teAmAdera rakSAkArI keu thAkave nA| Ara AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAra keAno hidAYAtadAtA nei|’

itaHpUrve teAmAdera kAche iusupha suspaSTa pramANAdisaha Agamana karechila, ataHpara tomAdera kAche se yA niYe esechila se samparke sarvadA sandeha peASaNa karate thAkate| avazeSe se yakhana mArA gela, takhana teAmarA valate zuru karale, ‘AllAha tAra pare Ara kAuke rAsUlarUpe pAThAvena nA|’ ebhAve AllAha sImAlaGghanakArI, saMzaYI vyaktike pathabhraSTa karena|

yArA tAdera kAche eseche emana keAno dalIla chAr3Ai AllAhara AYAta samparke vitarka kare, tAdera e karma AllAhara kAche khuvai asanteASajanaka evaM tAdera yArA ImAna eneche; ebhAve AllAha pratyeka ahaMkArI-svairAcArI vyaktira antare meAhara e~Te dena|
phiraAuna valala, ‘he hAmAna, tumi AmAra janya ekaTi suucca prAsAda nirmANa karo, haYateA Ami eka avalamvana pete pAri|’

‘AkAze (ArohaNera) avalamvana, ataHpara u~ki mere dekhava mUsAra AllAhake| vastuta Ami teA tAke mithyAvAdIi mane kari|’ ebhAvei phiraAunera kAche suzeAbhita karA haYechila tAra manda karmake evaM seAjA patha theke tAke virata rAkhA haYechila| phiraAunera cakrAnta vyartha haoYArai chila|
ye leAkaTi ImAna eneche se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA AmAra anusaraNa karo| Ami teAmAderake satpatha dekhAva|’
‘he AmAra sampradAYa, pArthiva e jIvana teA kevala upabheAgera vastu, Ara parakAla hacche sthAYI AvAsa|’
‘ye manda karma kare, se kevala tAra anurUpa zAsti pAve, Ara ye puruSa athavA nArI mu’mina avasthAYa satkarma kare tArAi jAnnAte praveza karave; sekhAne tAderake aparimita riyika deoYA have|’
‘he AmAra sampradAYa, AmAra kI halo! Ami teAmAdera DAki muktira dike, Ara teAmarA AmAke DAko Agunera dike!’
‘teAmarA AmAke DAko, yena Ami AllAhake asvIkAra kari evaM tA~ra sAthe zarika kari emana vastuke, yAra keAno pramANa AmAra kAche nei| Ami teAmAderake DAki parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla AllAhara dike|’
‘ete sandeha nei ye, teAmarA AmAke DAkacha yAra dike duniYA o AkhirAte tAra dike AhvAna vaidha naYa| Ara AmAdera pratyAvartana to AllAhara dike evaM sImAlaGghanakArIrAi have jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|’
‘sutarAM acirei teAmarA tA smaraNa karave, Ami teAmAderake yA valachi| Ami AmAra vyApAra AllAhara kAche samarpaNa karachi| nizcaYai AllAha vAndAra prati savizeSa dRSTi rAkhena|’
ataHpara AllAha tAke tAdera cakrAntera aniSTa theke rakSA karalena evaM phiraAunera geAtrake zeAcanIYa zAsti grAsa karala|
sakAle o sandhyAYa tAderake Agunera sAmane peza karA haYa evaM yedina kiYAmAta saMghaTita have, sedina Adeza karA have, ‘phiraAunera geAtrake kaThinatara zAstite praveza karAo|’

yakhana tArA jAhAnnAme paraspara vitarka karave, takhana yArA (duniYAte) ahaMkAra karechila tAderake durvalarA valave, ‘AmarA teAmAdera anusArI chilAma| teAmarA ekhana jAhAnnAmera Agunera kichu aMza AmAdera theke lAghava karave ki?’
yArA ahaMkAra karechila tArA valave, ‘AmarA savAi teA jAhAnnAme Achi| nizcaYai AllAha phAYasAlA kare diYechena tA~ra vAndAdera mAjhe|’
yArA jAhAnnAme Ache, tArA jAhAnnAmera rakSIderake valave, ‘teAmarA teAmAdera ravake Deke valo, tini yena AmAdera theke ekadinera zAsti lAghava kare dena|’
rakSIrA valave, ‘teAmAdera kAche ki suspaSTa pramANAdisaha teAmAdera rAsUla Asenani?’ tArA valave, ‘hyA~’| rakSIrA valave, ‘tave teAmarAi DAko’| Ara kAphiradera DAka niSphalai haYa|
nizcaYai Ami sAhAyya karava rAsUlagaNake o tAderake yArA ImAna eneche pArthiva-jIvane o ye dina sAkSIgaNa daNDAYamAna have|
se dina sImAlaGghanakArIdera ojara keAno upakAre Asave nA evaM tAdera janya thAkave abhizApa evaM tAdera janya thAkave nikRSTa AvAsa|
nizcaYai Ami mUsAke hidAYAta dAna karechilAma evaM vani isarAIlake kitAvera uttarAdhikArI karechilAma|
vuddhimAnadera janya upadeza o hidAYAtasvarUpa|
ataeva, tumi dhairyadhAraNa karo| nizcaYai AllAhara oYAdA satya| tumi tomAra pApera janya kSamAprArthanA karo evaM sakAla-sandhyAYa tomAra ravera saprazaMsa pavitratA varNanA karo|

nizcaYai yArA AllAhara AYAta samparke vitarka kare tAdera kAche AsA keAno dalIla vyatireke, tAdera antare AtmambharitA chAr3A kichu nei, yA arjane tArA saphala have nA; ataeva, tumi AllAhara AzraYa cAo| nizcaYai tini sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|
mAnuSera sRSTi apekSA AsamAna o yaminera sRSTi kaThinatara| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa tA jAne nA|
Ara samAna naYa andha o cakSuSmAna, Ara yArA ImAna Ane, satkarma kare o yArA manda kAja kare| teAmarA alpai upadeza grahaNa karo|
kiYAmAta avazyai Asave, ete sandeha nei; kintu adhikAMza leAka ImAna Ane nA|
teAmAdera rava valena, ‘teAmarA AmAke DAko, Ami sAr3A deva| yArA AmAra ivAdAta theke ahaMkAra kare tArA satvarai jAhAnnAme praveza karave lAJchita haYe|’
tinii AllAha yini rAta sRSTi karechena teAmAdera vizrAmera janya evaM dinake karechena dRzyamAna| nizcaYai AllAha mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa kRtajJatA svIkAra kare nA|
tinii AllAha, teAmAdera rava, savakichura sraSTA| tini vyatIta keAno satya ilAha nei| ataeva, teAmarA keAthAYa vibhrAnta haccha?
ebhAve tAdera vibhrAnta karA haYa, yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare|

AllAhai, pRthivIke karechena teAmAdera janya vAsasthAna, AkAzake karechena chAdasvarUpa evaM tini teAmAdera AkRti dAna karechena, ataHpara teAmAdera AkRti sundara karechena evaM tini teAmAderake dAna karechena utkRSTa riyika| tinii AllAha, teAmAdera rava| jagatasamUhera rava, AllAha katai nA varakatamaYa|
tini ciraJjIva, tini vyatIta keAno ilAha nei| ataeva, tA~ke DAko tA~rai janya ekaniSTha haYe| sakala prazaMsA vizvajagatera rava AllAhara|

valo, ‘yakhana AmAra kAche AmAra ravera pakSa theke spaSTa pramANAdi ese geche, takhana AllAha vyatIta teAmarA yAra upAsanA karo, tAra ivAdAta karate AmAke niSedha karA haYeche| Ami AdiSTa haYechi yena Ami jagatasamUhera ravera nikaTa samarpita hai|’

tini teA teAmAderake sRSTi karechena mATi theke, ataHpara zukravindu theke, ataHpara jamATa rakta theke, ataHpara teAmAderake vera karena zizurUpe, ataHpara teAmarA yauvane padArpaNa karo, ataHpara vArdhakye upanIta hao| teAmAdera kArao kArao era pUrvei mRtyu ghaTe, Ara yena teAmarA nirdhArita kAle pau~cho evaM anudhAvana karo|
tinii jIvana dAna karena evaM mRtyu dena| yakhana tini kichu karAra sthira karena, takhana kevala ekathAi valena, ‘hao’; amani tA haYe yAYa|
tumi ki tAderake dekhoni, yArA AllAhara AYAta samparke vitarka kare, kona pathe tAdera ghuriYe deoYA hacche?
yArA kitAvera prati evaM ye viSaYa diYe Ami rAsUlagaNake pAThiYechi, se viSaYera prati mithyAreApa kare| satvarai tArA jAnate pArave|
yakhana tAdera galadeze ver3i o zRGkhala thAkave; tAderake Tene niYe yAoYA have|
phuTanta pAnite, ataHpara tAderake Agune jvAlAneA have|
ataHpara tAderake valA have, ‘keAthAYa tArA teAmarA yAdera zarika karate|’
‘AllAha vyatIta?’ tArA valave, ‘tArA AmAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe geche; varaM AmarA teA itaHpUrve keAno kichura upAsanAi karatAma nA!’ ebhAve AllAha kAphiraderake vibhrAnta karena|
eTA ekAraNe ye, teAmarA duniYAte anyAYabhAve Ananda-ullAsa karate evaM teAmarA auddhatya prakAza karate|
teAmarA jAhAnnAmera darajA diYe anantakAlera janya sekhAne praveza karo| katai nA nikRSTa dAmbhikadera AvAsasthala!

ataeva, tumi dhairyadhAraNa karo| nizcaYai AllAhara pratizruti satya| ataHpara Ami kAphiraderake ye zAstira oYAdA dii, tAra kiYadAMza yadi tomAke dekhiYe dii athavA tomAra prANa haraNa kare nii, ataHpara AmAra kAchei tAderake phiriYe AnA have|

Ara Ami tomAra pUrve aneka rAsUla pAThiYechi, tAdera anekera ghaTanA tomAra kAche vivRta karechi evaM anekera ghaTanA tomAra kAche vivRta karini| AllAhara anumati vyatIta keAno nidarzana niYe AsA keAno rAsUlera kAja naYa| yakhana AllAhara Adeza Asave, takhana nyAYasaMgatabhAve phAYasAlA haYe yAve| sekSetre mithyApanthirA kSatigrasta have|
AllAhai teAmAdera janya catuSpada jantu sRSTi karechena, yena kichu prANIke vAhana hisAve vyavahAra karo evaM kichuke bhakSaNa karo|
tAte teAmAdera janya aneka upakAra raYeche; yena seguleAte AreAhaNa kare teAmarA teAmAdera abhISTa praYeAjana pUrNa karate pAra| eguleAra opara evaM naukAra opara teAmarA vAhita hao|
tini teAmAderake tA~ra nidarzanAvali dekhAna| ataeva, teAmarA AllAhara keAna keAna nidarzana asvIkAra karave?

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kareni? karale dekhata, tAdera pUrvavartIdera kI pariNAma haYeche| pRthivIte tArA tAdera ceYe saMkhyAYa vezi evaM zakti o kIrtite adhika pravala chila, ataHpara tAdera karma tAdera keAno upakAre Aseni|

tAdera kAche yakhana tAdera rAsUlagaNa spaSTa pramANAdisaha Agamana karechila, takhana tArA nijedera jJAna-garimAra dambha prakAza karechila, tArA ye viSaYa niYe ThATTA-vidrupa karechila, tA-i tAderake grAsa kare niYechila|
tArA yakhana AmAra zAsti pratyakSa karala, takhana valala, ‘AmarA eka AllAhara prati ImAna AnalAma evaM yAdera zarika karatAma, tAdera parihAra karalAma|’
yakhana tArA AmAra zAsti pratyakSa karave takhana tAdera e ImAna tAdera keAno upakAre Asave nA| AllAhara ei vidhAnai tAra vAndAdera mAjhe atIta haYeche| Ara ekSetre kAphirarA kSatigrasta haYeche|
hA mI-ma|
eTA avatIrNa parama karuNAmaYa, asIma daYAlura pakSa theke|
eka kitAva, era AYAtasamUha vizadabhAve vivRta haYeche Aravi kuraAnarUpe sei sampradAYera janya yArA jJAna rAkhe|
susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe, ataHpara tAdera adhikAMzai mukha phiriYe niYeche, sutarAM tArA zone nA|

tArA vale, ‘ye viSaYera dike AmAderake AhvAna karacha, se viSaYe AmAdera antara AvaraNe AvRta, AmAdera kAne Ache vadhiratA evaM AmAdera o tomAra mAjhakhAne Ache antarAla| ataeva, tumi tomAra kAja karo evaM AmarA AmAdera kAja kari|’

valo, ‘Amio teAmAdera matoi mAnuSa, AmAra prati oYAhi Ase ye, teAmAdera ilAha ekamAtra ilAha| ataeva, tA~ra dike dRr3habhAve egiYe yAo| evaM tA~ra kAche kSamAprArthanA karo| Ara muzarikadera janye raYeche durbheAga;’
yArA yAkAta pradAna kare nA evaM tArA parakAlao asvIkAra kare|
nizcaYai yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tAdera janya raYeche aphuranta puraskAra|
valo, ‘teAmarA ki tAke asvIkAra karacha, yini pRthivI sRSTi karechena dudine! Ara teAmarA tA~ra samakakSa sthira karacha? tini teA jagatasamUhera rava|’
tini era uparibhAge aTala parvatamAlA sthApana karechena, tAte kalyANa nirdhAraNa karechena; cAra dinera madhye tAte tAra jIvanopakaraNera vyavasthA karechena suSamabhAve prArthIdera janya|
ataHpara tini AkAzera dike maneAyeAga dilena — yA chila dhumrakuJja, ataHpara tini tAke o pRthivIke valalena, ‘teAmarA ubhaYe eso icchAYa athavA anicchAYa|’ tArA valala, ‘AmarA svecchAYa elAma|’

ataHpara tini tAderake dudine sAta AkAze pariNata karalena evaM pratyeka AkAze tAra vidhAna pAThAlena| Ara Ami karalAma duniYAra AkAzake pradIpamAlA dvArA suzeAbhita, eTA parAkramazAlI sarvajJa AllAhara vyavasthApanA|
ataHpara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave valo, ‘Ami teAmAderake satarka karalAma eka kaTheAra zAsti samparke Ada o sAmUdera zAstira mato|’

yakhana tAdera kAche esechila rAsUlarA sammukha dika theke evaM pechana dika theke e kathA valate. ye, teAmarA AllAha vyatIta kArao upAsanA kareA nA| tArA valechila, ‘AmAdera rava icchA karale avazyai pherezatA preraNa karatena; ataeva, AmarA teAmAdera AnIta viSaYa asvIkAra karalAma|’

Ada jAti pRthivIte ayathA ahaMkAra karala evaM valala, ‘AmAdera ceYe adhika zaktidhara ke?’ tArA ki lakSa kareni ye, ye AllAha tAderake sRSTi karechena, tini tAdera apekSA adhika zaktidhara? vastuta tArA AmAra nidarzanAvali asvIkAra karata|

ataHpara Ami tAderake pArthiva-jIvane lAJchanAra zAsti AsvAdana karAneAra janya tAdera opara preraNa karalAma jhar3avAYu, azubha dine| Ara parakAlera zAsti teA Arao lAJchanAkara evaM tArA sAhAyyaprApta have nA|

Ara sAmUda jAtike, tAdera Ami hidAYAta diYechilAma, ataHpara tArA hidAYAtera viparIte andhatvai pachanda karala| ataHpara tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe tAdera avamAnanAkara zAstira vipada ese pAkar3Ao karala|
yArA ImAna enechila o tAkaoYA avalamvana karechila, Ami tAderake uddhAra karalAma|
yedina AllAhara zatrudera Agunera kAche samaveta karA have| ataHpara tAderake vinyasta karA have vibhinna dale|
eka paryAYe yakhana sekhAne tArA Asave, takhana tAdera kAna, cakSu o tvaka tAdera viruddhe sAkSya deve se samparke yA tArA karata|

tArA tAdera tvakake valave, ‘teAmarA AmAdera vipakSe sAkSya dile kena?’ tArA valave, ‘ye AllAha savakichuke vAkazakti diYechena, tini AmAderakeo vAkazakti diYechena| tinii teAmAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechena evaM teAmarA tA~rai dike pratyAvartita have|’
‘tomarA kichui gopana karate nA ei vizvAse ye, tomAdera kAna, cokha o tvaka tomAdera viruddhe sAkSya deve nA; varaM tomarA mane karechile ye, tomarA yA kichu karate AllAha tAra adhikAMzai jAnena nA|’
‘teAmAdera rava samvandhe teAmAdera e dhAraNAi teAmAderake dhvaMsa kareche| phale teAmarA haYecha kSatigrastadera antarbhukta|’
ataHpara yadi tArA dhairyadhAraNa kare, tavuo jAhAnnAmai tAdera AvAsasthala| Ara yadi tArA anugraha kAmanA kare, tave tAdera anugraha karA have nA|

Ami tAdera pechane sahacara lAgiYe diYechilAma, ataHpara saGgIrA tAdera agra-pazcAtera Amala tAdera dRSTite zeAbhanIYa kare dekhiYechila| tAdera vyApAreo zAstira Adeza vAstavAYita halo, yA vAstavAYita haYechila tAdera pUrvavartI jina o mAnuSera vyApAre| nizcaYai tArA chila kSatigrasta|
Ara yArA kuphuri kareche tArA vale, ‘teAmarA e kuraAna zuno nA evaM tAte haTTagola sRSTi karo, yena tomarA jaYI hate pAro|’
sutarAM Ami avazyai kAphiraderake kaThina zAsti AsvAdana karAva evaM Ami avazyai tAderake tAdera manda kAjera pratiphala deva|
eTAi AllAhara zatrudera pratiphala| tAte tAdera janya raYeche sthAYI AvAsa, tArA ye AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karata tAra pratiphalasvarUpa|
kAphirarA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, yesava jina o mAnuSa AmAderake pathabhraSTa karechila tAderake dekhiYe dAo, AmarA tAderake padadalita karava, yena tArA apamAnita haYa|’

nizcaYai yArA vale, ‘AmAdera rava AllAha,’ ataHpara tAtei avicala thAke, tAdera kAche pherezatA avatIrNa haYa (evaM vale), ‘teAmarA bhaYa kareA nA, cintA kareA nA evaM teAmAdera jAnnAtera susaMvAda grahaNa karo yAra pratizruti tomAderake deoYA hato|’
‘duniYAra jIvane AmarA teAmAdera vandhu chilAma evaM parakAleo, sekhAne teAmAdera janya Ache yA teAmAdera mana cAYa evaM sekhAne tomarA yA dAvi karave|’
eTA kSamAzIla karuNAmaYera pakSa theke sAdara ApyAYana|
oi vyaktira ceYe uttama kathA Ara kAra hate pAre, ye AllAhara dike AhvAna kare, satkAja kare evaM vale, ‘nizcaYai Ami ekajana musalima|’
bhAlo o manda samAna hate pAre nA| mandake pratihata karo utkRSTa diYe takhana dekhave tomAra sAthe ye vyaktira zatrutA raYeche, se have antaraGga vandhu|
e caritra tArAi lAbha kare, yArA savara kare evaM e caritrera adhikArI tArAi haYa, yArA atyanta bhAgyavAna|
Ara yadi zaYatAnera pakSa theke tumi kono kumantraNA anubhava karo, tave AllAhara AzraYa cAo| nizcaYai tini sarvazreAtA, sarvajJa|

tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye raYeche dina, rAta, sUrya o cA~da| teAmarA sUryake sijadA kareA nA, candrakeo nA; AllAhake sAjadA karo, yini eguleA sRSTi karechena, yadi teAmarA niSThAra sAthe zudhu tA~rai ivAdAta karo|
ataHpara tArA yadi ahaMkAra kare, tave yArA tomAra ravera kAche Ache, tArA dina-rAta tA~ra pavitratA gheASaNA kare evaM tArA klAnta haYa nA|

tA~ra eka nidarzana ei ye, tumi bhUmike dekhave anurvara ataHpara Ami yakhana tAra opara vRSTi varSaNa kari, takhana se Andolita o sphIta haYa| nizcaYai yini tAke jIvita karena, tinii mRtadera jIvana dAnakArI| nizcaYai tini sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|

nizcaYai yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhera vyApAre vakratA avalamvana kare tArA AmAra kAche geApana thAke nA| ye vyakti jAhAnnAme nikSipta have se zreSTha, nA ye kiYAmAtera dina nirApade thAkave? teAmarA yA icchA tA-i karo, nizcaYai tini samyaka draSTA teAmarA yA karo|
nizcaYai yArA kuraAna AsAra para tA asvIkAra kare, (tAdera madhye cintA-bhAvanAra abhAva raYeche) Ara eTA avazyai eka sammAnita kitAva|
ete mithyAra prabhAva nei, sAmanera dika thekeo nei evaM pechana dika thekeo nei| eTA prajJAmaYa, prazaMsArha AllAhara pakSa theke avatIrNa|
tomAke teA tA-i valA haYa, yA valA hato pUrvavartI rAsUlagaNake| nizcaYai tomAra rava kSamAzIla evaM yantraNAdAYaka zAstidAtA|

Ami yadi anArava bhASAYa kuraAna avatIrNa karatAma, tave avazyai tArA valata, ‘era AYAtasamUha pariSkAra bhASAYa vivRta haYani kena? kI Azcarya ye, (kitAva) anArava bhASAYa Ara rAsUla AravIYa!’ valo, ‘eTA vizvAsIdera janya hidAYAta o reAgera pratikAra|’ Ara yArA mu’mina naYa, tAdera karNe raYeche vadhiratA evaM tA (kuraAna) tAdera janya andhatva| tAderake yena dUravartI sthAna theke AhvAna karA haYa|

Ara Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma, ataHpara tAte matabheda sRSTi karA haYechila| tomAra ravera pakSa theke pUrva siddhAnta nA thAkale tAdera madhye phAYasAlA haYe yeta| Ara tArA se (kuraAna) samvandhe eka asvastikara sandehe lipta|
ye satkarma kare, se nijera upakArera janyai kare, Ara ye asatkarma kare, tA tAra oparai vartAve| Ara tomAra rava vAndAdera prati meATei avicArakArI nana|

kiYAmatera jJAna tA~rai dike pratyAvartita haYa| tA~ra ajJAtasAre keAno phala AvaraNa theke vera haYa nA evaM keAno nArI garbhadhAraNa o santAna prasava kare nA| Ara yedina tini tAderake Deke valavena, AmAra zarikarA keAthAYa? sedina tArA valave, AmarA ApanAke nivedana karachi ye, e vyApAre AmAdera theke kono sAkSI nei|
pUrve tArA yAdera upAsanA karata, tArA udhAo haYe yAve evaM tArA vujhe neve ye, tAdera keAno niSkRti nei|
mAnuSa unnati kAmanAYa klAnta haYa nA; kintu yadi tAke amaGgala sparza kare, tave se nirAza o hatAza haYe par3e|

vipadApada sparza karAra para Ami yadi tAke AmAra anugraha AsvAdana karAi, takhana se valate thAke, eTA AmAra yeAgya prApya; Ami mane kari nA, kiYAmAta saMghaTita have| Ara Ami yadi AmAra ravera kAche phire yAi-i tave avazyai tAra kAche AmAra janya kalyANa raYeche, ataeva, Ami kAphiraderake tAdera karma samparke avazyai avahita karava evaM tAdera avazyai AsvAdana karAva kaThina zAsti|
Ara Ami yakhana mAnuSera prati anugraha kari takhana se mukha phiriYe neYa evaM pArzva parivartana kare er3iYe cale| Ara yakhana tAke aniSTa sparza kare, takhana sudIrgha du‘A karate thAke|
valo, ‘teAmarA bheve dekhecha ki, yadi eTA AllAhara pakSa theke haYa, ataHpara teAmarA eke amAnya karo, tave ye vyakti gheAra vireAdhitAYa lipta, tAra cAite adhika pathabhraSTa Ara ke?’

acirei Ami tAderake AmAra nidarzanAvali pradarzana karAva digante evaM tAdera nijedera madhye; phale tAdera kAche suspaSTa have ye, nizcaYai tA (kuraAna) satya| eTAo ki yatheSTa naYa tomAra rava samparke ye tini sarvaviSaYe samyaka avahita|
zune rAkho, tArA tAdera ravera sAthe sAkSAtera vyApAre sandehe raYeche; zune rAkho, tini savakichuke pariveSTana kare raYechena|
hA mI-ma|
A-ina, sI-na kvA-pha|
ebhAvei parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAha tomAra prati o tomAra pUrvavartIdera prati oYAhi preraNa karena|
AkAzamaNDalite yA-kichu Ache evaM yA-kichu Ache yamine, savai tA~ra adhIna| tini samunnata, sumahAna|

AkAza tAdera upara theke vidIrNa haoYAra upakrama haYa Ara pherezatAgaNa tAdera ravera prazaMsAsaha pavitratA varNanA kare evaM pRthivIte yArA Ache, tAdera janya kSamAprArthanA kare| zune rAkho, AllAhai kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
yArA AllAha vyatIta aparake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kare, AllAha tAdera opara samyaka dRSTi rAkhena, Ara tumi tAdera karmavidhAYaka nao|

ebhAve Ami tomAra prati AravibhASAYa kuraAna avatIrNa karechi, yena tumi ummula kurA (mAkkA) o tAra AzapAzera leAkadera satarka karate pAro evaM satarka karate pAro samaveta havAra dina samparke, yAte keAno sandeha nei| ekadala jAnnAte evaM ekadala jAhAnnAme (praveza karave)|
AllAha yadi icchA karatena tave tAdera ekai dalabhukta karate pAratena; kintu tini yAke icchA tA~ra rahamate praveza karAna, Ara sImAlaGghanakArIdera keAno abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI nei|
tArA ki tA~ra parivarte aparake abhibhAvaka sthira kareche? athaca AllAhai ekamAtra abhibhAvaka| tini mRtadera jIvita karena| tini sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
teAmarA ye viSaYei matabheda karo, tAra phAYasAlA to AllAhara nikaTa| tinii AllAha—AmAra rava; Ami tA~rai opara nirbhara kari evaM Ami tA~rai abhimukhI hai|

tini AsamAnasamUha o yaminera sraSTA| tini teAmAdera madhya theke teAmAdera janye yugala sRSTi karechena evaM catuSpada jantudera madhya theke jeAr3A (sRSTi karechena)| ebhAve tini teAmAdera (vaMza) vistAra karena| keAno kichui tA~ra sadRza naYa| tini sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|
AkAza o pRthivIra cAvi tA~ra nikaTa| tini yAra janya icchA riyika vRddhi karena evaM saMkIrNa karena| tini sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|

tini teAmAdera janya dInera kSetre se pathai nirdhArita karechena, yA dvArA Adeza diYechilena nUhake, Ara yA Ami pratyAdeza karechi tomAra prati evaM yA dvArA Adeza diYechilAma ivarAhIma, mUsA o IsAke ei marme ye, teAmarA dInake pratiSThita karo evaM tAte anaikya sRSTi kareA nA| muzarikadera kAche duHsAdhya vale mane haYa yAra prati tumi tAdera AhvAna karacha, AllAha yAke icchA tA~ra janya maneAnIta karena evaM ye tA~ra abhimukhI haYa, tAke tAra (dInera) dike hidAYAta dAna karena|

tAdera kAche jJAna AsAra para kevala tArA pArasparika vidveSera kAraNe matabheda kareche| yadi tomAra ravera pakSa theke nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta avakAzera pUrvasiddhAnta nA thAkata, tave tAdera phAYasAlA haYe yeta| Ara tAdera para yArA kitAvera uttarAdhikArI haYeche, tArA se samparke vibhrAntikara sandehe raYeche|

sutarAM ekAraNe tumi dAoYAta dAo evaM avicala thAko; yemana tumi AdiSTa haYecho| tumi tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa karo nA| valo, AllAha ye kitAva avatIrNa karechena, Ami tAte ImAna enechi| Ami teAmAdera madhye nyAYavicAra karate AdiSTa haYechi| AllAha AmAdera rava o teAmAdera rava| AmAdera janya AmAdera karma evaM teAmAdera janya teAmAdera karma| AmAdera o teAmAdera madhye vivAda nei| AllAha AmAderake samaveta karavena evaM tA~rai dike pratyAvartana|
Ara AllAhara dIna mene neoYAra para yArA se samparke vitarke pravRtta haYa, tAdera vitarka tAdera ravera kAche avAntara, tAdera prati AllAhara gayava evaM tAdera janya raYeche kaTheAra zAsti|
AllAhai satyasaha kitAva o (inasAphera) mAnadaNDa avatIrNa karechena| Ara tumi ki jAno, sambhavata kiYAmata Asanna|

yArA tAte vizvAsa kare nA tArA tAke tvarita kAmanA kare| Ara yArA ImAnadAra tArA tAte bhIta-santrasta thAke evaM jAne ye, tA satya| jene rAkho, yArA kiYAmata samparke vitarka kare, tArA cUr3Anta pathabhraSTatAYa raYeche|
AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera prati ati sUkSmadarzI| tini yAke icchA, riyika dAna karena| tini pravala, parAkramazAlI|
ye keu parakAlera phasala kAmanA kare, Ami tAra janya tAra phasala vAr3iYe dii| Ara ye ihakAlera phasala kAmanA kare, Ami tAke tAra kichu diYe dii evaM parakAle tAra keAno aMza thAkave nA|

tAdera ki emana katagulo zarika Ache, yArA tAdera janya dharmera vidhAna diYeche, yAra anumati AllAha denani? yadi cUr3Anta siddhAnta nA thAkata, tave tAdera vyApAre phAYasAlA haYe yeta| nizcaYai sImAlaGghanakArIdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

tumi yAlimadera tAdera kRtakarmera janye bhIta-santrasta dekhave| Ara tA tAdera opara patita havei| Ara yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tArA jAnnAtera udyAne thAkave| tArA yA cAive, tA-i tAdera janya tAdera ravera kAche thAkave| eTAi mahApuraskAra|

erai susaMvAda dena AllAha tAra sesava vAndAke, yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare| valo, Ami tAra (dAoYAtera) janya teAmAdera kAche AtmIYatAjanita sauhArdya vyatIta anya kono pratidAna cAi nA| Ara ye keu arjana kare uttama Amala, Ami tAra janya tAte puNya vAr3iYe dii| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, guNagrAhI|

nAki tArA vale ye, se AllAhara viruddhe mithyA raTanA kareche? yadi AllAha icchA karatena, tomAra antare meAhara e~Te ditena| vastuta AllAha mithyAke miTiYe dena evaM nija vAkya dvArA satyake pratiSThita karena| nizcaYai tini antarnihita viSaYa samparke samyaka jJAta|
Ara tinii tA~ra vAndAdera tAovA kavula karena, pApasamUha mArjanA karena evaM tomarA yA karo—tA tini jAnena|
evaM yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tini tAdera AhvAne sAr3A dena evaM tAdera prati svIYa anugraha vardhita karena| Ara kAphiradera janya raYeche kaTheAra zAsti|

Ara yadi AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera janya riyika prazasta kare ditena, tave tArA pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi karata; kintu tini ye parimANa icchA, avatIrNa karena| nizcaYai tini tA~ra vAndAdera samparke sarvajAntA o sarvadraSTA|
evaM tArA yakhana nirAza haYe par3e, takhana tini vRSTi varSaNa karena evaM svIYa rahamata char3iYe dena| tinii abhibhAvaka, prazaMsita|
Ara tA~ra nidarzanasamUha theke Ache, AsamAna o yaminera sRSTi evaM ubhaYera madhye tini yesava jIva-jantu char3iYe diYechena| tini yakhana icchA karavena, eguleAke ekatra karate sakSama|
teAmAdera opara yesava vipada-Apada patita haYa, tA teAmAdera karmerai phala evaM tini aneka kichu kSamA kare dena|
Ara teAmarA pRthivIte (AllAhake) akSama karate pArave nA evaM AllAha vyatIta teAmAdera nei keAno abhibhAvaka, evaM nei sAhAyyakArIo|
evaM tA~ra nidarzavali theke Ache samudre bhAsamAna parvatasadRza nauyAnasamUha|
tini yadi icchA karena, vAtAsake stavdha kare dite pArena| takhana nauyAnasamUha samudrapRSThe nizcala haYe par3ave| nizcaYai ete pratyeka savarakArI, kRtajJera janya raYeche aneka nidarzana|
athavA tArA yA arjana kareche, sekAraNe seguleAke dhvaMsa kare dena evaM anekake kSamAo kare dena|
Ara yArA AmAra nidarzana samparke vitarka kare, tArA yena jAnate pAre, tAdera keAno pAlAnora jAYagA nei|
ataeva, teAmAdera yA-kichu deoYA haYeche, tA pArthiva-jIvanera bheAgamAtra| Ara AllAhara kAche yA raYeche, tA utkRSTa o sthAYI tAdera janya, yArA ImAna Ane o tAdera ravera opara bharasA kare|
yArA kavirA gunAha o azlIla kAja theke ve~ce thAke evaM yakhana tArA kreAdhAnvita haYa, takhana tArA kSamA kare deYa,
yArA tAdera ravera AhvAne sAr3A deYa, sAlAta kAYema kare; parAmarzakrame pArasparika karma kare evaM Ami tAdera ye riyika diYechi, tA theke vyaYa kare,
Ara yArA yakhana tAdera opara nipIr3ana Apatita haYa, takhana tArA pratizeAdha grahaNa kare|
Ara mandera pratiphala teA anurUpa mandai| sutarAM ye kSamA kare o Apasa kare, tAra puraskAra AllAhara kAche raYeche; nizcaYai tini atyAcArIdera pachanda karena nA|
nizcaYai ye atyAcArita haoYAra para pratizeAdha grahaNa kare, tAdera viruddhe keAno vyavasthA grahaNa karA have nA|
kevala tAdera viruddhe vyavasthA grahaNa karA have, yArA mAnuSera opara atyAcAra cAlAYa evaM pRthivIte anyAYabhAve nairAjya sRSTi kare; tAdera janye raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
avazyai ye dhairyadhAraNa kare o kSamA kare; nizcaYa tA dRr3ha saMkalperai kAja|

Ara AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAra para tAra janya keAno abhibhAvaka nei| pApAcArIrA yakhana zAsti dekhave, takhana tumi tAdera dekhave ye, tArA valache AmAdera pratyAvartanera keAno upAYa Ache ki?

Ara tumi tAdera dekhave, tAderake tAra (jAhAnnAmera) sAmane upasthita karA hacche; apamAne avanata avasthAYa tAkiYe Ache ardhanimIlita cokhe| mu’minarA valave, kiYAmatera dina kSatigrasta tArAi, yArA nijedera o tAdera parivAra-parijanera kSatisAdhana kareche| zune rAkho, sImAlaGghanakArIrA sthAYI zAstite thAkave|
AllAha vyatIta tAdera emana keAno abhibhAvaka thAkave nA, ye tAdera sAhAyya karave| evaM AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAra keAno upAYa nei|

teAmarA teAmAdera ravera AhvAne sAr3A dAo AllAhara pakSa theke sei divasa AsAra pUrve yAra kono pratirodha nei; sedina teAmAdera janya keAno AzraYasthala thAkave nA evaM thAkave nA teAmAdera janya kono pratihatakArI|

yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave tomAke Ami tAdera rakSaka kare pAThAini| tomAra kartavya kevala pau~che deoYA| Ami yakhana mAnuSake AmAra rahamata AsvAdana karAi, takhana se tAte ucchvasita haYa, Ara yakhana tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe tAdera opara Apatita haYa keAno aniSTa, takhana mAnuSa khuva akRtajJa haYe yAYa|
AsamAna o yaminera rAjatva AllAharai| tini yA icchA, sRSTi karena, yAke icchA kanyA-santAna evaM yAke icchA putra santAna dAna karena|
athavA tAdera dAna karena putra o kanyA ubhaYai evaM yAke icchA vandhyA kare dena| nizcaYai tini sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|

keAno mAnuSera janya emana haoYAra naYa ye, AllAha tAra sAthe kathA valavena, oYAhira mAdhyama vatIta athavA pardAra antarAla theke athavA tini keAno dUta pAThAvena, ataHpara AllAha yA cAna, se tA~ra anumatikrame tA vyakta kare| nizcaYai tini samunnata prajJAmaYa|

Ara ebhAve Ami tomAra kAche rUha-ke oYAhi kare pAThiYechi AmAra Adezakrame| tumi to jAnate nA, kitAva kI evaM ImAna kI? kintu Ami eke karechi nUra, yA dvArA Ami AmAra vAndAdera madhya theke yAke icchA hidAYAta dAna kari| nizcaYai tumi sarala pathera dike nirdezanA dAo—
sei AllAhara patha; AsamAna o yamine yA-kichu Ache, sava yAra adhIne| zune rAkho, AllAhara dikei sakala viSaYe pratyAvartana kare|
hA mI-ma|
zapatha suspaSTa kitAvera,
Ami eke karechi kuraAnarUpe AravibhASAYa, yena teAmarA vujhate pAra|
nizcaYai e kuraAna AmAra kAche ummula kitAve Ache, tA samunnata, jJAnagarbha|
Ami ki teAmAdera kAcha theke ei kuraAna pratyAhAra kare neva e kAraNe ye, teAmarA avAdhya sampradAYa?
Ara pUrvavartIdera madhye Ami aneka navi pAThiYechilAma|
yakhanai tAdera kAche keAno rAsUla eseche, tArA tAra sAthe ThATTA-vidrupa kareche|
Ami tAdera ceYe adhika zakti-sampannadera dhvaMsa kare diYechi| Ara pUrvavartIdera dRSTAnta atIta haYe geche|
tumi yadi tAdera jijJAsA karo, ke AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena? tArA avazyai valave, eguleA sRSTi karechena parAkramazAlI sarvajJa AllAha|
yini teAmAdera janya pRthivIke karechena vichAnA evaM tAte teAmAdera janya karechena patha, yena teAmarA saThika patha pete pAra|
Ara yini AkAza theke parimita vAri varSaNa karena; ataHpara Ami tA dvArA mRta pRthivIke saJjIvita kari| ebhAvei teAmAdera utthita karA have|
Ara yini pratyekera yugala sRSTi karechena evaM tini tomAdera janya sRSTi karechena nauyAna o catuSpada jantu—yena tomarA ArohaNa karo,

yena teAmarA tAdera piThe sthira haYe vasate pAro| ataHpara teAmAdera ravera niYAmata smaraNa karo yakhana tomarA tAra upara sthira haYe vaso evaM valo—pavitra o mahAna tini, yini eke AmAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechena| AmarA tAderake vazIbhUta karate sakSama chilAma nA|
Ara AmarA avazyai AmAdera ravera dike phire yAva|
Ara tArA tA~ra vAndAdera madhya theke tA~ra janya aMza sthira kareche| nizcaYai mAnuSa spaSTa akRtajJa|
tini ki yA sRSTi karechena, tA theke kanyAsantAna grahaNa karechena evaM teAmAdera viziSTa karechena putrasantAna dvArA?

athaca yakhana tAdera kAuke (kanyAsantAnera) susaMvAda deoYA haYa, se vyApAre, yA (kanyAsantAna) rahamAnera prati se dRSTAnta Aropa kare, takhana tAra mukhamaNDala kAlo haYe yAYa| evaM se bhArAkrAnta haYe par3e|
(tArA ki AllAhara prati Aropa kare emana santAna,) ye alaMkAre lAlita-pAlita haYa evaM se tarka-vitarkakAle spaSTa vaktavye akSama|
tArA pherezatAderake nArI sthira kare—yArA AllAhara vAndA| tArA ki tAdera sRSTi pratyakSa kareche? acirei tAdera dAvi lipivaddha karA have evaM tAdera jijJAsA karA have|
evaM tArA vale, yadi rahamAna icchA karatena, AmarA odera upAsanA karatAma nA| e viSaYe tAdera kono jJAna nei; tArA to kevala anumAne kathA vale|
Ami ki tAderake tAra (kuraAnera) pUrve keAno kitAva diYechi, yA tArA A~kar3e dhare Ache?
varaM tArA vale, AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera peYechi ekai matAdarze evaM AmarA tAderai padAGka anusmaraNa karachi|

ebhAve tomAra pUrve Ami yakhana keAno janapade keAno satarkakArI pAThiYechi, takhanai tAra vittazAlIrA valeche, AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera peYechi e matAdarze evaM AmarA tAderai padAGka anusaraNa karachi|

se (satarkakArI) valata, teAmarA teAmAdera pUrvapuruSadera yAra (ye pathera) upara peYecha, Ami yadi tAra ceYe uttama viSaYa niYe teAmAdera kAche Asi, (tavuo ki teAmarA tAi valave)? tArA valata, ‘teAmarA ye viSaYasaha prerita haYecha, AmarA tA asvIkArakArI|
ataHpara Ami tAdera theke pratizeAdha niYechi| ataeva dekho, kemana chila mithyAreApakArIdera pariNAma|
yakhana ivarAhIma tAra pitA o sampradAYake valala, teAmarA yAdera upAsanA karo, tAdera theke Ami samparka-mukta|
tave yini AmAke sRSTi karechena| Ara nizcaYa tinii AmAke hidAYAta dAna karavena|
Ara eTike se tAra paravartIdera janya amara vANIrUpe rekhe geche, yena tArA pratyAvartana kare|
varaM Amii tAderake o tAdera pUrvapuruSadera jIvaneApabheAga karate diYechi, avazeSe tAdera kAche satya o spaSTa varNanAkArI rAsUla eseche|
Ara yakhana satya tAdera kAche ela, takhana tArA valala, eTA jAdu, AmarA tA asvIkArakArI|
tArA vale, ei kuraAna kena dui janapadera keAno pradhAna vyaktira opara avatIrNa halo nA?

tArA ki tomAra ravera rahamata vaNTana kare? Ami tAdera madhye tAdera jIvikA vaNTana karechi pArthiva jIvane evaM ekera maryAdAke aparera opara unnIta karechi, yena eke aparake sevakarUpe grahaNa kare| tArA yA saJcaYa kare, tomAra ravera rahamata tA theke uttama|
yadi sava mAnuSa eka ummAha haYe yAoYAra AzaGkA nA thAkata, tave yArA daYAmaYake asvIkAra kare, Ami tAderake tAdera gharera janya rUpA nirmita chAda o si~r3i vAniYe ditAma, yAra upara tArA car3ata|
evaM tAdera gharera janya darajA o pAlaGka, yAte tArA helAna deYa|
evaM svarNanirmitao| eguleA savai teA pArthiva-jIvanera bheAgasAmagrI mAtra| Ara tomAra ravera kAche parakAlera kalyANa raYeche muttAkidera janya|
ye vyakti daYAmaYa AllAhara smaraNa theke ceAkha phiriYe neYa, Ami tAra janya eka zaYatAna niYeAjita kare dii, ataHpara se-i haYa tAra saGgI|
Ara nizcaYa tArA (zaYatAna) mAnuSake satpatha theke vAdhA deYa| athaca tArA mane kare, nizcaYa tArA satpathaprApta|
avazeSe yakhana se AmAra kAche Asave, takhana se (zaYatAnake) valave, hAYa! AmAra o teAmAra madhye yadi pUrva-pazcimera dUratva thAkata, Ara katai nikRSTa saGgI se|
Ara Aja (tomAdera ei anutApa) kichutei kono upakAre Asave nA, yehetu tomarA sImAlaGghana karechile| tomarA to sakalei zAstite paraspara aMzIdAra|
tumi ki vadhirake zeAnAte pArave? athavA hidAYAta karate pArave andhake o tAke, ye spaSTa pathabhraSTatAYa raYeche?
Ami yadi tomAke niYe yAi, tavuo Ami tAdera nikaTa theke pratizeAdha neva|
athavA Ami tAdera ye zAstira pratizruti diYechi, tA yadi tomAke pratyakSa karAi, tave Ami avazyai tAdera opara pUrNa kSamatAvAna|
ataeva, tomAra prati ye oYAhi nAyila karA haYa, tA dRr3habhAve avalamvana karo| niHsandehe tumi sarala pathe raYecha|
Ara nizcaYai eTA tomAra o tomAra sampradAYera janya upadeza evaM zigagira tomarA jijJAsita have|
tomAra pUrve Ami yesava rAsUla pAThiYechi, tAderake jijJesa karo, daYAmaYa AllAha vyatIta Ami ki keAno upAsya sthira karechilAma, yAra ivAdAta karA yAYa?
Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzanAvali diYe phiraAuna o tAra pariSadavargera kAche pAThiYechilAma, ataHpara se valechila, Ami vizvajagatera ravera rAsUla|
ataHpara se yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra nidarzanAvali-saha ela| takhana tArA tA niYe ThATTA-vidrupa karate lAgala|
Ara Ami tAdera emana kono nidarzana dekhAini, yA tAra anurUpa nidarzana apekSA zreSTha naYa evaM Ami tAderake zAsti dvArA pAkar3Ao karalAma, yena tArA phire Ase|
tArA valala, he jAdukara, tumi AmAdera janya teAmAra ravera kAche se viSaYa prArthanA karo, yAra pratizruti tini teAmAke diYechena; tavei AmarA avazyai satpathaprApta hava|
ataHpara yakhana Ami tAdera theke zAsti pratyAhAra kare nilAma, takhanai tArA aGgIkAra bhaGga karala|
phiraAuna tAra sampradAYera madhye ei vale ghoSaNA karala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, misarera rAjatva ki AmAra naYa? ei nadIguleA AmAra pAdadeza diYe pravAhita naYa?| teAmarA ki dekho nA?
athavA Ami ki ei vyakti theke zreSTha nai ye hIna? evaM spaSTabhAve varNanA karate pAre nA|
tAke kena deoYA halo nA svarNa-vAlA, athavA kena tAra saGge pherezatAgaNa dala ve~dhe ela nA?
ataHpara se tAra sampradAYake veAkA vAniYe dila, phale tArA tAra kathA mene nila| nizcaYai tArA chila pApAcArI sampradAYa|
ataHpara yakhana tArA AmAke AzAhata karala takhana Ami tAdera kAcha theke pratizeAdha nilAma evaM tAdera savAike nimajjita karalAma|
ataHpara Ami tAderake paravartIdera janye atIta smRti o dRSTAnta kare dilAma|
Ara yakhanai mAraiYAma tanaYera dRSTAnta varNanA karA halo, takhanai tomAra sampradAYa tAte haTTageAla zuru kare dila|
evaM tArA valala, AmAdera upAsyarA zreSTha, nAki se? tArA tomAra sAmane ye udAharaNa upasthApana kare tA kevala vitarkera janyei kare| vastuta tArA halo vitarkakArI sampradAYa|
se teA eka vAndAi vaTe, yAra prati Ami anugraha karechi evaM tAke Ami karechi vani isarAIlera janya dRSTAnta;
Ami icchA karale teAmAdera theke pherezatA sRSTi karatAma, yArA pRthivIte uttarAdhikArI hato|
nizcaYa se halo kiYAmatera nidarzana| kAjei teAmarA tAte sandeha kareA nA evaM AmAra kathA mAno| eTAi sarala patha|
zaYatAna yena kichutei teAmAdera nivRtta nA kare| se to teAmAdera prakAzya zatru|

IsA yakhana spaSTa nidarzanasaha ela, takhana valala, Ami teAmAdera kAche prajJA niYe esechi evaM teAmarA ye kichu viSaYe matabheda karacha, tA tomAdera kAche spaSTa kare deoYAra janya| ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra anusaraNa karo|
nizcaYai AllAha AmAra o teAmAdera rava| ataeva, tA~ra ivAdAta karo| eTA sarala patha|
ataHpara tAdera madhya theke vibhinna dala matabheda sRSTi karala| sutarAM sImAlaGghanakArIdera janye durbhoga, yantraNAdAYaka dinera zAstira|
tArA kevala kiYAmaterai apekSA karache ye, AkasmikabhAve tAdera kAche ese yAve evaM tArA anudhAvanao karate pArave nA|
vandhuvarga sedina eke aparera zatru have, tave muttAkirA vyatIta|
he AmAra vAndAgaNa, teAmAdera Aja keAno bhaYa nei evaM teAmarA duHkhitao have nA,
yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe ImAna enechila evaM tArA chila AtmasamarpaNakArI,
teAmarA evaM teAmAdera vivigaNa sAnande jAnnAte praveza karo| tomAdera santuSTa karA have|
tAdera kAche parivezana karA have svarNa-nirmita thAlA o pAnapAtra evaM sekhAne raYeche mane yA cAYa evaM yAte cokha tRpta haYa| evaM teAmarA sekhAne sthAYI|
eTAi jAnnAta; tomAderake yAra uttarAdhikArI karA haYeche, tAra phalasvarUpa, yA tomarA karate|
sekhAne teAmAdera janye Ache pracura phalamUla, tA theke teAmarA AhAra karave|
nizcaYai aparAdhIrA cirakAla jAhAnnAmera zAstite thAkave|
tAdera theke zAsti lAghava karA have nA evaM tArA tAtei thAkave hatAza haYe|
Ami tAdera prati avicAra karini; kintu tArAi chila sImAlaGghanakArI|
tArA Deke valave, he mAlika, tomAra rava yena AmAdera zeSa kare deYa| se valave, nizcaYai teAmarA cirakAla avasthAnakArI|
Ami teAmAdera kAche satya niYe esechilAma; kintu teAmAdera adhikAMzai chila satya apachandakArI!
tArA ki keAno vyavasthA cUr3Anta kareche? tA hale Amii to cUr3AntakArI|
tArA ki mane kare ye, Ami tAdera geApana viSaYa o geApana parAmarza zuni nA? hyA~, zuni| AmAra pherezatAgaNa tAdera nikaTe theke lipivaddha kare|
valo, yadi daYAmaYa AllAhara keAno santAna thAkata, tA hale Ami tAra ivAdAtakArIdera prathama hatAma|
tArA yA sAvyasta kare, tA theke AsamAna o yaminera rava, Arazera rava pavitra|
ataeva, tAdera vAkacAturI o krIr3A-kautuka karate cher3e dAo, yatakSaNa nA sedinera sAthe tArA sAkSAt kare, yAra pratizruti tAdera deoYA haYeche|
Ara tini ilAha AsamAne evaM tinii ilAha yamine| tini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa,
varakatamaYa tinii, yA~ra kartRtve raYeche AsamAna, yamina evaM eduTira madhyavartI savakichu| tA~rai kAche Ache kiYAmatera jJAna evaM tA~rai dike teAmarA pratyAvartita have|
Ara tini chAr3A yAderake tArA AhvAna kare, tArA supArizera adhikArI have nA; tave tArA chAr3A yArA jene-zune satya sAkSya deYa|
yadi tumi tAdera jijJAsA karo, ke tAdera sRSTi karechena, avazyai tArA valave, AllAha, ataHpara tAdera keAthAYa pherAno hacche?
Ara rAsUlera ukti, he AmAra rava, e sampradAYa teA ImAna Anave nA|
ataeva, tumi tAdera theke mukha phiriYe nAo evaM valo, ‘sAlAma’| tArA zigagira jAnate pArave|
hA-mI-ma|
zapatha suspaSTa kitAvera,
Ami eTi avatIrNa karechi eka varakatamaYa rAte, nizcaYai Ami satarkakArI|
e rAte pratyeka prajJApUrNa viSaYa sthira karA haYa|
AmAra pakSa theke Adezakrame, nizcaYa Amii (rAsUla) preraNakArI|
tomAra ravera pakSa theke rahamatasvarUpa| tini sarvazreAtA, sarvajJa,
yini AsamAnasamUha, yamina o e duYera madhyavartI savakichura rava| yadi teAmArA nizcita vizvAsI hao,
tini vyatIta keAno ilAha nei, tini jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna, tini teAmAdera rava evaM teAmAdera pUrvavartI pitR-puruSaderao rava|
varaM tArA sandehera madhye par3e krIr3A-kautuka karache|
ataeva, tumi sei dinera apekSA karo, yedina AkAza prakAzya dho~YAYa cheYe yAve|
yA mAnuSake ghire phelave| eTA yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
he AmAdera rava, AmAdera opara theke zAsti pratyAhAra karuna, avazyai AmarA mu’mina hava|
kIbhAve tArA upadeza grahaNa karave? athaca tAdera kAche esechila spaSTa varNanAkArI rAsUla|
ataHpara tArA tAra theke vimukha haYe vale, se teA zikSita ummAda|
nizcaYa Ami kichukAlera janya zAsti pratyAhAra karava, nizcaYa teAmarA pUrvAvasthAYa phire yAve|
yedina Ami pravalabhAve pAkar3Ao karava, nizcaYa sedina pratizeAdha grahaNakArI hava|
tAdera pUrve Ami phiraAunera sampradAYake parIkSA karechi evaM tAdera kAche eseche ekajana sammAnita rAsUla,
ei marme ye, AllAhara vAndAdera AmAra kAche arpaNa karo| Ami teAmAdera janya vizvasta rAsUla|
Ara teAmarA AllAhara viruddhe auddhatya prakAza kareA nA| Ami teAmAdera nikaTa Asachi eka suspaSTa pramANa niYe|
teAmarA yena AmAke pAthara mere hatyA nA karo, ejanya Ami AmAra rava o teAmAdera ravera AzraYa cAcchi|
teAmarA yadi AmAra prati ImAna nA Ano, tave AmAra kAcha theke dUre thAko|
ataHpara se tAra ravera kAche prArthanA karala ye, erA aparAdhI sampradAYa|
tave tumi AmAra vAndAdera niYe rAtera velAYa vera haYe par3o| nizcaYai teAmAdera pazcAddhavana karA have|
evaM samudrake zAnta avasthAYa cher3e dAo| nizcaYai orA nimajjita vAhinI|
tArA cher3e giYechila kata udyAna o prasravaNa,
aneka zasyakSeta o suramya sthAna|
kata sukhera upakaraNa, yekhAne tArA Ananda-phurti karata,
emanai haYechila, evaM Ami oguleAra uttarAdhikArI karechilAma bhinna sampradAYake|
tAdera janye kA~deni AkAza o pRthivI evaM tArA chila nA avakAzaprApta|
Ami vani isarAIlake apamAnajanaka zAsti theke uddhAra karechi|
phiraAuna theke; nizcaYa se chila sImAlaGghanakArIdera madhye zIrSasthAnIYa|
Ami to jJAtasAre tAderake vizvavAsIdera opara nirvAcita karechilAma|
evaM Ami tAdera emana nidarzanAvali diYechi—yAte chila spaSTa parIkSA|
nizcaYa tArA valei thAke,
AmAdera prathama mRtyu vyatIta Ara kichui nei evaM AmAdera punarutthita karA have nA|
teAmarA yadi satyavAdI hao, tave AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera niYe eso|
tArA zreSTha, nAki tuvvA sampradAYa o tAdera pUrvavartIrA? Ami tAdera dhvaMsa kare diYechi| tArA chila aparAdhI|
Ami AsamAnasamUha, yamina o e duYera madhyavartI savakichu khelAcchale sRSTi karini|
Ami ubhaYaTi yathAyatha uddezye sRSTi karechi; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
nizcaYai phAYasAlAra dina tAdera savArai nirdhArita samaYa|
yedina keAno vandhui keAno vandhura upakAre Asave nA evaM tArA sAhAyyaprAptao have nA
tave AllAha yAra prati daYA karena, (tAra kathA bhinna)| nizcaYa tini parAkramazAlI asIma daYAlu|
nizcaYai yAkkuma-gAcha—
pApIra khAdya have;
galita tAmAra mato peTe phuTate thAkave|
Tagavage phuTanta pAnira mato|
tomarA tAke pAkar3Ao karo evaM Tene niYe yAo jAhAnnAmera madhyasthale,
ataHpara tAra mAthAra upara phuTanta pAnira AyAva Dhele dAo,
svAda grahaNa karo, tumi teA sammAnita, sambhrAnta|
eTA to seTAi, ye viSaYa tomarA sandeha karate|
nizcaYai muttakirA nirApada sthAne thAkave—
udyAnarAji o nirjhariNIsamUhe|
tArA parave mihi o puru rezamera pozAka, vasave mukheAmukhi haYe|
emanai have evaM Ami tAdera jor3A kare deva AYatanaYanA hUradera saGge|
tArA sekhAne zAnta mane sava rakamera phala-mUla Anate valave|
prathama mRtyu vyatIta tArA sekhAne Ara kono mRtyu AsvAdana karave nA, evaM tini tAderake jAhAnnAmera zAsti theke rakSA karavena|
tomAra ravera pakSa theke anugrahasvarUpa; eTAi mahAsAphalya|
Ami tomAra bhASAYa kuraAnake sahaja kare diYechi, yena tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
ataeva, tumi apekSA karo, nizcaYa tArAo apekSamANa|
hA mI-ma|
parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa AllAhara pakSa theke e kitAva avatIrNa|
nizcaYai AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte raYeche mu’minadera janye aneka nidarzana|
Ara teAmAdera sRSTite evaM ye jIva-jantu tini char3iYe rekhechena, tAte nidarzanAvali raYeche ai sampradAYera janya, yArA nizcita vizvAsa kare|

evaM rAta o dinera parivartane, evaM AllAha AkAza theke ye riyika (vRSTi) varSaNa karena, ataHpara tA dvArA pRthivIke tAra mRtyura para punarujjIvita karena, tAte evaM vAtAsera parivartaneo Ache jJAnI sampradAYera janya vahu nidarzana|
eguleA AllAhara AYAta, yA Ami tomAra kAche yathArthabhAve varNanA kari| ataeva, tArA AllAha o tA~ra AYAtera para Ara keAna kathAYa ImAna Anave|
pratyeka mithyAvAdI pApAcArIra janya durbheAga
tAra sAmane paThita AllAhara AYAtasamUha se zone, ataHpara ahaMkAre aTala thAke, yena se tA zunate pAYani| sutarAM, tAke yantraNAdAYaka zAstira susaMvAda dena|
yakhana se AmAra keAno AYAta samparke avagata haYa, takhana tAke ThATTArUpe grahaNa kare| tAdera janyai raYeche lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|
tAdera pechane raYeche jAhAnnAma| Ara tArA yA upArjana kareche tA tAdera keAno upakAre Asave nA| evaM AllAha vyatIta yAdera vandhurUpe grahaNa kareche, tArAo nA| tAdera janye raYeche mahAzAsti|
eTAi hidAYAta| Ara yArA tAdera ravera AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare, tAdera janye raYeche atizaYa yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
tinii AllAha, yini adhIna karechena teAmAdera janya samudrake, yena tA~ra nirdeze tAte nauyAna calate pAre evaM teAmarA tA~ra anugraha tAlAza karate pAra o tA~ra prati kRtajJa hao,
evaM tA~ra pakSa thekei AsamAnasamUha o yaminera savakichu tomAdera janya adhIna karechena, nizcaYai ete cintAzIla sampradAYera janya Ache vahu nidarzana|
mu’minadera valo, yArA AllAhara dinaguleAra pratyAzA kare nA tArA yena tAdera kSamA kare—yena tini nirdiSTa sampradAYake tAdera karmera pratiphala devena|
ye satkAja kareche, tA nijera kalyANArthei, Ara ye asatkAja karache, tA tAra oparai vartAve| ataHpara teAmarA teAmAdera ravera dike pratyAvartita have|
Ami vani isarAIlake kitAva, rAjatva o navuoYAta dAna karechi evaM tAdera diYechi pavitra jIvikA, evaM vizvavAsIra opara dAna karechi zreSThatva|

Arao diYechi tAderake dInera suspaSTa pramANAdi| ataHpara tAdera kAche jJAna AsAra para tArA zudhu pArasparika jedera vazavartI haYe matabheda kareche| tArA ye viSaYe matabheda karata, tomAra rava kiYAmatera dina tAdera mAjhe phAYasAlA karavena|
erapara Ami tomAke pratiSThita karechi zarIYatera vidhi-vidhAnera opara| ataeva, tumi tAra anusaraNa karo evaM yArA jAne nA, tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa karo nA|
AllAhara mokAvelAYa tArA tomAra keAno upakAre Asave nA| sImAlaGghanakArIrA eke aparera vandhu| Ara AllAha muttAkidera vandhu|
eTA mAnuSera janye AlokavartikA, evaM nizcita vizvAsI sampradAYera janya hidAYAta o rahamata|
yArA manda kAje lipta raYeche, tArA ki mane kare ye, Ami jIvana o mutyura kSetre tAdera se leAkadera samAna kare deva—yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare? tAdera vicAra katai nA manda|
AllAha AsamAna o yamina yathAyathabhAve sRSTi karechena, yena pratyeka vyaktike tAra upArjanera phala deoYA yAYa| tAdera prati avicAra karA have nA|

tumi ki (tAra prati) lakSa karecha, ye tAra pravRttike upAsyarUpe grahaNa kareche? AllAha jenezunei tAke pathabhraSTa karechena, tAra kAne o antare mohara e~Te diYechena evaM tAra ceAkhera opara rekhechena pardA| ataeva, AllAhara para ke tAke hidAYAta deve? tavuo ki teAmarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?
tArA vale, AmAdera pArthiva-jIvana vyatIta Ara kichui nei; AmarA mari o vA~ci; kAla-pravAhai AmAderake dhvaMsa kare| tAdera kAche e vyApAre keAno jJAna nei| tArA kevala anumAnai kare|
tAdera kAche yakhana AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha par3A haYa, takhana ekathA valA chAr3A tAdera keAno yuktii thAke nA ye, teAmarA satyavAdI hale AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera niYe eso|
tumi valo, AllAhai teAmAdera jIvana dAna karena, ataHpara mRtyu dena, ataHpara teAmAdera kiYAmatera dina ekatrita karavena, yAte keAno sandeha nei; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jJAna rAkhe nA|
AsamAna o yaminera rAjatva AllAharai| yedina kiYAmata saMghaTita have, sedina vibhrAntarA kSatigrasta have|
tumi pratyeka ummatake dekhave natajAnu avasthAYa| pratyeka ummatake tAdera AmalanAmAra prati AhvAna karA have| teAmarA yA karate, Aja teAmAdera tAra pratiphala deoYA have|
ei AmAra kitAva; tomAdera viruddhe valave nyAYasaGgatabhAve, teAmarA yA karate Ami tA likhe rAkhatAma|
yArA ImAne eneche o satkarma kareche, phale tAdera rava tAdera praveza karAvena svIYa rahamate| eTAi suspaSTa sAphalya|
Ara yArA kuphuri kareche, (tAdera jijJAsA karA have)| teAmAdera nikaTa ki AmAra AYAtasamUha par3A hato nA? kintu teAmarA ahaMkAra karate evaM teAmarA chile eka aparAdhI sampradAYa|
yakhana valA hato, AllAhara pratizruti satya evaM kiYAmate keAno sandeha nei, takhana teAmarA valate AmarA jAni nA kiYAmata kI? AmarA kevala eke dhAraNAi mane kari evaM AmarA dRr3ha vizvAsI nai|
tAdera manda kAjaguleA tAdera kAche prakAza pAve evaM ye zAsti niYe tArA ThATTA-vidrupa karata, tA tAderake grAsa karave|
Ara valA have, Aja Ami teAmAdera bhule yAva, yemana teAmarA e dinera sAkSAtke bhule giYechile| teAmAdera AvAsasthala jAhAnnAma evaM teAmAdera sAhAyyakArI nei|

eTA ejanye ye, teAmarA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake ThATTArUpe grahaNa karechile evaM pArthiva-jIvana teAmAdera pratArita karechila| sutarAM Aja tAdera jAhAnnAma theke vera karA have nA evaM nA tAderake santuSTilAbhera suyoga deoYA have|
sutarAM sakala prazaMsA sei AllAhara, yini AsamAnera rava, yaminera rava, jagatasamUhera rava|
Ara AsamAna o yamine sava gaurava-garimA tA~rai| tinii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
hA-mI-ma|
ei kitAva parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAhara pakSa theke avatIrNa|

AsamAna, yamina o ubhaYaTira madhyavartI savakichu Ami yathArthabhAve evaM nirdiSTa samaYera janye sRSTi karechi| athaca yArA kuphuri kare, tAdera ye viSaYe satarka karA haYa, tA theke tArA mukha phiriYe neYa|

valo, teAmarA AllAha vyatIta yAdera upAsanA karo, tAdera viSaYe bheve dekhecha ki? AmAke dekhAo, tArA pRthivIte kI sRSTi kareche? athavA AkAze tAdera keAno aMzIdAratva Ache ki? era pUrvavartI keAno kitAva athavA paramparAgata keAno jJAna AmAra kAche upasthita karo, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao|
ye vyakti AllAhara parivarte emana vastura upAsanA kare, ye kiYAmata paryantao tAra DAke sAr3A deve nA, tAra ceYe adhika pathabhraSTa Ara ke? Ara egulo teA tAdera upAsanA samparkeo anavahita|
evaM yakhana mAnuSake ekatra karA have, takhana e-sakala upAsya tAdera zatru have evaM tAdera upAsanA tArA asvIkAra karave|
yakhana tAdera nikaTa AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha par3A haYa, takhana tArA, yArA kAphera, yakhana tAdera kAche satya eseche tArA tA asvIkAra kareche, tArA valeche, e teA prakAzya jAdu|

nAki tArA vale ye, se (rAsUla) tA racanA kareche? valo, yadi Ami racanA kare thAki, tave teAmarA AllAhara zAsti theke AmAke rakSA karAra kSamatA rAkho nA| teAmarA e samparke yA AleAcanA karo, se viSaYe AllAha samyaka avagata| AmAra o teAmAdera madhye tinii sAkSI hiseve yatheSTa| Ara tini kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

valo, Ami teA keAno natuna rAsUla nai; Ara Ami jAni nA, AmAra o teAmAdera sAthe kI (vyavahAra) karA have| Ami kevala tArai anusaraNa kari, yA AmAra prati avatIrNa haYa| Ara Ami zudhui ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI|

valo, teAmarA bheve dekhecha ki, yadi eTA AllAhara pakSa theke haYa evaM teAmarA eke asvIkAra karo, athaca vani isarAIlera ekajana anurUpa kitAva samparke sAkSya diYeche evaM tAte ImAna eneche, Ara teAmarA ahaMkAra karecha, tave teAmAdera ceYe avivecaka Ara ke have? nizcaYai AllAha sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYake patha dekhAna nA|

Ara yArA kuphuri kare tArA, yArA ImAna Ane tAdera samparke vale, yadi e (dvIna) kalyANakara hato tave tArA AmAdera pechane phele egiYe yete pArata nA| Ara tArA yakhana era mAdhyame supatha pAYani, takhana zigagira valave, e teA eka purAtana mithyA kAhini|
era Age mUsAra kitAva chila anusaraNIYa o rahamata| Ara ei kitAva tAra satyAYanakArI, AravI bhASAYa, yena sImAlaGghanakArIdera satarka kare evaM satkarmazIladera susaMvAda deYa|
nizcaYai yArA vale, AmAdera rava AllAha evaM tAte avicala thAke, tAdera keAno bhaYa nei evaM tArA cintita have nA|
tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI! tArA sekhAne sthAYI have| tArA ye karma karata, eTi tArai pratiphala|

Ami mAnuSake tAra pitAmAtAra sAthe sadvyavahArera Adeza diYechi| tAra mA tAke garbhe dhAraNa kare bhISaNa kaSTera mAjhe evaM kaSTa kare prasava kare| tAke garbhe dhAraNa karate evaM tAra stanya chAr3Ate legeche triza mAsa| avazeSe se yakhana zakti-sAmarthyera vaYase o calliza vachare pau~che, takhana valate thAke, he AmAra rava, AmAke sAmarthya dAna karo, yena Ami teAmAra niYAmatera zeAkara karate pAri, ye niYAmata tumi dAna karecha AmAke o AmAra pitA-mAtAke evaM yena Ami satkarma karate pAri, yA tumi pachanda karo| evaM AmAra janya AmAra santAnadera satkarmaparAYaNa karo, Ami teAmAra abhimukhI halAma evaM nizcaYa Ami musalimadera antarbhukta|
Ami sakala leAkera pakSa theke kavula kari tAdera ye pratizruti deoYA hato, sei satya pratizrutira kAraNe tArA jAnnAtidera tAlikAbhukta|

Ara ye vyakti tAra pitAmAtAke vale, dhika teAmAdera, teAmarA ki AmAke ei bhaYa dekhAo ye Ami punarutthita hava, athaca AmAra pUrve vahu prajanma gata haYe geche? takhana tAra pitA-mAtA AllAhara kAche phariYAda kare vale, durbheAga teAmAra janya, tumi ImAna Ano! nizcaYa AllAhara pratizruti satya| takhana se vale, eTA teA pUrvavartIdera rUpakathA chAr3A kichu naYa|
tAdera pUrve vahu jina o mAnuSa sampradAYa gata haYeche, tAdera mato e dharanera leAkadera pratio zAstivANI avadhArita haYe geche| nizcaYai pUrvavartI sampradAYa chila kSatigrasta|
pratyekera janye tAdera kRtakarma anuyAYI maryAdA raYeche, yena (ekathA pramANita haYa) AllAha tAdera karmera pUrNa pratiphala dena| tAdera prati avicAra karA have nA|

Ara yArA kuphuri kareche tAdera yedina jAhAnnAmera kAche upasthita karA have sedina valA have, teAmarA teAmAdera uttama sAmagrI pArthiva-jIvane apavyavahAra karecha evaM seguleA dvArA bheAga-vilAsa karecha| sutarAM Aja teAmAdera apamAnakara zAsti deoYA have; kAraNa, teAmarA anyAYabhAve ahaMkAra karate pRthivIte evaM teAmarA pApAcAra karate|

evaM smaraNa karo Ada-era bhAiYera kathA, tAra pUrve o pare aneka satarkakArI gata haYechila, se tAra AhakAphera (vAlukAmaYa ucca upatyakAYa) sampradAYake e marme satarka karechila ye, teAmarA AllAha vyatIta kArao ivAdata kareA nA| Ami teAmAdera janye eka mahAdivasera zAstira AzaGkA kari|
tArA valala, tumi ki AmAderake AmAdera upAsya deva-devI pherAte esecha? tumi satyavAdIdera antarbhukta hale tumi ye viSaYera pratizruti dAo, tA niYe Aso|
se valala, e jJAna teA kevala AllAhara nikaTai raYeche| Ami ye viSaYasaha prerita haYechi, kevala tA teAmAdera kAche pau~chAi; kintu Ami dekhachi tomarA emana eka sampradAYa, yArA mUrkhatA karacha|

ataHpara tArA yakhana tAke (zAsti o AjAvera) megharUpe tAdera upatyakA-abhimukhI dekhala, takhana valala, e teA megha, AmAdera vRSTi deve| (huda valala) Asale eTA sei vastu, yA teAmarA tAr3AtAr3i ceYechile| eTA jhar3o vAYu, ete raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
tAra ravera Adeze se savakichu dhvaMsa kare deve| ataHpara tArA bheAra velAYa emana haYe gela ye, tAdera vasatiguleA chAr3A kichui dRSTigeAcara halo nA| Ami aparAdhI sampradAYake ebhAvei zAsti dii|

Ami tAdera emana viSaYe kSamatA diYechilAma, ye viSaYe teAmAdera kSamatA diini| evaM Ami tAdera diYechilAma karNa, cakSu o hRdaYa, kintu tAdera karNa, cakSu o hRdaYa tAdera keAno kAje elo nA, yakhana tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karala evaM tAdera sei zAsti grAsa kare nilo yA niYe tArA ThATTA-vidrupa karata|
Ami teAmAdera AzapAzera janapadasamUha dhvaMsa kare diYechi evaM AmAra nidarzanAvalI vistAritabhAve varnanA karechi, yena tArA phire Ase|

ataHpara AllAhara parivarte tArA yAderake AllAhara sAnnidhyalAbhera janye upAsyarUpe grahaNa karechila, tArA tAdera sAhAyya karala nA kena? varaM tArA tAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe gela| eTA chila tAdera mithyA evaM yA tArA managar3A racanA karata|

yakhana Ami ekadala jvinake tomAra prati AkRSTa karechilAma, tArA kuraAna pATha zunachila| tArA yakhana kuraAna pAThera jAYagAYa upasthita halo, takhana tArA eke aparake valala, cupa thAko| ataHpara yakhana pATha samApta halo, takhana tArA tAdera sampradAYera kAche satarkakArIrUpe phire gela|

tArA valala, he AmAdera sampradAYa, AmarA emana eka kitAva zunechi, yA avatIrNa haYeche mUsAra pare, e kitAva pUrvavartI sava kitAvera pratyaYana kare; patha dekhAYa satyadharma o sarala-sudRr3ha pathera dike|
he AmAdera sampradAYa, teAmarA AllAhara dike AhvAnakArIra kathA mene nAo evaM tA~ra prati ImAna Ano| tini teAmAdera pApa mArjanA karavena evaM yantraNAdAYaka zAsti theke tomAdera rakSA karavena|

Ara ye vyakti AllAhara dike AhvAnakArIra kathA mAnave nA, se pRthivIte AllAhake apAraga karate sakSama naYa evaM AllAha vyatIta tAra keAno sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA| tArAi prakAzya pathabhraSTatAYa lipta|

tArA ki jAne nA ye, AllAha; yini AsamAna o yamina sRSTi karechena evaM eguleAra sRSTite keAno klAntiveAdha karenani, tini mRtake jIvita karate sakSama? kena naYa, nizcaYa tini sarvaviSaYe sarva zaktimAna|

yedina kAphiradera jAhAnnAmera sAmane peza karA have, sedina valA have, eTA ki satya naYa? tArA valave, hyA~, AmAdera ravera zapatha| AllAha valavena, zAsti AsvAdana karo| kAraNa, teAmarA kuphari karate|

ataeva, tumi dhairyadhAraNa karo, yemana dRr3hacetA rAsUlagaNa savara karechena evaM odera viSaYe tvarA karave nA| oderake ye viSaYe pratizruti deoYA haYeche, tA yedina tArA pratyakSa karave; sedina tAdera mane have dinera eka muhUrtera vezi tArA pRthivIte avasthAna kare ni| eTA suspaSTa ghoSaNA| (ekhana tArAi dhvaMsaprApta have) pApAcArI sampradAYa vyatIta kAuke dhvaMsa karA have ki|
yArA kuphari kare evaM AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi kare, tini tAdera sakala Amala vyartha kare dena|

Ara yArA ImAna Ane, satkarma kare evaM muhAmmAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche, tAra prati ImAna Ane, Ara tA tAdera ravera pakSa theke satya, tini tAdera manda karma kSamA karavena evaM saMzodhana karavena tAdera jIvana pravAha|

eTA e kAraNe ye, yArA kuphari kareche, tArA vAtilera anusaraNa kare evaM yArA ImAna Ane, tArA tAdera ravera pakSa theke Agata satyera anusaraNa kare| ebhAve AllAha mAnuSera janye tAdera dRSTAntasamUha varNanA karena|

ataHpara yakhana teAmarA tAdera mukhomukhi hao yArA kuphuri kareche takhana tAdera gardAne AghAta karo| avazeSe yakhana tomarA tAdera (anekake hatAhata kare) pUrNarUpe parAbhUta karave takhana tAdera zakta kare ve~dhe phelave| ataHpara haYa tAdera prati anugraha karo, nA haYa muktipaNa| teAmarA yuddha cAliYe yAve yatakSaNa nA yuddha (zatrupakSa) tAra astra samarpaNa karave; eTii vidhAna; Ara yadi AllAha icchA karena tAdera kAcha theke pratizeAdha nite pAratena; kintu tini teAmAdera katakake katakera dvArA parIkSA karate cAna| yArA AllAhara pathe zahida haYa, AllAha kakhanoi tAdera karma vinaSTa karena nA|
tini tAdera hidAYAta dAna karavena evaM tAdera avasthA saMzodhana karavena|
ataHpara tini tAdera jAnnAte praveza karAvena, yA tini tAdera jAniYe diYechena|
he mu’minagaNa, yadi teAmarA AllAhake sAhAyya karo, AllAha teAmAdera sAhAyya karavena evaM teAmAdera pA dRr3ha rAkhavena|
Ara yArA kuphari kareche, tAdera janye Ache durgati evaM tini tAdera karma vinaSTa karavena|
eTA ejanye ye, AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena tArA tA apachanda kare| ataeva AllAha tAdera karma vyartha kare devena|
tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kareni, ebhAve tArA dekheni, tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma kI haYeche? AllAha tAdera dhvaMsa kare diYechena| Ara kAphiradera janya Ache tAdera anurUpa|
eTA ejanye ye, AllAha mu’minadera abhibhAvaka evaM kAphiradera keAno abhibhAvaka nei|

yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare, AllAha tAdera emana jAnnAte praveza karAvena, yAra taladeze pravAhita nada-nadI| Ara yArA kAphira, tArA bheAga-vilAse matta thAke evaM AhAra kare yebhAve catuSpada janturA AhAra kare; Ara jAhAnnAmai tAdera vAsasthAna|
Ara tomAra janapada, ye janapada tomAke vahiSkAra kareche, tAra ceYe kata zaktizAlI janapadake Ami dhvaMsa karechi, takhana tAdera kono sAhAyyakArI chila nA|
