ye vyakti tAra ravera pakSa theke Agata nidarzana anusaraNa kare, se ki tAra mato, yAra kAche tAra manda kAja zeAbhanIYa karA haYeche evaM ye tAra pravRttira anusaraNa kare?

muttAkidera ye jAnnAtera pratizruti deoYA haYeche; tAte Ache nirmala pAnira nahara, dudhera nahara yAra svAda aparivartanIYa, pAnakArIdera janye susvAdu zarAvera nahara evaM parizeAdhita madhura nahara| sekhAne tAdera janye Ache rakamAri phalamUla evaM tAdera ravera kSamA| se ki tAdera mato, yArA jAhAnnAme anantakAla thAkave evaM yAdera pAna karate deoYA have phuTanta pAni; ataHpara tA tAdera nAr3ibhur3i chinna-vicchinna kare deve?

tAdera madhye kichu loka tomAra kathA zravaNa kare, ataHpara yakhana tomAra nikaTa theke vAire yAYa, takhana tArA yAdera jJAna dAna karA haYeche, tAderake vale eimAtra se kI valala? tAdera antare AllAha meAhara mere diYechena evaM tArA nijedera pravRttira anusaraNa kare|
yArA satpathaprApta haYeche, AllAha tAdera satpathe calA Arao vAr3iYe dena evaM tAderake tAkaoYA dAna karena|

tave ki tArA zudhu ei apekSAi karache ye, kiYAmata akasmAt tAdera kAche ese par3uka? vastuta kiYAmatera lakSaNasamUha teA esei par3eche| sutarAM kiYAmata ese par3ale tArA upadeza grahaNa karave kemana kare?

sutarAM jene rAkho, AllAha vyatIta keAno ilAha nei| Ara kSamAprArthanA karo tomAke pApa theke rakSA karAra janya evaM mu’mina nArI-puruSera janye| AllAha teAmAdera gatividhi o avasthAna samparke jJAta|

yArA ImAna eneche, tArA vale ekaTi sUrA avatIrNa haYa nA kena? ataHpara yakhana keAno dvyarthahIna sUrA avatIrNa haYa evaM tAte jihAdera kathA ullekha thAke, takhana yAdera antare reAga Ache, tumi tAdera mRtyubhaYe mUrchAprApta mAnuSera mato tomAra dike tAkiYe thAkate dekhave| sutarAM dhvaMsa tAdera janye|

tAdera Anugatya o nyAYasaGgata kathA valAi uttama chila| ataeva, yakhana dRr3ha siddhAnta halo; yadi tArA takhana AllAhake deoYA aGgIkAra satye pariNata karata, tave tA tAdera janya maGgalajanaka hato|
tave ki ei sambhAvanA raYeche ye, yadi tomArA kSamatA lAbha karo, tAhale teAmarA pRthivIte nairAjya sRSTi karave evaM tomAdera AtmIYatAra vandhana chinna karave|
edera pratii AllAha abhisampAta karena, ataHpara tAdera vadhira o dRSTizaktihIna kare dena|
tave ki tArA kuraAna samparke gabhIra cintA kare nA? nA ki tAdera antara tAlAvaddha?
nizcaYai yArA nijedera nikaTa hidAYAta spaSTa havAra para tA theke pichane phire yAYa, (arthAt dIna tyAga kare) zaYatAna tAdera kAjake zobhana kare dekhAYa evaM tAdera mithyA AzA deYa|
eTA ejanya ye, AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena tA yArA apachanda kare tArA vale, acirei AmarA kichu kichu kSetre teAmAdera kathA mAnya karava| AllAha tAdera geApana parAmarza samparke avagata Achena|
pherezatArA yakhana tAdera mukhamaNDala o pRSThadeze AghAta karate karate prANa haraNa karave, takhana tAdera avasthA kemana have?
eTA ejanye ye, tArA sei viSaYera anusaraNa kare, yA AllAhara asanteASa sRSTi kare evaM AllAhara santuSTike tArA apachanda kare| phale tini tAdera karmasamUha vyartha kare dena|
yAdera antare reAga Ache, tArA ki mane kare ye, AllAha tAdera antarera vidveSa prakAza kare devena nA?

Ara Ami yadi icchA karatAma tomAke tAderake dekhiYe ditAma, takhana tumi tAdera lakSaNa dekhe tAdera cinate pArate evaM tumi avazyai kathAra bhaGgite tAdera cinate pArave| AllAha teAmAdera karmasamUhera vyApAre jJAna rAkhena|
evaM Ami avazyai teAmAdera parIkSA karava yatakSaNa nA Ami jene nii teAmAdera madhye mujAhida evaM dhairyazIladera evaM yatakSaNa nA Ami teAmAdera avasthAnasamUha yAcAi kari|

nizcaYa yArA kuphari kare evaM AllAhara patha theke mAnuSake phiriYe rAkhe evaM nijedera nikaTa satpatha spaSTa haoYAra para rAsUlera vireAdhitA kare, tArA AllAhara keAnoi kSati karate pArave nA evaM acirei tini vyartha kare devena tAdera karmasamUha|
he mu’minagaNa, teAmarA AllAhara Anugatya karo, rAsUlera Anugatya karo evaM tomAdera Amalagulo vinaSTa kareA nA|
nizcaYai yArA kuphari kare evaM AllAhara patha theke mAnuSake phiriYe rAkhe, ataHpara kAphira avasthAYa mArA yAYa, AllAha kakhanoi tAdera kSamA karavena nA|
ataeva, teAmarA hInavala haYe sandhira prastAva karo nA, teAmarAi have pravala| AllAha teAmAdera sAthe Achena| tini kakhanoo teAmAdera karma hrAsa karavena nA|
pArthiva jIvanaTA kevala khelAdhulA, yadi teAmarA ImAnadAra hao evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karo, AllAha teAmAderake teAmAdera pratidAna devena evaM tini teAmAdera dhanasampada cAna nA|
tini teAmAdera kAche tA cAile o teAmAderake cApa dile, teAmarA kArpaNya karate evaM tini teAmAdera manera saMkIrNatA prakAza karatena|

zono, teAmarAi teA tArA, yAdera AhvAna jAnAneA hacche, tomarA AllAhara pathe vyaYa karo| ataHpara teAmAdera keu keu kRpaNatA karache| yArA kRpaNatA karache, tArA nijedera viruddhei kRpaNatA karache| AllAha amukhApekSI evaM teAmarAi mukhApekSI| yadi teAmarA mukha phiriYe nAo, tave tini teAmAdera parivarte anya jAtike pratiSThita karavena, takhana tArA teAmAdera mato have nA|
nizcaYai Ami tomAke diYechi eka suspaSTa vijaYa|
yena AllAha tomAra atIta o bhaviSyat truTisamUha kSamA karena, tomAra prati tA~ra niYAmata pUrNa karena, evaM tomAke paricAlita karena sarala pathe|
Ara AllAh tomAke dAna karena valiSTha sAhAyya|
tini mu’minadera antare prazAnti nAyila karena, yena tArA tAdera ImAnera sAthe Arao ImAna vRddhi kare neYa| AsamAna o yaminera vAhinIsamUha AllAharai evaM AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa

yena tini mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina nArIdera jAnnAte praveza karAna, yAra taladeze pravAhita haYa nada-nadI, sethAYa tArA sthAYI, Ara yena tini tAdera pApa meAcana karena| eTAi AllAhara dRSTite mahAsAphalya,

evaM yena tini munAphika puruSa o nArI evaM muzarika puruSa o nArIderake zAsti dena, yArA AllAha samparke manda dhAraNA peASaNa kare; tAdera janya raYeche manda cakra| AllAha tAdera prati kruddha haYechena, tAderake abhizapta karechena| evaM tAdera janye prastuta rekhechena jAhAnnAma| evaM katai nA nikRSTa tAdera pratyAvartana-sthala|
AsamAna o yaminera vAhinIsamUha AllAharai| AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
nizcaYa Ami tomAke pAThiYechi sAkSI, susaMvAdadAtA o bhItipradarzanakArIrUpe|
yena teAmarA AllAha o rAsUlera prati ImAna Ano evaM tAke sAhAyya o sammAna karo evaM sakAla-sandhyAYa AllAhara pavitratA gheASaNA karo|

nizcaYa yArA tomAra kAche Anugatyera zapatha kare, tArA teA AllAhara kAche Anugatyera zapatha kare| AllAhara hAta tAdera hAtera opara raYeche| Ara ye zapatha bhaGga kare; se tA nijera kSatira janyei kare| ye AllAhara sAthe kRta aGgIkAra pUrNa kare; tini satvarai tAke mahApuraskAra dAna karavena|

maruvAsIdera madhye yArA pechane raYeche, tArA tomAke valave, AmAdera vyasta rekheche AmAdera dhana-sampada o parivAra-parijana; ataeva, AmAdera janya kSamAprArthanA karuna| tArA mukhe emana kathA valave, yA tAdera antare nei| valo, AllAha teAmAdera kSati athavA upakAra sAdhanera icchA karale ke tAke virata rAkhate pAre? vastuta teAmarA yA karo, AllAha se viSaYa samyaka jJAta|*

varaM teAmarA to dhAraNA karechile, rAsUla o mu’minarA tAdera parivAra-parijanera nikaTa kakhanoi phire Asate pArave nA evaM ei dhAraNA teAmAdera antare suzobhita kare deoYA haYechila| teAmarA manda dhAraNA karechile| teAmarA chile dhvaMsamukhI eka sampradAYa|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ane nA, Ami sesava kAphirera janye jvalanta Aguna prastuta rekhechi|
AsamAna o yaminera rAjatva AllAharai| tini yAke icchA kSamA karena evaM yAke icchA zAsti dena| tini kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

teAmarA yakhana yuddhalavdha dhana-sampada saMgrahera janya yAve, takhana pechane theke yAoYA vyaktirA valave, AmAderao teAmAdera saGge yete dAo| tArA AllAhara nirdeza parivartana karate cAYa| valo, ‘teAmarA kakhanoo AmAdera saGge yete pArave nA; tomAdera vyapAre pUravei emana vale diYechena AllAha| tArA Avazyai valave; varaM teAmarA AmAdera prati vidveSa peASaNa karacha| vastuta, tArA sAmAnyai anudhAvana kare|

pechane par3e thAkA maruvAsIdera vale dena—acirei tomAdera DAkA have eka pravala parAkrAnta sampradAYera uddeze, teAmarA tAdera sAthe yuddha karave, yatakSaNa nA tArA AtmasamarpaNa karave| takhana yadi teAmarA Anugatya karo, tave AllAha teAmAdera uttama puraskAra devena| Ara yadi pRSThapradarzana karo yemana itopUrve pRSThapradarzana karecha, tave tini teAmAdera yantraNAdAYaka zAsti devena|

andhera janye, paGgura janye o rugnera janye keAno aparAdha nei evaM ye keu AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karave, tAke tini jAnnAte praveza karAvena, yAra taladeze pravAhita haYa nada-nadI| pakSAntare ye vyakti pRSThapradarzana karave, tAke tini yantraNAdAYaka zAsti devena|

AllAha mu’minadera prati santuSTa halena, yakhana tArA gAchera nice tomAra kAche Anugatyera zapatha karala| tini avagata chilena yA tAdera antare chila| ataHpara tini tAdera prati prazAnti nAyila karalena evaM tAdera Asanna vijaYa puraskAra dilena|
evaM vipula parimANe yuddhalavdha sampada, yA tArA grahaNa karave AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha teAmAdera vipula parimANa yuddhalavdha sampadera pratizruti diYechena, yA teAmarA lAbha karave| tini tA teAmAdera janye tvarAnvita karechena| tini teAmAdera theke zatrudera hAta virata rekhechena, yena (tomarA kRtajJa hao, evaM) eTA mu’minadera janye eka nidarzana haYa evaM tini teAmAdera sarala pathe paricAlita karena|
Arao aneka sampada raYeche, yA ekhano teAmAdera adhikAre Aseni, AllAha tA veSTana kare Achena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarva zaktimAna|
yArA kuphuri kareche tArA yadi teAmAdera meAkAvelA karata, tave avazyai tArA pRSThapradarzana karata| takhana tArA keAno abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI peta nA|
eTAi AllAhara rIti, yA pUrva theke cAlu Ache| tumi AllAhara rItite keAno parivartana pAve nA|
tini (makkA zahare) tAdera hAta teAmAdera theke evaM teAmAdera hAta tAdera theke nivArita rekhechena, tAdera opara teAmAdera vijaYI karAra para| teAmarA yA kichu karo, AllAha tAra sarvadraSTA|

tArAi teA kuphuri kareche evaM vAdhA diYeche teAmAdera mAsajide hArAma theke evaM hAdIra janya Avaddha jantudera yathAsthAne pau~chate| yadi nA thAkata, mAkkAYa (kAphiradera mAjhe) kichusaMkhyaka mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina nArI yAdera teAmarA jAnate nA; sekSetre tAdera tomarA padadalita kare phelate, ataHpara tAdera kAraNe teAmarA ajJAtasAre kSatigrasta hate, (ejanya mAkkA vijaYakAle sarAsari yuddhera anuzarta deoYA haYanAi, yehetu) AllAha yAke icchA tA~ra rahamate praveza karAna| (kintu) yadi tArA (muminarA) pRthaka hato, tave Ami avazyai tAdera madhye yArA kAphira tAdera yantraNAdAYaka zAsti ditAma|

yArA kuphuri kareche tArA yakhana tAdera antare mUrkhatAyugera ahamikA pradarzana karala takhana AllAha tA~ra rAsUla o mu’minadera opara tA~ra prazAnti nAyila karalena evaM tAdera janya saMyama a tAkaoYAra dAYitva aparihArya kare dilena| vastuta tArAi chila era adhikatara yeAgya o upayukta| AllAha sarvaviSaYe samyaka jJAta|

nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra rAsUlera svapnake saThikabhAve satye pariNata karechena| AllAha cAhena teA teAmarA avazyai mAsajide hArAme praveza karave nirApade keu mAthA muNDita evaM keu keza kartita avasthAYa, teAmarA kAuke bhaYa karave nA| ataHpara tini jAnena yA teAmarA jAno nA| echAr3Ao tini diYechena teAmAdera ekaTi Asanna vijaYa|
tinii tA~ra rAsUlake hidAYAta o satya dharmasaha preraNa karechena, yena eke anya samasta dharmera opara jaYayukta karena Ara sAkSI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|

muhAmmada AllAhara rAsUla; evaM tAra sahacaragaNa kAphiradera prati kaTheAra, nijedera madhye paraspare sahAnubhUtizIla| AllAhara anugraha o santuSTi kAmanAYa tumi tAdera ruku o sejadAYa avanata dekhave| tAdera vaiziSTya tAdera mukhamaNDale prasphuTita have sejadAra cihna| tAorAte tAdera upamA emana evaM iJjile tAdera upamA yemana; ekaTi cArAgAcha, yA tAra aGkura nirgata kare, ataHpara (jami theke rasa niYe) tAke zakta o majavuta kare evaM kANDera opara dA~r3AYa dRr3habhAve, yA cASIke Anande abhibhUta kare, (ebhAve tini muminadera samRddhi dAna karena) yena AllAha tAdera dvArA kAphiradera antarjAlA sRSTi karena| tAdera madhye yArA ImAna AnAYana kare evaM satkarma kare, AllAha tAdera kSamA o mahApuraskArera pratizruti diYechena|
he ImAnadAragaNa, teAmarA (kono viSaYe) AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera sAmane agraNI haYeA nA evaM AllAhake bhaYa karo| nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA o sarvajJa|

mu’minagaNa, teAmarA navIra kaNThasvarera opara teAmAdera kaNThasvara u~cu kareA nA evaM teAmarA eke aparera sAthe yerUpa u~cusvare kathA valo, tA~ra sAthe serUpa u~cusvare valeA nA kathA valAra samaYa, tAte teAmAdera karma niSphala haYe yAve athaca teAmarA tA Terao pAve nA|
yArA AllAhara rAsUlera sAmane nijedera kaNThasvara nicu kare, AllAha tAdera antarake tAkaoYAra janya yAcAi karechena; tAdera janye raYeche kSamA o mahApuraskAra|
nizcaYa yArA hujarAra vAire theke tomAke u~cusvare DAke, tAdera adhikAMzai vodha rAkhe nA|
tumi vera haYe tAdera nikaTa AsA paryanta yadi tArA apekSA karata, tA hato tAdera janya uttama| AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

yArA ImAna enecha, yadi keAno phAsika vyakti teAmAdera kAche keAno saMvAda AnaYana kare, tave teAmarA parIkSA kare dekhave, yena ajJatAvazata teAmarA keAno sampradAYera kSatisAdhana kare nA vasa evaM pare tomarA yA karecha tAra janye anutapta nA hate haYa|

teAmarA jene rAkho teAmAdera madhye AllAhara rAsUla raYechena| tini yadi adhikAMza viSaYe teAmAdera kathA zunatena, tave teAmarAi kaSTera madhye par3ate| kintu AllAha teAmAdera kAche ImAnake bhAlovAsAra vastu vAniYechena, evaM tA tomAdera hRdaYera madhye sajjita karechena Ara kuphara, pApAcAra o avAdhyatAra prati ghRNA sRSTi kare diYechena| tArAi satpatha avalamvanakArI,
eTA AllAhara kRpA o dAna; Ara AllAha sarvajJa prajJAmaYa|

yadi mu’minadera dui dala yuddhe lipta haYe par3e, tave teAmarA tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare deve| ataHpara yadi tAdera ekadala apara dalera viruddhe sImAlaGghana kare (AkramaNa kare) tave teAmarA AkramaNakArI dalera viruddhe yuddha karave; yatakSaNa nA tArA AllAhara nirdezera dike phire Ase| yadi phire Ase, tave teAmarA tAdera madhye nyAYapanthAYa mImAMsA kare deve evaM inasApha karave; nizcaYa AllAha inasAphakArIdera pachanda karena|
nizcaYa mu’minarA hacche paraspara bhAi-bhAi| ataeva, teAmarA teAmAdera dui bhAiYera madhye mImAMsA karo evaM AllAhake bhaYa karo tAhale teAmarA anugrahaprApta have|

yArA ImAna enecha, tomAdera ekadala yena apara dalake upahAsa nA kare| hate pAre yAdera upahAsa karA hacche tArA upahAsakArIdera apekSA uttama evaM keAno nArI yena apara nArIkeo upahAsa nA kare| kenanA yAke upahAsa karA hacche, se upahAsakAriNI apekSA zreSTha hate pAre| teAmarA eke aparera prati deASAreApa kareA nA evaM eke aparake manda nAme DekeA nA| ImAnera para manda nAme DAkA katai nA khArApa| yArA tAovA karave nA, tArAi halo sImAlaGghanakArI|

he yArA ImAna enecha, teAmarA adhikAMza dhAraNA ve~ce thAko| nizcaYa kichu dhAraNA pApa| Ara tomarA keu kArao geApanIYa viSaYa sandhAna kareA nA| teAmAdera keu yena kArao pazcAte nindA nA kare| teAmAdera keu ki tAra mRta bhAiYera mAMsa bhakSaNa karA pachanda karave? vastuta teAmarA teA eke ghRNAi karo| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo| nizcaYa AllAha taovA kavulakArI, asIma daYAlu|

he mAnavajAti, Ami teAmAdera eka puruSa o eka nArI theke sRSTi karechi evaM teAmAdera vibhinna jAti o geAtre vibhakta karechi, yena teAmarA parasparake cinate pAro| nizcaYa AllAhara kAche se-i sarvAdhika sammAnita, ye sarvAdhika muttAki| nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa, samyaka avahita|

grAmya veduinarA vale, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’; valo, teAmarA ImAna Anoni; varaM valo, AmarA AtmasamarpaNa karechi; ekhano teAmAdera antare ImAna praveza kareni| yadi teAmarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karo, tave teAmAdera karma(phala) vindumAtrao kama karavena nA| nizcaYa, AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
prakRta pakSe tArAi mu’mina, yArA AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna AnAra para sandeha peASaNa kare nA evaM AllAhara pathe dhana-sampada o jIvana dvArA jihAda kare; tArAi satyaniSTha|
valo, ‘teAmarA ki teAmAdera dvIna samparke AllAhake avahita karacha? athaca AllAha jAnena, yA kichu Ache AsamAne evaM yA kichu Ache yamine| AllAha sarvaviSaYe samyaka jJAta|

tArA isalAma grahaNa kare mane kare, tArA tomAra prati anugraha kareche| valo, ‘teAmAdera isalAma grahaNa AmAra prati anugraha bhevo nA; varaM AllAhai ImAnera pathe paricAlita kare teAmAdera prati anugraha karechena, yadi teAmarA satyaniSTha haYe thAko|
nizcaYa AllAha AsamAna o yaminera adRzya viSaYa jAnena, tomarA yA karo AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|
kapha, sammAnita kuraAnera zapatha; (tumi avazyai satarkakArI)
kintu tAdera kAche tAderai madhya theke ekajana bhItipradarzanakArI AsAra kAraNe tArA vismaYaveAdha kareche| Ara kAphirarA vale, eTA Azcaryera vyApAra|
AmarA mare gele evaM mATite pariNata haYe geleo ki punarutthita havo? sudUraparAhata sei pratyAvartana|
mATi tAdera kataTuku kSaYa kare tA AmAra jAnA Ache evaM AmAra kAche Ache saMrakSaNakArI kitAva|
varaM tAdera kAche satya AsAra para tArA tAke mithyA sAvyasta kareche; phale tArA e viSaYa niYe saMzaYe dodulyamAna|
tArA ki tAdera uparera AkAza dekhe nA, Ami kIbhAve tA nirmANa karechi evaM suzeAbhita karechi? tAte keAno chidra/phATala nei|
Ara Ami bhUmike vistRta karechi, tAte parvatamAlA sthApana karechi evaM tAte udagata karechi sarvaprakAra naYanAbhirAma udbhida|
eTA antardRSTi o upadeza, pratyeka anurAgI vAndAra janye|
Ami AkAza theke kalyANamaYa vRSTi varSaNa kari evaM tA dvArA udagata kari udyAna o zasya yeguleAra phasala AharaNa karA haYa|
evaM lamvA lamvA khejura gAcha, tAte Ache guccha guccha khejura,
vAndAdera jIvikA evaM tA (vRSTi) dvArA Ami mRta janapadake saJjIvita kari| ebhAve punarutthAna ghaTave|
tAdera pUrveo mithyA pratipanna kareche nUhera sampradAYa, rAs evaM sAmUda sampradAYa|
Ada, phiraAuna o lUtera sampradAYa,
AikAra adhivAsI evaM tuvvA sampradAYa| tArA pratyekei rAsUlagaNake mithyA pratipanna kareche, phale AmAra zAsti avadhArita haYeche|
Ami ki prathamavAra sRSTi karei klAnta haYe par3echi? varaM tArA natuna sRSTira vyApAre sandeha peASaNa kareche|
Ami mAnuSa sRSTi karechi evaM tAra nAphasa tAke ye kumantraNA deYa se samvandheo Ami avagata Achi| Ami tAra ghAr3era dhamani thekeo adhika nikaTavartI|
yakhana dui grahaNakArI pherezatA DAne o vAme vase tAra Amala grahaNa kare (lipivdadha kare)|
se yekono kathAi uccAraNa kare, tA-i grahaNa karAra janye tAra kAche sadA prastuta praharI raYeche|
Ara mRtyuyantraNA nizcaYai Asave| eTA sei viSaYa, yA hate tomarA avyAhati ceYe Asacha|
evaM ziGgAYa phu~tkAra deoYA have| eTA oi dina yAra bhIti pradarzana karA haYa|
pratyeka vyakti Agamana karave; tAra sAthe thAkave cAlaka o sAkSI|
tumi teA ei dina samparke udAsIna chile| ekhana teAmAra kAcha theke AvaraNa sariYe diYechi| phale Aja teAmAra dRSTi prakhara|
tAra saGgI (pherezatA) valave, AmAra kAche ye (AmalanAmA) prastuta chila, tA ei|
nirdeza deoYA have pratyeka akRtajJa avAdhyake jAhAnnAme nikSepa karo, nikSepa karo|
erA maGgalajanaka kAje pravala vAdhAdAnakArI, sImAlaGghanakArI, sandeha peASaNakArI|
ye vyakti AllAhara sAthe anya ilAha grahaNa karata, tAke teAmarA kaThina zAstite nikSepa karo, nikSepa karo|
valave, tAra saGgI (zaYatAna), he AmAdera rava, Ami tAke avAdhyatAYa lipta karini| vastuta, se nijei chila cUr3Anta bhrAntite lipta|
tini (AllAha) valavena, AmAra sAmane vitarka kareA nA, Ami teA pUrvei teAmAdera zAsti dvArA bhaYa pradarzana karechi|
AmAra kAche kathA parivartana haYa nA evaM Ami vAndAdera prati kono avicAra kari nA|
sedina Ami jAhAnnAmake jijJAsA karava; tumi ki pUrNa haYe gecha? se valave, Arao Ache ki?
jAnnAtake upasthita karA have muttAkidera anati dUre|
(valA have) teAmAdera pratyeka anurAgI o hephAjatakArIke erai pratizruti deoYA haYechila|
ye nA dekhe daYAmaYa AllAhake bhaYa kare evaM vinIta antare upasthita haYa|
teAmarA tAte zAntite praveza karo| eTAi anantakAla vasavAsera dina|
tArA sekhAne yA cAive, tAi pAve evaM AmAra kAche raYeche Arao adhika|
Ami tAdera pUrve kata sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechi, tArA chila tAdera ceYe adhika zaktizAlI evaM deze-videze tArA vicaraNa kare phirata| (dhvaMsa karAra samaYa) tAdera keAno palAYana-sthAna chila ki?
tAte upadeza raYeche tAra janye, yAra anudhAvana karAra mato antara raYeche| athavA ye niviSTa mane zravaNa kare evaM se haYa sAkSI|
Ami AsamAna, yamina o ubhaYera madhyavartI savakichu chaYadine sRSTi karechi, AmAke keAno klAnti sparza kareni|
tAdera kathAra viparIte tumi savara karo evaM sUryeAdaYa o sUryAstera pUrve tomAra ravera saprazaMsa pavitratA gheASaNA karo|
rAtera kichu aMze tA~ra pavitratA gheASaNA karo evaM sAlAtera pareo|
zono, ye dina eka AhavAnakArI nikaTavartI sthAna theke AhavAna karave|
yedina mAnuSa nizcita sei bhaYAvaha AoYAja zunate pAve, sedinai punaratthAna divasa|
Amii jIvana dAna kari, mRtyu ghaTAi evaM AmArai dike sakalera pratyAvartana|
yedina mATi vidIrNa haYe mAnuSa druta vera haYe Asave| Ara ei samavetakaraNa AmAra janya sahaja|
tArA yA vale Ami tA samyaka avagata Achi| tumi tAdera opara zakti praYogakArI nao| ataeva, ye AmAra zAstike bhaYa kare, tAke kuraAnera mAdhyame upadeza dAna karo|
zapatha jhaJjhAvAYura|
zapatha veAjhA vahanakArI meghera|
zapatha svacchandagatira jalayAnera,
zapatha karma vaNTanakArIdera (pherezatAgaNera),
nizcaYai teAmAdera pradatta pratizruti avazyai satya|
vicAra divasa avazyambhAvI|
zapatha nAnA pathaviziSTa AkAzera,
nizcaYa teAmarA teA vireAdhapUrNa kathAYa lipta,
ye bhraSTa, sei tA (arthAt kiYAmata divasera vizvAsa) theke vicyuta haYa|
dhvaMsa heAka anumAnakArIrA,
yArA tAdera bhrAntite udAsIna haYe Ache|
tArA jijJAsA kare, kiYAmata kave have?
(valo) yedina tArA Agune patita have,
(valA have) teAmarA teAmAdera zAsti AsvAdana karo| teAmarA ekei tvarAnvita karate ceYechile|
nizcaYa muttAkirA jAnnAte o prasravaNe thAkave|
e-avasthAYa ye, tArA upabhoga karave yA tAdera rava tAdera devena| nizcaYa itaHpUrve tArA chila satkarmaparAYaNa|
tArA rAtera sAmAnya aMzei nidrA yeta,
rAtera zeSa prahare tArA kSamAprArthanA karata,
evaM tAdera dhana-sampade abhAvagrasta o vaJcitera haka raYeche|
nizcita-vizvAsIdera janye dharaNite nidarzanAvali raYeche,
evaM teAmAdera nijedera madhyeo, teAmarA ki anudhAvana karave nA?
AkAze raYeche teAmAdera riyika o pratizruta savakichu|
AsamAna o yaminera ravera zapatha! Avazyai e sakalai teAmAdera kathAvArtAra matoi satya|
tomAra nikaTa ivarAhImera sammAnita mehamAnadera vRttAnta eseche ki?
yakhana tArA tAra kAche upasthita haYe valala, ‘sAlAma, takhana se valala, ‘sAlAma’; erA teA aparicita leAka|
ataHpara se tAra parivArera nikaTa gela evaM ekaTi moTA-tAjA (bhUnA) vAchura niYe hAyira halo|
se (bhunA) vAchuraTike tAdera sAmane rekhe valala, teAmarA khAccha nA kena?
ataHpara tAdera samparke se mane mane bhIta halo, tArA valala; bhIta havena nA| evaM tArA tAke eka jJAnI putra santAnera susaMvAda dila|
ataHpara tAra strI phariYAdi bhaGgite sAmane ese, mukhe mRdu AghAta kare valala, Ami teA vRddhA, vandhyA|
tArA valala, teAmAra rava emanai valechena| nizcaYa tini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
se valala, ‘he prerita pherezatAgaNa, teAmAdera uddezya kI?
tArA valala, ‘AmarA eka aparAdhI sampradAYera prati prerita haYechi,
yena tAdera upara kAlomATi dvArA vAnAno pAthara nikSepa kari,
yA tomAra ravera nikaTa theke avAdhyadera janya cihnita|
ataHpara sekhAne yArA mu’mina chila, Ami tAdera uddhAra karalAma|
tave sekhAne ekaTi ghara vyatIta keAno musalima Ami pAini|
yArA yantraNAdAYaka zAstike bhaYa kare, Ami tAdera janya sekhAne ekaTi nidarzana rekhechi|
evaM (nidarzana raYeche) mUsAra vRttAnte; yakhana Ami tAke suspaSTa pramANasaha phiraAunera kAche pAThiYechilAma|
ataHpara se tAra sabhAsadasaha mukha phiriYe nila evaM valala, se haYa yAdukara, nA haYa pAgala|
ataHpara Ami tAke evaM tAra senAvAhinIke pAkar3Ao karalAma evaM tAderake samudre nikSepa karalAma| Ara se tiraskArayogya|
evaM (nidarzana raYeche) A’dera kAhinite; yakhana Ami tAdera upara pAThiYechilAma azubha vAtAsa|
ei vAtAsa—yAra upara diYe pravAhita haYechila, tAke chAr3eni; cUrNavicUrNa kare diYechila|
Arao (nidarzana raYeche). sAmUdera ghaTanAYa; yakhana tAdera valA haYechila, kichukAla upabhoga kare nAo|
ataHpara tArA tAdera ravera Adeza samparke auddhatya prakAza karala, phale vajrAghAta tAdera pAkar3Ao karala; e avasthAYa ye, tArA tA dekhachila|
ataHpara tArA dA~r3Ateo sakSama halo nA evaM tArA pratirodha karateo sakSama chila nA|
Ami itaHpUrve nUhera sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechi, nizcaYai tArA chila pApAcArI sampradAYa|
Ami AkAza nirmANa karechi AmAra zaktite evaM nizcaYa Ami mahAsamprasAraNakArI|
Ara bhUmike Ami vichiYechi| Ami katai-nA sundarabhAve vichAte sakSama|
Ara Ami pratyeka vastu jeAr3AYa jeAr3AYa sRSTi karechi, yena teAmarA upadeza grahaNa karo|
ataeva, tomarA AllAhara dike dhAvita hao| Ami tA~ra tarapha theke teAmAdera janya suspaSTa satarkakArI|
teAmarA AllAhara sAthe anya keAno ilAha sAvyasta kareA nA| Ami tA~ra pakSa theke teAmAdera janya suspaSTa satarkakArI|
ebhAve tAdera pUrvavartIdera kAche yakhanai keAno rAsUla eseche, tArA valeche, jAdukara, nA haYa ummAda|
tArA ki eke aparake e viSaYe mantraNAi diYe geche? vastuta orA avAdhya sampradAYa|
ataeva, tumi odera theke mukha phiriYe nAo| tAte tumi aparAdhI have nA|
evaM upadeza dite thAko; kenanA, upadeza mu’minadera upakAre Asave|
Ami sRSTi karechi mAnava o jina jAti; AmArai ivAdAta karAra janya|
Ami tAdera kAche jIvikA cAi nA evaM eTAo cAi nA ye, tArA AmAke AhAra deve|
AllAhai jIvikAdAtA, zaktira AdhAra, parAkrAnta|
ataeva, yArA sImAlaGghana kareche, tAdera janya raYeche gunAhera prApya zAsti, yemana tAdera sahacaradera gunAhera prApya zAsti chila| kAjei tArA yena AmAra kAche tA druta nA cAYa|
ataeva, kAphiradera janya durbheAga sei dinera, yedinera pratizruti tAdera deoYA haYeche|
zapatha tUra parvatera,
zapatha likhita kitAvera,
prazasta patre,
zapatha vAYatula-mAmura-era
zapatha samunnata chAdera, (arthAt AkAzera)
zapatha uttAla samudrera,
tomAra ravera zAsti avazyambhAvI,
tAra pratireAdhakArI keu nei,
sedina AkAza Andolita have pravalabhAve,
evaM parvatamAlA have druta calamAna,
sedina mithyAreApakArIdera janya durbheAga|
yArA anarthaka kathAra khelAYa matta raYeche|
sedina tAderake jAhAnnAmera Agunera dike dhAkkA mArate mArate niYe yAoYA have,
valA have, ei sei Aguna, yAke teAmarA mithyA mane karate,
eTA ki yAdu? nA teAmarA dekhate pAo nA?
tAte praveza karo, ataHpara teAmarA savara karo vA nA karo, ubhaYai teAmAdera janya samAna| teAmarA ye A’mala karate, teAmAdera kevala tArai pratiphala deoYA have|
nizcaYa muttAkirA thAkave jAnnAte o niYAmate|
tArA upabheAga karave, yA tAdera rava tAdera devena evaM jAhAnnAmera zAsti theke tAdera rava tAdera rakSA karavena|
tAderake valA have, teAmarA yA karate tAra pratiphala-hisAva teAmarA tRptibhare pAnAhAra karo|
tArA zreNivaddha siMhAsane helAna diYe vasave| Ami tAdera milana ghaTAva sunaYanA huradera saGge|

evaM yArA ImAna Ane evaM tAdera santAnerA ImAna sahakAre tAdera anugAmI haYa, Ami tAdera saGge milita karava tAdera santAnasantatike evaM Ami tAdera Amala theke kono kichui hrAsa karava nA; pratyeka vyakti nija arjanera janya nijei dAYavaddha|
Ami tAdera devo phalamUla evaM gozata yA tArA cAive|
sekhAne tArA eke aparake pAnapAtra deve; (era daruna) sekhAne kono anarthaka kathA valA have nA o pApakAja saMghaTita have nA|
surakSita muktAsadRza kizeArarA tAdera sevAYa ghorApherA karave|
tArA eke aparera mukhomukhI haYe jijJAsAvAda karave|
tArA valave, ‘pUrve AmarA nijedera parivAra-parijanera mAjhe thAkAkAle (jAhAnnAmera bhaYe) bhIta-kampita chilAma|
ataHpara AllAha AmAdera prati anugraha karechena evaM AmAdera Agunera zAsti theke rakSA karechena|
AmarA pUrveo tAke DAkatAma| tinii to kalyANamaYa, asIma daYAlu|
ataeva, tumi upadeza dAo| tomAra ravera kRpAYa tumi gaNakao nao o unmAda nao|
tArA ki vale, ‘se ekajana kavi, AmarA tAra mRtyu-durghaTanAra pratIkSA karachi ’ |
valo, teAmarA pratIkSA karo, Amio teAmAdera sAthe pratIkSAratadera antarbhukta Achi|

vahusaMkhyaka have pUrvavartIdera madhya theke|
evaM alpasaMkhyaka have paravartIdera madhya theke,
svarNakhacita siMhAsane,
tArA tAte helAna diYe vasave paraspara mukheAmukhi haYe|
tAdera kAche gheArApherA karave cira kizeArerA|
pAnapAtra, ku~jA o prasravaNa niHsRta surApUrNa peYAlA niYe,
yA pAna karale tAdera mAthAvyathA have nA evaM tArA vikAragrastao have nA|
Ara tAdera pachandamata phala-mUla niYe,
evaM pAkhira gozata niYe, yA tArA cAive|
evaM sundara cakSudhArI huragaNa,
upamAYa yena tArA surakSita muktA,
(esava niYAmata) tArA yA-kichu karata, tAra puraskArasvarUpa|
tArA sekhAne avAntara o pApakathA zunave nA|
‘sAlAma’ Ara ‘sAlAma’ vANI chAr3A|
Ara DAnapanthIrA, kata bhAgyavAna DAnapanthI lokerA!
tArA thAkave kA~TAvihIna kulagAche|
evaM kA~di kA~di sAjAno kalAgAche,
Ara samprasArita chAYAYa|
evaM sadA pravahamAna pAnite,
o pracura phala-mUle,
yA zeSa havAra naYa evaM niSiddhao naYa,
Ara thAkave samunnata zayyA|
nizcaYai Ami tAdera (rUpe) vizeSarUpe sRSTi karechi|
ataHpara tAdera karechi kumArI|
kAminI, samavaYaskA|
DAnapanthIdera janya|
tAdera aneke have pUrvavartIdera madhya theke|
evaM aneke have paravartIdera madhya theke|
Ara vAmapanthI leAka, kata nA hatabhAgA vAmapanthIrA!
tArA thAkave garama vAtAsa evaM uttapta pAnite,
evaM kAlo dho~YAra chAYAYa|
yA zItalao naYa evaM ArAmadAYakao naYa|
tArA itopUrve bhoga-vilAse chila|
tArA gheAratara pApakAje Duve thAkata|
Ara tArA valata, ‘AmarA yakhana mare hADDi o mATite pariNata haYe yAva, takhano ki punarutthita hava?
AmAdera pUrvavartI pitRpuruSagaNao?
valo, pUrvavartI o paravartIgaNa,
savAi ekatrita have eka nirdhArita dinera nirdiSTa samaYe|
ataHpara nizcaYai he pathabhraSTa mithyAreApakArIrA,
teAmarA avazyai yAkkuma gAcha theke khAve,
ataHpara tA dvArA peTa bharti karave,
ataHpara tAra upara pAna karave uttapta pAni|
Ara pAna karave tRSNArta uTera mato|
kiYAmAtera dina eTAi have tAdera ApyAYana|
Amii teAmAdera sRSTi karechi| ataHpara kena teAmarA tA satya vale vizvAsa karo nA?
teAmarA ki bheve dekhecha, teAmarA ye vIryapAta karacha, se samparke?
tA ki teAmarA sRSTi karo, nA Amii tAra sraSTA?
Ami teAmAdera janya mRtyu nirdhArita karechi evaM Ami akSama nai,
e vyApAre ye, teAmAdera parivarte teAmAdera sadRza Anate evaM teAmAdera emana kare sRSTi karate—yA teAmarA jAno nA|
Ara teAmarA to avagata haYecha prathama sRSTi samparke, tave kena teAmarA upadeza grahaNa karo nA?
teAmarA ye vIja vapana karo, se samparke bheve dekhecha ki?
teAmarA tAke aGkurita karo, nA Ami aGkurita kari?
Ami icchA karale tAke khar3akuTA kare dite pAri, ataHpara tomarA haYe yAve vismaYAviSTa|
(valave,) AmarA teA dAYagrasta (kSatigrasta) haYe gelAma;
varaM AmarA vaJcita haYe gelAma|
teAmarA ye pAni pAna karo, se samparke bheve dekhecha ki?
teAmarA tA megha theke nAmiYe Ano, nA Ami varSaNakArI?
Ami icchA karale tAke leAnA kare dite pAri, tavuo teAmarA kena kRtajJatA prakAza karo nA?
teAmarA ye Aguna prajvalita karo, se samparke bheve dekhecha ki?
teAmarA ki era gAcha sRSTi karecha, nA Ami sRSTi kari?
Ami tAke karechi smaraNikA evaM marucArIdera janya uttama pAtheYa|
ataeva, tumi teAmAra mahAna ravera nAmera pavitratA gheASaNA karo|
Ami zapatha karachi, tArakArAjira astAcalera
nizcaYai eTA eka mahA zapatha-yadi teAmarA jAnate|
nizcaYai eTA sammAnita kuraAna,
yA Ache eka surakSita kitAve (lAohe mAhaphuje)
pUta-pavitrarA vyatIta keu tAke sparza kare nA|
eTA jagatasamUhera ravera pakSa theke avatIrNa|
tavuo ki teAmarA ei vANIra prati zaithilya pradarzana karave?
evaM tomarA tomAdera upajIvya vAniYe niYecha ye, tomarA mithyAropa karave|
sutarAM kena naYa—prANa yakhana kaNThanAlIte pau~che|
Ara takhana teAmarA tAkiYe thAko,
athaca Ami teAmAdera ceYe tAra adhika nikaTe thAki; kintu teAmarA dekhate pAo nA|
sutarAM yadi tomarA kArao kartRtvAdhIna nA hao,
tave teAmarA ei AtmAke phiriYe Ano! yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao?
ataHpara yadi se naikaTyazIladera antarbhukta haYa;
tave tAra janye Ache sukha, uttama riyika evaM niYAmAte bharA udyAna|
Ara yadi se DAnapanthIdera antarbhukta haYa,
tave tAke valA have, teAmAra janye DAnapanthIdera pakSa theke sAlAma|
Ara yadi se pathabhraSTa mithyAreApakArIdera antarbhukta haYa,
tave ApyAYana have uttapta pAni diYe|
evaM se nikSepayogya have Agune|
nizcaYai eTA dhruva satya|
ataeva, tumi teAmAra mahAna ravera nAme pavitratA gheASaNA karo|
AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA-kichu Ache, savai AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA gheASaNA kare| tini parAkramazAlI; prajJAmaYa|
AsamAnasamUha o yaminera rAjatva tA~rai| tini jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna| tini sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tinii prathama, tinii zeSa, tinii prakAzamAna, tinii gupta evaM tini sarva viSaYe samyaka jJAta|

tini AkAzasamUha o pRthivI sRSTi karechena chaYadine, ataHpara Araze samAsIna haYechena| tini jAnena—yA bhUmite praveza kare o yA bhUmi theke nirgata haYa evaM yA AkAza theke varSita haYa o yA AkAze utthita haYa| tini teAmAdera sAthei Achena teAmarA yekhAnei thAko| teAmarA yA karo, AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|
AkAzasamUha o pRthivIra rAjatva tA~rai| savakichu AllAharai dike pratyAvartita have|
tini rAtake dine praveza karAna evaM dinake praveza karAna rAte| tini antarera viSaYAdi samparkeo samyaka jJAta|

teAmarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati ImAna Ano evaM tini teAmAderake yAra uttarAdhikArI karechena, tA theke vyaYa karo| teAmAdera madhya theke yArA ImAna Anave o vyaYa karave, tAdera janya raYeche mahApuraskAra|

teAmAdera kI halo, teAmarA AllAhara prati ImAna Anacha nA, athaca rAsUla teAmAderake teAmAdera ravera prati ImAna Anate AhvAna karache? evaM AllAha teA pUrvei teAmAdera aGgIkAra niYechena—avazya yadi teAmarA tAte vizvAsI hao|
tinii tA~ra vAndAra prati prakAzya AYAta avatIrNa karena, teAmAdera andhakAra theke AleAte vera kare AnAra janya| nizcaYai AllAha teAmAdera prati karuNAmaYa, asIma daYAlu|

teAmAdera kI halo, tomarA AllAhara pathe vyaYa karacha nA! athaca AkAzasamUha o pRthivIra mAlikAnA to AllAharai; teAmAdera madhye ye mAkkA vijaYera pUrve vyaYa kareche o jihAda kareche, (evaM ye paravartI) se samAna naYa; emana leAkerA tAdera ceYe maryAdAYa zreSTha, yArA pare vyaYa kareche o jihAda kareche| tave AllAha ubhaYake pratizruti diYechena kalyANera| teAmarA yA karo, AllAha se samparke samyaka jJAta|
ke sei vyakti, ye AllAhake uttama RNa deve? tA hale tini tAra janye tA vahuguNe vRddhi karavena evaM tAra janye raYeche sammAnajanaka puraskAra|

yedina tumi dekhave mu’mina o mu’minAdera, tAdera sAmane o DAnapAze tAdera jyeAti choTAchuTi karave, (valA have) ‘Aja teAmAdera janye jAnnAtera susaMvAda, yAra taladeze pravAhita haYa nada-nadI, tAte tomarA sthAYI; eTAi mahAsAphalya|

yedina munAphika puruSa o munAphika nArIrA mu’minadera valave, teAmarA AmAdera janya apekSA karo, AmarA kichu AleA neva teAmAdera jyeAti theke| valA have, teAmarA pechane phire yAo evaM AleAra kheA~ja karo| ataHpara tAdera mAjhakhAne sthApana karA have ekaTi prAcIra, yAra ekaTi darajA have| tAra abhyantare thAkave rAhamAta evaM vAire thAkave zAsti|

tArA tAderake Deke valave, AmarA ki teAmAdera sAthe chilAma nA? tArA valave, hyA~, kintu teAmarA nijerAi nijedera vipadagrasta karecha| tomarA (AmAdera amaGgalera) pratIkSA karecha, sandeha peASaNa karecha evaM alIka AzA tomAdera vibhrAnta kareche, avazeSe AllAhara Adeza pau~cheche| Ara mahApratAraka zaYatAnai teAmAdera AllAha samparke pratArita kareche|

ataeva, Aja teAmAdera kAcha theke keAno muktipaNa grahaNa karA have nA evaM kAphiradera thekeo naYa| teAmAdera AvAsasthala jAhAnnAma| seTAi teAmAdera yogya sthAna| katai-nA nikRSTa ei pratyAvartanasthala!

yArA mu’mina, tAdera janya ki AllAhara smaraNe evaM ye satya avatIrNa haYeche, tAra kAraNe hRdaYa vigalita haoYAra samaYa haYani? tArA tAdera mato yena nA haYa, yAdera pUrve kitAva deoYA haYechila| tAdera opara sudIrghakAla atikrAnta haYeche, ataHpara tAdera antarasamUha kaThina haYe geche| Ara tAdera adhikAMzai chila pApAcArI|
teAmarA jene rAkho, AllAhai pRthivIke tAra mRtyura para punarujjIvita karena; Ara Ami AYAtasamUha vizadabhAve teAmAdera janya vyakta karechi, yena teAmarA anudhAvana karo|
nizcaYai dAnazIla puruSa o dAnazIla nArI evaM yArA AllAhake uttama RNa deYa, tAderake vahuguNa vRddhi kare deoYA have evaM tAdera janye raYeche sammAnajanaka puraskAra|

Ara yArA AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ane, tArAi tAdera ravera kAche siddIka o zahIda, tAdera janya raYeche puraskAra o jyeAti; Ara yArA asvIkAra kare evaM AmAra nidarzana mithyA sAvyasta kare, tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

teAmarA jene rAkho, pArthiva-jIvana to krIr3A-kautuka, sAja-sajjA, tomAdera pArasparika ahamikA evaM dhana-sampada o santAnasantatite prAcurya vyatIta Ara kichu naYa| tAra upamA vRSTira mato, yAra utpanna phasala kRSakadera camatkRta kare! erapara tA zukiYe yAYa, phale tumi tA pItavarNa dekhate pAo, erapara tA khar3akuTAYa pariNata haYa| Ara parakAle Ache kaThina zAsti evaM AllAhara pakSa theke kSamA o santuSTi; tave pArthiva-jIvana pratAraNAra upakaraNa chAr3A kichu naYa|

teAmarA pratiyogI hao teAmAdera ravera pakSa theke kSamA o jAnnAtera, yAra prazastatA AkAza o pRthivIra prazastatAra mato| eTA prastuta karA haYeche tAdera janya, yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera prati ImAna Ane| eTA AllAhara kRpA, tini yAke icchA dAna karena| Ara AllAha mahAanugrahazIla|
pRthivIte athavA teAmAdera vyaktigata paryAYe yekono viparyaYa Ase, se viSaYe jagat sRSTira pUrvei likhita Ache, Ami tA saMghaTita karava| nizcaYai eTA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|
eTA ejanya ye, yena teAmarA yA hArAo, tAra janya duHkhita nA hao evaM tini teAmAdera yA diYechena, se janye ullasita nA hao| AllAha keAno uddhata ahaMkArIke pachanda karena nA|
yArA kRpaNatA kare evaM mAnuSake kRpaNatAra nirdeza deYa; evaM (evaM dAnera nirdeza theke) ye mukha phiriYe neYa, (tAra jAnA ucita) nizcaYai AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|

nizcaYai Ami AmAra rAsUlagaNake suspaSTa nidarzanasaha pAThiYechi evaM tA~dera sAthe avatIrNa karechi kitAva o nyAYanIti, yena mAnuSa inasApha pratiSThA kare| Ara Ami avatIrNa karechi lohA, tAte Ache pracaNDa zakti evaM mAnuSera vahuvidha upakAra| eTA ejanye ye, AllAha jene nevena, ke adekhA sattveo tA~ke evaM tA~ra rAsUlagaNake sAhAyya kare| nizcaYai AllAha zaktidhara, parAkramazAlI|
Ami nUha o ivarAhImake rAsUlarUpe pAThiYechi evaM tAdera vaMzadharera madhye navuoYAta o kitAva avyAhata rekhechi| ataHpara tAdera keu keu hidAYAtaprApta haYeche evaM adhikAMzai haYeche pApAcArI|

ataHpara Ami tAdera pechane pAThiYechi AmAra rAsUlagaNake evaM tAdera anugAmI karechi mAraiYAma-tanaYa IsAke evaM tAke diYechi inajIla| Ami tAra anusArIdera antare sthApana karechi namratA o daYA| Ara vairAgya, se teA tArA nijerAi udbhAvana kareche; Ami eTA tAdera opara pharaja karini; kintu tArA AllAhara santuSTilAbhera janye eTA avalamvana kareche| ataHpara tArA yathAyathabhAve tA pAlana kareni| tAdera madhye yArA ImAna enechila, Ami tAderake tAdera prApya puraskAra diYechi| Ara tAdera adhikAMzai pApAcArI|

he mu’minagaNa, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ano| tini nije anugrahera dviguNa aMza teAmAdera devena, teAmAdera devena jyeAti, yAra sAhAyye teAmarA calave evaM teAmAdera kSamA karavena| AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
eTA ejanya ye, kitAvadhArIrA yena jAnate pAre, AllAhara sAmAnya anugrahera oparao tAdera keAno kSamatA nei, evaM daYA AllAharai hAte; tini yAke icchA, tA dAna karena| AllAha mahAanugrahazIla|

ye nArI tAra svAmIra viSaYe tomAra sAthe vAdAnuvAda karache evaM phariYAda peza karache AllAhara nikaTe, AllAha tAra kathA zunechena| Ara AllAha tomAdera kathopakathana zonena| nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, samyaka draSTA|

teAmAdera madhye yArA tAdera strIdera sAthe jihAra kare, tAdera strIrA tAdera mA naYa| tAdera mA kevala tArAi, yArA tAdera janmadAna kareche| tArA teA asamIcIna o bhittihIna kathAi vale| nizcaYa AllAha mArjanAkArI, kSamAzIla|

yArA tAdera strIdera sAthe jihAra kare, ataHpara tArA yA valeche, tA theke phire Ase; tArA eke aparake sparza karAra pUrve ekaTi dAsa mukta karave| era dvArA teAmAdera upadeza deoYA haYa| Ara AllAha khavara rAkhena teAmarA yA karo|

kintu ye tA pAve nA, se eke aparake sparza karAra pUrve lAgAtAra dui mAsa siYAma pAlana karave| ye tAte sakSama naYa, se SATa jana abhAvagrastake AhAra karAve| eTA ejanye, yena teAmarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ano| eguleA AllAhara nirdhArita sImA| Ara kAphiradera janye raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

yArA AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare, tArA apadastha haYeche, yemana apadastha haYeche tAdera pUrvavartIrA| Ami suspaSTa AYAtasamUha avatIrNa karechi| Ara kAphiradera janye raYeche lAJchanAkara zAsti|

(sedina smaraNIYa); yedina AllAha tAdera sakalake punarutthita karavena, ataHpara tAdera jAniYe devena—yA tArA karata| AllAha tAra hisAva rekhechena, Ara tArA tA bhule geche| AllAha sarvaviSaYa samyaka sAkSI|

tumi ki lakSa kareAni ye, AsamAna o yamine yA-kichu Ache, AllAha tA jAnena| tina vyaktira emana keAno parAmarza haYa nA, yekhAne tini caturtha nA thAkena evaM pA~cajanerao haYa nA, yekhAne tini SaSTha nA thAkena; tArA era ceYe kama heAka vA vezi heAka, tArA yekhAnei thAkuka-nA kena, tini tAdera sAthe Achena, tArA yA kare, tini kiYAmatera dina tA tAdera jAniYe devena| nizcaYa AllAha sarvaviSaYe samyaka jJAta|

tumi ki lakSa karoni tAdera prati, yAdera gopana parAmarza karate niSedha karA haYechila, tAraparao tArA tAra punarAvRtti karala, yA tAdera niSedha karA haYechila; era sAthe pApAcAra, sImAlaGghana o rAsUlera avAdhyatAra janya gopana parAmarza kare| tArA yakhana tomAra kAche Ase, takhana tomAke emanabhAve abhivAdana kare, yA dvArA AllAha tomAke abhivAdana karenani| tArA mane mane vale, AmarA yA vali, sejanya AllAha AmAdera zAsti dena nA kena? jAhAnnAmai tAdera janya upayukta| tArA tAte praveza karave| katai nA nikRSTa sei AvAsa|

he mu’minagaNa, teAmarA yakhana gopana parAmarza karo, takhana pApAcAra, sImAlaGghana o rAsUlera avAdhyatAra janya gopana parAmarza kareA nA; varaM klyANakara kAjera kheAdAbhItira vyApAre gopana parAmarza kareA| AllAhake bhaYa karo, yA~ra kAche teAmarA ekatrita have|
mUlata gopana parAmarza teA zaYatAnera kAja; mu’minadera duHkha deoYAra janye| tave AllAhara icchA vyatIta se tAdera keAno kSati karate pAre nA| mu’minadera ucita AllAhara oparai bharasA karA|

he mu’minagaNa, yakhana teAmAderake valA haYa, majalise sthAna prazasta kare dAo, takhana teAmarA (sthAna) prazasta kare diYo| AllAha teAmAdera janya (sthAna) prazasta kare devena| yakhana valA haYa, uThe yAo, takhana uThe yeYeA| teAmAdera madhye yArA ImAna eneche AllAha tAdera maryAdA u~cu kare devena| evaM yAderake jJAna dAna karA haYeche, tAdera janya raYeche vibhinna maryAdApUrNa stara| AllAha khavara rAkhena—yA-kichu teAmarA karo|

he mu’minagaNa, yakhana teAmarA rAsUlera sAthe ekAnte kathA valate cAo tomarA ekAnte kathA valAra pUrve sadakA pradAna karave| eTA teAmAdera janya uttama evaM gunAha theke parizodhanakArI| yadi tAte sakSama nA hao, tave AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

teAmarA ki ekAnte kathA valAra pUrve sadakA pradAna karate bhaYa peYe gele? ataHpara yakhana teAmarA tA karate pArale nA evaM AllAha teAmAdera kSamA kare dilena, takhana teAmarA sAlAta kAYema karo, yAkAta pradAna karo evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karo| teAmarA yA karo, AllAha se samparke samyaka jJAta|

tumi ki tAdera prati lakSa karani, yArA emana eka sampradAYera sAthe vandhutva kare, yAdera prati AllAha ruSTa? tArA musalimadera dalabhukta naYa evaM tAderao dalabhukta naYa| tArA jenezune mithyA zapatha kare|
AllAha tAdera janye kaTheAra zAsti prastuta rekhechena| nizcaYa tArA yA kare, khuvai manda|
tArA tAdera zapathaguloke DhAla hiseve grahaNa kare, ataHpara tArA AllAhara pathe vAdhA pradAna kare| ataeva, tAdera janya raYeche lAJchanAkara zAsti|
AllAhara viparIte tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati kichui tAdera kono kAje Asave nA| tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, tArA sekhAne sthAYI|

yedina AllAha tAdera sakalake punarutthita karavena| ataHpara tArA AllAhara sAmane zapatha karave, yemana teAmAdera sAmane zapatha kare| tArA mane kare ye, tArA kono kichura upare raYeche| (arthAt tArA ebhAve vipada o zAsti theke ve~ce yAve) sAvadhAna, tArAi teA mithyAvAdI!
zaYatAna tAdera vazIbhUta kare niYeche, ataHpara AllAhara smaraNa bhuliYe diYeche| tArA zaYatAnera dala| sAvadhAna, zaYatAnera dalai kSatigrasta|
nizcaYa yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare, tArAi lAJchitadera dalabhukta|
AllAha likhe diYechena, Ami evaM AmAra rAsUlagaNa avazyai vijaYI hava| nizcaYa AllAha zaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|

tumi pAve nA emana kono sampradAYake; yArA AllAha o parakAlera prati ImAna Ane, AvAra tArA tAdera sAthe vandhutvao kare; yArA AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare, tArA tAdera pitA, putra, bhrAtA athavA jJAti-geASThI yei hoka| tAdera antare AllAha ImAna likhe diYechena evaM tAdera zaktizAlI karechena tA~ra adRzya zakti dvArA| tini tAderake jAnnAte praveza karAvena, yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita haYa nada-nadI| tArA sekhAne cirakAla thAkave| AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa evaM tArA AllAhara prati santuSTa| tArAi AllAhara dala| jene rAkho, AllAhara dalai saphalakAma|
AsamAna o yamine yA-kichu Ache, savai AllAhara pavitratA varNanA kare| tini parAkramazAlI prajJAvAna|

tinii kitAvidera madhye yArA kAphira, tAdera prathamavAra ekatrita kare tAdera vAr3i-ghara theke vahiSkAra karechena| teAmarA dhAraNAo karate pAroni ye, tArA vera have evaM tArA mane karechila ye, tAdera durgaguleA AllAhara kavala theke tAdera rakSA karave| ataHpara AllAhara zAsti tAdera opara emana dika theke elo, yA tArA kalpanAo karate pAreni| tini tAdera antare trAsa saJcAra kare dilena| tArA tAdera vAr3i-ghara nijedera hAte evaM musalimadera hAte dhvaMsa karachila| ataeva, he cakSuSmAna vyaktigaNa, teAmarA zikSAgrahaNa karo|
AllAha yadi tAdera janya nirvAsana avadhArita nA karatena, tave tAdera duniYAte zAsti ditena| Ara parakAle tAdera janye raYeche jAhAnnAmera zAsti|
eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kareche| ye AllAhara viruddhAcaraNa kare, (tAra jAnA ucita ye,) nizcaYa AllAha zAstidAne kaTheAra|

teAmarA ye khejuragAchagulo keTe phelecha athavA seguloke tAdera mUlera upara dA~r3Ano avasthAYa cher3e diYecha, o savai teA AllAharai anumatikrame tomarA karecha| eTi ejanya ye, tini avAdhyadera lAJchita karena|

AllAha tAdera nikaTa theke tA~ra rAsUlake yA phAI diYechena, sejanye teAmarA gheAr3AYa vA uTe car3e yuddha karoni, kintu AllAha yAra opara icchA, tA~ra rAsUlagaNake kartRtva dAna karena| Ara AllAha sarva viSaYe sarva zaktimAna|

AllAha janapadavAsIdera kAcha theke tA~ra rAsUlake yA diYechena, tA AllAhara, rAsUlera, (rAsulera) AtmIYasvajanera, iYAtImadera, abhAvagrastadera evaM pathacArIdera janye, yena zudhu teAmAdera madhyakAra vittavAnadera mAjhei (dhana-sampada) Avartita nA haYa| rAsUla teAmAdera yA deYa, tA grahaNa karo evaM yA niSedha kare, tA theke virata thAko evaM AllAhake bhaYa karo| nizcaYa AllAha zAstidAne kaTheAra|

ei sampada abhAvagrastha muhAjiradera janya, yArA nijedera vAstubhiTA o dhana-sampada theke utkhAta haYeche| tArA AllAhara anugraha o santuSTi anveSaNa kare evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlake sAhAyya kare, tArAi satyavAdI|

yArA muhAjiradera Agamanera pUrve mAdInAYa vasavAsa karechila evaM ImAna enechila, tArA tAdera kAche yArA hijarAta kare eseche, tAdera bhAlovAse, muhAjiradera yA deoYA haYeche, tAra janya tArA antare AkAGkSA poSaNa kare nA evaM tArA abhAvagrasta haleo nijedera opara tAdera agrAdhikAra deYa| yAderake manera kRpaNatA theke mukta rAkhA haYeche, tArAi saphalakAma|

Ara yArA tAdera pare eseche, tArA vale, he AmAdera rava, AmAderake evaM ImAne agraNI AmAdera bhAiderake kSamA karo evaM mu’minadera viruddhe AmAdera antare keAno vidveSa rekheA nA| he AmAdera rava, nizcaYa tumi daYAvAna, asIma daYAlu|

tumi ki munAphikadera dekhoni? tArA tAdera kitAvadhArI kAphira bhAidera vale, teAmarA yadi vahiSkRta hao, tave AmarA avazyai teAmAdera sAthe dezatyAgI havo evaM teAmAdera vyApAre AmarA kakhano kArao kathA mAnava nA| Ara yadi teAmarA AkrAnta hao, tave AmarA avazyai teAmAdera sAhAyya karava| AllAha sAkSya dena ye, nizcaYai tArA mithyAvAdI|

yadi tArA vahiSkRta haYa, tave munAphikarA tAdera sAthe dezatyAga karave nA| Ara yadi tArA AkrAnta haYa, tave tArA tAdera sAhAyya karave nA| yadi tAderake sAhAyya karate Ase, tave avazyai pRSThapradarzana karave| erapara kAphirarA keAno sAhAyyai pAve nA|
nizcaYa teAmarA tAdera antare AllAha apekSA adhika bhaYaMkara| eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA eka nirvodha sampradAYa|

tArA saGghavaddhabhAveo teAmAdera viruddhe yuddha karate pArave nA; kintu kevala surakSita janapade athavA durga-prAcIrera Ar3Ala theke| tAdera pArasparika yuddhai pracaNDa| tumi tAderake aikyavaddha mane karo; kintu tAdera antara zatadhAvicchinna| eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA eka nirvodha sampradAYa|
erA tAdera mato, yArA tAdera nikaTa atIte nijedera kAjera kuphala bheAga kareche| tAdera janye raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
tArA zaYatAnera mato, ye mAnuSake vale kuphuri karo| ataHpara yakhana se kuphuri kare, takhana zaYatAna vale, Ami tomAra theke dAYitvamukta| Ami vizvajagatera rava AllAhake bhaYa kari|
ataHpara ubhaYera pariNati have ei ye, tArA jAhAnnAme yAve evaM sekhAne tArA sthAYI have| eTAi sImAlaGghanakArIdera zAsti|

he mu’minagaNa, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo| pratyeka vyaktira lakSya karA ucita, AgAmI kAlera janye se kI agrima pAThiYeche| AllAhake bhaYa karate thAko| teAmarA yA karo, nizcaYa AllAha se samparke samyaka jJAta|
teAmarA tAdera mato haYeA nA, yArA AllAhake bhule geche| phale AllAha tAdera AtmavismRta kare diYechena| tArAi pApAcArI|
jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI evaM jAnnAtera adhivAsI samAna hate pAre nA| yArA jAnnAtera adhivAsI, tArAi saphalakAma|
yadi Ami ei kuraAna pAhAr3era upara avatIrNa karatAma, tave tumi avazyai tAke dekhate ye, AllAhara bhaYe vinIta o vidIrNa| Ami esava dRSTAnta mAnuSera janye varNanA kari, yena tArA cintA kare|
tinii AllAha, yini vyatIta keAno ilAha nei; tini dRzya o adRzyake jAnena; tini parama daYAmaYa, asIma daYAlu|
tinii AllAha, yini vyatIta keAno ilAha nei| tinii adhipati, pavitra, zAntidAtA, nirApattAdAtA, rakSaka, parAkrAnta, pratApAnvita| atIva mahimAnvita, tArA yAke aMzIdAra kare AllAha tA theke pavitra|
tinii AllAha, sraSTA, udbhAvaka, rUpadAtA, uttama nAmasamUha tA~rai| AsamAna o yamine yA-kichu Ache, savai tA~ra pavitratA gheASaNA kare| tini parAkrAnta prajJAmaYa|

he mu’minagaNa, teAmarA AmAra o teAmAdera zatrudera vandhurUpe grahaNa kareA nA| teAmarA teA tAdera prati vandhutvera vArtA pAThAo, athaca ye satya teAmAdera kAche eseche, tArA tA asvIkAra karache| tArA rAsUla o teAmAdera utkhAta kare; kAraNa teAmarA teAmAdera rava AllAhara prati ImAna rAkho| yadi teAmarA AmAra santuSTira sandhAne evaM AmAra pathe jihAda karAra janye vera haYe thAko, tave kena teAmarA geApane tAdera sAthe vandhutva karacha? teAmarA yA geApana karo evaM yA prakAza karo, tA Ami khuva jAni| teAmAdera madhya theke ye eTA kare, se saralapatha theke vicyuta haYe yAYa|
yadi tArA tomAdera peYe yAYa, tArA have tomAdera zatru evaM kSatisAdhanera uddezye tArA tomAdera prati tAdera hAta o ‍mukha samprasAraNa karave evaM tArA to ei kAmanA kare ye, tomarAo kuphuri karo!
teAmAdera svajana-parijana o santAna-santati kiYAmatera dina keAno upakAre Asave nA| tini teAmAdera madhye phAYasAlA karavena| AllAha oi viSaYa samyaka draSTA—yA tomarA karo|

teAmAdera janye ivarAhIma o tAra saGgIgadera madhye uttama Adarza raYeche| yakhana tArA tAdera sampradAYake valechila, teAmAdera sAthe evaM teAmarA AllAhara parivarte yAra ivAdAta karo, tAra theke AmarA samparkamukta| AmarA teAmAderake asvIkAra kari| teAmAdera mAjhe o AmAdera mAjhe sRSTi halo zatrutA o vidveSa cirakAlera janya; yatakSaNa nA teAmarA eka AllAhara prati ImAna Ano| kintu ivarAhImera ukti tAra pitAra uddeze vyatikrama| (se valechila,) Ami avazyai teAmAra janya kSamAprArthanA karava| evaM tomAra vyApAre AllAhara nikaTa Ami kono adhikAra rAkhi nA| he AmAdera rava, AmarA ApanArai opara bharasA karechi, ApanArai dike mukha karechi evaM ApanArai nikaTa AmAdera pratyAvartana|
he AmAdera rava, Apani AmAderake kAphiradera janya parIkSAra pAtra karavena nA| he AmAdera rava, AmAdera kSamA karuna| nizcaYa Apani parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tomarA yArA AllAha o zeSa divasera pratyAzA kareA, teAmAdera janya tAdera madhye uttama Adarza raYeche, Ara ye mukha phiriYe neYa, (tAra jAnA ucita), AllAha amukhApekSI, prazaMsita|
yAdera sAthe teAmarA zatrutA karacha, sambhavata AllAha tAdera o teAmAdera madhye vandhutva sRSTi kare devena| AllAha sarva zaktimAna evaM AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|

dInera vyApAre yArA teAmAdera viruddhe yuddha kareni evaM teAmAdera deza theke vahiSkRta kareni, tAdera prati sadAcaraNa o inasApha karate AllAha teAmAdera niSedha karena nA| nizcaYa AllAha inasAphakArIdera bhAlovAsena|

AllAha kevala tAdera sAthe vandhutva karate niSedha karena, yArA dInera vyApAre teAmAdera viruddhe yuddha kareche, teAmAdera deza theke vahiSkRta kareche evaM vahiSkArakArye sAhAyya kareche| yArA tAdera sAthe vandhutva kare tArAi sImAlaGghanakArI|

he mu’minagaNa, yakhana teAmAdera kAche mu’mina nArIrA hijarAta kare Ase, tomarA tAdera parIkSA karo| AllAha tAdera ImAna samparke samyaka jJAta| yadi teAmarA jAno ye, tArA mu’mina, tave Ara tAdera kAphiradera kAche pherata pAThiYo nA| erA kAphiradera janye hAlAla naYa evaM kAphirarA edera janye hAlAla naYa| kAphirarA yA vyaYa kareche, tA tAdera diYe dAo| teAmarA ei nArIdera viYe karale teAmAdera aparAdha have nA, yadi tomarA tAderake tAdera mohara pradAna karo| teAmarA kAphira nArIdera sAthe dAmpatya-samparka vajAYa rekheA nA| teAmarA yA vyaYa karecha, tA ceYe nAo evaM tArAo ceYe neve—yA tArA vyaYa kareche| eTA AllAhara vidhAna; tini teAmAdera madhye phAYasAlA karena| AllAha sarvajJa prajJAmaYa|

teAmAdera strIdera madhye yadi keu hAtachAr3A haYe kAphiradera kAche cale yAYa, ataHpara teAmarA suyeAga pAo, takhana yAdera strI (hAtachAr3A haYe) cale geche, tAderake tArA yA vyaYa kareche, tAra samaparimANa (artha) pradAna karo evaM AllAhake bhaYa karo, yAra prati teAmarA ImAna rAkho|

he navi, mu’mina nArIrA yakhana tomAra kAche ese vAi’Ata kare, tArA AllAhara sAthe kAuke zarika karave nA, curi karave nA, vyabhicAra karave nA, nijedera santAnadera hatyA karave nA, tArA sajJAne kono apavAda racanA kare raTAve nA evaM satkAje tomAke amAnya karave nA; takhana tAdera vAi’Ata grahaNa karo evaM tAdera janya AllAhara kAche kSamA prArthanA karo| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla asIma daYAlu|

he mu’minagaNa, teAmarA se sampradAYera sAthe vandhutva kareA nA, yAdera prati AllAha ruSTa haYechena| tArA parakAla samparke nirAza haYe geche, yemana kAphirarA kavaravAsIdera samvandhe nirAza haYe geche|
AsamAna o yamine yA-kichu Ache, savai AllAhara pavitratA gheASaNA kare| tini parAkramazAlI prajJAvAna|
he mu’minagaNa, teAmarA yA karo nA, tA kena valo?
teAmarA yA karo nA, tA valA AllAhara kAche khuvai asanteASajanaka|
nizcaYa AllAha tAdera bhAlovAsena, yArA tA~ra pathe sArivaddhabhAve jihAda kare, yena tArA sIsAgAlA prAcIra|

smaraNa karo, yakhana mUsA tAra sampradAYake valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA kena AmAke kaSTa dAo, athaca teAmarA jAno ye, Ami teAmAdera kAche AllAhara rAsUla| ataHpara yakhana tArA vakratA avalamvana karala, takhana AllAha tAdera antara vakra kare dilena| AllAha pApAcArI sampradAYake hidAYAta dAna karena nA|

smaraNa karo, yakhana mAraiYAma-tanaYa IsA valala, he vani isarAIla, Ami teAmAdera nikaTa AllAhara rAsUla, AmAra pUrvavartI tAorAtera satyAYanakArI evaM Ami emana ekajana rAsUlera susaMvAdadAtA, yini AmAra pare Agamana karavena; tA~ra nAma AhamAda| ataHpara yakhana se tAdera kAche spaSTa pramANAdi niYe elo, tArA valala, e teA prakAzya yAdu|
ye vyakti isalAmera dike AhUta haYeo AllAha samparke mithyA racanA kare; tAra cAite adhika sImAlaGghanakArI Ara ke? AllAha hidAYAta dAna karena nA sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYake|
tArA mukhera phu~tkAre AllAhara AleA nibhiYe dite cAYa| Ara AllAha tA~ra AleAke pUrNatA dAnakArI; yadio kAphirarA tA apachanda kare|
tini tA~ra rAsUlake patha nirdeza o satyadharma diYe pAThiYechena, yAte eke sava dInera opara pravala kare dena yadio muzarikarA tA apachanda kare|
he mu’minagaNa, Ami ki teAmAdera emana eka vANijyera sandhAna deva, yA teAmAdera yantraNAdAYaka zAsti theke mukti deve?
tA ei ye, teAmarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Anave evaM AllAhara pathe tomAdera dhana-sampada o jIvana diYe jihAda karave| eTAi teAmAdera janye uttama; yadi teAmarA jAnate!
tini teAmAdera pAparAzi kSamA karavena evaM emana jAnnAte praveza karAvena, yAra pAdadeza diYe pravAhita haYa nada-nadI evaM cirasthAYI jAnnAtera uttama vAsagRhe| eTA mahAsAphalya|
Arao ekaTi (anugraha devena), yA teAmarA pachanda karo| AllAhara pakSa theke sAhAyya evaM Asanna vijaYa| tumi mu’minaderake era susaMvAda dAo|

he mu’minagaNa, teAmarA AllAhara sAhAyyakArI haYe yAo, yemana IsA ivanu mAraiYAma tAra ziSyavargake valechila, AllAhara pathe ke AmAra sAhAyyakArI have? ziSyavarga valechila, AmarA AllAhara pathe sAhAyyakArI| ataHpara vani isarAIlera ekadala ImAna Anala evaM ekadala kAphira haYe gela| yArA ImAna enechila, Ami tAderake tAdera zatrudera viparIte zakti yeAgAlAma, phale tArA vijaYI halo|
AsamAnasamUha o yamine yA Ache, savai AllAhara pavitratA ghoSaNA kare| yini adhipati, mahApavitra, parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tinii ummidera (nirakSaradera) madhya theke tAdera ekajanake rAsUla kare pAThiYechena, ye tAdera kAche telAoYAta kare tA~ra AYAtasamUha, tAderake parizuddha kare evaM zikSA deYa kitAva o hikamata| yadio itopUrve tArA spaSTa pathabhraSTatAYa chila|
Ara tAdera paravartIrA, ekhano yArA tAdera sAthe milita haYani (tAderakeo parizuddha kare o zikSA deYa)| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
eTA AllAhara kRpA, yAke icchA tini tA dAna karena| AllAha mahA-anugrahazIla|

yAdera tAorAtera dAYitvabhAra deoYA haYechila, ataHpara tArA tAra bhAra vahana kareni, tAdera dRSTAnta sei gAdhAra mato, ye pustaka vahana kare| se sampradAYera dRSTAnta kata nikRSTa, yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake mithyA vale! AllAha sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYake hidAYAta dAna karena nA|
valo, he iYAhUdi sampradAYa, yadi teAmarA dAvi karo ye, teAmarAi AllAhara vandhu; anya keAno mAnavasampradAYa naYa, tave teAmarA mRtyu kAmanA karo yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao|
tArA nijedera kRtakAjera kAraNe kakhano mRtyu kAmanA karave nA| AllAha sImAlaGghanakArIdera samparke samyaka jJAta|

valo, ye mRtyu theke teAmarA pAlAccho, sei mRtyu avazyai teAmAdera mukhAmukhi have, ataHpara teAmAdera adRzya o dRzyera jJAnI AllAhara kAche phiriYe neoYA have| tini teAmAdera jAniYe devena sesava karma, yA teAmarA karate|

he mu’minagaNa, juma ’ Ara dine yakhana sAlAtera AyAna deoYA haYa, takhana teAmarA AllAhara smaraNera janya druta agrasara hao, evaM vecAkenA cher3e dAo| eTA teAmAdera janya uttama yadi teAmarA upaladdhi karo|
ataHpara yakhana sAlAta samApta have, teAmarA pRthivIte char3iYe par3o evaM AllAhara anugraha tAlAza karo| Ara AllAhake adhika smaraNa karo, yAte teAmarA saphalakAma hao|

yakhana tArA kono kraYa-vikraYa vA khela-tAmAzA dekhe, takhana tArA tomAke dA~r3AneA avasthAYa rekhe sedike chuTe yAYa| valo, AllAhara kAche yA Ache, tA khela-tAmAzA o kraYa-vikraYa apekSA utkRSTa| AllAha sarveAttama riyikadAtA|

yakhana munAphikarA tomAra kAche Ase, tArA vale, AmarA sAkSya dicchi, nizcaYai Apani AllAhara rAsUla| AllAha jAnena ye, tumi avazyai tA~ra rAsUla evaM AllAha sAkSya dicchena, munAphikarA avazyai mithyAvAdI|
tArA tAdera zapathaguloke DhAlarUpe vyavahAra kare| ataHpara tArA AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi kare| tArA yA karache, tA khuvai manda|
eTA ejanya ye, tArA ImAna AnAra para kuphuri kareche| phale tAdera antare meAhara mere deoYA haYeche| tAi, tArA vujhe nA|

tumi yakhana tAdera dekho, takhana tAdera dehera gar3ana tomAke mugdha kare| Ara yadi tArA kathA vale, tave tumi tAdera kathA (sAgrahe) zono| yadio tArA yena deoYAle Thesa deoYA kATha| pratyeka var3a AoYAjake tArA nijedera viruddhe mane kare| tArAi zatru; ataeva, tAdera samparke satarka hao| dhvaMsa karuna AllAha tAderake| tArA vibhrAnta haYe yAcche keAthAYa?
yakhana tAdera valA haYa, teAmarA eso, AllAhara rAsUla teAmAdera janya kSamAprArthanA karavena, takhana tArA mAthA ghuriYe neYa evaM tumi tAdera dekhave ye, tArA dambhabhare phire yAYa|
tumi tAdera janya kSamAprArthanA karo athavA nA karo, ubhaYai tAdera kSetre samAna| AllAha kakhano tAdera kSamA karavena nA| AllAha pApAcArI sampradAYake hidAYAta dAna karena nA|
tArAi vale, AllAhara rAsUlera sAhacarye yArA Ache tAdera janye vyaYa kareA nA| yatakSaNa nA tArA sare par3e| AsamAna o yaminera dhana-bhAnDAra AllAharai; kintu munAphikarA tA veAjhe nA|

tArAi vale, AmarA yadi mAdInAYa pratyAvartana kari, tave sekhAna theke sammAnitarA avazyai hInadera vahiSkRta karave| mAna-sammAna o zakti teA AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o mu’minaderai; kintu munAphikarA tA jAne nA|
he mu’minagaNa, teAmAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati yena teAmAdera AllAhara smaraNa theke udAsIna nA kare| yArA eTA kare, tArAi teA kSatigrasta|

Ami teAmAderake yA riyika diYechi, tA theke tomAdera kAro mRtyu AsAra Agei vyaYa karo| anyathAYa se valave, he AmAra rava, AmAke Arao kichukAla paryanta avakAza dile nA kena? tA hale Ami sadakA karatAma evaM satkarmIdera antarbhukta hatAma|
Ara AllAha kakhano kono prANakei avakAza devena nA, yakhana tAra nirdhArita samaYa ese yAve| teAmarA yA karo, AllAha se viSaYe samyaka jJAta|
AsamAna o yamine yA-kichu Ache, savai AllAhara pavitratA gheASaNA kare| rAjatva tA~rai evaM prazaMsA tA~rai| tini sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tinii teAmAdera sRSTi karechena, ataHpara teAmAdera madhye keu haYa kAphira evaM keu haYa mu’mina| AllAha se vyApAre samyaka draSTA—yA tomarA karo|
tini AsamAna o yaminake yathAyathabhAve sRSTi karechena evaM teAmAdera AkRti dAna karechena, ataHpara sundara karechena teAmAdera AkRti| tA~rai kAche pratyAvartana|
AsamAna o yamine yA Ache, tini tA jAnena| tini Arao jAnena teAmarA yA geApana karo evaM yA prakAzya karo| AllAha antarera viSaYAdi samparke samyaka jJAta|
itopUrve yArA kuphuri kareche, tAdera vRttAnta ki teAmAdera kAche pau~cheni? tArA tAdera kAjera manda pariNAma AsvAdana kareche, evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

eTA e kAraNe ye, tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa prakAzya nidarzanAvalIsaha Asata, takhana tArA valata, mAnuSai ki AmAdera hidAYAta dAna karave? ataHpara tArA kAphira haYe gela evaM mukha phiriYe nila| tAi AllAha vimukha halena, AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|

kAphirarA dAvi kare ye, tArA kakhano punarutthita have nA| valo, avazyai have, AmAra ravera kasama, teAmarA nizcaYa punarutthita have| ataHpara teAmAdera avahita karA have yA teAmarA karate| eTA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|
ataeva, teAmarA AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla evaM Ami ye nUra avatIrNa karechi, tAra prati ImAna Ano| teAmarA yA karo, se viSaYe AllAha samyaka jJAta|

yedina tini tomAdera samaveta karavena samAvezera dine| e dina hAra-jitera dina| ye vyakti AllAhara prati ImAna Ane evaM satkAja kare, tini tAra pApasamUha meAcana karAvena evaM tAke jAnnAte praveza karAvena| yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita have nada-nadI, tArA sekhAne cirasthAYI| eTAi mahAsAphalya|
Ara yArA kuphuri kare evaM AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare, tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, tArA sekhAne sthAYI| tA katai nA manda pratyAvartanasthala|
keAno vipada AllAhara anumati chAr3A Apatita haYa nA evaM ye AllAhara prati ImAna Ane, tini tAra antarake hidAYAta dAna karena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe samyaka jJAta|
teAmarA AllAhara Anugatya karo evaM rAsUlera Anugatya karo| yadi teAmarA mukha phiriYe nAo, tave AmAra rAsUlera dAYitva zudhu spaSTabhAve pau~che deoYA|
AllAha; tini vyatIta keAno ilAha nei| ataeva, mu’minarA yena AllAhara opara bharasA kare|

he mu’minagaNa, teAmAdera keAno keAno strI o santAna-santati teAmAdera duzamana| ataeva, tAdera vyApAre satarka thAko| yadi mArjanA karo, upekSA karo, evaM kSamA karo, tave AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
teAmAdera dhanasampada o santAnasantati teA kevala parIkSA| Ara AllAhara kAche raYeche mahApuraskAra|
ataeva, teAmarA yathAsAdhya AllAhake bhaYa karo, zono, Anugatya karo evaM vyaYa karo| eTA teAmAdera janye kalyANakara| yArA manera kArpaNya theke mukta, tArAi hacche saphala|
yadi teAmarA AllAhake uttama RNa dAna karo, tini teAmAdera janye tA vahu guNa kare devena evaM teAmAdera kSamA karavena| AllAha guNagrAhI, sahanazIla|
tini dRzya o adRzyera jJAnI, parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he navi, teAmarA yakhana strIdera tAlAka dite cAo, takhana tAdera tAlAka diYeA iddatera prati lakSa rekhe evaM iddata hisAva rAkho| teAmarA teAmAdera rava AllAhake bhaYa kareA| tAderake tAdera ghara theke vera kare diYo nA evaM tArAo yena vera nA haYa; yadi nA tArA keAno suspaSTa nirlajja kAje lipta haYa| eguleA AllAhara nirdhArita sImA| ye vyakti AllAhara vidhAna laGghana kare, se nijerai aniSTa kare| tumi jAneA nA, haYateA AllAha ei tAlAkera para keAno upAYa kare devena|

ataHpara tArA yakhana tAdera iddatakAle pau~che, takhana tAdera yatheApayukta panthAYa rekhe deve athavA yatheApayukta panthAYa cher3e deve evaM teAmAdera madhya theke du’jana nyAYaparAYaNa leAkake sAkSI rAkhave| teAmarA AllAhara janya saThika sAkSya deve| eTA dvArA ye vyakti AllAha o parakAlera prati ImAna Ane, tAke upadeza deoYA hacche| Ara ye AllAhake bhaYa kare, tini tAra janya patha kare devena|

evaM tAke tAra dhAraNAtIta jAYagA theke riyika devena| ye vyakti AllAhara opara bharasA kare, tAra janye tinii yatheSTa| AllAha tAra kAja pUrNa karavena| AllAha savakichura janya ekaTi parimANa sthira kare rekhechena|

teAmAdera strIdera madhye yArA RtuvartI haoYAra AzA hAriYeche yadi tomarA (tAdera iddatera vyApAre) saMzaYe thAko, tave tAdera iddata have tina mAsa| Ara yArA ekhano RtuvatI haYani, (tAderao iddatakAla anurUpa have|) garbhavartI nArIdera iddatakAla santAnaprasava paryanta| ye AllAhake bhaYa kare, tini tAra kAja sahaja kare dena|
eTA AllAhara nirdeza, tini tA teAmAdera prati avatIrNa karechena| ye AllAhake bhaYa kare, tini tAra pApa meAcana karena evaM tAra pratidAnake mahAna kare dena|

teAmarA teAmAdera sAmarthAnuyAYI yekhAne vAsa karo, tAderakeo sekhAne vAsa karate dAo| tAderake saMkaTApanna karAra janya kaSTa diYo nA| yadi tArA garbhavatI haYa, tave santAnaprasava paryanta tAdera vyaYabhAra vahana karave| yadi tArA teAmAdera santAnadera dudha pAna karAYa, tave tAdera prApya pArizramika dAo evaM e samparke paraspara saMyatabhAve parAmarza karo| Ara yadi teAmarA paraspara (nija nija dAvite) anamanIYa hao, tave anya nArI dudha pAna karAve|

vittazAlI vyakti yena tAra vitta anuyAYI vyaYa kare| yAra riyika sImita karA haYeche, se yena AllAha tAke yA diYechena, tA theke vyaYa kare| AllAha yAke yA diYechena, tAra cAite gurutara vojhA tini kArao opara cApiYe dena nA| AllAha kaSTera para sukha-svasti devena|
aneka janapada tAdera rava o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera Adeza amAnya karechila, ataHpara Ami tAdera kaTheAra hisAva niYechilAma evaM tAderake bhISaNa zAsti diYechilAma|
ataHpara tAdera kAjera zAsti AsvAdana karala evaM tAdera kAjera pariNAma kSatii chila|
AllAha tAdera janye yantraNAdAYaka zAsti prastata rekhechena; ataeva, he vuddhimAnagaNa, yArA ImAna enecha, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karo| AllAha teAmAdera prati upadeza avatIrNa karechena|

ekajana rAsUla, yini teAmAdera kAche AllAhara suspaSTa AYAtasamUha pATha karena, yena yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare, tAderake andhakAra theke AleAte vera kare Anate pArena| ye AllAhara prati ImAna Ane o satkAja kare, tini tAke praveza karAvena jAnnAte, yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita haYa nada-nadI, sekhAne tArA have cirasthAYI| AllAha tAke uttama riyika devena|

AllAha tinii saptAkAza sRSTi karechena evaM pRthivIo sei parimANe, esavera madhye tA~ra Adeza avatIrNa haYa, yena teAmarA jAnate pAro ye, AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarva zaktimAna evaM jJAnera dvArA AllAha savakichuke pariveSTana kare Achena|
he navi, AllAha tomAra janya yA hAlAla karechena, tumi tomAra strIdera khuzi karate ceYe kena tA nijera janya hArAma karo? AllAha kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|
AllAha teAmAdera zapatha theke avyAhati lAbhera upAYa nirdhAraNa kare diYechena| AllAha teAmAdera sahAYa| tini sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

smaraNa karo, yakhana navi tAra ekajana strIra kAche geApane ekaTi kathA valala, ataHpara yakhana se (strI) tA (anyake) jAniYe dilo evaM AllAha navira kAche eTA prakAza kare dilena, takhana navi se viSaYe (tA~ra strIke) kichu vyakta karala evaM kichu er3iYe gela| navi yakhana tA strIke jAnAla, takhana strI valala, ke ApanAke e samparke avahita karala? navi valala, AmAke avahita karechena tinii, yini mahAjJAnI sarvajJa|

(he navira strIdvaYa) yadi teAmarA ubhaYe tAovA karo, (tave bhAlo kathA), kAraNa teAmAdera ubhaYera antara (anyAYera pakSe) jhu~ke par3echila| Ara yadi navira viruddhe eke aparake sAhAyya karo, tave (jene rekho) AllAha, jivarAIla evaM satkarmaparAYaNa mu’minagaNa tAra sahAYa| uparantu pherezatAgaNao tAra sAhAyyakArI|

yadi navi teAmAdera sakalake parityAga kare, tave sambhavata, tA~ra rava (tomAdera) parivarte tAke devena teAmAdera ceYe uttama strI, yArA have AjJAvaha, mu’minA, AnugatyazIlA, tAovAkAriNI, ivAdAtakAriNI, siYAmapAlanakAriNI, akumArI o kumArI|

he mu’minagaNa, teAmarA nijedera evaM teAmAdera parivAra-parijanake Aguna theke rakSA karo, yAra indhana have mAnuSa o pAthara, yAte niYeAjita Ache nirmama, kaTheAra pherezatAgaNa| AllAha tAderake yA Adeza karena, tArA tA amAnya kare nA evaM yA tAdera Adeza karA haYa, tA-i kare|
he kAphira sampradAYa, teAmarA Aja oyara peza kareA nA| teAmAderake tArai pratiphala deoYA have, yA teAmarA karate|

he mu’minagaNa, teAmarA AllAhara kAche tAovA karo—vizuddha tAovA| AzA karA yAYa, teAmAdera rava teAmAdera theke meAcana karavena teAmAdera manda karmasamUha evaM teAmAdera praveza karAvena jAnnAte, yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita haYa nada-nadI | sedina AllAha navi evaM tAra mu’mina sahacaradera apadastha karavena nA| tAdera nUra tAdera sAmane o DAnadike dhAvita have| tArA valave, he AmAdera rava, AmAdera nUrake pUrNa kare dina evaM AmAdera kSamA karuna| nizcaYa Apani savakichura upara sarva zaktimAna|
he navi, kAphira o munAphikadera viruddhe jihAda karo evaM tAdera prati kaTheAra hao| tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma| tA katai nA nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala|

AllAha kAphiradera janya nUha-patnI o lUta-patnIra dRSTAnta varNanA karechena| tArA chila AmAra vAndAdera madhya theke duijana satkarmaparAYaNa vAndAra adhIne| ataHpara tArA tAdera sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karala| phale tArA (nUha o lUta) tAderake AllAha theke rakSAYa kono kAje Aseni evaM valA halo, tomarA ubhaYe anya pravezakArIdera sAthe jAhAnnAme praveza karo|

AllAha mu’minadera janya phiraAuna-patnIra dRSTAnta varNanA karechena| se valala, he AmAra rava, tomAra sannikaTe jAnnAte AmAra janye ekaTi ghara nirmANa karo, AmAke phiraAuna o tAra karma theke uddhAra karo evaM AmAke sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYa theke mukti dAo|

Ara (dRSTAnta varNanA karechena) imarAna-tanaYA mAraiYAmera, ye tAra satItva rakSA karechila| ataHpara Ami tAra madhye AmAra pakSa theke rUha phu~ke diYechilAma evaM se tAra ravera vANI o kitAvake satye pariNata karechila| se chila vinaYa prakAzakArINIdera ekajana|
varakatamaYa tini, yA~ra hAte rAjatva| tini sarva viSaYe sarva zaktimAna|
yini sRSTi karechena maraNa o jIvana, teAmAdera parIkSA karAra janya ke teAmAdera madhye karme sarvazreSTha? tini parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla|
yini sapta AkAza stare stare sRSTi karechena| tumi daYAmaYera sRSTite keAno garamila dekhate pAve nA| punarAYa dRSTi pherAo; keAno truTi dekhate pAo ki?
ataHpara tumi vAraMvAra dRSTi pherAo, tomAra dRSTi vyartha o parizrAnta haYe tomAra dike phire Asave|
Ara Ami pRthivIra AkAzake susajjita karechi pradIpamAlA dvArA; seguleAke zaYatAnadera janye nikSepaNera upakaraNa karechi evaM Ami prastuta kare rekhechi tAdera janye jvalanta Agunera zAsti|
yArA tAdera ravake asvIkAra kare tAdera janye raYeche jAhAnnAmera zAsti; katai nA nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala|
yakhana tArA tanmadhye nikSipta have, takhana tAra garjana zunate pAve Ara tA have udvelita|
kreAdhe se (jAhAnnAma) yena pheTe par3ave| yakhanai tAte keAno sampradAYa nikSipta have takhana tAdera tAra praharIrA jijJAsA karave, ‘ teAmAdera kAche ki keAno satarkakArI Aseni?’

tArA valave, “hyA~, avazyai AmAdera kAche satarkakArI esechila, ataHpara AmarA tAke mithyAvAdI sAvyasta karechilAma evaM valechilAma, ‘AllAha keAno kichu avatIrNa karenani; varaM teAmarA eka mahA vibhrAntira madhye Acha|
tArA Arao valave, ‘hAYa, yadi AmarA zunatAma athavA vodhavuddhi khATAtAma! tave AmarA jAhAnnAmIdera arntabhukta hatAma nA|’
ataHpara tArA tAdera aparAdha svIkAra karave| abhizapta heAka jAhAnnAmera adhivAsIrA|
nizcaYa yArA tAdera ravake nA dekhe bhaYa kare, tAdera janye raYeche kSamA o mahApuraskAra|
teAmarA teAmAdera kathA geApane valo athavA prakAzye valo, tini teA antarera viSaYAdi samparke samyaka avagata|
yini sRSTi karechena, tini ki jAnavena nA? tini sUkSmadarzI, samyaka jJAta|
tini teAmAdera janye pRthivIke sugama karechena, ataeva, teAmarA tAra vibhinna prAnte vicaraNa karo evaM tA~ra deoYA riyika theke AhAra karo| tA~rai kAche punarutthita have|
teAmarA ki e viSaYe bhAvanAmukta haYe gecha, AkAze yini Achena tini teAmAderake bhUgarbhe vilIna kare devena, ataHpara tA kA~pate thAkave, emanaTA hate pAre nA?
nAki teAmarA bhAvanAmukta haYe gecha, yini AkAze Achena, tini teAmAdera opara prastara vRSTi varSaNa karavena nA? takhana teAmarA jAnate pArave kemana chila AmAra satarkavANI!
Ara tAdera pUrvavartIrAo mithyAreApa karechila, ataHpara kata kaTheAra haYechila AmAra dRSTAntamUlaka zAsti|
tArA ki lakSya kare nA, tAdera Urdhvadeze vihaGgakulera prati, yArA pAkhA vistAra kare o pAkhA saMkucita kare? rahamAna vyatIta keu tAdera sthira rAkhe nA; nizcaYa tini sarva viSaYa samyaka draSTA|
rahamAna vyatIta teAmAdera emana keAno sainya vAhinI Ache ki, ye teAmAdera sAhAyya karave? kAphirarA vibhrAntitei patita Ache|
tini yadi riyika vandha kare dena, tave ke Ache, ye teAmAdera riyika deve? varaM tArA avAdhyatA o vimukhatAYa Duve Ache|
ye vyakti upur3a haYe mukhe bhara diYe cale, se-i ki sat pathe cale, nAki se vyakti ye seAjA haYe saralapathe cale?
valo, ‘tinii teAmAderake sRSTi karechena evaM diYechena kAna, cokha o hRdaYa| teAmarA alpai kRtajJatA prakAza karo|’
valo, ‘tinii teAmAdera pRthivIte vistRta karechena evaM tA~rai nikaTa teAmarA samaveta have|’
kAphirarA vale, ‘kave vAstavAYita have ei pratizruti, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao?’
valo, ‘era jJAna AllAha tAAlAra kAchei Ache| Ami teA kevala prakAzya satarkakArI|’
yakhana tArA sei pratizrutike Asanna dekhave takhana kAphiradera mukhamanDala malina haYe par3ave evaM valA have, ‘eTAi teA teAmarA cAite|’

valo, ‘teAmarA bheve dekhecha ki — yadi AllAha tAAlA AmAke o AmAra saGgIderake dhvaMsa karena athavA AmAdera prati daYA karena, (tAte kAphiradera kI?) kAphiraderake ke yantraNAdAYaka zAsti theke rakSA karave?’
valo, ‘tini daYAlu, AmarA tA~ra prati ImAna rAkhi evaM tA~rai opara bharasA kari| acirei teAmarA jAnate pArave, ke prakAzya pathabhraSTatAYa Ache|’
valo, ‘teAmarA bheve dekhecha ki, yadi teAmAdera pAni bhUgarbhera gabhIre cale yAYa, tave ke teAmAderake saravarAha karave pAnira sreAtadhArA?’
nUna, zapatha kalamera evaM tAra yA tArA lipivaddha kare,
tomAra ravera anugrahe tumi ummAda nao|
evaM tomAra janye avazyai raYeche azeSa puraskAra|
evaM tumi avazyai sumahAna caritre pratiSThita|
satvarai tumi dekhe neve evaM tArAo dekhe neve|
ke teAmAdera madhye vikAragrasta|
tomAra rava samyaka jJAta ke tA~ra patha theke vicyuta haYeche evaM tini jAnena yArA satpathaprApta|
ataeva, tumi mithyAreApakArIdera Anugatya karave nA|
tArA cAYa yadi tumi namanIYa hao, tave tArAo namanIYa have|
evaM ye adhika zapatha kare, ye lAJchita, tumi tAra Anugatya karave nA|
ye pazcAte nindA kare ekera kathA aparera nikaTa lAgiYe phire|
ye bhAlo kAje vAdhA deYa, se sImAlaGghanakArI, se pApiSTha,
kaTheAra svabhAva, tadupari kukhyAta;
e kAraNe ye, se pracura dhana-sampada o santAna-santatira adhikArI|
tAra kAche AmAra AYAta pATha karA hale se vale, ‘purono dinera rUpakathA|’
Ami tAra nAsikA dAgiYe deva|
nizcaYai Ami tAderake parIkSA karechi, yemana parIkSA karechi udyAnaoYAlAderake, yakhana tArA zapatha karechila ye, pratyuSe vAgAnera phala AharaNa karave,
‘inazAAllAha’ nA vale |
ataHpara tomAra ravera pakSa theke vAgAne eka vipada ese patita haleA| yakhana tArA nidrita chila|
phale sakAla paryanta haYe gela chinnavicchinna tRNasama|
pratyuSe tArA eke aparake Deke valala,
‘teAmarA yadi phala AharaNa karate cAo, tave sakAla sakAla kSete calo|’
ataHpara tArA calala phisaphisa kare kathA valate valate,
Aja yena keAno misakIna vyakti teAmAdera kAche praveza karate nA pAre|’
ataHpara tArA nivRta karate sakSama e dhAraNA niYe prabhAtakAle vAgAne yAtrA karala|
ataHpara yakhana tArA tA dekhala, takhana valala, ‘AmarA teA patha bhule gechi|’
‘varaM AmarA teA vaJcita|’
tAdera uttama vyakti valala, ‘Ami ki teAmAderake valini, ekhano teAmarA AllAhara pavitratA varNanA karacha nA kena?’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA AmAdera ravera pavitratA gheASaNA karachi, nizcaYai AmarA sImAlaGghanakArI chilAma|’
ataHpara tArA eke aparake bhatrsanA karate lAgala|
tArA valala, ‘hAYa! durbheAga AmAdera; AmarA chilAma sImAtikramakArI|’
‘haYato AmAdera rava era parivarte era cAite uttama vAgAna AmAderake devena| AmarA AmAdera ravera kAche AzAvAdI|’
zAsti ebhAvei Ase evaM parakAlera zAsti Arao gurutara; yadi tArA jAnata!
muttAkidera janya tAdera ravera kAche raYeche niYAmAtapUrNa jAnnAta|
tave ki Ami samarpitaderake aparAdhIdera nyAYa gaNya karava?
teAmAdera kI halo? teAmarA kemana siddhAnta diccha?
teAmAdera ki keAno kitAva Ache, yA teAmarA pATha karo|
tAte teAmarA yA pachanda karo, tAi raYeche?
nAki teAmarA AmAra kAcha theke kiYAmAta paryanta valavat keAno zapatha niYecha ye, teAmarA tAi pAve yA teAmarA sthira karave?
tumi tAdera jijJAsA karo tAdera e viSaYe dAYitvazIla ke?
nAki tAdera keAno zarika Ache? thAkale tAdera zarikadera upasthita karuka yadi tArA satyavAdI haYa|
ye mahAna dine pAYera geAchA unmocana karA have sedina tAdera sAjadA karate AhavAna jAnAneA have, kintu tArA sakSama have nA|
tAdera dRSTi avanamita thAkave; lAJchanA tAdera AcchAdita karave, athaca yakhana tArA sustha o sakSama chila, takhana tAdera sAjadA karate AhvAna karA haYechila|
ataeva, tumi cher3e dAo, AmAke o tAke ye ei kAlAmake mithyA sAvyasta kare; Ami tAdera dhApe dhApe emanabhAve dharava ye, tArA jAnate pArave nA|
Ami tAdera samaYa diYe thAki| nizcaYai AmAra kauzala atyanta majavuta|

athaca ei kuraAna teA vizvajagatera janye upadeza chAr3A kichu naYa|

ataHpara yAke AmalanAmA DAna hAte deoYA have, se valave, ‘nAo, teAmarAo AmAra AmalanAmA par3e dekho|’
‘Ami jAnatAma, AmAke hisAvera sammukhIna hate have|’
sutarAM se santoSajanaka jIvane thAkave;
samunnata jAnnAte|

‘Ami yadi nA jAnatAma AmAra hisAva!’
