e kAraNe, se nijeke mane kareche ye se svaYaMsampUrNa haYe geche|
nizcaYa tomAra ravera nikaTa pratyAvartana sunizcita|
tumi ki tAke dekhecha, ye vAdhA deYa
eka vAndAke yakhana se sAlAta AdAYa kare?
tumi dekhecha ki, yadi se saThika pathera opara thAke|
athavA tAkaoYAra nirdeza deYa|
tumi dekhecha ki, yadi se mithyAreApa kare o mukha phiriYe neYa|
tave se ki jAne nA ye, AllAha dekhena?
kakhanoi naYa, se yadi virata nA haYa, tave Ami hi~car3e niYe yAva mAthAra sAmanera kezaguccha dhare—
mithyAcArI, pApiSThera kezaguccha|
takhana, se yena tAra sabhAsadadera AhvAna kare!
Amio AhvAna karava jAhAnnAmera praharIdera|
kakhanoi naYa, tumi tAra Anugatya karave nA| tumi sijadAha karo evaM AmAra naikaTya arjana karo|
nizcaYai Ami eke avatIrNa karechi mahimAnvita rAte (lAilAtula kadare),
Ara tomAke kIse jAnAve mahimAnvita rAta kI?
mahimAnvita rAta halo hAjAra mAsa apekSA zreSTha|
tAte pherezatArA o rUha (jivarAIla) avatIrNa haYa tAdera ravera anumatikrame; sakala siddhAnta niYe|
zAntimaYa se (rAta), phajara udaYa paryanta|
Ahale kitAvadera madhye yArA kAphira o muzarika tArA pratyAvartanakArI have nA, yatakSaNa nA tAdera kAche pau~che suspaSTa pramANa|
AllAhara nikaTa theke ekajana rAsUla, ye tilAoYAta karave pavitra sahIphAsamUha,
yAte Ache supratiSThita vidhAnAvalI|
Ara yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche, tArA to vibhakta haYeche tAdera kAche suspaSTa pramANa AsAra para|

athaca tAdera ei nirdeza karA haYeche ye, tArA AllAhara ivAdAta karave vizuddhabhAve zudhu tA~rai Anugatya kare, ekaniSThabhAve, Ara sAlAta kAYema karave evaM yAkAta pradAna karave| eTAi pratiSThita dharma|
Ahale kitAvadera madhye yArA kuphuri kareche evaM muzarikarA jAhAnnAmera Agune sthAYIbhAve thAkave, tArAi sRSTira adhama|
nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, tArAi sRSTira zreSTha|

tAdera ravera kAche raYeche tAdera pratidAna sthAYI jAnnAta, yAra taladeze pravAhita haYa nada-nadI| tArA sekhAne sthAYI have| AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa evaM tArA AllAhara prati santuSTa| eTA tAra janye, ye tAra ravake bhaYa kare|
yakhana pRthivI tAra kampane prakampita have,
evaM pRthivI yakhana tAra veAjhAgulo vera kare deve|
evaM mAnuSa valave, tAra kI halo?
sedina se tAra vRttAnta varNanA karave,
kAraNa, tomAra rava tAke Adeza karechena|
sedina mAnuSa vibhinna dale vera haYe Asave, yena tAderake tAdera kRtakarma dekhAneA yAYa|
ataHpara keu aNu parimANa satkarma karale tA dekhate pAve|
Ara keu aNu parimANa asatkarma karale tAo dekhate pAve|
zapatha UrdhvazvAse dhAvamAna ghor3AsamUhera;
phale yegulo kSurAghAte Agunera sphUliGga vicchuraNa kare
ataHpara prabhAtakAle AkramaNa kare,
ataHpara se sekhAne dhUli ur3AYa,
ataHpara dhUli DhAkA avasthAYa zatrudalera abhyantare Dhuke par3e—
nizcaYai mAnuSa tAra ravera prati var3ai akRtajJa|
evaM se avazyai e viSaYe avahita o sAkSI
se nizcaYai dhana-sampadera bhAlovAsAYa pravala|
se ki se samaYa samparke jAne nA, ye samaYe kavare yA Ache, sesava utthita have
evaM antare yA Ache, tA prakAza karA have?
nizcaYa tAdera rava sedina tAdera yA kichu ghaTave, se samparke savizeSa jJAta|
mahApralaYa!
kI sei mahApralaYa?
evaM kIse tomAke jAnAve, kI sei mahApralaYa?
sedina mAnuSa have vikSipta pataGgera mato
evaM parvatamAlA have dhunita raGina pazamera mato|
ataeva, yAra (nekera) pAllA bhArI have,
se thAkave santoSajanaka jIvane,
Ara yAra (nekera) pAllA hAlakA have,
tAra ThikAnA have hAviYA|
evaM kIse tomAke jAnAve, kI seTA?
seTi jvalanta Aguna!
Adhikyera pratiyogitA teAmAdera gAphela kare rekheche,
yatakSaNa nA tomarA kavare upanIta hao;
eTA kakhano ucita naYa| teAmarA satvarai jAnate pArave|
ataHpara eTA kakhano ucita naYa| teAmarA satvarai jAnate pArave|
kakhanoi nA| teAmarA yadi nizcita jJAne jAnate|
teAmarA avazyai jAhAnnAma dekhave,
ataHpara teAmarA tA avazyai dekhave cAkSuSa vizvAse,
erapara avazyai sedina teAmarA niYAmata samparke jijJAsita have|
kAlera zapatha
nizcaYai mAnuSa kSatira madhye raYeche;
kevala tArA vyatIta yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare evaM parasparake satyera upadeza deYa evaM parasparake upadeza deYa savarera|
pratyeka pechane o sAmane paranindAkArIra janya durbheAga,
ye sampada jamA kare evaM gaNanA kare;
se mane kare ye, tAra sampada tAke amara kare rAkhave|
kakhano nA, se avazyai nikSipta have hutAmAYa|
evaM kIse tomAke jAnAve, hutAmAh kI?
eTA AllAhara prajjvalita Aguna,
yA hRtpiNDa paryanta pau~che yAve|
nizcaYa tA tAdera ghire rAkhave|
lamvA lamvA khu~Tira madhye|
tumi ki dekhoni, tomAra rava hAtIvAhinIra sAthe kemana vyavahAra karechena?
tini ki tAdera cakrAnta vyartha kare denani?
tini tAdera viruddhe pAThiYechena jhA~ke jhA~ke pAkhi,
yArA tAdera opara pAthure kaGkara nikSepa karachila| sUrA Ala-phIla-105, avatIrNa dhArA-19
ataHpara tini tAdera kheYe phelA khar3era mato kare dena|
kurAizera Asakti/abhyastatAra kAraNe!
tAdera Asaktira kAraNe zIta o grISmakAlIna sapharera|
ataeva, tArA yena ivAdAta kare ei gharera ravera,
yini tAdera kSudhAYa AhAra diYechena evaM (yuddha)-bhIti theke tAdera nirApada karechena|
tumi ki dekhecha tAke, ye vicAra-dinake mithyA abhihita kare?
se to sei vyakti, ye iYAtImake galAdhAkkA deYa|
evaM misakInake khAdyadAne utsAhita kare nA|
ataeva, durbheAga sesava musallira,
yArA tAdera sAlAta samvandhe udAsIna|
yArA pradarzana kare (mAnuSake)
evaM nitya vyavahArya sAmAnya vastu anyake deoYA theke virata thAke|
nizcaYai Ami tomAke kAusAra dAna karechi|
ataeva, tomAra ravera uddezye sAlAta AdAYa karo evaM kuravAni karo|
nizcaYai tomAra prati vidveSa poSaNakArI, se-i nirvaMza| sUrA Ala-kAphiruna-109/18,
valo, ‘he kAphirarA’!
Ami tAra ivAdAta kari nA, teAmarA yAra ivAdAta karo|
evaM teAmarAo tAra ivAdAtakArI nao, yAra ivAdAta Ami kari|
evaM Ami ivAdAtakArI nai tAra, yAra ivAdAta teAmarA karacha|
evaM teAmarAo ivAdAtakArI nao, yAra ivAdAta Ami karachi|
tomAdera janya tomAdera dIna evaM AmAra janya AmAra dIna|
yakhana Asave AllAhara sAhAyya o vijaYa,
evaM tumi mAnuSake dale dale AllAhara dIne praveza karate dekhave,
takhana tumi prazaMsAsaha tomAra ravera pavitratA varNanA karo evaM tA~ra kAche isatigaphAra karo| nizcaYai tini tAovA kavulakArI|
dhvaMsa heAka Avu lAhAvera dui hAta evaM dhvaMsa heAka se nije;
tAra dhana-sampada evaM tAra upArjana tAra keAno kAje Aseni;
satvarai se praveza karave lelihAna zikhAyukta Agune|
evaM tAra strIo, ye indhana vahanakAriNI,
tAra galAYa raYeche pAkAno razi |
valo, tinii AllAha, ekaka-advitIYa,
AllAha amukhApekSI evaM sakale tA~ra mukhApekSI
tini kAuke janma denani evaM keu tAke janma deYani
evaM tA~ra samakakSa keu nei|
valo, Ami AzraYa grahaNa karachi prabhAtera ravera,
tini yA sRSTi karechena, tAra aniSTa theke,
Ara andhakAra rAtera aniSTa theke, yakhana tA gabhIra haYa,
Ara gi~Te phu~ diYe yArA jAdu kare, tAdera aniSTa theke
evaM hiMsukera aniSTa theke yakhana se hiMsA kare|
valo, Ami AzraYa grahaNa karachi mAnuSera ravera,
mAnuSera adhipatira,
mAnuSera ilAhara
AtmageApanakArI kumantraNAdAtAra aniSTa theke,
ye kumantraNA deYa mAnuSera antare
jina o mAnuSera madhya theke|
